༷// / sha ji rtse / sna khu nga gangangan ri

dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas snyel dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur nyi dpe bsdur ma nga/ra skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i ske dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin ske legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhud sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu kho//spung lha'i bod rig pa dpe rgyun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad noX te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de ga 'an la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las kur gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyong rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser spug nang blta na dpe rnying 'tshor bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba pa'i tshes7la/

ba// sgrig gab55 bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa sang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khrag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgyal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (ka) (kha) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) (cha) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja she (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) stergyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkan mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags6)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)sde phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (she (tshan ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtoge ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā snyel 'a gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su la3 7nga tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañja 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags(2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ rmad la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ba khugazhang bstan dpe rnying 'chos bas phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyo lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yaṃ sa kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchode rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mjad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin r+ṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /mer gnang gas dpe rnying 'chos ba phyogs ga khang nas/10

dkar chaga'abrug pa sprul sku rin po ches mdzad pa'i tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms ba'i sman gcig (1)'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi yang snying / (29)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ (30)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bsnyen yig dngos grub gter mdzod/ (58)thod sku la brten nas tshe bdag nag po bsnyen pa'i reg zig mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs/ (63)'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ (69)tshe bdag rnon po nad gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ (116)'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ (129)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar (142)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa'i reg zig zhib mo rnam dag (153)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las mtha' yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje'i pha lam zhes bya ba/ (163)'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam bcas pa (171)

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog dkyil la mkho ba'i sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal/ (172)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda'/ (179)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can zhes bya ba/ (201)'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa zhes bya ba/ 4223)zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu shā/na zhes bya ba/ (250)'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa ceXs bya ba/ (321)zil gnon drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba/ (345)'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ (354)'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon sum ston pa'i lag bcangs/ (386)yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+e ḍūrla 'a do shal zhes bya ba/ (395)yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'i lhan thabs rigs 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ (407)yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ (418)yang bzlog (436)yang bzlog nag po me'i skru gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po/ (438)rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ka zhes bya ba/ (450)2

'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa (475)gshin rje khro chu dug sdong gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor spu gri 'bar ba (478)dum pa rgya'i gter ga'i ki gang dmar chung gi brgyud 'debs/ (482)gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed lde mig (483)gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang ma yig dang bu yig tu mi gsal ba'i kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro (490)gshin rje zhing gang dmar na gshigatang rag (506)'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i brgyud 'debs/ (507)'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad sgom lung bya tshul mthong bas don ldan/ 4510)las kyi gshin rje'i 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra/ (520)gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ (537)sbyin sreg gi sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig (552)rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dngos grub nyin mor byed pa zhes bya ba/ (555)dbang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum 'i lda/gas pa'i lcags kyu/ (557)drag po'i sbyin sreg bskal pa'i me dpung bzhugs/ (558)'jam dpal gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi drag po zor gyi 'phrin las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda'/ (562)'chi bdag zhal dbye'i phrin las rgyun 'khyer tshig nyung don gsal ba/ (600)

༄༅༅//'brug pa sprul sku rin po ches mdzad pa'i tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig bzhugs/༄༅//na mo mnyu badzā ya/cung zad sems gnas tsam la grub thob ces//cher rlom me khyer ma yin mtshan dpe'i sku//'ja' lus rdo rje'i snang bas srid zhi'i smag/mthar mdzad pad 'byung nyin byed rigs kyi bdag/man ngag phra mo'i khron par khengs pa'i snying //'gas pa'i ban sngags sbal chung mang mthong tshe//las bzhi'i rgya mtshor mthu stobs gdengs ka can//gnubs chen klu dbang rnam thar yid kyi gsos//pad gnubs gshed skor bka' gter mtho ris chab//rnam dpyod ltor gtams rigs 'dzin dzaḥ'i//legs bshad zhal skyugs 'khrul med gaṅgā'i rgyun//snga 'gyur 'dzin mar 'bebs kun phyag gi yul/khyad par se ston paṇa chen sku mched kyi//gdams pa'i bka' babs chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i//man ngag mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs drod po che//stsol mkhas chos dbyings rang grol snying dbus bzhugs//snang ba lha ru blta phyir gang zag rnams//dag par mos kyang 2na ) de yi chos tshul cher//dpyod pa mkhas pa'i lugs yin phyogs 'di la//sbyangs rnams rna ba blags te dpang po mdzod//de yang 'brug lugs pa rnams kyi nang nas mkhas pa'i yang rtser son pa sprul pa'i sku rin po che pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi yig cha 'ga' zhig 'dug pa'i brgyud 'debs bya nag rigs kyi zhabs drung gong ma'i phyag dpe thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bris kyi bu yig mar/rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas//slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la//zhes gsungs pa ni/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'jam dpal zhes pa'i mtshan tsam la 'byul pa'i rnam par ma brtags pa ste slob dpon 'di ni sirnya la'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin zhing ri bo me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mor gshin rje gshed kyi dngos grub brnyes pa sogs rnam thar shin tu rgyas/ rgya nag tu 'byon bzhugs ma mdzad pa'i mtha' bkag pa min kyang 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub tu grags che bas/ ri bo rtse lnga gnas kyi gtso bor mdzad pa stag lung du sems can gyi khrod nas mar rkyal tsho ba dang rbab rdo mgyogs pa gleng bar (2ba tha sngags pa'i lo rgyus ltar bka' brgyud pa'i thugs mos brtan po de ga'i dkyus su song ba 'dra/ skyon sprul pa'i zhing khams su/ /rigs 'dzin shrī sidha la/ /zhes gsungs pa shrī sidha paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan lta bu yin na'ang / bka' 'byed du/ shrī sidha sa byas pa la/ /sngon 'gro snying byang sgron ma yod/ /sgrub thabs rtag rab brtsegs pa yod/ /pra khrid 'khor lo'i sgrig rim yod/ /tshe bdag gsum du phye ba yod/ /maṇ+ḍal rgya mdud brtsegs pa yod/ /thun mong tshe bdag la sogs pa'i/ /phyi nang rtags kyi ngos 'dzin yod/ /las bzhi'i mngon rtogs med pa yod/ /'khor lo nyi shu tham pa yod/ /ces gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos skor du sgrig tu med par gsungs shing / bam chen gsang ba'i dbang gi mjug tu 'jam dpal bshes gnyen des sgrub thabs lag len thams cad mdzad nas shrī sidha la zhes pa lcags 'dra'i skor 'ga' zhig la dgongs kyi lcags sdig phyogs kyi brgyud par ye mi bzhugs pas de'i bla ma'i khrod du 'dren pa ni rje mar pas lta ba mi tri ba la phu thag bcad pa gsung la gsal yang gnas lugs phyag rgya'i brgyud khungs kyi skabs su/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ zhes g.yag mgo sho bzhag gis 'dren pa'i rnam thar de 'dir yang 'gebs par mdzad snang / bka' 'byed du slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa zhig kyang bshad rung 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la lcags sdig gnam lcags thog me/ lcags 'dra gnam lcags thog me/thun mong bsrung mtshams kyi chos sogs mang du yod pas lkugs pa'i rigs 'gre mdzad par mi rigs so/ /chos 'di'i brgyud pa'i bla ma ni (3na)chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku phyag rgya zil gnon/sprul sku gsang ba'i bdag po/ lha'i bu tshangs pa/ lha'i bu nyi ma/ lha'i bu bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' —2

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(khana'agro ma zla ba'i 'od zer/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gtsug lag dpal dge /rom bu gu phya de ba tsan+d+ra/ shan+ti gar+bha/ dha na dha la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ bha su dha ra/ jo bo gnubs ban sangs rgyas rin po che/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom zhes yod bas bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyang phyag rgya chen po'i slong du 'jam dar yug gcig la song bar snang / lcags sdig gi glegs bam gter du sbas pa las 'dra min bka' mar bzhag pa med pas gter brgyud khe rkyang yin rung dbang la chu bo gnyis 'dres stabs/ gnubasachen nas gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho sogs bka' ma'i brgyud lugs rgyas par yod pa snyan gyi dbang por ma son pa 'dra'o/ /rgya zhang khrom gyi rjes su/ gnubs chen gu ru mchog ldan dang / /mthu chen rgyal mtshan lhun grub la/ /zhes pa'i brgyud lugs 'di 'dra ni bka' brgyud pa dpon slob tsho thugs khog yangs drags pa min pa gzhan gyi blor mi chud de/ rgyu mtshan sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis phung po ri bo che dang lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas 'jam dpal gshin rje me'i skru gri'i chos skor rnams gdan drangasate lha rje gnubs chung ba la gnang / rje btsun mi la ras pas gnubs khu lung du drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag gsan nas a khu dang a ne sogs nye ba dgrar langs rnams la mthu mdzad pa/ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi dri lan du/ 'o na khye'u chung bzhin legs so/ /khyod rtogs 'dod can de tshur nyen dang / /mi nga ngo khyod kyis shes ma shes/ /mi nga ngo (3bsgo rgyad kyis ma shes na/ /mi nga rang mi la ras pa yin/ /lte ba gung thang smad du bcad/ /slob gnyer dbus gtsang mthil du bgyis/ /pha dges ston rngog mis dbu mdzad nas/ /rong ston lha dga' yan chad du/ /lar drin can gyi bla ma brgya tsam bzhugs/ /chos ni rgyud sde snga 'gyur zhus/ khong lta dgongs kyi chos la mkhyen pa mtho/ khyad par lha rje gnubs chung la/ /drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhus/ /zhes gsungs pas gter ston rgya zhang khrom rje mi la las cung zhig snga/ mi la dang bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba dus mtshungs/ bla ma sku bsrung pa rgyal mtshan lhun grub dang / sgar pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ bya 'jam dbyangs chos grags/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ dga' ldan chos rje smon lam dpal ba rnams bsres gzhen tsam ma gtogs thog mnyam pas gnubs chung pa —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nas bla ma sku bsrung pa'i bar la/ 'dus pa bde dgyes tshe 'khrid sogs brgyud rim mang por bla ma sku tshe thung ba rnams bor ba'i kha grangs nyung ngur bsdus kyang drug bdun med thebs mi 'dug pas dgongs 'tshal/ rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar du nga la mthu gza' gdong dmar nag ces bya ba hūṃ shi dang phaṭa 'gyel thongs pa zhig yod pa de/ gtsang rong gi gnubs khu lung bya ba na bla ma khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho bya ba sman yang shes sngags kyang shes pa zhig yod pa de la byin/ khong la ser ba mdzub khrid thongs pa zhig 'dug pa de nga la byin nas nged gnyis mthun pa'i grogs po byas te nga la mthu slob tu byung tshad khong du gtong bar byas/ khong la ser ba slob tu byung tshad nga can gtong bar byas yod pas/ zhes pa'ang gtsang smyon pas bla ma gnubs chung pa (4na)dang yon tan rgya mtsho gnyis nor ba'i 'khrul gzhir 'dug /rnam thar chos 'byung lo rgyus khung ma tshor gnubs chen gyi ci sras gnyis 'bangs kya gyen log gis zhabrug par bkrongs pas thugs chad de rgya dpe rnams stag sgro gzig sgror bcug pa rgya bong gu pa zhig la bkal te rgya gar du skyel bar dgongs te lam du chas pa na/ g.yas ban ma bon dang mjal nas khyim du gdan drangs/ bon pos chang nyo bar phyin pa so ye shes dbang phyug dang phrad nas dris pa rang la mchod gnas gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes yod smras pas sos mjal par byon de dang dus mtshungs su pa kor 'phags pa blon chen/ sru legs pa'i sgron ma/ dan yon tan mchog zhi bas rgya gar du mi gshegs par gsol ba bzhin bzhugs nas mdo sgyu sems gsum/ yang dag dang bdud rtsi'i chos rnams gsungs/ snar gyi shug pa nag por bzhugs pa'i tshe gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho lo sum cu lon pa zhig khyi ra la byon pa ri dwags ma sod par nub mo 'khyams nas 'khyags shing ltogs pa la spos kyi dri tshor te gnas shig yod dam snyam btsal bas rnyed de gnubs chen gyi sar byon dris pas rus gnubs yin par mkhyen te chos sgor bcug jo mo 'dre sgom dang gnyis la gshin rje'i dbang bskur/ gshin rje'i man ngag lung rdzod phrang dang mdo sgyu sems phyogs sogs chos mang du gsungs/ sras kyi dam pa lcam sring gnyis zhes kyang grags/ bka' shog rgya bo cher/ rgya gar mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra dang / /phyon —4

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(khanamakhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /bal po'i mkhas pa bha su dha ra dang / /bod kyi mkhas pa dz+nyā na ku mā ras/ /bdag la gnang ba'i man ngag 'di rnams yin/ /byang chub sems kyi (4ba tha ge bco brgyad po/ /don la dbye ba med kyang man ngag so so'i bzhed/ /rtsa 'grel ti ka gces pa'i yig chung ma bu rnams/ /so gnubs gnyis la gtad kyi 'gro don gyis/ /zhes pa so ye shes dbang phyug dang gnubasayon tan rgya mtsho gnyis yin la/ sems can don la byed ba'i man ngag brgya bcu gnyis/ /mkhas pa rnam bzhi'i man ngag rgyun ma bcad/ /byang chub sems don man ngag ngos 'dzin byed pa'i maṇ+ḍi ka /bu gcig yon tan rgya mtsho sems kyi dkyil du bstim/ /zhes 'byung bas gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho ni sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dngos slob yin/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho la thog mar sras gsum byung ba bla ma gshegs skyel la btang ba'i dus ser sna byas nas chos rnams ma phul bas dam tshig gi sel byung ste bla ma'i bka' bzhin chos mang du bskur nas gzhan du sprugs/ bla mas ming dang bcas te lung bstan pa'i sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho dang chung ba gnubs pad+ma dbang rgyal du grags/gcen ye shes rgya mtsho bon po dang 'gras par gcung la dbus su 'phrin btang ste gdams pa zab mo'i dpe khyer ba rnams bskur gsungs pa bzhin 'byor nas las sbyor mdzad pas bon po rnams kha phud du btang / gcung pad+ma dbang rgyal la sras gcig dang sras mo brgyad yod pa'i sras gnubs lha rje 'jam dpal gyis zhang pa tshab kyi jo mo khab tu bzhes par sras lha rje gnubs chung pa'am ye shes gzungs su grags pa 'byungs/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho dang gnubs chung pa'i bar mi rabs gnyis kyis chod pas 'khrul gzhi che zhing gso rig gi lo rgyus tshor rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dbu skra la dar yug btags pa'i sne la mtha' bzhi'i sman pa bkug pa rnams bzhag nas (ldan〉snyen bkur te/ mgo nag yongs kyi lha ni btsan po ste/ /des kyang thod du 'khrur bas lha rjer thogs/ /zhes rgya cher bsngagasapa dang chos mtshungs pa bon gyis mnga' bdag la thog 'bebs pa'i dus spar ba gu ru rin po che chos dbang gi yab mes spang rje btsan khrom gyis pho brang gi yang thog tu bzhugs pa'i tshe thog bar snang la —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)dmar hril hril byung ba sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la blangs te bon po'i steng du 'phangs pas sngags pa rnams la yang sman pa dang 'dra bar lha rjer btags pa ma go bar lha rje zer na 'tsho byed cig las 'os med snyam nas/sman yang shes sngags kyang shes zhes sgra dag mdog byed pa rmongs pa'i rang mtshang du gsal/drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag gnubs chung pas g.yung ston khro rgyal la zhus zer ba'ang the tshom gyi gzhi che ste gza' gdong dmar nag ngos 'dzin rnam grangs mangs pa'i gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po yin pa'i phyogs byed mkhan mang ba'i lugs ltar na'ang /chos skor 'di gnubs lugs rang la shin tu rgyas pas gzhan la zhu ba'i don ma byung /la la bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i nang gi gza' rgod skyid rengs yin par 'dod mod/gnubs chen drag sngags thams cad kyi bdag po yin pas chos skyong 'di'i skor ma bzhugs pa'i mtha' ni ci bkag deng sang bka' gter tshad mar grags chung zhing rje btsun bsam gtan gling pa'i gsan yig ltar na skyon chen po nas/cog ro dpal gyi mchod gnas/'khon rdo rje rin wo/'khon shes rab yon to/'khon yon to 'byung gnas/'khon tshul khrimasargyal po/'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/'khon dge skyabs/'khon dge mthong /'khon bal po/'khon shākya blo gros/'khon shes rab 5bskos khrims/'khon dkon cog rgyal po zhes 'byung bas gnubs lugs la brgyud pa gzhan zhig yod na ma gtagos 'khon nas brgyud pa rang ni the tshom gyi gzhin mchis/chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs yab sras kyi bzhed par yang bzlog me'i sbu grir gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag tu ngos 'dzin pas/rgyas gter nas bzhes 'phral gyi gri mgar lag ma de a khu a ne'i mgo bo la bsnun par mngon mod lugs gsum po gang yin gcig tu kha tshon ma chod kyang g.yag zhan pa'i rtswa ltar phyogs re'i mig can du ma song ba ni gal che bar gda'/ras pa brgyad bsgrigs dang bzhi bsgrigs zer ba'i mgur 'bum la lar gnubs chung pa bon po yin khul byas 'dug pa gnag rdzi rgan po chos sgor zhugs ma thag nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por song ba rnams kyis ban bon dbye ba ma byed pa thugs mad ces/den kha 'bul/bla mo sku bsrung pa'i 'og tu/skal

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'dzo mes pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(khanaldan rdo rje rgyal po dang / /dharma ke tu dpon slob la/ /zhes pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma'i khyab 'jug dang gnod sbyin sogs kyi brgyud par/ las wel rtsal/ lo ston rdo rje 'bum/ mthing ma brag 'od/ skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po zhes khrung bas/ las 'brel rtsal gyi sku skye kun mkhyen klong chen pa yin/drung chen rin po che tā'i si tus klong chen pa 'bri gung pa'i bla ma yin zhes sdang bar mdzad pa'i lo rgyusadeb sngon du yod/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po bod du phebs skabs drung chen rin po che gshegs zin/skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po dang dus mtshungs su byung tshod nas/ de rjes mi thog gnyis tsam song nas bla ma sku bsrung pa byung ba gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub nus/ dharma ke tu'i (6na)rjes su/ lcags gtun nag po cho se kyi grags/ /gter ston bya bral mtshan can la/ /zhes snang ba'i lcagasagatun nag po ni gter ston rgya'i dngos slob yin/ de'i slob ma gnubs ston chos grags yin/ gnubasabya bral ba zhes pa las gter ston yin pa kun la ma grags pas rtogs ldan pho mo rnams kyi rmi lam la shar ba yin shas che/ 'di'i slob ma skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po yin pas bla brgyud 'di sngags sdebasabazhin dkrugs pa ni min la che/ brgyud 'debs mngon rtogs kyi thog mar 'don pa sngags gsar rnying kun gyi srol yin rung khyed dpon slob bstod pa'i mjug tu gsung gi yod gda' ba khyad chos bla na med pa zhig yin nam snyam/ smon 'gro paṇa chen gyi phyag dpe'i khrod du lo chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi gsan yig nas 'i bshus pa sngags sdebs snying gzer nag po'i brgyud par/ pad+ma dkar po yan tshe bdag gi brgyud pa bshad ma thag pa bgrangs pa'i mjug tu rin po che lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po/de la lo chen gyis gsan zer ba bris 'dug pa gsang rdzogs brgyud pa dang mthun pa'i gu ru chos dbang nas gdung brgyud slob brgyud kyi rigs tshig gcig kyang med pa'i gnubs lugs nas brgyud pa'i khul de 'dre shar sgo la glud nub sgo kho na'i nang khrol gyi ltad mo phyi bstan du snang yang rjes 'jug rnams ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus brtan drags bas phyag mdzub gang gtad shar lasa'os ci mchis/ las byang dngos kyi skabs lcags sdig gi las byang chen mor/ nges pa'i mchog mthun —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bsgrub 'dod na lus dang mchod rten dkyil 'khor bsgrub de yi lag len rim pa rnams 'di ru legs gsal bkod pa'o:6bzhugasungs pa'i don bka' 'byed du/smad kyi gnyer ma gsum po las bstod bskul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum byung :de yang gces pa'i chos tshan gcig bar gyi gnyer ma gsum po las mngon rtogs che 'bring chung gsum byung : de yang gces pa'i chos tshan gcig ces las byang chen mo dang 'brel bar mngon rtogs chen mos dkyil 'khor/las byang 'bring po dang 'brel bar mngon rtogs tshong pos mar rten bcas cho go/las byang chung ba dang 'brel bar mngon rtogs chung bas gtor bzlog gam lus dkyil rgyun 'byer gyi nyams len du sbyar nas mdzad pa spyir bto dang bye brag las byang dang mngon rtogs r+ṣa mor sbyar ba'i gtor bzlog med ces mtha' bkag pa min rung gzhung gi dngos bstan dang bstun pa ni bstod bskul chen mor/bka' 'byed gser gyi lde mig brtsams:de las gyes pa'i 'phrin las che 'bring chung gsum yod dkyil 'khor mar rten gtor bzlog don lag len don du gsal bar bkod:ces sogs snga phyi'i dgongasapa'i dbang gis las byang gsum dang mngon rtogs gsum byung ba yin pa'i shes byed med par/dkyil 'khor gsum las ye thung la zhes pa'ang mun nag 'dom 'jal du zad/bstod bskul chen mor/hūṃ las 'phros pa'i khro bo bcu//zhes sogs bgegs sgrod kyi sngon du 'dug pa dang 'og tu/steng yang khro bo' rang bzhin la zhes snang ba 'khrugs sdebs kyi dgongs pa ma lon par thog mar khro bo bcu'i bsrung 'khor mdzad nas de rjes bgegs gtor btang zhing mtshams bcad pa ni go rim 'tshol bar ma zad dmigs pa dang lag len shin tu mi bde ba'i steng snga 'gyur gyi sgrub 'phrin phal 7na jir dang 'gal/'di ga'i brjod bya yang snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcur 'phro zer ba snang srid thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i ngang nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsgom dgos rgyu la snang srid tha mal gyi snang ba de ga 'khor lo rtsibs bas song ba don dang ma 'brel zhing bsgom tshe de ltar yin zhe na tshig skyon dngosasu sa zhugs pa' nyes pa gang gis sel/lte bar bdag nyid zil gnon sku//'jigs byed ki la ya sgrog 8

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(kha)pa/ /zhes pa'i ki la thung ngu ca col byed na 'jigs byed ca co'i sgra sgrog par ya mtshan rgyu ma byung zhing tshig grogs kyis ya ma thob rnam dbye ster na drug pa 'jug /ring por byas te phur bu la byed na gdab las kyi skabs ma gtogs gshin rje la phur pa'i sgra bcug pa'ang 'brel chags par ma mngon/ byin 'bebs la dam rdzas byin 'bebs zhes dmigs kyis bkar ba sgrub pa po gnas khang dam rdzas sogs thams cad la byin phab chog pas de 'dra'i rgya chung ba ci la dgos/ mchod rdzas byin brlab kyi skabs raṃ yaṃ waṃ zhes chu'i sa bon waṃ du mdzad pa sngags rnying ma la kho byed pa mi 'thad pa'i dag cha yin 'dug rung gsar ma dang mi mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byed na cho ga phyag len gsang sngags mtha' dag rnams rtsa ba nas gra slog pa'i brda chad gsar du dgos yong bas de ltar na lcags sdig 'phrin las la brten pa bas drag po phur zhabs ma ltar lha'am bla ma che ge mo zhig gis kho bo la rmi lam du gnang ba yin no zhes tshe bdag gsar pa chu las chu sdur rdol ba lta bu mdzad kyang cis ma khyab/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyi skabs/ snang stong dbyer med ye rte ma'i sku/ /zhes snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i sgyu ma'i rol pa lta bur 'chad pa ni chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin gyi phyogs tsam du yang ma song (7bsko/de ting gi don chos sku spros bral ka dag tu ngo 'phrod pa zhig dgos pas/ bstod bskul du/ gang la dngos po'i mtshan ma rdul tsam med ces 'byung bas so/ /longs sku kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la/yon to ye shes mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /zhes rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho lta bu'i nyamasashar ba'ang phyogs tsam du ma song ste/ de ting gi dus spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i gdangs kun ting la 'dir spros bral gyi don dam rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la dmigs pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po 'gag med du 'char ba'i gsal ba la 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa zhig dgos pa yin bas/ bstod bskul las/ sems can yongs la khyab pa yi/ /snying rje'i 'od zer dmar smug ni/ /rang bzhin gsal ba'i ngang du bsgom/ /zhes yang bas so/ /rgyu'i ṣi 'dzin gyi tshe/ sku ni sgyu ma'i phyag rgya cir yang snang / /gsung ni khro bo'i rngam sgra lnga dang ldan/ /zhes 'di'i skabs nas phyag rgya:laganon gyi sprul skur bzhengs—9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa 'dra zhig 'dug na'ang sku'i rnam pa ma yin pa'i rgyu'i sa bon stong pa'i cho 'phrul e yig nam mkha' las sprin byung ba lta bu bsgom pa ni lugs 'di la byang ba'i sngags rgan ral pa can rnams kyi bzhed pa lags pas rtsal bshad kyi thugs bzo 'di dag bya bral rgan po rnams kyi pang du ngal gso bar byos shig /ting 'dzin gsum ni/ gnubs kyi las rim gsal sgron du/ hūṃ/ rtog pa med pa'i chos nyid las/ /dngos po med pa'i ngang nyid du/ /stong pa'i ye shes cir yang gsal/ /chos nyid du ni dbyer med gyur/ /ā+oṃ a ti sam ti hūṃ/ hūṃ gsal ba'i rang bzhin dngos po med/ /kun gyi rang bzhin gsal ba las/ /'dzin sems med (8na)par cir yang snang / /gsal zhing dag pa dbyer med gyur/ /ā+oṃ ma hā sa pa ta sam ti hūṃ/ hūṃ rig pa'i ye shes gsal ba las/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba yin/ /stong pa'i cho 'phrul cir yang 'char/ /ā+oṃ ma hā dz+nyā na sam ti hūṃ/ zhes byung zhing sgrol chen bsam grub rdo rje'i las byang sogs khungs ma mang por yang de ltar yod pa gzur gnas rnams kyi snying la nyang ngo / /gzhal yas khang gi skabs/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta ba bas mchode rten dbyibs/ /zhes pa sgrub chen sogs dkyil 'khor la mchod rten dbyibs yong don med/ bcas chog bsgrub pa'i tshe gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i bshad tshod dang bsgom thebs gnyis ka med pas de 'dra lhan cig tu bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor ya ma zung de gnubs kyi sngags rgan rnams la bed mi 'dug pas mgon mang gi snon ma la rgyag pa zhu/ yang rta babs steng chos kyi 'khor lo zhes sngags gsar ma la grags pa'i 'khor lo dkyus ma'i tshab la mchod rten gyi bum pa yan chad mdzad pa rta babs bum mgo ma la thugs rtse gtad na ni bka' brgyad sogs gzhan la'ang mchod rten bcas chog gi rnam gzhag 'jog dgos pas ha cang thal lo/ /rta babs mchod rten dbyibs zhes pa'i tshig ris la dpags na rta babs de mchod rten gyi dbyibs su song 'dug pas bang rim rnams rta babs kyis yong ba'i bkra bkra zhig shar ba 'dra rung / rta babs snam bu bzhi ma la glang rgyab mig gsum ma dgos pas mchode rten gyi thig rtsa la glang rgyab yod pa ma mthong lhag tu tshe bdag la rta babs snam brgyad ma bshad pas rtog bzo'i dpe 'gebs —10

tshe bdag gi lag char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig/nang ma(khanathebs kyang ma byung bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dus mchode rten brgyad las ma grags rung 8ba ) yig dgon ṣā rdza gcog ma rdzo rten dbyar gyi lo ma'i cod pan can smo gsar du bskrun dgos pa 'dra'o//gtso bo bskyed pa'i skabs/e nyid e ka dza ṭi 'phros 'dus thim zhes rgyud dngos su bshad nas de ma thag/rgyu med klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong //zhes sogs dngos 'gal la song zhing gnam thog chen mo'i lam srol gyi skabs/rgyu dang rkyen las ma bskyed par//zhes pa'i tshig gsan par brten yo ga gsum gyi bsgom lugs ma dgongs par zhal nas ra 'don lug 'don byung ba 'dra/khyung gshog tsam ma gtogs dpal gyi chas brgyad so sor bgrangs pa dang gcig tu bsdoms pa'i gsal kha ma mdzad 'dug pa gter gzhung tshor tshig sna thung ba'i mi gsal zhing rnam bshad dang gsung rgyun snyan du ma dngas pa'i skyon 'dra bas/snga 'gyur gyi rang skad du/spyi gtsug mi 'gyur rdo rje phyed pa'i mas/khamasagasum zil gnon lcang lo ral pa'i chas//pa rol shugs ldan thabs shes gzhog pa'i chas pha rol dpung 'joms phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i chas//gzhan gyis ma thub bsrung ba go khrab chas//nyam nga kun bral rtog med ro gdan chas//'khor 'das ro mnyam khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i chas//nyon mongs kun bsreg bskal pa me dpung chas//zhes 'byung ba'ang rjes 'jug thul gog gcig gi 'og nas sprul sku ba dgu bzhengs mkhan rnams kyi thugs su bzhugs 'tshal/tshogs mtha' ma'i skabs bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi thun bdun pa'i tshig don badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs par snang /bka' brgyad gtso bo 'pho ba'i dbang du mdzad de tshe bdag gi bka' gzhan rnams las la bskul ba pad gnubs gnyis kyi phyag tu ma lon 9na ) pa 'di 'dra thugs nyams su bzhes thub pa rtogs ldan rnams gang yod 'dir shog gi blo shed che ba'i zhe med sgal ral gyi dpa' mas du 'dug go/tshogs lhag gi mjug tu chad mtho sbrel ba las byang chen mor yang mi 'dug cing 'di la gtor ma zur du bcas na zor 'phangs pa'i rjes su gtong ba'i lugs dang gtor ma dngos gzhi la dmigs na zor 'don khar mdzad pas mtshams 'dir bris pa bstod bskul dkyus ma'i nyams shar ba 'dra/lcags sdig tu sdig drug yan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)lag gi gtor bzlog shin tu rgyas pa zor las byed na cha lag tu nges par dgos kyang gsan gzigasam byung ba'am byung yang 'byugs sdebs kyi gnad ma dgongs par mchis/sgo dbye gtong ba gtor ma bskul ba'i tshe lha 'drer 'phog thug byung dogs sel byed yin pa dper na nag rtsis pa'i phung po 'don mtshams lo'i sgo phra mo gshag pa'i gnad dang 'dra ba ma dgongs par gtor ma spags nas sgo dbye bya gsung ba gsar ma ba'i bag chags ngan pa'i shog hril bsgril mchis/shar phyogs sgo ma rta gdong dkar sogs tshe bdag la 'phros tsam yang med pa'i bka' brgyad kyi sgo ma bzhi slebs gda' ba khong rnams la tshe bdag gi khral 'khri yi med pas dgongs pa zhu/sgo dbye'i rjes su bzlog gzhung gi sgrol pa zhig 'dri ba mdzad pa mtshams ma phyes pa'i 'dres skyon la ci zhu/zor gyi skabs tshe bdag gi rang skad thun mong ma yin pa'i rwa zor med pa la phur zor bsnan pa dag dug bsdus pa'i bam po de phug pa'i sbug tu dro po yong shas che/phyogs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i gshin rje mkhan po rnams ni lcags sdig lcags 'drar kha mi gsal ba gang nas kha 'geng na 'di la rna cha brgyad du grags pa'i 9ba ) khro 'dus bzlog pa'i rna cha/yur mo bsad pa'i rna cha/'char snamados zor gyi rna cha/zhing gang mnan pa'i rna cha/kha thun thod pa'i rna cha/'khrul 'khor rgyas sdeb sdebs kyi rna cha/rlung nag 'byed pa'i rna cha/sa 'tshol gto kyi rna mas yang na rnon po nad gcod bsrung ba'i rna cha/khro 'dus bzlog pa'i rna cha/zhakhyu la 'khor rgyas sdeb sdebs kyi rna cha/rlung nag 'byed pa'i rna cha/dur kha mnan pa'i rna cha/'char snamados kyi rna cha/srog dmar len bsad pa'i rna cha/yur mo ga sngags kyi rna cha zhes 'dren lugs gnyis yod pa'i 'char ka nag po nas zor rnams snon pa la 'char ka phur zor logs su bsham srol med/rwa zor yod phyin thod zor mi dgos pas bka' gter gyi gzhung so sor gzigs 'tshal/e ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag ces bya ba zhig mdzad 'dug par/mngon rtogs chung ba ltar dpral bar ya ma ra tsa/mgrin par rta mgrin/thugs kar phyag rdor/lte bar rus sbal/gsang gnas su rdo rje phur pa bskyed 'dug pa mngon rtogs chung ba 'di rgyun 'khyer du bshad pa la brten nas bsnyen pa'i dus las byang chen mo bsrang ba mi

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(khanalcogs pa gzhir bzhag yin snang ba khyed rang bka' brgyud pa dpon slob bsnyen pa dbang sgrub sogs gang la'ang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas byed pa yin zhes las byang mngon rtogs ci yang med pa de 'dra gong ra lo tsā ba dbang gi dkyil 'khor thig tshon gyi cho ga myed par ma tre gi sto bar lha gnas tsam bkod pa'i bzlog dkyil dkyus ma lhar bris yong 'dug pas mtshon rnying ma bar rlom pa'i zog po'i rigs 'dras byed mkhan ni yong shas che/ mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyi brgyud 'dzin sogs rnying ma ba tshad ldan rnams ni rmi lam du yang mi 'dod/ thun bzhin byas (10na)pa'i gcig la rgyas pa nges par mdzad/ gzhan rnams la'ang sngon 'gro dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus la/ mngon rtogs chus ba/ man ngag rtsa ba'i gzhung rkyang / mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i khro rgyal lam bsdus lta bu spyor ba yin/khyed kyi bsnyen yig 'dir bsrung 'khor ltar bsgom na zhes gshin rje dregs pa rus sbal gsum gcig gi thugs gar gcig gsal 'debs bde la ngos bzung ba bsnyen pa'i man ngag gi nyams len phyogs 'gro yang snyan du ma son par gda'/ bsnyen yig ces pa'i ming tsam thos skabs der bsnyen pa sgrub pa sgrub pa chen po'i khyad par dang dmigs pa'i zab gnad rnams bris yod dam snyam tsa na don du mngon rtogs nyung ngu sbyor mjug gang yang med pa'i mthar bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin bya zer ba zhig lasami snang bas thams cad stong pa yin no zhes pa'i hang hang gi lta ba de ga bsnyen yig la yang byung bas sgo nga'i mthil ni ha cang mi ring / bsnyen sgrub 'di 'dra'i rigs byung tsa na zhwa dmar nag bsgril ba'i dmag gis kong po klu sdings nas dbu la phyag bkab ste phebs 'jug pa las 'os ci mchis/ snying gzer nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston du grags pa zhig mdzad 'dug pa/rgyud/ dga' rab rdo rje dang gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa'i lung gcig tu bsdus zhesakhungs drangs pa/ dpal zla gsang nag po me lce 'phreng ba'i rgyud/ gshin rje zla gsang nag po ngan sngagasathams cad kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dpal zla gsang nag po'i rgyud dregs pa tshar gcod/ 'jam dpal gshin rje zla gsang nag po man ngag gi yig chung sgrub thabs kyi rgyud 'jam dpal (10ba)gshin rje gshed —13—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)po'i gsang ba drug cu pa'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal gsang ba sum cu pa'i rgyud/ seng ge 'o ma'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje zla gsang rin po che gsang ba'i rgyud/ zla gsang nag po yan lag gi rgyud/ 'jam dpal khro bo rin chen gsang rgyud/ gshin rje nag po'i sngags rgyud/ gshin rje dmar nag gi dme rgyud/ gshin rje nag po las sna tsho gis pa'i rgyud/ ya ma ra tsa khros pa'i rgyud ces pa ngan sngags bkol ba'i las rgyud/ 'khor lo drag po rdo rje yar mo zhes bya ba rtogs pa bsdus pa'i rgyud/rdo rje nyi ma khrag 'thung gi rgyud/ gshin rje'i gshed khro bo ṭak+ki rā dza'i rgyud/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtsa rgyud/ gshin rje nag po'i rgyud bskal pa me dpung 'bar ba las phyung ba/ thod pa rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud/ zlog byed 'char ka nag po'i rtsa rgyud/ srin po mgo brdung gi rgyud/ ya ma ra tsa sku khros pa'i rgyud/ 'joms byed 'bar ba'i rgyud/ mon pa nag po khros pa tsit+ta baṃ log gi rgyud/ gshin rje nag po gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi snying po 'khrul 'khor rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'phrul gyi me long khri drug stong pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ rgyal mtshan me long chung ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal dri med gsang rgyud/ gshin rje nag po'i rgyud/ gshin rje nag po gsang ba de kho na nyid kha thun gyi rgyud/ de'i phyi ma'i rgyud/ tshe bdag nag po'i drag sngags mngon du phyung ba'i rgyud/ tshe bdag nag po'i dgongs rgyud/ gshin rje nag po me rlung skyin thang 'byug pa'i rgyud/ drag sngags zla bsang nag po'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal khro bo snying gzer gsang ba'i rgyud/ zla gsang drag sngags nag po (11na〉sa zhan pa spu gri'i rgyud/ 'jig rten gsum gyi shes pa bsgral ba'i rgyud/ ngan sngags gtsug lag gi rgyud phyi ma'i yang phyi ma sdig pa snying 'dzings gsang ba'i rgyud/sdig pa snying 'dzings snying po don gyi rgyud/ drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud srog dmar lan gyi rgyud/sdig pa stobs chen gsang ba'i rgyud/ chu thigs sngon mo'i rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma/ drag po 'phung byed mchod rten nag po'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal las bzhi 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud/ pra khog blang ba'i rgyud/'jam dpal khro bo gshin rje gsang rgyud 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa rnal 'byor rgyal po'i le'u stong phrag lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa las ting 'dzin gsang ba'i rgyud khol du phyung ba/ gshin rje nag po khros pa rtsa ba'i —14

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(khanargyud/ gsang rgyud phyi ma/ dregs pa pho mo 'dus pa'i las rgyud/ gshin rje 'char ka nag po'i rgyud/ gdong zor nag po'i bstod pa'i rgyud/ sha pho ru 'dzings kyi rgyud/ 'joms byed nag po'i rgyud/ drag po sngags rgod de kho na nyid kyi rgya sdebs kyi rgyud/ drag sngags 'khor lo gsang ba sdebs kyi rgyud/ dmod pa drag sngags gsang ba mchog gi spyi rgyud/ drag po sngags rgod de kho na nyid phyir bzlog pa'i sngags rgyud/ thod pa nag po zhes bya ba spu gri gcod pa'i rgyud/ 'khrul 'khor rgya sdebs kyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal dngos grub sna tsho gis 'byung ba rlung las byed 'khor lo'i rgyud/ 'byung ba rlung nag 'khrugs pa'i rgyud/ rlung nag 'khrugasapa'i bskal pa dum bur phyur ba'i rgyud/ drags sngags 'dus pa' 'khor lo drag sngags gcod pa'i rgyud/ rnam gsum drag bo gshin rje drag sngags gcod pa'i rgyud/ gshin rje yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud/(11ba)de'i rgyud phyi ma/ 'khrul 'khor nag po'i sngags rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa/ gnod sbyin zla gsang dmar po'i rgyud/ sgrol ging ma ru tse bshan pa spu gri reg chod gnam lcags thog gi sta re bse mdung dmar po'i drag sngags dug mda' nag po dmod pa'i mtshon cha 'phrin las kyi mdo/ gnod sbyin dmar po ma ra khrag skyug gi rgyud/ gnod sbyin ging dmar po sgrol ba srin po'i rgyud/ rdo rje srin po bse'i skyes bu rtsa ba'i rgyud/ gshin rje dmar po bshan pa srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ za byed bshan pa'i 'khor lo gnod sbyin dra ba nag po'i rgyud phyi ma/ gshin rje nag po ma ra khrag skyug gsang rgyud spu gri reg chod/'jam dpal dmar po'i sngags rgyud/ gshin rje dmar po bshan pa la'i spu gri reg chod ru mtshon dmar po'i rgyud/ ma ru tse gsung gi rgyud/ 'jam dpal mched bzhi'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa zor ba dmar nag gi rgyud/ ma ru tse'i sngags rgyud/ ma ru tse'i thugs rgyud/ dpa' bo gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud/ 'di rnams nas re gnyis ma gtogs lhun grub pho brang gi rnying ma rgyud 'bum shin tu 'dzom che ba der bzhugs pa sha stag yin/ gnubs kyi bka' shog rgya bo che dang rgyal sras rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal gyi mdzad pa'i chos 'byung paṇa chen sku mched kyi gsan yig sogs su gshin rje dang drag sngags kyi rgyud tshor yang snying gzer nag bo zer ba ma rnyed/ dga' rab rdo rje'i yi ge'i khungs med pa'i spom yor —15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26) 'di 'dra g.yin la rdzun khag bkal ba'i zag zog gi gsung rab rib can du dogs/ lcags sdig gi sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po la bsnyeg na/ thog mar nus ldan brtson pa yis: sa chog dus bzang legs ldan la: rdul (12na〉sted srog chags spangs byas la: lho yi phyogs nas sa bslangs la:dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi pa tshad dang ldan pa rab tu bzhengs gtor ma mchod pa rgyas par bshams rgyal po bzhi la bka' yang bsgo khro bo bcu yis mtshams kyang bcad dam sri 'dul zhing sgo byang gdags ma khri ru dra bsgral las bya: de nas thig skud lnga ldan la zhes byung ba gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tu sa'i cho gar/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ bsrung ba ste lngar dbye/ stagon gyi skabs/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma gsum du dbye ba'i rnam gzhag mdzad/ se ston chen pos nges don bde 'jug tu yo byad bsham zhing gtor ma btang ba/ thig tshon rab tu gnas shing chag chag gdab pa/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing rdzas dgod pa ste sngon 'gro gsum du bsdus nas 'jug pa bde bar mdzad/ sgrub chen ha cang gi spros par 'dod na bka' ma'i 'dus pa mdo dang sgyu 'phrul gter ma'i bde 'dus gsang rdzogs lta bu nas zur brgyan du rung na'ang dbang chog 'dir gter ma bam chen gsang ba dang mu tig 'phreng ba/ rta nag sgrol ma dang se ston sogs phyogs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i bla ma rnams kyi yig cha gang dang yang mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan dkar gtor sa'i lha mos gtsos pa'i gzhi bdag rnams la bsngo zhing dmar gtor nag phyogs kyi 'byung po la byin nas bgegs skrod dgos rgyur/ sa'i lha mo mi snang ba'i khrod du ma bcug par mi snang bar sa bslang ba'i cho ga logs su byas/ de'i 'og tu sa sbyang ba'i nang tshan gyi lto 'phye brtag thabs bris/ de nasasa'i lha mo'i cho ga bkod pa gsang sngags gsar rnying thams (12bsod dang 'gal ba'i dwags brgyud rgan po'i rnam thar zangs thal du song / sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po'i rjes su 'brangs na rgyal chen mtho 'dzugs kyi rjes su khro bcu'i skabs phur gdab bya rigs/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho'i dbang chog ltar na sa gzung ba dang 'brel bar bgegs bskrad cing sras mchog ya ma ra tsa'i phur pa —16

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(kha)gdab par gsungs/ bka' brgyad tshor sa gzung ba'i mjug tu phur pa gdab pa'i rnam gzhag yod pas de dag gang dang yang ye mi 'dra ba'i sa lha'i rjes de ma thag phur pa 'debs pa 'khrul/ phur pa yang pad+ma kro ta sogs rta mgrin gyi phur pa btab 'dug pa gser gar blug las grub pa'i dngul sku mthong ba don ldan zhig bzhengs snang ba bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa che ba zhig tu skyel ba zhu/ sgrub thabs snying gzer nag por ma tre gi rjes su chag chag 'debs par gsungs pa bka' brgyad sogs dang mthun par 'dir rgyal mtho'i sngon du chag chag gdab pa gzhung dang ma 'brel chag chag gi rjes su thig gdab dgos rgyur sa gzung ba'i stang stabs kyi gar 'cham bshad pa gsang sngags gsar rnying gi phyag len byings dang ni mi mthun/ bka' brgyad khrag 'thung gi 'cham lta bu'i rgyas 'gebs na ma gtogasatshe bdag la 'cham yig dang de'i rgyun zur pa yod 'phros mi 'dug pas las bzhi'i stang stabs tsam ma gtogs rtsa 'cham gyi ngal ba ched gnyer mi dgos pa 'dra dgos kyang / bar du gang bshad 'cham gyis bsgrub/ /gal te ma grub 'di yas bya/ /rdo rje rgyal po dbus su 'dug /rgyas thebs bzhi ni sgor 'khod la/ /zhes pa'i zhe 'dod la dpags na 'cham ma 'grub tshe/ de'i tshab la rdo rje slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyi dbus su 'dug (13na)par slob ma rnams phyogs su 'khod nas 'khor gyi rnam pas mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pas go gcod rgyu'i lugs de ni nam yang ma yin te 'cham byed kyang de'i sngon du gsol gdab nges par 'gro dgos pas bla 'tshong 'di 'dra'i ca po yod na lha sa dang rtses dang gi tshong 'dus tshor phebs pa zhu/ deng sang yig cha dang phyag len phal cher las chog mdzad pa shas che mod lcags sdig gi dbang chog mu tig 'phreng bar snang srid thams cad kyi bdag po yin zhing g.yin thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir sa'i cho ga bya mi dgos te/ ji ltar rung ba ltar spyad par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pas mtha' gcig tu ma byas kyang skyon du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir sa gzung ba'i gar 'cham sogs spros bcas don du gnyer bar zad la/ yang na mu tig 'phreng ba khung ma min pa'i sgrub byed dam dgongs pa 'grel lugs gang rung dgos pas gshin rje mkhan po yod na ljags rkyong bar rigs so/ /—17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)phur pa'i rtsa 'cham gyi bam rde'u sa brtag pa la ga 'gas drud/ de la 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gnubs chen gyis/ slob dpon bal po'i rgyal po yis yang le shod kyi brag phug phya gnubs kyi ban chung 'dir shog gsungs bam chen ro yi dbang bskur nas: lha ru 'jam dpal tshe bdag gtad: ces gsungs pa'i bam chen gsang ba'i dbang gi bam sgrub gnyis nor ba'i/ 'gros bdun stang stabs brgyad du grags/ /tshul de phyin nas len rgyu'i ro/ /zhes dbang rten gyi bam ror ngos bzung ba ni nya dang nyung ma bsre ba'i gtam kho nar mngon/ 'dir phur pa'i 'cham phyogs nas tshe (13ba)bdag gis bdag gir mdzad pa bde chen chos 'khor bas rkun ma brgyab nas mgon mang la shor/ da ni rtogs ldan rang grol rnams kyis phyag rgya chen po'i sngon 'gror rtsa 'cham tshar re rgyag shas kha ba ri mthon po'i bu chung thang la 'khyams pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar can no/ /dam sri'i skabs mi rta khyi gsum gyi mgo bo yod pa dmigs kyis bsal ba/ dam sri la mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas mtshan ltas dang bstun dgos pa yin/ dam sri dbu gsum pa 'di zhal gzigs shig yin 'dra ba mgon mang du dam sri'i mgon po zhig kyang zhal 'debs su yong bar mchis/ gsang sngags spyi la ni liṅga bskyed bstim zin nas byang thag gis 'ching ba yin par de las go ldog pa'ang khyad chos su 'dug /ya them shing byang gi gshin rje ma he'i gdong can du mdzad pa spyir las kyi gshin rjer sku'i rnam 'gyur la mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang sngags rnying ma phyogs la srin zhal las ma lha'i zhal gyi gsal kha nyung ba kha thun sogs gzhung khung ma tshor gzigs 'tshal/ gsar ma la'ang rwa pod sogs su ma he dang srin zhal 'dam ka mang yang deng sang sa dge gnyis la ma he'i gdong can gyi gtor chog grags che ba las/ gshin rje yin na ma he'i gdong can las 'os med dgongs pa'i gzhan zer tshig gi 'khar ba tsam la brten pa rang skya mi pher ba kun gyi srol yin pas thugs dag /nag po gsum sgril gyi las gshin ma lha'i zhal can snang ba shog ser ngos ma mthong bas khyed kyi mched zla yin min gyi rgyu mtshan 'bul tshod ma zin/ma tre bsgral ba 'di la don dam pa bdag 'dzin gyi ma tre bsgral ba dang kun rdzob gdon bgegs kyi ma 18

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(kha)tre bsgral ba sogs/ (14na)so sor dbye ba'i rnam grangs yod kyang 'dir ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par gda'/ dkyil 'khor rgyan dgod kyi skabs sgrub chen la sgrub khrid dang lding khri byas na ni dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yong ba smos ma dgos 'jug pa bde skabs kyang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bum pa/ bam dbus saṃ lho gang rigs/ tshe zan nub/ gsang rdzas byang du 'god dgos par 'dir bum pa shar/ tshe zan lho/ gsang rdzas nub/ bam byang du bkod pa sogs snga 'gyur khungs thub rnams dang rgyab 'gal du song ba'i 'brul pa'i rang bzhin du snang rung khro phu ba'i dge bshes che che mo gcig gis khyed dpon slob tshos tshe bdag btsugs yod 'dug pa rnying lugs yin nam 'brug lugs yin zhes dpon tshang byang ngos par dri lugs la dpags na 'brug pa zhig gis rgya bal du phyin te paṇa grub la gtugs tshe bdag gsar du bsgyur nas blangs pa las 'os kyang ma byung yig cha 'di tsho'i babs dang bstun na pad lugs dang gnubs lugs la ltos mi dgos pa'i gdeng yod par nges pa rnyed/ bzlog bsad ma tre gzugs su bya zhes bsgral dbang gi liṅga ma tre gi gzugs su byas na dgra bo de dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi can shin tu 'jigs pa yong 'dug pas pa rnam lhun grub rtse nas rin spungs pas drag 'bud btang pa'i skabs zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jigs grags de ru dra thar pa nag po lta bur gzigs nas bya yul du bros phebs pa 'dra/ bam la lus kyi cha rnams su dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i zab gnad gang yang med par/ gser g.yu dar rgyan snying thag ni/ /zhes rin chen rgyan sprod mdzad pa ni sne'u gdong rtse dang rgyal rtse ba gnyis dang 'brel che ba'i spyan ltos byung (14ba)bas mi la sprod pa'i tshab ro la sprod pa rtogs ldan tshe blos btang gi rnam thar yin pa 'dra/ slob ma lhag gnas la byed kun/ baṃ la'ang bya ba shes par bya/ /zhesarba la ku sha gtad nas rmi lam sgug bcug par pa rnam g.yar po bdag rengs rong pas 'phrog pa'i mtshan ma zhig shar yod dam/ dkyil 'khor bzhi de rdul tshon dang / /lus dang bha ka baṃ chen no/ /zhes pa'ang spyi bye brag gnyis ka dang ma mthun te/ rdul tshon/ byang sems/ bha ga /don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rnam gzhag 'dir byed kyang —19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)baṃ der mi 'dren/ bye brag 'di ga khyad chos chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis/ bde chen ye shes sku dang mchog gi bam/ /mtshan ldan gzung ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rab 'byams bgrod pa rnam gsum la brten nas/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gsum du bsdu ba ni rgyud dang pad gnubs kyi dgongs pa yin no/ /tshe rdzas tshe bdag dmar por bsgom par gsungs pa'ang tshe dpag med la dmar po las 'os med snyam pa'i 'ba' ra lugs kyi lha gcig bum gcig la thugs ha cang zhan drags par snang /gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dbang chog tu lha tshogs thams cad sku mdog gangs la nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba zhes yod pas gnya' nang grod phug gi rgyas mi la ras pa rang che ba las 'os ci yod/dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs/ rin 'gyung bum pa'i dbang / 'od dpag med cod pan gyi dbang / mi bskyod pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i rnam gzhag 'dug pa/ rnam snang dang mi bskyod pa gnyis go sa 'pho ba snga 'gyur la shin tu mang nyid gsar ma khungs thub la'ang ye shes go sa 'pho ba yod/ gzhan 'di (15na)'dra'i dkrug lugs byas pa ni ma mthong / gter ma'i dbang phal che bar rig pa'i dbang lnga'i lha bsgom pa sogs don gyis thon pa las tshig gsal ba med pa mang / rnying ma bka' ma'i rgyud dang dkyil chog tshor tshig sna ring ba gsar ma dang cha 'dra tsam yong ba bla ma dam pa'i phur pa'i dkyil chog lta bu yin/ mnga' ris paṇa chen kyang bzhed pa bka' ma la che 'on kyang sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i phur pa la dkyi rdor 'don pa bsgyur ba de 'dra ni min pas pho rog ma nag cing skya ka ma khras pa zhig dgos pa lags/ lcags 'dra'i baṃ chen gsang ba'i dbang chog tu/ bum pa 'di yi dbang bskur bas/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang rnam dag nas/ /me long ye shes rtogs par shog /ces dang / dbu rgyan 'di yi dbang bskur bas/ /nyen mongasang rgyal rnam dag nas/ /zhes sogs dang/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho'i dbang chog tu rnam snang dang mi bskyod pa brjes pa ma gtogs gsang sngags spyi khyab dang mtshungs/ rta nag sgrol ma ba dang se ston chen po'i dbang chog sogs kyang tshig sna ma spros pa ma gtogs dgongs pa gcig pas nyon mongs pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras rnams bsre lugs de 'dra mdzad na 'bri —20

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(kha)gung dpal 'dzin gyis/ kye ma blun po snying khams can/ /thub pa'i bstan pa 'di 'drar dkrug /cesapa'i mched zla byung gi dogs so/ /gsung dbang gi skabs/ rnam rtog gdod nas chos sku yi/ /snang srid ma bcos phyag rgya bzhi/ /zhes dwags brgyud pa rnams kyi chos skad/ rnam rtog chos sku de phebs 'dug kyang de 'dra la ltos mi dgos pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+mas stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug tu rgyas btab pa'i 'jam (15ba)dpal rdzogs pa chen po sprul sku gsar ban phyogs med kyis spyan drangs pa'i man ngag dang lcags sdig gi stong dril nyi ma shar ba'i gdams pa la brten nas theg pa'i rtse rgyal a ti yo gas grol lam nyams su len pa la rta las babs nas bong bu zhon pa ni nam yang mi 'dod pa lags/ dur khrod chas sogs mtha' rten gyi dbang rnams bum dbang gi mthar mdzad pa shas che zhing yang dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i mjug tu mdzad pa'ang yod/ 'dir gsang dbang gi mtha' rten du byung ba'ang 'brel ma chags/ bam dbang dngos bskur ba'i dus rten brten par bsgrubs zin pa'i dwangs mas byin gyis brlab rgyu la/ drag pos bsgral phyir ral gri gtad/ /gshed chen mthu stobs yongs rdzogs las/ /zhes sogs kyis gtubs pa ni liṅga sgrol ba'i nyams lta bu shar bas chos 'di'i dgongs par ni spu tsam ma song rtogs ldan lkoms po ro bsha' ba'i rnam thar ni yin shas che/ bam dbang dngos bskur zin pa'i 'og tu gsang rdzas dang bsre ba'i lag len dang dbang dngos gzhi nor tshod du 'dug pa sngags 'chang tshe bdag bkra shis kyis lan de 'khyor bo zhig ma byung snang bas de rigs las dung dkar ras pas lung gis dbang gi go gcod pa dogs ci las bde ba yong mchis drag po mthu dbang rdo rje las rim nas bshad kyang bsgral dbang sger du mi mdzad pa gong du sbyor sgrol gyi dbang gi dod song zin pa la dgongs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yongs rdzogs mchod rten gyi dbang ni snyan gyi bu gar ma lhon 'dug pa med pa la khyer shog gi dper song bas rtsod pa zhu ci 'tshal/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal mnyam (16na thad nub dgon pa dang rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po yongs 'dzin du bsten nas phyogs 'di la mkhas shing grub brnyes kyi rtser son pas som nyir gyur nas dri ba ga la —21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)yin yang tshod bgam pa'i dri ba phul ba'i lan 'debs su bka' 'byed kyi skyon pad+mas mdzad pa la zhes pa'i lung drangs pa'i mjug tu/ zhes pa sangs rgyas ye shes nyid gsung lags/ /de bas dang po pad sdo/gas phyi ma la/ /gnubs sdo/gas zhes su drag sngags mkhas pas bsgrags/ /pad+mas mi mkhyen gnubs kyis shes smra min/ /dang por zab sbas phyi mar gsal bstan phyir/ /lugs phyi lhag pa dngos su 'thon min nam/ /zhes gsung ba la dpags na bka' 'byed nas bshad pa'i shin tu mi zab pa'i thun mong bsrung mtshams kyi chos tsam las pad lugs zur pa med par thag cad cing / gnubs lugs kyang lcags sdig kho nar ngos bzung ba bla chen tsho'i rnam par thar pa 'ba' zhig lhur blangs pa'i 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi skor gsan no mkhyen no zhes pa'i ming tsam la gtso bor gzung blun po dad pa can rnams kyis thal mo sbyar nas smin ma zangs zangs byas par rlom pa kho na'i skyon te/ zhe 'dod gnubs kyis phyon chen po la shin tu zab pa zhig zhus pa la lcags sdig sbas nas ma gnang bar mi zab pa'i lcags 'dra gnang bar brten des thugs ma khengs par bal yul du rgyal po bha su dha ra la lcags sdig gsan par 'dod pa ni/ ga nubs chen thaman rje'i bka' babs yin pas/ lcags sdig zhus na mi gnang ba ga la srid rung / nyang gi gter ma'i rnam thar zangs gling mar/ da lta rgyal khrims gnyan pas srog ser gtad mi (16ba'i gos/ /dusang na byung na dgos pas gter du sba/ /zhes byung ba ltar dus skabs bzang bas rje 'bangs rnams kyi mngon spyod la ha cang rtsal 'don ma byung / glang dar mas bstan pa gnubs pa'i dus gnubs chen gyis slar yang bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du lcags sdig khro chu dug sdong du brlung zhan srog ser gtad sel sdebs gzhor rlung bskrad sogs mngon spyod kyi mtha' rgya gcod par skye ba sngon ma'i spun zla bal po bha su dha ra'i sar byon pa yin pas yus po che mi mdzad par zhu/ pad lugs bcubs lugs dang lcags sdig lcags 'dra'i dbye ba/ bka' 'byed las/ bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: drag sngags tshe bdag nag po la: yang gces zab pa'i skor gsum las phyi skor lcags 'dra'i skor dang gcig nang skor thog 'dra'i skor dang gnyis gnam lcags thog me'i skor —22

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(kha)dang gsum: zhes lcags 'dra shin tu zab pa yod pa'i tshig 'di phyag shan rnon po zhig gis 'brad dgos pa yong zhing spyir lcags 'dra la yang phyi nang gsang gsum du yod pas pad lugs shin tu zab pa gnam thog chen po'i skor slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i man ngag rtsa ba sgrol ma drug gi gsal byed phag ston gyis mdzad pa'i rin chen 'od 'phro/ de'i 'grel pa brag stag pa rdo rje rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol ma drug pa/ mchod rten gsal byed sgron ma se ston chen pos mdzad pa/ man ngag rtsa ba'i le lag tu gtogs pa'i gter gzhung sprul sku rgyas phung po ri bo che sogs nas spyan drangs pa kha yar snang /ga 'kha yas khang lhun grub/ lha lkog bzhengs/ sngags thug phrad sogs gnam thog chen po'i lam gyi zab gnad slob dpon bha su dha ra'i spyi gcod (17na〉phrul gyi lde mig tu gsungs pa dang man ngag rtsa ba'i dgongs pa shin tu mthun/ gnubs lugs la'ang lcags sdig bka' 'byed nas bshad pa'i thems can dang der mi gsal ba'i thems med thor bu yod/ zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag nas bshad pa rnams lcags sdig min pas gnubs lugs yin tshad lcags sdig tu byas na/ dkar chag las/ gnubs kyi ban chung sangs rgyas ngas: lo ni brgya dang sum cu lon: nyon mongs bod yul dbus su langs 'tsho ba'i zas rnams 'bangs kyis phral: rgya gar yul du lan bdun phyin: dkar chag gnubs yul rong du btab: rtsal chen rdo rje sgrom bur rdzogs bla ma bcu gcig zhabs nas bteg:'on kyang mkhas pa bzhi la gtugs slob dpon dpal gyi seng ge dang : rgya gar khrag 'thung nag po dang : 'phung byed shan+ti gar+bha dang : bal po bha su dha ra bzhi mkhas pa bzhi yi thugs brtol nas zab pa'i chos drug thugs la bcang gzhan yang gdams ngag rtsis las 'das: zhes pa'i nang gi tshe bdag gi chos skor rnams gnubs lugs lcags 'dra gnam thog che ba'i lam srol gyi chos skor du ngos 'dzin pa las 'os med/ da lta rnying rlom hrul po rnams kyi bsam ngor lcags sdig zab cing lcags 'dra mi zab par gleng ba'i kha skyugs kyi rjes zlos mdzad pa/ lcags 'dra thams cad de la nang gses kyi gsum du phye ba'i phyi skor mi zab pa kho nar ngos bzung ba'i skyon yin/ phyi skor lcags 'dra ni bka' 'byed nas —23—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bshad pa'i shog le gsum la tshang ba sogs kyi rigs rnams yin/ pad gnubs kyi lcags 'dra (17ba)zab pa ni gsang skor lcags 'dra gnam thog chen po'i lugs yin pas lcags sdig dang mchod rten bcas chog la 'khor lo'i mang nyung tsam ma gtogs lam gyi gnad la zab mi zab kyi khyad par ci yang med pas phyogs 'di la 'khrul pa'i dri ma bral ba se ston chen po'i gsung las/ de ltar tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon lam/ /pad+ma'i man ngag rtsa ba sor bzhag la/ /pad lugs zhes grags gnubs kyi yang mdzod 'di/ /sgrub khog sor bzhag gzhubs lugs zhes grags mod/ /lam gyi gnad la khyad par ci yang med/ /'on kyang 'phrin las byang bu'i brjed byang la/ khyad par cung zad yod pa legs phye nas/ /'di ni pad+ma'i lugs nyid gsal bar byas/ /zhes gsungs shing de la yid brtan du byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin na chen po'i stong 'ur grags skam gyi mkhas grub ma yin pa'i phyogs 'di la phul du phyin pas/gsung las/ rje btsun dam pa'i drin gyis pa ma srol 'dir/ /ring du sbyangs pas blo gros mi dman zhing / /rgyud dang gdams pa'i gnad la 'dris pa'i phyir/ /don 'di'i ched la spro ba lhod ma gyur/ /ces lugs mgo tshos nas rna ba bregs pa yin 'dug pa dgongs dgos/ mchod rten srog shing dbyibs mdor gsungs pa la/ /da lta'i mda' tshad dgos dgongs 'khrul pa 'di/ /blo ldan khyod thugs rmongs pa mi srid kyang / /gzhan la co 'drir rdzu ba yin nam snyam/ /zhes pa 'od zer dri med du mchod rten gyi srog shing 'dzugs pa'i skor shin tu rgyas shing bum gdan gyi steng nas 'dzugs pa bshad par khungs che yang de 'dra'i rgyun sa phyogs de nas tsan+dan gzungs dogs ma dgos shing rna thos 'dra gsan pas 'byul (18na)ba yin tshe de'i phyag len lugs 'di la mi 'grig pas zhwa dpe lham 'gabs su 'gro mod bla ma zhang gi dbu zhwa yang bla ma'i phyags yin 'dug pas bka' brgyud pa dpon slob la de 'dra'i srol ni yod shas che/ rgyud du/ nag po gru gang bang rim bzhi: zhes pa'i dgongs pa ma lon par mchod rten la khru gang tsam las mi yong ba'i rtsis kyi srog shing gi dbyibs las mda' tshad mi dgos gsung ba sprul sku rin po che rang grub mtha'i stabs kyis phyogs 'di la thugs 'dris chung ba'i zhal len gnang yang thugs mi —24

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig / nang ma(khana'atsher shas kha'ang bya ba sku bsrung pa yab sras kyi zhabs la thag pa 'dom pa bco brgyad btags nas bya bral pho mo bye ba phrag brgyas sho gcig sho gnyis kyis 'then pa las 'os mi 'dug /gtso bor rgyud du/ gri mda' smyug rgod khrag can ldan/ /zhes shin tu gsal zhing rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshos mdzad pa'i gter gzhung dang rjes 'brang rnams kyis bkral ba'i yig cha khungs btsun mang por gri mda' khrag can dgos par bshad/ lcags 'drar seng khri'i nang dang lcags sdig tu de'i 'og sa 'dzin la thod pa zhal dbye gzhug dgos pa'i 'byub khung rgyud las/ maṇ+ḍal mthing nag gru gsum dag 'phung sa gsum dang dug khrag sbrus: bang rim gsum la kha khyer rtsang : dug khrag sol bas nag por byugs:dpa' rtul can gyi sngags pa yis zhing lpags dag gam ro gos la: rno myur gdug byed phag mo'i ltor: zhes kha bshad tsam min pa'i rgyud 'grel man ngag zhal shes phyag len shig mdzub sprod rgyu yod pas de ltar na mchod rten khru gang tsam gyi seng khri dang (18ba)sa 'dzin nang du mi mgo bam ril ci la shong / 'brug lugs kyi 'chi bdag zhal dbye de tshe lo bcu pa'i bu chung zhig gi thod par mdzad dgos yong ba 'dra/ phyag len de tsho gtsang drags pas dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng ba dang rin spungs zhabs drung sku tshe mthar phyin pas rtag brtan sprul skus paṇa chen smon 'gro bar mngon spyod mdzad pa'i dper song / tshe sgrub de rigs byung na mdzad rogs la rngan pa 'bul dgos mchis/ rtsa ba'i lha dang rgyan lha rnams 'god lugs slob dpon so so'i bzhed pa gtso bas mtha' gcig tu nges pa mi dgos pas chos can mi gcig 'khas la gsol ba 'debs mi 'tshal/ zhabs drung bdag pos ma gsungs pa'i gtam 'khyams la bdag po mdzad nas/ thod sku gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs min pa'i sgrub byed ci la mdzad dgos/ thod sku sgrub pa lcags sdig tu shin tu gsal zhing chos sde yongs su rdzogs pa la stod byang du bzhugs skabs gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rje la zhib tu gsan snang / paṇa chen sku mched kyis chos 'di la dka' ba spyad pa'i rgyu mtshan gsung las/ rgyal khams g.yengs pas bla ma rnyed/ /bsam yas bskor nas 'phrang phur phyin/ /bla ma rnyed nas gdams ngag zhus/ /rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'dzings las/ /man ngag zur chos brgyan pa rnams/ /ngal dub spangs nas zhu gtugs byas/ /sgyu lus lha bar song snyam 'dug /khong pa khrag gis gang snyam byed/ /lhu gzugs dum bur phral snyam byed/ /de ltar gyur pa khyad bsad nas/ /srog dang bsdos pa'i dam chos 'dis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar shog /ces chos phyir dka' ba
