spyad pa las (19nab ngoms grod 'grangs kyis thos bsam dang mi 'dra bar gda'/ e ring la oṃ 〉lha mi snon pa lcags 'dra lugs/ snon pa lcags sdig tu ba ched cing der ma zad pa'i yi ge 'byin 'jug gi gsung rgyun yang mchis/ e ring bsnal bzlog dkrug gshag sogs nyid kyi gsan gzigs tsam byung ba las chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis phyag tu bzhes nas gtsang pa zhing shag pa pha bu dang rjes 'brang byang pa dpon blon mang po dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal gyi zhing du gdan 'dren mdzad pa yin pas gter gzhung gi skyor zlos kha yar gsung ba zhang po'i mdun du tsha bo'i sngar gtam mi mdzad pa zhu/ dbang chog gi mdzad byang du 'jam dpal rdo rje nyid las chos thams cad la ci dga' bar spyod pa'i lung thob gsung ba shin tu thugs bden par mchis te/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis khyed rang gi thugs la gang dran dran lag thog tu khol zhes gnang ba byin par gor ma chag go /smras pa/ phyogs 'dzin mi 'dod rlung gis ma bskyod cing / /thos brtson rnam dpyod yangs pa'i gru rdzings la/ /brten nas gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i mtha' 'jal ba'i/ /gzur gnas de da dpon blo gros gsal rnams kyi/ /ma dag chu dong g.yin 'drid phub ma'i zol/ /bkab pa'i rnam thar dngos po'i gnas tshul tsam/ /brjod las yul la ma bston mtshang 'dru'i gtam/ /yin min nan tan dpyod cig shes ldan tshogs/ /chos rnams ma bslabs snying nas rang rdol du/ /yong bar lung bstan gyis bsnyems 'ol tshod kyi/ /bsgrigs pa'i bstan bcos bye ma'i changs bu de/ /(19ba ji pyad brdar gsher gyis 'jig pa rang gi gshis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar po zhes/ /snyan grags g.yu 'brug sngon po'i skad la za/ /star rdog skam po 'dis kyang de 'dra'i mtshan/ /'dzin pa phal gyi sgong mthil mdzub mos lon/ /—26

tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig/nang ma(khanamakhas grub gral snyeg snye ma 'phang mtho'i mgo/rnam dpyod 'bras bu med pa'i lang long gis//ston gyi bre 'jal skug pa'i rjes 'jug mkhan//'dod can zhing pa'i rgyu ma leb mor gtong //sgom chen pho mo'i 'khor la smras tshad gtam//song ba'i mgal dum pad gnubs dgongs pa'i don//yin na snag tsha byugs pas gser zhun mdog/gsal bar 'byung ngam za hor rig sngags 'chang //rgyud dang gdams par goms stobs mi ldan par//rtsal bshad rang bzo'i sgrub 'phrin sngon byon gyi//rigs 'dzin bzhed par dogs na khyod las gzhan//blun po ma mchos za hor rig sngags 'chang //'khrul pa'i log rtog zag rdzas mthor brtsegs par//'grig 'grig tshig gi sbyor ba'i sa g.yogs pa//ro brgya'i zas su mngon na phag rgod kyi//spun zlar nges so za hor rig sngags 'chang //bla wo bzang rdzumakhas pa'i 'chal sgra la//yid brtan dal 'byor stong zad mtshor mchongs na//mi lus dud 'gro'i 'du shes rang mtshang la//mi khrel su zhig za hor rig sngags 'chang //'bri byang zil gnon man ngag bdud rtsi'i chus//snying gi bum bzang gtams bzhin zag grog gi/dpe hrul 'tshol ba blo gros gron yin pas//bag yod sten cig za hor rig sngags 'chang //bsams kyin sngags 20na ) rlom smig rgyu'i rgyang 'od la//nam yang mi re'i smon lam legs thebs bdag/kha po'i ca co mi sgrog zab mo'i klung //btungs pas log rtog skom pa'i gdung bab cil/kho bo blo gros gser mig 'khyil min yang //log bshad than skad sgrog la mi brel bar//rgyud dang gdams par ring sbyangs gshog pa'i rtsal//rdzogs pa'i bya rgod gzhubs bstan nam 'phang spyod//brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes srog phral tho co'i bam rang bzo lha min gdon btab langs pa'i mgor//dgag sgrub rig sngags rdo rje bsnun pa'i mod//'jigasarngams bzang rdzu'i 'byung po pha mthar bros//snga 'gyur rigs dang skye bas bsnyems rnams kyis//bstan pa'i dag ther mdzad par rigs mod kyang //sdug khug bh+yo phaṭa mchis brang chas dang chang //sgra tshad gsar chos ngur smrig zol gyis g.yengs//gzhung brgya'i mang bkur khri la rang rigs mes//zhwa ser cod pan bcings kyang ris bral bstan//gliX ༷zhir 'khor los sgyur bas chos kyi khrims//blang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dor 'byed pa'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho/ /'di lan lung dang rig pas tshul bzhin du/ /'debs po yod na smra ba'i sgo phye dang / /legs so brjod las bzhin ras nyer gnag pa'i/ /gu dog zog po'i rang gnong ci la ston/ /dge 'dis 'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la/ /brten nas bdud bzhi'i dgra yi tshogs bcom ste/ /rang rig don gyi kun bzang he ru ka /'gro 'dis mngon sum (20ba)rang ngo 'phrod par shog /ces sgrub brgyud pa rnams kyi dbus na mkhas pa'i snyan grags nyi zla ltar gsal ba 'brug gnas sprul sku rin po che pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi yig cha 'ga' zhig snang ba 'khrul pa med pa'i rdo rje'i gsung las 'os ci mchis kyang bdag sogs tshur mthong gi skye bo las nyon gyi sgrib pas ches cher sbags te dag snang gi nyi ma ma shar ba'i nam mkhar log rtog gi rgyu skar go mtshams med par bkrams pa'i dbang gis rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig 'di ni rang gzhan gyi chos par rlom pa mtha' dag ja chang gi gar sla/ phye kha'i mtho dma' tshong dang zhing las kyi khe spogs sogs 'di snang kho nas g.yengs te bskul ba po'i rigs ma byung yang shes ldan mang po blo mig yangs pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ram snyam pas kun nas blangs te tshul 'dir dang por mkhas pa gnubs dang rgya/ bar du mkhas pa gangs g.yung gnyis/mtha' mar mkhas pa se ston chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan dang gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched kyi gdams pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa khri srong yang srid dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal las nye bar brgyud pa'i dbang lung bshad bka' phyag bzhes man ngag gi zab gnad phra mor bcas pa khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin las bum pa gang byor thob cing / rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po nas 'bri gung chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs la brgyud pa'i lcags sdig gi phyag len man ngag rnams dpal 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags(21na)pa dang rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub gnyis kyi drung du zhun thar bcad/ brgyud 28

'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi yang snying / nang ma(kha)pa de las 'ongs pa'i lung rgyun yongs su rdzogs pa khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen por nos shing / 'jam dpal gyi gnang ba thob pa sogs mi'i chos bla ma'i rdzun smrar ma nus rung / bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshad ldan lag tu blangs pas lag 'dren kha yar cham la phab pa'i lag rjes kyang cung zad bzhag pa za hor gyi sngags pa rgan po zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal gyis yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus dge bar rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gtsug lag khang rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dza / /zhes pa 'di yang pa ri dh+wa ra zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo chu shel dbang po rgyu skar khrums stod kyis nye ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin zla ba gro bzhin gyi 'grub sbyor la babs pa'i tshe dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du grub par bgyis so/ /maṅga le/'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi yang snying bzhugs so/ /rgya rgya gar khungs gas pa'i phyir stso4lo/ /gar skad du/ ārla mañju shrī tan+ta tsi ta:/ bod skad ga skur pha tshig smos pa'o/ /du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal tsho smos pa'i yang snying / rgyud kyi yang snying / 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur yi dam lha la phyag 'a pos ba'i phyir smos pa'o/ /pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar 'di la sangs rgyas thams༅ kyi mtshan 'dus pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /ye shes 'di lasangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku 'dus pa'o/ /sku ste rang byung ba/ /ye shes 'di la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs 'dus pa'o/ /mig gcig dri ma med/ /ye shes snang 'di lasangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo sprod 'dus pa'o/ /ba lam me ba/ /a yig 'bru 'di dgu la theg pa rim dgu 'dusapa'o/ /ra pa tsa na ya te na ma ye shes sku 'di la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung 'dus pa'o/ /nyid khyod la 'dud/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs 'di la40rgyas thams cad kyi yon to bos pa'o/ /rgyas kun gyis bshad/ /bcom 'di la4sa—29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rgyas thams cad kyi mas dang bstod pa 'dus pa'o/ /ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa de bzhin dngos kyi bka' byin rlabs 'dus pa'o/ /gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa rdzogs so/ /zla ba gcig gis 'grub pas the tsho ma za zhig /gu ru pad+mas jo mo shel bza' sgron la gnang ba 'di mtshan brjod tshar re dang mnyam par 'gyur gsungs so/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal bzhugs/na mo mañju shrī bī re ṇa mu drwa bhi bhū yā ya/ mkha' khyab spros bral gdod ma'i klong du 'jam dpal kun bzang chos kyi sku/ /'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtso bor rdo rje 'chang dbang longs spyod rdzogs/ /yid srubs gshed du 'khor 'das zil gnon tshe bdag nag po sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsung ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol rigs kyi gtso bor gtsug na mdzes/ /stang zil mdog ltar gnag pa'i srin po'i gzugs/ /dus kyi byin za'i dbus na 'gying ba'i gar/ /rab 'bar mtshon cha gdengs pa'i mod nyid la/ khro rgyal phal gyi lag cha dus gcig 'chor/ /dri nga mgo bo rgyu mar brgyus pa'i 'phreng / /phral bsad pags rlan lding stabs gos kyis kyang / /ma tshim snying gi khrag dron 'thung ba dang / /lhan cig thal zhag khrag gis lus kun byugs/ /ru dra bsgral ba'i dpal dang dur khrod chas/ /dpa' rtags log 'dren tshogs la rngom bzhin du/ /ka dag gzhog pa'i rtsal gyis 'khor 'das chos/ /zad mtha'i lhun (2na)grub mkha' la nam 'phang spyod/ /lha sngags ye shes rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ /gdengs tshe stobs ldan 'byung po sbyin skyes mo'i/ /dregs bsnyems mngal lhungs chabs cig lus med smag /gzi byin nyi ma'i 'od gdong ma chugs sangs/ /dgra po'i bla rku srog gcod tshe yi mtha'/ /btul ba'i bam ro'i steng na zhabs kyi bro/ /brdung yang 'gro la snying rje'i chus brlan pa/ /rgyal kun spyi lugs tshul las 'das min mtshar/ /—30

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanarang rgyud dug lnga phyi rol me long du/ shar ba'i dgra gdon des bskyed drung 'byin pa'i/ /bskyed rdzogasardzogs chen lam gyis tshe gcig la/ /phung po 'od skur grol nus lhag pa'i lha/ /rang srung btsan po'i lcags ri mtho steng nas/ /zlog bsad nag po mthu yi lce 'bab kyang / /dbang 'bring bar dor 'jam dpal zhi dang khror/ /ma bu rang ngo 'phrod pas ya mi nga / /de phyir zla gsang rgyud sde'o ma'i mtsho'i yang snying sdig rgyud mar gyi nying khu las/ /pad gnubs bzhed srol swā la'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /zab pa gter dang rnam dag bka' ma'i rgyud/ /yo (2ba〉ka gsum du 'grel lugs tha dad par/ /mkhyen ldan sngags 'chang dgongs don mang lon mthar/ /se ston phyag bzhes dbang po'i zhes gsal ba/ /'di ko rin chen khrod nas yid bzhin nor/ /gang der dpyad bzod yang dag gtan tshigs kyis/ /yid drangs rang nyams len dang snod ldan ched/ /'phrin las srid pa gsum las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi dbyangs su len/ /de yang 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa man ngag rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ltar mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid se ston chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan dang khri srong rnam sprul chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i bzhed pa bzhin 'dri ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/dang po 'jam dpal rdzogs chen nas bkang dang / /rnam nges rin cen sgron me dngos bstan gnyis/ /dang por skyabs sems bskyed gsol rgyud smon lnga'i/ /dang po skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /ye shes lha dang dam tshig lha la skyabs su mchi/ /chos sku 31ngas sku sprul sku gsum la skyabasasu mchi/ /bdag dang drin can pha mas gtso byas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas na pa nyid la der shes kyi/ /byang chub mchog tu rgya chen sems ni bskyed par bya/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyisapa bdag dang mdun gyi rten bskyed pa/ /ā+oṃ su bhā wa shurnya sarba rnyarmā su bhā wa shud+dhi3 nya/ chos kun stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang / /ā+oṃ wā gī shwa ri thu/ stong pa'i gdangs las sngags kyi sgra bsgrags mthus/ /—31—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pad (3na8 chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor steng / /rang nyid dzaskru gser gyi mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /yid 'ong gzhen nu zur phud lnga pa can/ /phyag zung shes rab ral gri ut+pal gyi/ /'dab stong rgyas rtser sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung can/ /sna tsho gos rin chen mdzes rgyan brgyad kyis spras/ /rab bkra lhab lhub dar gyis mngon par klubs/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /'phags pa mchod dang rang gzhan don byed gyur/ /mdun du dpag bsam ljon shing yal 'dab dang / /'bras bu mngon par rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus/ /mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la nyi ma'i gnyen/ /g.yas g.yon 'jam dpal dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyab tu nyan rang gus btud phyag rdor mdun/ /steng phyogs shing rtser de bzhin gshegs tshogs dang / /yal gar gnas pa'i lha yi bu bu mos/ /me tog la sogs kun bzang mchod sprin spro/ /thub pas rgyud gsung sems dpas sgra chen sgrog /'khor rnams dga' mgu yi rang rjes su 'dud/ /rkan gnyis rgyud kyi rnga chen lce'i dbyu gus/ /bskul las zab don chos sgras yongs gang gyur/ /gsum pa 'jam dpal brgyud 'debs rim pa ni/ /chos sku 'dus pa kun tu bzang po dang / /longs sku 'dus pa 'jam dpal rigs lnga dang / /sprul sku 'dus pa shākya thub pa sogs/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin cen mkha' 'gro dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kya mkha' 'gro dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro phyon mkha' 'gro sogs/ /(3ba〉ba lus mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang rdo rje 'amang chen po/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī sidha dang / /rang byung chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ khri srong lde btsan 'jam mgon sprul pa'i sku/ khre sa sgron gcig mtshan ldan gsang ba'i yum/ /gter ston chen po sar ban phyogs med sogs/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung zin sar ban nyi ma'i snying po dang / /sngags 'chang dbang dar 'gar ston rin cen 'bum/ /ri pa sangs rgyas byams pa dpal la sogs/ /brgyud 'dzin bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgya ban bla ma rba ston dpal ba dang / /rigs 'dzin —32

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i la byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(kha)chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can/ /rdo rje mgon po ngag dbang grags pa sogs/ /bka' babs bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang thugs sras nam mkha'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan blo gros dran mchog chos kyi rje/ /yongs 'dzan dam pas rjes bzung dbang po'i sde/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma rnamasal gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung gseng ngag gi dbang / /klong chen rab 'byams gsum pa sha gzug pa/ /zab don gter mdzod 'phrin las gsang sngags rje/ /mkha grub bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnubs chen yang srid 'phrin las lhun grub zhabs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /'jam mgon dgyes pa'i za hor bzhad pa rtsal/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug g.yu phra'i gnas/ /bdud rtsi'i tshul du rgyasabatab gsang ba'i gter/ /rdo rje phrag skyes skyin mthing shwa ṇa ma/ /gnas chos srung (4na sgor bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal rigs lnga zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /med byung rdzas kyi rten 'brel la brten nas/ /rig rtsal dbang bzhis ye shes thob pa yi/ /ngo 'phrod don gyi snying po rtogasapar shog /bde gshegs kun 'dus rang byung ye shes sku/ /gsal stong dbyer med bskyed pa'i rim pa yis/ /tha mal lus kyi snang zhen yongs grol nas/ /gzhi lus 'od phung chen por mngon gyur shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bcud phyungs glu blangs rgyud/ /brjod tshul bzhi dang yang snying snying po'i don/ /skye med a yi rang sgra yongs bsgrags nas/ /mthar thug 'bras bu sku bzhi thob par shog /rdo rje thugs kyi bzlasapas lam sbyangs nas/ /rtsa la ngo sprad rlung la bde ba sbyar/ /thig le chos kyi sku ru la zla ba'i/ /zag med dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtogs par shog /mtha' gnyis las grol rang rig chen po'i don/ /sgom med sgom sogs dbang po'i rim pa yis/ khreg cho de thod rgal ye shes zang thal sogs/ /tshul bzhin lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon dus rgyal ba'i smon lam rnam dag mthus/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rdul rnyed rab 'byams kyi/ /'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /bzhi pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rgyud bklag pa/ /gzhen nu'i cha lugs —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'chang ba po/ /zhes sogs blo la gcig gi mthar rgyud rgyas pa'am bsdus pa gang rung bya/ lnga pa smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyor ba/ /sngon dus rgyal bas ri bo bya rkang du/ khyud 'di gsungs(4ba) tshe sku las 'od zer 'bum/ /re re'i rtse la 'dab ldan pad+ma'i steng / /sprul pa'i sku res phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /chos 'khor bskor ltar bdag gis 'jam dpal gyi/ /chos 'di bsgrags pas semasacan thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la skye med yongs su thob pa dang / /'dzin med rang grol 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig /gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa rnam nges dngos bstan dgongs don la/ /zur rgyan brgyud 'debs skyabs sems tshad med bzhi/ /yan lag brgyad pa mtshams bshagasadam byin dbab/ /mchod rdzas byin brlab sngon 'gro rnam dgu'i khrigs/ /dang po zla ba gter bla brgyud gsol 'debs ni/ /thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gshin rje'i gshed du khros pa dus dgra'i dbang / /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rgyud sde'i bka' bsdu phyag na rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha'i bu tshangs pa nyi ma bde mchog ldan/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo zla ba'i 'od zer la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /zung 'jug sku brnyes 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma /bha wa/ /brtul zhugs mthar phyin bha su dha ra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /bod yul drag sngags bdag po gnubs ban rje/ /las ldan gter ston chen po rgya 'ad khrom/ /gdamasapa'i mnga' bdag bral te sa sto ṭar/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rigs 'dzin dbang po gangs ban bkra shis dar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gangs pa ri dkar pa/ /sde brgyad bran 'khol gangs pa shug 'bum pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /(ldan༄ 'gyur srog shing g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ /zab sbas gsal mdzad phag ston shākya mgon/ /rigs 'dzin sbug ston dpal ldan mgon po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /zur tsho rdo rje gling pa chos rgyal mtshan/ /spang ston 'jam dbyangs bde legs rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /mkhyen brtse —34

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khananus mnga' se ston rin rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /mthu chen spyan tshab mgon po zla ba'i zhabs/ /mnyam med nub dgon byams pa chos rgyal mtshan/ khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /de sras sprul pa'i sku mchog ngag gi dbang / /rdo rje 4 4 dngos chos dbyings rang grol dpal/ /za hor sngags smyon zil gnon drag rtsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /phyi nang gsang gsum gdams pa sa 'dzin dbang / /rno ngar rna cha brgyad sogs gser gyi ri/ /ston mdzad byed po dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /dzo lhud ri bo che sogs gnas mchogo tu/ /mi phyed phyag rgyas btab pa zab mo'i gter/ /gnas chos bka' yi srung mar bcas pa la/ /gsol pa 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /'khor ba'i ngang tshul kun la yid log cing / /'gro rnamasasangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i ched/ /med byung theg pa mchog gi lam zhugs nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlomes/ /bgrod pa rnam pa gsum gyi 'jug ngogs las/ /smin par byed pa dbang gi rim pa dag /mas ldan rdo rje slob dpon drung nod de/ /nges gsang snod du rung bar byin gyisarlobs/ /rgyu rkyen dang bral chu las nya 'phar tshul/ /gsal stong lha skur ldang ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /(5ba)dregs pa thug phrad gsod pa drag po'i sngags/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs bzang phyag rgya las 'ongs dga' ba bzhi/ /rdzogs pa'i bde stong ye shes rab rgyas shing / /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan sku bzhi'i gar/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /grangs med chos rnams ma lus sems kyi klong / /ye nas grol ba'i mi 'gyur kun tu bzang / /gdod nas zhabrul ma myong ba'i rig pa 'di/ /tshe 'dir myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlomes/ /gal te tshe 'dir grol ba'i lam zab mo/ /ma rnyed 'da' bar nye tshe gnad gcod bral/ /'chi ba 'od gsal rang byung ye shes sgron/ /sngar 'dris grogs bzhin shes par byin gyis rlomes/ /dbang po dman pas srid pa bar do sa /'jigasarung 'byul ba'i snang ba mang shar tshe/ /dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /rang thong —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa gsum thugs rjes lung bstan dbugs dbyung mthus/ /zhi khro'i zhing khams rgya mtshor rab bgrod cing / /tha mar chos ldan sgrub nus rten gzung nas/ /lhag ma'i lam sbyangs byang chub mchog thob shog /khyab bdag 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i skur bzhengs te/ /thar pa'i gnas su lus can kun 'dren zhid / /gnas skabs 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsams pa bzhin/ /'bad med lhun grub bkra shis dpal gyis skyongs/ /gnyis pa skyabs gsol smon 'jug sems bskyed pa/ /bdag dang bsrung bya rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i 'gro ba mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus deng nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ shes rab snying rje dang bcas pa'i/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas drung du gnas bcas nas/ /rdzogasapa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dran pa ni/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /ces sogs lan gsum brjod/bzhi pa yan lag brgyad pa'i tsho gos gsog pa/ /tre rat+na maṇ+ḍal/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas byang sems rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba rnams kyi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum ston pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis —36

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanamed yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor (6bskid kyis rnam sprul ba'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /dus gsum bzhugs la lus dbul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus nas byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /lnga pa mtshams gcod gsum las bgegs sgrod pa/ /skad cig gis rang nyid zil gnon phyag rgya chen po zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing ba/ phyag drug g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje/ g.yon gsum be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub can zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum du bgrad pas dres sa pa can thams cad mnan pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams can me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs kur nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po de las khro bo'i sprin rab 'byams lo ba dang bcas par gyur/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas/ /mthing nag hūṃ gi 'od zer las/ /stong gsum khro bos rab gang zhing / /rngam sgras 'jig rten kun bkang nas/ /gnod mdzes khro bo ma yin la/ /gdug pa g.yo 'gul ming yang med/ khro rgyal mtshon cha me ri 'bar 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /ā+oṃ sa ni nga hūṃ/ griṇ+ḍa gros hūṃ/ gro hā pa ya grihā pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bi sdi rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ gnyis pa khro mtshon me yi srung 'khor ni/ /hūṃ/ (7na)dur khrod mtshon cha me ri khro bo 'khrig /steng 'og phyogs mtshams me ri 'khrug cing 'bar/ /zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar/ /gti mug 'joms pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar/ /nga rgyal 'joms pa'i me ni ser nag 'bar/ /'dod chags 'joms pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar/ /phrag dog 'joms pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar/ /dbang drag gdug rtsub me ni kham nag 'bar/ /bar gcod bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlog /'bar ba me yi mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /phaṭa re e raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ khro bo dang mtshon cha dang me rab tu 'bar ba'i gur khang du gyur/ gsum pa lhan thabs gtsug tor srung ba'i gnad/ /rang —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i ngo bo khro zhal ser po/ rang gi thugs dar rje las srung ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu la ma su rla maṇ+ḍal zhes pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu'i steng du hūṃ bcu yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bcu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa be con dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur pa'i ngo bo khro zhal ser po zhi ba'i cha byad can/ phyag gnyis na 'khor lo bsnams pa'i nga rgyal gyis sngags bzlas te/ thugs dar ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'khor bas 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi bar du nad dang gdon dang rims dang dgra bgegs dang sdig sgrib thams cad nyal nyal bcad par gyur/ ā+oṃ ā/ u : dang badz+ra cakra warti/ sarba lo ki ka lo ki tā raṃ pa/ yan+ta man+t+ra tan+t+ra/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhan+ta bhan+ta/ku ru ku sa mu ru mu sa a bhi ṣañca a āḥ (7ba〉na tad mnan sbyor ba la sogs pa ngan gnod byed pa'i ban bon thams cad mā ra ya sod sod dza la bzlog phaṭa swāhā/ drug pa yul drang sdig sgrib bshags pa ni/ tre rat+na maṇ+ḍa la/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma 〉〉 maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥs spyan drangs thal mo sbyar la/ hūṃ/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /kun 'dus zil gnon thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ khro gtum thugs rje can la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /gsod byed rgyal mo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /dbyings ldan chags med yum la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /'byung ba sa me lung chu dngas ma las/ /ya ma rā dza phyag na rdo rje dang / /rus sbal rngam pa bya khyung rgyal po rnams/ /ye nas rdo rje'i rags dang rin cen rigs/ /las kyi bar gas dang pad+ma'i rigs nyid de/ /rigs bzhi khro bo'i thugs dang ci 'gal pa/ /dregs pa 'dul byed sku la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ khrung chen smug nag stag chen rngam pa dang / /seng chen brjid pa dug —38

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanasprul nag po ste/ /rgyan gyi lha brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal pa/ /dregs pa stobs kyi lha la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /'khor gyi gshin rje pho mo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ bstan srung so so'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /don dam ngang la dge sdig gnyis med kyang / /de ltar ma rtogs gzung 'dzin dbang gis na/ /nyams chags 'gal zhabrul gyur pa ci tshims pa/ /gnong 'gyod mos pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /rtsa ba (8na)dang yan lag gi dam tshig la chag nyams dang zhig dral du gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /ā+oṃ mañju shrī sa ma ya zhes sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdun pa mi 'da'i dam bca' yongs bzung ba/ /bdag ni deng nas byang chub sems bskyed de/ /bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i spyod pa mthar dbyung zhing / /bla med snying po bsgrub par dam bca'o/ /brgyad pa snod bcud rdzas la byin dbab pa/ /spos rol g.yab dar dang bcas te/ hūṃ/ bder gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /drag po las kyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /chos dbyings drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon yum dang bcas/ /rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha bdag po gsum/ /gshed bzhi mon bdud 'chi bdag sgo srung bcas/ /drag po'i las mdzad pho nya dam can sogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis byin phob cig /bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar ba la/ /re zhig dpung gnyen g.yin na ma mchis pas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la brtser dgongs nas/ /byin chen myur du dbab pa'i dus la bab/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /sngags tshig bshug pa brda yis spyan 'dren na/ /mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig /sgrub (8ba 〉 pa chog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bskur cig /sgrub rdzas dam pa 'di la mthu stsol cig /drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /bdag cag re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mdzod/ /hūṃ/ rtog med spros bral chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /stong pa'i chos nyid ye shes rang snang ba'i/ /'jam dpal khro bo zil gnon 'khor bcas kyis/ /dbang dang byin rlabs mthu dang dngosagrub stsol/ /rol mo tshar rjes/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes ring por brjod/ dgu pa phyi nang mchod tsho gos brlab pa ni/ /bdag gi thugs ma'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros phud snod la thim pas snod kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gnas pa'i steng du hūṃ dkar po de'i 'od zer gyis phyi 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi bkug bdud rtsi la thim pas dngos 'dzin sbyangs nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa lta bur gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& mahā sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ hri thā/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ lasa'od 'phros gtor ma la phog pas snod sne las dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du bcud dpal chen po zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug /rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa gsum/ gshed bzhi/ mon bdud brgyad/'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo srung dang bcas pa la 'dod yon gyi lha mos bskor par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥlha mahā bha lin+ta te dzo bha lin+ta bha ya bha te gu spo sam ye swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag gi thugs ka nas re yaṃ kho gis gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs te/ snod a las bhan+ta'i nang du bcud ā+oṃ āḥ/ zhu ba (9na)las byung ba'i 'dod bu thon drug gi lha mor gyur/ ā+oṃ bha lin+ta te dzo bha lin+ta bha la bha te gu tho sa ma ye swāhā/lan gsum brjod/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis rak+ta'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ bhan+ta ka pā la dra snod bhan+dha yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la ra dmar po de las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'khrug cing 'phyo ba'i steng du yi ge ra dmar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ de las 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus rak+ta'i ngo bo bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa zegs ma la 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phro bar gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ a ka bā la/ a bā sgru pu ā gha ni sha lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ cas ha ra a ha ra/ byu pe/phre ā lo ke /gharnye/ ni wi du/ sha rdi āḥ// gnyis pa dngos gzhin dam tshig ye shes mchode/ / bzlas —40

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanapa bstod bskul lnga las dang po la/ /stong nyid rten dang brten pa rnam gsum gyi/ /dang po spros bral ka dag bsgom pa ni/ /skye phye mye/ e nyid stong pa chos 'byung ste/ /ma skyes 'gag pa med pa las/ /rang bzhin gnas pa dran par bya/ /gnyis pa gzhal yas la ni dngos gdan gnyis/ /dang po rten la drag po'i gzhal yas ni/ /e yi pho brang zla gam gsum/ /thod pa'i mkhar bzhi 'khor lo brgyad/ /lcags mkhar bcu gnyis bar khyams bzhi/ /sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad dang ldan/ /'obs chen bcu drug rdo rje'i gur/ /byas pa med par lhun gyis grub/ /bshig pa med par ngang gis stongs/ /phyi dang nang med kun tu nang / /gnyis (9ba)pa gtso dang 'khor gyi gdan bskyed pa/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / /phyogs skyong ru dra ba ha brgyad/ /nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'bor du/ /gsum pa brten par skad cig gtso bo dang / /'khor tshogs gsum las dang po skad cig bskyed/ /rgyu dang rkyen las ma bskyed par/ /rig pa chu las nya 'phar tshul/ /gnyis par rtsa rgyan go gsum dang po ni/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs can/ /mthing nag zil gnon dregs pa 'dul/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /be con gtun shing sdig mdzub g.yon/ /rigs lnga'i khro bos dbu la brgyan/ /dpal gyi mas brgyad dur khrod brgyan/ /yum ni gnyis med chos kyi dbyings/ /mthing nag tsit+ta bhan dmar steg /ye shes bzhi yi sprul pa las/ /thugs kar ya ma rā dza ni/ /smug nag 'khor lo tsit+ta 'dzin/ ya ma'i thugs kar dregs pa'i bdag /ljang nag rdo rje snying 'phreng 'dzin/ /dregs pa'i thugs kur khyams khang ste/ /'jigs byed chen po thur du blta/ /lto na srid gsum tshe srog 'chang / /spyi gtsug mkha' lding gdug pa 'dul/ /dkar po zil gnon ro nya za/ /gnyis pa sprul pa gyad gnon rgyan lha brgyad/ /phrag gong smug nag 'jigs pa'i khyung / /sog khar stag rma ro la rngam/ zhu khar seng ge ral pa sprug /sta zur dug sprul kha rlangs 'byin/ /ri rab lta bur brjid pa yi/ /gsum pa khro bo bcu sogs sra btsan go /sku la khro bcu rdzogs par bsgom/ /e/ (10na〉steng dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo lo1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ni/ /spyi gtsug mgrin pa ltag pa dang / /dpung pa g.yas dang g.yon la bsgom/ /hūṃ mdzad rta mgrin rnam rgyal gshin rje'i gshed/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil rnams mthing nag zhal nang gzigs/ /'khor lo sdigs pa'i mdzub can bsrung ba'i tshul/ /mtshams bzhi 'og gi khro bo ni/ /brla g.yas g.yon dang lte ba dang / /dbyi mtshams gsang ba'i gnas su bsgom/ /dbyug sngon gzhan gyis mi thub mi g.yo mgon/khams gsum rnam rgyal stobs chen rnams ljang nag /'khor lo sdigs mdzub phyir gzigs byas pa bshig /mgur nas zhabs kyi bar dag la/ khro chung mtshon cha thogs pas gtams/ /ba spu rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /bu ga dgu nas rdo rje yi/ /thog dang me yi 'tshub ma 'phro/ /sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag med 'gyed/ /zhi khro ma gshin phur pa dang / /sa bdag 'gong po pe har dang / /dam sri skye 'gro thams cad kun/ /klu dang klu bdud mdze yi nad/ /zil gyis gnon cing stobs rnams 'phrog /gsum pa 'khor la sprul gshed mon bdud 'chi/ khyams sgo 'obs srung bdun las dang po ni/ /zla gam ga sum la sprul pa gsum/ /sku sprul 'chi bdag bye ba dang / /gsung sprul srog bdag dmar po dang / /thugs sprul tshe bdag dbu dgu pa/ khar lhor gsung sprul srog bdag sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi be con rgyu zhags g.yas/ /g.yon pa gnyis na lcags kyu bse mdung 'dzin/ /rus sbal g.yang gzhi dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /srin mo ro langs spu gri thod 'dzin 'byud/ /bse yi gyi ling dmar po (10ba)srab med chibs/ /lho nub sku sprul bye ba dgu ring ni/ /'chi bdag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /g.yas ser g.yon dmar dbus dang sku yi mdog /sngo nag thod dbyug dgra sta ral gri g.yas/ /thod pa mdung thung lcags kyi ri rab bam/ /me dpung g.yon 'dzin lcags khrab dur khrod chas/ /rin cen sprul sogs sku dang lhu tshigs brgyan/ /srin mo gsod byed tri shul thod 'dzin 'byud/ /ma he sngo nag sprul ris can la chibs/ /byang du thugs sprul tshe bdag sku mdog mthing / /dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad zhabs brgyad bgrad/ /dang po rma bya rkarma khyung gi mgo/ /bar pa dkar dmar dbus mthing khro bo'i zhal/ /rtsa zhal g.yas stag g.yon seng dbus ma he/ /phyag mtshan g.yas dgu rim bzhin 'khor —42

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanalo dang / /ral gri rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung mda' chen/ /zhing dbyug sna tshogs rdo rje lcags phur bsnams/ /g.yon pa be con gtun shing rgyu zhags sbrul/ /sdigs mdzub tri shul dgra sta gzhu tsit+ta/ /zhing stag pags rlon thod sprul la sogs brgyan/ /bdud mo gsod byed tsit+ta snyan dmar thogs/ /mi lpags gos gsol yab 'khyud ma he chibs/ /gnyis pa gshed bzhi yab yum bskyed pa ni/ /phyi rim thod pa'i mkhar bzhi la/ /gshed po ya ma rā dza dang / /srin po myos byed 'bar ba dang / /klu bdud ārla dmar po dang / /gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'o/ /smug nag ral gri zhags 'dzin dred mo zhen/ ser nag gri dang dgra sta 'dzin dom zhon/ /dmar nag lcags kyu zhags 'dzin drel rta nyon/ /ljang nag dbyug to zhags 'dzin rnga mo zhen/ /bzhi ga'ang sprul dang thod pa'i (11na)rgyan gyis brgyan/ /srin mo nag mo e ka dza ti dang / /bdud mo nag mo gnod sbyin nag mo rnams/ /rim bzhin yab la 'khyud cing thod khrag stob/ /gsum pa mon bdud rang rang yum bcas ni/ /de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la/ /phyogs bzhi la ni mon pa bzhi/ /mtshams bzhi la ni bdud bzhi ste/ /de dag yum dang bcas pa'o/ /dung gi mon pa dregs chen seng ge'i mgo/ /mon mo bla rkun rngam pa'i gdong can 'byud/ /lcags kyi mon pa gsod byed stag gi mgo /mon mo nag mo g.yu yi ral can 'byud/ /bse yi mon pa gtum chen dred kyi mgo/ /mon mo che 'phrog khrag gi ral can 'byud/ /gser gyi mon pa srog gshed khyung gi mgo/ /mon mo bla rkun snying la gzer 'debs 'khyud/ /yab bzhi g.yas g.yon 'khor lo zhags pa bsnams/ /yum bzhi tsit+ta thod khrag 'dzin 'byud stob/ /he ye khyab pa sngo nag 'khor lo can/ /bdud mo mi zan snying rkun ma yis 'byud/ /nag po 'dzum med ser nag ral gri 'dzin/ /bdud mo me thogs snying 'byin ma yas stid/ /so 'dar 'khrig pa dmar nag par bu can/ /bdud mo khrag skyug snying gzer 'debs mas 'byud/ /ral pa spyir bcings ljang nag khram shing can/ /nag mo myos byed dbugs sdud ma sa yas 'khyud/ /bdud po bzhi yi g.yon kun khram shing bsnams/ /yum bzhi tsit+ta thod khrag 'dzin 'byud stob/ /mon bdud yab yum kun kyang shin tu rngam/ /me lce slog dang skar mdas brgyan pa'o/ /bzhi pa las kyi 'chi bdag —43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)bcu gnyis ni//phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la//las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gnas//bhe ba su twa mthing nag be cen rdeg/1bshor bu dge 'phel ser nag 'khor lo bskor//ser nag 'joms byed khros pa lcags kyu 'dzin//bye ba dgu khri ljang nag dbyug to bsnams//rak+ta glog 'phreng dmar nag rgyu zhags 'phen//ya ka za byed sngo nag spu gri thogs//gtum po dud kha bdud kyi khram nag 'phyar//gang ba kun 'joms dkar po mda' gzhu 'geng /kha 'bar ral gcig dmar nag ral gri 'phyar//sprul mgo kun 'dzings sngo skya lcags mdung 'phen//dad pa stobs ldan ser po dgra stas gtub//hong pan srog 'dzin nag po bdud zhags rdeg/kun kyang shin tu khros pa'i cha lugs can//'jigs pa'i tshul la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan//lnga pa bar khyams la gnas sprul pa'i tshogs//de yi phyi rim bar khyams la//pho gshed mo gshed la sogs pa'i/sha za zhing dang ma mo'i tshogs//drug pa phyogs rnamasabasrung ba'i sgo ba bzhi//sgo bzhi ru ni rgyal po dang //mgon po bdud dang gnod sbyin bzhi//dkar po snying 'byin ru mtshon 'khor lo 'dzin//mgon po nag po g.yas g.yon beng thod khrag/yab rnga nag po lcam shing bdud zhags bsnams//sku mchog dmar sho g.yas g.yon dbyug to mdung //rang 'dra'i mdog mtshungs ber chen sku la gsol//bdun pa phyi rol 'obs chen srung byed rnams//phyi rol 'obs chen bcu drug la//'obs srung ོ po brgya drug gnas//de ltar de dag thams cad kun//sems rna stong pa'i cho 'phrul te//chos nyid stong las shar bsan//bar snang khams kyi 'ja' wo nam//me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin//snang la rang bzhin 12na thad par blta//rtsa ba'i gnyis pa ye shes dkyil 'khor la//snyan gsan spyan drangs bzhugs gsum dang po ni//e/mi rtog ngang las thugs rje'i sku//sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag/zil gnon lha tsho gos dbyingasanas bzhengs//badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/gnyis pa rang bzhin nas drangs dbyer med bstim//spos rol g.yab dar dang bcas/hūṃ/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshur gshegs khro rgyal tha' na rje'i gshed//gdug pa'i dgra bgegaXsgral ba'i phyir//thugs dam dbang gis gshegs

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(kha)su gsol/ /zil gnon sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ /yum chen gsod byed rgyal mo yang ma mo yongasakyi gtso mo ste/ /thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /zil gnon thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ya ma rā dza gshegs su gsol/ /ya ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dregs pa phyag rdor gshegs su gsol/ /dregs pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rus sbal khros pa gshegs su gsol/ /zil gnon dbu yi gtsug rum nas/ /bya khyung rgyal po gshegs su gsol/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ khyung chen smug nag gshegs su gsol/ /nyams pa'i sha khrag gsol mdzad pa'i/ /stag chen rngam pa gshegs su gsol/ /gdug pa zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /seng chen brjid pa gshegs su gsol/ /mdze shu rkang nad 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /dug sprul nag po gshegs su gsol/ /zla gam dbang gzhal yas nas/ /sprul pa rnam gsum gshegs su gsol/ /pho brang phyogs bzhi'i thod mkhar nas/ /gshed po bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas/ /mon pa bzhi dang bdud po bzhi/ /yum gyi tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol/ /lcags (12ba〉pa khar 'gar ba bcu gnyis nas/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol/ /pho brang phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas/ /sgo ba bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol/ /sgrol zhing las gshin pho nya'i tshogs/ /bye ba sa ya gshegs su gsol/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa yas gye hi dzaḥ/ baṃ sngo gsum pa rang rang stan la bzhugs par gsol/ /e/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lteb la/ /dug gsum yi dwags ma he dang / /phyogs skyong pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis brjid par bzhugs/ /sprul pa gsum sogs 'khor gyi tshogs/ /grangs med rnams kyang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dngos grub bsgrub dang 'gro don phyir/ /mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khag ra ma tsa ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te se gol gdab/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa mchod pa'i las rim la/ phyag phyi nang mchod gsum las dang po ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ e/ chos nyid skye ba med pa las/ /spros bral bde chen dag pa'i sku/ /rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa'i gsung / /—45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ma bsgribs don dam rdzogs pa'i thugs/ /sku gsung thugs nyid rnam dag gis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ khro rgyal 'dus pa kun gyi gtso/ /phyag rgya zil gnon la phyag 'tshal/ /dbyings las ye shes rig pa shar/ /rang bzhin lhun grub phyag rgyar gsal/ /gtso bo'i thugs dam skong mdzad pa'i/ /gsod byed rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal/ /zil gnon thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba/ /sde brgyad kun gyi sbyor ba 'joms/ /ya ma rā dza (13na)la phyag 'tshal/ /ya ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba/ /'phrin las sna tshogs rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /gsang bdag chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /dregs pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba/ /dug lnga rtsad gcod 'byung lnga skems/ /rus sbal khros pa la phyag 'tshal/ /zil non dbu yi gtsug rus nas/ /thugs kyi sprul pa ma cane byung ba/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /bya khyung rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /zil gnon sku yi dkyil 'khor nas/ /thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba/ /sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyi gshed/ /rgyan gyi lha brgyad la phyag 'tshal/ /sprul pa rnam gsum gshed po bzhi/ /mon bzhi bdud bzhi yum dang bcas/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo srung bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi ni a la la ho: gnyis pa thun mong phyi yi mchod pa ni/ /yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis/ /dung chos las 'ongs dngas ma'i chu gnyis sbreng/ /sman shing sna tshogs spos kyi dri ngad 'thul/ /thang skyes chu skyes me tog 'ja' ltar bkra /'bru bcud nyi zla rin cen me 'od gsal/ /dri zhim chab kyis gtams pa'i phor pa 'dzin/ /ro brgya ldan pa lha dang mi yi zas/ /rnga sil pi waṃ snyan pa'i rol mo dbul/ /ā+oṃ a ha ra a ha ra sarba bi dha ra pā dzi te hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sgru pa dhū/ ā+oṃ badz+ra bu 〉 bu/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke ā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ga rje gan/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ni wi du rne/ ā+oṃ badz+ra shabha sha /zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te 'jam rol bya/ gsum pa sman gtor gsang raka 'dod yon lnga'i/ /dang por spyi grangs dngos (13ba)grub gsung thog ma/ /hūṃ/ rar byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i —46

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(kha)sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba'i/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi'ang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ ji hi/ nges pa'i lung ston rdo rje slob dpon che/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /phyon pad+ma wakhrig lag dpal dge la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ ji hi/ bal po'i rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho ye shes rgya mtsho la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ ji hi/ pad+ma dbang rgyal lha rje 'jam dpal dang / /rgya gar rdo rje chos kyi ye shes la/ / dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ khro bo 'bar ba dar ma rgyal mtshan dang / /yang dag rdo rje phug pa sher rgyal la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ ji hi/ rngog ston 'bum legs gro ston bsod nams 'bum/ /bla chen blo rgyan phag ston shāka mgon la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ sbug ston dpal mgon rdor gling chos rgyal mtshan/ /spang ston bde legs se ston rin rgyal la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mgon po zla (14na)ba mnyam med nub dgon pa/ /bkra shis stobs rgyal ngag gi dbang po la /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ chos dbyings rang grol zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal/ /bka' gter bla brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gnyis pa lha tshogs rkang grangs kyis mchod pa/ /hūṃ/ gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon dang / /yum chen gsod byed rgyal mo la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ smug nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /gsod byed ya ma rā dza la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ljang nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dregs pa phyag na rdo rje la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ bskal pa rba klong 'khrug pa nas/ /rus sbal rngam pa mi zan la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /sprul pa'i bya khyung rgyal po rmo la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ khyung stag seng ge ro nye zung / /sprul pa rgyan gyi lha brgyad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /mahā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ /las kyi bdag po rnam gsum la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ya ma rā dza la sogs te/ /gshed bzhi yum dang bcas pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ dung gi mon pa la sogs te/ /mon bzhi mon mor bcas pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes (14bskos mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /mahā pañca a mra ta kha raṃ ji hi/ nye le khyab pa la sogs te/ /bdud bzhi bdud mor bcas pa la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang —48—

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanadangos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ bhe ba sa twa la sogs te/ /las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ sgo bzhi bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa'i/ /drag po'i sgo ba bzhi rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ dpal chen bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /ma gshin dregs pa'i tsho gos rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/gsum pa nyes bshags snod gyur bdud rtsi myang / yig brgya brjod de 'gal 'khrul bshags/ ā+oṃ ā ཿ PROB/dpal ldan rdo rje sku gsung thugs 'chang ba/ /mi phyed rdo rje sku gsung thugs dang ldan/ /deng bdag 'jam dpal sku gsung thugs 'dzin pas/ /'jam dpal sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi ā: tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ gnyis pa bha ling gtor mas mchode pa ni/ /hūṃ/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam par sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥ& baṃ ho'u he ru ka i rda/ (pe/ phre di paṃ/ gharnye/ bha kla ta kha kha khā hi ji hi/ gsum pa sman gyi gsang nan sbreng mchod ni/ /dug lnga'i bdud rtsi che sbyar ye shes lnga/ /sgrub rdzas byang sems me sa rak+ta chu/ /dri chen go ku da ha na sbyar 'di/ /'bul gyi dbyings thim yongs la khyab gyur cig /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā pañca a (15na)rlu ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ bzhi pa dmar chen rak+ta'i skyems 'bul ba/ /gdug can dgra bgegs khrag gi dngas ma'i mtshor/ /mkha' dbyings pad+ma rak+ta'i 'bab ldan kun/ /gcig bsdus mtshams sprin la 'gran dbu 'phreng dang / /rab 'jigs rba rlabs cher g.yo'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ lnga pa nang gi 'dod pa'i yon tan ni/ /dur khrod dbus su tshil chen snang 'od 'bar/ /zhing lpags bla bre 'phan gtibs rgyu ma'i phreng / /klad pa byang sems rdo rje lha ba sha /gsang ba dur khrod rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul/ /e ka hre —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā mo sa khā hi/ mahā rak+ta ji hi/ mahā tsit+ta ji hi/ mahā bha su ta khā hi/mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ke : ti khā hi/ rtsa ba'i bzhi pa sngags kyi bzla thabs la/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bzhi'i dang po/ /thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ gi mthar/ /sku yi sngags las 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od/ /ba spu'i bu ga nas 'thon sdig sgrib kun/ /ba mor nyi ma shar bzhin dag par gyur/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ gnyis pa nang skor gsung gi bzlas pa ni/ /bdag nyid ltar gsal ljags kyi rtse mo las/ /'od zer me dpung tsha tsha ltar 'phros pas/ /las ngan bag chags bar du gcod pa kun/ /bya sgro me la bsregs pa lta bur gyur/ /e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ gsum pa gsang sgor zhugs kyi bzlas pa ni/ /thugs kur mthing nag hūṃ la sngags 'khor ni/ /in+d+ra ni la'i phreng ba lta bu las/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo (15brkong mtshungs 'od zer gyis/ /sdig sgrib sbur ma me lces bsregs ltar gyur/ /e dun ka yaṃ/ bzhi pa yang gsang drag po sngags rgod 'dzab/ /bdag nyid khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon du/ /gsal ba'i tsit+ta rin cen za ma tog /nyi ma'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /sku mdog smug nag thugs gar swā rla'i steng / kha dog lnga ldan hūṃ la sngags kyi 'phreng / /g.yas su 'khor las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /ye shes sems dpa'i zhal brgyud rang gi lcer/ /chu skyes hāḥl sngags kyis bskor bar phog /de las 'od 'phros klad khang zla ba'i steng / /ā+oṃ la sngags phreng bskor la phog pa yis/ /lugs ldog tu 'phros mgal me'i 'khor lo'i mthus/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ /'od zer phyir los bder gshegs thugs rgyud bskul/ /byin rlabs tshur 'dus gsang gsum dngos grub thob/ /slar yang sems can la phog sgrib sbyangs nas/ /mthu dpal gzi mdangs tshur 'dus bdag la thim/ /phyir 'phros me lces dgra bgegs lhag med bsregs/ /tshe dpal mthu stobs ma lus tshur la bsdus/ /rang gi ba spu'i bu gar nyi gdan la/ /bzhugs pa'i khro chung me rlung 'khor lo thogs/ /go mtshams med par gtams te bar gcod kun/ /bsrung zhing bskyabs pas gzhom med rdo rjer gyur/ /ā+oṃ mye phye phye a kro te ga ya mān+ta ka ya ma ye/ kā la rū pa ka pa ye/ hāḥṭīḥ.a —5(/

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanapa ye/ a a ne a ne/ u u ne u ba/ du du ne du ne/ a i u e o e/ ra rī/ la'i/ du rū ye/ bya tsa ye/ sing ha ye/ hri da (16na/ye/ bi ta ye/ tsit+ta ye/ ha la ye/ mu ka ye/ u.u ba/ u.u ne/ bya tri ta/a a na na/ ya ma rā tsa/ ya ma raka /ya ma raka a/ ya ma rak+ṣa/ pe ta li/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e gtsa ti/ de ma kha la paṃ ri la/ ru lu ru lu/ shrī badz+ra kro ta/ ya ma ga rma ro ṣa ṇa/ kri dha tsan dha raka mon ta āḥ/ dzaḥ zhes bsnyen mthar/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig bsdus 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag la deng 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /rtag tu lus ni khyod kyi skur bsgom zhing / /ngag ni gsang sngags zab mo bsnyen cing bsgrub/ /yid ni bde stong ting 'dzin la rol na/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus la bab/ /gnas skabs 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i tshogs kun dang / khyad par srung zlog bsad mnan sreg 'phang sogs/ /mngon sbyang drag po'i las rnams ma lus pa/ /myur 'grub srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /mthar thug theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse mchog /spros bral a ti chen po'i lta ba dang / /rim gnyis zab lam thabs shes zung 'brel du/ /bsgoms pas kun bzang gdod ma'i sar bgrod shog /ces dngos grub blang ngo / /'i rtsa ba lnga pa bstod cing bskul ba ni/ /rab 'byamasadus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /ji snyed gsang gsum yon tan phung po'i tshogs/ /mi bzad sku gsum khro rgyal gad nyams kyis/ /rgya chen srid gsum log 'dren 'joms la bstod/ /zhal khyim (16ba)srod kyi mun pa stug po la/ /dmar zlum spyan gyi glog stong drag 'khyug cing / /'jigs rung gsung gi dbyar gyi rnga bo che/ /rab sgrog gnam lcags rdo rje'i zegs ma 'bab/ /in+d+ra ni la'i 'khri shing bskyod 'dra ba'i/ /phyag drug rno ngar mtshon cha gdengs tsam gyis/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das khro rgyal kun/ /skrag ste slar yang khyod kyi bran du mchis/ gyad kyi dor stabs zhabs ba pad gnyen steng / /mi sdug sgyu rtsal gar gyi rnam 'gyur 'chang / /rdo rje 'bar pa'i khyung gshog brkyangs pa yis/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yang khengs sam snyam/ /gzugs phung rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /mtshan dpe rgyan ldan bde —51—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)chen sar 'gying yang / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon phyir drag po'i skur/ /ston mdzad tshe bdag nag po khyod la bstod/ /dngos 'dzin mtshan bral ye nas ka dag mkhar/ /ma gdon 'bum sde'i mtshan rgyu'i gnyis skyes tshogos/ /'joms mdzad bde chen pad tshal rgyas pa'i yum/ /rdo rje khros ma bcu gnyis bdag por bstod/ /rnam shes phung po ye dag rdo rje'i rigs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis/khro rgyal mthu stobs sbyor ba lha min dpung / /'jigs mdzad sras mchog gtsug na zla bar bstod/ /tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag rin cen rigs/ /gnod sbyin bdud dang rgyal btsan the'u rang gnyan/ /mu stegs las kyi sbyor ba me yi dpal/ /zhi mdzad dregs pa ༷ bdag por bstod/ /'du byed phung po rnam dag las kyi rigs/ khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog dang bkrag mdangs (17na〉〉/ /'byung ba'i dngas ma dbang po'i bung ba kun/ /sdud mdzad rus sbal puṇ+ḍa ri gar bstod/ /'du shes phung po rnam dag pad+ma'i rigs/ /gdug can klu rigs lnga dang klu bdud kyi/ /mdze sogs nyer 'tshe'i sbyor ba glang po'i mgo /'gems mdzad khyung chen gdong lnga'i dbang por bstod/ /sa bdag sa srin btsan dang yul lha mi/ /dud 'gro stobs can dmod pa tsha dbal brag /phye mar 'thag mdzad gzugs kyi sprul bsgyur can/ /rgyan gyi lha brgyad gnam lcags thog mdar bstod/ /dus gsum rnam dag sku gsum thugs kyi gar/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i khro bo'i gzugs/ /mnan bshag bsad pa'i las kyi mtha' sdud pa'i/ /las kyi gshin rje bdag po gsum la bstod/ /nyon mongs bzhi dag spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /snying gi lte ba'i rtsa chen srung skyob cing / /dgra bgegs rtsa 'khor bdud bzhi rang gshed du/ /dbab mdzad las kyi gshed po bzhi la bstod/ /tshogs brgyad skye mched bcu gnyis ye dag pa'i/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i gshed ma mon bdud brgyad/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis bdag lta stong pa'i ngang / /rang rig lhar gsal sgo ba bzhi la bstod/ /ma bcos rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor du/ /'khor lo'i mgon gyis gang 'tsham las kyi phyir/ /rab spros brjod bral grangs med lha tshogs la/ /sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskul mchod bstod gsal sgron ni rgyun 'byer la mi dgos shing sgrub pa'i dus —52

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po' las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(kha)su byed tshul rgyas bsdus phyag len las shes par bya'o//17brko pa la mgon stag zhen dang gter srung mthu chen sde bzhir gtor bsngo dang gsol mchod byed cing gzhan yang chos skyong gi rigs la byed dgos yod na 'dir bya'o//gsum pa rjes chog tshogs 'khor lhag bstan bsdu//bsngo shis rgyun spyod bdun las dang por bas//spyan drang spyi dang bye brag mchod cing bshags//stob pa tsho gos rol bdun gyi dang po ni//ā+oṃ sarba dra bye shwadha ya hūṃ phaṭa/bi shudhe a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/dharma a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/badz+ra yak+ṣa krodha ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/raṃ yaṃ kho/ā+oṃ āḥ&/ā+oṃ bha lin+ta te dz+wa bha lin+ta bha la bha te gu khya sa ma ye swāhā/lan gsum brjod/gnyis pa tsho gis zhing lha tsho gis spyan drang ba//hūṃ/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis//tshur gshegasatshur gshegs khro bdag gtso//rab tu mi bzad 'jigs pa'i tshogs//tshogs kyi longs spyod chen po la//gtum rngam 'khrug pa'i tsho gos rnams gshegs//ya ma kro dha sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ ho gsum pa 'dod yon drug spros spyi ru mchod//hūṃ/bkod pa'i dam tshig phyag rgya che//gnyis su med par bzhes su gsol//mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni//sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs gtibs//mnyam sbyor mchod pas dgyes par thim//sna tshogs gzugs mdos phyag rgya gar//sgra snyan yid 'ong glu dbyangasadang //kun tu tshim byed dri mchog dang //bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan//mawo 'jam bde ba reg bya'i mchog/phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/khro rgyal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul//a la la ho dgyes par mdzod//bzhi 18na pa bye brag g.yas zhal dkar la 'bul//e/mnyam sbyor chos sku'i dkyil 'khor nas//'bar ba gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs//gtum rngam 'brug pa'i lha tsho gos la//log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phyir//zhal zas tshogos kyi mchod pa 'bul//'bar ba'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi//e ka ya ma krodha gha na tsakra pā dza 'a hi/lnga pa nyes tshogs g.yon zhal dmar la bshags//hūṃ/phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol//'dod chags zhe sdang nga rgyal phrag dog lnga//ye nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin la//rmongs pa'i dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te//dngos por bzung nas blang dor gzung 'dzin rnams//'jam dpal rang bzhin tshe bdag sku la

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bshags/ /yig brgya brjod/ drug pa tha ma'i tshogs la dgug pa dang / /bsgral cing stob pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ /hūṃ/ phye ring tshar gcig gis sprul pa spro/ khri dzaḥtri dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ lho bra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ e/ gru gsum e yi snod nang du/ /bdud rtsi lnga'am zas lnga la/ /mtshan ma ming dang bcasapar bya/ /gtum rngam 'brug pa'i lha tshogs kyis/ /dgra bgegs dbang po bkug la bstim/ /phur pas btab la mtshon chas gtubs/ /gnyis pa rnam shes spar zhing gzugs phung gtub/ /e/ zil gnon lha tsho gos 'khor bcas kyis/ /thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab/ /gang la bya ba khyod shes kyi/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /rtsa rgyas khrag dang (18ba)bla mtsho skoms/ /lus srog dbang po dngas snyigs phye/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mngon spyod tshul bzhin sgrol bar mdzod/ /phye myags ya rngubasamugs shag ka dun/ :tri srog la hur thums dzaḥ rtsa khrag snying thums ril raṃ shag rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la tsit+ta breng shag dzaḥ srog la hur thums bod/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ dgra bo a mu /srog la thun rmugs bh+yo/ srog la kho shag bh+yo/ srog la breng shag bh+yo/ srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo/ dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la sto bha ya nan/ gsum pa sman raka gis sbags ling ro dbul/ /ling ro la bdud rtsi sbran nas lta tshogs rnams la 'bul ba ni/ e/ phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa 'di/ /bdud rtsir bsgyur nas 'bul lags kyi/ /gti mug sha yi ngo bo'o/ /'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'thung / /zhe sdang rus pa'i ri bo choms/ /nga rgyal mkhris pa rtsad nas drongs/ /phrag dog don snying zhal du gsol/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga/ khams dang skye mched ma lus pa/ /'bar ba gshin rje'i zhal du stob/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /ma hā me sa khā lha/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta 'a hi/ mahā bha su ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na ji lha/ mahā sku : ti ji hi/ baṃ skongasadang rtsa gsum bskang gso gtong / bdun pa gsog 'jog med par longs spyod pa/ /de nas lha la mchod pa'i tshul du rol lo/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa lhag mar brlab dgug (19nasgo nan/ bstan bsgrag —54

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanasbran mchod bdun las dang po ni/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& sngo gnyis pa lhag ma'i mgron tshogs 'gugs pa ni/ e ma byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal bo mchog /gang phyir sems can 'dul don du/ khro bo 'di dag thugs las byung / /thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /ā+oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ dzaḥgasum pa phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan pa ni/ ā+oṃ shrī mañju kro dha dz+nyā na sarba du gi na bhan dha ya phaṭa/ bzhi pa dam tshig phyag rgya bstan pa ni/ sam ya du man+ta ka ra na phaṭa/ lnga pa dam tshig rna bar bsgrag pa ni/ e ka sa ma ya hūṃ/ drug pa byang chub sems kyi kha chu sbran/ phyag len ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyis dmigs pa dang bcas kha chu btab/ rme gtong sman dang zhing bcu'i sha rus dag /khrag chen dug dang sbrus te rab sbyar nas/ /bdud rtsi byin nas phyag rgya bsgreng byas te/ /log rtog bdag gir 'dzin pa'i zhing bcu la/ /mngon spyod rtags kyi 'phrin las 'di spyod cig /rnam nges kyi sa bcad la ras mi 'phog pa'i phyir 'di bzhin bkod kyi phyag len la kha phru byin rlabs kyi sngon du 'debs shing tshigs bcad 'di 'og gi sa bcad bdun pa dang sbrel lo/ /bdun pa mchod cing 'phrin las gnyer du gtod/ /ā+oṃ e ka ya ma kro ta khā hi/ da rma ya ma sarba sam ya 'a hi/ ma ma rak+ṣa shāk+ki ni khā hi/ bdud pra ma ya ji hi/ pre ta n+ta khā hi/ya ma rā dza pre ta dza la khā hi/ ya ma rā dza pre ta thon khā hi/ ging ka ra ji hi/ dgra bo'i mahā paṃ sa khā hi/ mahā rak+ta ji hi/ mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ dam can (19ba/snag ma'i lha tshogs rnal 'phrin las su gsol ba ni/ sngon rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon cog gi dbu 'phang stod/ge 'dun gyi sdodang srid skyongs/ sgrub pa po'i stong grogs tshul bzhen du mdzod/ gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog par mdzod cig /ces brjod/ zor las byed na skabs 'dir bya/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa bstan ma skyong ba ni/ hūṃ/ bod khams skyong bar khas blangs bstan ma'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi/ /gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi/ /kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi/ /bstan skyong chen mo bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /sngon tshe ji ltar dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes rnal 'byor grogs mdzod cig /bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sgrub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i mthar/ ma ma/ me me/ la la/ le le/ ta ta/ te te/ rdo rje sring 'gro ma hūṃ bh+yoḥm hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā ba kla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes nam mkha' mthong sar bteg la mchod/ sgo drung du bro brdung / nang du dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ e/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ khyad par mchod pa pañca.a mṛ ta/ mahā bha smra rak+ta bcas pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /chos dbyings ngang las khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /lha yi lhar gyur bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /bdud kyi bdud chen ma rungs 'joms pa'i lha/ khro rgyal kun gyi (20na gi tso la gus pas 'dud/ /yi dam lha mchog zil gnon 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las gzhud bzhin brgyas pa la/ /bdag cag ma rig log rtog dbang song ba'i/ /'gal zhabrul nongs pa ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /yig brgya brjod cing 'gal 'khrul bshags/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūṃ hūṃ/ gzhal yas rtsa ba'i lha lnga rgyan lha brgyad/ /gtso bo zil gnon nyid kyi thugs gar bsdu/ /zil gnon nyid kyang mi dmigs cho ge kyi dbyings/ /'khor rnams rang rang gnas su las la gshegs/ /badz+ra muḥ e ka he dun ya ma snying /brag ra ma tsa ya/ rtsa ba'i lnga pa dge ba'i tshogs bsngo ba/ /dge 'di'i mthu yis mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyi/ /rgyud la yod pa'i sgrib gnyis dpung bcoms te/ /gshin rje'i gshed gyur bcom ldan nyid 'grub nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i don byed shog /rtsa ba'i drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ /gang zhig bla med bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam yas pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la rab zhugs nas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /rtsa ba'i bdun pa rgyun gyi spyod lam ni/ dus kun tu lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa las mi 'da' bar nyams su blang ba'o/ /e ma bgrang yas bder gshegs kun gyi yab/ / 'gro ngor rgyal sras gas nu zur phud can/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed po mā /rnam rol phyag rgya zil gnon tshe yi bdag /gang de'i lha sngags ye shes rnal 'byor la/ /gcig tu gzhol na ban bon byad ma'i mtshon/ /rang gshed phab ste bsad zhan dgra (20ba tha gegs kun/ /lnga pa'i lam nas 'og —56

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal/ nang ma(khanamin zhing du 'dren/ /thun mong tsam la mi re tshe gcig la/ /'ong skur grol ba'i dbang rnon sngon mang ding / /sbyangs pa'i las 'phro sad pa'i brtson 'grus can/ /mi 'byung zhes bya'i mtha' de su yis bkag /dus skal phra yang 'jam dpal zhi dang khro'i/ /tshom bur chos nyid bar dor shar grol zhing / /ches dman mi lus thob nas lam gyi 'phro/ /'thud pa'i gnad kyis mi 'jigs zhe blo bde/ /de phyir 'di phyi bar do mtha' klas pa'i/ /skyabs gnas gcig chog 'jam mgon kun bzang las/ /ches lhag 'tshol phyir 'khor 'das thams cad la/ /myul yang rnyed pa'i go skabs ga la zhig /bgrang ring skye bar bsags pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /thob pa'i yi dam 'di dang deng nas bzung / /chos nyid zad sar 'byol min de srid du/ /mi 'bral byin rlabs snying dbus 'jug par shog /pad gnubs gdams pa'i mtho ris chu bo yis/ /nyes brgya'i dri ma ma lus rab bkrus nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dbang gi rgyal/ /skal bzang rgyal mtshan rtse mor mdzes gyur cig /de'ang sa yos brag sna chos rje skyon bstan 'dzin pas las byang tshig shin tu nyung ba la bdag mdun thams cad tshang ba dgos tshul gyi tshe/ de skabs nye skor du 'dzugs 'dun med par brten/ gzhan ngo ldog byed tsam zhig bkod pa thos bsam du mas g.yengs te/ tshig don gyi cha la zhus dag ma byung ba'i mur grwa tshang du 'dzugs rgyur sprad pa shing bya lo gdangs dbyangs gcod pa'i skabs lhan thabs kha yar byas na'ang dge 'dun dar rgyas (21na)sogs 'ga' zhig gis mi srun sgyu dra la brten skyo ma snga btsan gyis skyon mtha' dag sel ma bde bar lus pa 'di nyid lhag pa'i lhar song gshis dag skyor gal po cher mthong nas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams len du man ngag rtsa ba/ se ston chen po'i las byang la chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes lhan thabs sbyar ba'i dgongs don sor bzhag las lag len gzhan dag gis bslad pa med cing gsar rtsom cung zad yod pa rnams la'ang zhus shan tu dag par bgyis pa'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal zhes bya ba 'di ni ring nas bsgrig 'dun yod pa'i steng dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2naslong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum gyis da cha mgyogs pa zhig bsgrigs na legs zhes mtshams sbyar bas rkyen byas lam 'di'i smin grol man ngag mtha' dag la blo gros kyi snang ba gcig tu dkar ba'i za hor gyi sngags ban zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis kun dgar 'bod pa shing stag cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar cha'i dga' ba gnyis par pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang 'jam dbyangs grags pa nyid do/ /sarba maṅga le// //'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bsnyen yig dngos grub gter mdzod bzhugs/'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i rtsal/ /'jam dpal rnam par khros pa dus dgra'i gar/ /sgyur mdzad tshe bdag nag po la btud nas/ /de nyid bsnyen pa'i man ngag 'bri bar bya/ /de'ang 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bsnyen pa bya ba la/ sngon du 'gro ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ pad gnubs brgyud pa'i bka' srol ma nyams pa'i dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ mi dbar khyis ma chod pa'i rigs 'dzin rim par brgyud de/ sgo ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyisadakyil 'khor zab mor bcug ste smin par byas pa zhig gis gnas dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ dam pa gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu dgra 'dre'i 'tshe ba med pa'i gnas su/ sgrub chen rnams las bshad pa ltar spyir btang dmigs bsal byed pa'i sgo nas nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsag /gnas khang phyag bdar bya/ bsnyen sgrub yar ngo la mtshams la zhugs nas yar ngo la 'grol ba dang /las sbyor mar ngo la mtshams la zhugs nas mar ngo la 'grol bar mdzad cing / gza' tshes sogs las so sor 'os pa'i 'jam rtsub dang bstun/ rgyas par spro (2na)na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bring ngas bris kyi dkyil 'khor/ bsdu na sman raka gtor gsum tsam la'ang brten du rung / sgrub chen nas —58

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bsnyen yig dngos grub gter mdzod/ nang ma(khanabashad pa'i sngon 'gro rgyas pa mi mdzad kyang / dkar gtor dmar gtor bshams nas gzhi bgegs la bka' bsgo/ mtho bzhi la rgyal po bzhi'i sku dang bcas te/ bskyed chog nas 'phrin bcol gyi bar spyi dang mthun/ srung 'khor bsgom zhing sgo drung du mtho dkar po zhig brtsig /sgrub pa po kha lhor blta ba'i stan gyi 'og tu sa dkar ram 'bru dkar po'i g.yung drung ris chos skor du 'bri/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bris 'phur gyi sku byin rlabs can bsham/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs na nges don bde 'jug pas 'byung ba ltar dang / ras bris la brten na rdul tshon gyi tshab tu de nyid dgram zhing / bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag mdun tha mi dad pa yin pas dkyil 'khor zhal lhor gzigs pa'am/ gnas khang gi stabs dang ma 'grig na skabs dang sbyor/ bsdu na stegs bu'i khar sgrub gtor la tsakli btsugs/ dar nag gi gdugs phub/ sman raka /mchod gtor/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa (2ba〉〈gas mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bsham/ sgrub gtor dang mchod gtor so sor mdzad srol rnying ma gal cher la mi 'dug na'ang / 'dir byung bas so sor yod na dngos grub len ma ran gyi bar sgrub gtor lhar bskyed pa kho cho rtenas ga mod/ de'ang rnam pa tha dad yin pa'i dkyil 'khor dang mi 'dra la/ gtor ma gcig las med na shes pa rnam pa gsum gyi dbye bas pol 'phral 'gyur 'gro bas skabs thob shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ srod thun nas 'go 'dzugs dgos pas 'phrin las gzhung bsrangs te rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shigs pa'i sku bskyed/ bsnyen pa'i 'gor 'phreng ba man ngag ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs tsit+ta rin po che'i gur phub pa'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyi pa 'khor la/ ye shes sems dpa' ya ma rā dza sku mdog smug nag phyag mtshan gang yang mi mnga' ba zhig gi thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ gi mthar/ a kro 'bru bcu bdun pas bskor ba la dmigs nas/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sogs la mchod pa 'bul ba dang /sems can rnams kyi don byas te/ tshur 'dus 'od zer bdag la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ yang dag byin gyis brlab pa'i dmigs pa zhal shes ltar dang /—59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nado li'i bzlas pa/ las bzhi'i dmigs skor rnams gsung rgyun ltar bya/ srod thun gyi skabs bar chad bsrung ba'i dmigs pa zur khyad can zhal shes bzhin byed/ thun 'jog par dbyangs gsal la man ngag ltar gyi spel tshig btags pa lan bdun brjod/ (3na〉〈gas mchod bam bskang dang tshogs nub re bzhin mi gtong phyin lhag ma bstan ma skyong ba'i bar gzhung bzhin btang / slar yang dkyil 'khor rnams gsal 'debs skyor byas nas rang gis rang mchod pa'i tshul gyis mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ de nas rten brten pa thams cad mi dmigs pa rdzogs chen ka dag gi ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis rten brten pa thams cad khra lam gyis gsal btab/dge ba bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad ci rigs brjod/ sngags bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas dgung thun la gnyid log pas/ dbugs 'byung 'jug thams cad bzlas par 'gro/ de nas thor thun/ snga thun/ dgongs thun gsum la/ las byang rgyas pa byas kyang 'gal ba med/ mi spro na mngon rtogs bsdus pa zhig gis gsal btab rjes bzlas pa srod thun ltar la/ bar chad bsrung ba'i dmigs pa dbyangs gsal la spel tshig btags pa sngags bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas gnyid log pa gsum po mi byed/ snga thun la khyad chos 'bru gsum gyi mjug tu dbyangs gsal la spel tshig btags pa lan bdun brjod/ tshogs 'khor nyin ltar gyi spro na byed mi rung pa min kyang / /bsnyen pa la nges can mi dgos thun mtshams gang yang rung ba la dge sbyor g.yin gyi rigs dang / khyad par gter srung gi gsol ga sogs chag med du byed/ bsnyen tshad ni 'bum phrag gsum yin zhes gong ma rnams gsung / de nas phye ring gi bzlas pa la cho zhugs pas ga mod/ 'on kyang sku gsung thugs sngags kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba 'jam zhing legs(3ba)pa yin pas/ de'ang sngar bshad pa'i a kro spyi bsnyen gyi dmigs pa rnams sngags kha spo ba ma gtogs 'dir yang blangs la/ de la bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po/ las sbyor dang bzhi yod pa'i bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa'i mjug tu/ rnam nges rin cen sgron me nas gsungs pa'i sku gsung thugs so so'i sgos kyi dmigs pa rnams sbyor/ sku gsung thugs kyi bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag drug mdzad pa mang /—60

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bsnyen yig dngos grub gter mdzod/ nang ma(khanagazhung du 'bru 'bum bshad pa legs shing / long yod na gsung dang thugs la'ang bye ba re gtong ngo / /de rjes phye ring gi bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ rnam nges nas bshad pa'i bsnyen par bzla ba'i dmigs pa la phri bsnan ma byas pas gong gi dmigs pa rnam grangs bsnyo bshad pa sogs mtha' dag go rim ma gtogasatshang bas bcos bslad ma byas pas ba/ 'on kyang zhal shes kyi zur rgyan cung zad dgos pa ni brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi nyams su myong bar bya'o/ /bsnyen tshad 'bum du bshad kyang deng sang phyag len du 'bum phrag gsum mdzad/ bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir ye shes pa gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i ya ma rā dza phyag mtshan med pa de ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du gsal thebs pa de gtso che ba dang / las sbyor gyi dus rgyan gyi lha brgyad gal che zhes dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gsung ngo / /gsum pa mjug gi rim pa ni/ de ltar bsnyen pa thems nas 'grol bar/ snga thun las byang rdzogs par btang /bsnyen pa cung zad byas/ tshogs 'khor/ bam bskang / gter srung mchod pa/ bstan skyong / sgrub gtor las dngos (4na)grub blang ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu chog zhas brjod kyi bar rgyas par bya/ rgyal chen bzhi la gtang rag 'bul/ nang mtshams 'grol nyin der dam tshig gtsang ba'i mched lcam 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad/ mig dgra phyogs su lta stangs byed pa ni de thul ba'i dgos pa dang / nyi zla'i phyogs su blta ba ni tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel yin zhes gong ma rnams gsung ngo / /'phreng ba byin gyis brlabs nas gzhan gyis mi reg /mchil ma mi 'dor/ skra sen mi 'breg /nang gi dngos po phyir mi gtong / phyi'i mi dang dngos po mtshams nang du mi gtong / dmigs bsal gyi rigs dgos pa byung na thog ma nas mtshams 'og tu chud pa byed/ byin rlabs dang / srung mdud ster ba sogs mtshams ral ba'i skyon rnams thams cad spangs te bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi blang dor rnams ma 'phyugs par nyams su blang ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /phye ring drag por bzla ba ni rnam nges nas kyang cung zad bshad mod/ de dag ni bsnyen pa thems pa'i rjes su nar mar bzla ba dang / dmigs kyis bsal ba la mtshams bcad de sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi tshul du bzla ba dang / stong srog dang sgos srog gi khyad par sogs —61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rnam grangs shin tu mang ba ni phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gdams skor las shes par bya'o/ /pad gnubs zhal lung tshangs pa'i ral pa nas/ /gshed skor gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /rigs dzin brgyud pa'i skal ldan shing rta yi/ /drin las ma dag dri ma rnam par bkrus/ /lugs 'di'i srol 'byed gnubs dang dum pa (4ba)rgya/ /bar du rgyas mdzad shāka 'bum g.yung ston rje/ /tha mar gshin rje mkhan po nub dgon pa'i/ /gdams pa'i gter 'dzin dbang po'i sde'i gsung rgyun/ khyab bdag pad+ma dbang gi zhal lung las/ /zab don ro brgya'i dpal gyis dngar ba'i bcud/ /snying gi za ma tog tu legs bkod pas/ /cung zad smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho/ /gong chog lag len phra mo'i mgron bu yi/ /'od kyis 'dren byed phying ba'i sngags 'chang rnams/ /zla gsang rgyud sde'i rki la sha yi ri'i/ /rab dkar snang ba'i gzi 'od bzod nus min/ /dang por phyag len dmar khrid zhun thar dpyad/ /bar du bsnyen sgrub nyams len gnad du bsnun/ /tha mar drag po mig gsum 'dar nus pa'i/ /gnubs bstan 'dzin nges rnams kyi btsas su bsdebs/ /dge des bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra sde'i dpung / /ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i mtshon rnon pos/ /bsgral te lhun grub 'jam mgon kun tu bzang / /'od gsal snang bzhi'i lam bzang mngon gyur shog /'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bsnyen yig dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi yang srid rim par brgyud pa byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i zlos gar bya nag gi rigs su byon pa blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ za hor gyi sngags smyon drag po rtsal gyis bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal 61/ / shubha ma stu sarba dza ga rta// //—62

thod sku la brten nas tshe bdag nag po bsnyen pa'i reg zig mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs/ nang ma(khanathod sku la brten nas tshe bdag nag po bsnyen pa'i reg zig mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs bzhugs/dus kyi dgra bo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /gus pas btud nas thod sku dang 'brel ba'i/ /tshe bdag bsnyen pa'i las rim khrigs su sdeb/ /de la 'dir gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde'i zhal gdams chen po las/ pho thod mo thod bzang po la/ /lha bzo stobs ldan mkhas pa yis/ /rgyal nas bzung ste yab yum sku/ /sras mchog sbyor sgrol mkha' lding bzhi/ /gsang mtshan gser dngul thugs gar bzheng / /zhes pa ltar 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi thod sku sgrub par bcas dang lag len gzhud man ngag mthong rgyud kyis rtogs par byas nas lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ mngon rtogs chen mo dang bstod bskul chen mo la brten na smos ma dgos/ rang lugs pad+ma'i man ngag rtsa ba sor bzhag chos rgyal dbyang pa'i zur rgyan dang bcas nyams su bstar ba'i dbang gis 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du lasagazhung lcags 'dar brten rtsis dang / dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa bcad dang pos brtag blang sogs mu tig 'phreng bar mi dgos pa'i phyogs dang / gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho'i dbang chog tu dgos pa'i phyogs sogs rnam grangs mang yang / gnas khang rnying par med du mi (2na)rung ba ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag 'on kyang dkar gtor dmar gtor ba nges don bde 'jug tu'ang byung bas sa blang ba nyung ngu rnam gsal ltar bya de rjes rgyal tho/ /dam sri/ sgo byang / ma tre khro bcu'i mtshams gcod rnams gzhan rje rang gzhung ltar grub na legs mod 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te phur pa sor bzhag la phur pa zhes pa'i mtshan gyi tshab tu tshe bdag dang zil gnon sogs kyi tshig 'don 'byin 'jug byed/ thig tshon gyi skor yang nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhin no/ /de nas las byang gzhung bzhin gyer ba'i snang la rang —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bzhin med par blta/ zhes pa yan song mtshams mdun skyed la dmigs nas/ oṃ su bhā wa shud dha sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ mdun skyed kyi rten brten pa rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas 'khor lo pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du zhes pa'i mjug tu sku ma bris gang du thod pa kha sbyar sman 'brus bkang ba'i sgrub pa bshad na'ang / de skor gyi sgrub pa dang sku 'bri ba thog ma nyid nas logs su byas zin pa 'jug pa bde bas de'i dbang du byas nas/ thod sku lha tshogs rnams kyi sku/gyi
