snying gi srog yig stong srog 'khor lo'i sku rnams (2ba)gtso 'khor so so'i rnam par gyur pa ni/skad cig gis 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po zhal gsum phyag drug ces pa nas bzung thams cad kyang sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa yan dang zil gnon gyi sto bar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dho ra me ri nyi zla kha sbyor/ rtsibs so gnyis phyi nang can/ lte bar 'jam dpal tshe dpag med kyi bum pa'i nang du bsrung bya rnams sba zhing phyi nang du kun tu sngags kyi 'od zer gyi dra bas 'brel ba/ bla byang bsgrub bya so so dngos su gsal ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du zhes pa nas 'bum 'bum gyis bskor bar gyur zhes gsal gdab pa rnams las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo ltar bya/ e mi rtog ngang las thugs rje'i sku/ /zhes pa nas nang gi 'dod yon yan dkyus ltar byas rjes/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kur nyi ma'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang sngags dang de'i mthar/ ā+oṃ ring re res bskor zhing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa me 'od ltar 'bar zhing 'phro bas rtsa gsum zhi khro dkon mchog gsum dang chos skyong lha srin sdo brgyad la sogs pa mchog man bar pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa bsdus nas sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par bsam la thun bzhi'am drug gang rigs su bcas nas bzla/ thun mtshams su bstod bskul byed de ltar bzlas pa 'bum phrag bdun song nas sdeb kyi bzlas pa'i yi ge zur gsal ltar dang / thugs gar nyi ma 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i dbyibs can sran ma'i kha tsam gyis dbus su hūṃ la khyi thung gi sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la smyu a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa 'chi hāḥnyi a pa ye hūṃ/ zhes 'bum phrag bzla/ gang bzla bya'i lha'i thugs —64

thod sku la brten nas tshe bdag nag po bsnyen pa'i reg zig mkha' 'cha ngas/ nang ma(kha)ga'i sa bon sngags bcas las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'phri nu mas (3na15da bsgrubs tshur 'dus sgrub rdzas la thim par bsam/ oṃ āḥ/ dzaḥphyi bhe ta li me hūṃ/ sbyor yum rgyu ma ma e /tsa ti hūṃ/ sgrol yum/ smyu sdom kā li paṃ ril ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūṃ/ nga // smyu ya ma rā tsa kro ta hūṃ/ya ma/ spru badz+ra kro ta ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/ dregs pa/ shrī ma hā bhe tu ka ye hūṃ/ 4 /smyu khri /ru ta hūṃ/ khyung / sde ka he dun ya ma ra tsa hūṃ/ rgyad gnon brgyad de gong gsal so sor khri khrag re/ khyi ya ma du sha hūṃ/ sku sprul/zhe ya ma rak+ṣa hūṃ/ gsung sprul/ skye ya ma yak+ṣa hūṃ/ thugs ta sprul/ ya ma ra tsa bas to me ya/ srin po/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ gshin rje/ ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣi ya/ bdud/ ya snye la rā ma ya/ gnod sbyin/ tsan+ta ru tra mo man+ta dzaḥ dung mon/ ya ma mo n+ta dza: lcags mon/ rak+ṣa mo n+ta dza: bsre mon/ ya ka mo n+ta dzaḥ gser mon/du tri ru lu ha ha ya he le/ du ru ya ma snying du ya/ 'dzum med/ ru tra bha ti ru sha ya/ so bsdang/ ru tra ya ka trig na ya/ ral pa/ skye ya ma rā tsa kro ba kro ne pa tra pa tra/ shu la shu la/ dha sha gh+ri wa/ a ka gh+ri ba ru lu ru lu/ ha ha ya ya/ zla gshed/ ma mo re ma ti/ ma bha ra ma ni/ ma bhi bu ni/ ma tsa mun+ti/ ma bzhi/ bdud ru tra ha la nag po/ ya ma dun raka ya/ ru ru tsa pa la kha la ra smo paṃ thun bh+yo/ ya ka ti na baṃ bh+yo/ zhag gshed/tri tsa pa la a shā me ya/ ma hā kā la ya/ ru tra pu tra ya/ ya ka ru lu ha ha ya/ sgo ba/ ya ma ya ma/ dun na dun/ sha shu/ gh+ri ṇa gh+ri ṇa/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hu la hu la/ be ra be ra/ ha la ha la/ hu la ya hu la ya/ ma ma ru sa nag po ha : / hri ta ya hri ta ya/ ni la dun bh+yo dun bh+yo ya/ za gshed rnams so sor stong phrag re re bzla/sgrol yum thugs ga'i dza la ni/ /ā+oṃ la 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ /(3ba)yab kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /sems can yongs kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo khro mo thams cad dang / /dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi/ /sku la phog pa'i byin rlabs rnams/ /bdag gi lus la thim pa yis/ /sku ni gzi brjid ldan par bsam/ /snye /ya ma he dun raka dun dun dza ya a/ sku/ sgrol yum thugs ka'i dza la ni/ /āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ /yab kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /sems can yongs kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas —65

rgyal dbang ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)byang chub sems dpa' da rnga ma dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo khro mo thams cad dang / / dregs pa gzhan rje'i lha tshogs kyi/ / byangs yan lag drug cu rnams/ /bdag gi ngag la thim pa yis/ /gsung ni byin rlabs nus 9 // /zhe ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ gsung / sgrol yum thugs ga'i dza la ni/ /hūṃ la da zer mthing ga 'phros/ /yab kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /sems can yongs kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo khro mo thams cad dang / /dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tsho gos kyi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugasadam bskul/ /bdag gi yid la thim pa yis/ /thugs nyid tshe nyid rdo rje'i bdag /tshe yi bdag por myur bar bsam/ /spru myags ya rngubs mugs shag dun/ thugs/ sgrol yum thugs da'i dza la ni/ tre la bang 'od zer ser po 'phros/ /yab kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /sems can yongs kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo khro mo (4na)thams cad dang / /dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi/ /longs spyod yon tan kun bsdus nas/ /thod bzang kha sbyor rdzas la thim/ /yon tan yid bzhin nor ltar gyur/ /rnyu dun ka yaṃ/ yon tan gyi sngags te gong gsal bzhi ga so sor khri tshar re bzla/ sgrol yum thugs ma'i dza la ni/ /hrīḥlas 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/ /yab kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /sems can yongs kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / khro bo khro mo thams cad dang / dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi/ /'phrin las phur rdzas thun la thim/ /drag po mthu stobs nus ldan bsam/ /shrī myags kyi mthar dgra bo'i srog la gh+ri hur thums dzaḥ tsa khrag snying thum ril raṃ shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shag dzaḥ srog la gh+ri hur thums rbad/ e dgra bo'i srog la thums ril rbad bh+yo: dun khre shig tsit+ta la myogs bod bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i rtsal dun mugs rbad bh+yoḥ dgra bo yaṃ khrag la mugs ti thun rbad bh+yoḥsngags pa snying du sod/ tsit+ta gtubs rbad long / srog tsit+ta long / myags myags/ mā ra ya tsit+ta la thun bh+yo/'di 'bum tsam bzla bar bshad/ srong la/ rang nyid sbyor yum pe ta li/ sku mdog nag mo dur khrod —66

thod sku la brten nas tshe bdag nag po bsnyen pa'i reg zig mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs/ nang ma(khanachas/ /g.yas pa kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon thod khrag /pad+ma nyi ma ro gdan la/ /gar stabs tshul rgyas bzhugs par gyur/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil dmar po'i steng / /bhu ru lta bu'i ma dmar po/ /snying po 'bru yig g.yon du 'khor/ /i be ta li kro ta shwa ri hūṃ/ sngags kyi 'od zer ra ha bcas/ /yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas su zhugs/ /yab kyi gsang ba'i sgo (4ba)ru ni/ /sna tshogs rgya gram lte ba na/ /don yod grub pa bzhugasapa la/ /sna tsho gos bde stong mchod par 'bul/ /'phrin las thams cad grub par bsam/ /lde ba snying kha mgrin pa spyi/ /rigs kyi lha rnams der bzhugs la/ /oṃ āḥ& swāhā bsam/ 'od zer yi ge bsdusapa las/ /yon tan thugs gsung sku yi ni/ /bde stong mchod pas rab mnyes te/ /thugs dam dbyings su skye med stongs/ /'od zer dmar po lu gu rgyud/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i gnas su thim/ /yum lnga brgyud de gsang bar thon/ /yang yang 'khor ba'i mchod byas pas/ /dbang rnams rdzogs te zil gnon gyur/ /nam gung / nam phyed dbyings yum mu kha le/ /sku mdog nag mo re lde gsol/ khre shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams/ /ro yi gdan la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil drag las ni/ /snying po sngags dang 'od zer ni/ e dhe ma ga li paṃ ril ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ tho rangs/ pad+ma nyi zla ro gdan la/ /rang nyid e ka tsa ti ni/ /sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa ral gris skye shi yi/ /srog dang mgo lus gtubs par bsam/ /g.yon pa lce sbyang mgo dgu 'gyed/ /nyams pa'i srog dbugs tho rangs len/ /mi lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /thugs gar nyi dkyil bh+yo nag las/ /sngags bcas 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /sngar dang 'dra ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /e ma ma e ka tsa ci ti hūṃ/ nyin mo/ thun ldang bcas pa'i dang po la/ /sku yi tshe bdag sku mdog dkar/ /sgrol yum nas/ dun dun dza ya a zhes pa'i bar/ gnyis pa/ gsung gi tshe bdag sku mdog dmar/ /sgrol yum nas/ ra ma tsa ya'i bar gsum pa la/ thugs kyi tshe bdag sku mdog mthing / /sgrol yum nas/ mugs (5na 〉 zhag ka dun gyi bar/ bzhi pa/ yon tan tshe bdag sku mdog ser/ /sgrol yum nas/ e dun ka yaṃ gi bar/ lnga pa/ 'phrin las tshe bdag sku mdog ljang / /sgrol yum nas/ myags myags/ mā ra ya tsit+ta la thun bh+yo/ zhes pa'i bar zhag —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gnyis sam bdun gang rung bya/ de nas yab yum 'khril sbyor nas/ /g.yas su dbyings yum skyed par bya/ /g.yon du sgrol yum skyed par bya/ /yab kyi thugs kar 'od zer 'phros/ /pho rgyud rnams la phog pa yis/ khas blangs dam bcas bsnyen pa rdzogs/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ la 'dus/ /ya khod brtsegs pa lta bur bsam/ /pho rgyud rnams kyi srog dbang thob/ /bh+yo yis gsang ba'i dregs pa rnams/ /srog dbang thob pa bsnyen pa'i gnad/ /bla rdo la'i ba nyid du 'gyur/ /mtshan mo yum gsum snying po las/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ /mo rgyud rnams la phog pa yis/ /mo rgyud srog dbang nus pa rnams/ /ye shes mo rgyud gsum la bsdu/ /ma khod brtsegs pa lta bur gyur/ /mo rgyud bla rdo gsang ba'i gnas/ /skye ring stong phrag gcig bzla dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams gzhung ltar bshams bsang brlab bya/ bdag zil gnon du gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'i sa bon las 'od glog gi zhags pa ltar rno zhing myur ba spros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud ma lus pa'i tshe srog dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa bsdus tshe rgyas dang tshogs rdzas la thim par bsam/ kā ya wa kyi t+ta ā nga na tshe sa ni dzaḥlha swāhā/ stong phrag gcig bzlas rjes/ phyi snod nang bcud thams (5ba〉5da sems/ /'jig rten dregs pa yab yum thim/ /yab yum sngags bcas hūṃ la bsdu/ /hūṃ bcas dngos grub rdzas la bsdu/ /rang gi lus ngag yid la thim/ /zhes brjod/ tshe rgyas kyi phud lha la dbul/ /bar pa dngos grub kyi rdzas su rnal 'byor pa rnams rol/ tha ma sgrub rdzas kyi phabs rgyun la bsre rgyur bzhag /tshogs gzhung bzhin btang / 'jug tu sbyin sreg ma grub na yi ge brgya pa gang mang bzla/ thod sku/ stong srog 'khor lo/ gri snying gi lha rnams dam ye dbyer med du rten so sor brtan bzhugs dang rten 'brel snying po dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha gyur ba tu gnas/ rdul tshon rnams bsdu shis pa brjod do/ /ljongs 'dir u rgyan mkhan po'i bzhes gzhung / sangs rgyas ye shes mnog chos bka' gter la/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag pad gnubs lugs srol zhes/ /sngags 'chang phal gyi ngag las rlung ltar grags/ /gnubs lugs lcags 'dra lcags sdig nang tshan la/ /lam gyi gnad don zab par mtshungs —68—

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)na'ang na /bcas choge mchod rten sgrub sogs las rim la/ /rgyas bsdus mi 'dra'i dbye ba pha mtha' yas/ /legs ldan rdo rje'i ma dros rgya mtsho las/ /'bri byang phyag bzhes gaṅgā pa ku' klung / /dbur smyon chos grags khyab bdag zur chen gyis/ /drin las sgoms pa'i gdung ba ci yang sel/ /de phyir tshad ldan mda' yi srog shing sogs/ /mi dgos smra ba'i gral khyur ma tshud par/ /dka' gnad bcu drug cha shas gang ba'i bzla/ /blo gros shar gyi ri dbang rtse nas thon/ /dge dpe rmonges pa'i smag rus kun sangs nas/ /rgya bal bod kyi rigs 'dzin dgongs pa'i gzugs/ /ma 'dres so sor lta ba'i chos kyi spyan/ /(6na)ring min thob ste gzhan don byed par shog /ces pa'ang me 'brug lcags sdig sor bzhag gi mchod rten bcas chog bzheng skabs za hor gyi bzhes reg zig tu bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no// //'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags phros ra mtho zhes bya ba bzhugs/na ma shrī ya ma rā dzā yurba ta ye/ bde chen 'gyur med chos dbyings kun gsal mdzes mar grangs med gzugs sku'i mi lhung phyang phrul legs par 'god mkhas byed po kun tu bzang / /srid gsum bdud sde'i sha mchog sbyin byung phon po phye mar 'thag mdzad longs sku gtsug na zla ba'i nyag phran 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum yon tan phung po'i kun phan gang thugs mkha' la rab 'char las ldan sa mos rgyas mdzad sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum ngo bo rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyi zhabs zung mkha' lding dkar po bdag yid rdzing bur rol ba'i dga' ston stsol/ /snga 'gyur rgyud snga'i rang byung mgo skyes nas/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i zab lam 'chi med chab/ /'bad rtsol du mas phyogs 'dir rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /sgra bsgyur gnubs chen skal ldan shing rta'i zhabs/ /phyi —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nang gsang gsum gdams pa yid bzhin nor/ /sna tshogs sgrom bu'i klu dbang cod pan du/ /mi mngon phyag rgyas btab pa gsang ba'i gter/ /thub bstan 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas bya'i phyir/ /(2na)legs par 'don mdzad rdo rje 'od 'bar sogs/ /rab stims las bzhi'i rin chen bang mdzod mchog /'dzin mkhas dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin tshogs rnams la/ /gus pas 'dud do brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sdig rgyud gnam lcags thog mda' las grub pa'i/ /phrin las 'khor lo 'bar ba rtsibs ston can/ /man ngag ha la nag pos dar btags pa/ /phyogs bcur 'khor ro bdud sdeb ga yod byos/ /thog mar bla brgyud gsol 'debs ni/ khyab bdag thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang / kha sbyor bdun ldan khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed/ /nges gsang rgyud sde'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /zung 'jug sku brnyes 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma /bha wa/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin nor bu 'dzin/ /gsol ba 'debs sodangos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po budha'i mtshan/ /las ldan gter ston rdo rje 'od 'bar dang / /gang de'i gdams pa'i mnga' bdag /stoṭa ra/ /gsol ba (2ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rigs 'dzin dbang po gangs ban bkra shis dar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gangs pa ri dkar ba/ /ga brgyad bran du 'khol ba shāka 'bum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing rdo rje dpal/ /zab sbas gsal bar ston pa'i shākya'i mtshan/ /rigs 'dzin mkhas grub mkhyen rab dpal mgon la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed chos kyi rje/ /bde legs rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal gyur dang / /gsang rnying bstan pa'i bdag po sgrol ma bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /rnam gnyis gtsug bsten rat+na dh+wa dza'i 'bras/ /gshin rje gshed dngosasom nā tha dang / /dbang chen grub pa mchog brnyes nub dgon par/ /gsol ba 'debs so de ngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /sprul sku rigs 'dzin chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /zil gnon dngos grub mchog brnyes —7()

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanargyal mtshan dpal/ /zhing skyed bran du bkol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /ma lus gdams pa'i gaṅgā khyod thugs su/ /legs(gtams mkhas btsun bzang po'i brtul zhugs can/ /dpal 'byor sku gsum lhun grub drang srong che/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /srid gsum zil gnon mngon spyod drag rtsal las/ /'phrin las rdo rje'i pha lam rtsibs stong can/ /'khor byed khrag 'thung rnam rol dpa' bo'i sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /phyi nang gsang gsum gdam pa sa 'dzin dbang / /rno ngar rna cha brgyad sogs gser gyi ri/ /ston mdzad byed pa dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis byin chags gnas mchog tu/ /mi phyed phyag rgyas btab pa zab mo'i gter/ /(3na〉na nas chos bka' yi srung mar bcas pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /'khor ba'i ngang tshul kun la yid log cing / /'gro rnams sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i ched/ /med byung theg pa mchog gi lam zhugs nas/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bgrod pa rnam pa gsum gyi 'jug ngogs las/ /smin par byed pa dbang gi rim pa dag /mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon drung nod de/ /nges gsang snod du rung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu rkyen dang bral chu las nya 'phar tshul/ /gsal stong lha skur ldang ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /dregs pa thug phrad bsad pa'i drag po'i sngags/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /grangs med chos rnams ma lus sems kyi klong / /ye nas grol ba'i mi 'gyur kun tu bzang / /gdod nas 'khrul ma phyong ba'i rig pa 'di/ /tshe 'dir myur du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs bzang phyag rgya las 'ongs dga' ba bzhi/ /rdzogs pa'i bde stong ye shes rab rgyas shing / /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan sku bzhi'i bar/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'grub bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na yang zab 'jam dpal rdzogs chen sogs/ /sangs rgyas rjen par ston pa'i zab mo'i chos/ /nyams su blangs pas 'di phyi bar gsum gyi/ /bde legs don kun lhun gyis grub gyur cig /de nas 'jam dpal zhi ba bskyed pa ni/ /chos kun stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i —7/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ngang / /pad nyi chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor steng / /sngags kyi yi ge brjod dang 'phro 'du las/ /rang nyid 'dzam bu nā da'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /(3bcud 'ong gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa can/ /phyag zung shes rab ral gri ut+pal gyi/ /'dab stong rgyas rtser sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung can/ /sna tshogs rin chen phreng ba'i do shal dang / /rab bkra lhab lhub dar gyis mngon par klubs/ /thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /dam tshig pa dang ye shes gnyis med gyur/ /mdun du dpag bsam rkang 'thung yal 'dab dang / /gad bu mngon par rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus/ /mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la nyi ma'i gnyen/ /theg gsum gdul bya'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /bdag mdun kun la phyi nang gsang ba yis/ /mchod tshogs dngos bshams yid kyis legs sprul 'bul/ khyud tshig dbyar gyi rnga gsang cher bsgrags pas/ /skal ldan mdongs mtha'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /rgyud rgyas bsdus gang rung song rjes/ sngon dus rgyal bas ri bo bya rkang du/ /rgyud 'di gsungs tshe sku las 'od zer 'bum/ /re re'i rtse la 'dab ldan pad+ma'i steng / /sprul pa'i sku res phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ /chosa'akhor bskor ltar bdag gis 'jam dpal gyi/ /chos 'di bsgrags pas sems can thams cad kyi/ /rgyud la skye med yongs su thob pa dang / /'dzin med rang grol 'gyur ba'i rgyur gyur cig /skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus kun/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /rgya chen byang chub mchog tu sems mchogo bskyed/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing (4na ji/ mdun du rin chen khri pad nyi zla'i steng / /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon cod pan du/ /kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa la/ /dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo mchog gsum ston pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma —72—

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanalus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu dus dang dam pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / dag pa'i mtha' gzhan dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /dus gsum bzhugs la lus dbul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /de nas srung 'khor ni/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhen nur gsal ba skad cig gis phyag rgya chen po zil gnon zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ dur khrod kyi chas dang gar dgu'i nyams can ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs spu'i hūṃ las khro bo'i tshogs grangs med pa 'phro bar gyur/ de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas/ /mthing nag hūṃ gi 'od zer las/ /stong gsum mtho ba'i rab gang zhing / /rngam skas 'jig rten kun bkang nas/ /gnod mdzes khro bo ma yin pa'i/ /gdug pa g.yo 'gul ming yang med/ /(4ba)bro rgyal mtshon cha me ri 'bar 'bar ba'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /ā+oṃ nga ni byung hūṃ/ kṛ hā kṛ hā hūṃ/ kṛ hā pā ya kṛ hā pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho: bha ga wā na bi du rā dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sra brtan mi g.yo rdo rje'i gur khang dang / /gtum drag khro bo rol pas rab gtams shing / /rno ngar mtshon cha kha dog lnga ldan pa'i/ /dus mtha'i me yis bar mtshams med par khyab/ /phaṭa raṃ e raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ khro bo dang mtshon cha me rab tu 'bar ba'i gur khang du gyur/ /rang nyid zil gnon gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i thugs gar : yig las/ /gser 'khor lte bar bcas steng nyi gdan la/ /phyogs kyi grangs ldan hūṃ las khro bo bcu/ /rab 'jigs mthing nag be con zhags pa bsnams/ /dbus su rang nyid zhi ba'i nyams ldan pa'i/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal phyag gnyis tsakra 'dzin/ /thugs dar ye shes 'khor lo 'khor ba yis/ /rigs sngags byad stems rbod gtong zor kha dang / /log 'dren dgra sde'i gnod cing 'tshe ba sogs/ /stong gsum khro rgyal kun kyang skrag byed pa'i/ /rno ngar rtsibs kyi bar du lhag med gyur/ /ā+oṃ ā54 dzi badz+ra tsakra warti sarba lo ki ka lo ki ta raṃ pa yan tra man tra tan tra ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ku ru ku ru smu ru skru ru a bhi ṇiñca a āḥ gtad mnan sbyor ba la sogs pa dag mnan byed —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa'i ban bon thams cad mā ra ya sod sod/ dza la bzlog phaṭa swāhā/ long skabs dang bstan pa'i bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas bshags pa ni/ rab yangs bdag mdun mkha' la rin chen khris/ /chu skyes rta bdun dkyil 'khor gdan steng du/ /rtsa (ldan〉rgyud bla ma yi dam srung mar bcas/ /dbyar du chu 'dzin 'khrigs ltar bzhugs par gyur/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /kun 'dul zil gnon thugs dang ci 'gal ba/khro gtum thugs rje can la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /gsod byed rgyal mo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /dbyings ldan chags med yum la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /'byung ba sa me rlung chu dngas ma las/ /ya ma rā dza phyag na rdo rje dang / /rus sbal rnga slong bya khyung rgyal po rnams/ /ye nas rdo rje'i rigs dang rin cen rigs/ /las kyi rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs nyid de/ /rigs bzhi khro bo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /dregs pa 'dus byed sku la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ khyung chen smug nag stag chen rngam pa dang / /seng chen brjid pa dug sbrul nag po ste/ /rgyan gyi lha brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /dregs pa stobs kyi lha la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /'khor gyi gshin rje pho mo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /bstan srung so so'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /don dam ngang la dge sdig gnyis med kyang / /de ltar ma rtogs gzung 'dzin dbang gis na/ /nyams chags 'gal 'brul gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /gnong 'gyod mos pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /thogs med nas bsags rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung ma lus rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun la bzod par (5ba)gsol/ /zil gnon thugs dam bzhin du spyad par bgyi/ /yig brgya brjod/ de nas byin dbab ni/ /hūṃ/ bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /drag po las kyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /chos dbyings —74

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khan drag po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon yum dang bcas/ /rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha bdag po gsum/ /gshed bzhi mon bdud 'chi bdag sgo srung bcas/ /drag po'i las mdzad pho nya dam can tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis byin phob cig /bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar ba la/ /re zhig dpung gnyen g.yin na ma mchis pas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la brtser dgongs las/ /byin chen myur du dbab pa'i dus la bab/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /sngags tshigs shug pa brda yis spyan 'dren na/ /mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cing / /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /sgrub rdzas dam pa 'di la mthu stsol cig /drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /bdag cag re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /phyi nang gi mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/bdag gi thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ phud snod la thim pas snod kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gnas pa'i steng na hūṃ dkar po de'i 'od zer gyis phyi 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus/ /ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi bkug /bdud rtsi la thim pas dngos 'dzin sbyangs nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi (6na)mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa lta bur gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ :thā/ bdag gi thugs rka'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis rak+ta'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ ban+ta ka pā la : / snod ༷ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la ra dmar po/ de las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po rba klong zhabrug cing 'phyo ba'i steng du yi ge dmar po 'od zer 'phra bar gyur/ de las 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du'i rak+ta'i ngo bo bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgyad dang ldan pa zer ma la 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phro bar gyur/ ā+oṃ gi2PROB ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ kho gyis gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs te snod a las brgyu'i nang du bcud ā+oṃ āḥ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon drug gi lha mor gyur/ /ā+oṃ bha li ta te dzo bha kla ta bha la bha ti gu phya sa ma ye swāhā/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ /gtor ma la phog /—75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)snod : las dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du bcud dpal chen po zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug /rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa gsum/ gshed bzhi/ /mon bdud bcu drug /'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ sgo srung dang bcas pa la 'dod yon gyi lha mos bskor bar gyur/ ā+oṃ ma hā bha smra ta te dzo bha smra ta bha la bha te gu spo sa ma ye swāhā/ a ka pha la a dhu pu/ a ga na lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ baṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ a ha ra hūṃ/ badz+ra sgru pe/ phre ā lo ke /gha rje/ ni wa du/ shasta āḥ&/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ mye phye mye/ 'khor 'das (6ba〉pam gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang rig 'gyur med byang chub sems mchog ste/ /gsal stong gnyis med sku gsum gdod ma'i mgon/ /rab 'byams lha tshogs las kyi e ru gyur/ /'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs steng keng rus kyi/ /sa 'dzin dbang po'i rtse mor gzhal yas khang / /bkod legs rin chen las grub sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs brgyad ldan ban+ta'i pha gu la/ /brang 'gro'i srad bus gcus pa'i dra phyed 'phyang / /'obs r+ṣa bcu drug dur khrod wo po brgyad/ /rdo ra bskal pa'i me dpung rab 'khrigs pa'i/ /dbus su mthing nag e yi pho brang la/ /zla gam dmar po sum ldan thod mkhar bzhi/ /lcags mkhar brgyad dang bcu gnyis bar khyams bcas/ /snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tsho gos rnams kyi/ /ka gdung dral lcam yas phub snga them can/ /ma lus gnam lcags 'bar pa'i gzer gyis btab/ /klu gnyan sa bdag ha la'i ngo bo nyid/ /rlung gi zas can 'bum sde dur 'chi khri/ /'phar 'gro stong dang phyogs skyong ru dra kun/ /spyi las rab bsnol 'jigs pa bcu pa brgyad/ /'dab stong nam mkha'i nor bu'i dkyil 'khor steng / khyu rkyen dang bral rang nyid skad cig gis/ khro rgyal kun kyang skrag byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon sku/ /rab khros mthing nag dug chen 'khyil 'dra'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mun lta'i rtsa ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje 'phen/ /be cen gtun shing sdigs mdzub me dpung 'phro/ /zhabs(7na〉zhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang tshul gyas bzhugs/ /lha lam khyab pa'i rdo rje'i gshog pa sogs/ /dpal gyi chos brgyad dur —76

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)khrod rgyan rnams kun/ /bkod legs bgrang yas phyang phrul legs spud cing / /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur can/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /rdo rje khros ma sngo nag g.yas tsit+ta/ /g.yon pa bhan dha khrag bkang gtso la stob/ /zugs kar nyi dkyil bam steng sras mchog ni/ /g.yas pa gser 'khor g.yon pa tsit+ta bsnams/ /ya ma'i thugs kar bsil gzer gdan steng du/ /dregs pa ljang nag rdo rje rtse dgu g.yas/ /g.yon pa snying phreng 'dzin cing gsum ga yang / /rin chen sprul dang dur khrod mas kyis brgyan/ /gang thugs chu skyes steng du rus sbal ni/ /srid gsum tshe srog stor 'chang khro zhing rngam/ /rab dkar khyung chen ral gri 'dab gshog la/ /gnam lcags mchu sder rwa bgrad spyi bor lding / /phrag gong smug nag khyung gnyis gzhog pa brdeb/ /nu khar gdong lnga'i dbang po 'gying zhing rngam/ /sogs khar stagazung sha dang khrag la rol/ /sta zur sbrul nag gdug pa'i lce gnyis bskyod/ /lhun po lhar brjid gtsug tu hūṃ mdzad dang / /mgrin par pad+ma dbang chen ltag rnam rgyal/ /dpung pa gnyisal gshin rje bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /mthing nag rab khros nang du zhal gzigs srung / /brla gnyis dbyug sngon gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /lta bar mi g.yo mgon dang dbyi mtshams na/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gsang gnas stobs po che/ /ljang nag (7ba)phyir gzigs pha rol byas pa bshig /khro bo bcu po kun kyang 'khor lo g.yas/ /g.yon pa me dpung rab 'bar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /mgur nas long bu'i bar du tshon gang gi /khro chung me rlung las kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /bzod dka' tsha grang 'byung lnga'i 'brul 'khor gyis/ /srid gsum kun las rnam par rgyal bar gyur/ /sprul pa gsum bskyed pa ni/ gtso bo'i g.yas zur sku sprul 'chi bdag ni/ /rtsa zhal sngo nag g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ /phyag drug thod dbyug ral gri dgra sta g.yas/ /1 mdung dang lcags kyi ri rab g.yon/ /lcags khrab gsol zhing dur khrod mas kyis brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi ma he sngo nag steng du 'gying / /yum chen gsod byed phyag gnyis tri shu dang / /thod pa khrag gang 'dzin pas yab la 'byud/ /g.yon zur gsung sprul srog bdag dmar po ni/'kha gcig phyag bzhi 'khas gnyis sa gi ling chibs/ /g.yas gnyis be con rgyu zhags g.yon pa na/ /—77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)lcags kyu mdung bsnams rus sbal g.yang gzhi gsol/ /dur khrod chas brgyan ro langs spu gri dang / /ka pā la 'dzin yab kyi mgul nas 'khyung / /rgyab phyogs thugs sprul tshe bdag nag po ni/ /zhal dgu bco brgyad phyag la 'khas bzhi bgrad/ /dbus gsum ma he khro zhal khyung gi dbu/ /g.yas gsum stag dang zhi zhal rma bya'i gdong / /g.yon gsum seng ge dbang zhal dur bya'i mgo /phyag dgu g.yas kyis rdo rje zhing dbyug mdung / /'khor lo ral gri dgra sta kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gri gug rdo rje 'bar ba'i tho ba bsnams/ /g.yon dgu ka pā la dang 'byung po'i bya/ /(8na)be con gtun shing sdigs 'dzub lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa mi snying zhing lpags rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dur khrod chas brgyan bdud mo gsod byed rgyal/ /tsit+ta khrag gang thod 'dzin yab la 'khyud/ /gshed bzhi bskyed pa ni/ thod pa'i mkhar bzhin dred mo lag rdeb dang / /dom nag dre'u rta rnga mo gdan steng du/ /gshin rje srin po klu bdud gnod sbyin bzhi/ /smug ser dmar ljang rab khros nag po'i mdangs/ /bzhi ga'i phyag gnyis 'khor lo be con 'dzin/ /sprul dang thod pa'i phreng ba'i rgyan gyis spras/ /srin mo ral gcig bdud dang gnod sbyin ma/ /yab la 'byud cing thod khrag zhal du stob/ /mon pa bzhi bskyed pa ni/ lcags mkhar phyogs bzhi dung lcags bse gser gyi/ /mon pa seng stag dred dang khyung mgo can/ /g.yas pa ri rab g.yon pa zhags pa bsnams/ /bla rkun g.yu dang khrag gi ral pa can/ /snying la gzer 'debs ma rnams tsit+ta dang / /༷ 'dzin cing rang 'dra'i yab la 'khyud/ /mtshams bzhir he la khyab pa 'dzum med dang / /so 'dar 'khrigs pa ral pa spyi bcings rnams/ /sngo ser dmar ljang mdog la mun pa'i mdangs/ /'khor lo ral gri par bu khram shing bsnams/ /brgyad ka me dpung slog phreng skar mda' sogs/ /snying rkun snying 'byin gzor 'debs dbugs sdud ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra /mi snying thod pa 'dzin cing yab la 'khyud/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis bskyed pa ni/ phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis shar phyogs su/ /bhe wa sa twa nor bu dge 'phel gnyis/ /mthing ser mdangs can be con 'khor lo bskor/ khar lhor ser nag 'joms (8ba)byed lcags kyu 'dzin/ /lho ru bye ba dgu khri glog 'phreng zung / /ljang dmar —78—

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanamadog can dbyug pa rgyu zhags 'phen/ /lho nub za byed sngo nag spu gri thogs/ /nub tu gtum po gang ba kun tu 'joms/ /dud kha dkar mdangs khram shing mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /nub byang ral gcig dmar nag ral gri 'phyar/ /byang phyogs sprul mgo kun 'dzin ngad stobs ldan/ /sngo ser lcags kyi mdung thung dgra sta 'dzin/ /byang shar hong pan srog 'dzin bdud zhags 'phen/ /dur khrod chas sogs 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /bar khyams kyi lha bskyed pa ni/ phyi rim khyams su las kyi gshin rje rnams/ lga za ki gang ma mo dregs pa yi/ /tshul 'dzin sna tshogs mtshon thogs dgra bgegs kyi/ /srog dbugs bla tshe sha dang khrag la rol/ /sgo ba bzhi bskyed pa ni/ sgo bzhir dkar po snying 'byin mgon po nag /yab rje mun pa'i mgo can sku mchog dmar/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs ber chen sku la gsol/ /phyi rol 'obs srung ni/ 'obs srung 'jigs rung bshan pa srog gshed bdag /phyogs bcur las byed pho nya gshin rje'i tshogs/ /mig gis blta bar bzod dka' khro bo'i lus/ /mkha' la rgyu skar tshogs ltar lhun gyis grub/ /snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ rnyu/ mi rtog ngang las thugs rje'i sku/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /zil gnon lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs khro rgyal gshin rje'i (9na)gshed/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir/ /thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /zil gnon sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ /yum chen gsod byed rgyal mo yang / /ma mo yongs kyi gtso mo ste/ /thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /zil gnon thugasakyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ya ma rā dza gshegs su gsol/ /ya ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /phyag na rdo rje gshegs su gsol/ /dregs pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /rus sbal khros pa gshegs su gsol/ /zil gnon dbu yi gtsug rum nas/ /bya khyung rgyal po gshegs su gsol/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /khyung chen smug nag gshegs su gsol/ /nyams pa'i sha khrag gsol mdzad pa'i/ /stag chen rngam pa gshegs su gsol/ /gdug pa zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /seng chen —79—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)brjid pa gshegs su gsol/ /mdze shu rkang nad 'jom mdzad pa'i/ /dug sprul nag po gshegs su gsol/ /zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas nas/ /sprul pa rnam gsum gshegs su gsol/ /pho brang phyogs bzhi'i thod mkhar nas/ /gshed po bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas/ /mon pa bzhi dang bdud po bzhi/ /yum gyi tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol/ /lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu gnyis nas/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol/ /pho brang phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas/ /sgo ba bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol/ /sgrol gin las gshin pho lha'i tshogs/ /bye ba sa ya gshegs su gsol/ /myi ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya a gye ti dzaḥ& baṃ 〉 gye/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte ba la/ /dug gsum yi dwags ma he dang / /phyogs skyong pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /(9ba7rkyang bskum tshul gyis brdzing par bzhugs/ /sprul pa gsum sogs 'khor gyi tshogs/ /grangs med rnams kyang dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dngos grub bsgrub dang 'gro don phyir/ /mi 'gyur brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ti gi badz+ra/ phyag bya ba ni/myi/ chos nyid skye ba med pa las: spros bral bde chen dag pa'i sku: rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa'i gsung : ma sgribs don dam rdzogs pa'i thugs: sku gsung thugs nyid rnam dag gis: mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: khro rgyal 'dus pa kun gyi gtso: phyag rgya zil gnon la phyag 'tshal: dbyings las ye shes rig pa shar: rang bzhin lhun grub phyag rgyar gsal gtso bo'i thugs dam skong mdzad pa:gsod byed rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal: zil gnon thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba: sdo brgyad kun gyi sbyor ba 'joms: ya ma rā tsa la phyag 'tshal: ya ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba: 'phrin las sna tshogs rdzogs mdzad pa'i gsang bdag chen po la phyag 'tshal: dregs pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba dug lnga rtsad gcod 'byung lnga skems: rus sbal khros pa la phyag 'tshal: zil gnon dbu yi gtsug rum nas:thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba: khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i bya khyung rgyal po la phyag —8//

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khana'atshal zil gnon sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs kyi sprul pa mngon byung ba: sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyi gshed: rgyan gyi lha brgyad la phyag 'tshal: sprul pa rnam (10na)gsum gshed po bzhi mon bzhi bdud bzhi yum dang bcas: 'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo srung bzhi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud: phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya a ti pu ho: pra ti pu ho: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta mahā yo gi ni a la la ho: phyi mchod ni/ grangs med yid 'ong rin chen snod yangs su/ /yan lag brgyad ldan la 'gran nyal 'gro'i dbus/ /pad dkar sa mos 'dab stong ba 'ad pa 'di/ /mthong tshe 'chi med dga' tshal 'ongs sam snyam/ /ma la yar skyes me tog don can dang / /thal ba'i snying po la sogs dri mchog rnams/ /'od kyi shing rtas bsregs pa'i dud sprin ni/ /nam mkha'i gnyis 'thung sdug po 'khrigs pa bzhin/ /dus mtha'i rlung gi grogs po pham byed pa'i/ /snang gsal mar me lho phyogs rta gdong 'od/ /bzod par ma nus rta bdun dkyil 'khor de/ /mthar thug gzhu khyim bgrod tshe slar yang ldog /ji snyed gting mtha' dpag par dka' ba yi/ /chu srin grong khyer dag la bzang drug gis/ /legs par bran te rat+na'i snod yangs su/ /mngon par 'god pa'i byed po e ma mtshar/ /lha mi'i 'dod yon ro mchog brgya pa sogs/ /rnam mang zas kyi tshogs kun gcig bsdus pa'i/ /zhim dgu'i zhal zas rmad byung bkod legs 'di/ /rab mdzes rgyan gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /char dus dbyar gyi rnga gsang bsgrags ba ltar/ /pi wang gling bu sil snyan ā khyu ka /gre 'gyur glu dbyangs la sogs sgra yi tshogs/ /bsgrags pas gan dha lha yi khengs 'phrogs/ /legs bris sked med la 'khu zur (10ba/yeg can/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu'i nyams ldan yid 'phrog ma/ /lhab lhub gos dang phyang phrul legs brgyan nas/ /'dod yon lnga sogs mchod pa'i tshogs rnams spro/ /a+yo ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya putre nas/ shas pratā ts+tsha swāhā/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ myong grol dam rdzas dang sbyar a my-i ta/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byin brlabs 'di/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas la 'bul/ /e ka te dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ /ji lha/ bla ma brgyud mchod ni/—8/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'phags pa 'jam dpal 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /skyon pad+ma gtsug lag dpal dge la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ bal po'i rgyal po gnubs chen sangs rgyas dang / /yon tan rgya mtsho ye shes rgya mtsho la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta mahā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ pad+ma dbang rgyal bla chen 'jam dpal dang/ /rgya gar rdo rje chos kyi ye shes la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ khro bo 'bar ba dar ma rgyal mtshan dang / /yang dag rdo rje phug pa shes rgyal la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ rngog ston 'bum dang gro ston bsod nams 'bum/ /bla chen blo rgyal phag ston shāka mgon la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ spug ston chen po mkhas grub chen po dang / /slob dpon chen po se ston chen po la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ zla ba mgon po mnyam med nub dgon pa/ /dbang po'i sde dang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ gsang bdag gnyis pa 'khon ston chos kyi rje/ /bka' gter bla brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji nyi/ gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon dang / /yum chen gsod (11na)byed rgyal mo la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ smug nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /gnod byed ya ma rā —82

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)dza la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ljang nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dregs pa phyag na rdo rje la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ bskal pa rba klong 'khrug pa nas/ /rus sbal rngam pa mi zan la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /mahā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad pa'i/ /sprul pa'i bya khyung rgyal po la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ khyung stag seng ge ro nye zung / /sprul pa rgyan gyi lha brgyad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ /las kyi bdag po rnam gsum la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ya ma rā dza la sogs te/ /gshed bzhi yum dang bcas pa la/ /dam jos bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ dung gi mon pa la sogs te/ /mon bzhi mon mor bcas pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ he li khyab pa la sogs te/ /bdud bzhi bdud mor bcas pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /mahā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji nyi/ bhe wa sa twa la sogs te/ /las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ sgo bzhi bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa/ /drag po'i sgo ba bzhi rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/dpal chen bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /ma (11ba)gshin dregs pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/—83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dngos grub blang ba ni/ ā+oṃ āḥlha/ slar yang rigs /ridzin smra ba'i 'bab stegs khar/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myang ba yis/ /zil gnon sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /thogs pa med par myur du stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sid+dhi ā+oṃ/ wā ka sirnyi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/ rak+ta ni/gdug can dgra bgegs khrag gi dngas ma'i mtshor/ /mkha' dbyings pad+ma rak+ta'i 'bab ldan kun/ /gcig bsdus mtshams sprin la 'gran dbu 'phreng dang / /rab 'jigs rba rlabs cher g.yo'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /gye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā rak+ta pū dza ji hi/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/zhing bcu bsgral pa'i sha rus dbang lnga'i rdul/ /rab brtsegs dmar chen bha sla sprin chen dbang / /rin chen sna bzhi kun bzang mchod sprin du/ /dmigs te zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /khyu ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā bha li ta pā dza ji hi/ sbreng mchod ni/ dug lnga'i bdud rtsi che sbyar ye shes lnga/ /bsgrub rdzas byang sems mo sa rak+ta chu/ /dri chen sto ku da ha na sbyar 'di/ /'bul gyis dbyings thim yongs la khyab gyur cig /phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ nang gi 'dod yon ni/ dur khrod dbus su tshil chen snang 'od 'bar/ /zhing lpags bla bres 'phan gtibs rgyu ma'i 'phreng / /klad pa byang sems rdo rje lha ba sha /gsang ba dur khrod sna lnga'i mchod pa 'bul/ /gye ka ju dun ya ma snying (12na tshe brag ra ma tsa ya mahā mo sa 'a hi/ mahā rak+ta ji hi/ mahā tsit+ta ji hi/ mahā bha su ta khā lha/ mahā go ro tsa na ji hi/ mahā ke'u ti ji nyi/ rang snang shes rab e gsang chu gter che/ /thabs kyi dran pa'i ka ba'i lhun po yis/ /legs par bsrabs las byang sems bdud rtsi mchog /'du 'phrod thon pa'i bde chen rgyas gyur cig /phya ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā mu dra pā dza khā lha ho/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /ji snyed gsang gsum yon tan phung po'i tshogs/ /mi zad sku gsum khro rgyal gar nyams kyis/ /rgya chen srid gsum log 'dren 'joms la bstod/ /zhal khyim thun mtshams dus kyi mun pa la/ /dmar zlum spyan gyi glog stong drag 'khrug cing / /'jigs rung gsung gi dbyang gyi rnga bo che/ /rab sgrog gnam lcags rdo rje'i —84—

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanazegs ma 'bab/ /in+d+ra ni li'i 'khri shing bskyod 'dra ba'i/ /phyag drug rno ngar shasta btab tsam gyis/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das khro rgyal kun/ /skrag ste slar yang khyod kyi bran du mchis/ /reg byed grangs ldan bgrod byed pad gnyen steng / /mi sdug sgyu rtsal gar gyi rnam 'gyur 'chang / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i khyung gshog gdangs pa yis/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yang khengs sam snyam/ /chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo rigs brgya'i bdag /mtshan dpe rgyan ldan bde chen sar 'gying yang / /srid gsum 'di na dpe bral drag po'i skur/ /ston mdzad tshe bdag nag po khyod la bstod/ /dngos 'dzin mtshan bral ye nas ka dag mkhar/ /ma gdon 'bum (12ba)sde'i mtshan rgyu'i gnyis skyes tshogs/ /'joms mdzad bde chen pad tshal rgyas pa'i yum/ /rdo rje khros ma bcu gnyis bdag por bstod/ /rnam shes phung po ye dag rdo rje'i rigs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ /khro rgyal mthu stobs sbyor ba me sbyin skyes/ /'jigs mjad sras mchog gtsug na zla bar bstod/ /tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag rin chen rigs/ /gnod sbyin bdud dang rgyal bcan the'u rang gzhan/ /mu stegs las kyi sbyor ba'i du ba'i tog /zhi mdzad dregs pa sa d+dha 'a bdag por bstod/ /'du byed phung po rnam dag las kyi rigs/ khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog dang bkrag mdangs tshe/ /'byung ba'i dngas ma dbang po'i bung ba kun/ /sdud mdzad rus sbal puṇ+ḍa rā dar bstod/ /'du shes phung po rnam dag pad+ma'i rigs/ /gdug can ka dru bu dang klu bdud kyi/ /mdze sogs nyer 'tshe'i sbyor ba 'gram thung mgo /'gems mdzad khyung chen 'phrog byed dbang por bstod/ /sde brgyad dregs pa rbod gtong rig sngags dang / /tsha ba'i dbal sogs gnod byed brag gi ri/ /phye mar 'thag mdzad gzugs kyi sprul bsgyur can/ /rgyan gyi lha brgyad nam mkha'i tho bar bstod/ /dug gsum rnam dag sku gsung thugs kyi gar/ /rnam 'gyur cir yang ston pa'i khro bo'i gzugs/ /mnan bshig bsad pa'i las kyis mtha' sdud pa'i/ /las kyi gshin rje bdag po gsum la bstod/ /nyon mongs bzhi dag spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /snying ga lte ba'i rtsa chen bsrung skyob cing / /dgra bgegs rtsa 'khor bdud bzhi rang gshed du/ /dbab mdzad las kyi gshed po bzhi la bstod/ /tshogs brgyad (13na)—85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)skye mched bcu gnyis ye dag pa'i/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i gshed ma mon bdud brgyad/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis bdag lta stong ba'i ngang / /rang rig lhar gsal sgo ba bzhi la bstod/ /ma bcos rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor du/ /'khor lo'i mgon gyis gang 'tsham las kyi phyir/ /rab spros brjod bral spangs med lha tshogs la/ /sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ phyi nang gsang gsum yang gsang dang bcas pa'i bzlas thabs las/ dang po ni/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ gi mthar/ /sku yi sngags las 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od/ /ba spu'i bu ga nas thon sdig sgrib kun/ /ba mor nyi ma shar bzhin dag par gyur/ /phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ gnyis pa ni/bdag nyid lhar gsal ljags kyi rtse mo las/ /'od zer me dpung tsha tsha lngar 'phros pas/ /las ngan bag chags bar du gcod pa kun/ /bya sgro me la bsregs pa lta bur gyur/ /mye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ gsum pa ni/ thugs kar mthing nag hūṃ las sngags 'khor ni/ /in+d+ra nī la'i 'phreng ba lta bu las/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo dang mtshungs 'od zer gyis/ /sdig sgrib sbur ma me lces bsregs ltar gyur/ /mye dun ka yaṃ/ bzhi pa la bsnyen par bzla ba dang / drag por bzla ba'i lugs gnas las/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon du/ /gsal ba'i tsit+ta rin chen za ma tog /nyi ma'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /sku mdog smug nag thugs gar sur+ya'i (13ba〉steng / kha dog lnga ldan hūṃ las sngags kyi phreng / /g.yas su 'khor los 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /ye shes sems dpa'i zhal brgyad rang gi lce/ /chu skyes khyuḥl sngags kyis bskor bar phog /de las 'od 'phros klad khang zla ba'i steng / /ā+oṃ las sngags phreng bskor la phog pa yis/ /lugs bzlog tu 'phros mgal me'i 'khor lo'i mthus/ /sdig sgrib kun sbyangs dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /sems can don byas mthu dpal gzi mdangs kun/ /rta bdun 'bum gyi 'od ltar rgyas par gyur/ /phyir 'phros dgra dang bgegs rnams thal bar brlag /'jigs med rdo rje khro ba'i srung bar gyur/ /oṃ mye phye phye/ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma ye/ kā la rū pa ka pa ye/ hrī sti a pa ye/ a ā yi a ni/ u lū ba༄kyi ni/ du du ba du ba/ a i —86

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)u e tse( e/ ra rī/ la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ sing ha ye/ hri da ye/ be ta ye/ tsi ta ye/ ha la ye/ mu ka ye/ u u ne/ u u ba/ byi tri ta/ a a na na/ ya ma rā dza/ ya ma raka /ya ma raka a/ ya ma rak+ṣa/pe ta li/ kro ti shwa ri/ ma ma e ka dza ti/ de ma kha la baṃ ril/ ru lu ru lu/ /shrī badz+ra krota /ya ma ga rmā ro ṣa ṇa/ kṛ ta tsan ta/ raka mon ta āḥlha dzaḥ phyi ma drag por bzla dang rno 'don sngags/ /stong srog sgosasrog gdags sogs zab mo'i gnad/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung las stsal min pa/ /yi ger 'bri ba mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgyas gdams/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khre'i lha tshogs kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig bsdus 'jam dpal gshin (14na)rje'i gshed/ /phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag la deng 'dir dgongs su gsol/ /rtag tu lus ni khyod kyi skur bsgom zhing / /ngag ni gsang sngags zab mo bsnyen cing bsgrubs/ /yid ni bde stong ting 'dzin la rol na/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus la bab/ /gnas skabs 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i tshogs kun dang / khyad par srung bzlog gsad mnan bsreg 'phang sogs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las rnams ma lus pa/ /myur 'grub srid gsum kun las rgyal bar mdzod/ /mthar thug theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse mchog /spros bal a ti chen po'i lta ba dang / /rim gnyis zab lam thabs shes zung 'brel du/ /bsgoms pas kun bzang gdod ma'i sar bgrod shog /gter bdag mchod pa ni/ mthu chen sde bzhi'i gtor ma dang gtor snod sogs mkhas pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje gnubs ban lo tsā ba/ /rdo rje 'od 'bar la sogs spyan snga ma khas blangs dam ldan mthu chen sdebazhi po/ /thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra e gu sha dzaḥdzaḥ dgra bgegs sha khrag sa 'dzin lta bur spungs/ /don snying khrag gi 'bab ldan mtsho ru 'khyil/ /sna tshogs rus pas nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab/ /gsur chen dud pa zhun chen mar me dang / /sman raka gtor gsum bdud rtsi byin brlabs 'di/ /mthu chen bdud btsan zung gi spyan lam du/ /'dod dgur spyod la thogs med 'phrin (14ba)las sgrubs/ /rab dkar gtsang mar sbyar ba'i bsgos —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bu la/ /sna tshogs bzang po'i sman sogs rdzas kyis bkang / /yid 'ong gzugs mdzes rgyan gyis legs par spud/ /dri zhim spos dang gtsang ma'i yon chab dang / /sgyu rtsal las kyi sprul bsgyur gar la sogs/ /'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /bka' nyan lha klu zung gi spyan lam du/ /'dod dgur spyod la thogs med 'phrin las sgrubs/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis gtor ma 'bul/ /de nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ stobs kyi shugs 'chang rta dkar gdan steng du/ /zhi khro'i nyams ldan rab dkar lha mchog dpal/ /lhab lhub gos dang 'jam dkar dar thod can/ /srid rtser bsnyeg 'dra'i dar dkar ru mtshon 'phyar/ /stag ral gzig shubs rked bcings mthu ldan khyod/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs dgra dpung la/ /mi mthun rgyu thums snying gzer tshogs rnams thong / /bcol ba'i las kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /nor bu'i 'khri shing las grub sa 'dzin ltar/ /mdog dmar dar gyi thod dang lhab lhub gos/ /stag ral gzig shubs rked bcings ru mtshon 'phyar/ /btsan gyi zhags pa dmar po glog ltar 'phen/ /mthu ldan khyod kyi dam tshig rab dgongs la/ /dam nyams dgra la btsan zhags dmar po thog /gri 'thab lhog gzer nad sogs ma lus thor/ /bcol ba'i las kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /mthing nag mun pa'i mdog ldan srin po'i gzugs/ /dar nag gos gyon dbu la thod nag bcings/ /stag ral gzig shubs dang ldan ru mchen 'dzin/ /(15na)rta nag zhon nas mchan mo phyogs bcur rgyu/ /bdud zhags nag pos dgra bo'i ske nas 'chings/ /mthu ldan khyod kyi dam bca' ma yel bar/ /thibs nad nag po dgra bo'i steng du phob/ /bcol ba'i las kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /rab khros sder mo gnam lcags spu gri can/ /rus sbal la bcibs rdo rje spyan gcig ma/ /drug sbrul gdengs ma'i chun pos dbu la brgyan/ /sdig lpags gsol zhing sram gyi rgyal mchan 'dzin/ /dug sprul zhags pa nag po klad la bskor/ /mthu chen khyod kyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar/ /klu nad mdze shu nag po dgra la thong / /bcol ba las kun thogs med sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas tshogs ni/ raṃ yaṃ kho gyis tshogs kyi yo byad kun/ /ma dag skyon sbyangs gsang gsum yig 'bru —88

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanayi/ /nus mthu'i 'phrul gyis sbyangs rtogs rab sbar zhing / /ho yis zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥsnyi ho:gha na tsakra hūṃ hrī4/ mgron spyan drang ba ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/khyad par tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyan 'dren na/ /thogs pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol/ /tshogs spyir 'bul ba ni/ /ngo bo snang stong kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /rnam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan 'di/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /mchog thun 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /g.yon zhal la 'bul ba ni/ zag bral bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgya ldan pa'i/ /ye shes tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /rab dmar rjes chags (15ba)g.yon gyi zhal du 'bul/ /dgyes dgur spyod la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /yi dam nas bzung ste chos skyong gi bar la 'bul lo/ /g.yas zhal la bshags pa ni/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gaṅgā 'a rgyun/ /legs sgrub 'byung gnas dam tshig gangs kyi ri/ /nyes ltung dri ma'i tsha zer gyis bzhu ba/ khro rgyal chu 'dzin tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /yig brgya brjod/ dbus zhal la bsgral mchod ni/ hūṃ/ phye ring tshar gcig gas sprul pa spro/ /niḥdzaḥtro dzaḥ/ dzaḥ& baṃ 'a pra pe sha phaṭa a be sha āḥ phye/ gru gsum e yi snod nang du: bdud rtsi lnga yi zas lnga la: mtshan ma ming dang bcas par bya:gtum rngam 'khrug pa'i lha tshogs kyis: dgra bgegs dbang po bkug la bstim: phur pas btab la mtshon chas gtubs/ /phye/ zil gnon lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyi: thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab:gang la bya ba khyed shes kyis: dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol: zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms: rtsa rgyus khrag dang bla mtsho skoms: lus srog dbang po dngas snyegs phye: 'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus: snang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: mngon spyod tshul bzhin sgral par mdzod: phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun rlu tri srog la hur / dzaḥ rtsa khrag snying ṭaṃ ril ri shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shag dzaḥ srog la hur thums rbad: phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya: dgra bo a mu ka srog la thum rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yi shag bh+yo: dgra bo'i —89—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)srog la mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo'i (16na)srog la sto bha ya nan: phye/ phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa 'di: bdud rtsir bsgyur nas 'bul lags kyi gti mug sha yi ngo bo zo: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'thung : zhe sdang rus pa ri bo choms: nga rgyal mkhris pa rtsad nas drongs: phrag dog don snying zhal du gsol: phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga: khams dang skye mched ma lus pa: 'bar ba gshin rje'i 'kha du bstab: bstan pa srung phyir bzhes su gsol: ma hā me sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ mahā tsit+ta/ mahā bha su ta/ mahā go ro tsa na/ ma hā ko ni ti khā hi/ de nas bskang ba'i cho ga ni/ thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sha chan dang sbyar ba'i bag zan gyi bam ro'i gzugs mtshan nyid tshang ba/ sman raka gtor gsum sgron me dang bcas pa phyag len ltar bshams la/ hūṃ/ gsang chen gnas mchog bde 'a pho brang 'dir/ /rab yangs thod pa'i snod du bam 0 ro'i/ /spyi bor bha ling rgyan ldan khyung chen lding / /lag gnyis thod nang sman raka mtshor 'khyil zhing / /tshil chen mar me rta bdun 'od ltar gsal/ kha chen dud pa'i sprin gyis lha lam khyab/ /srog chags lus rnam 'gyur grangs las 'das/ /snyan brjid sgra yis phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs/ /kun kyang rang rang dgyes dgur longs spyod pa'i/ /lus kyi phyi nang dbang po don snod dang / ga khrag rus pa tshe srog dbugs la sogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /'dod yon lnga ldan kun bzang mchod sprin 'dis/ /bcom (16bskon phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskang / /yum chen rdo rje khros pa'i thugs dam bskang / /sras mchog dregs pa gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang / /rus sbal khyung chen zung gi thugs dam bskang / /sprul pa rgyan gyi lha brgyad thugs dam bskang / /las gshin bdag po gsum gyi thugs dam bskang / /phyi nang gsang gsum gshed po'i thugs dam bskang / /'chi bdag bcu gnyis sgo bzhi las gshin sogs/ /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong gyur nas/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /lhag ma btang ba ni/ ā+oṃ āḥ& ga zho badz+ra' ki rā dza hūṃ dzaḥ dkyil 'khor phyi rol bar khyams rab yangs par/ /sngon tshe dpal chen spyan sngar khas—90

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanablangs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro gshin rje la sogs dregs pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad thogs pa med par 'dir 'dus shig /ā+oṃ shrī mañju kro ta dz+nyā na sarba du / bhan+ta ya phaṭa/ sa ma ya du man+ta ka ra ya phaṭa/ e ka sam ya hūṃ/ dmar chen sha khrag bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /tshogs la rol ba'i lhag gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /'gal rkyen kun gsol mthun pa'i don rnams sgrubs/ /61 e ka ya ma krodha khā hi/ /rma ya ma sarba sa ma ya ji hi/ ma ma rak+ṣa ḍā ki ni 'a hi/ /bdud pra ma ya khā hi/ pre ta nyin dha khā hi/ ya ma rā dza pre ta dza la ji hi/ ya ma rā dza pre ta tho rka khā hi/ gying kā ra khā hi/ dgra bo'i ma hā mo sa khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta ji hi/ de nas rang bzhin gyi ched du gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde nas gsungs pa'i drag po zor gyi las bya ba ni/ (17na)ma tre gyi steng du lcags slang bug rdol med pa'i nang du ri rab bang rim bzhi par/ lha so so'i gtor ma thog gzugs bya/ tsa ka li rtsang mar mtshe yungs sogs dang / kong zor/ khrag zor/ mda' zor/ yungs zor/ rdo zor rnams bzhi'am brgyad dang / khyad par g.yag 'og yod kyi rwa g.yas dang / thun rdzas gtor chung dang ling ga bzlog gsad skabs thob kyis phye ba rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar zhib par bshams/ chas gos rnams nag por byas te/ rang nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ ā+oṃ la sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyis sman raka gtor gsum gyi skyon rnams sbyangs te ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ&/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ ā+oṃ su bha was mdun bskyed kyi gtor zor rnams stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rim gyis brtsegs pa'i steng du ke las keng rus kyi ri rab yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i steng du : las dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad dang ldan pa/ 1 skam rlon gyi rtsig pa la gnas pa la gnam lcags kyi gzer btab pa/ nang lha chen brgyad kyi ka ba/ klu chen brgyad kyi gdung / gza' chen brgyad kyi gzhu/ rus sbal gyi ka gdan glang chen gyi ma them/ 'brug gi ya them/ 'gram gnyis seng ge /stag gzig gi sgo la nyi zla zung gis brgyan pa/ chu srin gyi pad bskor/ zhing chen gyi thog phub pa/ dug —91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sbrul dang rgyu rlon gyi dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/ de'i dbus su e'i (17ba)pho brang gling dgu/ zla gam dmar po gsum dang ldan pa/ de'i phyi rol tu lcags 'khor bcu gnyis thod ras bskor ba/ gru chad bzhir lcags mkhar gru gsum bcu gnyis khyams dang bcas pa/ phyi rol tu rdo ra me ris bskor ba/ dbus su klu 'bum/ gnyan khri/ sa bdag stong / phyogs skyong bcu rnams spyi bcings su bsnol ba'i khar ma he brgyad kyis btegs pa'i 'khor lo pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ skad cig gis gtor ma 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po 'kha gsum phyag drug zhabs bzha bgrad pa/ rtsa 'kha dug ha la'i mdog lta bu/ g.yas zhal dkar la g.yon zhal dmar ba'i mdangs can/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan dgu sdang mig tu bgrad cing / dbu skra dang sma ra smin ma rnams bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ rab dkar mche ba'i chu 'dzin gyi dbu tha/su ljags kyi glog 'phreng 'khrug pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gnam lcags las sdo/ba pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas te bskor bas gshin rje'i tshogs rnams kyang sdigs pa/bar pas ral gri me rab tu 'bar bas bdud sde kun la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ster ba/ tha ma gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pas mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las bsrung ba/ g.yon gyi dang po ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con nor bu 'bar ba'i tog gis mtshan pa nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu stsol ba/ bar pa na pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po skyengs par byed pa'i gtun shing gis srid gsum dregs pa'i mgo bo 'gems pa/ tha ma sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pas log 'dren dgra bgegs thams cad 'ching ba/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i (18na)rtse phran gyis brgyan pa/ sde brgyad dregs pa'i mgo dang tsit+ta rgyu ma'i srad bu la brgyus pa'i do shal dang /rin po che'i phreng ba dang sprul gyi gdu bu rnams kyis spras shing / rdo rje 'bar ba'i khyung gshog mkha' la gdengs pa/ sku stod glang chen gyi ko rlon dang mi lpags kye g.yang gzhi gsol zhing / stag lpags kyi sham thabs sogs dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ spyi gtsug tu bya khyung 0(32

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)dkar po ral gri'i gshog pa la gnam lcags kyi mchu sder can/ spyi bor nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa/klu gnyan kun gyi gshed ma mdzad cing nam mkha' la lding ba/ g.yon phyogs su yum chen pe ta li sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dgra bgegs kyi don snying bzung nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing / g.yon ban+ta rak+tas bkang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ rin po che dang thod sprul la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing zhabs gnyis yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis ma srin thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ g.yas su dbyings yum srid pa'i rgyal mo mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas skye 'gro khram la 'debs shing / g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa dgra la 'phyo ba/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang gzig lpags kyi sham thabs gyon pa/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings pa/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyis brgyan cing thod sprul gyi do shal dang dar gyi lhab lhub can/ bam ro dmar po'i steng la bzhugs pa/ gling dgu'i shar phyogs (18ba)dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du dregs pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang snying phreng 'dzin cing / sprul dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ klu gnyan sa bdag kun gyi gshed ma mdzad pa/ lho phyogs gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la gsod byed sras mchog ya ma rā tsa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'khor lo dang tsit+ta 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gza' rgod rbod gtong thams cad kyi stobs 'joms par mdzad pa/ nub phyogs klu dbang pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rus sbal rngam pa mi zan gser rgyab ser po la dug khrag gi thig les brgyan pa/ spyan gnyis nyi zla ltar gsal zhing mche ba gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ sder mo spu gri ltar rno zhing ba spu mtshon cha ltar gzings pa/ srid gsum 'byung ba thams cad lto bar 'chang zhing / lha srin sde brgyad kun las rnam par rgyal ba/byang phyogs gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la sgrol yum e ka dzā ṭi sngo nag dug gi brlab sprin ltar 'phyo ba/ g.yas ral gri glog gi phreng ba 'dzin cing / g.yon g.yu'i spyang mo mgo dgu 'gyed pas dgra bgegs kyi bla dgugs pa/ mi lpags re lde'i gos dang thod sgrul gyi rgyan can/ ral pa nyi zla pad+ma — 33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nor bus mdzes shing bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ shar lhor me lha'i gdan la lha'i gshed po seng ge'i mgo can/ g.yas srid pa'i phyags shing dang g.yon na gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol (19na〉ba/ yum seng ge'i gzugs can 'gying ba la bcibs pa/ lho nub srin po'i gdan la srog bdag dmar po stag gi mgo can/ g.yas be con dang g.yon gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo 'dzin cing zhing chen dang stag lpags gsol ba/ yum stag gi gzugs can mi ro za ba la chibs pa/ nub byang rlung lha'i gdan la klu gshed nag po chu srin gyi mgo can/ ral pa'i gseb nas dug sbrul dgu gdeng ba/ g.yas khram shing dang g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin cing / rus sbal gyi g.yang gzhi dang dar dmar gyi ang rag gsol ba/ yum sprul gyi gzugs can gdug pa'i kha rlangs 'phyo ba la bcibs pa/ byang shar dbang ldan gyi gdan la bgegs kyi rgyal po bi na ya ma'i ded dpon khyung gi mgo can sku mdog mthing smug bya rgod kyi g.yang gzhi gsol pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ yum khyung gi gzugs can kha la me 'bar ba la bcibs pa/byang phyogs kyi zla gam la dmyal khams pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du sku yi sprul pa tshe bdag nag po dbu dgu/ phyag bco brgyad pa/ rtsa zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing khro bo'i zhal can/ bar pa gsum g.yas stag g.yon dom dbus gzig gi zhal can/ steng ma gsum ga khyung gi gdong can/g.yas kyi phyag dgu na 'khor lo/ ral gri /rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ mdung thung / dug mda'/ dbyug pa/ rgya gram/lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi phyag dgu na be con/ gtun shing / sprul zhags/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ sdigs mdzub/ spu gri/dgra sta/ g.yang gzhi/ snying phreng 'dzin (19ba)pa/ glang lpags la sogs pa'i dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ 'bus brgyad g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ shar sto'i zla gam la sa bdag pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag dmar po dbu dgu nag po bya rog gi gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo dang / g.yon rgyu zhags bsnams pa/lus thams cad mig gis khengs pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ thod rlon —94

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)gyi do shal can/ 'khas gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ lho nub kyi zla gam la klu gnyan pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du thugs kyi sprul ba 'chi bdag nag po chu srin gyi zhal la sprul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ g.yas gnam lcags kyi dgra sta dang g.yon sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi gos can/ sku smad sbrul gyi chun po 'khyil ba/ dug sprul gyi steng du bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol tu lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la srin po ya ma rā tsa g.yas ro dbyug dang g.yon 'khor lo bsnams pa/ yum thal mdog ma dang sbyor ba/ gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba ser nag g.yas be con dang g.yon 'khor lo bsnams pa/ yum gsod byed ma dang sbyor ba/ gshin rje a rla ma ru dmar po g.yas be con dang g.yon rtse gsum bsnams pa yum srog len ma dang sbyor ba/ gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag g.yas be con dang g.yon 'khor lo bsnams pa/ yum bdud mo ral gcig ma dang sbyor ba/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo can/ yum bla rkun ma dang sbyor ba/ lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo can/ yum g.yu ral ma dang sbyor ba/bse'i mon pa dred kyi mgo can/ mon mo khrag ral ma dang sbyor ba/ gser gyi mon pa (20na)grang gi mgo can/ mon mo snying 'byin ma dang sbyor ba/ bzhi ga'ang g.yas be con dang g.yon dgra bgegs kyi don snying bsnams pa/ he le khyab pa dkar po/ ma mo snying rkun ma dang sbyor ba/ nag po 'jum med ser po ma mo snying khrag bcud 'thung ma dang sbyor ba/ so 'dar 'khrigs pa dmar po/ nag mo sha la gzer 'debs ma dang sbyor ba/ ral pa spyi bcings ljang nag /nag po khrag ral ma dang sbyor ba/ bzhi ga'ang g.yas be con dang g.yon bdud zhags bsnams pa/ gru chad kyi lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la/ bha wa sa twa mthing nag /nor bu dge 'phel dang 'joms byed gnyis ser nag /ya ka glog 'phreng dmar nag /ya ka gsod byed nag po/ gtum po dud ka /gang ba kun 'joms dkar po/ kha 'bar ral gcig mthing nag /sprul mgo kun 'dzin dang / dad pa stobs ldan ser po/ he le khyab pa dang / gyad pa stobs chen nag po/ bcu gnyis po rnams kyang g.yas be con dang g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ phyi nang gsang ba'i gshed po bcu gnyis dang / las kya 'chi bdag bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang thod skam gyi dbu —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rgyan/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ phyi'i khyams su shar du bdud po khram thogs brgyad/ lhor gshin rje glang zhon brgyad be con dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub tu ma mo dril nag zhen pa brgyad nad rkyal dang thun zor bsnams pa/ byang du gnod sbyin bya nag zhon pa brgyad ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ shar sgor dkar po snying 'byin/ lho sgor mgon po (20bskog po nub sgor yab rje nag po/ byang skor sku mchog dmar po rnams rang 'dra'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i ber gsol zhing / g.yas khram shing dang g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ bde dpon chen po dgu/ gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga po rnams la yang rang 'dra'i 'khor 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang bdud po khram thogs/ nag po dar thogs/gsod byed mtshon thogs/ khyi nag /dom dred/ 'phar spyang mang po rgyug pa/ bya nag 'thib pa/ g.yag rog ngur ba/ rta nag 'tsher ba/ mon pa gar byed pa / lug pa rkan rdeb pa/ thun gyi ser ba 'bab pa mi lpags g.yab mo rdeb pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba/ zor gyi rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi bu yug 'tshi pa/ zor gyi sked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'gyug pa/ zor gyi rtsa bar ru dra pho mo khrag mtshor 'khyil ba/ zor thams cad kyang gnam lcags kyi thog me rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ de nas rol mo drag tu brdung zhing 'di skad do/ /'gyur med chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /rab 'byams mngon spyod phrin las bsgrub pa'i ched/ khro rgyal tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor che 'dir thogs med de tshur spyon/ /phye ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūṃ/ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūṃ dza: tiṣ+ṭha lhan/mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ 'jam (21na)dpal gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ /gus pas 'bul lo drag po'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /phye ka he dun ya ma rā dza a lha nas sha p+ta 'a bar dang / ma hā pañca — )()

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khana.a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā bha sla ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā mo sa kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na kha raṃ 'a hi/ ma hā bha su ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā ke dṛ te kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ de nas lha tshogs rnams bskul ba ni/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /phrin las yongs rdzogs 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /yab yum gsum gyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo slar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ khyod kyi phyogs bzhir dregs pa sras mchog dang / /rus sbal mi zan rngam pa sgrol yum dang / /bya khyung rgyal po'i thugs dam dus la bab/ /tshig rkang lnga po 'og ma kun la sbyor/ /mtshams bzhir lha dang srog bdag gnod sbyin klu'i/ /sdod pon seng stag dug sprul khyung mgo can/ /rgyan gyi lha brgyad thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo slar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /zla gam dmar po thod pa'i pho brang nas/ /mnan bshig bsad pa'i las kyi mtha' sdud pa'i/ /sprul pa rnam gsum thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo zlar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /rno ngar lcags 'khor bcu gnyis gdan steng nas/ /srid gsum tshe srog bla la (21ba〉dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /gshed chen bcu gnyis thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo zlar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /sdi/ chad lcags mkhar 'bar ba bcu gnyis nas/ /dus bzhi srid pa kun la khyab pa yi/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /—97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo slar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /g.yin yang las gshin zor gyi rna cha can/ /'char ga nag po srid gsum gtso mo mchog /dmag zor rgyal mo'i thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo slar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /snang srid sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs spyi dang / khyad par gza' bdud nag po rā hu la/ /rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzan bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchad 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bshegs gdug can 'di/ /lo zlar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /gzhan yang bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ khyad par zab mo gter gyi srung ma mchog /mthu chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam dus la bab/ /rno ngar drag po zor gyi las mdzod la/ /bstan pa spyi dang rigs 'dzin bdag cag gi /dgon gnas yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug can 'di/ /lo slar ma bzhag snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /mdor na snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra sems/ /da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /yar gyi pha rgyud mar gyi bu rgyud chod/ /sgo yi nor dang mchan gyi bu dang phrol/ /'chi ba'i dus thob gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ /lus dang srog phrol sa yi rten phur phyung / /rang bzhin las kyis shi la khungs ma 'byin/ /skad cig nyid la don snying de phyung zhig /'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro rgyal rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: phyogs skyong dregs pa ma he bsnol ba'i steng : e las phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog nag: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: rno ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams: sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po 'khor bcas (22na〉pa: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: byad dang rbod gtong —98—

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanam lus bzlog tu gsol: shar phyogs dri za pho mo bsnol steng du: dregs pa phyag na rdo rje ni ljang nag rdo rje snying phreng 'dzin: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: dri za'i byad dang khrod gtong bzlog tu gsol: lho phyogs gshin rje pho mo bsnol steng du: gsod byed ya ma ser nag ni:'khor lo tsit+ta phyag na bsnams: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: byad dang rbod gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol: nub phyogs klu dbang pho mo'i khri steng du: rus sbal rngam pa mi zan ni:sder mo gnam lcags spu gri 'dra: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: klu yi byad dang rbod gtong rims nad bzlog byang phyogs gnod sbyin pho mo'i khri steng du: sngags su e ka dzā ṭi ni:phyag na ral gri glog phreng bsnams: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: gnod sbyin byad dang rbod gtong bzlog tu gsol: yum mchog pe ta nag mo ni: tsit+ta ban+ta yab la stob: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs byad dang rbod gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol: shar lho me lha'i khri steng du: lha yi gshed po seng ge'i dbu spu gri mi snying phyag na bsnams: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus 'kha du bstabs: shar lho me lha'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: lho nub srin po pho mo'i khri steng du: srog bdag dmar po stag gi mgo spu gri tsit+ta'i phreng ba bsnams: srog bdag yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la: : dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: lho nub srin po pho (22bsgo'i gnod pa bzlog: nub byang rlung lha pho mo'i khri steng du: klu gshed nag po sprul gyi mgo: phyag na bse yi spu gri bsnams: yab yum 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la:dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs nub byang 'chi bdag klu yi gnod pa bzlog byang shar dbang ldan pho mo'i khri steng du: gnod sbyin gshed po khyung nag gnyis: zhal du gdug pa klu sbrul gsol yab yum khyung chen 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus('kha du bstabs: byang shar gnod sbyin pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog: zla gam thod mkhar gsum gyi dbus: dug gsum bsnol ba'i khri steng du: tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag gsum: sna tshogs mi sdug sems can dbu: mtshon la()(3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)cha mi sdug lag na thogs dug gsum sgrol byed 'khor bcas la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rusazhal du bstabs dug gsum 'dus pa'i byad dang rbod gtong bzlog: 'khor lo thod mkhar bcu gnyis nas: gsang ba'i gshed chen bzhi po ni srin po ya ma rā tsa ni: ma trang ro dbyug 'khor lo thogs: yum mchog thal mdog g.yon na 'khril: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba ni: ser nag be con 'khor lo 'dzin: g.yon du yum mchog gsod byed ma: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gshed po ar+ya ma ru ni: dmar po be con tsakra bsnams: g.yon du srog len nag po ni:khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gshed byed ral pa tshar dgu ni ljang nag be con tsakra bsnams:g.yon du bdud mo ral nag mo: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gsang ba'i gshed bzhi bcas pa (23na〉pa: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: gsang gshed sprul pa'i gdon dang gnod pa bzlog nang gi gshed chen bzhi po ni: dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo: yum ni mon mo bla rkun ma: lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo mon mo g.yu yi ral pa can: bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo: mon mo khrag gi ral pa can: gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo: mon mo snying 'dzin zor 'phen ma yab rnams be con tsit+ta bsnams: yum kun lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams: nang gi gshed bzhir bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: nang gshed mon pa'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: phyi yi gshed chen bzhi po ni: he le khyab pa shar gyi bdud: yum ni ro zan snying 'byin ma nag po 'dzum med lho yi bdud nag mo snying khrag rol 'thung ma: so 'dar 'khrigs pa nub kyi bdud: nag mo sha la gzer 'debs ma: ral pa spyi bcings byang gi bdud: ma mo nag mo khrag ral can: yab rnams khram shing zhags pa bsnams: yum kun spu gri mi snying bsnams: phyi yi gshed bzhir bcas pa la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: phyi yi gshed bzhi'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: gru chad lcags mkhar bcu gnyis ni ste wa sa twa nag po dang : nor bu dge 'phel ser po dang : nag po 'dzum med ser nag dang : bye ba dgu khri nag po dang : raka glog phreng dmar po dang : ya ka gsod byed —/00

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)nag po dang : gtum po dud ka ral pa gdong : gang ba kun 'joms dkar po dang : kha 'bar ral gcig mthing la sngo: sprul mgo kun 'dzin sngo la skya: dad pa stobs ldan kun nas (23ba)ser rgyad pa stobs ldan nag la 'jigs me con 'khor lo phyag na bsnams: zla gshed gshin rje'i bcu gnyis la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: zla gshed bcu gnyis gnod pa bzlog tu gsol:zhag gshed sum brgya drug cu ni: shar du khram thogs bdud po brgya chibs su rta nag rting dkar bcibs: lho yi gshin rje chu glang zhon: 'khor lo be con phyag na bsnams: nub na ma mo dred nag zhen: phyag na nad rkyal thun zor bsnams: byang du gnod sbyin bya nag zhen: phyag na ral gri zhags pa bsnams: theg gi gshed po 'khor bcas la:
