dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhaX du bstabs: 'ag gshed sum brgya'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: shar sgor dkar po shing 'dzin dang : lho sgor mgon po nag po dang : nub sgor bdud po yab rje dang : byang sgor gnod sbyin sku mchag dmar: 'khor lo thun khrag phyag na bsnams: sku la tse ber khra bo gsol: yum mchog mkha' 'gro ro langs kyang : mi lpags rlon pa'i na bza' gsol: phyag g.yas ma trang ro dbyug 'phyar: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu g.yon: sgo bzhi sgrol gying 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs:gshed bawo pho nya'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: phyi rol dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : za ma'i gshin rje bcu drug ni: pho gshed sum brgya drug cu dang : mo gshed sum brgya drug cu dang : gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu ni: phyag na 'khor lo thun khrag bsnams: chibs su mi dmar rta dmar bcibs: gshed chen bdun brgya nyi shu la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs las gshed rbod gtong gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: gshin (24na)rje phyogs skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs: sa chu me rlung sprin dang dur khrod bdag: mkha' la rgyu dang dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ma: zhing skyong ging dang laṅka bstan ma'i tshogs: 'jig rten kun tu khyab par rgyug byed pa: kyilas gshin rje pho nya 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs: pho nya gshin rje'i rbod gtong gnod pa bzlog: 'jam —101—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dpal tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs sa dbang po lnga dang sha khrag las: legs grub sman raka gis bran dmar chen gyi/ /gtor ma 'di 'bul brtse bas nyer bzhes la/ /rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag /ltos bcas kun la chags che nyam nga sogs/ 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /dgra bgegs steng du sgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye ka he dun ya ma rā dza'i mjug tu sman raka gtor gsum gyi sngags rnams btags te 'bul/ lha re la phrin las bcol ba'i tshigs bcad re dang gtor chung re sgrags nas 'bul/ de nas gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'brub khung gi nang du zan ling lus kyi skye mched rnams dod par byas te/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du bsham par bya'o/ /bsad pa'i skabs su shog ling sogs zur khyad mi 'dra ba cung zad dgos pa dag ni brgyud pa'i gdams ngag dang bal po'i shes rlom can rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pas/ brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung las myang bar bya'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i rdzas gsum gyis bzhin la thig le dang / drag po'i sems dang ldan pas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang (24ba)las/ rang gi thugs ka nas mthing nag cig chad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'brub khung nag po me rab tu 'bar ba phru gsum nang bang rim gsum dang ldan pa/ nang du 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil pa/ zhe sdang gi me rlung 'tshub pa/ gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ mtshon cha'i ser ba 'bab cing nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ than dang ltas ngan gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi gang ba/las kya gshin rje'i pho nya rnams na seng ge ltar rngam pa/ stag ltar 'phyo ba/ sbrul ltar 'khyug pa/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyug pa/ gsod gsod dang rgyob rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ de'i nang du phyin pa tsam gyis lha dang bral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ las ngan thams cad smin par byed pa'i btson khang drag po'i dbus su na las dmigs bya'i dam nyams dgra bo de dag mdog nag cing nyam chung ba/ bu ga dgu nas khrag dang rnag 'dzag pa/ yan lag thams cad lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa/mi mthun phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de nas sna tshogs pa'i rol mo dang / gro ga'i shu —/(/the

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)sgra dang bcas pas/ na mo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs/ khyad par 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra /bla ma'i sku dgra /dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra/ khyad par rigs sngags 'chang ba bdag dang / bltos (25na)bcas sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag la dar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bsam pa ngan pa yid la 'chang zhing / sbyor ba rtsub mor ston par byed pa rnams kyi bla srog tshe gsum dang bcas pa/ gling bzhi gling phran/ ri rab kyi khong gseng / nyi zla'i go bar/ chos bon bsrung ma rnams kyisaskyob pa'i 'khor lo sogs gang na gnas kyang dmigs rten gyi nya bo 'di nyid la khug cig /phye ring gi mthar/ badz+ra e gu sha ya dza: badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi tho badz+ra pra bai sha ya phaṭa/ a bai sha ya āḥ de nas dbang gzugs ni/ dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon dang / /rab stims mthu stobs ldan pa'i zhi khro'i lha/ /ye shes spyan ldan dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /ma nyes dpang mdzod bden rdzun gshags phye zhig /thub bstan gangs kyi ri la gnas bcas shing / /sdom gsum nga lus kya rtsal kha yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin gdong lnga'i dbang po bdag cag la/ /log 'dren shwa na'i bu yi gnod pa byung / /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtshos gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs la gzu dpang mdzod: dus las g.yel lam sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs/ /bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i 'dab gshog rab rgyas shing / /las sbyor drag po'i rno ngar mchu sder can/ /rigs 'dzin mkha' lding dbang po bdag cag la/ /dgra ba be gsang po'i bya yi gnod pa byung / /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /(25ba)bstan srung rgya mtshos gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs la gzu dpang mdzod: dus las g.yel lam sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs/ /sku gsum sa bon dbang bzhi'i 'chi med chab/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gangs ri las 'bebs —103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin skal ldan shing rta bdag cag la/ /dgra bgegs drang srong dzaḥ'i gnod pa byung /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtshos gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs la gzu dpang mdzod dus las g.yel lam sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs/ /smin byed gzhung gi lha lam la brten nas/ /sku gsum lam 'khyer zab mo pad+ma'i tshal/ /rgyas byed rigs 'dzin rta ljang bdag cag la/ /dgra bgegs chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i gnod pa byung / /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtshos gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs la gzu dpang mdzod: dus las g.yel lam sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs/ /grol byed rgyud sde'i nor 'dzin la brten nas/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum nye lam lhun po'i rtser/ /gnas bcas rigs 'dzin lha dbang bdag cag la/ /dgra bgegs sngon gyi lha yi gnod pa byung/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtshos gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs la gzu dpang mdzod: dus las g.yel lam sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan sa mos tshal/ /nyams byed dgra bgegs glang po'i mgo bo 'di/ /bstan srung dam can ri dwags dbang po yis/ /'gems par mi byed mthu dang rtsal gyis ci/ /'dus sde yongs 'du rdor 'dzin lo 'bras kun/ /'joms byed dgra bgegs grang reg nyer 'tshe'i stobs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho bde byed kyis/ /'joms par mi byed tsha gdung can 'dis ci/ /'gro drug sems can dge bcu'i bdog pa kun/ /'phrog byed dgra bgegs lha min stobs ldan 'di/ /bstan srung dam can 'jug pa bcu pa yis/ /nor 'dzin 'og tu mi 'ching thabs kyis ci/ /mdor na log 'dren 'di yi mtshang rnams kun/ /bdag yid dang ba'i sems kyi rab bsgrags na/ /mthu ldan dam can rgya mtshos dgra bgegs 'di/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces dam brdar/ de nas dar nag gi g.yab mo dang bcas (26na)te/ /bh+yo/ bla 'gugs sprul pa gnod sbyin gser gyi stag /lcags kyi dom spyang byu ru'i khyi mo dang / khyung chen gser gyi 'phar ba zangs kyi dred/ /gang 'tsham gzugs su sprul la khyod rnams —/(/4

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)kyis/ /bla tshe 'khyams po 'phyo pa'i dus drug la/ /bla rtags mi dang sha ba dgo ba lug /ra khyi bya dang gla ba bong bu sogs/ /gang du brdzus kyang da lta nyid du khug /phye myags kyi mjug tu/ dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim/ sha ma ru ti thul thul/ phyogs phyogs/ /yed yed/ sha ma ru ti khug khug /ling myogs ling shag /ling thums/ tsa mun tri dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ de nas lha dang dbye ba ni/ las kyi gshin rje gshed po thams cad dang / kha kha mu kha mthing nag bya rog gdong / /hu lu mu kha ser nag lug pa'i gdong / /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs mi nor 'khor bcas 'di/ /dgra dang dgra lha lus dang srung ma phrol/ khyod dang chung ma pha dang bu gnyis phrol/ /gnyen dang nye du pho bo nu bo phrol/ /dgra lha spya gtsug pho lha phrag pa g.yas/ /yul lha phrag g.yon srog lha snying gi dkyil/ /zhang lha lte khung ma lha gsang ba'i gnas/ /'go ba'i ban bon lha srung tshogs rnams kun/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang rdzas kyi 'byul 'khor mthus/ /skyob pa'i lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod/ /rang gshed rang la dbab sogs drag po'i las/ /thogs pa med par myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /phye myags kyi mthar/ /ma ma trag mā ra ya phye phye/ trag raka ru dra mā ra ya/ dgra bo lha srung dang bcas pa phye phye/dkrugs dkrugs/ gtor gtor/ med yed/ (26ba)bya rog dang lug pa'i dang sgros nya bo la byab cing / mthar gu gul gyi dud pas kyang bdug go /bsad pa'i skabs su sna tshogs pa'i rdzas ngan dang /de dag gi bsreg tshul sogs kyang zhal las shes dgos so/ /de nas thun brdeg pa ni/ mtshe yung rdo lcags la sogs drag po'i rdzas/ /dug dang khrag tu sbol te ngar btags pa'i/ /rdo rje'i thog dang mtshungs pa'i thun rdzas 'di/ /btab pas tshe srog bkrag mdangs nyams par gyur/ /zhes 'og gi phur pa gdab pa'i sngags kyi mjug tu 'di btags te brdeg par bya'o/ /mye dgra bo'i srog la thum ril rbad bh+yo: dun khre shig tsit+ta la myogs rbad bh+yo: a mu ka rtsa la dun rmugs rbad bh+yo: a mu ka yaṃ khrag la mugs ti thun bod bh+yo: sngags pa snying du sod/ tsit+ta gtubs rbad long srog tsit+ta long / myags myags mā ra ya tsit+ta la thun bh+yo: de nas phur pa btab pa ni/ rang nyid zil gnon gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /—105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ya ma rā dza sku stod khro bo'i gzugs/ /g.yas pa 'khor lo g.yon pa tsit+ta 'dzin/ /sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs lus la btab pa yis/ /snying gi dkyil du mar me lta bu'i srog /gsal mtshor dngas pa bsad cing :'i rnam pa'i/ /rnam shes phur rtser blangs te thugs mar bsdu/ /phye ring gi mthar/ a mu ka myags ṭaṃ ril rbad/ trig nan sbur ya nan/ e hur thums dza: snya shag ro myags mugs ti rbad yā/ phye myags kyi mthar/ na tri srog la hur thums dza: rtsa khrag snying ṭaṃ ri la raṃ shag thad/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shag dza: srog la hur thums rbad/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ (27na8gra bo a mu ka srog la ṭaṃ rmugs bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo'i srog la sto bha ya nan/ zhes phur pa btab/ de nas ling ro bsgral ba ni/ sras mchog thugs nas dregs pa'i bdag po ni/ /ngo bo gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /rnam pa gnam lcags ral gribs sha khrag kun/ /dum bur gtubs nas(gtso 'khor zhal du 'debs/ /gong gi sngags rnams brjod la ral gris gtub cing ling ro rnams ban dhar blug la/ de nas/ stong gsum khengs pa'i skur bzhengs nyi zla'i spyan/ /gzigs la gnam sa'i zhal gdongs glog dmar ljags/ khyod zhig gangs ri lta bu'i mche gtsigs nas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs bzhes shig /ces brjod la ling ro rnams gtor mar 'bul/ phye ka he dun gyi mthar/ ma hā mo sa sogs brjod/ de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ gtor ma'i khar rak+ta sbreng zhing 'di skad do/ /bh+yo/ da ni bzlog pa'i du la bab da ni bsgyur ba'i dus la bab: 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod nas klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong : ma he phyogs skyong dregs pa'i steng : gshin rje'i rgyal po tshe bdag ni: g.yas dkar lha yi chad pa bzlog: g.yon dmar ma mo'i chad pa bzlog: dbus mthing bdud kyi cho 'phrul bzlog: phyag drug rgyud drug rbod gtong bzlog: dbu la khyung chen 'bar ba yis: sa bdag klu gnyan rbod gtong bzlog: yum mchog za byed pe ta li: sbyor yum dbyings yum 'khor bcas (27ba)kyis:srid pa ma mo'i cho 'phrul bzlog: gyad gnon sprul pa'i lha brgyad kyis: lha srin sdo brgyad cho 'phrul bzlog:—/06

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanabadud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul: srid pa pho rgyud cho 'phrul bzlog: rak+ta khrag gi mchod pa 'bul:srid pa mo rgyud cho 'phrul bzlog: dmar gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: byad dang nod gtong cho 'phrul bzlog: dbu la nor bu 'bar bas brgyan: rnal 'byor tshe ring dpal yang bskyed: bh+yo/ tshangs pa brgya byin lha yi gdon: 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: dga' bo 'jog po klu yi gdon:brjid pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin gdon: 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: za byed rngam pa srin po'i gdon: drag po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: gtso mo kha 'bar yi dwags gdon: bzhed pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: phag gdong 'jigs pa sha za'i gdon: gtum po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: bi na ya ka bgegs kyi gdon: 'gying ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: khyab 'jug byi nu gza' yi gdon: drag po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol:khram thogs gri thogs ging gi gdon: sprul pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: kha bzhir 'gyogs pa btsan gyi gdon: 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: til pa cha sangs gshin rje'i gdon:sprul pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: ral pa gsig pa ma mo'i gdon: gsung gi stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: rol ba skya bdun dmu yi gdon: mgo brnyan brjid pas bzlog tu gsol: ma hā de wa mu stegs gdon: bden pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo/ 'ja' 'khyil lha yi ltas ngan yin: lha yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: seng ge gshin rje'i ltasang na yin: gshin rje'i (28na tshe snasangan bzlog tu gsol: dom gzig ma mo'i ltas ngan yin: ma mo'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: lug pa dmu yi ltas ngan yin: dmu yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: pha rog mgon po'i ltas ngan yin: mgon po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sha ba btsan gyi ltas ngan yin: btsan gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol:sbrul nag klu yi ltas ngan yin: klu yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: bya nag bdud kyi ltas ngan yin:bdud kyi ltas bzlog tu gsol: zhe tso klu srin ltas ngan yin: klu srin ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: gla ba sman gyi ltas ngan yin: sman gyi ltas bzlog tu gsol: bya rgod rgyal po'i ltas ngan yin: rgyal po'i —1()7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ltas bzlog tu gsol: srin bya the'u rang ltas ngan yin: the'u rang ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol pu shud 'gong pa'i ltas ngan yin: 'gong po'i ltas bzlog tu gsol: khyung khrung dri ma'i ltas ngan yin: dri ma'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: srod la bya pho 'tsher ba gnas the'i ltas ngan yin: gnam the'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba bar the'i ltas ngan yin: bar the'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol:dur khrod wa mo brgyal ba sa the'i ltas ga yin: sa the'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: spyang sngon rgyug pa pho rgyud ltas ngan yin: pho rgyud ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: gla ba grong rgyug mo rgyud ltas ngan yin: mo rgyud ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: lha khang 'od rnams rgyal po'i ltas ngan yin: rgyal po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sdig sbrul klu yi ltas ngan yin: klu yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sbal srin sa bdag ltas ngan yin: sa bdag ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sre cho byi 'khyer gnod sbyin ltas ngan yin: gnod sbyin ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: ri bya khyim zhugs gnyan gyi than: gnyan gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol:khyim du ro than 'gong pa'i than: 'gong pa'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sha pho ru 'dzings rje dpon than:rje dpon ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: nya mo rnga 'dzings bran gyi than: bran gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol:bya nag ster 'dzings chung ma'i than bye bral ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: 'dre bya sreg pa chung sri'i than:chung sri'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: ban : ho ma par bu'i than: ban dhe'i phung zor bzlog tu gsol:bon po'i (28ba)gtso zor zhab zhung than: bon po'i gtso zor bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs glang zor mi kha'i than: mi kha'i rgya than bzlog tu gsol: sha mo khyim gang mi yi than: khyim gang mi yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol ra gang nor la spu than byung : god 'dre god kha'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: bang gang sris la byi than byung : 'gong po'i sris than bzlog tu gsol: yun than srid pa'i rtsa than byung :rtsa than ser gsum bzlog tu gsol: dgra gshed dur lan rtsa than byung : glo 'gong rtsa than bzlog tu gsol: lha srin 'khrug pa'i gtad sel byung : byad ma 'bum gyi ltasang na bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i dge gsal bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad rkyen la bh+yo: yas bdud du g.yos —/(18—

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khanapa bh+yo: mas kyi sri ru langs pa bh+yo: phud bdud mkha' la 'jab pa bh+yo: mi bdud gshed du khol ba bh+yo:ltag par gshed drel byed pa bh+yo: mdun nas rtsang bzhin 'dzugs pa bh+yo: rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'brang ba bh+yo: ngos la sprel ltar 'dzeg pa bh+yo: yul mi'i dgra dar byed pa bh+yo: thams cad ma lus gcig tu dril:phung po khams dang skye mched rnams: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gsags su dril: nya bo 'di la bkug byas nas: phur 'dabs thun dang mtshon chas bsad: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur las la sbyar: dpal chen tshe bdag zhal du bstabs: 'khor dang gshin rje 'bum phrag gis: dgyes par rol cig kha raṃ 'a hi: lhag ma med par zhal du bstabs: gzugs phung sha khrag mchod par bzhes: dam tshig nyams chags so sor bshags: thugs dam skongs la dngos grub stsol: bar chad rkyen ngan (29na)gdug rtsub bzlog: bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: rab 'jigs gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i nus mthu ma lus kun/ /gcig bsdus tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog bsgyur dus la bab/ /mi sdug zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzha pa/ /sna tshogs mtshon 'dzin gar dgu'i nyams can gyis/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / /pha rol mi mthun ban bon rig sngags kyi/ /zor kha phur kha gtad kha khram kha dang / /nye 'byed 'gong chog bskrad 'khor dmar nag than/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen mi mthun nyer 'tshe kun/ /dgra bgegs steng du bzlog bsgyur 'phrin las mdzod/ /gcan gzan ri dwags 'dab chags la sogs pa/ /grangs med lus ngag yid kyi rnam 'gyur tshogs/ /dngos sam rmi lam nyams su gang shar ba/ /lha srid sdebargyad de dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /ma rungs ltas ngan cho 'phrul tshogs rnams kun/ /thams cad snang ba'i dgra yi steng du bh+yo: /ma lus gnod pa'i 'gegs kyi steng du bh+yo: /dam can mthu dang rtsal gyi dus la phab/ /de nas gtor zor rnams phyir spags te gral du bkod/ rol mo drag tu brdung zhing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan/ /gtor ma'i lam bstan shar du bstan/ /shar du rgyal po yul 'khor srung / /dri za pho mo'i —///9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'khar gyis bskor/ /sku zur de ni spyan byol zhig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ /(29ba khrig zor dmar po 'khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zor skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ /hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan lho ru bstan/ /lho na rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /gshin rje mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku zur de ni spyan byol zhig /gtang zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po 'khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zor skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ /hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan nub tu bstan/ /nub na rgyal po spyan mi bzang / /klu dbang mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku zur de ni spyan byol zhig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po 'khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zor skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ /hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan byang du bstan/ /byang du rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin mang po'i 'bar gyis bskor/ /sku zur de ni spyan byol zhig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po 'khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zor skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thems se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ /steng gi lha la zor mi 'phen/ /lha chen brgyad po zhabs sdus shig /'og gi klu la zor mi 'phen/ /klu chen brgyad po dbu 'phangs smod/ /bar gyi btsan la zor mi 'phen/ /gnyan chen sde bzhi sku zur cig /drag po gshin rje'i gtor zor 'di/ /snang ba'i dgra la gtor zor yā/ /dgra bo bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod/ /gnod pa'i dgra la khrag zor yā/ /mo rgyud khrag gi mngal nas skems/ /thun zor bu rgyud tsha la yu/ /bu tsha gdung brgyud rtsad nas chod/ /mda' zor sgo yi nor la rgyob/ /sgo nor gong 'dre phyags mas thob/ /thod zor nang gang (30na)sris la yā/ /phyags mas thob la rlung la bskur/ /thur zor dgra yi snying la yā/ /drag po'i gri 'thab nad kyis gsod/ /rdo zor dgra bo'i mkha' la yu/ /skye bo —//()

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(khana'akhor gyi rgyun lam chod/ /byad kha bzlog la phur kha sgyur/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas phyi rol tu sgra gcan gyi thebs brtsi ba sogs srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sbyor ba dang bcas te/sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu zor rnams sngar bzhin go rim ma log par bzhag /rdo rje slob dpon gyis gser skyems sbreng zhing / sngar gyi dbang gzugs rnams kyang rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas brjod par bya'o/ /de nas zor bskul ba ni/ dug chen shing la 'ug pa'i sgro yis bsgron/ /sngags 'phreng dug khrag gis bris mde'u sbyar/ /rab brjid gzhur bkang thog mdar byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad ṭaṃ ri li li bh+yo zor sngags 'di lhag ma kun la 'dogs so/ /phung shul dur khrod grog mkhar la sogs pa'i/ /sa las rab grub dug khrag thun gyis bkang / /'jigs rung sprin gyi zegs mar byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs sbyo srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad / ri li li bh+yo: dmar nag grog ma 'thab pa'i sar grub cing / /thun sogs drag po'i rdzas kyis rab bkang ste/ /rtsangs dmar khar bsgron thog tu byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs (30ba〉la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /a+yo myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ mye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad ṭaṃ ri li li bh+yo: dur khrod nag po'i rdo bar gdug pa'i sngags/ /rak+ta ha la sbyar bas legs bris te/ /sprin gyi 'od 'byung dag tu byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /mye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo:—11/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad ṭaṃ ri li li bh+yo: dme yug bud med la sogs dug can gyis/ /reg bral ma nyams yungs gar gang bzang dag /dur sa la gzugs thog tu byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad ṭaṃ ri li li bh+yo: 'bras can g.yag rgod g.yas pa'i rwa nang du/ /drag po'i rdzas ldan gdug pa'i sngags dang bcas/ /stong gsum kun las rgyal bar byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad ṭaṃ ri li li bh+yo: thor gzhan rnams phyogs bzhir 'phang zhing / rwa zor phyogs bzhir gdeng ba tsam byas nas gtor ma dang lhan du grub khang gi phyi rol gom pa zhe dgu'i sar 'khyer te/ long yod na gser skyems bya zhing / med tshe sngar gyi rwa zor 'phang zhing brtag pa bya/ de nas bskul 'di ltar bya'o/ /hūṃ/ rab yangs lcags snod nang du ri rab steng / /yongs rdzogs dmar chen drag po'i gtor ma'i tshogs/ /'jigs bral gnam lcags rdo rjer byin brlabs nas/ /dgra bgegs la 'phangs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /mye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ phye ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo: srog la kho shag bh+yo: srog la breng shag bh+yo: srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo: srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad ṭaṃ ri li li bh+yo: zhesagator ma gnam lcags kyi thog tu bskyed pa de nyid dgra bo yul mkhar dang bcas pa'i steng du 'phangs pas/ thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam mo/ /de rjes bdag nyid khro rgyal nas bzung ste/ /srung 'khor gyi bar rnams brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis mjug bsdus la phyi mig mi blta bar srung 'khor gyi rgyas btab bo/ /de nas nang du log ste/ lugs gcig la sgo drung du me chus rgyas —1/2

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)'debs shing / phye ring gi mthar bsrung sngags gdags par bya'o/ /(31na)de nas sgrub pa po rnams rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor gzhong ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri rnams chud par bsams la 'di skad do/ /stong gsum 'jig rten yangs pa'i gzhal yas su/ /bcud kun 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rang nyid la/ /bro brdung bdud sde'i tshogs rnams thar med gnas/ /de phyir glu dang bro 'di rgyun mi chad/ /phyogs bzhir phrin las rnam bzhi'i bro brdungs pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub par shog /mye a kro te ka ya man+ta ka /kā la rū pa hrī:nyi wi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ pu spyi ku ru ye swāhā/ pā she ku ru ye swāhā/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ de nas chad mtho bsgrag cing bstan ma bskyang ba ni/ gtor ma nam mkhar bteg ste/ hūṃ/ bskal pa brgyad khri 'das pa'i sngon rol du/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /spros bral bde chen kun tu bzang po yis/ /bya rtsol bral ba'i yid chos bstan pa'i tshe/ /rigs lnga bde chen mkha' dbyings 'khor gyi tshogs/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ khyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du gtor ma long /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du phrin las sgrubs/ /de rjes 'gro ba'i don la dgongs pa'i tshe/ /slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ /'jam dpal bye ba 'bum sde dpe la bkod/ /ma gshin yongs kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /bka' srung gshin rje drug gis srog snying phul/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi (31ba)gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du ma chad dam/ /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du ma chad dam/ /de rjes slob dpor shan+ta nga gar+bha dang / /mu stegs bzlog pa'i stobs can sngags bzlog brtsod/ /snying gzer nag po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /sdig pa snying 'dzangs mu stegs bstan pa bcad/ /dregs pa bco brgyad rang srog phul ba'i tshe/ /dregs pa ma lus 'dus nas srog snying phul/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len —113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin stong bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma 'ad dam/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du phrin las sgrubs/ /de rjes slob dpon bha su dha ra yis/ /bka' yi mchod rten stobs chen bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /las kyi gshin rje'i srog snying zhal kyang bstan/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du phrin las sgrubs/ /de rjes sangs rgyas ye shes rin chen gyis/ /mye ring rnam gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /mchod rten lus la bkod nas bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /ma gshin zhal bstan dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /bka' nyan sde brgyad dam la thogs pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ khyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ khyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du phrin las sgrubs/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ /dkyil 'khor mchod rten lus dkyil gtor ma bshams/ /bka' bzhin phog pa'i srung ma dam can rnams/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas kyang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /yon bdag bar chad (32na)bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du gtor ma long /ji/ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /sngon tshe slob dpon spyan sngar rnal 'byor gyi/ /las rnams bsgrub par dam bcas bstan ma'i tshigs/ /'dod yod lnga ldan gtor ma 'di long la/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gtang rag mchod pa ni/ khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /ma hā bha ling bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /rak+ta la sogs phyi nang —1/4

'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo/ nang ma(kha)gsang ba yi/ /mchod pa 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rtsa ba'i lha dang rgyan gyi lha brgyad rnams/ /phyag rgya zil gnon thugs ka' hūṃ la thim/ /'khor rnams rang rang gnas gshegs gtso bo ni/ /gnyis med spros bral chos dbyings ngang du bzhugs/ /smon lam ni/bsnyen sgrub las gsum yongs 'du sa brtol la/ /bskyed rim lo 'dab 'bras bu rab rgyas shing / /grol byed lam gyi gang bu g.yur za ba'i/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis dga' ston rgyas par shog zhas pa brjod pa ni/ 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas bla ma yi dam lha/ /dpag dka' rab 'byams las bsgrub dam can tshogs/ /pho nya las gshin la sogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /bkra shis dga' ston dpal la rol gyur cig /de ltar zla gsang sdig rgyud rgya mtsho che/ /bdag yid khyab 'jug 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar las/ /'ongs pa'i bdag mdun las byang bdud rtsi'i bdud/ /rigs 'dzin dga' ston dpal la rol gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud 'grel man ngag dang / khyad par chos rje sgrol ma pa/(32ba)se ston gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i las byang zur 'debs/ lcags sdig las byang chen mo gsum la gzhi byas/ /spyang mo drug la sogs pa'i man ngag zab mo 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ gzhan ma bdag mdun tshang ma khrigs chags su bsdebs shing / /bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngags rnams legs sbyar gyi skad dang mi mthun pa 'dug kyang / sgron gsal las/ ko ṭa k+ṣa la sogs pa'i sgra/ /'jig rten bstan bcos la med cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bder gyur pa/ /de ni ji bzhin min par grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang sor bzhag cing / gzhan ma'i tshig sbyor la la gter gzhung dngos dang / brgyud ldan rigs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi gsung rnams byin rlabs kyi mthu dpung che bas rang sor bzhag /'ga' zhig 'khyer bde ba'i slad du tshig phreng gsar du bsgrigs pa'i las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di yang / dbang 'gro mgon chos dbang gi gdung las/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la zhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa skyon blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon snyem pa'i sde'am ming gzhan/ shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang —1/du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)blo bzang rgya mtsho tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ myos ldan gyi lo/ dag byed zla ba'i phyogs gnyis pa'i drang srong lha min bla ma nam gru'i dga' ma dang rtse ba'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sarba maṅga lo// //tshe bdag rnon po nad gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs so/ /na mo mañji lho dzi shi ba kro tā ya/ lnga ldan zur phud 'chang ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag gar/ /rab bsgyur 'khor med drin can yongs 'dzin tshogs/ /snying gi ze'u 'brur spyon la bdag byin rlobs/ /gtsug lag dpal dges gshed skor rgyud sde'i don/ /legs bkral bka' babs pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /bal po'i rgyal por gtad de gnubs chen gyis/ /spungs pa ri bo'i ngos su rgyas btab pa/ /dum pa rgya yis spyan drangs zab mo'i gter/ /gnubs chung phyag mtshan las kyi ral gri che/ /deng dus rje btsun rat+na rjes 'brang gis/ /rang skyob gzhan gsod go mtshon gces pa'i nor/ /de phyir smin byed rnon po nang gcod kyi/ /dbang chog lag mthil rdzas bzhin gsal nus pa/ /pad gnubs brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes mi nyams slad/ /yi ger 'bri na gter srung gnang ba stsol/ /de la 'dir gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag me'i spu gri'i dbang gi rim pa pad+mas ming btags rje btsun dbu ru smyon pa la yi dam gyi lhas dngos su gnang ba'i dbang mchod rten gyi dkyil (2na skokhor la brten pa'i dbang rgyas pa yod pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha shin tu kha gsal bar snang la/gter ston rgya zhad khrom gyi zhal gdams chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs kyi bar du snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa'i rnon po nang gcod sde pa snang rtse nas kyis mdzad pa der snying po nang bas gsung ba ming yang ma dgongs 'dug pas don la re sa med pas nang cha phyir bstan no/ /kyi dbang 'di la rje btsun rat+na'i zhabs kyi reg zig nyung ngu zhig ma gtogs —//6

tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'akor/ nang ma(khanayig cha khungs btsun pa gzhan mi snang bas bstan pa'i rgyun la phan phyir go bde bar bkod pa la/gnas khang byi dor byas slob dpon gyi g.yas su stegs kyi khar rten khebs sogs bkod pas mdzes pa byas par 'bru sna dar btags man ngag las byung ba'i rdzas rnams 'tshogs par byas pa khrag chang gis sprus pa'i gtor ma gtso 'khor lnga pa bra gzugs/ khram ris/ 'khor lo/ ong skyu/ me ri/ sha snang rtse nas kyis thog mde'u'i gzugs kyi dkar rgyan sha khrag gis brgyan pa gsung ba gsar rnying kun la ma grags pa'i khyad chos shig yin pa 'dra/ khrag gis brgyan par so so'i lha rten tsaka li gtor gdugs sogs zhib cha mtha' dag mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar mngon par 'du byas pa ma zhi'i steng du bkod/ (2bsgo thar chu gnyis sngon snang rtse nas kyis phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor gsum zhes sman raka gtor gsum nang mchod kyi gral nas btone 'dug pa khrag gi a sogs la 'byul bar snang yang phyi mchod la phyi mchod kyi phyi mchod/ phyi mchod kyi nang mchod/ phyi mchod kyi gsang mchod /de bzhin du nang gsang gnyis la yang mu gsum du dbyer yod pa nang gses kyi rnam gzhag yin pa ma dgongs pa'i shes bya mtha' bkag pa 'di 'dra rnying ma byings dang ma mthun kyang nyid kyi gter gsar na yod shas che/ dbang gtor gyi smad sha khrag gi rgya mtshor bskyed gsung ba de ga 'bul ba'i thugs rtse gtad bzhin du gtor ma zur pa bzos par dgos pa lhag po med cing gnyer tshang gi bu lon la gnod pa bog go /du 'gro ba'i phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ sman raka /gter srung dang gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma/ las bum rdzas ldan kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ yungs thun/ gu gul/ rol mo/ tsho gos chas sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad 'tshogs par bya/ las byang gzhung bsrang reg zig na bdag mdun gnyis so sor bsgom par gsung ba mi rung ba ma yin kyang gzhung gyer thengs gcig pu de spus me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bdag mdun gyi lta zhal sprod du bsgom pa las pa bde zhing srung bzlog gi skabs kyang 'di na mdzad/ ba sbas lha gnyis kyi mngon rtogs kyi mthar rbad ya bzlog ya zhes pa'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor bar gyur zhes pa'i bar btang rjes las bum gyi nang du pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi gdan la ya mthing nag las skyes pa'i las kyi gshin rje dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ral pa kham nag zur gsum gyen du 'phyo ba spyan gsum dmar zhing 'khrug pa/smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom rnams me ltar 'bar ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur hūṃ gi sgra sgrog —117—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2na wa wa pa/ sbom thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing mi sdug pa/ rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing / sku stod la (3na)mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang sku smad stag gi sham thabs grol ba/ /g.yas be con rdeg pa'i tshul dang g.yon thugs mar sdigs mdzub dgra bgegs kyi don snying 'drad pa'i tshul gyis zhags pa 'dzin pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bskal pa dus mtha'i me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar dang / de nas slar yang yab yum thugs ga'i hūṃ bh+yo las/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste bsgrubs na lang tsho dang mnyam/ zhes dag pa dran pa'i bar gyi rjes su lha rnams kyi thugs skar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ mthing nag gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam rjes su/ khams gsum ma lus gzhal yas chen por lta shes sogs gdengs gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rtsa ba'i bsnyen sngags rnams 'grub tshad bzla/ las bum la dmigs te/ ā+oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ji ltar rigs pa dang / ji srid dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams bsrung zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog dor/ gter srung mchod/ tshogs mchod dbul/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas bdag nyid kyis dbang blang / slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung / gral la 'khod/ dkar gtor dang dmar gtor bshams nas bgegs sgrod dang bsrung 'khor dkyus bzhin gtong / maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ spyi dang bye brag gi chos bshad/ khyad par yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa'i phyir sngon byung rdzogs ldan gyi bskal par lha'i srid pa ka ru zhes (3ba)pa sngags kyi lam du zhugs pa lta spyod log ste lho phyogs rim pa mdun gyi 'og lcags mkhar gling dgu'i bdag po 'chi bdag nag po ma rungs par skyes shing 'gro ba rnams 'phung bar byed pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bskul te 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur bzhengs nas btul zhing dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'bangs dang bran du bkol cing bstan pa'i srung mar bskos/ de nas lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas gtum drag gi tshal zhes bya ba phyi dur khrod kyi —//di

tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'akor/ nang ma(khanagazhal yas khang nang rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa 'og min gyi gnas su 'jam dpal kun tu bzang pos gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa man ngag gi rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud/ 'phros pa'i rgyud/ spyi rgyud dang / sgos rgyud la sogs pa rgya cher bka' stsal pa rdo rje rnon po dang / lag na rdo rje sogs kyis bsdus te be+e ḍūr+sha'i glegs bam du byas nas skyon gyi yul du dpal rang byung gi mchod rten chen por rgyas btab pa slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams dam la btags te mchod rten nas byung ba phyon gsang yig tu bris te slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas gsang mtshan rdo rje gzhen nu rtsal zhes par gtad/ lugs gcig la 'og min nas lha'i bu tshangs pa/ nyi ma/ bde ba mchog ldan rnams las rim par brgyud de mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer gyis sibla la'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la bka' babs kyi tshul du gtad/ de nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng / slob dpon shan+ti gar+bha/ ye shes snying po/kha gar+bha/ gtsug (4na〉pag dpal dge /dha na dha la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ bha su dha ra sogs slob dpon 'di dag la gshin rje'i rgyud man ngag gi bka' babs tshul ni go rim mi mthun pa sna tshogs yod pa mtha' gcig par nges bzung du gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub mi nus shing slob dpon so sos rgyud man ngag la brten nas kha thun/ tshe bdag /khro 'dus/ 'joms byed/ khro chu sogs sgrub thabs kyi rim pa mtha' klas pa mdzad cing bye brag gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi skor 'di 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nas rim pa bzhin 'phung byed shi snyi gar+bha/ des slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po'am gsang mtshan rdo rje myu gu gter la gtad pa bka' ma dang zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rgyud rtsa ba chen po ni tshangs pa klu gnad kyi bse'i ka ba nas slob dpon dz+nyā na gar+bhas gter nas bton te si nu nags tshal du slob dpon a kā sha gar+bha la gtad/ des khrag 'thung nag po la gtad de bka' gter zung du 'jug pa slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge la babs/ slob dpon 'dis rgyud man ngag rnams kyi nang nas phyung ba shin tu zab pa skor gsum mchan bzhi gnad gsum du grags par yang bzlog me'i spu grir —/19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)btags nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal la gnang / des bal bo'i slob dpon bha su dha ra zhes gsang mtshan rdo rje thog 'bebs rtsal du grags pa la gtad/ de'i drung du drag sngags kyi bdag po gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis lan bdun byon pa'i phyi ma'i tshe bka' rgyas btab ste gnang ba chu dar sngon po la dngul gyi yi ger bris te shel gyi par bur stsal pa mchong sgrom smug por bcug nas phung po ri bo che dang lho (4ba)brag mkho mthing lha khang gnyis su gter du sbas/ phung po ri bo che nas gnubs chen gyi skye ba sprul pa'i gter ston rgya zhad khrom gyis spyan drangs nas lha rje gnubs chung rgya dang gnubs chung gi bar du bla ma gnyis tsam zhig snang sog gong gsum gyi brgyud yig tu 'dug pa snang rtse nas kyis 'di skor 'bri gung du gsan pas de'i brgyud par ni yong don mi 'dug kho rang rnams kyi rmi lam du byung ba ni min la che/ lar zag zog gi rigs 'di la rgyas bsdus ma mdzad na rdzun grog po phu rdugs da rdol gnyen gda'o/ /pa gsang mtshan rdo rje gter ba 'ad rtsal la gnang /gnubs chung pas lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas spyan drangs pa'i gter kha gsar rnying zhus dag pher ba byung / rje btsun mi las mngon spyod kyi grags pa thon pa'ang gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag 'di nyid yin par grags shing mtshur ston rin cen rdo rjes spong zhon ston la mthu byas pa'i tshe/ de'i bzlog pa'i rim gro pa rol po mes ston gyis byas par brten mthu log ste cho 'phrul chen po byung ba na mtshur ston gyis kha rag lha mo dbang phyug rdo rje'i drung du rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas rol po mes ston las bzlog pa mkhas pa gtsang gi rgyal khams na med/ nged kyi bzlog pa yang zhun gyi rigs dang khyod rang la phyag cha ur mo 'dug pa rnams kyi mi 'ong bas gtsang rong du lha rje gnubs chung par zhus shig pa'i lung bstan pa ltar snam bu tshos ma bdun khyer nas zhus par gdams pa ma chad pa zhig gnang bas rang yul du log ste bsgrubs kyang cho 'phrul cher song / slar khu lung du byon nas rta pho ngang zhur zhig dang gser srang du ma phul te zhus pas gdams pa chad lhag med pa'i dbu dbyung dang bcas rdzogs par gnang (ldan)bas thugs tshim nas sras 'jam dpal lo bco brgyad pa dang mtshur ston dbang de lo bco lnga 'gro ba gnyis dang lhan du srung bzlog bsad mnan gyi sngags rgyun btsugs pas tshur —/2()

tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'akor/ nang ma(kha)bzlog mkhan po rol po mes ston dpon g.yog bzhi khrag skyugs te shi/ de rjes spong zhon ston pho mo drug cu rtsa gcig zla ba dgu'i khongs su 'jig rten pha rol gyi ltad mor song / mtshur ston rin cen rdo rje la sku zhad dpal ldan gyis gsan/ de nas rim ba'i na bla ma tshul khrims rin chen/ sngags 'chang byang chub mgon po/ mkhas grub nam mkha'i mtshan can/ des rigs 'dzin tshul khrims zhabs/ rgya ston dbon po nam mkha' rigs 'dzin gsang ba/ 'di'i zhal ngor rwa ba'i bla ma rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus sogs mkhas grub mang du byung zhing phyi ma 'ga' zhig tshe bdag la shin tu mkhas pas yang bzlog gi lhan thabs kyi yig cha mang du mdzad/ de la lha sras rgyal po'i rnam sprul chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin cen phun tshogs kyis gsan cing thugs nyams su bstar bas yi dam lhas zhal gzigs shing gzhis ka rin spungs pa sogs bsgral ba'i zhing du mar rtags mtshan dngos su bstan pa sogs 'phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub/ des rgyal sras lha rje'i yang srid rigs kyi sras chos rgyal phun tshogs la gnang / des nā ro pa'i rnam sprul sras bkra shis phun tshogs la stsal/ des rigs 'dzan gnam lcags me 'bar gyi sprul pa'i sku gcung rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la gnang / yab sras 'di gsum gas kyang yi dam gyi lha zhal gzigs shing mngon spyod la rtags thon pa sha stag yin/ dam pa 'di nyid la bdag cag gi rnam (5bskor dren gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i sprul pa'i zlos gar zur rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol gyis rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gsan/ yig rnying gi lung dang phyag len ni rje rin cen phun tsho gos nas snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog /ngag dbang ye shes grub pa/ zur kun mkhyen chen po/ yang phyag len gnad 'gag rnams du ma rang grol nas yab zur chen gzhon nu don grub la gsan pa thams cad bdag la bka' drin du stsal zhing phyag len shin tu zhib pa ni dbur smyon chos kyi grags pa nyid las dngos su thos/ dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang dang rnon po nang gcod/ lung yongs su rdzogs pa ni dbur smyon dkon cog phun tshogs nas sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pa/ des bdag la gnang zhing —/21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gzhan yang bka' gter gyi brgyud pa mtha' klas yod pa thams cad chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun ma nyams pas rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rigs 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa/ smon lam dbang bskur brgyud pa/ bka' babs lung bstan brgyud pa/ las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa/ shog ser tshig gi brgyud pa ste bdun ldan brgyud pa'i bka' ma nyams pa/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba/ phyag len mthong brgyud kyi dmar 'khrid ma chad pa/ dam nyams 'dres khyer gyi bslad sa la ma zhugs pa/ steng na bsrung ba rdo rje'i gur khang ma zhig pa/ bar na bzlog bsad rlung zor gyi dbal ngar ma chag pa/ 'og tu mnan gtad sdebs hom gyi tsha ngar ma nyams (6na)pa/ dkar po chos bsgrub pa la med du mi rung ba nag po mthu'i lcags ri gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi byin rlabs rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang 'bul bar byed pa la/ thog mar mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i slad du mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis bsam yas dbu rtse nas gdan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal don gyi gsang tig las/ na mo/ bla ma 'jam dpal tshe yi bdag /dus 'di nas bzung ye shesasems dpa'i sku ma thob bar du phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum dang / 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa/ /sras bcas rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /dus gsum mgon po gang mdzad pa'i/ /don de bdag gis bzung bar bgyi/ /dri ma bral ba'i tshul khrims dang / /chos rnams yongs sdud dge ba dang / /sems can don byed rnam pa gsum/ /bdag gis yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /ma rgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /de bzhin ma dgrol ba rnams grol/ /dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing / /thams cad mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /'jam dpal sku yi dam tshig tu/ /dkon mchog gsum bzung mi gtang ngo / /'jam dpal gsung gi dam tshig tu/ /theg pa gsum po ma nyams bzung / /'jam dpal thugs kyi dam tshig tu/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bzung / /'jam dpal —/22

tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'akor/ nang ma(khanayon tan dam tshig tu/ /dus drug sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin/ /'jam dpal 'phrin las dam tshig tī/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bya/ /'jam dpal thams cad bos pa yi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /sdom (6ba)pa kun dang yang dag ldan/ khyud kun yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ rje rat+na'i reg zig tu gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang phyi 'gyur la grags pa'i sdom bzung la zhal 'phangs shing gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar yang sdom bzung de dang cha mtshudas snang bas gang bde byas pas khyab la/ gsar ma dang phyogs mthun pa yang phur sogs rnying ma bka' ma mang por yod pas phyogs re'i mig can gyi sbugs 'thum bya mi dgos/ gsal ba gdab pa ni/ gsang tig las/ e/ mthing nag e las drag po'i gzhal yas su/ /gshin rje chu glang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du/ /'jam dpal ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed/ /gshed po khro bo dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ reg zig tu rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs 'dug pa mi 'thad pa ma yin na'ang kha 'geng dgos pa rnams rje dbur spyon gsang tig nas blangs pa legs pa'i phyogs su bzhed/ de nas bla ma dang gtor ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam pa can bdag mdun gyi tshul du bzhugs par brda sprad/ ye shes dbab pa'i phyir du slob ma las sngags dang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥyig ser po yongs su gyur pa las slob ma 'jam snang rtse nasakyis mngon rtogs srung 'khor gzhung bzhin bskyed gsung ba byang chen 'di'i dkyil 'khor yin (7na)pas bka' brgyad kyi dbang lta bu la yang slob ma che mchog tu bskyed pas mi chog par dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom gyin yod pa yin nam/ rdzabacog mang na ja khang gi snod la lag rdugs 'byung dogs dgos 'dun go /dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can 'kha ga ṇi ga phyag gnyis pa/g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dpung pa'i thad sor 'dzin cing / g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kur 'dzin pa 'dab ma snyan kyi thad kur kha phye ba rgyas pa'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu —123—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo klung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing / ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'i dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dang bdag mdun gyi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin dag pa 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa sku che ba ri rab dang chung ba rdul phran tsam pa bu yug 'tshub pa ltar spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i lus la sku/ ngag la gsung / yid la thugs/ mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar thim pa'i dmigs pa sprad/ gu gul sogs rdzas sbyar ba'i dud pa btang zhing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas las byang rdo rje'i thog mda' las byung ba'i byin 'debs kyi mjug tu ā+oṃ sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lus la gzi byin bskyed du gsol/ /lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dngosagrub stsol/ /āḥ(7ba tshen sung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ngag la nus pa spar du gsol/ /ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /gsung gi snying po lung gi dnges grub stsol/ /hūṃ thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /sems la rtogs pa spar du gsol/ /sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /thugs skye med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol/ /zhi drag gi sngags dang rtsa sngags rnams kyi mthar tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya a be sha ya dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal a ba sha ya a āḥ zhes dbyer med du bstim zhing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab ste brtan par bya/ byin phab pa'i rkyen gyis rgyu 'jam dpal 'bras bu gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gsal bar/ dbang dngos bskur ba la/ dang po sku'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba ni/ gtor ma gtso 'i ye sgor lngar gsal snang rtse nas kyis gtor ma ltar bskyed gsung ba ltar na dbang bsgrub kyi rigs mdzad kyin med pa 'dra dpyod ldan rnams ni sngar yod gsal 'debs kyi tshul du zer ba yin/ sde pa skyid shod pa 'i dmag dpon mdzad 'phror dbang bskur la byon pa'i skyon du bog /ba'i gtso bo'i dpral ba'i ā+oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kya dpral bar thim/ lus kya nang thams cad gang bas byin gyis brlab —124

tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'akor/ nang ma(kha)par brda sprad/ gtor ma dpral bar gtugs la/ las byang gi bstod ring gi /e/ cho me kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa nas/ /gshin rje ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i steng/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste dmigs pa gang yin de nyid da lta brlag /khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dbang bskur ro/ /'khor gyi gshin rje bye ba'i dbang thob shog /gsang tig las/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan/ /(8na)deng bdag sangs rgyas sku 'dzin pa/ /sku yi rdo rje ā+oṃ yang sbyin/ /ā+oṃ a snang rtse nas kyis dbang bskur rdzo bstod ring nas len dgos pa rtsad ma chod cing sngags kyang a kro 'bru bcu gcig pa sbyar ba 'bri gung du dbang gsan dus snyan bal dug gis bsgags yod pa 'dra/ 'di 'dra'i rdo rje slob dpo gyi thugs khur sne'u sdong rtser rin cen rgyan sprod la 'byon pa rang babs sam snyam/ ka ya ma du ru tsakra kā ya a bhi tañca hūṃ hrī: zhes dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sku bsgrub pa la dbang / sku'i dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung / lus sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes ngo sprad/ gtor ma ma mo khrag mig mar gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros khyod rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ mgrin pa'i nang thams cad gang bas byin gyis brlab par bde sprad/ gtor ma mgrin par gtugs la/ hūṃ/ khro rgyal chen po'i g.yon gyi phyogs nas ni/ /gsod byed yum chen ma mo khrag mig ma/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste zhabs gnyis dor stabs rab bgrad dgra bgegs gnon/ /yum mchog e ka dzā ti'i dbang bskur ro/ /'khor gyi ma mo'i dmag tshogs dbang thob shog /dpal ldan rdo rje gsung 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas gsung 'dzin pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje āḥyang sbyin/ /h+ya ka ya ma du ru tsakra wa ka a bhi ༷ñca hūṃ hrīḥ zhes dbang bskur bas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gsung bsgrub pa la dbang / gsung gi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung / ngag longs (8ba〉spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes ngo sprad/ gtor ma sras mchog ya ma rā tsar gsal ba'i thugs rka'i hūṃ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ snying gi nang thams cad gang —125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bas byin gyis brlab par brda sprad/ gtor ma snying gar gtugs la/ hūṃ/ g.yas na sras mchog ya ma rā tsa ni/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste phyag g.yon dgra bgegs rnams kyi don snying 'drad/ gsod byed ya ma rā tsa'i dbang bskur ro/ /'khor gyi las mkhan sde brgyad dbang thob shog /dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan/ /deng bdag sangs rgyas thugs 'dzin pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje hūṃ du mdzod/ /gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra tsit+ta a bhi khiñca hūṃ hrīḥ zhes dbang bskur bas/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs bsgrub pa la dbang / thugs kyi dam tshig ma lus pa bsrung / yid chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes ngo sprad/gtor ma yab yum sras gsum sku sprul 'chi bdag gsung sprul srog bdag ste gtso 'khor lnga'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs nga dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga'i gnas rnams su thim/ lus kyi nad thams cad gang bas byin gyisabarlab par brda sprad/ gtor ma lag rje zur pa'i dus sbas lha gnyis zhal shes su mdzad pas las mkhan bka' btad kyi tshul du dgongs pa snang rtse nas kyis ma rtogs par gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag nas stim pa ni dngos bstan gyi lha yab yum sras (9na〉sum las med pa sor sgos gi rang mtshang ngo / khu gtad la/ hūṃ/ gzhan yang khro rgyal chen po khyed rnams la/ /'phrin las bcol ba 'di rnams da mdzod cig /ces pa nas bzung ste/ bcol ba'i 'phrin lasamyur du sgrub pa mdzod/ /sarba tsit+ta gzer thums lhag nan trig nan/ rbad ya/ bzlog ya/ sarba sirnyi a bhi khiñca hūṃ hā: zhes dbang bskur bas/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la dbang /gsang sngags brda'i dam tshig bzhi bsrung / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal rgyas par spro na gtso pho gnas gsum gyi 'phro 'du sogs la brten nas gtor ma spyi mgrin snying ga lag par gtad nas skul tshig kha bsgyur ba'i dbang bzhi dang yab yum sras gtso 'khor lnga ga la yang so sor dbang bzhi kha phral nas byed pa yod na'ang deng sang gong ma nyid mdzad pa shas che'o/ /ba can du byas so/ /bsgom pa lha'i bskyed rim de dag ni sku'i dbang yin la/ zhes de'i mjuka snang 'a kyis yab —/26

tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'akor/ nang ma(khanayum gyi dbang bskur rgyas gdab mdzad 'dug pa rnying rgan rnams la de 'dra'i dbang mi dgos pas ra lung du 'brug pa mi pham chos rgyal la bskur ba zhu/ ngo sprad/ gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni bdag mdun gyi gtso 'khor lnga so so'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso bo'i thugs gar hūṃ mthing nag /yum gyi thugs gar bh+yo smug nag /sras dang sbas lha gnyis kyi thugs gar ya dmar nag gi mthar rang sngags kyis g.yas skor du 'khor ba shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ slob ma'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba la thim/ slar sna bug (9ba〉na yas nas thon/bdag mdun gyi sna bug g.yon brgyud thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pa sogs gsal bar bsgom zhing rtsa sngags dang bsrung sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum/ sngags 'phreng g.yon du 'khor ba la 'phro 'du gong ltar byas nas bzlog bsad mnan gsum gyi sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gyi mthar ru dra k+ṣa'i snang rtse nas kyis me tog gtor te bcom ldan bdag la stsal sogs sgrub thabs rgya rgyam nas badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs 'dug pa si tu drung pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang mgo med rtsa med de dang lhan du mtshur phur skyel ba zhu/ 'phreng ba mgrin par bzhag ste dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: zhes byin gyis brlab/ de ni sngags kyi bzlas lung zhes pa gsung gi dbang yin zhes brda sprad/ gsum pa thugs kyi sdo pa snang rtse bas 'di med pa la rdo rjes gnas gsum du go bgo ba 'dug pa rnam 'joms kyi byab khrus kyi dpe tshal pa zhig rnyed pa'am/ yang na gter zhabs tshul du khyung tshang brag nas bton pa 'dra'o/ /dbang ni/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa las/ gzhi don bsgom bya sgom byed bral/ /ngang gis gsal la gzung 'dzin med/ /so ma rang gdangs lhug pa'i ngang / /gsal stong lam bsgom dbang bskur ro/ /zhes/gnas lugs kyi gzhi bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral yang gang du sku'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba dang gsung gi byin rlabs sngags kyi bzlas pa'i lung gi spro bsdu sogs bskyed rim pa'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa de thams cad mkha' la 'ja' tshon bzhin ngang gis gsal yang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa med pa rig pa so ma rang gdangs sam bcos lhug pa'i gshis gsal stong 'dzin bral spros med bde ba chen po chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bor cung zad —/27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nacig mnyam par 'jog par zhu zhes ngo sprad pa ni thugs kyi dbang yin no/ /spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig rnams la nan tan du bsrung snyam pas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bdag ni rtse gcig gus gdung bas/ /ma lus bdag gis bsgrubs lags na/ /brtse bas rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ tshogs lhag /chad mtho/ bstan ma/ bro brdung /zil gnon las byang chen mo bzhin gtang rag gis mchode/ bzod gsol/ rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal ba/lus bsrung ba rnams las byang rdo rje thog mda' ltar dang smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /mi bsrun gdug pa 'dul ba'i gnyen po sa /dus kyi dgra bor 'jam dpal dpa' bo che/ /srid gsum za byed khro zhal gdangs pa'i mod/ /yid srubs sder bcas 'pham pa'i cho nge 'don/ /gtsug lag dpal dgyes zla gsang bcud phyung ba'i/ /gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gaṅgā'i chab/ /rgya bal paṇa grub ma dres las babs pa/ /gnubs chen brgyud pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /dum pa rgya nas rim bzhin zhal sgros su/ /'ongs pa'i smin byed rnon po nang gcod dbang / /lha sras rnam sprul chos rgyal 'bri gung pas/ /'khrul pa'i dri bral reg zig med du byung / /'on te blo dman rnams kyis ma rtogs dang / /log rtogs bgrod dka'i dpya 'phrang la rdugs shing / /zag zog rdzun bris yig hrul rdul 'tshub kyis/ /phyag lan dngas pa'i chu klung rnyog mar byas/ /sngon byon dam pa'i ring lugs rta ljang can/ /skal dman thun mtshams stegs la nye ba'i tshe/ /rigs 'dzin (10na)kun+da ba 'ad pa'i smin byed gzhung / /nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ding 'dir shar/ /lag nom mun pa'i rdzas 'tsho pa mi dgos par/ /phyag bzhis rjen par mthong ba'i snying nor 'di/ /ming btags ma yin bstan srog 'dzin nges pa'i/ /sngags 'chang ral pa'i khur can rnams kyis long / /dge 'dis mgon po zur phud lnga ldan des/ /grangs med skye bar bshes mdzad rjes bzung nas/ /'jam dpal rdzogs chen them skas la 'dzegs te/ /rang rig dag pa'i 'og min zhing bgrod shog /ces 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po me'i spu gri'i rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang gi chog sgrigs nya rgyas —/28

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanazla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ni rtsod dus pad+ma'i rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku mchog gter bdag gling pas snga gong nas gsung gis bskul ba dang chos rgyun gyi phyag len mi 'phyugs par phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kyang yid drangs te za hor gyi sngags smyon drag po rtsal gyis mtshungs med gnam lcags me 'bar gyi reg zig dang brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes la yid gtan du bzung / med du mi rung ba rnams rang bzo'i bslad pa ma zhugs pas kha bkang nas bag yod kyi lo ston gyi zla ba'i nyer gsum pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor thog pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /maṅga lo// //'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhugs/'khor 'das yongs kyi phyag rgya ma lus pa/ /zil gnon 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po dang / /dbyer med chos kun ka nas dag pa'i dbyings/ /rang grol rtsa ba'i bla ma gtsug na mdzes/ /sreg blugs zas kyi mchod pas gshin rje'i gshed/ /dgyes pa bskyed rnams ngal ba don ldan zhes/ /rgyud dang rgya bod mkhas grub gzhung lugs las/ /gsungs pas yid la spro dga' gzengs su mtho/ /de phyir spyi dang bye brag nyes pa'i tshogs/ /smag rum dpung la nyi zla ji bzhin du/ /zhi byed 'phrin las gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'di/ /'byul med brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin 'dri/ /de la 'dir dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i 'phrin las kyi rim pa mtha' yas pa rnams kyi nang nas bsreg pa me'i sbyor ba la brten nas las bzhi bsgrub pa'i nang tshan zhi ba'i sbyin sreg lag tu blang ba la zhi ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa la shis pa'i gza' tshes dus sbyor sogs dang bstun g.yin gyis longs ma spyad pa'i sa yin na sa chog nges par dgos shing / gnas khang rnying pa sogs la ma byas kyang rung / phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu byed par spro na (2na)gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dbang chog sogs las shes shing / mi spro na dbang chog nges don bde 'jug gi sngon 'gro'i —12(3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)skabs bzhin nyams su len/ sgrub pa sogs dang 'brel ba'i gnas khang gi mtho nang du bya ba la de dag kyang bya mi dgos so/ /de'ang gnas khang du phyag bdar dang skyang nul bya/ dbye 'gugs bsad bskrad sogs la dgos pa'i sa dang ma 'dres pa'i gtsang zhing bkra shis pa'i sa la stegs bu brtsigs/thab khung thur du phyag gang rgyar khru gang brus/ thig chen brgyad btab pa'i zangs kyi kha mtshams nas phyir sor bzhi'i tshad kyi kha khyer dang mu ran bskor ba la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang / zur bzhin zla phyed la gnasapa'i rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang 'dab ma la phyag mtshan sa bon tshom bu gang rung grangs ldan bkod/ de'i steng du dgongs rgyud las lcang ma glang ma gzhan yang pad ma 'o ma can zhes bshad pa'i shugs la bal bu/ 'om bu/ shug pa sogs rung bar gsungs pas de ga ltar ram/ bzo dbyibs 'jug bde ba'i dbang du byed na nags kyi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa gang (2ba)rung gis thab zlum po rkang gang ba brtsigs te sa dkar ram 'bras dkar gyi khu bas byugs/ man ngag ltar me tshang bca'/ nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig bzhag /dkar rtsi'i steng du gangs ri dang sa bon bris pa'i me yol bya/ bshad ma thag pa'i yam shing gis chag rul zos med pa srid du sor brgyad sboms su mthe'u chung dang mnyam pa rtsa rtse gnyis mar dang 'o ma dang sbrang rtsis byugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri zhim dkar po'i chus sbags pa/ rang mdog can gyi mar khu sogs rdzas chen nyer lnga dang rdzas kyi sbags shing rdzas sna brgyad 'bras dkar rlangs btsos dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog lugs 'di'i khyad par gyi rdzasahrū sna tshogs/ rtsi mar/ me tog sna tshogs/ gu gul dkar po/ tsan dan dkar po/ du rba/ bri yang ku /thang chu/ 'bras yos/ tsam pa ka /'dod gsol gyi shing byang sogs la thun mong ma yin pa'i dam rdzas lngas sbags te so sor bshams pa'am shing byang ma gtogs pa rnams ril bur bsgril ba sogs gang bder byas pa'i rdzas rnams rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du 'das ma 'das kyi dbye bas mang nyung gnyis su byas te go rim ma 'khrugs par g.yas su bkod/ rang rdzas dmigs bsal gyis sbags pa'i 'das gtor dang me lha'i gtor ma/ phyi nang gi chu gnyis nyer spyod tshar gnyis —/30

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanare g.yon ngos nas bsgrig /mdun du las bum/ me tog /thod rnga/ rdo rje/ dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dril bu/ sman raka /ku sha brgyad/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab ri mo can/ so rtsi/ ngos zung sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams las mthun gyi gdan la bshams/ de nas (3na〉skrub pa po lus dri zhim pos byugs/ zhi ba'i gar chas sam/ ma 'grub na gos rgyan thod sogs dkar po byas/ ngag bcad nas pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis kha shar du phyogs te sngon du las byang gyer ma zin na 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs 'dzab cung zad bzla/ tshogs las yan song nas/ rdor dril bcangs te de nyid dang rnga byin rlabs gsang rdzogs kyi las byang lhan thabs ltar bya/ gzar bu gnyis brlab pa ni rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du bkug ste gzar bu gnyis la thim/ de zhu ba las hūṃ las blugs gzar rdo rje dang a las dgang gzar dril bu'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag nag po rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa dang gsod byed ma sngo nag tsit+ta bhan dmar 'dzin pa dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu nas blugs gzar dang dgang gzar gyi rnam par bsam/ las bum ni dbang chog nges don bde 'jug tu rgyas bsdus gnyis gsungs pa'i/ 'dir bsang chu'i dod tsam la bsdus pa nyid kyis khyab pas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/su bha was sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las : las byung ba'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su a dkar po shel dkar ltar 'tsher ba de las 'od zer 'phros 'og min nas bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rab 'byams rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te bum chu (3ba)la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis sems can rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la ā+oṃ ā:nyu brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ ye kho zhes pa nas bzung ste gu spo sa ma ya swāhā zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mchod pa brlab pa ni g.yas pas g.yas skor gyis gsang chu dang / sman phud —131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nas kyang gtor/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsams la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a: āḥlha nas shasta āḥ& gi bar brjod pa'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/sreg rdzas brlab pa ni/ sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i sreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi zhi ba'i las rab 'byams ma lus pa bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par mos la phyag rgya dang bcas te/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ swāhās rdzas rnams bkru/ ā+oṃ ā:swāhā yaṃ shing / ā+oṃ shrī swāhās mar/ ā+oṃ dzi swāhā 5 5 /ā+oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhās rdzas (4na/gzhan rnams brlab bo/ /me bsgrub pa ni/ las sngags brjod cing gzhung nas gshad pa'i me las spar ba'i spor lde thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas lan gsum bskor de dang mtshungs par phye myags bzla zhing ting lo sbar ba dang bcas/ hūṃ/ bram ze rgyun bzhag la sogs chad med las/ /blangs te dri ldan shing la rab sbar bas/ /zhi ba'i sreg rdzas 'bar bar mnga' gsol lo/ /'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'khyil ba'i las mdzod cig /ā+oṃ a gli raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing (skam cung zad bcug /bshad ma thag pa'i sngags dang bcas blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso zhing rlung g.yab kyis cung zad g.yab/ me pra ngan na gzhil ba'i thabs bya/ sngar bzhin thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran gnyis ka sor bzhi pa rdo rje'i 'phreng bas zlum por bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ dkar po —/32

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)las bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dkar po ra skyes la zhen pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas zhe gu dang g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral ba'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra'i ag tshom dang tshangs pa'i skud pa 'phyang ba/ sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing drang (4ba)srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi me mtshams nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing / dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas rna ba'i drung nas g.yabs te/ dang po dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs me lha drang srong mchog /bstan pa bsrung mdzad gzi brjid can/ /rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du/ /'dir gshegs zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /e spo hi bha ga wā na dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ au asna ye dz+nyā na sam ye ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tri shu dza thong sam ya sdo/ zhes spyan drangs te bstim/ hūm̐/ gzi byin chen po me yi lha 'dod pa thams cad rab bsgrub cing : thugs rjes zhi ba'i las mdzad paḥ 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs so gsolaḥ ma asna ye sa ma ya ti ṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes gdan dbul: ྅: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs pa: 'phrin las kun gyi dpang po mdzad: ting 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo: zho asna ye a la la ho: a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: zhes phyag bya/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: ra skyes bcibs pas glog las mgyogs: sreg rdzas kun gyis phyag tshang mdzad:tshim byed khyod la mchod pa ni: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri chab zhal zas dang :snyan pa'i rol mor bcas pa 'bul bzhes nas zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod tshwa badz+ra kro ta asna ye arnya hūṃ dza hūṃ/ ā+oṃ pā rdu pā dza hūṃ nas shag pā dza hūṃ (5na ye rna pa'i bar gyis phyi mchod dbul/ hūṃ/ ting 'dzin dbang sgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi lnga: drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i: dag cing gtsang mar sbyar ba 'bul lags kyis thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol: rlu badz+ra kro ta asna ye pū dza khā hi/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ji hi/ ma hā ba kla ta ji hi/ mahā rak+ta ji nyis nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ/—/33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gzi brjid chen po me yi lha: /'dod pa thams cad rab bsgrub cing : thugs rjes zhi ba'i las mdzad par: longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zho badzā kro ta sgyu ye ga ṇa tsakra pu dza ji hi: zhes tshogs nas kyang 'bul/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: mnyam pa'i ngang las kun snang yang : chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa'i: ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod/ ku sha brgyad po g.yon du bzung nas sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa zhi pa'i las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yis kyang dag byed yin/ /'di yas bdag la bgegs med cing / /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /badz+ra satwa a/ zhes ku sha rnams rtse mo g.yas skor du bstan te/ snga ma'i rtse phyi ma'i rtsa bas non pa dgram/ /byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ (5ba tshe yig gis mtshan par mos nas/ oṃ asna ye swāhā brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la lag gnyis pus mo'i khongs las mi 'da' bas rdo rje khu tshur ra ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor zhing / ā+oṃ asna ye de bya de bya bi shud+dhi ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ me pra brtag cing ngan na bsrung / /me lha'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas/ /bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun dud khu dang / /rnag khrag srog chags gzugs brnyan tshul/ /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /phyir thon sreg rdzas rnams la thim/ /zhes brjod nas/ me lha drang srong 'khor bcas la/ /yam shing me tog dar sna mar/ /til chang spos dang dur 'bras so/ /zas mchog ku sha yungs kur sha /khrag tshil sgro mdongs lan tsha nas/ /'o ma sran ma rin chen gro/ /dngar gsum sman sna shing tog snum/ khyad par rdzas dang bcas pa 'bul/ /tshe dpal bsod —/34

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)nams stobs 'byor dang / /lung rtogs chos srid legs tshogs pa/ /bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs dgra /gtad sel mnan dbye rbod gtong byad/ /dbul phongs na da rims dus min 'chi/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ji snyed pa/ /ma lus byang zhing dag 'gyur ba'i/ /zhi ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab/ /ces brjod de g.yon pas sreg rdzas kyi snod nas bzung g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te 'og nas (6na)bskor zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ yam shing ni/ ā+oṃ asna ye badz+ra yā dz+nyā ya/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sogs nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa thog mtha' gnyis su ci rigs dang rdzas sngags rkyang pas bdun nam nyer gcig sogs mang nyung skabs sbyar 'bul/gong gi bsnyen pa na kha skong ba'i spel tshig gi tshab la dmigs bsal gyi las gang sgrub kyi kha bsgyur dgos pa phyag len ltar bya/ lha rdzas kyi sngags gnyis gong ltar gyi me tog sna tshogs ni gzi brjid phun sum tsho gos pa'i tshab tu/ mdangs phun sum tshogs pa la zhes pas mtshon te las sngags bsgyur mi dgos pa'i dmigs gsal byung ba rnams ma gtogs 'don pa bsgyur lugs kun la 'gre/ dar sna ni kha dog phun sum tsho gos pa la/ mar ni/ ā+oṃ asna yes lha rdzas gnyis ga'i sngags kyis go bcad/ 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la/ til ni/ sarba bā pa da ha na badz+ra ya/ dge ba phun sum tshogs pa la/ /sngags gnyis gong ltar gyis chang ni/ /nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs pa la/ spos ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ du rba ni/ badz+ra ā yu she /tshe phun sum tshogs pa la/ 'bras ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pu spyi ye/bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la/ so ba ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tsho gos pa la/zas mchog ni/ ā+oṃ sarba /bha de/ bdeb phun sum tsho gos pa la/ ku sha ni/ cas prati ha ta badzā ya/ (6ba)srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la/ yungs kar ni/ ā+oṃ sarba a tho sa khyu ya/ bgegs med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ sha khrag: tshil gsum yang sngags gsum bshad ma thag pa ltar gyis 'bul/ sngagasaganyis gong bzhin gyis rma bya'i mdongs ni/ 'ag gdon gyi 'tshe ba med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ lan —135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)tsha ni/ sbyor ba ngan pa med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ nas ni/ ā+oṃ ma hā be gā ya/ shugs phun sum tshogasapa la/ sngags gnyis gong ltar gyis/ 'o ma ni/ longs spyod phun sum tsho gos pa la/ sran ma ni/ ā+oṃ ma hā ba lwa ya/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la/ rin chen sna tsho gos kyang sngags gsum gyis gong ltar 'bul/gro ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gha sma re/ rims med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ dngar gsum ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma le pusta ya/mos pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ sman sna tshogs ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā shri yaṃ sa ta ye/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la/ shing tog sna tshogs ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sho ba le/ rigs brgyud phun sum tshogs pa la/ 'bru mar ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra tshe tā ya/ sa lam gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa la/ khyad par ba'i rdzas spyi rnams/ā+oṃ a sna ye/ bdag cag gi ting nge 'dzin mi gsal zhing sngags chad lhag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā dang / shing byang ni/ ā+oṃ asna ye/ bdag cag gi 'khor 'das kyi phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i nad rims/ dbul phongs 'thab rtsod/dgra byad/ mnan gtad zor rlung / dbye bskrad phra men/ mdo (7na tshe sgrub dmod pa/ gdon bgegs dus min 'chi ba nyes ltung sdig sgrib ma lus pa shan+ti ku ru swāhās sngar bzhin gyi grangs dang bcas te 'bul/sreg rdzas mchod pas mo yi lha/ /mnyes te sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /bsgrub bya'i snying gar phog pa yis/ /slar yang sgo gsum sdig sgrib bsregs/ /'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ltar/ /babs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams rab bkrus te/ /bshang gci'i lam nas thon par gyur/ /zhes brjod/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /ra skyes bcibs nas glog las mgyogs/ /zhesasogs sngags bcas kyis mchod/ /bstod pas bstod/ me lha 'khor bcas khyod rnams kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba/ /gnod byed nad gdon dgra bgegs dang / /mthu byad dbul phongs dus min 'chi/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus pa/ /zhi zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ spyan drangs pa'i me lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/ asna ye/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ gha tsha gha tsha/ la bha bha mu: ye shes me lha dam tshig pa nyid las/ /phyir gshegs shar lto'i mtshams su rab bzhugs nas/ /—/36

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanazhal tshur gzigs te dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mnyes byed mchod pa'i dbang por mdzad par gyur/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ /dam tshig me lha'i thugs ka mā /e yi pho brang zla gam gsum/ /zhes pa nas bzung ste snang la rang bzhin med par lta'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/ /gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog rtsa ba'i zhal/ /rab dkar zhi (7bsgo khro yi 'dzum mdangs can/ /dkar la 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba yis/ /zhi ba'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur/ /phye/ mi rtog ngang las thugs rje'i sku:zhes pa nas/ sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstodaḥkyi bar gyis spyan 'dren mchod bstod las byang gi dkyus ltar la/ nang gi 'dod yon gyi mchod pa'i rjes su/ bar gcod mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs la/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /'bar ba gshin rje'i 'kha du kha raṃ ji hi/ e ka ya ma kro ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ji hi/ ces tshogs nas kyang 'bul/ byon zan ni/ ye shes pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūṃ dang dgang blugs kyi rtse la raṃ yig gis mtshan par mos nas phyag rgya sogs sngar bzhin bgyis te/ phye myags tshar bdun brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar 'geng ba sogs 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar byas te/ ā+oṃ asna ye de bya de bya nas bzung ste nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā'i bar gyis sngar ltar lan gsum 'bul/ me lha'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang dang po 'das lha'i thugs nas 'od 'phros pas/ zhes par bsgyur te rdzogs par brjod/ mye/ phyag rgya zil gnon gsod byed rgyal/ /ya ma rā dza gsang ba'i bdag /rus sbal rngam pa bya khyung rgyal/ khyung stag seng ge dug sprul zung / /rtsa ba rgyan gyi lha rnams la/ /yaṃ shing me tog dar sna mar/ /zhes pa nas/ zhi (8na)ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab kyi bar brjod nas/ 'jig rten pa'i skabs bzhin rdzas chen nyer bdun khyad par gyi rdzas dang bcas pa rnams 'jig rten pa'i sngags dang 'das sngags brje ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing grangs nyer gcig dang brgya sogs skabs sbyar dang / khyad par gyi sgos chos bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rdzas sngags gcig la brten nas chig dril du thun re la stong khri sogs sngags kyi ring thung dang bstun te phyag len bzhin 'bul/
