des mtshon te rang 'dod pa'i las gang bsgrub kyang de ga'i rdzas sngags chog dril bya tshul mthong brgyud kyi phyag len la rag lus so/ /de nas 'khor rnams la/ phye/ sprul pa rnam gsum gshed po bzhi/ /mon bdud 'chi bdag bar khyamasalha/ /sgo ba 'obs srung bcu drug dang / /pho nya bye ba sa ya sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas la/ /yam shing me tog dar sna mar/ /zhes pa nas/ zhi ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab kyi bar brjod/ sngags rnams gong dang 'dra bar byas te rdzas chen nyer bdun dang khyad par gyi rdzas rnams bdun nam nyer gcig tsam dang / dmigs bsal gyi rdzas gtso bo'i bcu cha 'bul/ sreg rdzas mchod pas me yi lha/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang dang po sreg rdzasamachod pas ye shes lha/ /zhes par bsgyur nas tshang bar brjod/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar dgang blugasabadun tshan gsum gshegs skyems su 'bul/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas (8ba)rol mo 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya a lha prati ts+tsha swāhā nas sha lta'i bar brjod/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ khyad par mchod pa pañca a mṛ ta/ /ma hā ba kla rak+ta ra bcas pa 'bul/ /bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā pañca dang mahā ra sa sbyar bas sman raka dang / gtor ma las byang gi mchod gtor ltar byin gyis brlab/ /hūṃ/ bla med mchog gi mchod par sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon to lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya ma hā ba kla ta pā dza ji his 'bul/ ā+oṃ badz+ra taskru la ye swāhā so rtsi dang / ā+oṃ badz+ra wa sdu ye swāhās gos zung 'bul/ chos dbyings ngang las khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /lhag pa'i lhar gyur bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /bdud kyi bdud chen ma rungasa'adul pa'i lha/ khro rgyal kun gyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces mchode bstod bya/ de nas dgongs—/38

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khana'adus rta nag gi pad+ma dbang zhes pa 'don pa bsgyur ba 'di lta ste/ lha yi lha mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dus rnams rtag tu khro rgyal khyed bsgrubs te: srog gi phyir yang yi dam mi spong na ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol: khro rgyal 'khor bcas khyod kyi gzi brjid kyis: bar gcod bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bsal nas kyang : byams (9na)pa'i zhal bzang mngon sum ston pa dang : sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir stsal du gsol: yang 'bri gung zur pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ /lha mchog khyod dang smon lam gcig pa'i mthus/ /da lta zhal mthong yi dam lhar gsol na/ /snying po byang chub mchog la mi gnas tshe/ /tshe rabs 'khor ba gar skyes gar gnas kyang / /rjes su bzung zhig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /dngos grub stsol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /bar gcod sol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gzhan yang / mkhyen brtse nus mnga' 'jam dpal dpa' bo yis/ /bstan pa rgyas dang de 'dzin tshogs rnams kyi/ /sku tshe 'phrin las skye rgu'i bde skyid la/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi mdzad gsol/ khyad par rigs 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob dang / /yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa'i/ /sngon lasa'aphral rkyen las byung dgra bgegs gdon/ /nad rims dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi mdzad gsol/ /phyi nang drang srong dmod pa mthu byad dang / /byung dang skal ngan mi shis dus min 'chi/ /sgeg sri langasasogs chags che nyam nga ba'i/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi mdzad gsol/ /'phrin las chad lhag dam rdzas ma tshang nyams/ /bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing dus kyi mchod pa chag /ting 'dzin mi gsal gsang sngags sgra nyams sogs/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ma lus zhi mdzad gsol/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor dbang phyug (9ba)phun sum tshogs/ /lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan sogs/ /'khor 'das dngos grub kun dang khyad par du/ /'jam mgon kun bzang tshe 'dir mngon gyur mdzod/ /ces 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi yig brgya lan gsum gyis chad lhag kha bkang / /yi —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dam lha mchog zil gnon 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las gzhung bzhin bgyis pa la/ /bdag cag ma rig log rtog dbang song ba'i/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchos bzod par gsol/ /zhes nongs pa bshags/ /ā+oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang / badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsam/ /slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ /dbang por bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi me lha badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ slar yang dam tshig sems dpa' dang : dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: ra skyes bcibs nas glog las mgyogs: zhes pa nas/ ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar gyis mchod bstod bya/ /me lha drang srong 'khor bcas la/ /yam shing me tog dar sna mang / /zhes pa nas khyad par ba'i rdzas yan sngar ltar dang gshegs skyems dgang blugs bdun gsum byon zan bzhin phul rjes/ badz+ra tā myu las so rtsi wa stas gos zung 'bul/ gtor ma las byang ltar byin gyis brlabs/ ā+oṃ asna ye sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba la ta pū dza ji hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes las zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ me lha 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /zhes sogs (10na 'dod gsol bya/ ā+oṃ asna ye a lha pra tī ts+tsha swāhā nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ yig brgya dang ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gas gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur spyon cig /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /ā+oṃ asna ye ya hi gas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥ/ baṃ sngos/ rang dang gnyis su med par bsam/ mched rnams srin lag sbrel gral zlum por byas te/ hūṃ/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: kun kyang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: khro bo 'dus pas nam mkha' gang :khro mo 'dus pas bar snang gang ri khro chung 'dus pas sa gzhi gang : thams cad 'dus pa'i ngang nyid las: rkang pa g.yas kyis bro brdungs pas: pho sri thams cad g.yas su mnan: rkang pa g.yon gyis bro brdungs pas: mo sri thams cad g.yon du mnan: gnyis su med par bro brdungs pas: chung —14()

'jam dpal tshe bdag gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanasri thams cad rdul du brlag: bro ni ye shes chen po'i bro dgra rnams thal bar rlog pa'i bro bdud rnams phye mar 'thag pa'i bro de phyir glu bro rgyun mi chad shar du zhi ba'i bro brdungs pas: dgra bgegs thams cad zhi bar shog: rlu a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥspyi li kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa zhi ba shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes bro brdung zhing byung brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya zhing me tog sil ma phyogs kun tu gtor/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug /sbrel nas byed na thal ba rnying pa ma (10ba)dkrugs par nim tsam byas pa'i khar tse(nga kong brtsigs la bshad ma thag pa nyams su blangs/ long yod na me ma shi bar du mi bsgul zhing / rings na 'o mas gzhil la rdul tshon dang thal ba rnams phal cher 'bab chu chen por dor zhing / nyer mkho'i rdzas su tshags bya ba'ang rung / thab dang nye 'khor kun tu dris byugs shing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag zhi ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /nyes brgya'i dri 'khrud sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /pad gnubs tshangs pa'i ral klung las babs pa/ kho bo'i blo gros chu gter klong du 'khyil/ 'di phyi'i don chen bsgrub pa'i bgegs tshogs kun/ /dus dgra'i dbang po mchod pas nyer zhi nas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rang zhal mngon sum 'jal bar gdon mi za/ /de phyir rigasakun bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol bka' drin las/ /zil gnon phyag rgya'i lam nges longs rnyed pa'i/ /za hor rigs kyi bzhes yi ger bkod/ /pad gnubs lugs srol 'khrul med yi ge dag /tshad ma'i dbang por byas te man ngag gis/ /brgyan las phyi 'gyur kho na'i rgyas 'gebs dang / /rang bzos ma bslad shog ser dri ngad ldang / /dge des mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'/ /mi bzad gdung ba'i rtsa ba dug gsum gyi/ /mun pa'i dmag rum mtha' dag gzhil byas te/ /ye zhes mchog gi 'od stong 'bar gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'di ni gnubs (11na)ban blo bzang thabs mkhas/ sngags ban blo bzang ngag dbang / sngags ban ngag dbang chos —141—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'dzin/ sngags ban 'phrin las rgya mtsho bzhis phye ring bsnyen chen btang ba'i dus kha skong gi sbyin sreg ngag 'don zhig dgos zhes bskul bas rkyen byas nas slad mar yang lam 'di la mos shing nyams su len pa rnams la phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis pad gnubs gnyis kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg dang las bzhi so so'i sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams la gzhi byas/ 'bri gung dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa'i tshe bdag sbyin sreg dang / gzhan yang gshin rje khro chu gter kha gong 'og /byang gter sogs rnying ma rang lugs kyi yig cha nas kha 'gang dgos pa rnams bkang / cung zad mi gsal ba'i med du mi rung ba rnams mthu chen 'jigs med dpa' bo dang 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la sogs kyi gsung rab la zhib por dpyad nas tshig phrad bsnon dgos kyis brgyan te zur chen rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin la brten nas chos tshul 'di la goms pa'i za hor gyi sngags smyon bzhad pa rtsal gyis pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so// // sarba maṅga lo// //'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i/mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma ka ra dang / /bod yul drag sngags bdag po gnubs chen zhabs/ /zab gter sgo 'phyed dum pa rgya zhang sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/ /bcas pas rdo rje'i mkhar rdzong btsan pa'i go /rang gshed dbab pa bzlog bsad mnan gtad mtshon/ /pha rol ban bon mu stegs byad mkhan gyis/ /lo brgyar bsgrubs 'jig gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog /de phyir chos sku 'gyur med thugs kyi rten/ /'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon dkyil 'khor cha/ /rab gnas cho ga mkhas pa'i phyag len ltar/ khrigs su bsdeb bo shes ldan rna ba lhogs/ /de la 'dir sdig pa snying 'dzings nag po sogs rgyud kyi dgongs don ltar rgya bal gyi mkhas —142

mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar/ nang ma(khanagrub rnams kyis khrigs su bsdebs pa'i mchod rten bcas chog bod yul 'dir dang por gnubs dang gter ston rgya/ bar du mkhas pa gangs pa shāka 'bum dang g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ tha mar mkhas pa se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan dang paṇa chen sku mched sogs kyi phyag len lcags sdig lcags 'dra gnyis kyi mchod rten gang lag tu bstar (2na sko'ang med du mi rung ba ni/ lcags sdig zhal gdamasalas/ mchod rten rab tu gnas par bya/ /rab gnas med na 'phung bshig yin/ /zhes rab gnasagal che zhing / de'ang sngags gsar rnying spyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i rab gnas grub kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin mod/ med du mi rung ba gter gzhung las byung ba'i cho ga'i phyag len gyi rim pa ni/ thog mar lcags sdig kun gzhi gti mug sems byung las chad pa'i chos sde dbang bka' rin cen phreng ba las/ sāts+tsha gdab cing chu gtor btang / /'grub na pha rol phyin la 'don/ /ma grub dbang skong bshags pa bya/ /zhes pa ltar lus kyi sgrib sbyong sāts+tsha gdab pa/ ngag gi sgrib sbyong gsung rab klog pa/ yid kyi sgrib sbyong chu gtor gtong ba/ bla ma dngos su bzhugs na dang min na rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i tshogs mchod dbul ba ste phyi'i bshags pa bya/ dkar gtor dmar gtor nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhin btang / rgyal chen mtho 'dzugs ni/ mchod gtor byin rlabs dang bskyed chog mchod gtor 'bul ba rnams phur pa'i sa chog gi skabs ji lta ba las/ (2ba)lha/ shar gyi phyogs nas yul 'khor bsrung / /dri za'i gdon las mtshams chod cig /lho yi phyogs nas 'phags skyes po/ /grul bum gdon lasamatshams chod cig /nub kyi phyogs nas spyan mi bzang / /klu yi gdon las mtshams chod cig /byang gi phyogs nas rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin gdon las mtshams chod cig /ces 'phrin las bcol ri rab lhun po'i rtse brgyad nas zhes sogs nang mtshams gcod pa dang nang bshags byed pa bshad 'dug na'ang las gzhud bsrang ba'i zhar la 'ong bas btang snyoms su bzhag /stegs bu'i khar rab rdul tshon/ 'bring ras bris/ tha ma tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gang rung gi steng du man 'ji'i khar lha tshogs rnams kyi tsakli bzhag /sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gi nyer spyod gter srung gi gtor ma/ tsho gos chos —143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sogs bsham/ las byang gzhung bsrangs te 'dzab bzlas bstod bskul rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyi bar byas la bdag mdun lhan cig tu bsgrub/ rnam bum dang las bum gnyis rdzas dang bcas pa gu gul gyis bdug /bdag nyid khro rgyal sogs brjod cing yungs gar gyis brabs te bgegs bskrad/ srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang la bum rdzas nyer lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga blug /kha rgyan mgul chings/ dud chos gzungs thag btags/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zlo las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ 'khas zhus pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang (3na)ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sman sna tsho gos kyis gang ba'i nang du khye yi pho brang zla gam gsum zhes pa nas nang gi 'dod yon gyi bar dkyus ltar dang / de rjes bstod pa bya/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ bum lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs te rgyal ba'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu dang byin rlabs tshur 'dus/ yang 'od zer 'phros 'og min gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ mthu stobs dang gzi brjid byin rlabs sku sngags phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bum pa la thim/ bum lha rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis bum pa gang bar bsams la/ sku gsung thugs sngags dang phye ring bzla/ mchod bstod bya/ thod chu blug pas sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ mchod rten la khrus gsol gyi ched du las bum du'ang cung zad sdugs/ kha rgyan gyi mdun ngos su tsakli rnams bzhugs dbu rgyan dang cod pan bum pa'i kha la bsdams kyang rung / dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkang / las bum gyi nang du nyi zla'i dbus su a dkar po las 'od zer 'phros 'og min nas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te bum chu la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rten mi gtsang bas 'phags pa'i dri ma thams cad 'dag par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ ā+oṃ āḥ(3ba)྅ brgya —/44

mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar/ nang ma(kha)rtsa bzla/ rang gi g.yas ngos su bzhag /lcags sdig mkhal ma las chad pa'i chos sde rab gnas ye shes zung 'jug las/ mchod rten gyi cha tshad bstan cing tha mal gyi mchod rten bcas pa'i dri ngan dbyi bar bshad pa'i cha tshad ni 'dir smos ma dgos/ dri ngan dbyi ba ni 'bras zan gyi changs bu thogs te ā+oṃ ma hā shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3 lha/ zhes kha yar brjod pa dang lhan cig par mchod rten gyi phyi la zan phyis brgyag pa'i tshul byas la ro ma phyir dor/ bgegs bskrad cing ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa la bgegs gtor btang / gu gul gyis 'dug /bdag nyid khro rgyal ma sogs brjod de yungs dar brabs la bgegs bskrad/ dur khrod me rim sogs kyis mtshams bcad/ rang gi thugs ga nas 'od zer 'phros spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i mchod rten la khrus gsol bas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad dud khu dang sol khu ltar nag nyil gyis phyir thon/ mchod rten dngas shing dri ma med pa lta bur gyur bar bsams nas las bum thogs me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ hūṃ/gur kum la sogs sbyar ba'i chu/ /dag pa ye shes chu yis khrus gsol bas/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams rab dag nas/ ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i gnas gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa/ de dag sku la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la/ phar phyin drug gi bar (4na〉〉 ltar bya/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ri rab bang rim bzhi pa seng ge'i khri dang bcas pa'i steng du zlo las cho 'phrul mchod rten bang rim bzhi man chad nag po/ bum pa/ bre/ gdugs char khebs tog dang bcas pa rnams dkar po dngas gsal rnyog pa med pa shel ltar 'tsher bar bsam/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba la sogs pa'i nyid khams nas de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams rnam pa cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can kha dog sngon po grangs med pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sam dzaḥ shar phyogs bde gshegs zhing khams grangs med nas/ /rdo rje —/45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rigs kyi mchad rten sngo la 'tsher/ /mchod rten gzhal yas chen po'i shar phyogs su/ /'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra a khyo sa sāts+tsha dzaḥlha baṃ lha zhes lan grangs mang du brjod/ mdun ngos nas thim pas mchod rten de in+d+ra ni la'i mdog ltar sngo zhing 'tsher bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i zhing khams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin cen 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i rin cen rigs rnams rnam pa cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can kha dog ser po grangs med pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza: lho phyogs bde gshegs zhing khams grangs med nas/ /rin chen rigs kyi mchod rten ser la 'tsher/ /mchod rten gzhal yas chen po'i lho phyogs su/ /'gro ba'i don du spyan (4ba 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rat+na saṃ bha wa lha sāts+tsha dzaḥ& baṃ ho:lan grangs mang du brjod/ lho phyogs nas thim pas mchod rten de gser zhun ma'i mdog ltar ser zhing 'tsher bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nub phyogs bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la sogs pa pad+ma'i rigs rnams rnam pa cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can kha dog dmar po grangs med pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza: nub phyogs bde gshegs zhing khams grangs med nas/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi mchod rten dmar la 'tsher/ /mchod rten gzhal yas chen po'i nub phyogs su/ /'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /a mi twa bha hrīḥswats+tsha dzaḥ&:rba hoḥ lan grangs mang du brjod/ nub kyi phyogs nas thim pas mchod rten de pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar dmar zhing 'tsher bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa la sogs pa'i zhing khams nas de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa la sogs pa las kyi rigs rnams rnam pa cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can kha dog ljang gu grangs med pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ byang phyogs bde gshegs zhid khams grangs med nas/ /las kyi rigs kyi mchod rten ljang la 'tsher/ /mchod rten gzhal yas chen po'i byang phyogs su/ /'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /a mo gha sirnyi āḥswats+tsha dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ lan grangs mang du brjod/ byang gi —/46

mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar/ nang ma(kha)phyogs nas thim pas mchod rten mnad kyi mdog ltar ljang zhing 'tsher bar bsam (ldan)rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ steng phyogs 'og min la sogs pa'i zhing khams nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnams rnam pa cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can kha dog dkar po grangs med pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbus phyogs bde gshegs zhing khams grangs med nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dkar la 'tsher/ /mchod rten gzhal ya sa chen po'i dbus phyogs su/ /'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /be+e ro tsa na ā+oṃ sāts+tsha dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: lan grangs mang du brjod/ dbus phyogs nas thim pas mchod rten shel dkar ltar dkar zhing 'tsher bar gyur/ mchad cing bstod pa ni/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa bsham/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rje las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a lha āḥ& nas shasta'i bar/ ā+oṃ rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar brjod/ mchod pa sprin gyi gzungs/ ā+oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra su ra pra ma rda zhe/ ta thā ga tā ya a rta te sa mya kle ba khyu ya/ ta du thā/ ā+oṃ badz+re badz+re/ mahā badz+re/ mahā te dza badz+re/ mahā bi sdi badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bodhi ma'o pa saṃ kum ṇa badz+re sarba ga me ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na (5ba ji dze swāhā/ zhes brlab/ rnyog med dngas shing bsil ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /nogs med dngas shing bsil ba'i 'khas bsil 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /chu skyes thang skyes shing skyes me tog kun/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ khreng sna sman spos bsregs pa'i bdug spos 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /'bru mar rtsi bcud las spar sgron me 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /spos dang dri zhim sbyar ba'i dri chab 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /nas 'bras gro sran sbyar ba'i lha bshos 'di/ /de —/47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /mkhar rnga dung dang cha lang gling bu'i sgra/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga arnya nas sha lta'i bar brjod/ gzugs mdzes gar bsgyur snyan pa'i rol mo 'brol/ /dri zhim spos chu ro brgya bda' ba'i zas/ /'jam mnyen na bza' khyad par ji snyed pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten du 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar brjod/ ri rab lhun po gling bzhi gling phun dang / /rin cen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo tog tshogs/ /rgyal srid bdun dang nye ba'i rin cen bdun/ /gter chen bum pa sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad/ /nyi zla gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun tshogs kun/ /de bzhin (6na)gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra khru ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi mchod rten sngon po ni/ /sgo mang rta babs chos 'khor gdugs dang bcas/ /me long ye shes 'od zer sngon po 'phro/ /zhe sdang rnam rtog ma lus tshar bcad nas/ /dmyal ba'i skye sgo gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho phyogs rin cen yod pa'i zhing khams nas/ /rin cen rigs kyi mchod rten ser po ni/ /sgo mang rta babs chos 'khor gdugs dang bcas/ /rin cen rigs kyi 'od zer ser po 'phro/ /ser sna las gyur rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod/ /yi dwags skye sgo gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nub phyogs snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams nas/ /pad+ma rigs kyi mchod rten dmar po ni/ /sgo mang rta babs chos 'khor gdugs dang bcas/ /pad+ma rigs kyi 'od zer dmar po 'phro/ /'dod chags las gyur rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod/ /mi yi skye sgo gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang phyogs 'brug sgra sgrog pa'i zhing khams nas/ /las kyi rigs kyi mchod rten ljang gu ni/ /sgo mang rta babs chos 'khor gdugs dang bcas/ /las kyi rigs kyi 'od zer ljang gu 'phro/ /phrag dog las gyur rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod/ /byol song skye sgo gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dbus phyogs bde ba chen po'i zhing khams nas/ /de bzhin rigs kyi mchod rten dkar po ni/ /'dus pa chos dbyings 'khor lo spungs —/48—

mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar/ nang ma(kha)pa'i tshe/ /chos 'khor gdugs la dril bu g.yer (6bakhi 'brol/ /de bzhin rigs kyi 'od zer dkar po 'phro/ /gti mug las gyur rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod/ /lha yi skye sgo gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor/dkon cog gsum gyi bden pas bden pa chen po 'di 'grub par gyur cig /ces phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas lan gsum brjod/ de ltar rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi ngo bo byin gyis brlabs pa la dbang bka' rin cen phreng ba ltar gsung sngags sgrib dbang gi lha bsgom du rung ba'i dbang ni/ lha bskyed cing 'dzab bzla dgos pas/ dpal 'bri gung pa chen po chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i lcags sdig nag po'i bca' gzhi rgyas bsdus gnyis ma'i mchod rten gyi las byang ngag sgrigs ma'i skyabs 'gro nas bzung sle ring la ā li kā li dang rten 'brel snying po btags nas bzla ba'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pa yul yangs pa yod na mchod rten la dngos su bskor ba dang med na yid kyis bskor ba bya/ lha bka' don gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ tsakli rnams rim par thogs te/ dkyil 'khor las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du mchod rten gyi lha so so la thim par bsams la/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings la 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' yang / /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i skur sprul te/ /ye shes khro bo tshe bdag nag po ni/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan/ phyogs skyong gshin rje ma he bsnol ba'i steng / /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /g.yas dkar g.yon (7na)dmar dbus mthing nag po'i zhal/ /g.yas pa rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pa be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub 'phyar/ /chos kyi sku la 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dgongs/ /dbyings su sgrol ba'i don gyi dbang thob shog /e ka te dun ya ma snying khrag rā ma tsa ya a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/ bdud mo mthing nag thod 'phreng brgyan/ /yum chen rang byung rgyal mo ni/ /sku mdog yab dang mthun pa la/ /g.yas pas yab kyi mgul nas 'byud/ /g.yon pa dung dmar gtso la stob/ /'khor ba dbyings sgrol dbang thob shog /e ka he dun ma ma trag raka kro ti a bhi khiñca hūṃ/ tshe bdag thugs gar ya ma rā dza ni/ /sku mdog smug nag —149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mchod smug bcag pa 'dra/ /g.yas pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tsit+ta'i phreng ba 'dren pa yis/ /dregs pa dbang du sdud pa'i dbang thob shog /e ka he dun ya ma rā tsa a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ/ya ma'i thugs gar dregs pa phyag rdor ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /g.yas pa gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tsit+ta'i phreng ba smug nag 'dren/ /gnod sbyin dbang du sdud pa'i dbang thob shog /ā+oṃ badzā pā ṇi a sgyi ṣañca hūṃ/ dregs pa'i thugs skar rus sbal khyams khang ni/ /sme ba'i thig le khrag dang dug gis brgyan/ /yan lag bzhi ni shel gyi mchod rten brgyan/ /snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang thob shog /e ka he dun mahā :rka a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/ mkha' lding rgyal po gha ru ḍa/ /gshog g.yu mtshon cha 'khor lor gtams/ /klu gnyan dpa' bo gdug pa gzir/ /bya khyung rgyal po'i (7ba)dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma hā gha ru ḍa a bhi 'i ṣañca hūṃ/ khyung mo smug nag klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul/ /stag ma ro zan btsan dang sa bdag 'dul/ /seng ge dkar mos rig 'dzin las la 'dzud/ /dug sprul nag pos las kyi khrod gtong bzlog /sprul pa gyad gnon dbang mchog thob par shog /e ka mahā gha ru ḍa bya tri ca n+ta sa dha ro he ha la a bhi khiñca hūṃ/ sprul sku bye ba dgu ring dang / /gsung sprul ārla ma ru dang / /ya ma gtum po mgo dgu pa'i/ /mnan bshig bsad las dbang thob shog /e ya ma du sha hūṃ/ ya ma rā ka hūṃ/ ya ma ya ka hūṃ a bhi khiñca hūṃ/ mchod rten yongs rdzogs bang rim dang po la/ /tshe srog kun 'dzin gshed chen bzhi po ni/ /sku mdog mi 'gyur de bzhin rigs dang mthun/ /g.yas pa be con g.yon pa 'khor lo 'dzin/ /dred dang dom dang drel rta rnga mo bcibs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i tshe srog sdud pa dang / /ma mo las la bskul ba'i dbang thob shog /ya ma rā tsa sa do me ya sogs kyi mjug tu a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/ mchod rten yongs rdzogs bang rim gnyis pa la/ /tshe bdag las mgon mon pa bzhi po ni/ /dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo can dang / /lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo can dang / /bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo can dang / /gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo can bzhi/ /g.yas pa gri gug g.yon pa tsit+ta za/ /ru dra rdul du brlag pa'i dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma mo n+ta a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/ mchod rten yongs —/5(/

mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar/ nang ma(khanardzogs bang rim gsum pa la/ /tshe bdag nag po phyi yi gshed bzhi ni/ /he le khyab byed so 'dar 'khrigs pa dang / /(8na skog po 'dzum med ral pa char dgu bzhi/ /sku mdog mi 'gyur de bzhin rigs dang mthun/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na gcod pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon pa 'joms byed be con bar snang 'phyar/ /dgra bgegs phung po gzhom pa'i dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma bdud tre kā la a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/mchod rten yongs rdzogs bang rim bzhi pa la/ /tshe bdag las mkhan 'chi bdag bcu gnyis ni/ sku mdog ma nges so sor gsal ba la/ /g.yas pa 'khor lo g.yon pa be con 'dzin/ /ru dra'i tshe srog sdud ba'i dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma kriṣ+ṭha dza ma ri ya ma da rma a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ/ mchod rten yongs rdzogs ri rab sgo bzhi la/ /dkar po snying 'byin mgon po nag po dang / /yab rje nag po sku mchog dmar po bzhi/ /g.yas pas 'khor lo g.yon pa dgra sta 'phyar/ /lta spyod tshad med bzhi yi don rtogs nas/ /lha tshogs las la bskul ba'i dbang thob shog /dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ.asti khiñca hūṃ/ thugs bum pa'i dbang ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa btegs/ hūṃ/ snang stong gnyis med rnam rgyal bum pa ni/ kha rgyan nam mkha' 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /zhabs rgyan sa gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad yin/ /bar gyi yon tan bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'phros/ /bum pa rnam dag gzhal yas dbang bskur bas/ /mi rtog chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang thob shog /bum pa'i dar dpyangs las 'od gsal spro bsdu cod pan gyi dbang ni/ cod pan lha grangs dang mnyam pa gsar du 'dogs pa'am sngar nas btags zin pa'i dbang du byas na 'jug pa bde (8ba)bas de la dmigs te cod pan thogs la/ hūṃ/ cod pan rin cen lha yi dar dpyangs 'di/ /nas 'bras 'bru yi phreng brgyus nas/ /theg pa rim dgu 'dzeg pa'i rtags/ /'di la dar gyi 'phur lce 'phro ba ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa 'bul ba'i rtags/ /rin cen cod pan 'di yi dbang bskur bas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sal bgrod par shog /cod pan gdags tshul bya/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bshags pa bya/ rdul tshon yin na gshegs gsol/ ras bris yin na tsakli dang lhan du brtan bzhugs/ /mjug tu smon lam shis brjod sogs byas te las kyi rjes mi mngon par —151—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bsdu/ mchod rten la brtan bzhugs kyi sgrub pa zhag gsum bya ba ni/ mye ring gi raka mo n+ta'i mjug tu su pra tiṣ+ṭha btags nas thun bzhi'am drug tu bcad nas ci nus bzla zhing thun mthar yang rak+ta mo n+ta'i mtshams su rten 'brel snying po btags pa nyer gcig tsam bzla zhing / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa zhes sogs dang bcas me tog mthor ba ni mchod rten dam ye dbyer med nus ldan du bya ba'i rab gnas kyi man ngag go /bdag mdun la tshogs mchod 'bul zhing bdag bskyed kyi 'jug chog spyi ltar bya'o/ /bcas chog mchod rten yod ces snyan pa'i rnga/ /phyogs bral rna lung mdzes byed ches mang yang /byin rlabs nus ldan rab tu gnas pa'i thabs/ khrigs pa'i sngags 'chang nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /gdams pa'i man ngag tshang ba mthong ba dkon/ /mthong yang yig nag thug phrad 'jog pa mang / shes par (9na)rlom yang 'khrugs sdeb gnad la rmongs/ /snga 'gyur bstan yang ming btags tsam du zad/ /skye sprul ming gis dka' ba'i gnad mi rtogs/ /rigs rus tsam gyis mthu nus ga la zhig /'chal spyod chang bzi grub thob zhig po min/ /ngur smrig mdzes kyang gzhan snang bsgyur thabs tsam/ /ri mgo kha bas gtums la te se zhes/ /grags skam tsam min don ldan rig sngags 'chang / /'bri gung dbur smyon zur chen pad+ma dbang / /drin las smra ba'i gdengs tshad cung zad rnyed/ /gter gzhung dngos don rang bzos ma bslad cing / /dam pa'i phyag bzhes lung rigs dang 'brel ba'i/ /mchod rten rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi/ /rab 'bar yid srubs mun pa pha mthar bskrad/ /dge des 'jam dpal chos sku bde chen klong / /rang rig longs sku phyag rgya zil gnon du/ /bzhedas te sna tshogs sprul skus mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bdag 'gyur shog /ces 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten bcas chog gi rab gnas byin rlabs nyi ma'i gzi 'bar zhes bya ba 'di ni me 'brug lo mchod rten gsar bzhengs kyi tshe gal po cher mthong nas dbang bka' rin cen 'phreng ba'i lha dbang gi tshig 'ga' zhig ma rnyed pa mu tig phreng ba sogs nas bkang ste za hor gyi sngags 'chang zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa —152

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa'i reg zig zhib mo rnam dag nang ma(kha)ni gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no// // sarba maṅga lo// //'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa'i reg zig zhib mo rnam dag bzhugs/ /deng nas byang chen bar gyi skyabs gag pu/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo 'khor 'das phyag rgya kun/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gar/ /snying dbus pad mtshor rtag tu rol bar mdzod/ /de'ang 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i drag po zor gyi las sbyor lag tu blang thabs la/ rjod byed kyi tshig nyung zhing brjod bya'i don gsal ba'i brjod byang gi rim pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ sngon 'gro la/ dang por sngags pa bsnyen rdzogs pas/ /zhing chen gdan la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /'bru nag lha grangs tshom bu dgod/ /mchod bshags bskang bzlog bsad gtor ram/ /dmar gyi gtor ma chen po bsham/ /sman phud rak+ta mchod pas bskor/ /lha rten tsa ka li yis brgyan/ /ri rab rtsang dmar mtshe yungs gzug /bzlog byang mang pos mtha' yang bskor/ khrag kong gtor ma lo tshad bsham/ /zhes pa'i don ltar dkyil 'khor dang rdzas dang yo byad ji lta ba bshams par rang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'dri ba chog sgrigs nyung ngu rnam gsal las shes par bya/ 'bring dud 'gro'i g.yang gzhi'i steng du ras bris kyi bzlog dkyil la tshom bu gong bzhin bkod pa/ tha ma rdul tshon dang ras bris gnyis ka (2na)ma 'byor na ma tre gyi dod g.yang gzhis go bcad pa'i steng du tshom bu dgod/ de'i steng du drag po'i shing gi khri'u gru gsum mi mgo'i tog can srid pa lugs 'byung gi gtor stegs sam yang na lcags kyi malji'i khar lcags slang bug rdol med pa'i nang du ri rab lcags mkhar mar lcags sdig lugs kyi lha grangs bkod pa/ yang na gtor ma'i dbus su gshin rje'i zhal phyung bar spyan shangs tsam ma gtogs gzhan ma gtor ma'i dbyibs ma zhig pa legs zhes rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po gsung —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nazhing nub dgon phyogs su dbu rgyan/ snyan dang / snyan rgyan/ zhal rgya sogs yod pa zhal 'bag lta bu'i spros pa can gyi srol ltar yol mo gter ston bstan 'dzin nor bus skabs 'gar phyag bzo mdzad pa gang byas kyang mi 'gal bar sems mod/ 'on kyang snga ma nyid la gtso bor bzhed/ 'di la 'khor drug dang gtso tsaka tsam ma gtogs mi 'dzugs pa dar so che yang 'og gi tshom bu'i grangs dang bstun pa'i 'khor dang tsaka li btsugs na legs zhes zur kun mkhyen chen po gsung ba lha sten tsaka li yis brgyan zhes pa dang mthun pas rgyas par spro na 'di nyid legs shing spros pa chung bar 'dod na snga ma byas kyang skyon du mi (2ba)'gyur bar sems/ dmar smug byu ru'i tshal du slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i gzigs snang gtor mar grags pa deng sang sgrub gtor du ngos 'dzin pas lcags mkhar zur drug pa 'khor drug mthar lcags mkhar bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba mdog dang zur gyi khyad par gyis mi 'dra ba ste gsum po gang la yang mtshe yungs rtsang rgyu ma tsaka li gtor gdugs sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bya/ zab gnad stong srog 'khor lo la brten pa'i srung 'khor dang 'khor ling 'dug pa'i dam pa'i gsung rgyun yod pa zhal las 'dri/ de ltar gtor ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba bsham/ gtor chen gyi 'og tu ma sdig bteg pa'i zor kong gcig /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du rab sbyin bdag gi lo grangs sam ma 'grub na grangs nyer gcig tsam ji ltar rigs pa rgyu drag po'i sa sna las grub par g.yas su mda' khra/ g.yon du 'phang khra/ rgyab tu rtsang / mdun du dpal 'bar sogs 'char ga'i gzhung nas 'byung ba'i rdzas rnams tshang bar blug /logs gsum du khrag gis bh+yo bzlog rbad 'dri/ tshon skud sna lngas rked rnams sbrel/ g.yas su dur khrod kyi rdo nag gam mi bsad pa'i rbad rdo bya sgong tsam pa drug la gong bzhin yi ge bris pa/ g.yon du tshon skud lnga las grub pa'i sgu do/ /mi lpags kyi mthil dang yugs skra'i ljags can g.yas su skyer pa'i mda' la 'ug pa'am 'ug srin khra gsum gyi sgro bskyon pa gri lcags kyi mde'u rtser khrag bsnyugs pa/ logs la sngags phreng khrag gis bris pa drug /g.yon du zor gzhu/ g.yas su drag po'i sa sna la bzos pa'i —/54

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa'i reg rig zhib mo rnam dag nang ma(khanadabyibs zur gsum la (3na)gang bu btsugs pa drug /g.yon du drag po'i sa sna las grub pa'i kong bu zur gsum khrag sna thun rdzas kyis bkang ba drug /mdun du khri'u lta bu stegs kyi khar rwa zor gzhud bzhin bcas la/ thod tshal du thun khrag gu gul sogs byin rlabs kyi rdzas/ dmar gtor/ phyogs gtore bzhi rnams bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i zur bzhir khrag chang gis gtams pa'i snod re/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog nas g.yas skor du rtsa thig brgyad kyi rtse mo dang bstun khrag gis a lha dang zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog tan chen gyi sbyar spos/ tshil rkang gi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/sha rus bsres pa'i bshos bu gru gsum dmar nag rnams dang rgyas par spro na phyi mchod tshar gcig bkod/ shar du mchod pa/ lhor bshags pa/ nub tu bkang ba/ byang du bzlog pa rnams kyi gtor ma/ ka pā la'i snod du chos sman/ sha chen ka ra/ bu ram dang sbyar ba'i mdangs skongs tshang ba'i baṃ mdun/ gzhan yang nub re bzhin gtong rgyu'i bzlog pa'i thun gtor 'khor drug pa khrag yungs kyis brgyan pa dang /gser skyems/ mchod bstod gsal sgron gyi gtor ma dang khrag skyems/ bzlog gzhung gi zhal stob gtor chung gcig /sman raka dang bcas pa rtsa gsum gtor ma nyer mkho rnams tshang bar bshams/ bzlog dkyil gyi rgyab tu bstegs bang rim can gyi steng ma'i dbus su tshe bdag sgrub gtor g.yas g.yon du bla ma dang yi dam gyi rigs kyi gtor ma/ bang rim gnyis pa'i dbus su tshe bdag gi mchod gtor/de'i g.yas su chos skyong pho rgyud kyi rigs dang g.yon la mo rgyud/ bang rim gsum pa'i dbus su dpal mgon stag zhen gtso 'khor/ (3ba)g.yas su rdo rje rgya gram dkar po'i steng du g.yung bu'i rtse lha dang klu bdud gnyis kyi gtor ma dkar gsum dngar gsum klu sman sbran pa/ g.yon du rdo rje rgya gram dmar po'i steng du yer pa'i rdzong btsan dang lha sa'i bdud btsan gnyis kyi gtor ma/ mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa sbreng tshar/ g.yas su bdud/ g.yon du rak+ṣa rnams dgod/ de yang gnas khang khos su phebs pa byung na rdo rje slob dpon zhal lho dang mdun bskyed byang gzigs dgos shing rlung rgyug bde ba sogs kyis rdul tshon 'khyer ba lta bu'i skyon du 'gyur na zhal phyogs skabs su gang babs dang —155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nago yul dog pa'i sar slob dpon dang phyogs mthun par bzlog dkyil gyi zhal yang gtod srol yod cing ting nge 'dzin gtso che bas skyon du mi 'gyur la rten gtor sogs bsgrig lugs kyang gtor gzhi yod pa dang sgrub mchod gzhan dang rim gyis mu 'thud lta bu'i yi dam chos skyong gi gtor tshogs rgya cher bsham pa'i skams la dgod lugs cung zad ma 'grig kyang dus gnas dang bstun no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bgegs gtor slob dpon la kha bstan par chab sbran/ bgegs sgrod kyi rol dbyangs par slob dpon gyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gnod byed gdon bshegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra a byu sha dzaḥs bkug /gtor mar dmigs nas raṃ las ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ yaṃ las chos nyid kyi rlung gis gtor/ khe las mtshan med kyi chus bkrus/hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma rang rang gi dbang po rnams tshim par byed pa'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis (4na)byin gyis brlab/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khe zhes sogs kyis bskor zhing lan gsum gyis bsngo/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag dang bcas/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po rnams kyi bden pa dang / chos nyid ye nas dag kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can chos skyong srung ma rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag gi lha sngags ye shes kyi rol ba'i mthu la brten nas nag phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba lan chags dang gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs nam mkha' la 'phyo ba/ bar snang la rgyu ba/ sa gzhi la 'grim pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa/ skyob grib la gab pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub pa chen po mthong thos mi bzod pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la byams pa'i sems kyi so so rang rang gi gnas dang rten la dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo sprin rab 'byams kyis ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas phye mar brlag par 'gyur ro/ // bha'i dus yungs gar gyis —156

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa'i reg zig zhib mo rnam dag nang ma(khanabrab/ gu gul gyis bdug /snod la bshal chu gtor/ byin 'bebs la rdo rje slob dpon gyi g.yab dar dang las kyi rdo rjes zhwa gyon/ spos phor dang bcas bdag cag ma nas spos bskor zhing sngags tshig bshug pa'i tsha bshug ring lan gsum byed/ tshig rdzogs khamatshams su zhwa phud phyag gsum bya/ sman phud byin rlabs kyi tshe (4ba〉sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i dang po'i gdangs dang bstun 'phyar zhing lan gsum g.yas skor du dkrug /sngags rjes ma gnyis la'ang 'gro/ rten gtor gyi tshe/ sgrub gtor/bzlog gtor/ thun gtor yum la bdud rtsi sbran/ mchod gtor gyi tshe mchod gtor dang gtor ma gzhan rnams la bdud rtsi sbran/ rak+ta'i tshe g.yon du bskor ba tsam ma gtogs bdud rtsi dang mtshungs/a ka ba la'i tshe phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams la bdud rtsi 'thor/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyis g.yab dar dang las kyi rdo rje'i byed lugs byin 'bebs ltar la khyad par khams gsum ma nas zhwa phud/ phyi mchod kyi tshe phyi'i mar me sbar/ sman phud kyi tshe slob dpon dang las kyi rdo rje gnyi gas 'thor zhing las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon gyi khyer bar bdud rtsi blugs pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te gnas gsum du reg cing myang / las kyi rdo rjes gsang nan gyi tshe spro na skyogs kyis sgrub gtor dang bzlog gtor la bdud rtsi sbreng / rak+ta'i tshe slob dpon gnyis gas 'thor/ dur khrod kyi nang mchod kyi tshe nang gi zhun me sbar/ thun rdzas sngon nas bsgrub dgos shing med na 'theb chag sgrub pa'i ched du thun sngags kyang kha yar bzlas nas thun bskor/ rwa zor bsgrub pa'i tshe zor sngags gang mang bzla zhing kong zor sogs zor gzhan rnams kyang zor gyi tshig dang mthun par gsal 'debs shing pho rgyud mo rgyud kyi tshogs bstim pa sogs nus 'don gyi dmigs pa bya/ tshogs kyi tshe spyir 'bul ba dang bstun las kyi rdo rjes tshogs nas gtor ma phyi nang thams cad du sbyon pa zhig 'dug na'ang tshogs chas sna tshogs (5na sgod na gtor ma chud za ba'i rgyur song dog pas bla ma/ yi dam spyi/ bye brag tu tshe bdag /chos skyong spyi/ bye brag dmar zor ma/ stag zhen/ mthu chen sdebazhi/ gnam phud gcig dang bcas snod brgyad du bsham zhing sgos mgron mang ba yod na rig pas dpyad pa'i tsam dgos bstar zhing bsdu na bla ma yi dam —/57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)chos skyong rnams la spyir gcig /tshe bdag chos skyong gter srung dang bcas par gcig /gnam phud gcig ste gsum tsam gyis mtshon spel lugs rig pas dpyod/ bdud rtsi sbran nas dbul/ gong gi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zan dang sman phud sbran te thal mo sbyar nas bshags pa bya/ tshogs tha ma'i liṅka'i khar sman phud ma sbran gong gi tshogs sha dum zhig bzhag par rak+ta spron cing hūṃ zhes slob dpon gyis rdo rje snying gar reg pa'i rkyen gyis rak+ta'i lha mo thugs gar ba spu zhal stob zin nas ling ro dum re bzlog gtor dang sgrub gtor la sbyon/ dum cig lhag mar spungs rgyu'i thebs su bzhag /gzhan ma'i dum bu dmangs rnams phud chang dang bsres nas bzlog byang gi skabs su 'debs rgyur 'jog /de nas baṃ gyi sman raka gso zhing mar me sbar nas baṃ skongs gtong / rtsa gsum gyi bskang gso'i mjug tu gnam phud 'thong/ sang nyin gtor ma 'phen rgyu'i 'dzab mjug tu zor skor gyi tshe rdo rje slob dpon nas dkyil 'khor bar gyi g.yas g.yon gyi gral gnyis bar ma chad par bsgrigs/ de nas bzlog pa g.yu spyang gi thal brdab dang pa'i tshe phyogs gtor nas 'go brtsams kong zor/ rdo zor/ mda' gzhu/ khrag thor/yungs zor/ rwa zor/ de'i rdzas skam thun rlon thun/ thun gtor ram bzlog gtor rnams g.yas kyi tha (5ba)ma nas lag gnyis su re re gtad pa thogs te phye ring la bzlog pa g.yu spyang btags pa dang zor sngags tshar re bzla ba song nas phyag rgya gar pad dang bcas gdeng ba'i stang ka byas nas phu btab ste rim bzhin shugs pa g.yon gral gyi mthar thun gtor ma slebs par bya/ kong zor rnams 'di nas bzung zur phyi la bstad nas bsgrig /thog tu zor lam dbye skabs/ raṃ yaṃ kho gis gser skyems kyi ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gser gyi mchod pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sde brgyad yul lha bzhi bdag rigs drug gi sems can dang bcas pa'i yar gnas kyi thugs dam skong zhing mar gnas rnams kyi dbang po tshim pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ zhes slob dpon gyis rol mo'i ring brlab/ gser skyems kyi gdangs byed ring shub bus gser gyi mchod pa 'dod —/58

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa'i reg zig zhib mo rnam dag nang ma(khanapa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas deng 'dir srung bzlog bsad mnan sreg 'phang sogs mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las da lta nyid du 'grub pa'i mthu dpung bskyed cing stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil mnon gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /'og ma kun la 'gre/ mahā kā la phyag bzhi drug /gur mgon rnam sras sku kha bzhi pa sogs dregs pa pho rgyud kyi srung ma/ dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba can/ 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī sngags srung e (6na〉ka dz+nyā ṭi sogs dregs pa mo rgyud kyi srung ma/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po sogs dregs pa gnyis med kyi srung ma rnams la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ khyad par las gshin khro chu dug sdong / 'chi bdag 'char ka nag po/ gshin rje gi gang dmar nag /dpal mgon stag zhen nag po/ lha chen khyab 'jug rā hu la/ gter srung mthu chen sde bzhi rnams la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po ral pa tshar dgu/ yum gtum mo dug hrul ma/ bka' nyan pho brgyad mo brgyad/ 'khor snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ mngag gzhug bran g.yog dang bcas pa rnams la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /bye brag tu'ang steng gi nam mkha' la rgyu ba gza' dang rgyu skar/ bar snang la 'phyo ba gnyan rigs sdo bzhi/ sa gzhi la dbang ba sa bdag rdze blon/ lo zla zhag dus tshes grangs dus tshod la dbang pa'i lha klu 'byung po/ srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu rje'i mgur lha/ 'bangs kyi srog lha/ bstan ma bcu gnyis yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di dag gi yul lha gzhi bdag /mdor na sgo skas lam 'phrang la gnas pa'i mi ma yin rnams la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /lan chags dang bu lon thams cad byang zhing 'khor bar gyur cig /gzhan ma dgra dmigs bsal la de'i lha srung la bsngo ba sogs rig pas 'phrul shes pa byed/ gser skyems btang rjes lhag nas lha'i nga rgyal gyis cung zad myangs pa'i lhag ma nas gtor ma dang tshogs lhag ma sbran/ srid pa hur caka li'i rgyab yig bsgrags/ gtor ma zor lam phyogs su btang —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2naba'i rjes su (6ba)sor mo bzhi nang bsdams kha phye zhing mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ba'i phyag rgya bstan/ sgo dbye'i phyogs gtor rnams sgo so so'i tshig rdzogs mtshams su 'phen cing steng gi lha la zor mi 'phen zhes pa'i dus gser skyems 'thor/ gtor ma rgyag nyin/ da ni bzlog pa'i dus la bab ces pa'i tshe bzlog gtor phyir zhal bsgyur/ sman rag gtor tshig dang bstun nas 'bul ba'i gtor ma zur du mi dgos par mchod bshags bkang bzlog rnams kyi gtor ma sgran/ gtor chen bteg pa'i thul du bam skongs bkod/ phyi rol tu lhag ma rnams zor snar gtong / zor phyogs bzhin 'phen pa'i stang ka tsam ma gtogs thebs phyogs su 'phen/ kong zor log na gnas la 'bebs/ rwa zor thebs chen dang brdung thebs g.yas g.yon gnyis po gang rung ma byung na gnad 'bebs lan gnyis kyi bar bskyar/ des kyang ma byung na gnad 'bebs kyi sngags bzlas te 'phen/ des kyang ma song na chags che ba'i rtags yin pas mi skyor bar slar sgrub pa byed/ bro brdung ba'i tshe/ lag g.yon steng du byas pa' gral zlum por bskor/ de phyir glu bro rgyun mi chad ces pa'i bar g.yo 'gul med par bsdad/ rkang pa g.yas kyis bro brdungs pas zhes pa'i dus thams cad kyis g.yas bteg g.yon gyi dus su g.yon/ gnyis su med pa'i dus gnyis gas gnon tshul bya/ slob dpon gyis mnan pa g.yu spyang shub 'don dang / dmangs mas sum+bha tshar gcig gi rjes su g.yas skor du zhi ba'i gsol byang / de bzhin du g.yon skor du nga dang drag po/ g.yas su sum+bha dang dbang / g.yon du sa dang rgyas pa (7na)gsum rjes ni bsdu chog gi tshe/ rdul tshon yin na dbang ldan nas brtsams te dbus su then la rdul tshon bsdu zhing thig shul dbye/ ras bris yin na tshol bu 'jig gnam gang gi nyin long che ba yod na nyer dgu'i nub tshe 'gugs dang rtsa gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul zhing chad mtho gtong ba sogs dkyus bzhin byed/ nang par 'phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba nas rgyun 'dzab/ bstod pa/ rgyan gyi lha brgyad yan gyi bskul/ tshogs nas rtsa gsum gyi bar btang /thugs sgrub kyi chad mthos chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams bskul bar sman raka sbran slob dpon gyis 'phrin las gzhol/ thog tu bsgrigs par sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug lta bsangs ltar bya/ gser —/6()

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas pa 'i reg zig zhib mo rnam dag nang ra/kholanaskyems/ lhag ma chad mtho btang ste gtor ma zhal nang du bstan nas phud/ bshal chus bstan ma bskyang / sgrub khang 'og nas gtang rag man 'dra gong 'og gi gtor ma phyir 'bul ba thams cad la 'dod gsol rgyas par bya zhes pa bka' brgyad rang byung dang rang shar gyi nang gtor nas byung ba/ rol mo'i ring slob dpon gyis hūṃ/ ka pā la yi snod nang du/ /zhal zas sna tshogs gtor ma'i rgyu/ /bdud rtsi rnam lnga gtor ma'i rgyan/ /'bru gsum sngags kyis byin brlabs nas/ /mi mnyes pa ni gang yang med/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig /yi dam thugs dam stong gyur cig /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /tshad re da gtor ma 'di bsngos pas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad la/ /longs spyod ldan zhing tshogs rdzogs nas/ /thams cad myur du sangs rgyas shog /ces gtor ma lag pas btegs la 'bul/ de nas 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ ho/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad (7ba)kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ log par lta ba thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/bar gcod dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ rkyen dang dus min 'chi ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ zhes dang / ga skun yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe brtan pa dang mdo sngags kyi sde dang bshad sgrub 'phel ba dang rgyal po chen po rnams kyis sa chen po byams pas skyong zhing 'jig rten kun bde zhing skyid pa/ khyad par sngags 'chang sgrub pa po sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa ma lus pa phyir bzlog cing rdul du rlog pa dang bdag sogs rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang dang lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa sogs khyab bdag kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu rigs pas dpyad de sbyar/gtor ma 'phen khar/ bstan 'gro yongs la 'tshe ba spyi'i dgra/ yang sgos rigs 'dzin bdag cag rgyu —16/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod par byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bo mi nor sde dpung dang bcas pa 'di rnams 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje snang srid sde brgyad dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi zas skal du gtad pa yin pas bla khug /srog chod/ dbugs long / sha zo/ khrag 'thung / rus pa mur/ pags pa gos su gyon/ tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang longs spyod mi nor phyugs gsum sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams thal ba'i (8na)rdul bran bzhin du rlog la/ ming dang brda dang tha snyad tsam du yang sgra mi grag par rjes med thal ba rlung la bskur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces dang / bgegs la gtso bor byed na/ bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog cing bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus la na tsha/ sems la sdug bsngal/ srog la hur thums/ bsam pa la bar chad gtong bar byed pa'i 'byung po che ge 'di'i lusang ga yid gsum mthu stobs nus pa thams cad thal pa'i rdul du zhes sogs rig pas sbyar ba'i drag sngags dmod pa'i mtshon char dbab bo/ phra mo'i gnad la pha mtha' chod dka' zhing / /rtogs par sla rnams dpyod par ma shes sogs/ / nongs pa mthong bas mang por legs 'gro ste/ /zhib mor dpyad 'di snod ldan tsho gos la spel/ /zhes 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang zor las dang bcas par nye bar mkho ba'i brjod byang gi reg zig zhib mo rnam dag 'di ni gong ma'i gsung rgyun rjes 'brang du mar dpyad pa dang rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku'i zin tho gtso bor gzung rang blos gang spobs kyi 'thad pa sgrubs te za hor gyi sngags smyon bhu su ku pas shing stag cho 'phrul gyi dus chen la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis shing las byang ma bu bzhi po bka' dam par ma zad reg zig 'di nyid shin tu gces par 'dzin dgos pa gter srung rnams kyi bya ra mdzod cig/ // gu ༅ sa ma ya //—/62

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khana'ajam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las mtha' yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje'i pha lam zhes bya ba bsdo kyigs rbesna/ /dpal ldan gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam rol can/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub la/ /gus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ /de la 'dir khro bo'i dbang po dus kyi dgra chen po'i las tshogs/ phyi skor lcags 'dra/ gsang skor gnam lcags thog me'i skor gsum gyi nang tshan du mi gtogs pa'i/ ga rjes pa brgyad dang ldan pa 'di/ /kun la yod na ngo mtshar chung / /zhes gnubs ban gyi che ba brgyad ldan gyi man ngag /dum pa zhang khrom gyis lho brag mkho mthing lha khang nas bzhes pa'i zab gter yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i 'phrin las ngag 'don go rim bzhin 'khyer bde ba brjod par bya'o/ /deng sang tshe bdag gsum gyi rnam dbye tsam yang mi shes pa'i 'di kho nas tshe bdag mkhan por rlom pa mang du mchis kyang / mnan bsreg 'phang gsum sogs 'di'i lag len dbyis phyin par lugs gzhan rnams la bltos dgos shing / rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa yab sras kyi bka' srol dri ma med pa kho bo'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i lugs 'di la/ tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi (2na'i bang bzhi thob cing / dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las sngon du 'gro ba zhig gis nyams su len pa'i phyag bzhes yod pas/ 'di 'phrin las thun slong ma yin pa rnams ma gtogs/ thun mong ba rnams las byang gnam lcags 'bor lo ltar 'dri bar bya'o/ /de la thog mar skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus kun/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /rgya chen byang chub mchog tu sems mchog bskyed/ /tshogs zhing ni/ mdun du rin chen khri pad nyi zla'i steng / /bcom ldan phyag rgya —163—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zil gnon cod pan du/ /kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa la/ /yi dam ye shes gnyis su med par gyur/ /ji snyed yid kyi lha lam rab yangs par/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs shing / /thugs rje'i char gyis sdig lhung dri ma 'brud/ /dge tshogs byang chub 'bras bu rgyas gyur cig /phyi nang gi mchod rdzas byin gyi brlab pa ni/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ /ye shes 'byung gsum dag gis sa bon rnams/ /phyogs bcur 'phros pas sman raka gtor gsum gyi/ /ma dag skyon sbyangs zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ ā+oṃ (2ba)āḥ& ma hā pañca a mra ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ ma hā bha kla ta/ma hā rak+ta hūṃ 1ṭha/ srung 'khor lha dang bcas par bskyed pa ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu 〉 sarba dharma su bhā wa shu rtse3 lha/chos rnams ma lus stong pa nyid du gyur/ dharma dha tu āḥgrangs med lus can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i slad/ bo dhi tsit+ta hūṃ/ rang sems gdod ma'i mgon po hūṃ yig mthing / /de las 'phros pa'i raṃ yaṃ zhe gsum gyis/ /dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor sbyangs dkyus ngang nyid las/ /hūṃ las e yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo rnams ni/ /rim gyur nam mkha' rlung me chu sa lnga/ /brtsegs steng : dkar 'od zer lnga ldan dang / /dbyangs gsal ngo bo rdo rje'i pha lam can/ /byang chub mchod rten gdan khri bang rim gsum/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi pa bum pa bre/ /chos 'khor gdugs tag nyi zla nor bur bcas/ /'od zer kun khyab stong gsum khengs par gyur/ /bum nang hūṃ las gser gyi rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram dra mig rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'khol/ /lte ba ga'u kha sbyor lta bu'i dbus/ /pad nyi'i steng du shel rdor rtse lnga pa/ /rwa bcu 'od zer lngas mtshan lte bar hūṃ/ /de las 'od 'phros ya ma ti ra baṃ/ /zhes pa'i 'phro 'dus gshin rje ma he zung / /nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /dhu yig hūṃ nag 'phro 'dus gnam lcags kyi/ /rdo rje rtse dgu hūṃ yig mthing khas mtshan/ /'od zer rab 'phros sngags kyi rnam par gyur/ /ā+oṃ akro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags 'phreng yongs gyur rang nyid skad cig gis/ khro rgyal kun kyang skrag byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon sku/ /rab khros mthing nag dug chen 'khyil 'dra'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bsgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mun lta'i (3na)rtsa ba'i 'kha/ /phyag —164

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanadrug 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje 'phen/ /lcags kyu gtun shing sdigs mdzub me dpung 'phro/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul gyis bzhugs/ /lha lam khyab pa'i rdo rje'i gshog pa sogs/ /dpal gyi chas brgyad dur khrod rgyan rnams kun/ /bkod legs bgrang yas 'phyang 'phrul legs spud cing / /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur can/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /thugs kar dra las gser 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i steng / /'jam dpal ser po phyag g.yas ral gri dang / /g.yon pa'i mtheb srin thugs dar ut+pa la'i/ /yu ba nas 'dzin 'dab ma snyan gyi thad/ /rab rgyas steng na sher phyir glegs bam can/ /mi phyed skyil spung rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhi zhing 'dzum ldan ral pa'i zur phud can/ /srung ba'i tshul gyis bzhi ga'ang zhal nang gzigs/ /'khor lo'i lte bar pad nyi zla steng du/ /sna tshogs rin chen mchod rten bum par yang / /sum rtsegs gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje ser/ /yar gyi rwa lnga bde gshegs rigs lnga yab/ /mar lnga yum gyis legs par mtshan pa yi/ /lte bar dbyangs gsal zhu ba'i nyi zla'i gur/ kha sbyar rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ yig nang / /bsrung byar bcas pa bsrung ba'i sngags 'khor dang / /ā li g.yas dang kā li g.yon skor gyur/ /khyung nag rdo rje'i mchu la nyi zla'i spyan/ /gnam lcags rwa ster spu gri'i sgro gshog dang / /spu phran mtshon cha khyung nag rdo rjes gtams/ /dkar nag sbrul za spyi bo'i gtsug tu lding / /thugs rka'i 'od zer rtse la bh+yo smug nag /'phro 'du yongs gyur nag mo khrag mig ma/ /skrug (3bskog gcer bu rgyan med 'jigs gzugs can/ /zhal gcig phyag g.yas lcags kyu mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thugs gar ban+ta khrag gang 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs ma mo bye bas bskor/ /slar yang thugs ga'i 'od zer rtse la ya/ /dmar nag yongs gyur ya ma rā tsa ni/ /zhal ba ṇi ga phyag gnyis g.yas pa ral gri dang / /g.yon pa tsit+ta 'drad cing zhing chen gsol/ /zhabs gnyis sar brdeb sdebargyad yongs kyis bskor/ /gnyis pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /thugs nas re spros hūṃ bh+yo khro khro mos/ /srung ba'i gur rnams bar mtshams med par gtams/ /mchod rten phyi rol : las gser ga'u'i/ /nang bzhugs de nas phyi rol rim pa bzhin/ /hūṃ snya ra ṇa phaṭa/ khro sngon —/65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rdo rje thogs pa rdo rje'i gur/ /ā+oṃ snya ra ṇa phaṭa/ khro dkar 'khor lo thogs pa 'khor lo'i gur/ /tra ma snya ra ṇa phaṭa: khro ser nor bu thogs pa nor bu'i gur/ /myi s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: khro dmar pad+ma thogs pa pad+ma'i gur/ /āḥsla ra ṇa phaṭa: khro bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pas gtams/ /tik+ta g.yon phyogs drag 'khor ral gro'i 'khor lo yis/ /gnod byed ma lus phyi mar btubs pa 'a gur/ /yaṃ snya ra ṇa phaṭa: khro baṃ rlung g.yab thogs pa rlung gi gur/ /raṃ dza la maṇ+ḍal phaṭa: khro dmar me dpung thogs pa me 'bar gur/ /baṃ tik+ṣa maṇ+ḍalaḥ khro dkar chu zhags thogs pa chu zhakhrug gung / /lo tik+ta maṇ+ḍal: rgya gram nang kun khro ser ri thogs gur/ /e maṇ+ḍal: nam mkha' lcags gur nang du khro bo nag /sna tshogs mtsho ni cha char ltar 'bebs pa'i gur/ /kun kyang sra mkhregs ser bu'i rlung tsam yang / /mi thar rdo rje spu gri reg gcod rlung / /me dpung (4nad+ku gri mtshon cha 'khor lo sogs/ /las ma drag po'i 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba'i rdul du gyur/ /rang sngags dbyangs gas pa 'phreng gas dgra bgegasakun/ /sod ces stong nyid rang sgra sgrog pa'i gur/ /thun phur las gshin dmar nag zhal gcig la/ /phyag g.yas be con brdeg tshul g.yon thun thag /'dzin pas dgra bgegs don snying 'drad tshul can/ /stag lpags sham thabs zha khas gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ spros bral bde chen chos dbyings lha lam las/ /gzugs sku phyag rgya zil gnon chu 'dzin che/ /rtse gcig gdung ba'i dbyar dus na chung dang / /snyan tshig rlung gi bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni/ grangs med ye shes lha yi gru char tshogs/ /'gyur med thugs rjes dus las ma g.yel bar/ /dam tshig rten gyi zla ba'i ma ma la/ /ting 'dzin sngags kyis mdza' ba'i lcugs mar gyur/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e phya hi dza:྅ baṃ ho/ 'jig rten dregs pa ma he lhun po'i steng / /pad nyi rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ /'jam dpal gshin rje mchod sbyin brgya pa gang / /'gyur med rdo rje lta bur rtag bzhugs gsol/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e phya lha dza:྅ baṃ ho/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ phyag bya ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis nus mthu'i 'phrul/ /gcig —166

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanabasdus khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yi/ /drag po e yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e gye hi dza:྅ baṃ ho/ a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza ho: nang gi mchod pa ni/ myong grol dam rdzas dang sbyar a mṛ ta/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byin brlabs 'di/ /rtsa (4ba7rgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tsho gos dang bcas la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e gye hi dza:྅ baṃ ho/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta khā raṃ ji hi/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ ā+oṃ āḥ&/ slar yang rigs 'dzin smra ba'i 'bab stegs khar/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myang ba yi/ /zil gnon sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /thogs pa med par myur du stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya sid+dhi ā+oṃ/ waka sirnyi a tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ rak+ta ni/ gdug can dgra bgegs khrag gi dngas ma'i mtshor/ /mkha' dbyings pad+ma rak+ta'i 'bab ldan kun/ /gcig bsdus mtshams sprin la 'gran dbu phreng dang / /rab 'jigs rba rlabs cher g.yo'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e bye hi dza:྅ baṃ ho/ ma hā rak+ta pā dza 'a hi/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha rus dbang lnga'i rdul/ /rab brtsegs dmar chen ba li sprin chen dbang / /rin chen sna bzhi kun bzang mchod sprin du/ /dmigs te zil gnon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e gye hi dza:lha baṃ ho/ ma hā bha li ta pū dza khā hi/ rang snang shes rab e gsang chu gter che/ /thabs kya dran pa'i ka ba'i lhun po yis/ /legs par bsrubs las byang sems bdud rtsi mchog /'du 'phrod thon pa'i bde chen rgyas gyur cig /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza ma ma e ka dzā ṭi e da phya hi dza:snyi baṃ ho/ma hā mu dra pā dza ji hi ho: de nas bstod pa ni/ rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /ji snyed gsang gsum yon tan phung po'i tshogs/ /mi zad sku gsum khro rgyal gar nyams kyis/ /rgya chen srid gsum log 'dren 'joms la bstod/ /bka' yi las mdzad yum chen khrag mig ma/ /sras mchog gshed po ya ma ra tsa dang / /'jigs rung las kyi gshin rjer bcas pa la/ /dang (na thas phyag 'tshal —167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ lha tshogs thugs da'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las/ /pho nya sprul pa yang sprul dpag med 'phros/ /bdag gzhan bsrung bya'i tshe srog ṇi'i rnam pa/ /sde brgyad rnams kyis brku 'phrogs yar ba sogs/ /srid rtse mnar med bar du gar yod kyang / /gnod byed tshar bcas tshe srog hūṃ yig gi /rnam par byas la so sor bstim gyur zhing / /bde gshegs zhi khro'i byin rlabs sde brgyad kyi/ /srog snying lhag ma'i tshe srog 'byung lnga'i bcud/ /bkug la rang gzhan la thim stobs ldan gyur/ /e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa srungs/ /he ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa srungs/ /gī ma ya ma du ru tsa kras srungs/ /sarba tsit+ta gzer thum thog nan treg nan: rbad ya bzlog ya: se gh+ri wa ri dag dmigs yul dang bcas pa la/ srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes sngags thun drug gam bzhir bcad la bzla'o/ /de nas bzlog pa ni/ sgrub pa po rnams chas gos nag po gyon 'ing / skra dngos sam bcos ma'i skras kyang rung ste/ bzhin la rdzas kya thig le dang drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ 'brub khung bskyed chog nas bzung ste lha dbye'i bar las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo ltar byas la de nas 'di ltar brjod do/ /bla srog zhugs pa'i ling ga dgra dngos de'i/ khang par gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /rno ngar ldan pas brgyangs pas g.yo 'gul med/ /spyi bor lam las su ri nag po ni/ /bang rim dgu pa bong tshad ri rab cam/ /mgo 'bras log pa zhig gis mnan pa'i steng / /mchod rten srung ba'i gur dang bcas par gyur/ /snying ga'i 'jam dpal bzhi yang rab (5ba〉bros shing / /zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad la/ /thugs ka ba spu rnams nas khro bo'i tshogs/ /mtshon thogs skar ltar zhakhyug cing glog ltar 'khrug /byad ma phar bzlog thal ba ltar btang zhing / stobs cher tshul bzlog rnams kyang mtshon chas gtubs/ /byad stems phab cing rang gshed dbab par gyur/ /ā+oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa bzlog /he ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa bzlog /gh+ri ra ya ma du ru tsakra sa bzlog /sarba tsit+ta gzer thum lhag nan trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i rig sngags kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad byad ma kho rang gi steng du mā ra ya bzlog ya/ zhes thun drug gam bzhir bcad la —/68—

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanabazlas rjes/ thun 'jog khar/ dgra bo'i sha la rgyug /snying la mā ra ya rgyug /dbugs la rgyug /srog la mā ra ya rgyug /khrag la rgyug /rtsa la mā ra ya rgyug /hūṃ phaṭa/ byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bzlog yā/ zhes pa 'di sngags gong ma la mang nyung 'tsham pa re btags te thun bsgrub cing / de nas thun brdeb pa ni/ skyabs bral log par 'dren pa'i dgra bo de'i/ khong pa'i gnam lcags 'khor lo drag 'khor bas/ /srog snying rtsa khrag thams cad rab 'bad cing / /stobs dang nus pa gzi brjid nyams par gyur/ /mtshe yungs rdo lcags la sogs drag po'i rdzas/ /dug dang khrag tu sbol te dar btags pa/ /thog dang sna tshogs mtshon cha'i char gyur pa/ /btab pas lus kun khrol ma lta bur gyur/ /dug dang nad kyi rlangs pa rab rgyas shing / /brten pa'i lha dang rdzas sngags zhakhrul 'khor sogs/ kho rang rnams kyis byas pa'i sbyor ba kun/ /dgra bo 'khor bcas gsod pa'i gshed du gyur/ /bzlog sngags (6na po ma bu dang bcas pas thun brdeg cing / de nas rang nyid tshe bdag gsal ba'i phyag gnyis po/ /zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyur pa'i bar/ /lhag mar lus pa'i 'og 'dren dgra sde'i tshogs/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur/ /zhes dmigs pa dang bcas pas thun gtor 'phang / gtang rag mchod pa ni/ khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /ma hā bha ling bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /rak+ta la sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mchod pa 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /smon lam ni/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum yongs 'du sa brdol la/ /bskyed rim lo 'dab 'bras bur brgyas shing grol byed lam gyi gang bu g.yur za ba/ /dngos grub rnams nyis dga' ston rgyas par shog shes brjod ni/ 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas bla ma yi dam lha/ /dpag dka' rab 'byams las sgrub dam can tshogs/ /pho nya las gshin la sogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /bkra shis dga' ston dpal la rol gyur cig /thun mtshams su/ bsrung bya ma lus thugs ga'i hūṃ yig gi /thig ler thim zhing rang nyid gshin rje gshed/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khor lo lcags kyu 'dzin/ khro bo'i nga rgyal dag gis mtha' dag bsrung / /zhes srung bzlog gnyis kyi go rim dngos su bsgrigs pa 'dis/ /mnan bsad gnyis kyi ngag 'don kyang rags rim tsam —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)shugs la shes par 'gyur la/'on kyang srung bzlog bsad mnan gyi lag len zhib mo zhal shes dang bcas pa ni/gter gzhung dang sgo bstun te brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i gsung las myang dgos pa'i phyir/ngag 'don tsam yang spros pa ma yin no//smras pa/lnga brgya'i dus mthar bsil ba'i ljongs 'di na//tshig tsam skyabs 'dzin mkhas dang tshul 'chos bsgom//stabs legs6ba ) mthu ru rlom pa'i rigs sngags 'chang //blun rmongs skye bo'i gtsug tu mngon par mdzes//rgyud rgyal ma hā yo ga'i rgya mtsho las//gshed skor yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che//'dzin pa'i khas 'che mang yang zab mo'i gnad//tshul bzhin shes pa u dum wā ra bzhin//snod la mi lta bu sogs 'ga' zhig la//ston pa'i rigs nas drang srong gsang tshig dang //phan tshun tshig gcod ngang las rang shugs kyis/shes pa'i rtog ge'i chos dang 'di mi 'dra//tshul 'di rin chen lta bu'i gdul bya yis//thog mar rdo rje slob dpon rab bsten nas//snyan brgyud zab mo sgro 'dogs legs dpyad pas//'dod don dbang gi rgyal po de nas 'grub//de phyir bsam zhing gnubs ban lo tsā ba//zab gter spel lo sngags 'chang dum pa rgya//snyan brgyud bzung ngo rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa//brtsebs brkyangs so' ston chos rje'i zhabs//deng dus rigs rus stobs dang jog rdzun gyis//ches rab khengs kyang smra bcas rgya yis bcings//zla bral zab gnad 'di la gdengs thob pas bsamasashing bka' drin dran no yongs 'dzin rje//de ltar yang bzlog me yi spu gri yi//las byang sngon med 'byer bde bklags chog 'di//bkod pas bdud rigs mun pa'i srog bcom ste//nges gsang pad tshal ches cher rgyas gyur cig/ces wom dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las mtha' yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang /rang gshed dbab pa rdo rje'i pha lam zhes bya ba 'di yang /tshul 'dir mos pa'i skal ldan 'ga' zhig la phan par 'gyur zhing /khyad par du nges gsang theg pa mchog la gcig tu gzhol ba'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi skabs su 'os pa'i nyams len du 'khyer bde bar bsams te/

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma6)zil gnon drag (7na sol rdo rjes/ chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa'i bya 'dabs dga' ldan khang gsar du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam bcas pa bzhugs so/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ trig khro sto ma ni ma ra ni bh+yo: ma ra dun bh+yo: ra ma ra ga sha na: ting yā rak+ta bh+yo: mā ra ya:ya mā rā tsa gī lwa ya bh+yo: na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang /dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bden pa dang / phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang / rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' bden pa dang / chos nyid ngo bo ka nas dag kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob skyob yul dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/gdug pa dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ lo rgyal po'i sgeg sri/ zla ba blon po'i skeg sri/ zhag dmag mi'i sgeg sri/ dus tshod mtshon cha'i skeg sri/ za lam du dug g.yo ba/ lus la mtshon kha gtod pa/ g.yul 'khrug /'thab rtsod/ kha smras/ smod mo/ chags che ba/ nyam nga ba/ rmi lam (2na)ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ dus min 'chi ba nad dang rims dang sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod pa sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya bzlog bzlog /byad bzlog gtso bor byed tshe dmigs bsal yod na khyad par che ge mo dang / med na ban bon sngags pas btang ba'i rbad 'dre rbod gtor phar phyin bka' mthu'i mdo sgrub/ byad kha phur kha/ mnan gtad/ mdos —17/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zor/ hom dang par bu rlung gi 'khrul 'khor sogs rig sngags kyi stobs dang rdzu phrul dang / ngan sngagasakyi dpal dang / kho'i chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad kho rang gi steng du bzlog cing / rang srog rang gis chod cig /rang sha rang gis zo zhig /rang khrag rang gis 'thung zhig /rang nus rang la smin cig /rang mtshon rang la rgyob cig /rang gshed rang la phob la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog cig /mā ra ya bzlog bzlog /bh+yo bh+yo zor bskul ba ni/ bh+yo: lcags sam bhan+ta'i snod nang du/ /'bru sna lnga la ngar phye byas/ /drag po'i bshus bu zur gsum bzhengs/ /mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsangs kyis brgyan/ /myos byed dug dang khrag gis byugs/ /rtsa bar 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil/ /ngos la zhe sdang me dpung 'bar/ /'og tu gti mug mun pa 'khrigs/ /rtse mor (2bsgo tshone cha'i bu yug 'tshub/ /rked par gshin rje'i dmag dpung bsdus/ /gshin rje rol pa'i gtor zor 'di/ /'phangs pa gshin rje nyid kyis 'phangs/ /brdeg pa dam nyams dgra la brdeg /dgra khams thal ba'i rdul du rlog /zor sngags bzlog sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ /zab rgya: : maṅga lo// //'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog dkyil la mkho ba'i sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhugs/blo gros 'dab stong thugs rje'i nyi ma yis/ /bzhad pa'i drin can bla ma rdo rje sems/ /yin par nges rnyed sangs rgyas thob nas kyang / /gtsug tor rtse mor rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /de la 'dir 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i drag po zor gyi 'phrin las sgrub pa la nye bar mkho ba rdul tshon la brten pa'i bzlog dkyil 'dri ba la/ de yang mdos gtor gyi bzlog dkyil bsdus pa'i rigs phal cher la thig tshon gyi cho ga sogs par bkab mi mdzad pa rnying ma phyogs su dar so che yang zhib mor dpyod pa rnams kyis sngon 'gro'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa mdzad pas de la'ang —/72

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog dkyil la mkho ba'i sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal/ nang ma(khanas brtag bslang sbyang gsum sogs dkyil chog rnams su phyag len mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung ba las shes par nus shing 'dir de dag gi spros pa dor te med du mi rung ba'i rim pa lag khrid du gtong ba la/ sa bslang ba/ thig tsho ni brlab pa/ chag chag 'debs pa/ thig gdab pa/ tsho ni bkye ba dang lnga las/ dang po sa bslang ba ni/ las byang sngon du btang zin dang ma zin na rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa'i gzhung bsrangs te 'dzab bzla/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i sa der gtor ma dkar (2na)dmar gnyis bsham/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong sde brgyad gzhi bdag zhing skyong gdon bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥs bkug dkar gtor sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis brlab/ phyogs skyong sde brgyad rnams dang khyad par yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di kun na gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag zhing skyong gtsang phud la dga' ba rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag cag rnams 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'phrin las zab mo nyams su len pa la bar gcod mi 'byung ba'i dge ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig /ces bka' bsgo/ nag phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba lan chags dang gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs nam mkha' la 'phyo ba/ bar snang la rgyu ba/sa gzhi la 'grim pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa/ skyo 'grib la gab pa/ bsnyen sgrub lab/gsum gyi sgrub pa chen po mthong thos mi bzod pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la byams pa'i sems kyis so so rang rang gi gnas dang rten la (2ba)dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo sprin rab 'byams kyi ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas phye mar brlag par 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas zhes sogs kyi mthar/ yungs kar rgyas brab/ gu gul gyis bdug /rol mo drag po dang bcas phyir bskrad/ dur khrod mtshon cha me ri khro bo 'khrig /ces sogs kyis srung 'khor bsgom/gnyis pa thig tshon brlab pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i dbus su ka pā la'am rin po che'i snod lnga'i dbus su rdul tshon sngon po/ shar du dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang gu rnamasal rdo rje'i rtses rim pa bzhin du hūṃ hūṃ/ ā+oṃ lī/ swā / / e bye/ hā rta rnams 'dri/ tshon mdog dang mthun —173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa'i thig skud so sor bkod/ phyi mchod lnga dang nang mchod gsum bsham/ las byang ltar mchod rdzas rnams brlab/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was thig tshon rnams sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sa gnon dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ shar du rnam snang dkar po phyag gnyis 'khor lo dril bu dang bcas te byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor rin 'byung ser po g.yas rin po che cha dgu pa dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma ki dang mnyam par sbyor ba/nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te pad+ma (3na)dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ byang du don grub ljang gu g.yas rgya gram dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lnga ga'ang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i dpral bar ā+oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dar hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ ho8sa gnyis su med par bsam/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra a ha ra a ha ra nas sha lta pra ti ts+tsha swāhās mchod/ jags mjug tu ma hā pañca a my-i ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā ba kla ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ hūṃ/ gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /sa gnon chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings rnam dag rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung gnas la/ / mtha' yasardo rje chos kyi don/ /sor rtogs ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /don grub rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung / /bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /skyabs na chen —/74

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog dkyil la mkho ba'i sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal/ nang ma(kha)po'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /(3ba)phyag 'tshal rdo rje don grub la/ /zhes bstod/ thig skud la dmigs nas/ā+oṃ a rkyo n+ya a nu ga lha sarba dharmaḥpa ra lpa ra a nu pra zhim sarbaḥdharma/ ā+oṃ āḥlha zhes bzla/ tshon la dmigs te/ ā+oṃ sa ma ya snyu tra ma ti kra ma hūṃ zhes bzla/ rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs thig tshon so so la thim pas ye shes lnga'i thig dang rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i rdul tshon du bsam/ sems can khams rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /'di ni me long byin rlabs so/ /sems can khams rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /'di ni chos dbyings byin rlabs so/ /sems na khams rnams dag bya'i phyir/ 'di ni mnyam nyid byin rlabs so/ /sems can khams ni dag bya'i phyir/ /'di ni sor rtog byin rlabs so/ /sems can khams rnams dag bya'i phyir/ /'di ni bya grub byin rlabs so/ /zhes brjod pas/ lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas thig tshon so so la thim par bsam/gsum pa chag chag gdab pa ni/ hūṃ/ rang byung bdud rtsi ye shes la ldan pas/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i rigs mchog bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsung sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /dam rdzas gsang ba bdud rtsi'i chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā a mṛ ta pañca maṇ+ḍal sarba saṃ sho dha na ye swāhā/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi kun tu khyab par byugs la gu gul gyis bdug cing / sa gzhi ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du bsam/ bzhi pa thig gdab (4na)pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor ma lus kun/ /byang chub sems ni gcig tu gyur/ /ces pas skud pa lnga phyogs gcig tu dril ba la/ thig skud rnams ye shes lnga'i srad bur bsam/rang nyid shar du blta zhing las kyi rdo rje la thig sna gtad la/ hā1 / stong gsum brdal ba yum gyi gzhal yas su/ /thugs rje 'gyur med yab kyi thig btab pas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med byang sems kyis/ /rab byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la gsal/ /lha bi shwa bi shu zhe dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal zlo/zhes ye shes kyi thig thig bskor dang bcas te slob dpon dang slob ma'i spang bya ma nor bar 'debs/las thig ni/ dkar chal gyis tshangs thig dang zur thig btab la lte ba nas cha chen gcig gis bskor —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ba'i nang du slar yang cha phran gcig gis bskor ba thod ra/ de'i dbus su gru gsum rtse mo phyogs can gyi kha byang bstan zla gam
