gsum dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du cha chen gcig gis bskor ba'ang phyed du thod ras dgos pa'i nang ma la zur thig gi g.yas g.yon nas bcad pa'i thod mkhar bzhi/ phyi ma la 'khor lo rtsabs brgyad/ de'i phyir cha phran gnyis kyis bskor bar lcags mkhar gru gsum rtse mo nang du bstan pa phyogs kyi stod smad gnyis dang mtshams bzhir re re/ de'i phyir mu khyud cha phran phyed kyis bskor ba/de'i phyir khyams kyi dod mu khyud cha phran phyed gnyis kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyir cha chen gcig gis bskor ba mu khyud de'i steng du gru gsum bcu drug rtse mo phyir (4ba)bstan pa 'obs khung bcu drug /de'i phyir rdo ra la cha chen phyed dang me ri la cha chen gcig gis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol tu ma tre mgo bo mdun du bstan pa 'dri/ rgyas par spro na sgom don la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mdzad pas de don ltar byed na lte ba nas cha chen gsum gyi sar rtsa thig gdab/ nang gi mu khyud la bcar ba'i khrag khyams gru bzhir 'don/logs thig nas rtsig pa la cha phran gcig /'dod snam la cha phran gnyis/ pha gu la cha phran gcig /dra ba dra phyed la cha phran gnyis/ shar bu dang / mda' yab la cha phran re snam bu brgyad la cha phran re re yod pa'i snam bu dang po gser gdung ka rgyan gyi mtha' dang mnyam pa/ gnyis pa rta rkang dang gsum pa chu skyes gnyis de las cha phran gcig gis ring ba/ bzhi pa rin chen de las gnyis kyis thung ba/ lnga pa sgrom bu de las gcag gas rang ba/ drug pa za ra/ bdun pa pad+ma/ brgyad pa mda' yab/ gsum pa cha phran re res thung ba/ 'jug pa bde bar byed na glang rgyab ni lto ba'i zheng sgo tshad gcig g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis por cha phun gnyis re de 'dzom mtshams nas rtse'i zad mtha'i bar sgo tshad gcig phyir cha phun gcig gi sar rgyan pa tra 'dri bar phyag len la yod par snang / 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gdugs ri dgas dang bcas pa rgyas par sgyu 'phrul ltar glang rgyab gu na dha ri ni tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon du snam bu dang por cha phran phyed bzhi gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis la drug drug bzhi pa la bzhi lnga bar gsum drug pa la de nas bdun pa'i nang thig gi tshangs thig rtser reg pa/ chos 'khor la cha chen gcig /—/76

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog dkyil la mkho ba'i sngon 'gro'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal/ nang ma(kha)pad ra cha phran gnyis/ 'obs khung (ldan)dang dur khrod la cha chen re/ rdo ra me ri dang nang thig gong dang 'dra/ lcags sdig ltar byed na lte ba nas cha chen phyed gnyis kyis bskor ba'i nang du slar yang cha phran gcig gis bskor ba/ thod ra de'i dbus su gru gsum che ba/ de'i lte ba zlum por bskor ba gling dgur bcad pa'i dbus su gru gsum bton pa gtso bo'i gnas/ thod ra'i phyi rol nas cha phran gnyis la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis/ de'i phyir cha phran gnyis gru bzhir btab pa'i gru chad bzhir gru gsum sum brtsegs rtse mo nang bstan/ de'i phyir cha phran gnyis kyis bskor ba'i khyams kyi logs rer gru gsum cung zad che ba re dang g.yas g.yon du bzhi re rtse mo nang bstan/ de'i phyir 'obs khung nas me ri'i bar gong dang mtshungs shing / dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs byed na lcags 'dra la sgyu 'phrul dang mthun par rta babs snam bu brgyad mdzad kyang 'dir rta babs snam bzhi mar ba ched pa shas che bas/ nang thig khyams grur gcod cing rtsig pa nas mda' yab kyi bar lcags 'dra ltar la rta babs snam bu bzhir cha phran re/ nga po'i mtha' tshad la cha chen bzhi g.yin gsum rim gyis nang du cha phran re 'dums pa'o/ /bum mgo ma bton gshis 'khor lo gdugs bcas la cha chen gnyis/ lugs gnyis ka la nyid lpags kyi rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sogs dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa pad rdor me gsum dug gsum gyi dag bya dag byed du gsungs pas pad ra dor ba'ang 'thad par mi sems shing dur khrod kyang las byang srung 'khor gyi tshig gis thon pa'o/ /lnga pa tshon bkye ba ni/ gru gsum mthing nag zla gam gsum khrag khyamasamatshon pa'i dmar po/ (5ba)thod ra rnams dkar/ thod mkhar nang khyams dmar po'am yang na ljang gu/'khor lo rnams ser/ mchan rnams sngo/ mu khyud mdzes tshoni/ lcags mkhar gru gsum sngo/ khong gseng dmar/ phyi khyams phyogs mdog/ mu khyud gzhi nag gi steng du 'obs khung dmar nag /rdo ra gzhi nag la rdo rje ser po/ me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa/ sgo rdzogs su byed na/ gru chad phyogs mdog dang bar khyams dmar/ rtsig pa nas mda' yab kyi bar spyi dang mthun/ rta babs snam bu brgyad mar dang po gser gdung ser/ gnyis pa rta rkang sngo/ gsum pa chu skyes dmar/ bzhi pa rin chen mthing / lnga pa sgrom —/77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bu sna tshogs/ drug pa bzar sngo/ bdun pa pad+ma dmar/ brgyad pa mda' yab dkar/ 'khor lo dang ri dwags ser/ gdugs dkar/ pad+ma'i lte bar khrag ris 'dri/ lcags sdig la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dbus kyi gru gsum phyi khyams dmar/ ling tshe'i phyogs bzhi sngo/ mtshams bzhi dang mu khyud re khā ser/'khor lo bcu gnyis sngon po/ mchan khrag khyams/ gru chad phyogs mdog 'dri/ lha mtshan ni/ 'bru nag lha grangs tshom bu dgod ces pa'i don ltar bra bo khrag gis sbags pa dbus su gtso bo la che ba gcig /zla gam la sprul pa gsum/ thod mkhar la gshed bzhi/ rtsibs la mon bdud brgyad/ lcagasamakhar la 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ phyi khyams kyi dod la sgo ba bzhi/ 'obs la 'obs srung bcu drug rnams ma nor bar dgod/ lcags sdig ltar na gling dgu'i dbus su gtso bo/ shar nas rim bzhin phyag rdor/ sras mchog /rus sbal/ sgrol yum/ shar lho nas seng ge /stag /sprul/ khyung / zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum/ 'khor (6na〉( bcu gnyis la phyogs bzhin gsang gshed bzhi/ de rnams kyi g.yas bzhi la nang gshed bzhi g.yon bzhi la phyi gshed bzhi/ gru chad kyi shar lho nas brtsams te bcu gnyis la 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ khyams kyi phyogs bzhi'i dbus su sgo ba/ de'i g.yas g.yon du bzhi re dgod dgos pa/ shar du brgyad la bdud/ lho'i brgyad la gshin rje/ nub kyi brgyad la ma mo/ byang gi brgyad la gnod sbyin/ de'i phyir 'obs khung bcu drug la 'obs srung rnams ma nor bar dgod do/ /de yang sa ma dul bas rjen pa sogs su byed dgos byung na sa brtag bslang sbyang gzung sogs dgos shing 'di ni gtsug lag khang dang rgyal po'i pho brang gis mtshon pa'i dul mar byed pa'i dbang du byas nas 'jug bde tsam du bkod la/ gtor bzlog tu ma zad dbang gi skabs kyang spros pa chung bar 'dod na lha mtshan dgod lugs tsam ma gtogs 'di kho nas nges don bde 'jug gi mdzes rgyan du 'gyur ro/ /lugs srol 'di la sngon goms bag chags dang / /tshe 'dir sbyangs pa'i sa bon yongs smin pas/ /legs bshad sa ha ka ra'i snye ma'i bcud/ /myang 'dod rdo rje'i spun rnams dgyes dgur rol/ /ces 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i bzlog dkyil 'bri ba la nye bar mkho ba'i chog sgrigs nyung —178

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanangu rnam gsal 'di'ang zor las gnam lcags thog mda' lhan thabs su za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// // maṅga lo//'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda' bzhugs/rgyal kun yab gyur 'jam dpal tshe bdag dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul/ /mi phyed dad pa'i gtsug tor rtser bkod nas/ /zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda' 'dri/ /de yang las byang dang zor las gnyis so sor bkod pa 'khrul gzhi chung zhing nyams su bstar bde bar mngon pas/ lcags sdig bzlog gzhud thems mang las/ /dang por sngags pa bsnyen rdzogasapas/ /zhing chen gdan la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /'bru nag lha grangs tshomi bu dgod/ /ces sogs gsungasapa ltar bzlog dkyil rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung dang bzlog gtor phyag len rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig yod pa ji ltar rigs pa/ zor/ mchod gtor sogs bdag mdun gnyis gar dgos pa'i chas dang yo byad rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ thog mar 'khor 'das mtshams dbye ba'i rol mo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba bya/ de nas 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi skyabs 'gro nas bzung yan lag brgyad pa mtshams gcod kyi sprin rab 'byams 'phro ba (2na)dang bcas par gyur ces brjod/ bgegs gtor bshams la rdo rje slob dpon gyis bsngo/ bdag nyid khro rgyal ma nas mchod rdzas byin rlabs kyi bar song nas bdag mdun gnyis me long la gzugs sgrub chen la thog mar ngo bo dbyer med byas nas mthar 'dzab khang dbye ba'i gnad shes dgos kyang gtor bzlog la thog ma nas zhal sprod byed pas ma 'dres par gal che/ brnyan shar ba ltar gyer bsgom tshul du stong nyid bsgom pa nas/ 'dod yon nang mchod kyi mjug tu mchod pa'i rnga tshig chen mo phyag len bzhin bya/ 'dzab kyi tshe a kro bcu bdun ma/ sku —179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gsung thugs sngags/ mye ring rnal ma/ gzir ba g.yu spyang dang bzlog pa g.yu spyang btags pa rnams mang nyung long sabs dang bstun nas bzla zhing byas pa bshig pa sogs las g.yin sbyar dgos yod na man ngag bzhin byed/ 'dzab rdzogs mtshams su dmod mo bya zhing thal mo brdab dngos grub blangs/gtor mar sman rag sbran/ bstod pa btang / gtor ma dang khrag skyems la dmigs nas/ raṃ yaṃ kho gis bsregs gtor bkrus/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis gtor ma sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsam/ sgrub pa'i thog mtha' gnyis la 'jug pa bde phyir mchod (2ba)bstod gsal sgron gyi rgyan lha yan mdzad srol 'dug na'ang thog ma nas tshang ma btang ba mi 'gal bar sems shing gtor bzlog la thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /ces pa'i mthug tu/ bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces dang mnan sreg 'phang ba sogs la kha bsgyur ba gnad du che/ thugs sprul gyi khyung bskul rjes su nyin dang por rwa zor gyi ngar 'don ni/ sla nga'i nang du gzugs gsum po bshams par rak+ta sbran/ tshogs tha ma ji lta ba la phur 'debs kyi tshab tu rwa zor snying gar bsnun pa'i stang ga tsam gyis gnas spar nas mi gsod myong bas gtubs rjes sman raka sgron te zhal stob dkyus ltar byed/ rwa zor sgrub lugs man ngag dang phyag len bzhin nyams su bstar/ bskul rdzogs mtshams su mā ra ya'i drag brdungs dang bstun gtor ma khrag skyems 'bul khar rdo rje slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor ba dang bcas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dang sgrub pa po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgos kyi 'dod gsol rgyas par byed cing 'dis mtshon gtor ma phyir 'bul ba rnams la rigs 'dre/ gter srung sogs chos skyong gi bskang gso nas tshogs bar pa'i bar dkyus bzhin gtong / de nas gdab las rgyas par spro na shog ling zan ling sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar bsham/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis gser skyems byin gyis brlab/khro rol chog sgrigs bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs nas blangs pa'i zhi khro bka' brgyad lha zhes pa 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po dang dpal mgon nag po ma ning che/ stag zhen mthu chen sde bzhi por bsgyur/ 'brub khung bskyed pa ni/ su bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas —/80

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)e (3na)mthing nag gcig chad mdun du 'phros yongs su gyur pa las/ dug dang zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom me 'bar ba gru gsum pa bang rim dgu dang ldan pa/ kha khyar yangs shing gting zab pa de'i nang du 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba zhe sdang gi me rlung 'tshub pa/ gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ mtshon cha'i drag char 'bab pa/ nad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar du 'phyo ba/ khrag gi ser chen 'bab pa/ gshin rje'i skyes bu dpag tu med pa rgyug pa/ than dang ltas ngan gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ g.yin yang sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba rnams ni seng ge ltar rngam pa/ stag ltar mchong ba/ 'brong ltar 'gying ba/ khra ltar 'dzul ba/ sbrul ltar 'byug pa/'dre srin ltar ngur ba/ 'gong po ltar smyo ba/ srin bya ltar rgod pa/ wa mo ltar brgyal ba/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyug pa/ sod sod dang rgyob rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pas gang ba/ de'i nang du bskal pa stong gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ phyi nas bskal pa stong gi me 'bar zhing rlung nag 'tshub pa/ gshin rje'i zhing khams/ bshan pa'i pho brang / srog gcod kyi grong khyer/ srid pa las kyi gzhan yas khang chen po/dgra bo phyin ma thag lha dang 'bral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ las ngan thams cad rnam par smin par byed pa'i btson khang drag po/ de'i dbus su/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra /dkon mchog gi spyi dgra /bla ma'i sku dgra /rnal 'byor gyi sgos dgra /dmigs pa'i dgra bo gang gi rnam par shes pa rje dud kha yongasasu gyur pa las/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo de dag /nyam chung ba/ skyid pa phra ba/ skra gzings pa/ (3ba)mdog nag cing bam pa/ mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ bu ga dgu nas khrag dang rnag 'dzag pa/ kha nas srid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ bsrung zhing skyob pa'i lha dang bral zhing gshed du babs pa/ gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de'i 'og tu zhing chen gyi sa gzhi brdal ba/ mtshon cha sna tshogs gzengs te 'dug pa/ drag po'i tsha tsha chil li li 'khol ba/ de'i 'og tu rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'brug cing zhing chen gyi rba nyil nyil 'phyo ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i me rlung dmar nag 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal ba'i rlung spu gri so rgal chil li li 'brug pa/ de'i 'og tu drag po chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil —/81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'khor gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dgra bo thams cad gtan nas rlag par byed pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis bkug par gyur/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungasasngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang / chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bder gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs spyi dang khyad par 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje 'chi bdag bhe wa sa twa 'khor lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang / sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag gi lha sngags ye shes kyi (4na)rol pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra /rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor mched kyi sgos dgra /rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po'i rkyen dgra /sems can yongs la 'tshe ba khyad par sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag la dar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba/ ngo phyar gdod nas bsdo ba/ kha 'jam thabs kyis gnod pa/ g.yul 'khrug grosang na bshoms pa/ dug dang mtshon kha gtod pa/ mthu byad rbod gtong byed pa sogs mdor na bsam pa ngan pa yid la 'chang zhing sbyor ba rtsub mor ston pa rnams kyi bla srog tshe gsum dang bcas pa gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran/ ri rab kyi khong gseng / nyi zla'i gong bar chos bon srung ma rnams kyis bskyabs pa'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sogs gang na gnas kyang dmigs rten gi liṅga 'di nyid la khug cig phye ring gi raka mo n+ta'i mtshams su/ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra sgro ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho: badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be —182

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma6)sha ya a/ zhes drag rol gro ga'i rtsi sgra dang bshug pa'i 'bod sgra dang rdzas dud g.yab dar tsham ngam dang bcas pa gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs ji ltar rigs pa bya/ gru gsum e yi snod nang du/ zhes sogs blo ka phyed gnyis brjod/ gzu dpang ni/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas bstan la rab bzhugs te/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la skyabs su song / /rigs bdun so so thar pa'i sdom pa blangs/ /byang chub mchog gi bsam pa brten por ldan/ khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa/ /rdo (4ba)rje slob dpon khong gi snying ltar bzung / /de yi sku la ma brnyas gsung ma bcag /thugs rgyud ma dkrugs gus brten dam ma dral/ /theg dgu rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos dang / /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho phyi nang gi /rgyud gzhung man ngag thos bsam sgom pa dang / /smon grol bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin spyad/ /chos longs sprul sku'i ston dang rten cing 'brel/ /zung 'jug rgyu 'bras ldan pa'i chos bstan pa/ /gdul bya'i bsags pas thag pa grub mtha' sgo/ /mtha' yas du mar go yang ngo bor gcig /kun la ris med dag snang rtsal sbyangs shing / /bdag bstod gzhan smod chags sdang tsher ma spangs/ /rang gis tshul bzhin dam chos spyod pa la/ /ban sngags bon dgra nag pos 'tshe ba dang / /rang zas sman dang gzhan zas dug ltar bltas/ /dman pa'i sa bzung khas nyen dpung pa dmad/ /mtho la ma smad dman la ma brnyas shing / /bar du phrag dog ru nga'i sbyor spangs kyang / /bstan pa'i ru dra nag po glang snying 'dis/ /spyir ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yongs la 'tshe/ /sgos su dpal ldan bla ma'i thugasargyud dkrugs/ /yang sgos bdag cag chos srid bcas pa la/ /bden pa khyad bsad rang gnod khong skran bcas/ /ngor rtsub ma bde thabs kyis mtha' nas bskum/ /rang nus ma thon log 'dren g.yin dag rbod/ kha dkar zhe gnag mgo smod sgab nas rtsub/ /ma byas byas dang ma byung byung zhes pa'i/ /legs bsub nyes sgrog ya kha ngan smras sbor/ /rgyab nas 'ded cing mdun nas 'gugs pa dang / /zur nas gsod gcod rku 'phrog rdeg byed cing / /rang gi chos srid 'byor pas ma ngoms par/ /gzhan la phrag dog bstan la bstengs pa yi/ /(5na〉phyo dgra zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba dang / /nang dgra bsam ngan —/83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rlung ltar 'tshub pa yi/ /snga dgra nyes byed chu ltar rgyug pa dang / /phyi dgra byed sems dug ltar khong du g.yo/ /da dgra drag po tsher las rtsub pa yi/ /byad ma dgra bo phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang / /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho dregs pa'i 'khor/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor la gdung ba'i/ /rngam drag 'bar ba dpal gyi pho nya rnams/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang rnal 'byor dam bzhin 'dus/ /nyes byed dgra bo'i gzugs phung rnam shes bcas/ /pha tshan yul 'khor mi nor sde dpung rnams/ /rang dbang med par drag po'i rten la phob/ /de nas dgra bo'i bla rgyu ba'i dus drug dang bla rtags brgyad la pho nya brgyad bskul te 'gugs pa ni g.yab dar dang bcas nas/ hūṃ bh+yo/ da ni bsgral ba'i thugs dam dus la bab/ /da lta nam gyi song la bab dus 'dir/ /chom rkun las la 'gyed pa'i dus yin pas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'khyam pa'i dus/ /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nam gyi gung la bab dus 'dir/ /sems med 'byung ba chu yang gnyid log gi /dgra bo las ngan sdig can gnyid log pa'i/ /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nam gyi tho rangs bab dus 'dir/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo zhing 'phro ba'i dus/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo ba'i dus/ /bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nam langs nyi ma shar dus 'dir/ /mi phyugs thams cad las la gram pa'i dus/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe sgo ru thon pa'i dus/ /bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nyi ma'i gung la (5bathab dus 'dir/ /dgra kun rnam shes bying zhing myos pa'i dus/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe 'thom zhing 'khyam pa'i dus/ /bla 'khyams lasang na myur du khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nyi nub grib so phog dus 'dir/ /snying mi dga' zhing shes pa 'phyo ba'i dus/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe rnam shes 'phyo ba'i dus/ /bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shog /bh+yo/ bla 'khyam las ngan 'phyo ba'i dus drug la/ /bla gshed pho nya khyed rnams myur du rgyug /mgon med bye'u phrug rgya khras zin pa ltar/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam mi ru brdzu ba na/ /pho nya gnod sbyin srin por sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam sha bar brdzu —/84

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)ba na/ /pho nya gser gyi stag mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam sgo bar bsgrub na/ /pho nya lcags sdong nag por sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la sna snag /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam lug tu brnab ba na/ /pho nya lcags kyi spyang mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam ra ru brdzu ba na/ /pho nya byu ru'i khyi mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam bya ru brdzu ba na/ /pho nya bya rgyal khyung du sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam gla bar bsgrub na/ /pho nya gser gyi 'phar bar sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra po'i bla 'khyam bong bur brdzub na/ /pho nya zangs kyi dred mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /bh+yo/dam nyams dgra bo'i bla rtags brgyad po la/ /pho nya brgyad kyi gnyen por sku sprul la/ /'brub khung 'khor ba'i btson khang 'di'i nang du/ /dam nyams lid+ma'i rten la bla srog khug /bla srog gsum la drag po'i phur pas thob/ /phur mtshon dpal gyis lus sems phye mar thod/ /dgra bo'i bla srog steng du mā ra ya/ /srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod la shog /bla 'khyam las ngan steng du mā ra ya/ /ra dang lug dang bong bu rnam pa gsum/ /bla rtags yin pas myur du khyer la shog /so dang sen mo pags pa rnam (6na)pa gsum/ /phyi rtags yin pas myur du khyer la shog /rna ba lce dang mig dang gsum po ni/ /dbang po yin pas myur du khyer la shog /slo ba snying dang mchin pa gsum po ni/ /don snying yin pas myur du khyer la shog /mnye ma rgyu ma mkhal ma gsum po ni/ /nang khrol yin pas myur du khyer la shog sha khrag brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /phye myags kyi mthar/ che ge mo ā ga r+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ.ā yudz+nyā na a da r+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥtri yaṃ ni ā ga r+ṣa ya hūṃ dza:dzaḥ rū pa skan+ta ā ga r+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥzhes dang / mye myags kyi gsham du/ dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim/ sha ma ru ti thul thul/ phyogs phyogs/ yeng yeng / sha ma ru ti khug khug /ling myogs/ ling shag /ling thums/ tsa mun tri dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥ zhes rtags ma byung gi bar bya/ de nas/ lha dang dbye ba ni/ las kyi —/85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gshin rje'i gshed po thams cad dang / kha kha mu kha mthing nag bya rog gdong / khu lu mu kha ser nag 'ug pa'i gdong / /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs mi nor 'khor bcas 'di/ /skyob pa'i dgra lha lus dag srung ba phrol/ khyo dang chung ma pha dang bu gnyis phrol/ /gnyen dang nye du pho bo nu bo grol/ /dgra lha spyi gtsug pho lha phrag pa g.yas/ /yul lha phrag g.yon srog lha snying gi dkyil/ /'ad lha lte khung ma lha gsang ba'i gnas/ nga/'go ba'i ban bon lha srung tshogs rnams kun/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang rdzas kyi 'byul 'khor mthus/ /skyob pa'i lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod/ /rang gshed rang la dbab sogs drag po'i las/ /thogs pa med par myur du sgrub par mdzod/ /mye myags kyi mthar/ che ge mo : wa ka pa ye/ e dza la dza la/ ra tsa phye ra tsa phye a shag shag (6ba tshe ka ma phye ya ya ma phye ya/ spu ta sbu ta phus phus/ lang lang / seng seng / phus phus/ che ge mo yul lha dang phye/dgra lha dang phye/ srog lha dang phye/ pho lha dang phye/ ma lha dang phye/ zhes dang / phye myags kyi gsham du/ ma ma trag mā ra ya phye phye/ trag rak+ta ru dra mā ra ya/ dgra bo lha srung dang bcas pa phye phye/ dkrugs dkrugs/gtor gtor/ yed med/ ces rdzas dud gtong zhing dang sgros byab/ thun brdeg pa ni/ mtshe yungs rdo lcags la sogs drag po'i rdzas/ /dug dang khrag tu sbol te ngar btags pa/ /rdo rje'i thog dang mtshungs pa'i thun rdzas 'di/ /btab pas tshe srog bkrag mdangs nyams par gyur/ /ces 'og gi phur gdab kyi sngags mjug tu las drug gi so gang dgos dang nyin mtshan gyi thun sngags ci dgos btags nas brdeg /phur gdab ni/ e/ zil gnon lha tsho gos 'khor bcas kyi/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcasaphur pa ya ma rā dzar gsal ba snying gar btab ste tshe khrus kyi dgongs pas rnam shes spar/ ral gris gtub pa ni/ sras mchog thugs nas dregs pa'i bdag po ni/ /ngo bo gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /rnam pa gnam lcags ral gyis dgra bgegs kyi/ /gzugs phung sha khrag ma lus dum bur gtubs/ /zhes phur gdab kyi sngags dang bcas te rkang pa g.yon nas rim bzhin gtub/ stob pa ni ling ro sman rag gis sbrus pa bhan+ta ra blugs ste/ mye/ phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /zhes —/86

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbul/ bam skongs dang rtsa gsum gyi bkang ba song rjes tshogs la rol/ lhag ma byang shar du snod cig tu spungs nas btson du 'dzin/ gter gzhung du phye ring mye myags bzlog gsham sprad/ ces pa'i dgongs pa ltar/ sku'i sngags la/ (7na〉bo tsit+ta ro myags kha tham srog gzer sbur nan 'drid phyung hri shag rbad/ btags te lan gsum bzlas pa'i gsum ga'i mjug tu thal mo re brdeb/ des 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ gsung gi sngags la/ ha la ha la tsa ma ri phyung gnod byed a mu ka myags thum ril trig nan sbur ya nan e hur thums dza kho shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya btags pa lan gsum/ thugs kyi sngags la/ gsung sngags kyi gsham bu gnod byed a mu ka man ji lta ba btags pa lan gsum/ phye ring lan gsum la spyang mo drug skabs thob kyi gang dgos sbyor zhing rgyun du bzlog sbyang gtso che bar mdzad/ tshar gsum pa'i mthar dmod mo rgyas par brjod/ yang bzlog me'i spu gri/ rdo rje pha lam/ saḥdhīḥl grong khyer nyi shu pa btags pa rnams kyang so sor lan gsum rer thal rdeb byed pa gong dang 'dra/ 'di'i dus rdo rje slob dpon sogs kyi blor yod na pho khrom dang mo khrom gyis mtshon bzlog sngags zab mo g.yin yang bzlas pa legs char 'gyur bar sems so/ /mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs lcags 'drar gsal ba rnams lcags sdig tu bsgyur ba bka' brgyad la dbu nyer gcig par bsgyur ba dang mtshungs la/ de nas phud chang la btab pa'i ling ro rnams tshig dang bstun nas 'bul zhing / 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro rgyal rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan: phyogs skyong dregs pa ma he bsnol ba'i steng : e las phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: rno ba'i mtshon bya sna tshogs phyag na bsnams: sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po (7ba)'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob byad dang khrod gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol: shar phyogs dri za pho mo bsnol steng du: dregs pa phyag na rdo rje ni ljang nag rdo rje snying 'phreng 'dzin dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob dri za'i byad dang rbod gtong bzlog tu gsol:—187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)lho phyogs gshin rje pho mo bsnol steng du: gsod byed ya ma ser nag ni: 'khor lo tsit+ta phyag na bsnams: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: byad dang khrod gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol: nub phyogs klu dbang pho mo'i khri steng du: rus sbal rngam pa mi zan ni: sder mo gnam lcags spu gri 'dra: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob klu yi byad dang rbod gtong rims nad bzlog: byang phyogs gnod sbyin pho mo'i khri steng du: sngags srung e ka dza ti ni: phyag na ral gri glog 'phreng bsnams: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: gnod sbyin byad dang rbod gtong bzlog tu gsol: yum mchog pe ta nag mo ni: tsit+ta nga yab la stob dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob byad dang rbod gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol: shar lho me lha'i khri steng du lha yi gshed po seng ge'i dbu: skru gri mi snying phyag na bsnams: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: shar lho me lha'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: lho nub srin po pho mo'i khri steng du: srog bdag dmar po stag gi mgo spu gri tsit+ta'i 'phreng ba bsnams: srog bdag yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: lho nub srin po pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog: nub byang rlung lha pho mo'i khri steng du: klu gshed nag po sbrul gi mgo: phyag na bse yi spu gri bsnams: yab yum 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: nub byang 'chi bdag klu yi gnod pa bzlog: byang shar dbang ldan pho mo'i khri steng du:gnod sbyin (8na)gshed pa khyung nag gnyis: zhal du gdug pa klu sprul gsol: yab yum khyung chen 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob byang shar klu gdon gnod sbyin gnod pa gnod pa bzlog: zla gam thod mkhar gsum gyi dbus: dug gsum bsnol ba'i khri steng du tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag gsum: sna tshogs mi sdug sems can dbu: mtshon cha mi sdug lag na thogs:dug gsum sgrol byed 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus 'kha du stob: dug gsum 'dus pa'i byad dang skrod gtong bzlog: 'khor lo thod mkhar bcu gnyis dbus: gsang ba'i gshed —/88—

'jam dpal me'i sbu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanachen bzhi po ni: srin po ya ma rā tsa ni: ma tre ro dbyug 'khor lo thogs: yum mchog thal mdog g.yon nas 'khril: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gshin rje myos byed 'bar ba ni: ser nag be con 'khor lo 'dzin: g.yon du yum mchog gsod byed ma: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gshed po ār+ya ma ru ni: dmar po be con tsakra bsnams: g.yon du srog len nag mo ni: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gshed chen ral pa tshar dgu ni ljang nag be con tsakra bsnams: yum mchog bdud ma ral nag ma: khram shing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams: gsang ba'i gshed bzhin bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: gsang gshed sprul pa'i gnod pa bzlog nang gi gshed chen bzhi po ni: dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo: yum ni mon mo bla rkun ma: lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo: mon mo g.yu yi ral pa can bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo: mon mo khrag gi ral pa can: gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo: mon mo snying 'byin gzer 'bebs ma: yab rnams be con tsit+ta (8ba lnga snams:yum kun lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams: nang gi btand bzhir bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: nang gshed mon pa'i gnod pa bzlog: phyi yi gshed chen bzhi po ni: he le khyab pa shar gyi bdud: yum ni ro zan snying 'byin ma nag po 'dzum med lho yi bdud: nag mo snying khrag rol 'thung ma: so 'dar 'khrig pa nub kyi bdud: nag mo sha la gzer 'debs ma: ral pa spyir bcings byang gi bdud: ma mo nag mo khrag ral can: yab rnams khram shing zhags pa bsnams: yum kun spu gri mi snying bsnams: phyi yi gshed bzhir bcas pa la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob phyi yi gshed bzhi'i gnod pa bzlog gru chad lcags mkhar bcu gnyis nang : ste wa sa twa nag po dang :nor bu dge 'phel ser po dang : nag po 'dzum med ser nag dang : bye ba dgu khri nag po dang : raka glog 'phreng dmar po dang : ya ka gsod byed nag po dang : gtum po dud kha ral pa gdengs: gang ba kun 'joms dkar po dang : kha 'bar ral gcig mthing la sngo: sbrul mgo kun 'dzin sngo la skya: ngang pa stobs ldan kun na ser: rgyad pa stobs ldan nag la 'jigs: be con 'khor lo phyag na bsnams:—/89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zla gshed gshin rje bcu gnyis la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: zla gshed bcu gnyis gnod pa bzlog: zhag gi gshed po so gnyis ni: shar du khram thogs bdud po brgyad: chibasasu rta nag rting dkar chibs: lho yi gshin rje chu glang zhon: 'khor lo be con phyag na bsnams nub na ma mo drel nag zhon: phyag na nad rkyal thun zor bsnams: byang du gnod sbyin bya nag zhon: phyag (9na sko ral gri zhags pa bsnams: zhag gi gshed po 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob zhag gshed sum brgya'i gnod pa bzlog shar sgor dkar po snying 'dzin dang :lho sgor mgon po nag po dang : nub sgor bdud po yab rje dang : byang sgor gnod sbyin sku mar dmar:phyag na 'khor lo thun khrag bsnams: sku la tse ber khra bo gsol: yum mchog mkha' 'gro ro langasabazhi: mi lpags rlon pa'i na bza' gsol: phyag g.yas ma tre ro dbyug 'phyar: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu g.yon: sgo bzhi sgrol ging 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: gshed bzhi pho snya gnod pa bzlog phyi rol dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : za ma'i gshin rje bcu drug ni: pho gshed sum brgya drug cu dang : mo gshed sum brgya drug cu dang : gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu ni: phyag na 'khor lo thun khrag bsnams: chibs su mi dmar rta la chibs: gshed chen bdun brgya nyi shu la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: las gshed rbod gtong gnod pa bzlog:gshin rje phyogs skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs: sa chu me rlung sprin dang dur khrod bdag mkha' la rgyu dang dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ma: zhing skyong ging dang laṅga bstan ma'i tshogs: 'jig rten kun tu khyab par rgyug byed pa: las kyi gshin rje pho nya 'khor bcas la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob: pho nya gshin rje'i rbod ga sto gnod pa bzlog: de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ sman rag gtor gsum tshig dang bstun nas dbul zhing 'di skad do/ /bh+yo/ da ni bzlog pa'i dus la bab da ni bsgyur ba'i dus la bab: 'jigs su rung (9ba tha'i dur khrod na: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong : ma he phyogs skyong dregs pa'i steng : gshin rje'i rgyal po tshe bdag ni: g.yas dkar lha yi chad pa bzlog:—/90

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)g.yon dmar ma mo'i chad pa bzlog: dbus mthing bdud kyi cho 'phrul bzlog: phyag drug rgyud drug rbod gtong bzlog dbu la khyung chen 'bar ba yis: sa bdag klu gnyan byad than bzlog: yum mchog za byed pe ta li sbyor yum dbyings yum 'khor bcas kyis: srid pa ma mo'i cho 'phrul bzlog: gyad gnon sprul pa'i lha brgyad kyis: lha srin sde brgyad cho 'phrul bzlog bdud rtsi chang gi mchod pa 'bul:srid pa pho rgyud cho 'phrul bzlog: rak+ta khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: srid pa mo rgyud cho 'phrul bzlog: dmar gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul byad dang rbod gtong cho 'phrul bzlog: dbu la nor bu 'bar bas brgyan:rnal 'byor tshe srings dpal yang skyed bh+yoḥ tshangs pa brgya byin lha yi gdon: 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: dga' bo 'jog po klu yi gdon: brjid pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin gdon gzer ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: za byed rngam pa srin po'i gdon:drag po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol gtso mo kha 'bar yi dwags gdon: ba 'ad pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: phag gdong 'jigs pa sha za'i gdon: gtum po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol:byi na ya ka bgegs kyi gdon: 'gying ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: khyab 'jug byi nu gza' yi gdon: drag po'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: khram thogs gri thogs ging gi gdon: sprul pa'i stobasakyis bzlog tu gsol kha bzhir mgyogs pa btsan gyi gdon: 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: hal pa phya sangs gshin (10na)rje'i gdon: sprul pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: ral pa gsig pa ma mo'i gdon: gsung gi stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol rol pa skya bdun dmu yi gdon/mgo brtan brjid pas bzlog tu gsol: ma hā de wa mu stegs gdon bden pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo/ 'ja' 'khyil lha yi ltas ngan yin lha yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: seng ge gshin rje'i ltas ngan yin: gshin rje'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol dom gzig ma mo'i ltas ngan yin ma mo'i ltasang na bzlog tu gsol: 'ug pa dmu yi ltasang na yin: dmu yi ltas ga bzlog tu gsol: pho rog mgon po'i ltas ga yin mgon po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sha ba btsan gyi ltas ngan yin: btsan —191—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sprul nag klu yi ltasang na yin: klu yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: bya nag bdud kyi ltas ngan yin: bdud kyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: zhe tso klu srin ltas ngan yin: klu srin ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: gla ba sman gyi ltas ngan yin: sman gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: bya rgod rgyal po'i ltas ga yin: rgyal po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: srin bya the'u rang ltasang na yin: the'u rang ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: bu shud 'gong po'i ltas ngan yin: 'gong po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: khrung khrung dre mo'i ltas ngan yin: dre mo'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: srod la bya pho 'tsher ba gnam the'i ltas ngan yin: gnam the'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: tho rang sgo khyi ngu ba bar the'i ltasangan yin: bar the'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod wa mo brgyal ba sa the'i ltas ngan yin:sa the'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: spyang sngon rgyug pa pho rgyud ltas ngan yin: pho rgyud ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: gla ba grong rgyug mo rgyud ltas ngan yin: mo rgyud ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: lha khang 'od rnams rgyal po'i ltas ngan yin: rgyal po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sdig sprul klu yi ltas ngan yin:klu yi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sbal srin sa bdag ltas ngan yin: sa bdag ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sre mo byi khyer gnod sbyin ltas ngan yin: gnod sbyin ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: ri bya khyim zhugs gnyan gyi than: gnyan gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: khyim du ro than 'gong po'i than: 'gong po'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sha pho ru 'dzings rje dpon than rje dpon ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol:nya mo rnga 'dzings bran gyi than: bran gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol bya nag sder 'dzings chung ma'i than:bye bral ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: 'dre bya sreg pa chung sri'i than: (10ba〉dung sri'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: ban+de ho ma par bu'i than: ban de'i ltas ga bzlog tu gsol: bon po'i bco zor zhang zhung than: bon po'i btso zor ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs glang zor mi kha'i than: mi kha'i rgya than ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: sha mo khyim gang mi nad than: khyim gang mi nad ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: ra gang nor la spu than byung : god 'dre god kha'i ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: bang gang sris —192

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)la byi than byung : 'gong po'i sris than ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: yul than srid pa'i btsa' than byung :btsa' sad ser gsum ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: dgra gshed dur len btso than byung ཿ slo 'gong btso than ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i gtad sel byung : byad ma 'dum gyi ltas༅ bzlog tu gsol: bh+yo bh+yo snang ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bar chad rkyen la bh+yo: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bh+yo: mas kyi sri ru langs pa bh+yo: chung bdud mkha' la 'jab pa bh+yo: mi bdud gshed du khol ba bh+yo: ltag par gshed dril byed pa bh+yo: mdun nas rtsang bzhin 'dzugs pa bh+yo: rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'breng ba bh+yo: ngos la sprel ltar 'dzeg pa bh+yo: yul mi dgra sdang byed pa bh+yo: thams cad gcig tu dril nas kyang : phung po khams dang skye mched rnams: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gzugs su dril: nya bo 'di la bkug byas nas: phur 'debs thun dang mtshon chas bsad:bsgral ba'i zhing gyur las la sbyar: dpal chen tshe bdag zhal du stob: 'khor dang gshin rje 'bum phrag gi /dgyes par rol cig kha raṃ ji hi lhag ma med par zhal du stob: gzugs phung sha khrag mchod par bzhes: dam tshig nyams chags so sor bshags: thugs dam skongs la dngos grub stsol:bar chad rkyen ngan gdug rtsub bzlog: bsams (11)pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: 'phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs 'gro ba 'jam dpal sa thob shog: ces thun gtor dang gser skyems thog khar 'bul zhing mā ra ya'i drag brdung byed ring slob dpon gyis dmod mo brjod cing thal mo brdab/ rtsa gsum gtor mar sman raka sbran te dpal 'bar btsugs la/ chad mtho ni/ hūṃ/ bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong sngon rol du/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na/ /spros bral chen po kun tu bzang po yis/ /bya rtsol bral ba'i yid chos bstan pa'i tshe/ /rigs lnga bde chen mkha' dbyings bkod pa'i tshogs/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /de rjes 'gro ba'i —/93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)don la dgongs pa'i tshe/ /slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ /'jam dpal dra ba 'bum sde dpe la bkod/ /ma gshin yongs kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /bka' srung gshin rje drug khris srog snying phul/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ khyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /de rjes slob dpon sharnyi gar+bha dang / /mu stegs bzlog pa'i stobs can sngags bzlog rtsod/ /snying gzer nag po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /sdig pa snying 'dzings mu stegs bstan pa bcad/ /dregs pa bco brgyad rang srog phul pa'i tshe/ /dregs pa ma lus 'dus nas srog snyeng phul/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ khyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /de rjes slob dpon bha su dha ra yis/ /bka' yi (11bsgo chordo rten stobs chen bzhedas pa'i tshe las kyi gshin rje'i srog snying zhal yang bstan/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ khyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /de rjes sangs rgyas ye shes rin chen gyis/ /phye ring rnam gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /mchod rten lus la bkod nas bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /ma gshin zhal bstan dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /bka' srung sde brgyad dam la thogs pa'i tshe/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor bar chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /da lta sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ /dkyil 'khor mchod rten lus dkyil gtor ma bshams/ /bka' bzhin phog pa'i srung ma dam can rnams/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor bu bzin skyong bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor bar /94

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)chad bzlog par ma chad dam/ khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du gtor ma long / /ji ltar dam bcas bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /rol chen gyi tshe slob dpon gyis 'phrin bcol byas mthar gtor ma thog tu phul ba'i bshal chus bstan ma bskyang / mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ smon lam shis brjod kyi bar dkyus bzhin no/ /sang zor 'phen pa'i nyin snga mar bzlas pa'i dus zor skor bya ba ni/ bzlog pa g.yu'i spyang mo bzla ba'i tshe raka mo n+ta rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sku 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar gcod spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan thams cad e nan yaṃ bzlog 'drid bh+yo sogs kyi rjes su thal mo lan gsum brdab/ de'i tshe phyogs gtor nas brtsams te bzlog gtor gyi bar go rim ma 'phyugs par g.yas skor du bskor zhing mtshams kyi lag ma 'gags pa rnams kyis bzlog mtshams su thal rdeb byed/ de nas bsgrig lugs kyang kha bsgyur phyag lan ltar bya/ gzhan ma cho ga dkyus ba'i na la/ zor lam dbye ba ni/ bzlog gzhung gi byad ma 'bum gyi ltas ga bzlog tu gsol yan (12na〉spyab mtshams/ dpon slob rnams thog tu byon/ gser skyems/ lhag ma/ dkar gtor rnams gtong zhing phyag rgya bstan/ kha phrus btab/gtor snod nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhal zas hūṃ gis dngos zlog bsregs/ /āḥyis nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /ā+oṃ gyis mos pa ji lta bar/ /lho yis bdud rtsi nyid du bsgyur/ /gzugs ni bsgral ba'i dngos por gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& sngo zhes slob dpon rkyang pas brlab/ bsngo ba'i bar dkyus bzhin song nas/ sgo dbye ni/ hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan/ /gtor ma'i lam bstan shar du bstan/ shar du rgyal po yul 'khor srung / /dri za pho mo'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku gzur de ni spyan byol cig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zer skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan/ /gtor ma'i lam bstan lho ru bstan/ /lho ru rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /gshin rje mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku —195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gzur de ni spyan byol cig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zor skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan/ /gtor ma'i lam bstan nub tu bstan/ /nub tu rgyal po spyan mi bzang / /klu dbang mang po'i 'bor gyis bskor/ri/sku gzur de ni spyan byol cig /gtar zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zer skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan/ /gtor ma'i lam bstan byang du stan/ /byang du rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku gzur de ni spyan byol cig /gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/khrag zor dmar po khyil li li/ /thun zor ser phran nyil li li/ /mda' zer skar ltar brengs se breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims se thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/steng gi lha la zor mi 'phen/ /lha chen brgyad (12ba)po zhabs sdus shig /'og gi klu la zor mi 'phen/ /klu chen brgyad po dbu 'phang smod/ /bar gyi gnyan la zor mi 'phen/ /gnyan chen sdebazhi sku gzur cig /drag po gshin rje'i gtor zor 'di/ /sdang ba'i dgra la gtar zor yā/ /dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas cho de/ /gnod pa'i dgra la khrag zor yā/ /mo rgyud khrag gi mngal nas skoms/ /thun zor bu rgyud tsha la yā/ /bu tsha bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod/ /mda' zor sgo yi nor la rgyob/ /sgo nor god 'dre'i phyags mas thob/ /thod zor nang khang sris la yā/ /phyags mas thal ba rlung la skur/ /phur zor dgra yi snying la yā/ /drag po gri 'thab nad kyis gsod/ /rdo zor dgra bo'i mkhar la yā/ /skye bo 'khor gyi rgyun lam chod/ /byad kha bzlog la phur kha sgyur/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i tshig dang bstun phyogs gtor 'phen zhing mthar phyag len ltar gser skyems gtor/ zor bskul las kong zor ni/ /ri rab tshad mnyam stobs chen kong bu'i zor/ /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs bu sdug —/96

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'byug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i zor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobs rdul du rlog /lus ngag yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ /phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ che ge mo'i srog la thun rmugs bh+yo/ srog la kham shag bh+yo/ srog la (13na)breng shag bh+yo/ srog la yaṃ shag bh+yo/ srog la mā ra ya rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la rbad thum ril li li bh+yo/ zor sngags 'og ma rnams la 'gre /rdo thor ni/ rdo zor ri rab thogs pa'i gnod sbyin dpung / /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'gyug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i zor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobs rdul du rlog /lusang ga yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ /mda' zor ni/ gshin rje'i dmag tsho gos thog mda'i zor 'phen pa/ /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'khyug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i zor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobs rdul du zlog /lus ngag yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ khrag zor ni/ dal yams 'phyo ba khrag zor ma mo'i tshogs/ /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogasabu yug 'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo slog ltar 'byug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i thor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobs rdul du rlog /lus ngag yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ /yungs zor ni/khro mtshon bdud po khram thogs yungs kyi zor/ /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'byug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i zor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobasardul du rlog /lus ngag yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ /rwa zor ni/ sdebargyad dug mtshon 'khrug pa rwa yi —197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zor/ /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'byug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i zor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ / ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobs rdul du rlog /lus ngag yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ /gter zor ni/ /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rol pa gtor ma'i zor/ /rtse mor mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub/ /rked par zor bdag pho mo glog ltar 'byug /rtsa bar ru dra'i khrag mtshor zhing dum 'phyo/ /drag po'i zor sna dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /ban bon mthu byad bzlog la rang gshed phob/ /bsod nams rlung rta nus stobs rdul du rlog /lusang ga yid gsum srog la mā ra ya/ /zhes so so'i bskul dang bstun nas zor gzhan rnams dang gtor bskul gyi rjes su/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /zhes sogs kyi bskul dang bcas te drag rol gyi tshe bzlog sngags dang dmod mo zab mo btags nas thun gtor 'phen zhing thal mo dgu phrugs su brdab/ bshal chur 'bru tshom dang bcas te bstan ma bskyang / srung 'khor bsgom/ sgrub khang du chad mtho gtor mar sman rag sbran zhing mchod pa nas shis brjod gyi bar dkyus ltar gtong / sang nyin phyi rol du gdab las mi spro na bzlog gzhung gi tshe zhal bsgyur lam dkar 'then/ mchod gtor sogs gtor chen la sbran pa phyag len bzhin byas nas/byad ma 'bum gyi ltas ngan bzlog tu gsol/ zhes pa'i dus dmag lto'i tshul du zur gyi khrag chang bzhi nas gtor mar sbran te gtor chen bteg /mā ra yu'i drag brdung gi tshe/ slob dpon gyis rwa zor thogs la lam 'gros len bzhin pas phyir 'thon te gser skyems nas sgo dbye'i bar nub snga ma ltar la tshogs lhag 'don ring dkar gtor bteg tsam ma gtogs mi gtong / zor 'chams dang bcas te bskul dang bstun nas zor sna re 'phen zhing rwa zor 'phen tshul bya/ slob dpon gyis rwa zor dang zor gzhu thogs te sna drangs gtor ma 'phen sar gser skyems/ srid pa hu/ de nas dmigs yul dgug gzhug byas rjes/ bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /zhes sogs nas drag rol gyi zor rnams sngags dang bcas te rim bzhin brdeg /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs zhes sogs kyi bskul dang bcas gtor ma —/98

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khana'aphen/ phod ga'i sne gnyis bzung ba'i dul mo dang thal brdab dmod pa byed/ bshal chus bstan ma skyong / srung 'khor dang me chus rgyas 'debs/ spyang mo dang u sgri dzi'i sngags bzlas bzhin par slob dpon gyis rjes mnan te tshur log nas sgo drung du zor snod rnams kha sbub/ slob dpon gyis dgra bgegs dam sri rnams dgug gzhug bya/ bro brdung ba ni/ hūṃ/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ / kun kyang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ khro bo 'das pas nam mkha' gang / khro mo 'dus pas bar snang gang /khro chung 'dus pas sa gzhi gang / /thams cad (14na tshe sku dus pa'i ngang nyid las/ /rkang pa g.yas kyis bro brdungs pas/ /pho sri thams cad g.yas su mnan/ /rkang pa g.yon gyis bro brdungs pas/ /mo sri thams cad g.yon du mnan/ /gnyis su med par bro brdungs pas/ / chung sri dam sri rdul du rlog /bro 'di ye shes chen po'i bro/ /dgra rnams thal bar rlog pa'i bro/ /bdud rnams phye mar 'thag pa'i bro/ /de phyir glu bro rgyun mi 'chad/ // bha sogs dang / shar du zhi ba'i bro brdungs pas/ / dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar shog /mye a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa/ khyoḥspyi wi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ shān+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ byang du drag po'i bro brdungs pas/ /dgra bgegs dam sri med par shog /mā ra ya phaṭa/nub du dbang gi bro brdungs pas/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang bsdud shog /pa shaṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ lho ru rgyas pa bro brdungs pas/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog /pusti ku ru ye swāhā/ rgyas pa'i gsol byang gi tshe gtor snod rnams kha skyen la slob dpon gyis 'bru tshom blug go /phyi rol du 'gros dang bstun nas gdab las rgyas par byed na chad lhag mi 'byung ba'i phyir tshogs tha ma las byang gi dkyus bzhin btang / bzlog gzhung gi byad ma 'bum gyi ltasang na bzlog tu gsol/ zhes pa'i mtshams su gtor zor sgrub khang gi sgo'i nang tsam du sbags/ gser skyems/ tshogs lhag /sgo dbye rnams bya/mdor gser skyems nas bzung ral gris gtub pa'i bar dang stob pa (14ba)'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ stong gsum khengs pa'i skur bzhengs nyi zla'i spyan/ /gzings la gnam sa'i zhal gdongs glog dmar ljags/ khyongs shig gangs ri lta bu'i mche gtsigs nas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs —/99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bzhes shig /ces 'chams dbyangs dang bstun gdab las rgyas pa ji lta ba la liṅkar nang zor rdeg pa tsam ma gtogs gong dang 'dra/ nang du slebs nas tshe 'gugs/ gtang rag gi tshul du bam bskang gtong / chad mtho dang bcas chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams thog steng du 'bul/ sgrub gtor dang bam la sman raka sbran te gtang rag /bzod gsol gyis bshams/ bam dngos grub kyi tshul du rol/ rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol dang yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'bor bsdu/ smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong gi /snying rtsa dmar chen zor gyi mtshon rnon pos/ /gcod dang lhan cig sgrib gnyis ye shes gris/ /bcad de bde chen sa la rol bar shog /'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi zur rgyan zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba 'di ni se brgya mkhar pa/ nub dgon pa/ chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can yab sras kyi phyag bzhes zur thams cad mkhyen pa las thos pa dang gsung rgyun 'dzin pa'i rjes 'brang du mar bgros pa'i steng sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma 'phrin las kyi zin bris nyid gtso bor bzung gdab las kyi legs cha gshin rje khro chu nas kyang blangs (15na)te za hor gyi sngags smyon drag po rtsal gyis rta chen zla ba'i dmar cha khrag 'thung rol pa'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// //sarba maṅga lo// //—200

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma yarwadzāñca49〉dhe ji kālā su sha tre spe/ rgya chen gting mtha' gzhal dka'i bde chen chos dbyings zla ba'i ma mar dus kun g.yo med ngang nyid las/ sna tshogs 'gro blo'i bcu gnyis khyim du mtha' yas longs spyod rdzogs sku nyin byed dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /au ṭi ya na'i sin dhu rgya mtshor chu skyes rta dmar la brten sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun dngos khyod kyi zhabs sen bdag snying pad dkar ze'u 'brur 'god pa'i dge legs stsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /ye shes srung ma'i ded dpon gshin rje'i gshed/ /rno myur 'jig rten gza' bdud ltar bsgrub pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin gnubs chen khu dbon phyag gi yul/ /'jig bral zab gter rdo rje'i pha lam gyi/ /'phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba dum pa rgya/ /bdud sde'i dpung 'joms sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /'byul med brgyud par bcas la gus pas 'dud/ /phun tshogs dpal 'byor a ti'i gling bzhi la/ /lhun grub lung rtogs gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /thogs med dbang bsgyur rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /'khon ston chos rje yab sras rtag tu rgyal/ /sngon chad phyi nang gsang ba'i skor gsum du/ /gab 'byugs thor bu'i tshul du mnan pa'i las/ /snod ldan slob bu rnams kyi don ched dang / /bstan pa'i btsas su lag len khyad du sdebs/ /de la 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid byang phyogs gangs ris bskor ba'i (2na tshe rdzongs su gsang sngags gsar rnying zhes yongs su grags pa'i rnying ma'i phyogs su sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag sogs dang / gsar mar yang gshed skor mgon chen sde bzhi sogs las/ 'phrin las bzhi'i bsgrubs tshul spyi dang bye brag mngon spyod kyi las sbyor ji snyed cig mchis na'ang / 'gran gyi do —201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2named 'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon du grags shing don la gnas pa'i phyir/ 'di nyid kyi mnan pa'i las sbyor bri bar bya ste/ de yang bka' 'byed gser gyi lde mig las/ /bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyi/ /drag sngags tshe bdag nag po las/ /yang gces zab pa'i skor gsum la/ /phyi skor lcags 'dra'i skor dang gcig /nang skor thog 'dra'i skor dang gnyis/ /gnam lcags thog me'i skor dang gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lcags 'dra dang gnam lcags thog chen gnyis kur mnan pa'i skor 'dra min tsam bshad pa las/ skabs 'dir bka' 'byed du/ g.yon nas rgyu ma'i ro ma las/ /mnan pa ri rab stobs chen byung / /zhes pa ltar/ gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde nas gsungs pa'i mnan pa'i lag len khrig chags su rgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i gsung ltar sdebs par bya'o/ /'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi cho ga las/ dang po la gang du bya ba'i gnas/ gang gis bya ba'i sgrub pa po/ /gang der mkho ba'i yo byad bshams pa dang gsum las dang po ni/ bsgrub (2ba)thabs su/ gnas ni dur khrod du bya/ brag ri nag po mon pa khros pa 'dra ba'am/ lho phyogs su kha bltas pa shin tu mnyan par phyin la/ zhes rab tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bar byed pa'am/ yang brgyud las/dge zhing nyams dga'i gnas dag tu/ /zhes dam pa gong ma rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs shing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su skye bo'i 'du 'dzis dben pa'i sgrub khang du bya ba ni/ ding sang gi skye bo rnams kyi blo dang 'tsham zhing bar chad nyung ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod la/ 'on kyang drag po'i las la sbyar ba'i tshe dur khrod dam/ de'i nye 'brel sogs dang dam can dngos bzhugs pa lta bu'i rtsub 'gyur ston pa'i gnas su bya ste/ drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud las/ dur khrod gdugs pa'i dben gnas su/ /mchog gsum tshang ba'i mtshams bcad la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dad dang brtson 'grus me ltar 'bar ba dang / shes rab che zhing phyogs med slob pa dang / /dad pa che zhing gzungs thob blo brtan pa/ /dam tshig gtsor 'dzin sgom phran che ba dang / /rang rig blo ldan chos nyid don rtogs dang / /zhes gsungs pa dang / zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ lta ba dbang bgrod dam ldan —202

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)pas/ /sems kyi 'du 'dzi med pa sa /dpa' brtul sngags kyi dmod pa dbab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa spyi dang / khyad par zhe sdang thabs rgyud gshin rje gshed kyi cho gel mi ldog pa'i dad pa nga ldan pa/ zab mo'i chos nyid nyan cing nyams su len pa rnams la brtson 'grus che ba/ rgyud 'grel gyi tshig don kun la chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis tshul bzhin dpyod par nus pa/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung kun la phyogs lhung dang bral bas slob cing / lam gyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa srog ltar gces spras su byed pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa sogs phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin la/ de yang dper na/ rin po che mchog dag sor mo'i 'du byed legs par shes pa'i bzo bo la brten nas/ji ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi sprul bsgyur 'byung ba bzhin slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen (3na)gyis/ goms pa sngon sbyangs mang thos chos rnams shes/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i don rtogs gti mug med/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med gzungs ma 'du/ /bla ma'i man ngag thob pa'i gdengasaldan pa/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma dam pa bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngags lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can mngon du gyur pa sogs yon to yongs su rdzogs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du/ smin byed kyi dbang / rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / man ngag gi dka' gnad kun la/ deng sang gi chen por rlom pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar ltar thos lo mthong lo ma yin pa'i gting phyin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa/'di nyid bsnyen cing bsgrub pa la dgos pa'i phyi nang gi mchod rdzas rten dang bcas pa gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin grub cing / gong bsnyen sngon du song bas mtshan ma thob pa'i rigs sngags 'chang ba zhig dgos so/ /gsum pa ni/ da lta gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gsar rnying gi sngags 'chang phal cher zhig /rang nyid la blo legs par bkal te skyabs su 'dzin pa'i yon bdag gi khyim dag tu/ bsog khra bri tshe rang la nye bar gang mkho bri ba sogs rang gzhan thams cad bslu ba'i bya ba la 'jug pa ma gtogs/ las spyi dang mnan pa la dgos nges kyi rdzas rnams rna ba'i bu gar zur tsam yang ma son pa mang zhing / de dag gi rjes su zhugs pas long bas long ba khrid pa'i rkyen gyis gnyis phung gi g.yang la —203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'phyan pa'i skye bo rnams la yid lhag par brtse yang / gsar rnying gi las rab 'byams mtha' dag bri ba'i jo ma thog mod/ zil gnon mnan pa'i las tshogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams zhib par bri ba ni/dgra bgegs gang la bya yang / maṇ+ḍal dang 'brub khung gi rgyu ni/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ bde gshegs 'dus pa/ ki gang dmar nag /khro chu gur zhal sogs gsar rnying gi mngon spyod kyi las kun la cung zad 'dra min tsam las phal cher mthun la/ de yang bsrung bzlog bsad mnan gyi las rnams lhun gyis grub byed/ dril sgrub dam pa rgya mdud (3ba)chen po bsnol mar brtsegs pa'i las mchod rten nag po yongs su rdzogs pa grub na/ mnan pa ri rab stobs chen 'di nyid la bca' bzhi logs su mi dgos kyang / ma 'grub pa'am gnas khang gzhan du dgos pa sogs byung tshe/ sdig pa snying 'dzings las phung shul mi mi bsad g.yul bkye dang / dur khrod ro yi sa dag la/ /ro bsregs rdo dang sol ba dang / /gri lcags dpa' bo g.yul bsad khrag /ra dug re lcags a shwa gan/ /grogs mkhar ras spyin khron shun nag ti sgog 'dag tshe chu sbyar te rtsigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phung shul gyi sa/ mi bsad pa'i sa/ g.yul sprad pa'i sa/ dur khrod kyi sa/ ro bsregs pa rdo sol ba/ dpa' bo grir bsad pa'i khrag dug sna/ shā sbud kyi sa/ grog mkhar gyi sa/ gri lcags sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs brdar ba'i phye ma lha srin drag po gnas pa'i sa/ thogs ser rgyab babs kyi sa/ rdza gsar pa spyin po/ shog 'dag /rdzas de rnams skru byed chu mig gnyan po'i chu/ dug khrag dug sna tshogs btab pa'i chu/ byug rdzas/ dug khrag /gri khrag /ro sol lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas gu gul/ yugs sa mo'i zhabs ma/ rme khrag tan na pa'i lham skrad/ tshil chen/ rwa bzhog /rta bon/ khyi lud/ mi blun/ mu zi/ sgog skya/ mdze khrag ri khro dang spu nag gi rtsa ba/ ra mag kyi rkyo ma/ bung bu'i bangs/ la jug pa'i snod/ bya rgod/ ngang pa/ bya rog /byi ba/gcan zan/ grum pa/ glang / mdzo/ drel/ phag pa/ ra/ khyi/ skyes grir shi ba/ rab chad/ mon pa/gzhan yang mi non pa'i thod pa bzhi ma gtogs/ mi rnams kyi thod pa ja ril glang sa lha 'dre sgod kyi gnon na/ 'khrid kha rin chen phreng bar gsungs pa'i gzhan la med pa'i khro bo'i dbang po 'di'i khyad —2()4

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)chos sde brgyad bye brag tu mnan pa'i skabs su/ sde brgyad so so'i liṅga 'jug pa'i snod so sor bshad la/ 'jug rgyu'i 'khor lo so sor snang yang / skabs 'dir rigs pa'i mdas drangs pa dam pa'i phyag len no/ /sgril ba'i tshas/ re nag /'ching byed thag pa tshon skud sna lnga/ yugs skra/ ro skra/ mnan pa'i sa/sa tshon sna lnga/ brang ba'i thun rdzas/ gu gul/ rgya chil/ (4na)mu zi/ bong tshil/ tshil chen/ ra khrag /mngal khrag /mdze khrag nyung dkar nag /skye tshe/ mtshon cha brdar ba'i bye ma/ de la sbol rgyu'i rlon thun/ kha gcod ro g.ya' mam/ rang thag ya khod/ gzhan yang tshwa/ ba tshwa/ bu tog /g.yer ma/dug shog /la cha sogs dang / rang bsrung gi rdzas nyin gcig la mdze thod rlon pa stong / klu gdol ba gnas pa'i chu mig la brgyab pa sogs rtsub spyod kyi cil bka byas kyang / lha srin sde brgyad kyis/ mig blta ba tsam yang mi nus pa'i rdo rje'i pha lam lta bu'i dug khrag tu grags pas/ dpal rdo rje phur pa nas rgyas par gsungs shing / de'i snying po lta bu rigs 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pa'i gter pa lcags sdong mar grags pa rdo rje gtum mo'i las tshogs dang / rgya phur bu'i gter ma'i bum thang ma dang lcags sdong ma gnyis nas bshad pa ltar gang zung lag tu lon na/ mnan pa'i las sbyor 'di tsam du ma zad/ drag po'i las gang la yang mchog du bsngags kyang / da lta nor 'dzin gyi lto bar rig sngags 'chang ba'i khur 'dzin gyis khengs na yang / dug khrag gces pa dud 'gro'i khrag rlon par btsan dug gi phye ma btab pa zhig yin nam snyam pa las/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phrul 'khor phul du byung ba'i tshul mig dang rna ba'i dga' ston du gyur pa ni nyin skar tsam du snang bas/ shin tu dkon cing don chen po dang ldan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang chos mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan legs par soms la/ shes ldan kun gyis rig 'dzin pa rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal las blang bar byos shig /g.yin yang / gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sder gong dang cha mtshungs pa'i rdzas bsrung dang / mchod rten nyams su blangs pa'i spra khrid nas gsungs pa'i rdzas sna bdun dang gter kha gzhan nas byung ba'i rdzas bsrung zab mo ches phra ba yod pa las/ dug khrag yod —205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)na 'di rnams dang mi ldan yang 'gal ba med la/ de (4ba〉ltar ma yin na sngar bshad pa rnams las sna re med du mi rung ngo / /spyir drag po'i las sbyor dus rang bsrung ba gal che bas/ ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa gnad/ 'dogs rgyu'i 'khor lo sku gsung thugs dang bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi za yig rnam ba la bri gzhi/ byug rdzas/ lteb tshul/ za lugs dmigs pa sogs snying gi khrag lta bu'i man ngag rnams kyang glegs bam du yod pa tsam ma yin par lag tu blang bar bya ba ni gnad yin no/ /des na gong du bshad pa'i rdzas de dag thams cad ming tsam shes pas chog pa ma yin te/ de rnams kyi ngo bo/ngos 'dzin lugs/ 'ga' zhig tu sbyar lugs dang / bzo dbyibs dang / tshad kyi khyad par dang / yul la brten nas 'jug snod brtag pa dang / 'debs rgyu'i sngags dang / 'khel lugs dang / ri mo bri tshul sogs shin tu zhib pa'i man ngag gi gnad mtha' dag mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len dang /rigs 'dzin bla ma mchog gis zhal gyi bdud rtsi las myang bar bya'o/ /smras pa/ sna tshogs rdzas kyi glog stong 'brug sgra dang / /'khrul med gdams pa'i char sprin stug po las/ /mngon spyod gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog chen gyis/ /dgra bgegs brag ri 'joms par gdon mi za/ /e ma yang zab rdzas kyi 'khrul 'khor mchog /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhed man ngag gis/ /legs brgyan sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa rje'i/ /gzhal med drin las kho bos rdzogs par thob/ /gtan gyi bde las phyir phyogs 'di snang gis/ /bya bzhag 'jig rten phal pa'i rjes zhugs kyang / /'gro kun 'dren pa'i khur 'chang stobs kyi bdag /chen po 'ur rgyang can tsho'i spyod yul min/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lag len gyi dngos gzhi dang / sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/maṇ+ḍal/ 'khor lo liṅga sogs brtsigs pa dang bri ba'i dus su gza' skar gyi 'phrod sbyor srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi thebs/ sa bdag gdug pa can rgyu ba sogs rtsi dgos pa/ de yang mchod rten yongs rdzogs nyams su blang ba'i pra khrid du/ dmigs (ldan)dmar dang phur bu dar ba la/ rwa hu la dang bstun 2(36

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)te rtsi dgos/ tha skar ram bra nye lag sor la sogs pa la bya'o/ /zhes rag rim tsam las zhib par gzhan du blta bar dgongs shing / yig cha gzhan du'ang gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / rtsis kyi gtsug lag la blo gros 'jug pa cung zad dang ldan pa'i sngags 'chang 'ga' la/ gzhan du blta ba'i khur spangs te 'khyer bde slad du gsal bar bkod na/ nyi ma smin drug zla ba khrag mig dmar skag /lhag pa chu/ phur bu mgo /pa sangs rgyal/ spen pa mon dre ste bdud nyi bdun dang / de bzhin gza' bdun rim par/ lha mtshams smin drug mon dre/ tha skar/ mgo /snar ma/ me bzhi ste 'chi sbyor/ mchu/ sa ga /lag /snubs/ mon dre/ bi rdzi/ chu stod de sreg sbyor bdun/ snubs/ byi zhun/ khrums smad/ smin drug nam so/ bre/ sa ri ste bdud rgyal bdun/ bcu gcig /nyer drug bcu dang / nyer lnga/ gsum/ bco brgyad/ drug /nyer gcig /gnyis/ bcu bdun/ bdun nyer gnyis te/ yar ngo dang mar ngo'i bsreg tshes/ gzhan yang gza' skar gyi khams dang bstun pa'i sa rlud / chu rlung / sa me sogs 'phrad pa dang /rtsa ba'i sgra gcan/ drang srong / gza' dgu'i bgrod pa'i gnas tshul/ thun phyed rwa hū/ yud tsam rwa hu/tshes kyi rwa hu/ zla phyed rwa hu rnams mtha' dag rtsi ba mchog tu gal che yang / rtsis rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan gra phugs pa'i thebs gzhung las/ khyad par dpa' bo'i rjes su dmag dpung bzhin/ /thun phyed thebs dang bstun pa man ngag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thun phyed rā 'a hā 'a rtsi tshul la nan tan du bya zhing nag rtsis su gsungs pa'i gza' dar rgud/ zin phung sogs sa bdag rnams kyi rgyu tshul dang /mdor na skar ma rnams kyi chu tshod yun ji tsam sdod sogs rtsi dgos la/ skar rtsis dang dbyangs 'char dag la thos bsam legs par song ba yin na/ rkang pa brgyad cu pa dang / spen pa'i 'khor lo sogs ji snyed cig gsungs pa (5ba〉rnams rtsis na las rnams 'grub pa myur bas legs pa yin no/ /thebasaphyogs su kha bstan la zin phung sogs sa bdag rgyu ba'i gdong ma thug par byas te/ rang nyid gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ bya sha zan gyi sgro rtse'i snyu gus ling ga dang 'khor lo rnams bri bar bya ba ni spyir ling ga la/ ling ga 'khor lo can dang / sngags can dang / ling rkyang dang gsum yod pa'i —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gsum gar 'khor lo sngags phreng rnams yod med tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan la ling ga bri tshul tshang ma gcig la/ deng sang ni ling ga zhes pa mi'i gzugs kyi dbyibs tsam bri ba las/ tshul gzhan shes pa'i sngags 'chang bsil ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar dkon pa 'di snying la gcags te gsal bar 'god do: de yang ling ga byad dbyibs bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan pa dang / shi ba ro'i rnam pa gnyis ka ma yin pa'i gcer bu nyams chung ba/ ngal zhing dub pa/ nyams thag pa/ gson po'i rnam pa can/ skra gzings shing kha mthur du blta ba/ yan lag bzhi lcags sgrog gis gdams pa ni ling ga spyi'i bri tshul yin 'i/ skabs 'dir lce phyir byung ba'i steng du 'khor lo bri ba ni/gtso bor dgra nus pa can gyi ngag mnan pa'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gnon tshe rat+na gling pa'i gter ma'i yang bzlog me'i spu gri las/ lus mnan tsakra mgo la bskor/ /ngag mnan tsakra lce la bskor/ /yid mnan tsakra snying la bskor/ /de ni man ngag dam pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya la/ 'on kyang lus ngag yid gsum sogs gcig char du mnon pa'i skabs su lce'i steng 'khor lo bskor bas/ lce 'og tu lus dang snying gnyis yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyi legs la/ de yang lce 'khor lo'i rgya khyon la dpag pa'i steng du tsakra ni/ khrid ka rin chen 'phreng ba las/ lce la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bskor/ rdo rje rgya gram mchod rten rab/ /mthing nag gru gsum zhes pa ltar/ /mu khyud lnga pa dbus su mchod rten/ de'i phyi rdo rje rgya gram de'i (6na)phyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bya la/ sngags 'god tshul 'di nyid lcags sdig kho na'i khyad chos las/ lcags 'dra sogs gzhan nas zhus dag pher ba med pa'i/rin chen phreng ba'i gzhung dang / bla ma'i man ngag bstun pa ma gtogs/ sngags 'god pa gsal bar bri ba dang / dpe'u chung du yi ge 'god pa sogs bka' rgya dam pas mi rung ngo / /ling ga 'khor lo can dang / sngags can/ rkyang pa sogs gang la'ang med du mi rung ba ni/ man ngag snying gzer nag po las/tsit+ta rin chen gur khang na/ /srog ces bya ba'i ngo bo de/ /rgyu ni dngas ma lnga las grub/ /dbyibs ni yi ge'i rnam par gnas/ /rnam shes yi ge 'bru gzhig go /rtsa gsum mkha' la btegs nas ni/ /btson —2(/8—

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanakhang 'od kyi nang na gnas/ /trig nan gnyis kyi steng nas gzir/ /rtsa nas kun gzhi rnam shes rgyud/ /de la 'phrog byed 'bru gsum gnas/ /tsit+ta snying gi phyogs bzhi nas/ /rtsa bzhi gyes nas rlung bzhi brgyu/ /de la gcod byed 'bru bzhi gnas/ /mgo bo la ni yig 'bru gsum/ /mgrin pa la ni yig 'bru bzhi/ /yan lag bzhi la gcod byed bzhi/ /steng 'og gnyis la e tri dang / 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sabon yin/ /de ltar rang la bdud langs nas/ /rang srog gcod par rang gshed do/ /ces pa'i don bshad na/ de nyid las/ ya gi bde gshegs zhi khro nas/ /'gong po srin po yan chod la/ /srog bzhi kun la yod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ srog bzhi las snying gar bri rgyu ni mi 'gyur srog ste/ mi la ni dang 'dre la tri bkod pa'i phyogs bzhin dza bzhi dang / rtsa gsum gyi steng du 'phrog byed kyi yig 'bru hur thum dza gsum/ steng du gzir byed kyi yi ge trig nan gnyis/ rlung bzhi gcod byed kyi 'bru bzhi mā ra ya rbad dang / mig gnyis su long long / rna ba gnyis su 'on 'on/ kha la bdud po nga long / lag pa gnyis la zha zha/ rkang pa gnyis la chag chag /rla 'og gnyis su tsha tsha/ rkang mthil gnyis su yaṃ yaṃ/ 'doms su phaṭa/ ces pa'i rang gshed dbab pa'i mtshon cha rnams tshang bar bri dgos la/ ling ga bri tshul spyi la med pa'i gshin rje gshed ki gang dmar nag nas bshad pa'i (6ba)lus la 'god rgyu'i yi ge rnams skabs 'dir gtso bor mnan pa'i las yin pas 'bri ba gnas yin no/ /de yang spyir liṅka'i lag gnyis lus kyi rgyab phyogs su bkyig pa'i tshul byed pa yin yang / sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi man ngag gi khyad chos su btsad bo/ slob ma dam nyams dam tshig gcig pa'i sngags pa/ bon po/ drag sngags/ urmo rnams la liṅka'i yan lag gi rnam 'gyur/ lus la mtshon cha/ srog chags gdug pa can gyis gzugs/'bri rgyu'i sngags rnams sgo sor gsungs te/ de skad du yang man ngag rtsab las/ las rgyal po bsad pa ni/ /tsakra spyang ku'i khog par bzhugs/ /thod pa seng ge'i khog par gnan/ /slob ma dam nyams bsad pa ni/ ling ga'i snying gar sdig pa gzhug /thod pa stag gi 'dzum la mnan/ /dam 'dres yi dam gcig pa la/ /liṅka'i snying gar sbal pa bzhugs/ /thod pa gzig gi thig ler mnan/ /dam mi gcig —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa'i sngags pa la/ /liṅka'i snying gar sbal pa bri/ /thod pa mun pa'i gling du mnan/ /bon po mu stegs bsad pa la/ snying khar dug gi phag pa bzhugs/ /ling ga srin mo'i sgroms su mnan/ /ā khro mkhan po nang 'gras na/ /drag sngags rnams dkrug bsnol mar brdeg /thod pa 'brong gi rwa la mnan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas dka' 'byed las/ rgyu tshil ster ma ring po las/ /btsad po bsad pa la sogs te/ /mnan pa las drug 'khor lo byung / /zhes pa ltar/ las mtha' drug gis bsad pa'i dmigs yul/ rin chen phreng bar las mtha' drug gi bsad pa ni/ 'khor lo drug gi bri thabs la/ /rgyal po seṅge'i khog tu bris/ /mnan pa brag dkar 'og tu mnan/ /slob ma stag gi khog par bri/ /lam ni rgya gram 'og tu mnan/ /sngags pa sdig pa'i khog par bri/ /mchod rten rgya mdud 'og tu mnan/bon po phag gi khog par bri/ /la rtsas sa mkhar 'og tu mnan/ /skye bo rus sbal khog tu bri/ /rgya mtsho rtu mig 'og tu mnan/ /bu med bya yi khog par bri/ /ri sna brag sna rnams su mnan/ /zhes pa ltar gyi yul so so'i dmigs (7na)bsal byung tshe/ so so'i khog par liṅga bri dgos la/ de yang seng ge sogs kyi khog par 'khor lo mu khyud lnga pa/ lte ba gru gsum pa/ zla gam gsum dang ldan pa/ mu khyud gnyis par rdo rje rgya gram/ mu khyud gsum par rtsibs bcu gnyis/ mu khyud lnga par rtsibs nyi shu/ liṅga sngags dang bcas pa man ngag dang / dpe chung bstan nas las mtha' drug gi 'khor lo/ nang rgyas 'khor lo/ las bcu'i 'khor lo zhes pa/ btsad po/ slob ma dam 'das ā slo mkhan dang sde/ ma mo mkhan dang / gshin rje mkhan dang / bon dang mu stegs/ drag sngags mkhan/ bya khyung mkhan/ sngags pa gtad mkhan rnamasal rim pa bzhin/ seng ge kha 'thab/ stag mo kha 'thab/ rdo rje dme 'thab/ glang chen mche thab/ shwa ṇa lce 'thab/ khyung mo gshog 'thab/ pho nya rkang 'gyogs bzlog pa/ gnam lcags thog 'khor/ rma bya 'jing ston/ rus sbal lto sdebs/ sbrul nag kha 'thab ste bcu po'i bri tshul phal cher gong ma drug dang mtshungs la/ sdom pas 'khor lo bcu drug po 'di rnams mtshan tsam gyis kyang dga' rab dbang phyug sde dang bcas pa 'dang bar byed pa'i gnam lcags kyi thog lta bu sdig brgyud nas gsungs pa'i rab 'byams —2/khri

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanamangon spyod kyi las 'di nyid kyis 'grub la/ snying dang 'dra ba yin pas dka' ba'i gnas kyi zhib cha mtha' dag la/ tha snyad dang rtog ge'i tshig tsam la chen pa'i 'chal ba'i shes rab kyi ma sbags pa'i/bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis myos pa'i theg pa mchog gi rigs can dag gis chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis zhib mor dpyod par byos shig /de nas stong srog 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ spyang mo drug gi las gang byed kyang med du mi rung ba yin la/ skabs 'dir yang mnan pa g.yu'i spyang mo'i rno 'don dgos pas bri tshul yang / 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi pa/ lte bar gru gsum zla gam gsum dang ldan/de'i phyi rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyi 'phrul mig nyer brgyad/ de'i phyi 'phrul mig nyer dgu rnams la liṅga sngags dang bcas pa man ngag dpe (7ba〉rgyang dang bstun la bri bar bya'o/ /de nas liṅka'i lus dang /dbang po'i sgo rnams dang / ling ga 'khor lo gnyis ga'i sngags la rno 'don rgyu'i rdzas rnams byug rjes ling ga la khrag drod rlung sha rus/ sems can rnams chags pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ sngags rnams brjod la/ de nas rang gi kha rlangs dri ma dag pa dang / tshur mi bzlog pa/ dgra la mi thebs mi srid cing / gzhan du 'byams pa'i gnad/ dgra thams cad tshe zad/ rgyags chad kyi man ngag rnams la nan tan bya la/ gong gi ling 'khor 'bri ba'i gza' tshes dang mthun par maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi/ dpangs su khru gang / rgyar phyogs rer mda' gang ba/ kha khyer la sor bzhi tsam gyis tho ba'i dbus 'byub khung gru gsum du brus pa bang rim gsum pa kha khyer cung 'thob/ stegs bu 'brub khung dang bcas pa thams cad 'byug byed kyi rdzas rnams kyis phyi nag po dang nang dmar por byugs la bang rim gsum pa'i yas nas mar drang ba'i dang por/ rtsangs stod dmar smad nag nyer gcig srin mong 'gros su btsugs/stegs bu'i kha khyer la yang rtsangs srin mo 'gros su zhe gnyis tsam gang mtshams su 'dzugs so/ /des na gong du bshad pa'i ling ga de yang thog mar lus kyi cha gang sngon du bri ba dang / 'khor los lus kyi gnas phal cher khyab 'gro bas lus la rang chas su yod pa'i yi ge rnams ling rkyang ltar mdun dngos kyi so so'i thad du bris tshe 'khor lo'i steng du yong bas 'brir mi btub cing / khyad par dgra dmigs —211

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bsal la ling ga gzo dbyibs dang / snying khar rang gshed so so'i spu gri'i so dang / ral gri dang /sdig pa sogs 'bri dgos/ de dag thams cad ling ga 'khor lo can la bri tshul dpral bar rus bri tshul rus tshan lnga'i nang nas gang yin ngos ma zin na byed lugs/ las drug kha 'thob stong srog 'khor lo rnams kyi yi ge spel tshig dang bcas pa'i 'god tshul/ las drug mnan pa'i skabs su bri gzhi dag snag tsha la bsre rgyu'i rdzas/ dgra dmigs bsal la kho rang gi skra sen/ gcin shul/ zag pa (8na)dbang po lnga'i dri ma/ gos kyi dum bu sogs gang rnyed rnams kyang gang la byug dang dri tshul dgra dmigs bsal yod med kyi dbang gis lus kyi cha mtha' dag la byug rgyu'i rdzas cung zad mi 'dra'i dmigs bsal gyi skabs/ yugs sa'i 'khas ma sogs kha cig gnang ba lus la byugs tshe ji ltar byed snyam pa'i 'khrul gzhi che bas/ de dag gi byed tshul sogs dang bcas pa'i lag len gyis dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dir man ngag gi gnad che phra mtha' dag ni rigs 'dzin dam pa'i gsung las myang zhing mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len du bstar ba dang / 'ga' zhig tu drag sngags kyi spyi sdom chen mo rnams las blang bar bya'o/ /smras pa/ mtha' yas rigs kyi dgra sde 'byung po'i bya/ /grangs med sprul bsgyur bgegs dpung kun ta'i tshal/ /gcig char 'joms pa'i 'phrin las rta ljang can/ /'byul 'khor 'khor lo gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /sngags 'phrong rno dbal mtha' bsgyur dus kyi me/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gdams pa'i ming tsam yang / /rna bar ma grags gsang sngags 'chang ba zhes/ /rigs dang rus tsam skyabs 'dzin mgo skyes khur/ /rab lci ngal ba mngon rten blun po'i dbus/ /mchod dang bstod pas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /'grub ces mthu stobs bdag por rlom rnams mtshar/ /thos shes ming tsam yid la ma zhen par/ /phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi zab gnad kun/ /dam pa'i drin las snying dbus legs bcangs pas/ /grags can don gyis dben tshor yid smon bshol/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /—212

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanaganyis pa la/ rdo rje'i mkhar du mi shigs pa'i sku skyed pa/ med du mi rung ba dmigs rten la bla 'gugs shing lha dang dbye ba/ mnan bsad las sbyor dngos la 'jug pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo'i 'dzab bstod kyi bar dkyus bzhin gtong ngo / /gnyis pa la/ /spyir btang dmigs bsal gnyis las/ dang po ni/ (8ba〉dzi rtags sla la/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa po rnamasachas gos nag po gyon zhing / skra dngos sam bcos ma'i skra dang bcas te/ snang stong lha skur shar ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nang nas/ gser skyems gtong / rang gi mdun du lcags bsreg las grub pa'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing nag gcig chad pa yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas bzung ste/ thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod kyi bar las byang gnam lcags 'khor lo'i dkyus bzhin btang / shin tu rgyas par spro na/ gser skyems kyi sngon du/nyes byas drag bskul srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba gtong zhing / rgyas bsdus mtshams par byed na las byang gi gser skyems rang gi gnyis ga'i go chod/ de rjes spro na/ bla 'gugs kyi bskul rgyas pa de bya zhing /mtshams par byed na las byang ltar tsa mun tri dzaḥlha baṃ lha'i bar brjod cing / 'brug khyung skyed chog nas 'di yan bla 'gugs kyi dus thams cad du 'khrig chags su byed do/ /bla 'gugs dus ni/ yang bzlog me'i spu grir bdud dmag la chas pa'i dus/ srin po lto la rub pa'i dus/ stag chen kha gdangs pa'i dus/ tho rangs skar chen shar ba'i dus/ zhogs pa shar phyogs byung ba'i dus/ sa rub kyi dus zhes bshad pa dang / ki gang nag por bla 'gugs kyi sngags dus bzhin bzla bar bshad/ dmar chung du ya ma ra tsa'i mgo la dus bzhir byed pa bshad/ drag sngags kyi spyi sdoms su nyin phyed la 'phyams zhing / nyi shar nas drod chung tshun la bla 'gugs par bshad pa sogs cung zad 'dra min mang yang gnad gcig pas/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu bla 'gugs kyi sngags rnams la bla'i rtags chen drug /sprul pa bcu gnyis la sogs
