rtags rnams man ngag bzhin nam byung gi bar du nan tan du bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di'i lugs la bla 'gugs dang lha dbye'i sngags thun mong ma yin pa sngags byang snye ma dkar mo nas —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gsungs pa rnams bsgrub bya dmigs kyi dkar ba la byas na shin tu legs kyang / snod ldan don gnyer phyi nang gsum gyi man ngag la thos bsam lhur blangs tshe shugs (9na〉pa shes par 'gyur bas man ngag phra mo tsam gyis yid khengs par ma byed par brtson pa drag po bskyed la khong du chud par byos shig /de ltar bla'i khugs rtags kun la nges pa brtan po bsnyed nas skyob byed kyi lha dang phral bar bya ste/ de skad du yang man ngag snying gzer las/ khrag gtor bshams la dmod pa bya/ /lha dang phye la gshed dang sbrad/ /zhes pa ltar lag len mtshams par byed par/ las kyi gshin rje gshed po thams cad dang / /zhes pa nas/ yid yid kyi bar du dkyus bzhin btang / dmigs pa dang bcas pas byab byed kyi nya bo'i lus kun la khyab cing sngags la nan tan du bya'o/ /de ltar bla 'gugs rtags pa sogs zhib cha'i gnad bla'i rtags/ de dag nyams dang mngon sum rmi lam sogs ci rigs par byung yang /bsgral 'os pa dang mi 'os pa'i khyad par myur tshul/ bla rtags kyi dus/ spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi dbye ba phye ste bya tshul/ khram 'debs dus mtshams/ lha dbye'i skabs su kho'i chos bon gyi bsrung ma/ 'go ba'i lha lngas bskyabs pa 'a rtags rnams la legs par bltas te dbye ba/ mdor na bla 'gugs lha dbye'i skabs kyi dmigs pa sogs mtha' dag la sla 'chos dang / dpe hrul tsam la yid brtan ma byed par bla ma dam pa'i gsung las myang bar byos shig /sngon dus kyi sngags gsar rnying man ngag la mkhas mkhas mod byed pa 'ga' zhig gi bla rtags rgyag pa dang / lha dbye byed tshul sna tshogs yig char bkod pa dang / de dag gi lag len rgyun las byung ba ni/ rigs 'dzin dam pa'i man ngag dang ldan pa zhig gis rtags tshe cal col gyi gtam du snang yang rmongs zhen lhur len pa'i skye bo rnams ni/ sbrang bu me lce la bsnyeg pa bzhin du snga ma'i rjes shul non par 'dug go /'on kyang ding sang mngon spyod kyi las la bla 'gugs lha dbye sogs dgos pa'i tshul thos pa kho na ngo mtshar che ste/ phal cher tshul 'di rnams kyang ma thos par/ rnam dbye gang yang med pa'i zan gru gsum du rdzis (9ba)pa zhig 'phangs pa mthu yong bar re ba'i gdung rus che che mo dang / khri mtho mtho mor 'dzegs pa'i chen por rlom pa 'di tsho ni —2/4

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)dngos cag gis ci yin ma shes so/ /smras pa lhag phran sgyu rtsal la goms skyes bu yis/ /pha rol dmigs gtad 'ben rnams 'bigs pa ltar/ /skyabs bral bla sogs zhugs pa'i nya bo de/ /rdzas sngags ting 'dzin 'khor lo'i mtshon chas 'joms/ /bsad bya'i nya yis dben pa'i mtsho 'gram du/ /'bigs byed lcags kyu rnon po 'dzin byed pa'i/ /lugs skyong bstan 'dzin bden tshig 'grub rlom tshe/ /nam mkha'i pa blor rol 'dod bung ba'i grogs/ /e ma 'di snang 'khrul ba'i sa gzhi'i ngos/ /yang 'brul logs pa'i man ngag dra ba sa /snod ldan ri dwags bcug ste gsod byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen rngon pas nor 'dzin lto ba khongs/ /de ni tshul dang tshul min rnam dbye dag /'byed nus theg mchog rigs can yod gyur na/ spyangs shes rta pho srab kyis kha bsgyur ba chin/ /yang dag lam la sdogs shig skal ldan kye/ /ceXs bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa las sbyor dngos kyi sgo nas bsgrub pa dang / mthar mnan pa bya ba gnyis las/ dang po nang nub kyi mgor sngags ring la bsrung zhing gzir ba btang ba re bzla zhing / de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar byed/ i/ dug lcags zangs las grub pa'i khang sgrom dbus/ /las kya srid pa'i rus sbal lto ba mā /gshin rje'i lcags khang phyi nang nyi shu brgyad/ /g.yon phyogs drag 'khor gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ /lcags khang nang kun drod dbugs rtsa'i dngas ma/ /'joms byed thugs gsung 'phrin las drag sngags kun/ /gson po skos 'debs gshin po rnams kyi rje/ /grangs med las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs su gyur/ /de dbus kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa ni/ /mthing nag gsang mdzod chos 'byung gru gsum du/ /nyon mongs dug gsum sa bon las grub pa'i/ /liṅga bla sogs zhugs pa'i dgra dngos kyi/kho yi lus las grub pa'i lce'i steng du/ /'jigs rung 'bar ba'i 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi/ /rno ngar (10na)ser po'i mdangs ldan nyi shu bdun/ /mtshon rtse ltar 'bar nyi ma gzi 'od can/ /ri ltar lci ba'i gakhri es mtshan pa/ /rang gshed 'bebs phyir lus kyi mtshon cha rnams/ /mi bzad mtshon cha spu gri lta bu —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)yi/ /gang gis bzod dka'i rno ngar ldan par gyur/ /rang nyid tshe bdag gsal ba'i thugs ka mā /sum rtsegs sems dpa'i ya ma ra tsa yi/ /thugs ga'i ya las tsha zhing rab rtsub pa'i/ /'od zer 'phros pa'i 'chi bdag thugs gar 'phrog /de las 'od 'phros ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pas bskul nas las byas pas/ /mthing nag i yi nang gi rtsa rnams bcad/ /nyi shu bdun gyis phyi yi rtsa rnams bcad/ /nyi ma dag gi lus kyi rtsa rnams bcad/ /stobs chen ri yis 'gyur ba med mnan te/ /dgra ming lha bsrung bcas pa'i stobs nus pa/ /tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang longs spyod rnams/ /ma lus gcig char nyams shing mnan gyur la/ /lus ni rgyal zhing rengs dang ngag lkugasadig /yid ni myos shing thibs la tshe bsod nams/ /bkrag mdangs gzi brjid mas stobs nus pa kun/ /las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs la thim pa yis/ /ma lus stobs dang gzi brjid ldan par rgyas/ /dgra bgegs bcud bral sge stong lta bur gyur/ /zhes dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang la/ phye myags ya rngubs mugs shaka dun/ che ge mo a mu ka bhi sto ba ya nan/ e hur thums dzaḥzhe shag ro myags mugs ti rbad yā/ zhes pa skabs dang sbyar te ji tsam 'grub tu bzlas de nas/ skyi myi myi hri thi a ba ye/ byi ti ta na hūṃ byad ma sto bha ya nan/ e yaṃ raṃ kho yaṃ le nan/ ya ka ya ma rag mo/ badz+ra krodha dun ting ki la yā/ma ma rag mo/ he sha trag rak+ṣa/ du brag dun ting bhi la ni/ sa du tri/ tri sha na ra tsa dh+wa ri/ ra tsa mu tra shan+ti lha/ na ni ro/ a tri sa du/ ra tri ra tsa/ san ga ra tsa/ : ba ru tri/ gha na pa ti/ bhi na ka ro/ /la dug brag /byi du ra na na ga ma tri/ sa ga byi du/ sarba che ge mo sha hūṃ/ du du nan/ snying du nan/ srog tu nan/ lus ngag (10)gsum mā ra ya sto bha ya nan/ myags thum ril trig nan/ sbur ya nan ma rgyu nan/kho shag ro myags mugs ti rbad yā/ zhes mnan gzhung gi sngags 'di yang long skabs dang sbyar/ de rjes/ phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag dun/ dgra bo'i srog la d+dha hu ṭaṃ dza ca khrag snying thum ril raṃ shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta dred shag dza/ srog la rtsi hur ṭaṃ rbad/ ces thod nang du thun rdzas blug la sngags dang bcas pa'i phus btab ste/ nus ldan du byas/ de nas thun rdeg pa'i bskul las byang gi dkyus —216

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanabazhin byas rjes 'di brjod do/ khyad par srog gi ngo bo lan pa'i mgo/ /rgya gar mthar gnas dang po'i lto ba sa /lnga pa'i lnga pa gnas pa'i mig dbus na/ /ljangs khu'i mdangs can dug gsum yi ge ni/ /drag sngags mtshon cha'i rang bzhin 'phros pa dang / /sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bskul ba'i mthus/ khrag gi sbal par bcas pa skad cig la/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i thugs gar thim/ /zhes dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/ gong gi sngags spel dgos rnams man ngag ltar byas pa'i mjug tu 'di btags la mthun rdeg go /phye ka he dun ya ma ra tsa sa to me yā/ a mu ga'i srog la breng shag /rtsa khrag snying thum ril/ nag po yak+ṣa snying la hur thum nan/ nag po ya ka srog la hur thum rbad/nag po du sha rtsa la breng shag rbad nag po trag raka dgra bo'i snying khrag tshal pa she long rbad/ gha lha rtsi dzaḥbarnye bon po ste bha yaḥphye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun bh+yoḥ.a mu ka ma e ka tsi ti snying khrag dun mug yaṃ bh+yoḥm rag mo snying tshal pa hur ṭaṃ rbad bh+yoḥ ma yag mo dgra snying sha hūṃ mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥban bon snying la sha sha ka rbad bh+yo/ thun khrag dun dun rbad bh+yo/ zhes thun du bcad la zhag grangs kyi bar du bsgrub bo/ /de ltar spyir btang gtso bor bshad nas/ dmigs bsal 'di dag gi skabs su bzang ngan dang las 'grub mi 'grub/ myur bul sogs kyi rtags/ mnan bsad spyi bye brag gi dbye ba mtha' dag la zhib par byas te phul ba dang / (11na〉ba grub pa dang / pha rol stobs che ba dang / rang la g.yin gyi ngag mnan pa sogs kyi rtags byung tshe/ sngags dkrugs sdebs byed lugs/ gzhan gyi kha 'chings gser gyi 'khor lo sdebs/ rang gi kha 'byed sngags kyi lde mig sdebs/ rang kha mi shigs ka ba 'dzugs pa dang gzhan gyi rkang mthil spyi bor 'don pa dang / tshe zad las zad sogs kyi man ngag sdebs spyi dang 'di'i lugs thun mong ma yin pa sogs kyi gnad dang / sgrub pa'i dus kyi spyod lam spyi bye brag dang / dgra dmigs bsal la bri bya'i 'khor lo dang / bri rgyu'i sngags dang / bsam bya'i dmigs pa sogs kyi kha bsgyur dang spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi skabs mtha' dag tu nyin mtshan gyi sngags kyi dbye ba/ thun bsgrubs 'debs gnyis dar lan ji tsam phyed dang / dmigs pa'i gnad gong —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gi dmigs pa tshigs bcad ma 'di chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i zhes mdzad pa'i ki dang dmar chung gi las byang du dmigs pa rnams tshig don gnyis ka phun sum tshogs pa 'dug pas rkyen byas shing / lhag tu man ngag gi gnad long du chud pa zhig la sgrub pa'i skabs rjed tho lta bu yong bar bsam ste bris pa yin la/ 'on kyang dmigs pa de rnams gcig char dang rim can du byed rgyu sogs mang du yod pa zhal las ma blangs tshe dpe kho nas lag tu lon par 'dod pa'i shes rlom can rnams ni/ gru shan med par chu bo chen po'i pha rol tu bgrod par rtsom pa dang khyad par med pas bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /des na 'di'i las sbyor sngags gsar rnying gi man ngag zab zab mo gang gis kyang cha tsam yang 'gran du med pa'i gdams pa yin pas gong du bshad pa ltar gnad che phra mtha' dag la tshul 'dir snying nas mos pa'i skal ldan yin tshe/ su byung gi bla ma/ gang byung gi ga dmasang ga dang /khungs med kyi dpe hrul dang / 'brel med kyi bshad pa la yid ma rton par rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa yab sras kyi bka' srol dri ma med pa 'brul med du khong du chud pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa (11ba)zhig gi zhabs kyi pad+mo yun ring du bsten/ gsung gis bdud rtsis snying gi bum pa legs par gang bar byosashig /gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i gza' skar de rnams gang rigs la 'khor lo'i ngag sogs thams cad man ngag ltar lteb/ 'ching byed kyis bcings la thod par bcug rdzas kyis bkang /rdo rjes kha bcad mos kyis dril zhing rtsangs gzer ba sogs mnan chas rnams legs par byas/ rdo rje slob dpon zhwa pho sogs byas te bdud chas su zhugs/ sgra gcan gyi thebs phyogs su kha bltas la/gzhi bdag gtor ma dang / gser skyems/ mnyes pa'i dpangs gzugs sogs rgyas par byas/ nyesapa srungs byed kyi sa la reg /de nas dgra sta dang gri sogs phyag /mtshan brdeg cing dmigs pa dang bcas pas/ hūṃ 'byung ba gdan bzhi'i brngam 'og nas/ /las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni/ /ya mtshan che la med du byung / /mun nag thib po'i 'og na bzhugs/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na ri rab bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na rgya mtsho bsnams/ /zhabs kyis rlung gi 'khor lo gnon/ / ma nyams dgra bo las —218

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanangan 'di/ mnan pa las kyi dus la babs/ /sgo med lcags mkhar nang du chugs/ /gshin rje rnamasakyi zas su byin/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la skyon/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chugs/ /ri bro chen po'i rmang du gnon/ /nam yang ldang bar ma byed cig /che ge mo mā ra ya sto bha ya nan/ ces brjod cing liṅga 'khor snod dang bcas pa dong nang du 'phangs zhing / las kyi gshin rje'i zas skal du btang la mnan sngags dang dmod pa brjod do/ /ri mo bris pa'i ya khod kyis bkab rjes/ mthong brgyud ltar lag tshags dam par bya zhing / 'byung ba go bzlog gi dmigs pa dang bcas pas sngags dang dmod pa brjod rjes/ rdzogs chen gnas lugs kyi steng du mnyam par 'jog go /'on kyang 'di skabs kyi dong 'bru kha man gyi ngag 'don rnams dbang po'i sde'i gsung bris gi gang gi dkyus bzhin 'don pa bsgyur na'ang skabs su bab pas legs pa yin no/ /de ltar zhib cha rang la sa bdag klu gnyan gyi mi gnod pa'i bsrung ba 'chang ba/ sa 'bru ba'i lag cha gang gis byed/ mnan pa'i sa (12na〉〉 sdoms su mnan pa'i sa brgyad ces bshad pa dang / ki gang nag por mnan pa'i sa dang / gtod yul gyi sde brgyad so sor dmigs bsal bshad pa dang / 'ga' zhig tu dgra bo'i phyogs su mnan zhes bshad pa dang / lugs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa mnan pa'i yul drug gsungs pa dang / gtad kyi sna nas tshol du ri sogs mtha' dag mi 'gal bar gnas gcig tu rtogs pa'i dgongs pa/ man ngag gi spyir btang dmigs bsal phye ste bya tshul/ mnan pa'i dong ring thung gi tshad/ ha cang ring na rang la bzlog cing / thung na dgra mi 'chi bas de dag gi skabs mtshams med du mi rung ba byad du bzhugs pa'i sngags lugs 'di'i dmigs bsal dang / mnan pa'i rna cha nas bshad pa'i sngags rnams long skabs rgyas bsdusasbyar te byed du 'jug tshul/ mnan chas skabs kyi sgril chings gzer tshul/ gnon pa'i skabs kyi me chu rdzas rnams blugs pa'i go rim dmigs pa sogs zhib cha'i gnad ches phra ba mtha' dag ni mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len/ la gyi bdud rtsi las myang bar byos shig /smras pa/ u rgyan rgya bod rigs 'dzin du ma yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'grub pa'i yi dam —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nalha/ /bla tshe'i gshed po 'chi bdag dus dgra zhes/ /grags snyan ral gri'i rtsibs stong phyogs bcur 'khor/ khyad par ljongs 'dir snga 'gyur rig sngags 'chang / /tshe bdag mkhan po'i khur gyisang la ba can/ /rgyu skar 'phreng ba lta bur bgrangs yas kyang / /zab don gnad la lta ba'i skal bas dben/ /sdig rgyud drag sngags glang chen smyon pa'i snar/ /'khrul sdebs mtshon cha 'bar ba rab bskor nas/ /yang zab gnad kyi ha las ngar btags tshe/ /ma rungs dgra sne'i dpung tshogs phye mar 'thag /de ltar na yang tshul 'dir mos pa'i blo/ /'dzin pa mang yang zhabrul med gdengs rnyed pa/ bdud 'joms rdo rje'i rjes 'breng bcas pa las/ /yangs pa'i sa chen 'di na gzhan med par/ /'khums te kho bos rigs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs/ /legs par bsten nas zab gnas man ngag kun/ /bum pa gang 'jor rab 'thob de'i (12ba)phyir na/ /dregs ldan gzhan la ldang ba'i 'gram chu bad/ /deng 'dir mnan pa'i lag len 'khyer bde tsam/ 'khrugs sdebs tshul du bkod mod zab gnad kun/ /snying nas thub bstan gces 'dzan khur ldan pa/ yod tshe dka' ba spyod la zhal las long / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bsrung 'khor bsgom zhing bsam gtan bum chu dang / las bum gyi chu sogs kyi khrus byed/ bsdams pa bcad/ bcings pa 'grol/ mnan pa 'don/ ngag dbang bskur ba sogs dang /phyag dar rdul spugs/ las rjes mi mngon par byas la tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol ba las byang gi dkyus ltar bya/ sbyin bsreg dang zor 'phangs ni gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar na snubs ban gyi bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /rgya bal yul du lan bdun phyin/ /dgos pa'i gdams pa ma lus rnyed/ /mkhas pa kun gyi bcud thig pa/ /drag sngags stong dang rtsa brgyad las/ khyad par rang gshed bsrung bzlog dang / phyir bzlog lugs la mang yod kyang / /a mu ka phung brnag pa'i las/ /bcud phur snying gi gnad thig 'di/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor dam pa yis/ /don du spu gri dkar nag bstan/ /dkar po'i lam sgron phyi ma'i chos/ /nag po dug gi 'bor lo 'di/ /dgra don nyen pa'i mkhar sper shog ces —220

'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)gsungs pa ba chin gnubs kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags mtha' yas pa bsgyur ba las 'gran zla dang bral ba'i 'jigs su rung ba'i las sbyor/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i drag sngags 'di yin la/ 'di'i dbang lung gi rgyun dang man ngag phyogs 'gro mkhyen pa'i rigs 'dzin shin tu mang ba las/ dum pa shad khrom gyis zab gter snyan rgyud kyi skor yongs su rdzogs pa 'khrul med du mnga' ba'i chos rje se ston pa dang / kong chen nam mkha' dpal ldan gnyis kyi gdams pa ma lus pa thugs su chud pa'i snyan rgyud kyi bdag po ni rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje yab sras su nges pas/ de dag gi bka' srol gyi rgyun nyams med du 'dzin pa'i rigs 'dzin dam pa'i drung du/ kho bos chos 'di la klag lung tsam dang / lag len gyi (13na)phyogs 'gro tsam nges pas yid tshim par ma byas par/ thog mar dka' ba khyad du sad nas zhal gyi gdams pa kun la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod par byas shing / bar du bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor nyams su blangs pas gong 'og gi lag len che ba kun la gnad kyi gdengs thob na yang / gnam lcags u rme'i skor thams cad ltas chog tu dris tshe/ gnam sa yang gcig char du 'khrug par nus pas/ las 'bras rgyab tu bskyur ba'i 'dod pa can gyi lag tu shor na rang gzhan mtha' dag phung bar byas kyi dogs pa dang / bsnyen rgyud kho na yin pas yi ger 'god pa'i spros pa dor mod/ 'on kyang bskor gsum gyi nang nas kyang phul du byung ba'i gang zag gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde nas gsungs pa'i mnan pa ri rab stobs chen 'di cung zad mkho che zhing / dpe gcig gi steng nas lag tu lon pa mi 'dug pas/ 'khrug sdebs su byas pa yin la 'di tsam gyis kyang rang g.yin phung tshengs kyi bya ba chen po sgrub nus pas lag len che phra thams cad slob dpon ma bsten par dpe kho nas lag tu lon pa med na yang / yi ge bstan la bltos nas gsal zhing / khyad par rgya bod gnyis kur bka' brgya shin tu dam pas/ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang lung sogs ma thob cing theg mchog snying po'i chos 'di la snying nas dmod pa sogs snod min la bstan pa byung tshe ston pa po dang /ston yul gnyis ka gza' bdud nag po ra hu la dang / gter bsrung klu bdud rdo rje spyan gcig ma —221

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gnyis kyis/ snying khrag dron mo 'thung la tshar chod cig /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi bkas bkrol ba ni ma gtogs so/ /smras pa/ mkhan slob chos rgyal lo paṇa mkhas grub tshogs/ khyad par rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /dam pa 'ga' yi drin las gangs can 'dir/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i pad tshal cher cher rgyas/ /'on kyang nag phyogs bdud sde'i sprin phung las/ ma rung dgra sde'i rkyen thang 'bab gyur zhing / /bstan (13ba〉sna dzin gzugs brnyan bdud rigs glang chen gyis/ /sna tshogs bya ba goms pa 'degs par rtsom/ /de lta na yang deng dus thub bstan gyi/ khur 'byer 'ga' zhig gtor bsngos bskang gso tsam/ /byas nas mngon spyod 'phrin las 'grub tu re/ /blon po'i dbus su stobs dang skye ba yis/ /dregasaldan bla ma'i gzugs brnyan phal cher ni/ /ngan g.yo rdzun dang phra ma dug mtshon las/ ya rabs khyim pa rnams kyang ngo tsha'i gnas/ /byed la 'dzem bag spyod pa'i snang tshul 'di/ /mthong bas rkyen byas kho bos mnan pa'i las/ /lag len ji bzhin khyer bder rab bkod 'di/ /snod dang snod min gsang ba'i yul la sogs/ /ma 'dres yid du bzung la 'di lta ra spel/ /chos dang bla mar snying nas dad gusakyis/ /rnam par bral yang kha mkhas mgo bskor gyis/ /man ngag len pa'i dam med g.yo khram can/ /skyes bu 'di 'dra shin tu mang / de 'drar tshul 'di gsang ba'i yul/ /rigs stobs skye bar grags las thos bsam gyis/ /dben yang bstan pa'i bdag po'i khur 'chang ba/ /lha'i bu snying zhugs long bas long ba dag /'khrid pa'i chen por rlom tsho thos ba4 sgom pa gang yang ma byas pa 'di mang / gsang ba'i yul/ /tshe 'di'i 'dam du bying yang chos brgyad kyis/ /rlan bral smra ba'i grub mthas blo kha dag /ma bsgyur blun po mgo bo bskor byed pa'i/ /zog po bstan pa'i chom rkun dag brgyud pa dang sgom ོ ༅ phyogs su shin tu mang / gsang ba'i yul/ zab chos phan tshun dkrug rtsom shog ril dag /rang gis sbas 'don de rjes 'brang byed pa'i/ /pad+ma'i zab gter bstan la rma 'byin pa/ log pa'i smon lam can sngags cha mtha phyogs su snang /tshor gsang ba'i yul/ tha snyad tshig dang rtog ge'i rig pa dag /cung zad shes la snying nas a thas pa'i mu —222

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanastegs grangs can lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes/ /chos spong sgrib pas sbags 'di 'dra ba gzhan kun la snang /tsho gsang ba'i yul/ /des na dam tshig sdom pa la gnas shing / /theg mchog rigs can zab don snying dbus su/ /gces 'dzin mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob ma (14na)la/ /'gyur med bka' rgyas thob la legs par byin/ /de skad dgra sde ma lus gnon byed pa'i/ /thar med 'bar ba'i lcags mkhar nag po che/ /chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can zhes pa 'di/ /rnam dkar lhag pa'i bsam pas bkod pa yis/ /bdud sde ma lus gnam lcags thogs chen gyis/ /brag ri 'joms ltar thal bar rab rlag ste/ /thub bstan mngon par rgyas pa'i gzi 'od kyis/ /theg mchog phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas par shog /ces 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i mnan pa thar med lcags khang nag po chu srin mgrin pa'i rgya can zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'brom gyis rigs las byung ba'i sngags pa slob dpon pa chos rje bsod nams grags pa dang / phan bde legs bshad gling gi slob dpon pa chos rje sku skye gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi slob ma a tsar+ya dharma pā la nas bzung ste/ snga 'gyur ma gshin phur pa'i grub pa rim par thob pa'i gdung las son pa rig sngags 'chang ba zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rjes khyu mchog gi lo nag zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gral tshes la/ dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i mngon spyod rol pa'i lding khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa zhes bya ba bsdo/gas the tho/ /na mo ya mā ri mu drwa bhi bhū yā yurla ta ye/ 'jam dpal zhi khro'i bka' babs rgya bod kyi/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa bgrang yas dkyil 'khor lha/ /yongs 'dus kun go gcig chod drin can rje/ /chos dbyings rang grol snying gi pad+ma ra bzhugs/ /o rgyan rgya bal mkhas grub mtha' klas pa'i/ /bka' —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)babs pad gnubs bzhed gzhung chu klung tshogs/ /rnam dpyod rgya mtshor gcig 'dres nub dgon rje/ /mnga' ris rigs 'dzin nyi zla zung 'brel bzhin/ /mgon gnyis mkhyen yangs tshangs pa'i ral pa nas/ /smin grol gdams pa mtho ris nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /'bebs mkhas skal ldan shing rta dbang po'i sde/ /yab sras zhal lung chad med nor bu'i 'phreng / /bka' gter rgyud dang man ngag rig byed bzhir/ /ring nas goms pa'i blo gros gdong pa bzhi/ /bstan te zab rgyas gnad don snod bas tshogs/ /mngon sum sprul pa'i gzigs mo 'di na mtshar/ /'khor 'das khro rgyal kun gyi lag cha rnams/ /stabs cig 'chor ba zil gnon phyog rgya che/ /bsnyen sgrub las rim rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ bdud dpung lha min snying rtsa 'dar 'di'o/ /de'ang 'jam pa gsum (2na)gyis 'dul bar mi nus pa'i gdug pa can spyi dang / bye brag lho phyogs rim bdun sa 'og thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na gnas pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dul ba'i gnyen por 'jam dpal rdo rje dus dgra'i dbang por bstan pa ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa gsang sngags snga phyir 'gyur ba'i rgyud sde rnams su mang du byung ba'i nang nas 'khor 'das kyi phyag rgya thams cad cig car zil gyis gnon pa 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i rgyud 'grel man ngag /steng phyogs lha'i yul dang o rgyan rgya bal sogs na rgya cher bzhugs pa'i nying khu dpal o rgyan chen po dang / lo tsā ba gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po ches ljongs 'dir gdan drangs pa la pad lugs gnubs lugs gnyis su grags shing pad lugs phal che ba ni phung po ri bo che sogs su gter du sbas pa las dang skal bar ldan pa'i sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyis spyan drangs/ gnubs lugs la'ang bka' gter gnyis su byung ba'i bka' ma ni/ bka' 3|ga rgya bo che las/ las kyis 'brel ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /dad pa che ba legs pa'i sgron ma dang / /grogs mchog dam pa ye shes dbang phyug dang / /rtsol shugs gtod (2ba)phod che ba'i blon rje 'phags/ /zhes gnubs kyi thugs sras bzhi byung ba'i nang nas gdung rus gcig pa'i sras kyi thu bo gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho la bka' babs pa —224

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(kha)lcags 'dra dang thog 'dra'i skor shin tu rgya che zhing gter du bzhugs pa lcags 'dra dang lcags sdig rnams dum pa rgyar bka' babs pa yin pa deng sang rang lugs rgyun gyi nyams len ni mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis/ de ltar tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon nam/ /pad+ma'i man ngag rtsa ba sor bzhag la/ /pad lugs zhes grags gnubs kyi yang mdzod 'di/ /sgrub khog sor bzhag gnubs lugs zhes grags mod/ /lam gyi gnad la khyad par ci yang med/ /'on kyang 'phrin las byang bu'i brjed byang las/ khyad par cung zad yod pa legs phye nas/ /'dir ni pad+ma'i lugs nyid gsal bar byas/ /rje btsun dam pa'i drin gyis lam srol 'dir/ /ring du sbyangs pa'i blo gros mi dman zhing / khyud dang gdams pa'i gnad la 'dris pa'i phyir/ /don 'di'i phyir la spro ba lhod ma gyur/ /ces pa ltar pad+ma'i man ngag rtsa ba sor bzhag dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa'i lhan thabs sbyar te nyams su len pa'i rgyun yod pa bzhin lag tu bstar ba la/ lha nye bar bsnyen cing bsgrub pa las rab mas thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal gshes gnyen gyis/ dad dang brtson 'grus me ltar 'bar ba dang / shes rab che zhing phyogs med slob pa dang / /dad pa che zhing gzungs thob blo brtan pa/ /dam tshig gtsor 'dzin sgom sran che ba dang / /rang rig (3na)blo ldan chos nyid don rtogs dang / /go 'phang thob dang man ngag 'dod pa la/ /zhes dang / man ngag las/ thog mar shes ldan smin pa yi/ /rigs ldan rnal 'byor brtul zhugs can/ /zhes pa ltar/ shes rab che zhing chos 'di la/ yid ches kyi snying nas dad pa thob pa zhig gis/ goms pa sngon sbyangs mang thos chos rnams shes/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i don rtogs gti mug med/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med gzungs ma 'du/ /bla ma'i man ngag thob pa'i gdengs ldan pa/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma dam pas bya/ /zhes mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa tshul bzhin thob nas smin pa'i gang zag gis ji ltar bsgrub pa'i gnas ni/ mchin pa las chad pa'i chos sde sngon 'gro gnas kyi las rim du/—225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i gnas kyi khyad par so sor rgyas par gsungs na'ang / deng sang yul dus kyi 'grub par dka' nyid / rgyud las/ dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas dag tu/ /zhes dang / sgrub thabasalas/ gnas ni dur khrod du bya/ brag ri nag po mon pa khros pa 'dra ba'am/ lho phyogs su kha bltas pa shin tu gnyan sar phyin la zhes bshad kyang dpa' gdengs cung zad rnyed pa rnams la gnas gnyan sa rtogs pa 'phel na 'ange / las dang po pa la shin tu 'jam pa'i phyogs su bsgrubs na bar chad chung bas/gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho'i g.yu 'byug sngon po/ nub kyi bya dmar po/ byang gi rus sbal nag po sogs sa ba po shis pa theg dman/ mu stegs/ skye bo'i ya ga /nag phyogs kyi (3ba tshe r+sāng po'i 'tshub 'gyur gyi rigs med cing /dam pa gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong ba btsal bar bya/ de nas 'tsho ba zas dang skom sel btung ba'i rigs/ nad zhi ba sman dang dgra bzlog pa go mtshon sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par sogs g.yos mkhan dang brda sbyor sogs mtshams g.yog blo thub cing dam tshig dang ldan pa grangs ji ltar rigs pa dang / mthun rkyen gyis mtshon pa'i rgyu 'grul gzhan nas slar yong rgyu rnams kyang gang nas yong cha bting ba'i thog ma nas dmigs 'og tu chud pa'i mtshams mi ral ba bya/ dus tshod ka dag gi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ba rab la ma nges kyang / 'khrul pa'i rdzun phugs ma rdib pa'i rigs kun rdzob kyi snang ba dgag tu mi rung bas spyir rgyas par nyi ma byang bgrod dang yar ngo / drag po'i nyi ma lho bgrod dang mar ngo / zhi bar nyi ma 'char gdong sogs/ dbang la nub mo bya bar gsungs shing bye brag /ji skad du/ lo dang zla ba skar ma bzang / /dus tshod bzang la 'jug par bya/ /zhes spor thang gtsug lag nas bshad pa'i mche ba can sogs lo zla rtsub pa/ rang gi dgra gshed lta bu ma yin pa'i lo gza' skar sbyor byed khyim gyi dus sbyor sogs dang po'i sangs rgyas dang g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud rnams las byung ba ltar bsnyen sgrub la shis pa nges par bsgrig cing gza' tshes 'dzom na yar ngo dang mar ngo gang bde ba/ dus tshod ji skad du/ nyi —226

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanam nub par gyur pa na/ /lha yang byin gyis rlabs kyis 'du/ /zhes lha dbang du byed pa'i rten 'brel gyi srod thun nas 'dzugs/ thog mar sde brgyad cha snyoms pa'i phyir/ bsangs (4na khong gser skyems/gsung rab klog pa/ sāts+tsha 'debs pa/ nye'u 'don pa/ sbyin gtong sogs bsod nams kyi dpung rgya cher bsag /gnas khang phyag bdar rkyang tshul bya/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan spyan gzigs sogs dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bris 'bur gyi sku byin rlabs can rnams bkod pas mdzes par dgram/ sgrub rten rab rdul tshon/ 'bring ras bris/ tha ma sman raka gtor gsum tsam la'ang rten rung ba'i/ rdul tshon la rgyas pa spro na/ lcags sdig mgo bo gru gsum las chad pa'i chos sde/ sgrub thabs snying gzer nag por/ thog mar nus ldan brtson pa yis/ /sa cho go dus bzang legs ldan la/ /rdul med srog chags spang byas la/ /lho yi phyogs nas sa blangs la/ /dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi pa/ /tshad dang ldan pa rab tu bzhed/ /zhes pa ltar stegs bu brtsig par bshad pa 'grub na dang / ma 'grub na cog tse'am khri'u lta bus kyang rung / yang de nyid las/ rgyal po bzhi la bka' yang bsgo/ khro bo bcu yis phyi mtshams bcad/ /dam sri 'dul zhing sgo byang gdags/ /ma tre ru dra bsgral las bya/ /zhes pa ltar rgyal mtho/ mtshams gcod/dam sri/ sgo byang / ma tre rnams sngags rnying ma spyi gzhung dang mthun zhing / dbang chog mu tig 'phreng bar/rgyud las/ snang srid thams cad kyi bdag po yin zhing / gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/sa chog bya mi dgos te/ sa la ji ltar rung ba ltar spyad par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pa ni slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis glang po che'i dpral ba bkas nas thal byung du byon pa lta bu'i sngags 'chang chen po rnams (4ba)la dgongs kyis/ las dang po ba rnams ni gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tu sa brtag pa dang / blang ba dang / sbyang ba dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / bsrung ba'o/ /zhes 'byung bas sa ma dul ba la nges par dgos/ snying gzer las/ de nas thig skud lnga ldan la/bdud rtsi dkar dmar btab byas la/ /tshe bdag pe ta li ru bsam/ zhes sogs kyi thig dang / pho brang gling dgu 'khor lo dang / /thod mkhar gru chad khyams sgo las/ /pad+ma rdo rje me ris bskor/ /zhes sogs —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nagasungs shing / thig chen gyi cho ga lag len nag 'gros lta bu 'byer bde ba ni/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor tu gsal mod/ bsnyen pa tsam la'ang rgyal mtho nges par bsdam zhing / dam sri mnan na legs pa'i cha lag tu 'gyur yang / de phyin rang lugs kyi dbang chog nges don bde 'jug tu/dang po la/ yo byad bsham zhing gtor ma btang ba/ thig tshon rab tu gnas shing chag chag gdab pa/dkyil 'khor bri zhing rdzas dgod pa'o/ /zhes sa bcad gsum du 'dus pas don 'grub la/ 'on kyang bsnyen pa yun ring bas rdul tshon zhig pa sogs kyi 'jigs pa che ba'i phyir bshad ma thag pa'i sa bcad dang po'i rjes su ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dgram pa'am/ /'dzab khang dbye ba'i lugs rgyas pa byed 'dod cing / dkyil 'khor ma 'byor na maṇ+ḍal lta bur thig btab pa'i khar 'bru nag khrag gis sbags pa'i tshom bu bkod pa gang rung gi steng du baṃ chas su bcug pa bzhag /de steng man 'ji'i khar sgrub gtor lha tsaka gtor gdugs kyis brgyan pa bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun shar sgo'i thad du mchod gtor/ (5na ti'i g.yas su sman phud/ g.yon du rak+ta/ phyogs gang bder gshin rje dang sgosakyi chos skyong gter srung gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog /de nas rim bzhin g.yas skor du khrag gi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ dbang po'i me tog sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha kyi rus zhal zas rnams dang / de'i mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rnams bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ gzhan yang tshogs mchod/ rdor dril/ thod rnga/ 'thor nas/ mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad 'du byas/ gnas khang gis btub na sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshangs can gyi 'og tu sa dkar gyi g.yung drung ris chos 'khor gyi tshul du 'bri/ bdag bskyed tsam la brten tshe/ dkyil 'khor gsum dang po dor nas stegs bu'i dbus su sgrub gtor bkod/ sgrub gtor dang mchod gtor so sor mdzad srol rnying ma phal cher la mi 'dug na'ang / 'dir byung bas so sor yod na dngos grub len ma ran gyi bar sgrub gtor lhar bskyed pa kho nas chog mod/ de'ang rnam pa tha dad yin pas dkyil 'khor dang mi 'dra ba la/ gtor ma gcig las—228

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanamed na shes pa rnam pa gsum gyi dbye bas phral phral 'gyur 'gro bas skabs thob shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bsnyen pa sgrub pa las sbyar gsum/ dang po ni las byang gzhung bsrangs la/chos skyong gter srung gzhi bdag gi gtor bsngos/ tshogs mchod/ baṃ bskang / bstan skyong gi bar dkyus bzhin btang / lce byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ban sngags bon dgras bdag (5ba〉de ngag bcings na/ /de dag 'grol zhing gso dang ngag byin brlab/ /kun las zab 'di nyams blang snying ltar bzung / /nang par nam langs kha dang dgongs nyi dag /nub khar nyams su blang bya 'di kho na/ /bdag gi lce steng raṃ yig dmar po bsam/ /raṃ las me 'bar lce ni thul gyis bsregs/ /slar yang lce ni 'od kyi rang bzhin bsam/ /de yi ngang las lce ni gang gis kyang / /mi tshugs mi shigs sra brtan pha lam gyi/ /rdo rje rgya gram tha mar rten snying gi /sngags 'phreng chos skor dag tu bskor bar bsam/ /rten snying brgya'am nyer gcig skabs sbyar bzla/ /de ltar byas pas 'dzam gling 'dir 'khod pa'i/ /ban sngags bon dgra 'dus pa'i byad phur dang / /ngag mnan ngag bcings rbod gtong yod na yang / /bye ma'i phung po chu yis 'jig ltar grol/ /ngag 'grol ngag gso ma shigs rdo rje dngos/ /phyag na rdo rje ji bzhin 'di nyid do/ /'di dang ldan la gzhan gyis ngag mnan sogs/ /byas na phyag cha rang la 'khor ba'i phyir/ /kun la gsangs nas rang nyid nyams su blang / /bdag 'dra bal po bha su dha ra yis/ /rang bzo ma yin pad rgya nag po yi/ khyud la brten nas rang nyams dang du blang / /skye ba snga ma'i spun zla yin pa'i phyir/ /gnubs kyi ban+de sangs rgyas me shes la/ /gdams so gtad do ma g.yel thub par chongs/ /'chal na dregs pa'i bka' chad 'bab par nges/ /sam ya/ drag po rang byung rang shar las/ raka thod 'phreng ma gtogasapa'i/ /bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i 'phreng g.yin med/ zhes dang / sred pa'i gter khyim du/ drag po la ru raka dang thod pa ḍā gi 'du ba'i dngos grub myur bar bshad pa ltar ru raka (6na70 nyid dang ldan pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bla ma dgongs 'dus las byung ba ltar/ 'phreng ba lag mthil g.yon du bskyil/ /mdo 'dzin steng du yod par byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdo 'dzin klu —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong phyogs skyong sde brgyad 'khor lo pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi ga g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje/ g.yon gsum be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dur khrod dang dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ yum pe ta li sku la 'khril ba/ 'phreng rdog rnams rtsa ba'i lha gzhan bzhi/ rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa gsum/gshed bzhi mon bdud 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ zhag gshed sum brgya drug cu/ sgo srung bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shur gsal bar bsam/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi blo ka gcig gis bstim/phyi mchod dang sman raka gtor gsum sngags tsam gyis phul/ chos dbyings ngang las khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ lag pa g.yas me rta ge thogs la 'bru bcu bdun sku gsung thugs sngagasaphye ring rten 'brel snying po dbyangs gsal rnams ci rigs dang / khyad par/ ā+oṃ ru tsi bra ma rta na ya rat+na ma ṇi khyu ra dz+nyā na de wa a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas sngags dang me rtag las 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ bgrang 'phreng ltar gsal ba la thim/ lha rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas 'phreng ba'i rnam par bsams la shis pa brjod/ 'phreng ba byin rlabs 'di lan cig byas rjes 'phreng ba la nyams chags kyi rigs ma byung na rgyun (6ba)gtan du ma byas kyang chog /bzlas pa'i 'gor 'bru gsum gyis sna drangs pa'i dbyangs gsal/ rten 'brel snying po gang gi sngags rnams tshar gsum re bzla/ bsnyen pa dngos la/ gong gnod 'bru bcu bdun pa/ phyi skor sku'i drag sngags/ nang skor gsung gi drag sngags/ gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags/ yang gsang drag po rgod kyi drag sngags dang lnga/ dang po la bsnyen pa/ bdag byin brlab/ sgrub pa chen po/ 'phrin las bzhi'i dmigs pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ nges don bde 'jug tu de'ang chos 'di'i lugs kyi bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnamasachig chod du bsgrub pa yin la/ de tsam blos ma lcogs pa 'dzab khang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dbye ba'i gnad shes dgos so/ /zhes gsung ba ltar 'dzab bzla khar phaṭa dzaḥ zhes bdag mdun tha mi dad pa la mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du phye nas me ri 'dab 'byar du bsgom/ bdag —230

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanamadun gnyis ga'i rten brten pa thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan nam nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'i gsal snang dang / de ltar snang ba de'ang rang rig kun bzang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed gsar du blos btags ma yin pa gdod ma nas rang chas su yod pa de ga dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bdag mdun gnyis ga'i thugs tsit+ta rin po che'i gur phub pa lta bu'i rnam par gsal 'debs/ de la sku rgyab brten pa'i tshul gyis ya ma rā dza/ de'i thugs brang du phyag rdor/ de'i thugs brang du 'jigs byed chen po gsal ba ni rtsa ba'i lha drug tshang dgos pa'i don gyis yin la bsnyen pa'i skabs ye shes sems dpa' la dmigs pa gtso bor (7na)gtod pas gur khang gi dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog smug nag zhal ga khrig phyag gnyizla/pa rgyan dang phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub thugs ka dang / g.yon brla steng sdigs mdzub gyen du bstan pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du hūṃ mthing nag 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba/ de'i phyi rol du a kro 'bru bcu bdun pa'i sngags 'phreng kha dog sngon po klog thabs su bskor/ de las 'od zer dkar po dang mthing kha 'dres pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis bar thag 'dzings pa lta bu bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can dpag tu med pa bun gyis 'phros rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar gsal lam gyi gyur/ 'od zer mgal me ltar 'khor bas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rtsa sbur mes bsregs pa bzhin sangs kyis dag /'od zer thugs ka nas phyir 'phros pa'i sne la mchod pa'i lha mo nyer spyod lnga sogs phyi'i mchod pa sman rag gtor gsum sogs nang gi mchod pa/ sbyor sgrol sogs gsang ba'i mchod pas mtshon kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad kyang gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas rtsis zin par byas nas mdun gyi 'dzab khang gi lha tshogs rnams la phul bas chags sred kyi rtog pa mi mnga' yang bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i slad du bde stong gnyis med kyi ngang nas rol zhing —23/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'tshim/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba'i rkyen gyis mchode yul las sku gsung thugs yon (7ba)tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam par tshur 'dus bdag la thim/ yang bdag mdun gnyis ka nas 'od zer gong bzhin 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams la mchod pa sogs phul nas byin rlabs bdag mdun gnyis ka la bsdu/ yang 'od zer gong bzhin phyir 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa rnams la phog pas bsam sbyor ngan pa'i nus pa thams cad dag nas thams cad 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ de dag rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdu nas bdag mdun la thim par bsams la/ ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañja hūṃ phaṭa/ cesathun bzhir bcad nas bzla/ de'ang bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag gsum du gong ma rnams kyis bshad pa 'tshub chung ba'i ched yin pas/ bsnyen pa sngar byed ma myong ba'i rigs phye ring kho na byed pa'i dbang du btang ba yin gyi/ sku gsung thugs sngags kyang gtong na 'bum gcig tsam gyis kyang chog pas/ don du grangs ji tsam byed pa de zhag grangs du ma bu lngar bcad nas/ dum bu dang po la dmigs pa 'di kho nar chig dril byas pa gnad du che zhing / thun re re bzhin dmigs pa bzhi ga byed pa ni lugs gcig la yod pas 'gal ba ni med do/ /de'ang rnam rtog gis mi 'chun pa'i rigs la dag zhing gi rten brten pa zhig logs su yod pa ltar (8na)blos bcos nas bdag bskyed nas mdun bskyed la 'phros/de las kyang rang bzhin gyi gnas su spros te bdag mdun gnyis gar dngos grub bsdu ba sogs mi 'thad pa ma yin pas gong du de ltar bshad mod/ gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len dang ldan tshe 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems nyid kyi rnam 'phrul las ma 'das pas 'og min sogs dag zhing dang sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams 'dzab khang mdun gyi lha tshogs las logs su med par —232

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanathag chod pas gong du smos pa'i dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du rnams 'dzab khang gi lha tshogs kho nar bgyis pas chog go /thun 'jog khar 'dzab bstod btang rjes 'bru gsum dor ba'i dbyangs gsal mjug phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tsho gos thams cad 'grub par gyur cig swāhā/ lan gsum mam bdun gang rung dang brtan ched du gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa kha bsos nas mchode bstod bsdus pa zhig bya shrī ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya sto hoḥ zhes 'dzab khang gi lha bdag nyid las logs su med kyang chu nang gi zla ba ltar snang ba la me tog 'thor/ hūṃ/ lhun grub rang bzhin gnas pa'i pho brang nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed kyi lha/ /ma lus mnyam pa rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /'jam dpal sku gsung thugs yon byin rlabs dang / khyad par brtul zhugs drag po stobs kyi rtsal/ /mngon spyod 'grub pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol/ /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba (8ba)sirnyi sirnyi hūṃ dzaḥ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig gang rung brjod pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas lnga'i yig 'bru las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu'i rnam par byung nas bdag gi spyi mgrin snying ga ste gsang gi gnas rnams su thim pas dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam/ hūṃ dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ 'dzab khang tshur bsdus nas tha mi dad par bsam/ de nas bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad med bzhin du snang ba sems/ sems stong pa snang stong dbyer med/ dbyer med brjod bral ka dag spros bral gyi ngang du cung zad glod/ de'i ngang nas chu las nya ldang ba ltar lam gyis gsal btab ste sku'i sngags bzlas nas lus bsrung / bsngo smon ci rigs bya/ bar chad kyi mtshan ltas che na/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i srung 'khor ram byang gter gyi srung 'bor drug gang bde bya/ gung thun la 'byung ba cha snyoms pa'i ched du nyal ba'i tshe/ gzhan yang rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha brgyad ces sogs kyis 'od gsal du bsdus te dmigs med kyi ngang nas sngags bzlas pas gnyid log pa'i ring gi dbugs 'byung 'jug thams cad bzlas par 'gro/ thor thun gyi tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rang nyid gtso bo'i —233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nga rgyal gyis langs te las byang rgyas bsdus gang rung gyer nas nyams len byed lugs srod thun ji lta ba la/ 'phreng ba byin rlabs par bka' ma byas pas chog kyang 'bru gsum dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po ru tsi gam rta rnams bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma srung 'khor bsdu chog gsum dor/ dgongs thun gyi mjug las gshin gter srung bam bskang gi gsol ga (9na)kha ton dge sbyor gzhan yod na bya/ tshan pa lngar bcad pa'i/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i zhag grangs la bdag byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ku'i hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'bros pa'i 'od zer gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyor lugs sngar ltar la/ thugs ka nas phyi rol tu 'phro ba'i tshe 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa thon 'dzab khang gi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas de dag gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer de 'dra dpag tu med pa phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad las sku 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi rnam pa che ba ri rab chung ba yungs 'bru tsam pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas bdag mdun gnyis ka la sib kyi thim pas sku sngar bas kyang gzi brjid che ba nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od ltar rgyas shing sku'i dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad a kro 'bru bstobadun pa/ skye ring sku gsung thugs sngags/ ā li kā li sogs rang sgra sgrog pa dpag tu med pa byung ba rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bas kyang che ba grag stong skye ba med pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa yan lag drug cu sogs gsung gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams rdo rje/'khor lo/ ral gri /be con/ gtun shing sogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa'i rnam par byung ba 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par ltem gyi zhu nas/ rang gi snying khar thim pas sems gsal stong 'dzin med bde ba chen po'i ye shes rgyas te/ thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam/ yang (9ba)thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ phyir 'phros snod bcud kyi ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa/ tshur 'dus bdag mdun —234

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanaganyis ka la thim par bsam/ lnga tshan bzhi pa'i zhag grangs kyi ring sgrub pa chen po'am do li'i bzlas pa ni/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor 'god lugs gong ltar la/ 'od zer 'ja' 'od la mthing kha shas che ba ye shes sems dpa'i zhal lam shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ rang gi lce pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze 'bru la hrīḥdamar po'i mtha' skor du a kro bcu bdun pa dmar po'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba la phog /'od zer dmar shas che ba zhal nas thon shangs bug g.yon du zhugs/ klad pa dung khang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā+oṃ dkar po'i mthar a kro bcu bdun pa dkar po'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba la phog /slar 'od zer dkar shas che ba shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon du zhugs/ thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pa mgal me'i 'khor lo lta bur nan tan du bya/ yang ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas nas 'od zer thur du 'phros/ rdo rje'i lam nas thon pa 'dzab khang gi gtso bo'i gsang gnas brgyud/ ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon du zhugs/ thugs rgyud bskul te g.yas nas thon/ ljags dang dung khang gi 'gro lugs sngar ltar la/ shangs bug g.yas nas thon pa bdag bskyed kyi shangs bug g.yon du zhugs/ rim gyis klad khang ljags steng brgyud (10na)nas ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas 'asdug pa sogs bdag mdun gnyis la mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar bskor bas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ de nas 'od zer phyir 'phros te phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros/ 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la phog bas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/mthu dpal gzi mdangs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas/ bdag nyid ye shes kyi sku shin tu gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros/ yul gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs rnams la phog pas bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar bcoms/ 'od zer tshur 'dus de dag —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nagi tshe dang bsod nams kyang bdag la thim zhing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i khro chung phyag na me rlung gi 'khor lo bsnams pas gtams ta bar gcod bsrung bar bsgom zhing las dang po pas de dag la khrigs su byas pa'am brtan pa cung zad thob pas 'phro 'du rnams cig car du bya ba yin no/ /lnga tshan lnga pa'i zhag grangs kyi ring yas bzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'dzab khang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag mdun gnyis ga'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong dus gcig la shar ba lta bu 'phros pa rang gi lus la zhugs/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa/ nad thams cad snag (10ba/bug ljan ljin gyi rnam pa/ gdon thams cad srog chags kyi rnam pa rnams ye shes kyi mes gzhob thul gyis bsregs/mun khung du nyi zer shar ba ltar gyur/ nad gdon khol ba la de ga'i thad du khol chags lta bu'i bug pa nas du ba'am rlangs pa lta bu bun bun thon par bsam/ gzhan don du byed na bdag gzhan kha spo/ rgyas pa la bdag mdun gnyis ka nas 'od zer ser po phyi rol tu 'phros/ bla tshe srog gsum brkus phyogs yar ba yi ge rtsi dang 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam pa/ sa chu me rlung gi bas rnams bdud rtsi ser dkar dmar ljang gi rnam pa/ 'jig rten gyi gtso bo gsum/ brgya byin sogs lha/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ grul bum/ klu la sogs pa mi ma yin mthu bo che/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po/ khams kyi rgyal phran/ khyim bdag btsan phyug sogs kyi tshe dang bsod nams mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi mkhyen pa/ grub thob ku su li rnams kyi rtogs pa/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas/ byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos stong srung ma rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od dang 'od zer sogs bkra shis rtags rdzas lta bu gzugs can gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan rgyas par bsam/ dbang la bdag mdun gnyis rka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khams gsum gyi mi nor zas gsum thams cad dbang du bsdusanas char bzhin babs par bsam/ sgos kyi dmigs bsal yod tshe/ skyes pa bud med lta bu la mtshon —236

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(kha)na/ gang yin de ga'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung / rkang zhabs nas rlung gis bteg nas sbur (11nasgo rlung gis khyer ba bzhin bkug ste/ rang gi rkang pa la kho'i mgo bo btud par bsam/ drag po'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag mdun gnyis las 'od zer nag po tsha zhing rtsub pa grangs med pa'i sne mor lcags kyu/ phur pa/ ral gri/ dgra sta/ 'khor lo sogs mtsho ni cha'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa yod pa spros/ bstan dang rang g.yin skyabs yul dang bcas pa la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs bar gcod thams cad lcags kyus rang dbang med par bkug /mtshon cha sna tsho gos kyis btubs/ ye shes kyi mes bsregasate thal ba'i rdul phran tsam du brlag par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa phyi skor sku'i drag sngags ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ yig gi mthar 'bru bcu gnyis pa kha dog mthing khas bskor ba las/ 'od zer 'phro 'du thams cad dngos gzhi 'bru bcu bdun pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba la/ thugs ka tsam du ma zad ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'phro ba dmigs bsal yin cing / bsnyen pa/ bdag byin brlab/do li/las bzhi bzhi ga kha bsgyur dgos/ de'ang sngags kun gyi thog mar sku'i sngags bzla bar sungs te/sngags don gsal sgron du/ drag po sngags kyi 'bru bcu gnyis pa de dag ni zhal gyi dmod pa drag po mngon du phyung ste gsang chen gcig tu dril ba'i sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin te kun gyi 'go la bgrang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ grangs ni 'bru 'bum tsam skabs su bab bo/ /gsum pa nang skor gsung gi drag sngags ni/ gzhan thams cad sku'i bsnyen pa ji lta ba la/ ba spu'i bu ga'i tshab tu ljags kyi rtse mo las 'od zer me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba dmigs bsal lo/ /bzhi pa (11ba〉nasang skor thugs kyi drag sngags ni/ gzhan thams cad 'dra ba la/ ljags nas ba'i tshab la/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor de mgal me lta bur 'khor ba/ khyad chos yin cing / grangs ni 'bru 'bum tsam gsung yang gsung thugs la bye ba re lags shing / las rung tsam la skor bzhi ga 'bum tsam gyis chog go/ /de dag kyang bsnyen pa ltar bzlas pa yin gyi/ rang rang gi spu gri'i sgo nas las phan gnod bsgrub pa ni man ngag ltar shes par bya'o/ /dmar yig tu/ sku yi sngags sbyor brnag pa dang / /dmar len snying phyung 'bru brgyad gsungs/ /—237—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)drag sngags sbyor ba'i rgyal por bshad/ /ces dang / e dun ka waṃ/ gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags te/ /spu gri rnam gsum ma nges gyur/ /zhes dang / kun kyang chos nyid ma bcos pa'i/ /ma 'gags rang snang rol pa'i rtsal / /chos kun snying por gyur pa yi/ /'jam dpal gzhen nu yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /lnga pa yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags bzlas thabs ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying / 'jam dpal lha rgyud kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i drag sngags/ drag po mye ring gi sngags te/ 'di la bsnyen par bzlas pa dang / drag por bzlas pa gnyis/ dang po zhi bar bsnyen po ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ gi mthar thugs kyi sngags dang / de'i phyi skor du phye ring mthing kha/ ljags kyi hrīḥmathar gsung sngags dang phye ring dmar po/ dung khang gi ā+oṃ gyi mthar sku sngags dang skye ring dkar pos bskor ba tsam ma gtogs bsnyen sgrub/sgrub chen (12na〉pas bzhi thams cad la a kro spyi bsnyen kha bsgyur ba'o/ /bha su dha ra'i rgyud kyi spyi spyod las/ phyi skor sku yi drag sngags dang / /nang skor gsung gi drag sngags dang / /gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags dang / yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags so/ /de la phyi skor sku yi drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa la/ las phan gnod dang bcas pa'o/ /nang skor gsung gi drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba 'bru brgyad pa las dang bcas pa'o/ /gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i 'bru bzhi pa las dang bcas pa'o/ /yang gsang rgod ni drag po sngags ring las dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i/ rtsa ba lus kyi drag sngags la/ /yig 'bru brgya dang zhe dgu yang / /'bum phrag gcig tu bzla bar bya/ /zhes dang / de ni lus kyi tshul yin te/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bar bsnyen/ /zhes 'bum phrag gcig tu bzla bar gsungs pa 'bras dus la dgongs kyi/ deng sang 'bum phrag gsum du bzla ba gong ma rnams kyi phyag len no/ /gnyis pa ni/ drag por bzla ba la ltar gsal ba/ yul gsal ba/ sngags gsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag mdun rgyan gyi lha brgyad gsal thebs pa gal che 'on kyang thugs kar sngags 'bor ni mi dgos/gnyis zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang bcas pa gsal bar byas la/ bdag mdun —238

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(kha)gnyis kyi gtso bo'i thugs gi po che ma'i smug po lta bu'i/ tsit+ta'i nang du nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ mthing kha/ nyi gdan la bzhugs/ ya ma rā gtso bo'i thugs la rgyab bsnyes byas pa lta bu/ dza'i thugs gar nyi gdan/ ya smug nag /zla gdan/phyag rdor gyi (12ba)thugs ya ma'i thugs la rgyab bsnyes/ gar hūṃ nyi gdan/ sngon po/ rus sbal pad gdan gyi steng du kha thur du blta/ gyi thugs gar 'khor 'das kyi srog gi dngas ma rgya gar gyi yi ge'i dbyibs can 'di lta bu ('dir lā& zhig 'dug kyang 'bri thabs ma rnyed/)bya khyung gi thugs nyi gdan/ kur dkar po/ khrom/ yum gyi thugs nyi gdan/ gar mthing / ma/ so so'i sa bon gyi mthar phye ring gi sngags phreng gas rnams mthing nag /ya ma rā dza smug po bya khyung dkar po dgos rigs yin bog /raka mo n+ta yan rdzogs mtshams su gnod dper na rgyal 'gong lta bu la byed na gong gi dgra bgegs kyi tshab la gnod byed rgyal 'gong lta bu 'dug /byed dgra bgegs thams cad myags thum ril trig nan/ sbur ya nan/ e rgyal po la ye dang tsa rjes/ 'di srog yig lha 'dre dmigs bsal yod na sgyur byed kyi yi ge yin/'phrog pa'i srog chu mos 'di min/ tshis ke kā yin no/ yin thums dzaḥ zhe shag ro myags mugs ti rbad ya/ zhesabatags pas bskor ba bsgom/ gnyis pa yul gsal ba ni/ mdun du ting nge 'dzin gyi sprul pa'i e las gnam lcags kyi 'brub khung gru gsum/ bang rim sum ldan phyi nag nang du 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khol zhing zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ phyi nas gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa/ kha dog mthil yangs zin nas thar pa med pa'i nang du rtsi las dgra dang tri las bgegs gang yin pa mdog nag cing baṃ pa/nyam thag cing mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs can yan lag sprul dang lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa 'chor ba med par bsam/ yang ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pho nya grangs med pa spros/ dmigs bya thams cad btson khrid pa bzhin rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs la bstim mo/ /gsum pa sngags gsal ba ni/dmar yig tu/ a mu kai /'bru gsum srog gshed (13na〉bsdebs pa yin/ myags/ gcig gis srog dang snying po gzhom/ thum ril/ gnyis kyis rbod /gtong rang la bzlog /trig nan sbur ya nan/ lnga yis stobs dang nus pa gnon/ e gcig gis stong srog gnod yig 'gyur/ hur thums dzaḥ gsum gyisasrog gi 'bras bu sdud/ kho shag 'bru gnyis rtsa dang dngas ma 'bral/ ro myags/ gnyis kyis stobs —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dang nus pa gnon/ mugs ti rbad/ gsum gyis lus srog sbyor ba gcod/ ces pa ltar thugs ga'i sngags 'phrong rnams las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas 'phros te/ 'od zer gnam lcags kyi so dang spu gri'i so la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba dpag tu med pa bun bun byung ba/ mdun gyi dgra bgegs kyi lus la phog pas nyal nyal thor thor btang nas sngags bzla bzhin pa'i e hur thums dza'i skabs dgra bgegs kyi srog gi ngo bo rtsi dang tri la sogs pa gang yin pa de rang dbang med par bsdus te/ rus sbal gyi thugs ku'i lu lha'i e kā la thim par bsams nas zla ba bdun nam gcig gam gsum mam tha ma'ang zhag gsum tsam bzla/ zhi bar bsnyen pa thengs nas rgyun 'dzab sogs thams cad la spyang mo btags pa 'di ga legs zhes gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang pos yang yang bka' stsal ba thos zhes kho bo'i bla ma zur thams cad mkhyen pa lan cig ma yin par gsung / bye brag tu pha rol gyi stobs gzhom pa la sogs pa'i ched du srod dang tho rengs brgya rtsa re bzla bar bya'o/ /rtsa bar/ srod dang tho rengs brgya brgya yis/ /phas stobs dang sbyor ba 'joms/ /zhesadang / bal po bha su dha ras/ drag po (13bgyi ring sags rgod 'di/ /rtag par rgyun du bzlas gyur na/'jig rten lha 'dre khams zhakhrug cing / /lha srin tsit+ta dkrug par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang sbyang mo drug po dang / gang gnod pa'i sgos srog dmigs su shar ba la sogs pa man ngag ltar bya'o/ /rtsa bar drag po skye ring sngags rgod la/ /'byung ba lnga yis 'go 'dren bsgyur/ /drag po e yi rtsa ba la/ /btsan po mkhar du gzhug pa dang / /spyi srog dbang du sdud pa dang / /stong srog gnad la bor ba dang / /sgos srog dmigs su shor ba'i las/ /mkhas pas bsdeb pa shes par bya/ /'di skor gyi zhib cha ni pad lugs sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor sdig pa snying 'dzings drag po'i 'bru 'grel sogs las shes par bya/bshad ma thag pa'i bsnyen lugs rnams 'dzab khang dbye ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ sman raka gtor gsum tsam la brten na/ mdun bskyed kyi dmigs pa rnams dor bas 'grub bo/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ mdor bsdus pa gong gi drag por bzla bas go chod mod/ rgyas par spro na mchod —240

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(kha)rten bcas chog /de tsam ma 'grub na thod pa zhal dbye mchog phag liṅga tsam la brten pa sogs rnam grangs mang yang / 'dir snying po bsdus par spros pa che na man ngag sgron ma drug pa sogs las 'byung ba ltar stegs bu 'brub khung bca' ba'am/ ma 'grub na/ shing lcags kyi hom khung ngam/ lcags slang lta bur 'khor lo gsang ba'i pra khrid las/ bdag 'dra ban chung sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /rgya gar mkhas pa gtsug lag dpal dge yis/ /'khor lo'i gdams pa pra khrid gsang ba 'di/ /(14na)bal yul yam bu'i dgon par gnang ba yin/ /'dzam gling bod yul tsam nas mi rnyed de/ /lnga brgya dus kyi gang zag skal pa can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo bcas pasahrūb ba ni/ /steng 'og 'khor lo gnyis po bsko mi dgos/ /srid pa rus sbal sto na dngas snyigs 'khor lo gnas/ /zhes sogs byung ba ltar/ stong srog 'khor lo phyag len ltar bris pa bcug /'dzab bstod yan song nas/ gser skyems nas bzung / lha dbye'i bar dkyus bzhin btang / thun re'i thog mar phye ring la spyang mo btags pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing / de nas rang nyid lhar gsal bar byas la/ ting nge 'dzin gyis ngar bskyed la drag sngags bzlasapas/ dbugs kyi rta las drag sngags mtsho ni cha'i rang bzhin shugs kyis 'phros nas/ sha za srog gcod mang po bskul te/ dgra bo'i bu ga dgu ru thim/ kho'i srog gi ngo bo/ khrag gi sbal pa bye'u lan pa'i mgo bo tsam zhig gi nang na rgya gar gyi yi ge ya dmar nag gi dbus na/ ma gnas pa ma'i mig na rje ljang gu zhig gnas pa la/ drag sngags bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ snying la gnas pa'i drag sngags 'bru brgyad/me dang chu 'bar zhing khol bas zhabrug cing bskyod nas dngas ma'i rtsa bzhi'i nang nas nad 'du ba rnam bzhi langs te/ rang gshed kyi sdig pa nag po bzhi'i rwa brgyad las/ drag sngags tsā brgyad spu gri yis/ /rtsa chen bzhi dang rtsa phran brgyad po bcad nas kho rang gi snying na gnas pa'i ye shes sems dpa' bcug cing bsgoms pa'i tshe bdag de zhe sdang lcags kyi sdig pa nag por gyur nas/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dngas ma bzhi bsdus shing (14ba)srog rtsa gcod par bsam/ kho'i srog gi ngo bo snro ru gnas pa dang / khrag gi sbal par bcas pa de 'khrul 'khor bcas pa de la bsdus nas thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i dmigs —24/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa dang ldan pas zhag bdun nam dgu ru drag po'i las 'di la 'jug go /rgyun sngags 'khor lo nag po'i drag sngags drag po btsan thabs 'dis brdeg go /de'i drag sngags bstan pa ni 'di'o/ /phye myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ dgra po'i srog la ni hur thums dza: rtsa khrag snying thums ril raṃ shag rbad/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta breng shag dzaḥ srog la ni hur thums rbad/ ces bzla zhing / thun 'jog khar skam rlon gyi thun rdzas la phus btab nas nyin mtshan gyi dbye ba'i thun sngags dang bcas thun brdeg /thun gtor la rak+ta sbran/ dgug gzhug lan gsum/ sman raka sbran drag gtor ltar byin brlab/ phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la zhes sogs kyis 'bul/ yang bzlog gi bsad pa'i bskul tshig dang lcags sam bhan+ta sa dgra phyogs su 'phen pa ni/ rgyud las/ bskyod pa kha gso rgyun mi bcad/ /ces pa'i dgongs pa dang 'brel/ de ltar bsad rtags ma byung gi bar bsgrub bo/ /de rjes tshogs byin rlabs nas stob pa'i bar dang / lhag ma btson du bzung / chad mtho bstan skyong rnams btang ngo / /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa las sbyor ni/ dgug gzhug nas bzung zhal stob kyi bar zhi dkyus ban byas rjes/ 'khor lo'i nang gi liṅga bton pa drag po'i sbyin sreg gam/ yang na mnan pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pas mtha' bsdu/ zor las zhag sbrel lam nyin gcig (15na skong rung rgyas par bya/ de'ang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rgyud dang rtags rnam nges rin chen sgron mer rgyas par gsungs kyang / 'dir snying por bsgril ba lcags sdig bad kun dar dkar yol ba las chad pa'i chos sde las/ phye ring bsnyen pa'i grub rtags dang gcig /rbod gtong rbad pa'i grub rtags dang gnyis/ mye ring bsad bzlog gi grub rtags dang gsum/ dang po phye ring bsnyen pa'i grub rtags ni/ mkhar ram btsan sa zin pa dang / /go cha lus la gyon pa dang / /mtshon gyi rtse mo brdar ba dang / /de rnams dang po'i rtags su bshad/ /gangs la nyi ma shar ba dang / /dung dkar 'bud dang gyen la 'dzeg /ri bo klad la bskor ba dang / /me tog sna tsho gos 'thu ba dang / /lus la me 'od 'phro ba dang / /lha yi gnas su phyin pa rmi/ /de rnams bar ma'i rtags su bshad/ /thams cad sgyu mar shes pa dang / /snang ba 'dzin pa chung ba dang / /zas nor 'dod sred chung ba dang / /ci smras chos su —242

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(kha)'ong ba dang / /lus yang sems stobs che ba dang / /ri dang rtsig pa kun la yang / /thogs pa med par 'gro ba dang / /po ti glegs bam thams cad kyang / /mthong ba tsam gyis grol ba dang / /rigs drug skad rnams rnam bcud shes/ /sems can kun la byams dang snying rje skye/ /de rnams mthar phyin tha ma'i rtags su bstan/ /phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod gtong lha rtags ni/ /gshin rje rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /a tsar nag po gar byed 'os/ /ma mo rbod pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /bud med nag mo bshan byed 'ong / /gnod sbyin rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /dar dang ru mtshon lung pa gang / /klu rnamasarbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /(15bskong 'og chu dang na bun 'brub/ /rgya mtshor nya sprul gang ba dang / /sbal lcong glu bro brdung ba rmi/ /rgyal po rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /lha khang 'jig dang lder bzo smra/ /btsun pa gsil byed thogs pa rmi/ /srog bdag rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /rta dkar 'tsher dang khyi dkar zug /bya dkar the le smra ba dang / /mi reng zhags pa thogs pa rmi/ /srin po rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /lung pa 'tshub mas gang ba dang / /mi reng ro la zhon pa rmi/ /ru dra rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /blags pa zor thun thogs pa dang / /bya nag klad la ldir ba rmi/ /btsan rnams rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /brag dmar rtse la 'dzeg pa dang / /rta pa phub can 'khrug pa rmi/ /gza' rnams rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /nam mkha' 'a bla' yi 'od du 'khyil/ /'brug dang ser ba 'bab pa rmi/ /'gong the rbad pa'i mtshan rtags su/ /byis pa bskul rdo thogs pa dang / khye thong gos dmar gyon pa rmi/ /dam sri spyi yi mtshan rtags su/ /dmar dang dmag dang zang zing dang / /phug stong 'grim dang lung stong 'khyams/ /de rnams spyi yi rtags yin no/ /zhal gdams gnad kyi shog dril ston/ /don gsum pa/ phye ring bsad bzlog gi rtags bstan pa ni/ /sbra nag tshugs shing 'gyel ba dang / /bya nag rnyi la zin pa dang / khyi nag thur la bdas pa ni/ /'gong po bzlog pa'i rtags su bshad/ /a tsar gar byed bkyigs pa dang / /bdud bya skyung ka bzung ba ni/ /bdud dang gshin rje bzlog pa'i rtags/ /bud med gdos la bcug pa dang / /brag dmar rtse nas nyil ba ni/ /btsan dang ma mo bzlog pa'i rtags/ /sngags pa lcags su bcug pa dang / /mi reng thur la bdas —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa ni/ /ru dra srin po bzlog pa'i rtags/ /lha khang me yis bsregs pa dang / /btsun pa dong du bskyur ba dang / /rta dkar thur la bdas pa (16na skong / /bya dkar rnyi la bzung ba ni/ /rgyal po srog bdag bzlog pa'i rtags/ /rgya mtsho gting nas bskams pa dang / /nya sbal mgo nas za ba dang / khye thong dbyug pa thogs pa ni/ /klu dang the'u rang bzlog pa'i rtags/ /mtshon cha lag na thogs nas su/ /srog chags mang po bsad pa dang / /dud 'gro thur la bdas pa ni/ /dam sri rnams ni bzlog pa'i rtags/ /sems can kun gyi lce za zhing / /rbod gtong gtong ba'i ru dra de/ /snying bston lte ni za ba rmi/ /rang gshed rang la phebs pa'i rtags/ /zhes so/ /mtshams la gces pa'i dam tshig dang spang blang gi rim pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma'i gsung gis bod kyi sngags pa rnams la rtags dang yon tan tshul bzhin du mi 'byung ba ni mtshams gsum ral ba'i skyon yin/ mtshams gsum ni/ sku mtshams ma grol bar g.yin dang 'phrad pa/ gsung mtshams ma grol bar ngag shor ba/ thugs mtshams ma grol bar nyen mongs drag pos bar gcod pa'o/ /dam tshig gsum nyams na mi 'byung ste/ bskyed pa'i sku mi gsal/ bzlas pa'i sngags mi dag /bsgoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin g.yel ba'o/ /bsrung bya gsum nyams na mi 'byung ste/ /lus kyi bcud thig le nyams pa/ ngag gi bcud mchil ma dor pa/ yid kyi bcud rnam rtog rgyun ma bcad pa'o/ /yan lag ni/ sgrub pa ma thon par gnas mi spo/ gdan mi sprug /mi dang kha 'phro mi bsre/ gtor ma dus ma yol bar 'bul/ 'thab 'khon mi bya/ gtor phud nyams su mi 'jug /sgrub khang du khyi yugs sa mdze po dme can 'ong mi 'a sdug /de kun gyis zas skom (16bsgo 'dzem smar dang ag tshom mi 'breg /rang gi nyal mal du gzhan mi gtong / phreng stan mi lag mi 'grim/ gzhu mi phab/ mda' mi gcog /mtshon rtse khar mi 'jug /spyir sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ skyon bcu spong dgos/ bcu ni sgra skyon lnga la/ che ba/chung ba/ mgyogs pa/ bul pa/ me phub dang lnga'o/ /bar chad lnga ni/ glo lu pa/ gtam smra ba/ sgrid pa/gnyid la shor ba/ yengs pa dang lnga'o/ /'di lnga ni ting nge 'dzin gyi srog nyams pa'i skyon yin no/ /de'ang rngam slong las/ sgra ches skyon ni 'byung po dang / /snod med thos gyur bar chad 'byung / /de la sngags kyi —244

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khananus pa med/ /bul na bzlas pa'i grangs mi thims/ /dus 'das bar chad sbyor ba 'byung / / glo dang sbrid pa gtam dang ni/ /gnyid la sogs pas bar gcod na/ /de ni yi dwags bdud la sogs/ /spro nas bar chad sgyur bar byed/ /sems yengs nus pa mi 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /des na bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ /bzlas pa'i 'phro la gnyid bro ba/ glal/ sgrid pa/ lud pa/ 'og rlung /bshang ba/ gcin sogs byung na de ma thag 'phreng ba bzhag ste nye reg bya nyid kha bshal nas gong gi de 'dra byung skabs kyi sngags de bzlas pa'i grangs su mi gzhug go /de bas na bsnyen sgrub spyi la gnyid sogs bdun po byung skabs kyi sngags de bzlas grangs su mi brtsi ba yin cing / 'phreng skor 'khor nas mdo 'dzir rtsar ma sleb pa'i bar rnams su mi dang gtam shor na sngar bcad zin nas 'phreng rdog bzhi/glo lu na lnga/ glal na gsum/ sbrid na bcu/ mchil snabs lud pa sogs 'dor na gcig /'og (17na)rlung la bdun/ gnyid la bco lnga rnams grangs su mi brtsi bar bshad la/ gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i skabs su lha gzhan gyi sngags dang chos spyod byas na yid kyis bshags shing gsol ba btab nas bzlas pa snga ma la 'jug /bgegs bsrung ba dang / nad zhi ba dang / lhod pa dang / bag med pa dang / lus sems skyo ba dang / ma bsdams pa dang / mi gtsang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa sogs 'phral rkyen zhi ba dang / mtshams gsum gong du bshad pa ltar ma bsdams par sngags bzlas pa ni rtsa ba'i gzhi bsnyen gyi grangs dang /bsnyen pa kha gso ba sogs grangs bsnyen gyi grangs su mi brtsi bar legs grub las gsungs so/ /yang bzlas pa'i phyed gnas gcig tu byas phyed gzhan du spos nas bzlas pa dang / bzlas pa dus las 'das pa sogs kyis kyang bzlas pa'i go mi chod do/ /dus las bzlas pa zhes pa ni bsnyen sgrub kyi thog ma nas thun drug gam lnga'am bzhi sogs gang bcad pa de nyid bsnyen sgrub ma thob bar sgrigs la 'bebs dgos kyi/ rang gi dal 'khom dang bstun nas thun grangs gang rung byas pas mi 'thus so/ /gzhan yang srid pa'i gter khyim dang rdzong 'phrang dang rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud sogs bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung chen dang bstun cing / bsnyen pa thems kyang rtags med na sngags sdebs kyis gnad la dbab —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa sogs mkhas pas gnad dang ldan par bya ba gal che'o/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa mjug gi rim pa la/ las byang gzhung bsrangs tshogis tha ma yan btang / /dngos grub len par/ rdzas bshams/bgegs bskrad/ byin 'bebs pa/ dngos (17ba)grub bsdu ba/ bskul ba/ len pa/ dngos/ smon lam shis brjod dang bdun gyi/ dang po la/ rten gtor tsam la brten na bam chos su btsug pa/ tshe bum/tshe ril/ tshe chang sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas thams cad ma tshang ba med par bsags/ gnyis pa bgegs sgrod dang / gsum pa byin 'bebs las byang ltar byas rjes/ bam bsnyen dus nas bcas che dus de ga dang / gzhan ma 'di'i dus nges don bde 'jug las byung ba ltar bam la bskyed bstim mchod bstod bsdus pa tsam dang / tshe bum gyi sgrub pa gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dbang chog nas len/bzhi pa dngos grub bsdu ba ni/ bdag zil gnon du gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'i sa bon las 'od glog gi zhags pa ltar rno zhing myur ba spros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud ma lus pa'i tshe srog dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa bsdus che rgyas dang tshogs rdzas la thim par bas myo// kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ā yudz+nyā na tshe zlo ṇi dzaḥ& swāhā/zhes pa brgya rtsa sogs bzlas rjes/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad sems/ /'jig rten dregs pa yab yum thim/ /yab yum sngags bcas hūṃ la bsdu/ /hūṃ bcas dngos grub rdzas la bsdu/ /rang gi lusang ga yid la thim/ /zhes brjod/ lnga pa dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hoḥ nam mkha'i khams mnyam zil gnon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sku yi dngos grub nam mkha'i dkyil zhi yangs ban/ /gsung gi dngos grub 'gag med brjod dang bral/ /thugs kyi dngos grub mi rtog mnyam pa'i ngang / /yon tan dngos grub yid bzhin rin chen (18na gi ter/ /'phrin las dngos grub rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor/ /ji ltar bsams pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnas skabs nad gdon bar gcod la sogs pa/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang / /mnga' thang snyan —246

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanagrags dgos dgu rgyas pa dang / /mos bzhis khams gsum srid gsum lha mi'i nor/ /yid la gang 'dod dbang du 'du ba dang / /bstan dang bla mar do bsdo bdag la 'tshe/ /dgra bgegs gang byung drag pos bsgral ba sogs/ /rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mthar thug bdag don phun tshogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob cing / /gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul gzugs skus chos bstan nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la rab 'god pa'i/ /don gnyis phun tshogs dngos grub deng stsol zhig /hūṃ/ yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid rigs 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /'dzab bsnyen grangs su thems zin gyi/ /bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob zin gyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskangs zin gyi/ /sgrub pa'i zhag grangs thems zin gyi/ /rdo rje srin po nam langs nye/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ /dam can thugs dam bdag bskul gyi/ /sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang / /dam bcas ma (18ba)bsnyel deng dgongs la/ /dngos grub dam pa da lta stsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ drug pa dngos grub len pa ni/ bam dpral bar te gtugs/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston zhig /sku yi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis/ /rdos bcasalus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā ya sirnyi ā+oṃ/ mgrin par gtad la/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston zhig /gsung gi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis/ /'chal ba ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka wā ka sirnyi ā+oṃ/ snying gar gtad la/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtagasadang mtshan ma myur ston zhig /thugs kyi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis/ /'khrul pa sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka tsit+ta sid+dhi ā+oṃ/ gnas gsum du gtad la/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston zhig /rnam gsum dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis/ /dug gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ /sarba sirnyi pha la hrīḥ—247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zhes brjod/ sman mchod 'bul zhing dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams la rol/ bdun pa smon lam ni/ 'di ltar bsags pa'i legs byas mthus/ /bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad dang / khyad par 'jam dpal zhi khro yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa sogs dang / 'bad dang rtsol ba ma sogs kyi shis brjod kyang bya/ tshogs la rol pa nas rta bro'i bar dkyus bzhin dang / gtang rag gi mchod pa kha gso/ bdag mdun gnyis gar dmigs pa'i mchod bstod/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ rdul tshon dang tshom bu lta bu yin na ye shes rten dang dam tshig pa ngang la bsdu/ ras bris (19na〉la brtan bzhugs dang / bdag bskyed tsam la brten na rgyun gyi nyer bsdu las spros pa gzhan ma dgos smon lam shis brjod rgyas par bya/ rgyal mtho 'grol de nyin dam tshig gtsang ba'i mched lcam 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad/ dgra phyogs su mig blta stangasabyed pa de thul ba'i dgos pa/ nyi zla phyogs su blta ba tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel yod ces bla ma gong ma rnams gsung / de 'phral lam long skabs ci rigs par kha skong gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rang rig don gyi 'jam dpal kun tu bzang / /rang ngo ma 'phrod 'brul pa'i snang ngo sa /srog 'phrog ha la'i mdog can gshin rje'i rgyal/ /'gro tshogs ltag pa'i bdud sgor 'chi bdag gzugs/ /gtso 'khor gdul bya 'dul byed kun rdzob tu/ shar yang chos sku'i klong du ro gcig pa/ /'khor 'das gnyis med rang sems gdod ma'i rtsal/ /'di don rtogs na bzang ga blang dor bral/ /de phyir mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rnon pos bdud sde'i snying ga thal phyung du/ /'bigs la phyag rgya thams cad zil gnon pa/ /slu med skyabs gcig 'jam dpal gzhan nas su/ /'og min zhing gi gtso bos gsungs pa'i rgyud/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro rgya bal paṇa grub las/ /nyer brgyud pad+ma ka ra gnubs ban gyi/ /gdams pa'i byin rlabs drod rlangs deng ma yal/ /drin can bla ma'i gsung rgyun ma brjed cing / /rgyud 'grel man ngag gab dkrugs 'thor bsdebs las/ /g.yin zer tshig gi 'khar ba la brten pa'i/ /zhwa dpe lham gyi rgyas 'gebs 'di na med/ /snga 'gyur bka' gter gzhung mang thos (19ba)pa —248

'jam dpal phyag rgya zol gnon gyi bsnyen yig rdo rje rtse brgya pa/ nang ma(khanayi/ /spobs mtho tsam min pad lugs gshed skor la/ /mos pas 'bod brgyangs sngon goms bag chags mthus/ /smra ba'i gdengs tshad thob pas tshulu 'di bkod/ /rang nyams len dang gzhan la ston pa'i tshe/ /snying gar lag bsnol mi dgos bzhin gyi mdangs/ /dngom par nus 'di zur chen bla ma'i drin/ /stong gsum gser gyis bkang yang gzhal dka'i gnas/ /'on te mgon khyod rigs kyi bdag po sa /bzhugs pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje rang sems las/ /g.yin du mi 'tshol dngos po gcig blta ba'i/ /thag chod nyams 'og chud pas blo re bde/ /lam 'di'i sgo nas mchog mthun dngos grub tshogs/ /sgrub 'dod yongs kyi snying la mañju shrī/ /zhugs te skye bar dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /yi ge tshogs chen sa la myur bgrod shog /rigs 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog sprul pad+ma 'phrin las sa byi yang rdzong du lo gsum phyogs gsum gnang skabs bsnyen yig yid bzhin nor bu'i gsal byed du dngos grub gter mdzod bkod par zhib cha rnams zhal shes dang mthong brgyud las rtogs pa'i dbang du byas pas/ las dang po ba'i rigs go dka' ba'i skyan gyis/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis gsal byed cig byung na legs tshul dang / chos rje rkan bu ba gnubs zil gnon rdo rjes las sbyor gyi skor kha gsal ba zhig dgos tshul/ sngags rams pa blo bzang kun dga'/ jo gdan phun tshogs lhun grub/ 'phyong rgyas ngag dbang nam mkha'/ lta sa blo gros legs pa/ sngags rams pa ngag dbang mkhas btsun lnga bsnyen mtshams(byed skabs go gsal ba zhig dgos tshulu dang / slad nas/ sngags(20na tha tsun blo gros rgya mtsho so shin tu rgyas pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba dang / rtses dang mtsho gling chos mdzad ngag dbang bde chen dang ri chos pa chos rgyal mtshan gnyis bsnyen pa byed pa'i dus kyi gtugs pa la brten bur thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' drin las/ gdams skor 'di nyid kyi dbang lung man ngag rnams khong du chud cing / lcags sdig dang me'i spu gri'i skor gyi bka' gnang zhal shes rnams chos rgyal 'bri gung pa dkon cog phun tshogs kyi drung du nos pas tshul 'di la mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs rnyed pa'i za hor gyi sngags spyon zil —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal gyis chu khyi hor zla dang po'i dmar cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bgyis pa dzā yas// maṅga le//zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu sbyo/na zhes bya ba bzhugs/na maḥpad+mā ka rā ya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug thog ma'i mgon gyi ro 'dzin gser ldan dga' ma'i lto ba khyon yangs par/ /phun tshogs zab don theg mchog nor bus rab gang gsang chen rgyud rgyal ma hā yo ga chu gter chen po gang / /dpal ldan rdo rje snying pos bskul tsheg lhun po phul byung thugs rje chen po'i stobs ldan lha yis bsrubs pa las/ /legs 'ongs gshed skor dug bcud zla gzhen dbus na sdig rgyud nyin mor byed pas nag phyogs sde las rtag tu rgyal/ /de lta'i yang zab rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig /skal bzang 'gro ba stsol phyir kun tu bzang / /sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam rol can/ /dngos brgyud bla ma'i zhabs zung spyi bor bsten/ /khyad par gang gi yon tan pha mtha'i tshad/ /kun mkhyen gzigs pas gzhal yang rtogs dka' ba'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gtso gyur pad+ma 'byung / /grangs med skye bar dge ba'i bshes mdzod cig /drag sngags rdo rje'i pha lam rno dbal gyis/ /zhing bcu'i snying ga 'bigs pa'i gnubs ban rje/ /skye sprul zab gter sgo 'byed dum pa (2na)rgya/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od kyis legs par skyongs/ /gsang gter rin chen rgyal mtshan rtser 'dzin cing / /bdud dpung ma lus 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i thog /chos dbang skye mtha' 'phrin las yongs grub stsal/ /snyan brgyud rgyas par mdzad rnams phyag gi yul/ /rmad byung rgyud sde'i bdud rtsi zil mngar gyis/ /bdag blo'i bum bzang yongs su 'geng mdzad pa'i/ /chos 'di'i bka' drin stsal ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /snying dbus pad mtsho'i rgyan du rtag bzhugs shig /in+d+ra ni la'i sa 'dzin dbang po me dpung —25(/—

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khana'abar ba'i gos gyon zhing / /'bum phrag dbyar rnga'i sgra yang dman byed nga ro drag pos srid gsum 'dar/ /zag med bde stong rol ba'i dbyings las g.yo ba med pa'i gar gyis rtsen/ /bcom ldan dpa' bo phyag rgya zil gnon dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol/ /gnam sngon bzhu 'dra'i mtsho la ngang mo ltar/ /dam ldan rnal 'byor drung na legs 'dus nas/ /las bzhi'i tshogs kun thogs med sgrub byed pa'i/ /chos srung rgya mtsho me rtag tu shis par mdzod/ /gang zhig legs par bshad pa'i snyan brgyud mchog /thos tshe gla rtsi'i dri tshor (2ba)dug sbrul bzhin/ /ngan smras sna tshogs tshig gi lce rkyong ba'i/ /mkhas rlom rmongs pa'i thos chung khung bur nyol/ /me tog ro bcud myang la yid spro ba'i/ /bung ba'i rnam thar ji bzhin zab chos la/ /thos bsam lhur len rin cen lta bu yi/ /skal ldan tshogs rnams dga' ba'i gar byos shig /'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa
