gsal bar byed pa'i rnam par nges pa rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la gnyis/ khungs btsun zhing khyad par can du rtogs par bya ba lo rgyus bshad pa dang / tshul de ldan gyi rnam nges dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ rgyud 'di ston pas gsungs shing 'jig rten dregs pa'i gshin rje btul tshul/ gsungs pa'i rgyud bsdus shing lha dang mkha' 'gro la bshad pa/ de nas 'gro ba mi la ji ltar brgyud pa/ de lta bu'i rgyud man ngag rnams phyogs gar gtogs shing dgos ched gang dang ldan tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gnas chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang chen por/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la/ 'khor ye shes lnga la gnas pa dang /sa lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig pa mkhyen cing mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa lha dang mkha' 'gro rigs 'dzan rnams dang / spyod pa dang / bgrod pa phyin ci ma log pa'i 'jig rten dregs pa'i gtso bo sogs 'khor rnams kyis bskor ba'i dbus nas/ zhu ba po gsang ba'i bdag pos gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / 'a sdig rten pa'i gshin rje sogs —251—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dregs pa can (3na)dbang du bsdu zhing / bdud dang mu stegs sogs gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ rtsol med lhun grub mnyam pa chen po'i dgongs pas/ rtsa rgyud sogs rgyud rnams gsungs pa yin te/ /rtsa rgyud gleng gzhi'i le'u las/ rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba stan las langs te: bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba: kye ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang : chos sku thugs rje chen pos kun khyab kyang : ma rtogs sems can thugs rjes bsgral ba'i phyir mi rtog dbyings las rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs la: mnyam pa'i ngang las 'gro ba'i don mdzod cig ces gsol bas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nyad mi rtog pa'i dbyings rol pa chen po'i skur thugs rje chags pas bzhengs te/ dregs pa can dbang du bsdu zhing gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir/ phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te: gsang sngags 'di dag ched du gsungs so: zhes gsungs la/ gleng gzhi 'jig rten dregs pa'i gshin rje btul tshul ni rgyud rnams kyi gleng gzhi/ sdig pa'i skye rgyud kha thun lo rgyus sogs dang / 'khon ston rdo rje 'dzin pas nag po dra ba can gyi rgyud kyi khungs sogs dang sbyar te gsungs pa sogs gshed skor spyi bye brag gi bshad tshul rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag pos don bsdus te/ 'og min gyi gnas su lha'i bu tshangs pa dang nyi ma sogs lha rnams la bshad cing / lha'i bu bde ba mchog ldan gyis rdzu phrul gyi mthus o rgyan gyi yul du mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer la sogs la gsungs so/ /(3ba)gsum pa la rgya bal du byung tshul dang / bod du byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa'i rgyahrūl gyis mkha' 'gro'i sras su 'khrungs pa/ gsang ba'i bdag pos dbang bskur zhing rigs 'dzin gyi sku brnyes pa'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya ba brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas/ mig gi lta stangs tsam gyis kyang kha che'i rgyal po'i lus tshal bar bkas pa'i mthu mnga' ba sogs mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon chen po 'dis mkha' 'gro'i brda yig las mi yul du bsgyur cing / rgyud man ngag tu bsdebs pa yin la/ kha thun gyi lo rgyus chen mor/ ri ma la ya gnam —252

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanalcags 'bar ba'i rtser/ nyin 'od chags shing mtshan me 'bar ba gzigs pas/ der byon pa na/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gshin rje rtsa ba'i rgyud 'bum pa sogs rtsa rgyud thams cad phul zhing / phyi rabs kyi don du sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad par bshad dzi tshig rigs ma gtogs don gcig par sems so/ /de nyid kyis slob dpon pad+ma la gnang zhing / slob dpon 'di ni rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ 'gro ba so so'i snang ngo dang 'tsham pa'i sku'i bkod pa dang mdzad pa mtha' yas pa ston na'ang / gzur gnas tshad ldan la yongs su grags par/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du pad+ma'i sdong po las zhakhrungs shing / rgyal po in+d+ra bho ti'i sras su mnga' gsol yang / rgyal srid spangs te rgya gar phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i zhal mthong zhing dngos grub thob pas dregs pa can bran du 'khol ba/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la dgongs te/ rgya gar gyi mkhas grub rnams las/ shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i (4na〉spyol bstan cing / skye 'chi med pa tshe'i rigs 'dzin dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon 'di nyid kyis bal yul yam bu'i rgyal rigs las gnas lnga mkhyen cing mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa 'khor 'das yongs kyi srog la mnga' sgyur ba'i slob dpon bha su dha ra la gnang ba yin no/ /'khon ston rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos/ ri me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mor/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis gtsug lag dpal dge la gnang / des gnas de nyid du slob dpon pad+ma la gnang bar gsungs pa ni/ me'i spu gri'i gdams pa 'di slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dges rgyud las bsdus te slob dpon pad+ma la gnang ba lta bus mtsho ni te/ gshed skor 'ga' zhig de nyid la slob dpon pad+mas gsan pa yin la/ slob dpon pad+ma la'ang de nyid kyis ga sto pa yin te/ las byang snga ma brgyud mchod las/ o rgyan pad+ma gtsug lag dpal dge la/ /zhes pas kyang shes so/ /gzhan yang spyi spyod 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis 'a sngal dpal gshin rje'i rgyud le'u stong phrag bcu drug pa nas/—253

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)drag po gnam thog gi spyor ba rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i rgyud bcu drug las rtsa ba'i rgyud snying por phyung ba sdig pa snying 'dzings 'di man ngag tu bsdebs nas gtsug lag dpal dge la bshad/ des shān+ti gar+bha/ dha na da la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ bha su dha ra rnams las rim par brgyud nas gnubs chen gyis gsan par bshad do/ /spyir yang phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gdams pa'i brgyud rim la brtags tshe/shān+ti gi lha/ gtsug lag dpal dge /khrag 'thung nag po/ dha na da la/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung (4ba)gnas sogs de'i dus kyi slob dpon 'ga' zhig gshed skor gi chos bka' phan tshun du gsan res mdzad par mngon par mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing / tshig tshogs mangs kyis dogs pas zhib par ma spros so/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ slob dpon pad+ma la brten nas dar tshul/ slob dpon bha su dha ra la brten nas dar tshul/ gnyis ka zab mo'i gter du sbas pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs rje'i shugs las kha ba can gyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod kyi sa gzhi 'dul ba dang / dam pa'i chos dar ba'i ched du slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa spyan drangs pa sngon gyi smon lam mthu btsan pa'i shugs kyis byon nas bod mun pa'i gling lta bu dam pa'i chos kyi 'od stong gis dkar por mdzad de/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa bsgrubs shing / khyad par mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du rje 'bangs dgu sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du sman par mdzad pa'i skabs kyi sku 'jam dpal gshin rje la me tog babs pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che la 'jam dpal gshin rje'i skor mtha' yas pa gnang zhing / khyad par 'jam dpal gshin rje gsang ba'i rgyud 'khor lo 'bum pa'i le'u las phyung ba/ drag po gnam lcags thog gi sbyor ba rang gshed nag po drag sngags rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi snying po sdig pa snying la ru 'dzings 'khrul 'khor nag po'i rgyud las btus pa man ngag rtsa ba gnang la/ 'di nyid de las 'phros pas phal cher lcags 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dregs pa gnyis kyis gshin yul dme nag bya ba khrag mtsho gting 'khol gyi zhe —254

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanasdang lcags kyi sdig par dpe byas pa'i ko bse'i sdig pa'i snod (5na)du chu dar sngon po la gser gyis bris pa'i chos skor bcug ste/ khro chu'i sgrom bur rgyas btab pa dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du sbas pa slob dpon shārnyi ga lhas brtarna pa gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde 'di/ slob dpon pad+ma bod du phebasaskabs ha cang zab cing rno bas thugs la gab cing / dus de'i tshe chos khrims dang rgyal khrims gnyan pa'i stabs kyis bskal dus bzang bas gnubs kyis kyang man ngag gi mtha' rgya gcod pa ma byung zhing /phyis glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pas de 'dul ched bal yul du byon nas slob dpon rnar 'dzin lag dmas pa yongs rdzogs zhus te/ bal skad las bod du bsgyur ba yin te/ bka' 'byed las/ skye ba tre yi spun zla zhig: gnubs yul rong du tshe 'phos nas: sangs rgyas ye shes bya ba 'byung : smon lam las 'brel dag gi mthus: bal yul yam bu'i tshal du ni: bha su dha ra nyid dang mjal: gshin rje zla gsang chos dī: zhe gagasungs la/ slob dpon bha su dha ra la lcags sdig tu ma zad/ lcagasa'adra yang 'ga' zhig zhus te/ drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud bal po bha su dha ra dang / bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas ye shes kyis ba ra sa ru mkha' 'gro dang bka' bgros te bsgyur bar bshad pas shes so/ /bod du byon dus/ rgyal po dar ma lha lung dpal rdor gyis bsgral zin 'dug na'ang / bar der rang gi sras gnyis 'bangs kyis ngo log nas 'khrug pa la grangs 'dug pas nus mthu'i sgo nas dgra bo grong khyer dang bcas pa brlag pas/ bka' 'byed las/ ban chung bdag (5ba)gis bod du 'ongs: sgrags kyi grong khyer bdun cu gtan la phab: ces dang / sgrub khang pha ma'i mkhar las byas: sgrags la nag po'i rtse ru ni: nye 'byed rlung gi 'khor lo bskor sbrags kyi grong khyer sum cu rtsa bdun brlag ces so/ /gsum pa la gsum/ gter sbas pa dngos/ las 'phro can gyis bton tshul/gter gyi chos rnams gnyan zhing khyad par 'phags tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ thang yig las/ gtsang gi phug mo che ru tshe bdag sbas: zhes pa tsam las ma byung kyang / ga lhud mo/ phung po ri bo che/ myug gi rdo rje sgrom bu gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i dbus gtsang gi gnas du mar rgyas btab pa yin te/ bka' 'byed —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)las/ ma yi skor rnams lhud mo'i rdza la sbas bu yi skor rnams rdo rje'i sgrom bur sbas: zhes dang /gter byang las/ g.yung gi phu yi rdza bdud nag po la: dam chos bka' rtags bum skur bcas pa gtad:g.yas ru myu gu rdo rje sgrom bu dra/ dbang rtags rdo rje bka' ru bcas pa sbas g.yas ru gtsang 'khris phung po ri bo cher: dbang rtags bas sgrom smug po bcas pa sbas: zhes pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bka' thang las/ la stod gcung pa dril chen chu ltar 'khrug: g.yung phu rdza lhud sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung : gter ston dum rgya zhang khrom zhes bya 'byung : zhes pa dang / zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag las/ nga min nga yi cha byad can:sha ni ser la skra ni li: bongs ni thung la g.yas ni dkar: g.yon ni dmar ba'i sha mtshan can: so ni dkar la so tshags dam sme ba'i ga sha (6na〉ltad pa yi: lo ni khyi 'brug lo pa la: rus rgya ming ni zhang khrom zhes: de lta bu yis rnyed par shog ces pa ltar/ smon lam gyi mthus gnubs chen nyid rong ram pa chu chan khar rdo rje 'od 'bar du skye ba blangs nas/ gnubs chen gyi sprul pa zhig gis grogs byas gter sgo phye nas zab chos 'ga' zhig dang kha byang rnams thon rim gyis gter chos rnams rdzogs par bzhes shing / spyir gter ston 'di nyid yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' zhing / khyad par nus mthu 'gran zla med pas/ khro chu'i las rab rgya mtsho las/ phyi ru lo mang zhig lon pa na: rgya zhang khrom zhes bya ba gshin rje gshed dngos su 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig 'byon: des gter nas 'don cing gdams pa che ba bstan pa'i phyir gtor ma dang bskul byas pa tsam gyis bal bo dang gtsang stod bar du ban bon lnga bcu zhag bdun nas 'chi rtags thon nges par sgrol lo: zhes bshad la/ gter chos rnams las ldan gi slob ma du ma la gnang zhing / gangs can gi ljongs 'dir dar rgyas su gyur pa yin la/ khyad par se ston chen po dang / rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa mched yab sras rnams ring lugs 'di nyid 'dzin par 'gran zla dang bral ba yin cing / gdams pa phra mo tshul la'ang dka' ba dang du blangs te sgro 'dogs bcad pas/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis/ kho bo pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis/ /lus dang srog la —256

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)gcig ma bltas/ /dam pa'i chos la dung nge bsam/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gsum lo dus la/ /pha yul nor rdzas nye 'brel spangs/ /rgyal khams g.yengs pas bla ma rnyed/ /(6ba)bsam yas bskor nas 'phrang phur byin/ /bla ma rnyed nas gdams pa zhus/ /rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzings la/ /man ngag zur chos brgyan pa rnams/ /ngal dub spangs nas zhu ga khugs byas/ /zhes kyang gsungs la/ de yang myang dang chos dbang gi skye sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis bsam yas dbu rtse nas rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi zab gter dgra bcom zung gi lhung bzed kyi nang nas spyan drangs shing / gter kha de nyid las/ glo bo ma thang zhes bya'i phur rje rigs sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa: pha ma rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi bu: kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong nas bskrun: zhes lung zin 'di nyid kyi skye ba mi nyag byang pa sngags 'chang bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes/ se ston pa dang rigs 'dzin sku mched kyi gshed skor gyi bdag por gyur cing / der ma zad spyir yang / slob dpon chen po'i sprul par ni/ myong grol pad+ma rā ga dang lhan cig tu byon pa'i lung bstan las/ da lta'i mgo nag spyi yi rgyal po khyod: smon lam dag pa'i skye ba rnam lngas 'don: dam rdzas 'di dag 'phrad pa'i skyes bu de: skye ba du mar zab gter la spyad pas: sku yi gzi brjid mtshan rtags bcu gsum ldan: bden pa'i ngag 'grub sgra dbyangs tshangs pa'i gsung : thugs kyi byin rlabs dgongs pa'i gting dpag dka': bdag dang rgyal po'i yon tan sprul pa ste/ 'phrin las rnam pa lnga la rang dbang spyod ces dang / sngon byon gter kha phal cher gyi bka' babs/ brag lhang lhang ma'i gter kha las/ sngon du byung ba'i zab gter mtha' dag gi: bka' babs (7na〉2byung gi mi nub rgyal mtshan tshugs: zhes gsal bar byung ba yin no/ /gter ston nas rim pa bar ma chad du byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan dang go rim tsam ni gzhung so so'i skabs dang / bla brgyud gsol 'debs rnams kyi skabs su shes shing / rgyud man ngag gsan tshul sogs rgyas pa ni yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris la/ so so'i rnam thar chos 'byung du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gter chos rnams bka' ma ltar/ slob dpon gzhan gyis rang bzo'i bslad pa 'jug mi thub pas byin rlabs nus mthu'i —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'drod ma yal zhing / bka' srung gnyan pas gter ston nas bzung ste/ rjes 'jug slob bu mtha' dag kyang byung rgyal du spyod pa rang nyid phung bas/ zhib tu dpyod dgos par gsungs te/ zhal gdams le'u las/ gter chos 'di nyid shin tu gnyen pa ste: dper na dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu 'dra thabs la mkhas na nor bu lon pas 'tshengs: thabs ma mkhas na dug gis 'chi bar byed de bzhin yang na 'tshengs la yang na phud: phung 'tsheng nus pa rin chen sa yi gter: zhes dang / de bas nga yi gter chos shin tu gnyan: dug gis sto yong rma bya tsam las med: ces dang / thugs rje chen po pad+ma'i dbang phyug gi lung bstan las/ gter gyi chos 'di shin tu gnyan: rin cen sbyor ba'i bcud len ni rnyed par dka' zhing 'ju ba'ang dka' zhes sogs ltar yin la/ rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pas gnam skas can nas bzhes pa'i zhal gdams gsal sgron las/ phur pa yang dag bdud (7bcu gshin rje dang : ma mo la sogs bka' brgyud rim par spel: shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnams: spyir yang bod rnamasagasar dad che ba dang : snyigs ma'i 'gro ba lhag par snying rje bas: mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag: ces dang / sprul sku mnga' bdag myang gi chos 'byung nor bu'i phreng bar/ da lta rgyal khrims gnyan pas srog ser gtad mi dgos dus ngan byung tshe dgos pas gter du sbas: zhesapa ltar tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams pa dang 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa'i man ngag dpag tu med pa gter du sbas pa'i chas sna res kyang dngos grub thob pas gter la thos bsam bgyis pa las ldan du nges pas na khyad par du 'phags te/ rat+na'i dbang chen gsang 'dus them byang rin cen gter mdzod las/ khyad par nga yi gter chos sel med dang : 'phrad dang 'brel tshad sbyangs pa sngon song yin: de phyir las sad skyes bu ma gtogs pa rtog ge tha snyad mkhan dang chig phyir 'brang : bsag med phal pa'i 'gro ba mos mi 'gyur: zhes dang / gsal sgron las/ ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan: sgom chen la sogs phyogs ris degs pa can rang che 'byin cing gter la rtsod na yang : snyigasama'i chos byed phal zhig gter gyis 'dren: zab la kha tshar ma bsgrigs mtha' rgyas shing : gdams pa —258

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanasna res gang zag grol bar nges: de bas las zad skal ldan sbyangs pa can/ 'chi ba dran na gter chos nyams su long : tshe gcig thar lam thob bo rjes 'jug rnams: snyigs dus (8na)gter la mos pa'i skal ldan rnams deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam thebs thams cad las can yin no dga' ba sgoms zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ theg pa rim pa dgu las/ bla med kyi sku gsung thugasayon tan 'phrin las lnga las/ sku'i sgrub pa rdo rje thogs med ces bya ba/ de la yang bskyed pa ma hā yo gar gags la/ bskyed rdzogs gsum las tshul a nu dang mthun zhid / lta ba a ti ltar nyams su len pa yin/ dgos ched ni/ log par 'dren pa'i dgra bgegs bdud sde'i dpung rnams 'joms shing /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bsrung ba dang / lam sa'i bar chad sel ba/ bdud bzhi bsgral rten mthar thug gdod ma'i ye shes mngon du bya ba'i ched du'o/ /smras pa/ ngo mtshar gtam gyi skyed tshal rdzing bu sa /gsang chen chos kyi byung tshul pad dkar phreng / /tshig sbyor bsdebs pa'i 'dab stong ba 'ad pa na/ /dpyod ldan rkang drug glu dbyangs cis mi sgrog /gzhan dag mthong ma thag tu khyi ngan rnams/ /rmug pa'i thog mar ku co 'don pa ltar/ /tshad ldan brgal brtagasamed par gzhan gyi chos/ /snying nas lko smod byed pa'i blun po mang / khungs dang rgyu mtshan bral yang gzhan dag rnams/ /sun 'byin 'phya gtam phyogs lhung skye bo'i dbus/ /sgrogs pa'i glegs bam lhur len mkhas rlom dag /ngan 'gro'i sa bon bskrun las gyi nar sdod/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshul de ldan gyi rnam nges dngos bshad pa la gsum/ gang gis bsgrub pa'i (8ba tshe skrub pa po'i mtshan nyid/ gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas/ gang ltar bsgrub pa'i las kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/chos tshan nyer lnga'i slob bu'i 'dod pa brtag thabs las/ sdig la mi dad snying rje can mi rtag shesapa 'dzin pa med: tshig la mi gnyer don la gnyer: rgyud 'jam spyod pa dal ba rnams dam tshig can gyi snod ldan yin: zhes dang / dad pa che zhing gzungs thob blo brtan pa dam tshig gtsor 'dzin sgom sran —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)che ba dang : zhes pa ltar/ theg pa rim pa dgu las/ snying po'i theg pa rnams la lhag par mos shing mi ldog pa'i dad pa dang / rgyud man ngag thams cad la phyogs med du bslab pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal kha can/snying rje che zhing dam tshig la gces spras su byed pa sogs yon tan du mas phyug pa'i snod ldan/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyud man ngag gi tshig don gyi cha la sgro 'dogs chod cing rtogs pa khyad par can dang ldan pas rjes su bzung ste/ smin byed kyi dbang dang zhal gyi gdams pa sogs ding sang gi mkhas rlome rnams kyi lugs ltar thos lo tsam lhur len pa ma yin par gab sbas med par legs par thob pa/ bsnyen pa song zhing lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pa zhig gis bsgrub pa yin te/ zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ lta ba dbang bgrod dam ldan pas: sems kyi 'du 'dzi med pa ru: dpa' brtul sngags kyi dmod pa dbab/ /ces dang / man ngag las/ thog mar shes ldan smin pa yi: rigs ldan rnal 'byor brtul zhugs can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang se ston chen pos/ lta ba de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa ni (9na tā ba yin la/ min na'ang lta ba'i don spyi nges por byas pa ni shin tu gal che ste/ /drag po'i lam kun tu lta ba'i rtsis zin par byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bsnyen pa yang 'phrin las nyams su blang ba tsam la ni/ grangs bsnyen tsam song yang / cho ga la las sbyor nyams su blang ba yin na mtshan ma nges par thob dgos so/ /zhes rnam nges rin cen sgron mer gsungs pa ni shes rab dag snying la bcang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang / yo byad bshams pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gong du sems kyi 'du 'dzi med pa ru zhes pa'i don/ yul grong 'du 'dzi can dang / chags sdang dam sel yod pa/ mu stegs log lta'i gnas sogs sgo du ma nas sems gtser bar byed pa med pa'i sar bsgrub dgos pas/ rgyud las/ dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas dag tu zhes gsungs te/ de'ang spyir dam pa gong ma'i sgrub gnas su mchog thun gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ slob dpon chen por mnga' bdag gis zhus par/ las can don du ri brag lung ba rnams/o rgyan nyid kyis sgrub pa'i byin gyis brlabs/ /thugs rjes bzung bas bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /—26(/—

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)gnas rnams kun tu sgrub pa 'phel mod kyang / khyad par 'phags pa'i sgrub gnas gang la bgyi/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / de'ang sgrub gnas kun gyi rgyal po khyad 'phags ni/ mkha' 'gro ma bsgrubs rang bzhin 'du ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi gnas lnga/ 'di gsum gnas (9ba)su mchog thun gang bsgrub pa sgrub pa byas na mi 'grub gang yang med: ces pa'i dbang po rab kyi gnas gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i mdor na/ lung lnga gling gcig ljongs gsum gangs nyi shu:zhes sogs slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i sgrub gnas kyis mtshon te/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gnas khyad pa ra can du bogs che zhing / las dang po pas de rnams ma grub na'ang / nyams dga' ba shin tu 'jam pa'i sa phyogs su bsgrubs pas bar chad nyung ba'i dgos pa yod cing / gdengs cung zad rnyed dam/ drag po'i las la sbyar ba'i dus su dur khrod dang / ri'i dbyibs rtsub cing sa gru gsum gyi rnam pa/ dregs pa can rgyu ba'i drag po'i gnas su bsgrubs pas rtogs pa 'phel zhing las myur du 'grub pa yin te/ sgrub thabs pas/ gnas ni dur khrod du bya/ brag ri nag po mon pa khros pa 'dra ba'am/ lho phyogs su kha bltas pa shin tu gnyan sar phyin la/ zhes dang / phur bu yang gsang bla med kyis dpyad las/ dur khrod 'jigs pa shin tu gnyen pa'i sar/ der rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa bogs 'don pa'i gnas su legs zhes bshad cing / bye brag sgrub pa che phra rnams kyi gnas bzang ngan dang spang blang ni gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gnas khang phyag bdar byas la/ der stegs bu'i khar rak+tas chag chag gdab/ thod pa mtshan ldan du dpal bsgos nag po zur gsum pa me thab skyus bskor ba la sha khrag dang snying nas brgyan pa/ sman raka /gzhan yang dug gi me tog sngon po dang nag po/ tshil bu'i gsur/ zhun gyi mar (10nas/ khrag gis:/dri chu'i bsang chab/ thod rnga dang rkang gling la sogs pa ci rigs pa bsham/ thod pa zhig tu mon nam rabs chad sogs/ skyes pa'i gri snying / g.yag nag po'i snying dang gsum la dar nag gi dgab/ thun mong spyi'i mchod pa lnga'ang bsham mo/ /zor las byed na/ dug khrag dang g.yag mā—26/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nazor gtor/ skam thun la sogs pa'ang bsham par bya'o/ /zhes rnam nges rin cher sgron mer nub phyogs sing gha la'i dmar smug byu ru'i tshal gyi dgon par/ slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas bshad pa bzhin don bsdus te bkod pa tsam las gsal ba zhig mi 'dug la/ 'on kyang rigs 'dzan dbang po'i sdes rin chen sgron me'i dgongs don dang / bla ma dam pa'i zhal bzhes ltar dri ma med pa'i phyag len du mdzad par/ gtor ma la sgrub gtor dang mchod gtor gnyis su bsham zhing / /sgrub gtor la'ang rgyas bsdus gnyis snang ba skabs dang sbyar te gang bde bshams lag chen dang sbyar ba'i bam mthu chen sde bzhi'i gtor ma/ bdud rtsi chos sman bsres pa'i sman phud/ /dmar chen dang sbyar ba'i rak+ta/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'i bzo dbyibs/ so so'i mthun rdzas/ go rim/ gsham tshul gyi zhib cha mtha' dag mthong brgyud kyi phyag len 'phyugs med du gnang ba ltar bya zhid / bdag mdun gnyis spu'i zhib pa logs su shes so/ /gsum pa gang ltar bsgrub pa'i lam gyi rim pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga dang gsum gyis nyams su blang bar (10ba)bya ba'i dang po la gser skyems btang ba/ 'jam dpal zhi ba bskyed cing rgyud bklag pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa/ yan lag brgyad pa bya ba/ mtshams bcad pa/ bshags pa bya ba/ dam bca' ba/ byin dbab pa/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dza gad byin gyis brlabs la phud mchod tshul bzhin du byas shing / sde brgyad cha mnyam par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ā+oṃ wā gī shwa ri rlu zhes pa'i 'phro 'dus/ bdag nyid 'jam dbyangs su gsal ba'i mdun du bcom ldan shākya thub pa 'khor bcas gsal btab ste/ dngos sam yid kyis mchode pa phul/ yid mos pa brten pa dang bcas pas rgyud rgyas bsdus long skabs dang bstun nas brjod rjes/ sngon dus rgyal bas ri bo bya rkang du zhes sogs kyi smon lam bya ba yin la/'on kyang las byang 'dir cho ga zor yang phyir tshig tshogs nyung bas don mdor bstan pa yin zhing /dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs zhib pa ni/ dbang po'i sdes/ bdag gi mdun du rtsa ba sra brtan dpag —262

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)bsam shing / /yal ga lo ma me tog 'bras bu phun tshogs pa/ /de yi dkyil stod ston pa bcom ldan shākya thub/ /g.yas g.yon byang sems 'jam pa'i dpal dang spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyab tu nyan thosadang ni rang sangs rgyas kyi tshogs/ /gus pas lus btud mthu ldan phyag na rdo rje mdun/ /steng phyogs shing gi rtse mor de bzhin gshegs mang po/ /gzhan yang yal ga la ni lha yi bu bu mo/ /mang pos bskor zhing me tog la sogs mchod pa 'bul/ /gtso bos rgyud gsung ji ltar sems pas (11na skyo chen sgrog /dga' mgu'i tshul gyis 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang 'dud/ /steng 'og rkan gnyis rnga bo che las rgyud tshig rnams/ /lce yi dbyu gus bskul zhing chos sgras yongs gang gyur/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin ma yengs par bya'o/ /de yang spyir lcags 'drar 'jam dpal zhi ba sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dang / lcags sdig tu/ /stong dril nyi ma shar ba las/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i chos sde zhes pa byung zhing / khyad par stod dril gyi chos sder ni/ 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i sgrub pa/ btags grol/ tshe sgrub/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'pho ba sogs shin tu zab pa'i chos mang bas/ mtshan ma'i bag chags sgrib pa dag 'od lnga kha dog 'ja' 'od 'byung : zhes dang / ring bsrel 'ja' 'od rkang nas 'byung : ma smin sngon du 'gro ba'i chos:zhes tshe gcig byang chub bsgrub pa'i thabs mchog yin la/ skabs 'dir/ stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug nas gter ston gsar ban phyogs med kyis spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi rjes su 'brangs te 'phrin las kya sngon 'gror/ dbang po'i sdes bla ma gong ma'i man ngag la brten nas phyag bzhes su mdzad pa ni/ ljongs 'di'i tshe bdag mkhan po gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos so/ /de'ang zhi ba'i bskyed chog ma byas kyang rung mod/ byas na legs pa ni phyogs 'di la mkhas dbang gi bzhed srol lo/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag nyid kha lhor blta bas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi ngang tshul la shin tu 'jigs pas skyabs yul khyad par can rnams la skyabs su 'gro (11ba) ba'i bsam pa brtan pos/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus kun/ /zhes sogs brjod/bzhi pa ni/ rgya chen byang chub mchog tu sems mchog bskyed/ /ces pas gsal btab ste/ de'ang —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'khor 31 nag po'i sgrub thabs las/ gang zhig lta ba ngan pa yis/ /31ga par lta ba'i sems can la/ /drag po'i thugs rje brtan pa dang / /rang byung ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha was mdzad pa'i phyag rdor gsang sgrub las/ gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i/ /snying rje drag po sngon song nas/ /zhes pa ltar gdul bya gdug pa can gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can la snying rje bsgom zhing / sems can thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa'i ched du lam 'dir 'bad do snyam du smon sems dang 'jug sems bsgom par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ byang lugs kyi las byang chen mor/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa/ sogs brjod pa phyag len du yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang ngag tu brjod cing tshad med pa spyi dang 'dra bar bsgom mo/ /de skad du'ang khro 'dus las/ byang sems rnam gnyis bsgom pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dran pa ni/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i lam yin pas/ /sgrub pa pos ni nan tan bya/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /drug pa ni/ mdun du rin cen khri pad nyi zla'i steng / /zhes sogs/ slo ka gcig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyis bskor ba spyan (12na)drangs la/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /zhes sogs brjod cing / tshogs zhing rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba'i sems dang ldan pas phyag gi mchod pa/ thun mong spyi'i mchod pa/ nang dang gsang ba sogs kyi mchod pa dngos sam yid kyis sprul te 'bul/ dngos grub 'grub pa'i bgegs su gyur pa'i nyes pa rnams bshags/ rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rjes dag par mos pa dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang ba dang / sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed cing / bdag dang sems can thams cad dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la lus dbul ba sogs dge tshogs rgya chen po bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu byang chub chen por bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa yin la/ mthar tshogs zhing rang la gnyis med du thim pa'i ngang la cung zhig blta'o/ /—264

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzan 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanabadun pa la/ bdag gsal gdab pa/ bgegs bskrad pa/ srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhen nur gsal ba zhes sogs kyis skad cig gis zil gnon phyag rgya chen por bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las khro bo gnod mdzes stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gang bar spros te/ bgegs dang log 'dren rgyang ring du bskrad par bsams te/ bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas/ /zhes sogs dang hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/ /gsum pa la spyi'i srung 'khor dang /bye brag gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i srung 'bor gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdo rje'i gur dang / khro bo dang /sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha dang / kha dog sna lnga pa'i me dus mtha'i me (12ba〉rto bu'i gur khang gang gis kyang gzhig tu med pa sra zhing brtan par bsams te/ sra brtan mi g.yo rdo rje'i gur khang / zhes sogs dang / phaṭa raṃ sogs brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor lor sgyur ba ser po khro zhal can gyi thugs sgar hūṃ las srung 'khor ser po rtsibs bcu pa nyi gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du hūṃ bcu las khro bo bcu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba zhi ba'i nyams can phyag gnyis na 'khor lo bsnams shing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ thugs gar ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba'i rtsibs kyi bar du nad gdon/ dgra bgegs/ sdig sgrib/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin kyi sbyor ba sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad nyal nyal gcod par bsams pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ rab yangs bdag mdun zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhis/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ g.yas su zhi ba/ g.yon du khro bo/ dbus su bla ma rigs 'dzin bzhugasapa'i mtha' skor du dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang bcas pa'i dam tshig pa gsal btab la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te sprin gyi phung po ltar bzhugs par mos la/ nyes byas bshags pa'i bsam pa rtse gcig pas/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /sogs brjod/ dgu pa ni/ bdag —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)deng nas yi dam gyi lha dang byang chub kyi sems mi spong bar gces par 'dzin (13na〉byeng / bsnyen pa dang / sgrub pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i mthu yis/ gsang ba'i theg pa la rnam par 'tshe ba'i dgra bo rnams drag po mngon spyod kyi nus mthus bsgral ba sogs gsang sngags zab mo'i spyod pa thams cad mthar dbyung zhing / bla med bsgrub cing ma thob kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dpal chen zil gnon 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam bzhin du spyad par dam bcas te/ ji ltar khas blangs pa las mi 'da' ba'i bsam pas/ zil gnon thugs dam bzhin du spyad par bgyi/ /zhes sogs brjod/ bcu pa ni/ bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /sogs brjod la hūṃ gsum gyis bshags yul spyan drangs/ bde gshegs rigs 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs bcas thams cad bdag dang rdzas la gnyis su med par bstim/ chos rje sgrol ma ba'ang phyag len 'di nyid bzhed do/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ bdud rtsi/ rak+ta/ mchod gtor/ sgrub gtor/ phyi mchod brlab pa lnga las/ dang po ni/bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ zhes sogs las byang ltar byas nas/ bdud rtsi'i sngags nyer gcig sogs bzlas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis/ /zhes sogs las byang ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ a las bhan+dha yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud ā+oṃ āḥlha zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan drug gi lha mor bsams la/ ba sal ta'i sngags mdun gyi dang por gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo me long 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas sgra'i lha mo pi wang / gsum (13ba)pas dri ma spos khang /bzhi pas ro ma zhal zas/ lnga pas reg ma na bza'/ drug pas chos ma chos 'byung / sngags lan bdun bzlas pas de dag kyang mang por spel lo/ /zhes rnam nges rin can sgron mer gsungs la/ 'di ni de ga'i 'og tu de'ang bsnyen sgrub zhag sbrel du byed pa'i tshe snga ma ltar dang / 'phrin las nyin gcig byed pa'i tshe mchod gtor du brlab pa'am/ yang na bsnyen sgrub dang nyin gcig gang byed kyang sgrub gtor dang mchod gtor gnyis su bshams nas so sor brlab par byas na'ang mi 'gal bar mngon la/ zhes gsungs pas/ gong 'og gi don la zhib tu dpyad tshe/ 'dod yon drug gi lha mo rnams 'og nas 'byung —266

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanaba'i sgrub gtor gyi skabs su gsol 'debs dgos la/ 'dir mchod gtor gyi skabs su 'byung ba ni/sgrub gtor logs su med par mchod gtor rkyang pa bsham pa la dgongs la/ sgrub gtor dang mchod gtor so sor yod tshe/ mchod gtor snod ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ zegs ma la 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar byin gyis brlab pa ni gong 'og tshang ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhing legs pa yin no/ /rje sgrol ma pa'i phyag len du bcud med du byung ba'i gtor ma'i ri tsam du gyur zhes pa snang ngo / /myang ri khrod pa chen pos mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal thugs sgrub kyi sgom khog las/ sgrub gtor ni dngos grub blang ba dang / gter du sba bar bya/ mchod gtor la sbyin sreg dang lhag phud yar gnas (14na)mchod par bya/ zhes 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ gtor mar bdud rtsi blug la/ bdag gi thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ gtor ma la phog pas/ snod : las zhes sogs las byang ltar dang / ā+oṃ āḥlha gi rjes su ba kla ta'i sngags lan bdun bzlas so/ /lnga pa phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ a /pā la a pā dhu pu so gos kyi sngags brjod pas/ a lha ma dung chos a lhas gang ba dang / bdug pa ma spos/ me tog ma motog /mar me ma mar me/ dri chab ma dri'i phor pa 'dzin par brlab bo/ /rin cen sgron mer bdud rtsi'i sngags nyer gcig bzla bar bshad pa 'grub na shin tu legs pa yin la/ mchod gtor gyi sngags bdun bzla bar bshad pa ni/ 'dod yon drug gi lha mor gsal mi 'debs phyin mi dgos par sems so/ /smras pa/ 'di na 'phrin las sngon du 'gro ba'i skor/ /go rim gnad kyi rgyu mtshan ma 'dres par/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad bla ma'i zhal bcud ltar/ /'khrul med bsdebs pas blo gsal 'dod pa 'jo/ /gang zhig brtson pas sbyangs pa'i gzu bo'i tshig /cha tsam smra ba'i lce mgrin rgyas bcings kyang / /rig sngags 'chang ba'i khur gyis degs pa can/ /de 'dra snga 'gyur bstan la lhag par gnod/ /kye ma lam 'dir mos pa'i blo ldan pa'i/ /bzang po'i bag chags can dang 'ga' mchis na/ khengs pa spongs la tshul 'di lhur byos dang / /zil gnon phyag rgya'i lam der myur 'jug nges/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ phyag rgya chen po (14bañja la gyis gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa yin te/ de la phyag rgya'i ngo bo dang / bsgom pa'i thabs dang / las dang 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /zhes sogs kyi don te/ de'ang / slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i man ngag rtsa ba las/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems/ /sems 'di skye 'gag gnyis med par/ /thams cad kun gyi dngos gzhi gnas/ /sku gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs par gcig /rol pa chen po gsum du shar/ /ye shes rgyas pas bsgrub mi dgos/ /zhes 'byung bas/ 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi rig pa mi 'gyur ba byang chub kyi sems yin te/de'ang 'di zhes rang bzhin med pa ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa la skye med spros pa la rtsal ma 'gags par rang gsal du 'char bas 'gags med rol pa stong pa'i rang bzhin gsal ba gsal ba'i rang bzhin stong pa ste gsal stong gnyis su med pa de rgyal ba sku gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'ang / skye med spros bral chos sku/ 'gags med rol pa longs sku/ 'a/sa sna tsho gis byed pa sprul pa'i sku ste mdor na brtan g.yo thams cad dbyer med sku gsum gyi rol par gnas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sku gsum po de bde gshegs zhi khre'i rten brten pa mtha' yas pa las skabs kyis phye bas phye sta/ zil gnon gyi rten brten par lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de lta bu'i ngo bo de'ang glo bur du grub pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ ye gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pa' ngo bor gnas pa yin no/ /de skad du rgyud las/ ngo bo ma (15na sta lhos chos kyi sku/ /chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku dang mtshan mar btags pa kun/ /ye shes lhun gis grub pa'i sku/ /las dang sbyor ba sna tshogs kun/ /sgyu ma lhun grub sprul par 'dus/ /rol pa'i phyag rgyar snang ba'o/ /zhes dang / rtsa ba mi 'gyur byang chub sems/ /gcig ni kun gyi rang bzhin yin/ /ces yang bas dngos gzhi ma bcos pa de kho na nyid sku thams cad kyi ngo bo'am rang bzhin nam gzhir gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa bsgom pa'i thabs la/ rang nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor —268

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)bsgrub pa/ thun mong du mchod pa'i las rim/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa/ sngags kyi bzlas thabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po la stong nyid bsgom pa/ rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa/ brten pa lha'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar chos thams cad rang sems su shes dgos la/ de lta bu'i sems de skye med stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba/ cir yang mi 'gags pas kun khyab rang gsal bar 'char ba yin la/ gsal stong dbyer mi phyed pa de chos thams cad kyi rgyu'am dngos gzhi yin pas sems kyi gnas lugs 'bras bu sku gsum gyi ngo bo/ chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid du ro gcig pa de'i don rtogs na gang shar thams cad sku gsum gyi rol pa rang byung du 'char la sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas/ lha'i sku gsung thugs su ye nas gnas pa yin pas gak+ṣ-i na nas 61gas su bsgrub mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rten dang brten (15ba)pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du gsal 'debs pa yin pas/ rnam nges rin cen sgron me las/ rtsa bar/ e ni stong pa chor+sha/'byung ste/ /ma skyes 'gag pa med pa la/ /rang bzhin gnas(pa dran par bya/ /zhes pas/ phye mye mye/ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin spros bral stong pa nyid rig pa rang gsal gyi ngang du lhag gis gsal bar bya'o/ /de ni ting nge 'dzin gyi chos thams cad 'byung gnas su gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang 'di yin la/ de'ang las byang chen mo rnam nges dang bcas par/ ting nge 'dzin gsum zhes pa'i ming 'dogs dngos su mang ba dang / rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ting nge 'dzin gsum mam mngon byang lnga la sogs rgyu rkyen las rim gyis bskyed pa ni min te/zhes gsungs pa rnams la ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum mi dgos sam snyam pa'i log rtog skye srid pas/ting nge 'dzin gsum mi dgos pa ni ma yin te/ ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum gyi don/ chos thams cad rang sems las logs su med pa'i gang du'ang ma grub pas/ gsal stong gnyis su med pa de rgyal ba sku gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa/ skye med spros bral chos sku/ 'gags med rol pa longs sku/ las sna tshogs byed pa sprul sku ste sku gsum dang sbyor ba yin pas de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ kun du snang —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi dang po chos sku/ gnyis pa longs sku/ gsum pa sprul skur sbyor zhing / las byang chen mor/ skye phye phye zhes pa gsum po la (16na)ting nge 'dzin gsum tshang zhes pa byang lugs kyi zhal bzhes yin la/ lcags sdig las byang chen mo dang / chos rje sgrol ma ba'i las byang rnams su bskyed pa mahā yo ga ltar rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du bsgom pa'i thabs su ting nge 'dzin re la sh+lau ka sngags dang bcas pa re snang ngo / /'khon ston rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis/gsang sngags gsar ma ba rnams kyi sku gsum lam 'khyer du grags pa snga 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum du tshang zhes gsung ba snying la bcang bar bya'o/ /'o na ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum sogs rgyu rkyen las rim gyis gsal 'debs pa yin nam snyam na/ skabs 'dir de ni ma yin te/ rdzogs chen ltar ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum sku gsum dang sbyar ba'i gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i spros bral stong nyid rig pa rang gsal gyi ngang du gsal bar bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ 'byung bzhi ri rab/ gzhal yas khang dngos/ gdan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brtsegs steng sogs kyis/ rig pa rang gsal gi ngang las nam mkha' stong pa dngos med la rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags/ me 'od rab tu 'bar zhing / khrag gi rgya mtsho'i rba rlabasa'akhrugs pa/ mchog phran zhing gi sa gzhi yangs pa'i steng du keng rus kyi ri rab gsal 'debs pa yin la/ de'ang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ lcags sdig las byang chen mo/ rje sgrol ma pa'i las byang rnams su 'byung bzhi ri rab gsal 'debs kyi tshigs bcad sngags dang (16bstacas pa yod cing / de'ang lcags ga las byang du/ gser gyi sa gzhi zhes dang / rje sgrol ma ba'i der zhing gi sa gzhi zhes sogs cung zad 'dra min snang la/ las byang chen mo rnam nges dang bcas par tshig dngos su ma thon pa ni don gyis yong ba la dgongs pas/ 'dir las dang po pa la gsal ba'i phyir brjod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhal yas khang / bkod legs sogs te/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub —270

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanapa'i gzhal yas khang ye shes chen po'i gnas mtha' dang dbus med pa/ rgya ma chad pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ phyi dang nang med pa/ kun tu'ang nang du gyur pa/ ye shes chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ phyogs bzhin sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo rnams gar byed pa/ rtsig steng nas thod pa'i pha gu 'phyar can du gnas pa la thod pa'i phreng ba/sprul nag gi srad bus dkris pa'i dra ba dang dra phyed 'phyang ba/ rgyu ma'i lda ldi/ tsit+ta'i pho longs can/ ro ras las grub pa'i mda' yab/ ru chen gyi mchod rten sbrags pa'i pu shud/ mi mgo'i tog dang bcas pa/'obs wo bcu drug /dur khrod r+sā po brgyad kyi khor yug dang ldan pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i gur khang me rab tu 'bar ba/ de'ang dbus kyi pho brang gru gsum mthing nag la thod ra zlum pos bskor ba/ zla gam dmar po gsum dang ldan pa/ de'i phyi rol na thod pa'i mkhar bzhi/ de'i phyi rim na lcags mkhar brgyad/de'i phyi rim na lcags mkhar bcu gnyis/ mu khyud (17na)zlum pos bskor ba/ gru chad bzhi bar khyams dang bcas pa/ thod pa rin po che las grub pa/ nang zhing chen po brgyad kyi ka ba/ lha chen po brgyad kyi gdung ma/ klu chen po brgyad kyi lcam/ rgyu skar gyi dral ma/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga'i thog zhal byas pa zhing gi sgo 'geb/ ba dan gyi ka rgyan/ rus sbal gyi kha gdan/ nyi zla'i ka gzhu/ sbrul gyi skyes bu/ khyung gi ya phub/ chu srin gyi snga them la sogs pa dang / gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer btag la/ dbus kyi gtsang khang phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rab tu mtho ba'o/ /de skad du man ngag rtsa ba las/ a yi pho brang zla gam gsum/ /thod pa'i mkhar bzhi 'khor lo brgyad/ /lcags mkhar bcu gnyis bar khyams bzhi/ /sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad dang ldan/ /'obs chen bcu drug rdo rje'i gur/ /byas pa med par lhun gyis grub/ /bshig pa med par ngang gis stong / /zhes dang / a mu ka phung ba'i rgyud las/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag la/ /zla gam dmar po gsum dang ldan/ /thod mkhar chen po bzhi dang ni/ /phyi rim lcagasamakhar brgya gnyis dang / /'obs chen bcu drug dag gis bskor/ /phyi nang med par khyab cing gsal/ /gru chad ye shes snam bur ldan/ /sgo bzhi rta babs dag dang bcas/ /dra ba dra byed chun 'phyang dang / /lda ldi —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)tsit+ta pho long 'phyang / /thod pa rin po che las grub/ /rtse mo rab tu mtho ba'o/ /lha brgyad klu brgyad rgyu skar dang / /zhing dang bam chen rus sbal dang / /nyi zla khyung dang chu srin sbrul/ /sogs (17ba)pas rab tu brgyan pa'o/ /gnam lcags 'bar bas rab tu brgyan/ kha khyer lha tshogs mang pos mdzes/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /lcags mkhar brgyad rgyud 'dir mi gsal yang / man ngag rtsa bar/ 'khor lo brgyad/ ces gsal bar byung la/ de'ang 'khor lo brgyad ces pa bri bya'i dbang du byas pa'i gdan gyi rtsibs yin gyi/sgom don la bslang ba'i tshe 'di'ang lcags mkhar du legs so/ /dur khrod brgyad man ngag rtsa bar dngos su mi snang yang / zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dur khrod chen po brgyad ldan bsam/ /zhes 'byung bas/de'ang skabs don gzhal yas khang thod pa bam ro la sogs pa dur khrod rgyu las grub par dgongs pa yin par sems te/ lcags sdig las byang du/ e las: chad dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /zhes 'byung ba lta bus mtsho ni te shes la/ der ma za dur khrod chen po brgyad/ bkod pa zla gsang gi lung 'dis bsgrub nus shing / bla ma rnams phyag len du'ang mdzad pas legs so/ /de lta bu'i gzhaX yas khang dbang chen yab yum lnga la sogs pa rgyu rkyen las bskyed pa ma yin te/ gzhal yab sna khang ye nas lhun grub tu gnas pa gsal 'debs pa yin no/ /de skad du'ang rgyud las/rang bzhin mi gnas mnyam nyid las/ /lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas khang / /phyi dang nang med kun tu nang / /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ klu gnyan sa bdag ces sogs kyis/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ klu mthong ba'i dug can sbrul 'bum/ /gnyan rwa'i dug can sdig pa khri/ sa bdag (18na)mche pa'i dug can sbal pa stong / dug gsum rang gnas kyi khri sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i steng du phyogs skyong bcu mgo phyogs phyogs su bstan te rkang pa dbus su bsnol ba'i khar/ /ru dra pho mo byi bcings su bsnol pa/ ma he glang rgod brgyad kyis brdzis pa'i steng du pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan ni gtso bo'i gdan no/ /ji skad du'ang /man ngag rtsa ba las/ klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / /phyogs skyong ru dra ma he brgyad/ /nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de'ang rlung gi zas can —272

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzan 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanasprul/ ngur 'chi sdig pa/ 'phar 'gro sbal pa/ 'jigs pa bcu pa ma he'i ming du sngon gyi brdar grags pa ltar las byang du bkod pa'o/ /'khor gyi lha'i gnas su/ nyi ma'i steng du bam rlon pa mgo g.yas su bstan pa re bsgom par bya ste/ dgongs rgyud las/ gzhan na zhing rkang nyi mar bcas/ /zhes khrung la/yang na ched du bsgom mi dgos te/ gdan dang chas yin pas so/ /zhes kyang gsung ngo / /gsum pa brten pa lha'i 'khor lo bsgom pa la'ang / dkyil 'khor skad cig gis bsgom tshul bstan pa/ gtso bo bstan pa/ 'khor bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu rkyen dang bral rang nyid skad cig gis/ /zhes pas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor / ting 'dzin gsum mam mngon byang lnga la sogs pa rgyu rkyen las rim gyis bskyed pa ni ma yin te/ chu las nya ldang ba lta bu'i tshul du skad cig gis gsal 'debs pa yin pas/ rgyud las/ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje chen po bzhengs/ rgyu rkyen (18ba)gnyis med rang bzhin chos kyi sku/ /zhes 'gyung la/ de'ang slob dpon bha su dha ras/ spyir lcags 'dra/ thog 'dra/gnam thog chen po dang gsum las/ 'dir gnam thog chen po'i lam srol/ gzhal yas khang lhun grub/ lha kog bzhengs sngags thug phrad du bzhed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gtso bo la'ang / rtsa ba'i lha drug bsgom pa/ rgyan gyi lha brgyad bsgom pa/ go cha'i lha bkod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khro rgyal kun kyang skrag byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /ces sogs kyis/ rang gi rig pa skad cig gis drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rgyal ba kun gyi spyi'i gzugs can chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed srid gsum zil gyis gnon cing / dregs pa can thams cad dbang du sdud pa'i bdag nyid can/ shin tu khros shing rngam pa/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/zha kha g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas dang po 'khor lo/ bar pa ral gri/ tha ma rdo rje/ g.yon gyi dang po be con/ bar pa gtun shing / tha ma sdigs mdzub can/ zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dor stabs su bgrad pa/ nam mkha'i lam thams cad khyab pa'i rdo rje'i gshog pa gdeng ba/ zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags slog pa/ spyan dgu me'i phung —273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2napo ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra sma ra ba spu thams cad rdo rje'i me 'bar ba/ bdud/ srin po/ btsan/ rgyal po/mu stegs kyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu re re bzhin brgyan pa la rigs lnga'i khro bo bzhugs pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyi mgo bo dang / thod rlon gyi phreng ba lnga bcu tshar gsum gyi do shal ༅ rin po che'i rgyan dang /klu rgyal rigs kyis snyan cha/ rje rigs kyis mgur chu/ bram ze'i rigs kyis phyag gdub/ dmangs rigs dang gdol pa'i rigs kyis zhabs gdub dang ska rags la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams byas shing /gdan du'ang bting la/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang / glang chen gyi ko rlon/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ thugs gar zhag gi sor ris/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/mkhur tshos la rak+ta'i thig les byugs pa/ 'bar ba'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs par gsal 'debs so/ /de'ang snying 'dzings las/ sbrul dang rin cen 'bar ba dang / /dregs pa'i mgo can phreng bas brgyan/ /klu rigs du mas sku la spras/ /zhes pa las g.yin pa'i rgyan cha gsal ba ma byung zhing / sgrub thabs dang rje sgrol ma ba'i las byang rnams su'ang / dur khrod kyi mas brgyad dang dpal gyi mas rnams tshig zin la dngos su med pa sogs kyis/ ljongs 'di'i tshe bdag mkhan po'i khur gyisang la ba mang po zhig sgom don 'phyugs par mngon te/ bri bya la'ang zil gnon gyi sku gshog pa sogs rgyan ma tshang ba mang du bris snang ngo / /de'ang dgongasargyud las/ glang chen la sogs dur khrod chas/ /zhes dang / tshul dgu mas dgu rgyan dgu dang / /zhes dang / lcags sdig las byang du/ dur khrod chas brgyad rdo rje'i (19ba)gshog pa gdengs/ /zhes pa rnams kyis/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang / rdo rje'i gshog pa sogs dpal gyi mas brgyad dam dgu'ang bshad cing / de dag gi don man ngag rtsa bar/ dpal gyi chas dang dur khrod chas/ /zhes yang ba ltar/bla ma rnams phyag len du mdzad pas 'dir yang / dpal gyi chas brgyad dur khrod rgyan rnams kun/ /zhes bkod pa yin no/ /gtso bo'i g.yon du yum rdo rje khros ma sngo nag rab tu khros shing ral pa mun ltar gtibs pa'i zar bu la mu tig sogs rin po che sna tsho gis pas spras pa/ phyag g.yas tsit+ta thogs pas —274

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing / g.yon — rak+tas gang ba gtso bo la stob pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs rgyan dang ldan pa'o/ /de'ang yum gyi sku mdog ras bris khungs ma 'ga' zhig na sngo nag tu snang ba/ gtso po'i sku mdog dang tshon mdog mi 'dres pa dang / don gyi cha la 'gal ba med pa'i dbang gis mdzad 'dug la/sgom don du'ang rigs 'ga' zhig la gtso bo sku mdog mthing nag la/ sku la 'khril ba'i yum sngo nag lta bur byas pa dmigs pa gsal ba'ang yod pas las byang du bkod pa yin la/ gzhan ma man ngag rtsa ba dang / chos rje sgrol ma ba'i las byang gnyis dar/ mthing nag ces bshad 'dug pa ltar/ sgom don du mthing nag byas kyang legs par mngon no/ /gtso bo'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ gsod byed sras mchog ya ma rā tsa sku mdog smug nag rab tu 'jigs shing rngam pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa dang / g.yon dgra bgegs kyi don snying (20na smo'u na pa/ zhabs bam gyi gdan la bgrad pa/ de'i thugs skar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo dregs pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / g.yon snying phreng 'dzin pa/ zhabs dor stabs su bgrad pas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs mnan pa'o/ /de'ang las byang du/ gsum pa'ang / rin cen sprul dang dur khrod mas kyis brgyan/ /zhes pa'i don/ yum sras mchog /dregs pa gsum dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i don te/ phyi ma gnyis sprul dang rin po che dur khrod kyi mas kyis brgyan pa rnam nges las dngos su gsal zhing / yum la dur khrod kyi chas zhes dngos su gsal ba ma byung yang / khro mo'i cha lugs zhes pas don gyis thon zhing / rje sgrol ma ba'i las byang du/ mthing nag dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /zhes gsal bar byung ngo / /de'i thugs gar pad+ma'i gdan la bya ba nan tan ye shes kyi ngo bo rus sbal khros pa shin tu rngam pa 'jigs byed chen po kha thur du bltas pa/ lto ba na srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog 'chang ba'o ya ma rā tsa la nyi gdan/ phyag na rdo rje la zla gdan/ rus sbal la pad+ma'i gdan bya bar 'khor nag las bshad do/ /gtso bo'i spyi bor so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo khyung dkar po 'dab gshog ral gri gnam 275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'alcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder can rwa bgrad pa/ spyi bo'i gtsug na nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa/ gdug pa can thams cad 'dul zhing sprul za ba'o/ /de dag ni rtsa ba'i lha drug ste/ man ngag rtsa bar/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /(20ba 〉 ngas rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs can/ /mthing nag zil gnon dregs pa 'dul/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yas/ /be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub 'bar/ /rigs lnga'i khro bos dbu la brgyan/ /dpal gyi chas brgyad dur khrod brgyan/ /yum ni dmigs med chos kyi dbyings/ /mthing nag tsit+ta bhan dmar thogs/ /ye shes bzhi yi sprul pa ni/ /thugs mar ya ma rā tsa ste/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /smug nag 'khor lo tsit+ta 'dzin/ /ya ma'i thugs gar dregs pa'i bdag /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /ljang nag rdo rje'i snying phreng 'dzin/ /dregs pa'i thugs kar khyams khang ste/ /bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid/ /'jigs byed chen po thur du blta/ /lto ba srid gsum tshe srog 'chang / /spyi gtsug mkha' lding gdug pa 'dul/ /so sor rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkar po zil gnon ro nye za/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ga lhas pa sprul pa gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad ni/phrag gong smug nag khyung gnyis bskye|ga pa brdeg /ces sogs kyis/ gtso bo'i phrag gong gnyis su khyung smug nag 'dab gshog brdeb cing sprul za ba gnyis/ nu kha gnyis su seng ge 'gying zhing rab sprug pa gnyis/ sogs kha gnyis su stag mo ro za zhing sha khrag glo snying nang khrol la rngam pa gnyis/ sta zur gnyis su dug sprul nag po lce gnyis bskyod cing gdug pa'i kha rlangs 'byin pa gnyis so/ /de dag ni rgyan gyi lha brgyad de/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ phrag gong smug nag 'jigs pa'i khyung / /sog khar stag mo ro la rngam /(21na'i khar seng ge ral pa sprug /sta zur sprul nag kha rlangs 'byin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang rtsa bar stag sngon du byung zhing / sgrub thabs dang rje sgrol ma ba'i las byang du seng ge sngon la byung ba ni gang bde byas pas 'gal ba med do/ /de'ang / snying po don gyi gsang rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyi gzugs can/ /ma skyes ngang las rang bzhin 'char/ /phyag rgya kun gyi zil gnon yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa go cha ni/ lhun po ltar brjod gtsug tu hūṃ mdzad dang / /zhes sogs —276

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanakyis/ gtso bo'i sku ri rab lta bur brjid pa'i spyi gtsug tu hūṃ mdzad/ mgrin par rta mgrin/ ltag par rnam rgyal/ dpung ba g.yas su gshin rje gshed/ g.yon du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ brla g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ lte bar mi g.yo ba/ dbyi mtshams su khams gsum rnam rgyal/gsang gnas su stobs po che'o/ /de skad du man ngag rtsa ba las/ ri rab lta bur brjid pa yi/ /lus la khro bcu rdzogs par bsgom/ /steng dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo ni/ /spyi gtsug mgrin pa lhag pa dang / /dpung pa g.yas dang g.yon la bsgom/ mtshams bzhi 'og gi khro ba ni/ /brla g.yas g.yon dang lte ba dang / /dbyi mtshams gsang ba'i gnas su bsgom/ /zhes so/ /de'ang steng dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo lnga ni/sku mdog mthing nag zhal nang du gzigs nas srung ba'i las mdzad pa/ mtshams bzhi 'og gi khro bo lnga sku mdog ljang nag zhal phyir gzigs nas pha rol gyi byas pa (21ba tshes shig pa'i las mdzad cing / bcu ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa yin te/chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes/ hūṃ mdzad rta mgrin rnam rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil rnams mthing nag zhal nang gzigs/ /'khor lo sdigs pa'i mdzub can srung ba'i phyir/ /dbyug sngon gzhan gyis mi thub mi g.yo mgon/ khams gsum rnam rgyal stobs chen rnams ljang nag /'khor lo sdigs mdzub phyir gzigs byas pa bshig /ces pa ltar ro/ khro bo bcu po 'di dag gi 'god tshul dang / sku mdog phyag mtshan/ snying 'dzings kyi sgrub thabs lag tu blang ba'i sgron me khrag 'thung zhal gyi gdams pa las/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rdzas bzlog nag po ngar gcod kyi las bya na/ spyi bo'am smin mtshams su hūṃ mdzad/ mgrin par rnam rgyal/ dpung pa g.yas su gshin rje'i gshed/ ltag mdud du rta mchog /dpung pa g.yon du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub can/ zhal nang du gzigs pa srung ba'i tshul can/ lte bar 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ dbyi mtshams su mi g.yo ba/tshang steng du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ dbyi g.yon du khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gsang bar rdo rje gnod mdzes sku mdog ljang nag te zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'khor lo dang sdigs mdzub zhags pa can —277—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zhal phyir gzigs pa pha rol gyi byas pa bshig pa'i tshul can no/ /snying gi dkyil du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po zhi ba'i rgyan chas can/ phyag na 'khor lo dang pad+ma (22na)bsnams pa bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje 'jig bral mang bar byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ bdag nyid phyag rgya chen po'i sku/ /ri rab tsam du rab bsgoms la/ /gnyen po yan lag rdzogs par bsgom/ /spyi gtsug mgrin pa snying ga dang / lte ba dang ni gsang ba lngar/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro/ /bu ga dgu ru me 'tshub ni/ /dmar nag 'khyil dang 'tshub par bsgom/ /thugs kar ya ma rā dza ste/ /phyag g.yas dbyug pa sngon po la/ /g.yon pa ṭak+ki rā dza ste/ /gsang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil la bsgom/ /zhabs g.yas 'khor lo stobs po che/ /g.yon pa mi g.yo mgon po'o/ /smin mar hūṃ mdzad ltag par dbang / /gsang bar las mchog rgyal po bsgom/ /zhes 'byung ba dang yang don mthun/ yang gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba drag sngags ur mo las byung ba ltar 'brel te/ de'ang man ngag gi 'grel par/rang nyid mi 'jigs pa'i go bgos pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus la khro bcu rdzogs par bsgom nyid /zhes dang / drag pos ring gi rtsa ba las/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i khro bo bcu'i las sngags drag po bsdebasal ur me ngar gcod kyi dgongs pas rang srog btsan po'i mkhar dugazhug pa dang / zhes sogs 'byung /de'ang hūṃ mdzad dgra sta/ rnam rgyal 'khor lo/ dbyug sngon dbyug pa/ gzhin rje be cen/ mi g.yo ral gri/rta mgrin pad+ma/ 'dod rgyal lcags kyu/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba rgya gram/ khams gsum rnam rgyal tri shu la stobs po che gtun shing ngam rdo rje (22bsnyu gcig pa/ g.yon thams cad sdigs mdzub bo/ /drag sngags las/ lcags kyu dbyug pa be con dang / /rtse gsum pad+ma rdo rje dang / /ral gri dbyug pa dgra sta dang / /rdo rje rtse gcig bsnams pa ste/ /g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /ces 'byung ngo / /sku mdog ni/ kha dog rigs dang mthun pa'am/ /yang na thams cad sngo nag gi /zhes 'byung ngo / /de nas/ mgur nas long bu'i bar du mtshon gang gi /zhes sogs kyis/ sku'i mgur nas long bu'i bar du nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i khro chur me rlung las kyi 'khor lo bskor bas gtams pa/ ba spu'i bu ga —278

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khananas rdo rje'i me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ bu ga dgu nas rdo rje'i thog dang me'i 'tshi ma sogs bzod par dka' ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ ya mtha' rgyal ba zhi khro ma gshin phur pa nas/ ma mtha' sa bdag 'gong po pe gar dam sri klu dang klu bdud mdze 'dre la sogs pa'i skye 'gro dregs pa can thams cad zil gyis gnon cing stobs rnams 'phrog pa'o/ /de'ang man ngag rtsa ba las/ mgur nas zhabs kyi bar dag la/ khro chung mtshon cha thogs pas gtams/ /ba spu rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /bu ga dgu nas rdo rje yi/ /thog dang me yi 'tshub ma 'phro/ /sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag med 'gyed/ /zhi khro ma gshin phur pa dang / /sa bdag 'gong po pe gar dang / /dam sri skye 'gro thams cad dang / /klu dang klu bdud mdze yi nad/ /zil gyis gnon cing stobs rnams 'phrog /ces so/ khro chung gi phyag mtshan gnubs (23na)kyi las rim gsal sgron las/ mgur nas zhabs kyi long bu'i bar/ /ye shes khro chung mtshon re ba/ /raṃ yaṃ ga me tsakra 'phro/ /su rla'i gdan la phyi nas bsrung / /zhes dang / rje sgrol ma bas/ tshig de bod skad du bsgyur nas/ me rlung las kyi 'khor lo 'phro/ /nyi ma'i gdan la phyi nas bsrung / /zhes pa ltar las byang 'dir yang bkod pa yin la/ rtsa bar mtshon cha sna tshogs su bshad pa sgom don la gang bde dang / gnyis ka byas kyang khro chung mtha' yas pa skyed pa mi 'gal bar sems so zla gsang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ mgur gyi bum pa man chad nas/ /zhabs kyi long bu yan chad du/ khro chung sems dpa' mtshon gang ba/ /mdog nag mtshon cha sna tsho gos bsnams/ /nyi ma'i 'od stong ldan par bsgom/ /zhes so/ /de'ang rnam nges rin cen sgron mer/ gang zhig mngon par rtogs pa bsgom zhing 'phrin las byed pa'i tshe/ mngon par rtogs pa'i tshig gi phreng ba bzung ste/ de ma byung gi bar du tshig risayid la byed cing 'don la/ rtsol med du byang por song ba'i tshe/ /yid rgya yan du btang nas tshig byang yud tsam gyis rdzogs par byed cing / cung zad sems bzung nas tshig bshar bas brjed pa lta bur song nas thogs par snang bas na byang cha de 'byung zhes smra ba'i mngon rtogs bsgom par rlom pa la ni snying po ci'ang med do/ /des na dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i gnas lugs blo yul du 'dris—279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)par byas nas nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ blo che na cig car du lam gyis gsal (23ba tha'am/ blo chung dang po bas rim gyis mtshan ma phra mo yan chod gsal 'debs shing / gsal 'debs kyi rkyen du brjod pa'i tshig bshad las byang ltar bya ba ni rang cag gi phyag len yin la/ 'on kyang mngon rtogs kyi tshig bshad zhib por brjod pa nyid ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i rkyen du nges par 'gro bar snang na/ mngon rtogs kyi tshig sgom khog ltar ngag tu brjod pa la'ang nyes pa med par sems so/ /zhes gsung ba ni ding dus kyi gsang sngags gsar rnying gi mngon rtogs bsgom zhing 'phrin las byed pa phal cher gyi rang mtshang du gang 'bab shes ldan dag snying la 'chongs shig /gnyis pa 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa bstan pa la/ sprul pa gsum bskyed pa/ gshed bzhi bskyed pa/mon bdud bskyed pa/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis bskyed pa/ bar khyams kyi sprul pa bskyed pa/ sgo ba bzhi bskyed pa/ phyi rol 'khru ldog gi 'obs srung bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bo'i g.yas zur sku sprul 'chi bdag ni/ /zhes sogs kyis/ dbus kyi a'i pho brang mthing nag rtse mo lhor bstan nang du gdan steng du gtso bo bzhugs pa'i gru gsum thong ra zlum pos bskor ba'i zla gam gsum gyi lho nub gtso bo'i g.yas zur du sku sprul 'chi bdag bye ba dgu ring dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ dbus dang sku mdog sngo nag /phyag g.yas pa gsum na thod dbyug /ral gri/ dgra sta 'dzin cing /g.yon gsum na thod pa mdung dang lcags kyi ri rab bam me dpung 'dzin pa/ lcags kyi khrab gsol zhing /dur khrod (24na)kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ ma he sngo nag gi steng du 'gying ba/ yum chen srin mo gsod byed ma tri shul dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar a mu dang zla gsang las bshad cing bskul dang mthun pas bde/ phyag rgya gsal sgron du/ g.yas gsum ral gri zhing dbyug lcags kyi ri rab/ g.yon gsum be con lcags kyu rdo rje'i rgya gram 'dzin cing / chu glang nag po la gzhen par bshad do/ /dgongs rgyud las/ rang nyid zil gnon sku ru gsal/ /bye ba dgu khri mdun du bskyed/ /zhing bsnol ru dra'i gdan steng na/ /chu glang sngon po sprul ris can/ thod pa nus pos brgyan pa la/ /nyi zla dang —280

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)bcas gdan la gnas/ /sku mdog sngo nag khro zhing gtum/ /sku stod glang chen stag sham zhing / /sbrul dang thod pa rin po che/ /dbu dang lhu tshigs phyag zhabs brgyan/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /g.yas pa gsum na ral gri dang / /be con lcags kyi ri rab bsnams/ /g.yon pa gsum na lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa rdo rje rgya gram bsnams/ /zhes so/ /zla gam gsum gyi shar lho/ gtso bo'i g.yon zur du gsung sprul srog bdag sku mdog dmar po zhal gzhig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na be con dang rgyu yigs/ g.yon gnyis na lcag ba'i kyu dang bse mdung 'dzin pa/ rus sbal gyi g.yang gzhi gsol zhing / dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/bse'i gyi ling la bcibs pa/ yum srin mo ro langs ma spu gri dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ /(24ba)phyag rgya gsal sgron du/ srog bdag sku mdog dmar po thod pa'i rna cha can be con dang rgyu zhags 'dzin par bshad do/ /de'ang snga ma ni/ a mu dang zla gsang gnyis ka las byung zhing / rje sgrol ma ba dang chos rgyal dbang po'i sde gnyas ka phyag len du mdzad pa'o/ /rin cen sgron mer/ yang na bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i dus su srog bdag phyag rgya gsal sgron ltar dang / 'og nas byung ba'i tshe bdag dang / gshed bzhi'i bzhen pa'ang gdan du bya la/ las la bskul ba'i dus su bzhen pa can du byas na'ang mi legs pa med do/ /zla gam gsum gyi byang phyogs gtso bo'i sku'i rgyab phyogs su thugs kyi sprul pa tshe bdag sku mdog mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad/ zhabs bzhi bgrad pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal gsum dbus ma he/g.yas stag g.yon seng ge'i mgo bo ste gsum ga'ang khro zhing rngam pa/ bar pa'i zhal gsum dbus mthing nag /g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ gsum ga khro bo'i zhal la g.yas cung zad bzhad pa'i nyams dang / g.yon chags pa'i nyams can/ steng gi zhal gsum dbus khyung / g.yas rma bya/ g.yon dur bya'i mgo bo can no/ /phyag g.yas dgu na rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje/ zhing dbyug /dar mdung / 'khor lo/ ral gri /dgra sta/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gri gug /rdo rje'i tho ba 'dzin cing / g.yon dgu na rim pa bzhin/ban+ta/ 'ug pa/ be con/ gtun shing / sdigs mdzub/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ mi snying / zhing chung gi rgyal —281

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mtshan 'dzin pa/ zhing lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang / stag lpags(25na skyo tshe pas smad dkris pa/ thod sprul sogs dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o/ /bdud mo gsod byed ma tsit+ta dang 0 khrag gi gang ba thogs pa mi lpags gyon pas stid pa'o/ /phyag mtshan de ltar zla gsang dang / a mur bshad pa rje sgrol ma ba'ang phyag len du mdzad/ yum gsum yang zla gsang dang a mur bshad do/ /dgongs rgyud las/ phyag dgu g.yas na phyag mtshan bsgreng ba ni/ /'khor lo ral gri rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung / /mda' chen zhing chung dbyug pa rgya gram bsnams/ /g.yon dgu be con gtun shing rgyu zhags sbrul/ /sdigs mdzub tri shu dgra sta gzhu dang tsit+ta 'dzin 'byung ste mchod bstod gsal sgron dang mthun no/ /de dag ni sprul pa gsum ste/ man ngag rtsa bar/ zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum/ /sku sprul 'chi bdag bye ba dang / /gsung sprul srog bdag dmar po dang / /thugs sprul tshe bdag mgo dgu pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gshed bzhi ni/ thod pa'i mkhar bzhir dred mo lag rdeb dang / /zhes sogs kyis/shar gyi thod mkhar gyi nang du gshin rje ya ma rā dza smug nag sprul dang thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ dred mo lag rdeb la zhon pa/ lhor srin mo myos byed 'bar ba ser nag sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/gtum po dom nag la zhen pa nub tu klu bdud a rla dmar po dmar nag sbrul dang thod pas brgyan pa/drel rta la zhen pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag sprul dang thod pas brgyan pa/ drel rta la zhen pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag sbrul dang thod pas brgyan pa/ rnga mo gdong ser la zhen pa/ bzhi ga'ang g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon (25ba tha con 'dzin cing / yum yang snying 'dzingasadang man ngag rtsa 'grel rnams su mi gsal yang / stobs chen ltar/ srin mo nag mo/ e ka dzā smi/bdud mo nag mo/ gnod sbyin nag mo rnams rim pa bzhin yab la 'khyud cing thod khrag stob pa'o/ /rje sgrol ma ba'ang phyag len du 'di mdzad/ yang mthun mi sgron ma rtsis kyi yi ge las/ gshed bzhi'i bzhen pa ya ma rā dza snga ma dang 'dra ba/ myos byed 'bar ba dom snying dkar lan pa/ a rla dmar po wa mo stod ser la zhen pa/ ral pa tshar dgu drel rta la zhen pa/ zhes bshad de/ gshed bzhi'i phyag mtshan/ ya ma —282

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)rā dza ral gri dang zhags pa/ myos byed 'bar ba ral gri dang dgra sta/ a rla dmar po lcags kyu dang zhagasapa/ ral pa tshar dgu dbyug to dang zhags pa 'dzin par dbang po'i sde'i zur 'debs su yod pas/ lasabyang 'dir 'byer bde bas phyir snga ma ltar bkod kyang don la khyad par med do/ /de dag ni gshed bzhi ste/mnang ga rtsab las/ phyi rol thod pa'i mkhar bzhi na/ /gshed po ya ma rā dza dang / khrin po myos byed 'bar ba dang / /klu bdud a rla dmar po dang / /gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa mon bdud ni/ lcags mkhar phyogs bzhir dung lcags bse gser gyi/ /zhes sogs kyis/ lcags mkhar brgyad kyi shar du dung gi mon pa/ seng ge'i mgo can mon mo bla rkun rngam pa'i gdong can gyis 'byud pa/ lhor lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo can mon mo g.yu'i ral pa can gyis 'byud pa/ nub tu bse'i mon pa dred kyi mgo can/ mon mo tshe srog 'phrog pa/ (26na log gi ral pa can gyis 'byud pa/ byang du gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo can/ mon mo bla rkun snying la gzer 'debs mas lkod pa/ yab bzhi phyag g.yas ri rab dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin cing / yum bzhi g.yas tsit+ta dang g.yon thod khrag go /lugs gcig la yab bzhi 'khor lo dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'ang yod do/ /las byang 'dir/ rang 'dra'i yab la 'byud/ ces pa/ shin tu rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i cha nas rang 'dra zhesabashad pa yin la/ yum gi zhal khro mo'i zhes can las/ yab ltar sems can gzhan gyi mgo brnyan ni ma yin no/ shar lhor he li khyab pa sngo nag g.yas 'bor lo 'dzin cing / yum bdud mo mi zan snying rkun mas 'byud pa/ lho nub tu nag po mdzum med ser nag g.yas ral gri 'dzin cing / yum bdud mo me thogs snying 'byin mas 'khyud pa/ nub byang du so 'dar 'khrig pa dmar nag g.yas tshe srog sdud pa'i bar du 'dzin cing / yum bdud mo khrag skyug snying la gzer 'debs mas da pa/ byang shar du ral pa spyir bcings ljang nag g.yas khram shing 'dzin cing / yum nag mo myos byed dbugs sdud mas 'khyud pa/ yab rnams kyis g.yon khram shing dang / yum rnams g.yas tsit+ta dang g.yon thod khrag go/mon bdud brgyad yum dang bcas pa shin tu rngam zhing me lce glog dang skar mdas brgyan pa'o/ /rje sgrol ma ba'i las—283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)byang du/ ral pa spyir bcings g.yas zhags pa 'dzin par bshad/ rin can sgron me dang / rje sgrol ma ba'i las byang gnyis kur nag (26ba)po 'dzum med dang so 'dar 'khrig pa gong 'og brjes 'dug pa yig rgyun nor ram gang yin brtag go /las byang 'dir ni dbang po'i sde'i zur 'debs ltar bkod pa yin te/ de nyid las/ he le khyab pa sngo nag 'khor lo can/ /bdud mo mi zan snying rkun ma yis stid/ /ga po 'dzum med ser nag ral gri 'dzin/ /bdud mo me thogs snying 'byin ma yis 'khyud/ /so 'dar 'khrig pa dmar nag par bu can/ /bdud mo khrag skyug snying gzer 'debs mas 'khyud/ /ral pa spyir bcings ljang nag khram shing can/ /nag mo myos byed dbugs sdud ma yis 'khyud/ /bdud po bzhi yi g.yon kun khram shing bsnams/ /yum bzhi tsit+ta thod khrag 'dzin 'khrud stab/ /mon bdud yab yum kun kyang shin tu rngam/ /me lte glog dang skar mdas brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de dag ni mon bdud brgyad de/ man ngag rtsa bar/ de'i phyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /phyogs bzhi la ni mon pa bzhi/ /mtshams bzhi la ni bdud bzhi ste/ /de dag yum dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa 'chi bdag bcu gnyi che/ni/ phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis shar phyogs su/ /zhes sogasakyis/ lcags mkhar bcu gnyis kyi shar stod du bhe wa satwa mthing nag be cen 'dzin pa/ shar smad du nor bu dge 'phel ser nag 'khor lo bskor ba/ shar lhor ser nag 'joms byed lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho stod du bye ba dgu khri ljang nag dbyug to bsnams pa/ lho smad du ya sgo glog phreng dmar nag rgyu zhags 'phen pa/ lho nub tu ya ka za byed sngo nag spu gri thogs pa/ (27na〉kyib stod du gtum po dud kha bdud kyi khram shing 'phyar ba/ nub smad du gang ba kun 'joms dkar po mda' gzhu 'geng ba/ nub byang du kha 'bar ral gcig dmar nag ral gri 'phyar ba/ byang stod du sbrul mgo kun 'dzings sngo skya lcags mdung 'phen pa/ byang smad du ngang pa stobs ldan ser po dgra sta 'dzin pa/ byang shar du hong ban srog 'dzin nag po bdud zhags 'phen pa/ thams cad shin tu khros shing dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o/ /ltar rje sgrol ma ba'i phyag len du bshad cing / dbang po'i sde'ang 'di ga mdzad/ thams cad kyi phyag —284

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)mtshan g.yas phur pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin par bshad pa'ang yod do/ /de dag ni 'chi bdag bcu gnyis te/ man ngag rtsa bar/ phyi rim lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la/ /las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gnas/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa bar khyams kyi lha ni/ phyi rim khyams su las kyi gshin rje rnams/ /cheXgasogs kyis/ bar khyams la pho gshed mo gshed la sogs pa las kyi gshin rje thams cad sha za gi dang ma mo la sogs dregs pa can gyi tshul 'dzin cing sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha thogs par bsam mo/ /de dag ni bar khyams kyi lha zhes bya ste/ man ngag rtsa bar/ de yi phyi rim bar khyams la/ /pho gshed mo gshed la sogs pa'i/ /sha za ki dang ma mo'i tshogs/ /zhes so/ /drug pa sgo ba ni/ sgo bzhir dkar po snying 'byin mgon po nag /ces sogs kyis/ shar sgor dkar po snying 'byin lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor mgon po nag po zhags pa (27ba 'dzin pa/ nub sgor yab rje nag po lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor sku mchog dmar po dril bu 'dzin pa/ bzhi ga'ang rang mdog dang mtshudas pa'i ber gsol ba'o/ /phyag mtshan de ltar 'byer bde ba'i dbang du byas pa ste/rje sgrol ma ba dang dbang po'i sde gnyis/ dkar po snying 'byin ru mtshon 'khor lo/ mgon po nag po be con thod khrag /yab rje nag po khram shing bdud zhags/ sku mchog dmar po dbyug to mdung 'dzin par bzhed la/ rin cen sgron mar yang na zhes 'dam gar bshad pas gang bde bya'o/ /de dag ni sgo ba bzhi ste/ man ngag rtsa bar/ sgo bzhi ru ni rgyal po dang / /mgon po bdud dang gnod sbyin bzhi/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa khor yug ni/ 'obs srung 'jigs rung bshan pa srog gshed bdag /ces sogs kyis/'obs chen bcu drug la ni/ 'obs srung chen po 'jigs su rung ba bcu drug sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs par bsam mo/ /de skad du'ang / phyi rol 'obs chen bcu drug la/ /'obs srung chen po bcu drug gnas/ /zhes so/ /mdor na dkyil 'khor gyi khyams stongs la gnas pa'i pho gshed mo gshed rnams dang / phyi rol gyi dur khrod la gnas pa'i bshan pa tshe srog gi gshed ma phyogs —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bcur las byed pa'i pho nya gshin rje dregs pa can gyi tsho gis rnams gang du ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gnas pa de nyid du nam mkha' la rgyu skar 'khrigs pa ltar rang bzhin lhun grub tu 'dus nas 'phrin las byed pa yin te/ las gshin (28na skoms kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ thugs rjes nyi ma lta bu'i dbyugs phyung nas/ /dkyil 'khor chen bo bsrung bar 'phrin las bskos so/ /zhes rgyud las byung ba ltar ro/ khyud du/ 'khor rnams las las grub pas bskyed mi dgos/ /zhes gsung ba ni/ 'khor rnams rang rgyud pa kho na ltar mi bskyed pa la dgongs pa yin gyi/ don la 'khor yang rang rgyud pa dang sprul pa gnyis su gsungs pa la/ 'dir ni dkyil 'khor spros pa'i tshe lha thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgrubs pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs rdzogs shing / ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'phrin las myur du 'grub pa yin no/ /a mu ka phung gi rgyud las/ rgyal ba gcig gi ye shes la/ /du ma las la rgyug 'gro ba/ /rang las byung ba'i sprul par snang / /don dam gnyis med gcig tu rdzogs/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes pa'i don gyi gnad go ba lam 'di la gal che bar yod do/ /de ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par blta bar bya ste/ man ngag rtsa bar/ de ltar de dag thams cad kun/ /sems nyid stong pa cho 'phrul te/ /chos nyid stong pa shar ba na/ /bar snang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon nam/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med par blta/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /da lta phyag len du man ngag rtsa ba'i tshig bdun sgrigs mar zur 'debs kyi tshig dgu sgrigs mas brgyan te ngag 'don (28ba)du byed pa yin no/ /smras pa / gdod nas lhun grub zil gnon rten dang brten par bcas pa' 'khor lo che/ /lha lam ngos su dbang po'i gzhu ltar phan tshun ma 'dres rnam bkra zhing / /gang gis 'jig dang gzhes du med pas rdo rje lta bur sra brtan pa/ /kun las rnam par rgyal 'dir rnal 'byor byed gang med byung skal ba can/ /zhes so/ /gzhung gi don gnyis pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la/ snyan gsan gdab pa/spyan drang ba/ brtan par gzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /dang po ni/ e/ mi rtogang nga las thugs rje'i sku/ /—286

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanazhes sogs dang / badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus pa rigs 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs bcas phyag rgya zil gnon gyi rnam pa sad par bya/ /gnyis pa ni/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /zhes sogs dang / dzaḥsnyi baṃ ho ces bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par bstim/ de ltar spyan drang ba ltar snang ba'ang / ye shes pa g.yin zhig tu yod pa'i blo bcad pa'i phyir yin gyi/ don dam du rang nyid lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor du rdzogs pa las gzhan pa'i ye shes pa logs nas spyan drang du med do/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte ba la/ /zhes pa nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /gzhud gi don gsum pa/thun mong du mchod pa'i rim pa la/ phyag gi mchod pa thun mong spyi'i mchod pa/ khyad par rang gi mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos nyid skye ba med pa la/ /zhes sogs (29na)dang / a ti pu hoḥs bdag dang ye shes pa gnyis su med pa phyag gi ngo bo dang / pra byu sngos gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor de'ang gsal la rang bzhin med par nyams su len pa phyag gi lan yin no/ /spro na/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi ni a la la sngo zhes pas rtog pa brda 'jal ba la ngo mtshar bskyed pa yin la/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ grangs med yid 'ong rin cen snod yangs su/ /zhes sogs dang / ā+oṃ a ha ra hūṃ nas sha lta'i bar brjod cing 'bul lo/ /de'ang pad+ma kun+da sogs me tog gi tshogs rin po che'i snod du bshams shing / tsan dan dkar dmar a ka ru sogs dri bzang bsregs pa'i dud pa mkha' la 'khrigs pa/ dus mtha me lta bu'i 'od dang ldan pa'i mar me'i phreng ba dang / bzang po drug sogs dri mtha' yasapa dang ldan pa'i dri chab/ mngar skyur bska ba la sogs pa'i ro mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa'i zhal zas kyi tshogs/ pi waṃ gling bu/ sil snyan dang / u dha ka sogs rnga'i rigs dang rol mo'i bye brag dpag tu med pa ste/ phyi'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis so sor thogs te 'bul bar byed pa'i sgom don tshig tu bsgrigs pa'o/ /—287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nagasum pa la/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa/ rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa/ bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa/ sman gyi gsang nan sbreng ba/ 'dod yon nang gi mchod pa/ phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa'o/ /dang po la'ang / sman gyi che ba brjod de spyir mchod pa/ lha rkang grangs kyi sgos (29bsgo cho de bya ba/ dngos grub blang zhing bdud rtsi myang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ myong grol dam rdzas dang sbyar a skṛ ta/ /sogs brjod de/sngags lan gsum gyis/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong sogs la dbul zhing / bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa lta bu mchod yul rnams kyi 'kha du gsol bas/ thugs zag med kyi ye shes chen pos gang zhing dgyes te dngos grub stsol bar bsams pas/ bsdu na de tsam gyis 'grub la/ rgyas par spro na/'phags pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /zhes sogs las byang chen mo nas 'byung ba'i bla ma brgyud mchod kyang bya/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyas par spro na/ gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhes sogs las byang chen mo nas 'byung ba ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rdzogs par re re nas mchod cing / sman mchod kyi sham bu'am ji ltar rigs pa btags so/ /gsum pa ni/ yig brgya brjod cing / nyes byas sman gyi sgo nas bshags te snod du rung bar byang la/ ā+oṃ āḥ& zhes sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'bru gsum bdud rtsi'i nang du babs par bsam/ slar yang rigs 'dzin sogs brjod la/ 'bru gsum gnas gsum du bstim zhing / kā ya sirnyi sogs brjod la bdud rtsi myang ngo / /gnyis pa rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa ni/ gdug can dgra bgegs khrag gi dngas ma'i mtshor/ /zhes sngags dang bcas pas khams gsum rak+ta'i rgya mtsho zhal du gsol bas/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'dod (30na)chags rtsad nas bcad par bsam mo/ /gsum pa bha ling ni/ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha rus dbang lnga'i rdul/ /zhes sngags dang bcas pas gtor ma bdud
