rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'dod yon drug gi lha mos mchod par bsam/ de'ang tshig zin la/ rdul mang brtsegs pa'i rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i lhun po/ /rgyu dang tshad che zhing phun sum tshogs pa dper mtshon nas/ zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha rus khrag dang sbyar ba'i —288

zil gnon phrin la kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)dmar gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa bdud rtsi'i ro dang ldan par bsams pa'i don to/ /bzhi pa sbreng mchod ni/dug lnga'i bdud rtsi che sbyar ye shes lnga/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas gtor ma bdud rtsi mu tig dri ma med pa lta bu lha rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing bdud rtsi gtor mar blug go /lnga pa nang gi 'dod yon ni/ dur khrod dbus su tshil chen snang 'od 'bar/ /zhes kha thun ltar sngags dang bcas pas dbul/ drug pa phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ rang snang shes rab e gsang chu gter che/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen pos mchode do/ /phyag rgya gar mchod 'di las byang chen mor gsal ba med kyang / rje sgrol ma ba'i phyag len ltar byas pa yin no/ /g.yin yang skabs 'dir glu ye shes kyi mchod pa'ang rung ste/ spro na/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang / /zhes sogs tshang bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa ni/ rab 'byams (30ba)dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis dbus kyi gtso bo phyag rgya zil gnon nas bzung ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la bstod par bya ba yin no/ /de'ang 'di'i don ye shes lnga sogs la sbyar te rgyas par 'og tu 'chad cing / tshig zin gtso bo'i mngon rtogs dang mthun pa ltar yin la/ 'khor rnams nyi mas pad tshal rgyas shing / 'ug pa sogs mtshan mo'i bya rnams rmongs pa ltar/ gsod byed mas bde ba chen po bskyed cing ma gdon 'joms lha dbang phyug gis lha ma yin bcomasapa bzhin/ sras mchog gis/ khro bo'i gtso bo rnams kyi mthu las dang sbyor ba 'joms/ rgya mtsho sogasachus mi gsod pa ltar/ gsang bdag gis 'jig rten drags pa'i las dang sbyor ba 'joms/ /bung ba rnams me tog gi nang du gnas pa ltar/ srid gsum gyis khyams dang / seng ges glang po sogs gsod pa bzhin/ khyung chen gyis klu rigs sogs 'og gdon gyi nus pa 'joms/ gnam lcags thog gis brag ri 'jig pa ltar rgyan lha brgyad kyis gdug pa can so sgo 'joms zhes pa'i don no/ /gzhung gi don lnga pa sngags kyi bzlas thabs bstan pa la/ phyi skor sku'i drag sngags/ nang skor gsung gi drag sngags/gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags yang gsang drag po rgod kyi drag sngags bzlas thabs so/ /dang po ni/—289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nathugs gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig las/ /zhes sogs kyis/ bdag gi thugs dar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sku'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'ja' tshon (31na sko bu byung / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'phros te bdag g.yin gyi sdig sgrib dgra bgegs thams cad ba mo la nyi ma shar ba bzhin du dag par bsam mo/ /de'ang sngags kun gyi thog mar sku'i sngags bzla bar gsungs te/ sngags don gsal sgron du/ drag po sngags kyi 'bru bcu gnyis pa de dag ni zhal gyi dmod pa drag po mngon du phyung ste gsang chen gcig tu dril ba'i sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin te/ kun gyi 'go la bgrang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ljags kyi rtse mo las/ /zhes sogs kyis/bdag nyid kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las 'od zer me'i tsha tsha lta bu 'phros pas las ngan pa'i bag chags dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ thugs da'i mthing nag hūṃ las sngags 'khor ni/ /zhes sogs kyis/ thugasaspu'i hūṃ la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer mgal me ltar 'khor zhing 'phos pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad star tshan la sbur mi chags pa bzhin du song bar bsam mo/ /de dag kyang bsnyen pa ltar bzla ba yin te/ rang rang gi spu gri'i sgo nas las phan gnod bsgrub pa ni man ngag ltar shes par bya'o/ /dmar yig tu/ sku yi sngags sbyor gnag pa dang / /dmar len snying phyung 'bru brgyad gsungs/ khrag sngags sbyor ba'i rgyal por bshad/ /ces dang / e dun ka yi/ gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags te/ /spu gri rnam gsum ma nges 2gyur/ /zhes dang / kun kyang chos nyid ma bcos pa'i/ /(31bsgo 'gags rang snang rol pa'i rtsal/ /chos kun snying por gyur pa yi/ /'jam dpal gzhen nu yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /bha su dha ra'i rgyud kyi spyi spyod las/ phyi skor sku yi drag sngags dang / nang skor gsung gi drag sngags dang / gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags dang / yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags so/ /de la phyi skor sku yi drag sngags ni/rtsa ba'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa la/ las phan gnod dang bcas pa'o/ /nang skor gsung gi drag sngags ni/rtsa ba 'bru brgyad pa las dang bcas pa'o/ /gsang skor thugs kyi drag sngags ni/ rtsa ba'i 'bru bzhi pa —290

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)las dang cas pa'o/ /yang gsang rgod ni drag po sngags ring las dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa yang gsang rgod kyi drag sngags bzlas thabs ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying / 'jam dpal lha rgyud kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i drag sngags drag po mye ring gi sngags te/ 'di la bsnyen par bzla ba dang / drag por bzla ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bdag nyid khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon du/ /zhes sogs kyis/ bdag nyid zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs tsit+ta rin po che gur phub pa 'dra ba'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog smug nag phyag mtshan mi mnga' ba zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs dar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ mthing kha 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba zhig bsam/ de la sngags kyi phreng ba klog stabs su bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas thon te rang gi pad+ma dmar (32na)po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la hrī:dmar por gnas pa'i mtha' skor du sngags phreng gis bskor ba la phog /slar 'od zer steng du 'phros pas/ klad pa dud khang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā+oṃ dkar por gnas pa'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la phog /slar yang lce steng nas thugs skar 'phros shing de ltar 'phro 'du 'khor mor byas pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ de nas 'od zer phyir 'phros te phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su 'phros pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te/ 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros/'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ mthu dpal gzi mdangs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas/ bdag nyid ye shes kyi sku shin tu gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros/ yul gnod byed kyi dgra bgegasarnams la phog pas bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar bcoms/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ de dag gi tshe dang bsod nams kyang bdag la thim zhing / bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du nyi ma'i gdan la 291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nabazhugs pa'i khro chung phyag na me rlung gi 'khor lo bsnams pas gtams te bar gcod bsrung bar bsgom shing / las dang po bas de dag la khrid du byas pa'am/ brtan pa cung zad thob pas 'phro 'du rnams cig car du bya ba yin no/ /de'ang thog mar yig 'bru (32ba)brgya dang zhe dgu pa 'di nyid la bsnyen pa byed do/ /de skad du'ang / rtsa ba lus kyi drag sngags la/ /yig 'bru brgya dang zhe dgu yod/ /ces dang / de ni lus kyi tshul yin te/ /bsnyen pa dang ni nye bar bsnyen/ /ces so/ /bha su dha ras/ dang po kho na drag po dbang sdud sngags ring la nan tan bya ste/ de'ang sku gsung thugs kyi 'phreng ba las gcun pa dang / gnad la dbab pa dang / grong khyer dkrug pa dang / ming dang 'bod pa dang / srog gzir ba dang / dbrog pa dang / bcad pa'i las rnams sngags kyis byed pas rang bzhin bsnyen par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa drag por bzlas pa la/ lhag gsal ba/ yul gsal ba/ sngags gsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha dang bcas ba gsal bar byas pa'i gtso bo'i thugs tsit+ta'i nang du nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ/ sras kyi thugs gar ma/ dregs pa'i thugs kar hūṃ/rus sbal gyi thugs gar kā/ bya khyung gi thugs kar khrom/ yum gyi thugs rkar ma/ de rnams kyi tha mar drag sngags kyis bskor bar bsam mo/ /lha rnams rim par thugs kyi phyi brang gi nang du bsgom zhes rje dbang gsung zhes rin cen sgror mar bshad do/ /gnyis pa yul gsal ba ni/ gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs de gzhung bzhin bskyed do/ /gsum pa sngags gsal ba ni/ phye ring lus la gzir ba g.yu spyang can btags la bzlas so/ /dmar yig tu/ a mu na: 'bru gsum srog gshed bsdebs pa yin/ /myags gcig gis srog dang snying po gzhes/ /thum ril: gnyis (33na)kyis rbod gtog rang la bzlog /trig nan sbur ya nan lnga yis stobs dang nus pa gnon/ /e gcig gis stong srog gnad yig 'gyur/ khung thums dzaḥ gsum gyis srog gi 'bras bu sdud/ /kho shag /'bru gnyis rtsa dang dngas ma 'brel/ ro myags: gnyis kyis stobs dang nus pa gnon/ mugs ti rbad: gsum gyis lus srog sbyor ba gcod/ /ces gsungs so/ /bsnyen pa —292

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)thems nas 'di nyid gang 'grub bzlas shing / /bye brag pha rol gyi sbyor ba 'joms pa'i phyir srod dang tho rengs brgya rtsa bzlas par bya'o/ /rtsa bar/ srod dang tho rengs brgya brgya yis/ /phas kyi stobs kyi sbyor ba 'joms/ /zhes so/ /bal po bha su dha ras/ drag po skye ring sngags rgod 'di/ /rtag par rgyun du bzlas gyur na/ /'jig rten lha 'dre khams 'khrug cing / /lha srin tsit+ta dkrug par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /man ngag rtsa ba las/ drag po mye ring sngags rgod la/ /'byung ba lnga yi log 'dren bsgyur/ /drag po e yi rtsa ba la/ /btsan po mkhar du gzhug pa dang / /spyi srog dbang du sdud pa dang / /stong srog gnad la bor ba dang / /sgos srog dmigs su sprukhor ba'i las/ /mkhas pas bsdeb pa shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyang mo drug gi so dang gang gnod pa'i sgos srog dmigs su gshor ba sogs la man ngag gi gnad mtha' yas pa snang bas zhal gdams snying gi khrag lta bu rnams khong du chud par byas nas nyams su blangs na gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i thog dang mtshungs shing / deng sang gi chos la ras sbyong mkhan gzhan gdams (33ba)par spyod pa ltar byung rgyal du 'jug pa ni rang nyid phung bar byed pa'i rgyu yin pas/ srog la gces pa rnams bag dang ldan par byos shig /skabs su ur mo ngar gcod dang / lha srin gyi tshe bdud kyang shes par bya'o/ /de skad du'ang / slob dpon nor 'dzin gyis gnubs chen la gdams par/ phye ring stong srog lha yi nga rgyal dang / /rang gshed spyang mo drug gi dgongasapa dang / /lha srin yid 'phrog ting 'dzin yig chung dang / /'di gsum bsdebs la ban chung thugs dam mdzod/ /'di gsum mang pa'i sdig pa snying 'dzings ni/ /nor bu'i phreng ba thag pa chad pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dzab bstod 'bul ba dang dngos grub blang ba las byang chen mo zur du med kyang / rje sgrol ma pa'i phyag bzhes su 'dug la/ 'dir ni gsol ba btab cing dngos grub blang ba tsam byas na bde zhing legs par mngon par bsnyen pa'i mjug tu/ bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tsho gis kyi/ /zhesasogs brjod do/ /smras pa/ ye nas lhun grub rang sems ye shes lha/ /rmi lam ltar du logs nas spyan drangs —293—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'apa'i/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro kun 'dus lha/ /zil gnon phyag rgya'i 'khor lo rnam par bkra/ /gnyis med phyag dang phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dpag bsam ljon shing gis/ /mtha' yas mchogo thun dngos grub 'bras bu che/ /phugs med dus su stsol ba'i dpyid kyi ma/ /sku gsung thugs dang yang gsang sngags kyi mthu/ /rnam par 'grub pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /snod ldan snying gi bum pa 'geng 'dod na/ /rgyud ldan (34na)dam pa'i zhabs pad ring du bsten/ /rtog ge'i dug chus myos pa'i mkhas rlom dang / /stobs ldan blun pos bkur ba'i dregs pa can/ /bstan 'dzin lung med gzhan la 'chang ba'i chos/ /yangs pa'i sa 'di gang phyir tshul 'di gsang / /zhes so/ /gzhung gi gsum pa las dang 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ thog mar las bshad par bya ste/ de'ang dbus kyi gtso bo phyag rgya zil gnon gyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ g.yon na yum rdo rje khros mas mo gdon kun zil gyis gnon/ thugs ga'i ya ma rā dzas zhi khro gshin rje phur pa pad+ma'i mthu las dang sbyor ba thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /de'i thugs ga'i phyag na rdo rjes bdud dang mu stegs rgyal po dkor srung btsan dang the'u rang gnyan dang gnod sbyin gyi las dang sbyor ba thams cad zil gyis gnon/ de'i thugs ga'i rus sbal khro bos skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dang bkrag mdangs tshe dang dbang po 'byung ba'i dngas ma thams cad sdud cing 'chang / spyi gtsug gi bya khyung gis klu dang klu bdud klu srin mdze 'dra'i stobs dang nus pa thams cad 'joms shing zil gyis gnon/ phrag gong khyung gnyis kyis sa bdag sa srin btsan dang yul lha thams cad zil gyis gnon/ nu kha'i seng ges mi rigs stobs can kun zil gyis gnon/ sogs kha'i stag gis gcan gzan dang dud 'gro'i stobs zil gyis gnon/ sta zur gyi sprul nag gis sngags dang dmod pa drag po dang / tsha ba'i dbal kun zil gyis gnon/ da ni 'khor rnams kyi las bshad de/ de'ang 'chi bdag gis mnan pa'i las mtha' dag byed/(34ba)srog bdag gis bshig pa'i las mtha' dag byed/ tshe bdag gis bsad pa'i las mtha' dag byed/ gshed po bzhis rang gi rtsa chen bzhi bsrung zhing bdud bzhi'i gnyen po byed do/ /mon bdud —294

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanabargyad kyis rnal 'byor pa'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad bsrung zhing dgra bo'i gshed byed de/ de'ang bye brag tu/ dung gi mon pas srid pa'i phung po lnga dang 'bral/ lcags kyi mon pas srid pa'i 'byung ba lnga dang 'bral/ bse'i mon pas sring pa'i chags sdang lnga dang 'bral/ gser gyi mon pas srid pa'i rnam shes brgyad dang 'bral/ he la khyab pas srid pa'i bla brku/ nag po 'dzum med kyis srid pa'i dbugs len/so 'dar 'khrig pas srid pa'i tshe 'phrog /ral pa spyir bcings gyis srid pa'i bla dang 'bral/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis kyis rang gi skye mched bcu gnyis bsrung zhing / dgra bo'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis gnad gcod bcings pa'o/ /dkar po snying 'byin gyis dgra bo lcags kyus 'gugs shing spyor 'jug /mgon po nag pos zhags bas bcings nas brgyal du 'jug /yab rje nag pos lcags sgrog gis bsdams nas khram la 'degs/ sku mchog dmar pos dril bus myos shing rgyu zhags thogs nas rtsa rgyusagacod par byed/ /sprul pa sha za drug khri drug stong gis dregs pa dpa' rtsal 'gran pa'i las byed do/ /da ni 'bras bu bshad par bya ste/ de la'ang rten dang brten pa so so'i rnam dag bshad pa dang /lam kun gcig tu grol ba'i 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang yin la/ bye brag tu (35na)dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag ni yum gyi mkha' chos kyi dbyings spros bral mtshon pa'o/ /zla gam gsum ni khams gsum rnam par dag pa bde ba chen po'o/ /thod phreng ni thugs rje rol pa'o/ /thod mkhar bzhi ni ye shes bzhi'o/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rtsibs mtshan dang bcas pa ni ye shes bcu drug go /lcags mkhar bcu gnyis ni skye mched bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi ni tshad med bzhi/ khyams bzhi ni 'phrin las bzhi/ /sgo bzhi ni ye shes bzhi'o/ /rta babs rnam par thar pa brgyad/ dra ba dra phyed phar phyin bcu/ rgyan sna tshogs chos brgyad kyi spros pa dag pa'o/ /rtse mo mtho ba thig le nyag gcig go /gdan gyi dregs pa can rnams ni de dag bsgral nas chos nyid du sbyor zhing / nyi zla pad+ma thabs shes chags med mtshon pa'o/ /de nas brten pa lha'i rnam dag bshad par bya ste/ de'ang nang bcud kyi 'jig rten rnam par dag pa brten pa lha'i 'khor —295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)lo yin la/ bye brag tu dbus kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das nyid ni 'byung ba nam mkhar 'dzin pa'i dngas ma dang gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa cho me kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo ste/ de'ang gzhi khamasagasum gyi 'gro bar chen pa'am/ bdag tu 'dzin nga gsum lam rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du dag nas lā sa bu sku gsum du grol ba'i don no/ /phyag drug ni/ gzhi rigs drug tu 'khor ba nyid lam phar phyin du dag nas las bu gas drug ye shes chen po drug tu grol ba'i don no/ /zhabs bzhi ni/ skye ba rnam bzhir 'dzin pa nyid tshad med pa bzhir dag nas rdo snyul (35ba)gyi rkang pa bzhir grol pa'i don no/khro bo'i chas dgu ni rgyan du chags par 'dzin pa nyid gar dgu dag nas 'bras bu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur grol ba'i don no/ /rang 'od rdo rje'i me dpung ni/ ma rig pa nyid rang bzhin gyis 'di gsal ba'i ye shes su dag nas 'bras bu ye shes chen po'i klong du rang grol ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /de skad du'ang rgyud las/ phyag rgya chen po rngam pa'i sku/ /mthing nag dug chen dug lnga 'joms/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /sgo gsum sku gsung thugs su rdzogs/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa med/ /pa rol phyin drug ye shes drug /skye ba rnam bzhi stong bdag med/ /tshad med bzhi dang rdo 'phrul rkang / /rdzogs par rang bzhin lhun nas grub/ /ces 'byung ngo / /g.yon gyi gsod byed ma ni/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i ngang du mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /thugs ga'i ya ma rā dza ni 'byung ba sar 'dzin pa'i dngas ma dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po nyid ya ma rā dza ra dag nas 'bras bu me long lta bu'i ye shes su grol ba rdo rje'i rigs so/ /phyag rdor ni 'byung ba mer 'dzin pa'i dngas ma dang tshor ba'i phung po nyid dregs pa phyag na rdo rje'i skur dag nas 'bras bu mnyam nyid ye shes su rang grol ba'i rin po che'i rigs so/ /rus sbal ni 'byung ba rlung du 'dzin pa'i dngas ma dang 'du byed kyi phung po nyid rus sbal rngam par dag nas 'bras bu bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su rang grol ba las kyi rigs so/ /bya khyung ni 'byung ba chur 'dzin pa'i dngas ma dang 'du shesakyi phung po nyid (36na)bya khyung rgyal po'i skur dag nas 'bras bu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su grol ba —296

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanapad+ma'i rigs so/ /de ltar yongs su rdzogs pa'i drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi'i gzugasacan phyag rgya zil gnon zhes bya'o/ /rgyud las/ sems min logs nas 'char ba'am/ rkyen las 'byung ba ma yin te/ ye shes chen por lhun gyis grub/ /ces so/ /lha de dag nang rtsa gnas la sbyar te bshad pa ni rgyud dang man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /rgyan gyi lha rnams ni gdul byar 'dzin pa nyid lha brgyad du dag pa ye shes kyi rol pa'o/ /da ni 'khor gyi rnam dag bshad par bya ste/ /de la sprul pa gsum ni dug gsum lhar dag pa sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes so/ /gshed bzhi ni nyen mongs pa bzhi lhar dag pa ye shes bzhi'o/ /mon bdud brgyad ni rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa ye shes kyi cho 'phrul lo/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis ni skye mched bcu gnyis dag pa'i ye shes/ sgo ba bzhi ni bdag tu lta ba dag pa'o/ /de ltar bshad pa'ang gong du rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam pa gsal ba'i skabs rnams su de dang de'i rnam dag nges par byas nas nyams su blang ba ni bla na med pa'i lam srol thun mong ma yin pa ste/ sngags 'bru gcig la lam du byed pa zhes pa'ang 'di 'dra la dgongs pa yin par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa bar/ chos nyid skye ba med pa las/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par bshad/ /ye shes rol pa 'gag pa med/ /bde chen lhun grub re dogs bral/ /bdag nyid lhun grub dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la bha (36ba) su dha ras/ chos sku skye med las rang byung gi ye shes rang shar bas ye shes lhun grub/ gzugs sku 'gro don rtsol med du spyod pas rnam pa lhun grub/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa sgyu ma lhun grub/ de nyid 'phrin las bsnyen sgrub 'phro 'du'i rtsol ba dang bral zhing yongs rdzogs su gnas pas dbang po lhun grub/ cir snang phyag rgyar gsal bas sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo ste rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye shes lngar lhun gyis grub cing bgrod thob med pas lā sa bu lhun grub ces gsungs te/ mdor na chos sku skye med kyi rol pa/ longs sku bde ba chen po'i rnam 'phrul bsam yas 'bad med lhun grub tu bzhugs pa ni lam mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu yin —297—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nano/ /de la sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can du'ang tha snyad 'dogs te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshesaganyen gyis/ phung po lnga snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba longs sku/ de'i rang bzhin chos sku/ don byed pas sprul sku/ rang byung ye shes rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad la sogs par gdul bya so sor snang bas mngon byang / de dag tshig snga phyir byung yang don la dbyer med cing rtag pa ther zug rgyun las grol bas rdo rje'i sku'o/ /de lta bu ni phyag rgya chen po zil gnon lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa mthar phyin par bshad do/ /rgyud du'ang / 'khor ba dong sprugs ka dag gling / /sangs rgyas rang chas btsal du med/ /ces gsungs so/ /da ni lam gyi skabs su grub pa'i mtshan ma bstan pa'ang zhan la bshad par bya ste/ de la bam chen gsang ba'i dbang chur grub pa'i rtags ni/(37na)rin po che'i rgyal sa thob pa dang / rin po che'i ga: la 'dzegs pa dang / bdud rtsi'i chu la khrus byed pa dang / sha khrag dang 'dod yon la rol ba'i rmisaltas dang / zhes dang / 'khor lo nag po'i rgyud las/ de la rtags kyi rim pa 'byung ngo / /mgo la sku gdung nyi zla gab/ /bdud rtsi'i chu la khrus byed dang / me chu 'tshub mar 'khyil ba'i lha/ /klu la gdod phyir gru gzings bskyod/ /glang po zhen nas mtshon cha 'bar/ /phyi yi rtags spyod yul du 'gyur/ /'od sgra du ba ba 'ad cing ston/ /dmag 'dren dgra 'gugs 'od byed dang / /nad gcod rkang 'bebs las la 'phyur/ /spyod yul rnam gsum nang du zung / /lus yang sems rgod rig pa dngas/ /zas dang sgom gyi 'du shes chud / /nyen mongs shes pa mul la 'bar/ /snga na med pa'i rnam pa myong / /thun zor sha khrag rngam zhing rol/ /gsang ba'i rtags ni dbang sdud sbyar/ /gzhan yang rtags kyi rim pa la/ /bdag nyid phyag rgya gsal ba dang / /rang sems mi g.yo nyams dang ldan/ /'dod pa'i yul la shin tu 'tshig /sngags rnams gsal la 'bar zhid 'dril/ /blo ni mi g.yo don rnams gsal/ /lce lkog tsha la g.ya' ba dang / /'brum bu phra mos 'gengs pa dang / /lus la 'du ba'i nad med cing / /lus la drod dang g.yo ba'i rlung / /bod pa'i dus su snying gnas ldang / /thog ser tho lum 'bar ba dang / /mtshon cha klad la —298

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanabaskor ba dang //gzhan gyi ngag lam 'khor los bkag/rang gis rang gi yul khams bshig/'khor gyi 'brad bral 37ba ) bas da pa 'byung //rang yang dbugs 'thums lce mi bde//rang 'khor rang la gnod pa byed//man ngag ldan pas 'khrul 'khor 'gyur//zhes dang /rgya gar dha na dha las/rtags ni sku dngos su mthong ba dang / rten gyi bris sku zhal bzhad pa dang / nam langs pa dang / 'od kyis rgyal khams khengs pa dang //nyi zla gza' skar dus gcig tu shar ba dang /lus kyi zag pa zad pa dang //'dod yon mngon du 'byung ba dang //lus yod du mi tshor zhing 'du ba dang bral ba dang /dbugs phyi nang rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang /ngag gi bden pa grub pa dang /sems gang du'ang mi 'pho bar chos nyid la gnas pa la sogs pa ci rigs su 'byung ngo //zhes gsungs so//bye brag tu drag po'i las mthar thug pa'i rtags ni drag las rang rang gi skabs su 'byung ngo //smras pa/snod bcud rnam par dag pa rten brten pa'i//rang snang ye shes rol par rtag 'char ba'i//lhun grub sku gsum ngo bo phyag rgya'i gar//theg mchog snying po'i rnal 'byor rmad du byung //chos kun sems las gzhan du ma mchis kyang / /mkha' la sprin dang 'ja' tshon glog 'khyug ltar/ /'khrul snang lam gyi mtshan mar ston pa 'dis//slu med rten cing 'brel bar 'byung de mtshon//zhes so//spyi don gsum pa 'phrin las kyi rdzas kyi cho ga la/tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba/lhag ma btang ba/'phros don zor las bye brag tu bshad pa//bstan ma bskyang ba/dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/dge ba bsngo ba/shis pa brjod pa'o//dang po la/tshogs bsham zhing byin gyis brlab pa/tshogs zhing spyan drang ba/38na〉spros te spyir mchod pa/bye brag tu zhal g.yas dkar la mchod pa/g.yon dmar la bshags pa/dbus mthing ba la stob pa/tsho gis la rol ba'o//dang po ni/raṃ yaṃ 'a gis tshogos kyi yo byad kun//zhes sogs brjod de/raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis tshogos ma dag pa rnams mes bsregs/rlung gis gtor/chus bkrus te sbyangs/ā+oṃ āḥ/ gis sbyangs rtogs sbar zhing /ho:yig zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir byin gyis bas bo// 299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gnyis pa ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /zhes sogs kyis/ bla ma bde gshegs zhi khro'i tsho gos spyi dang / khyad par zil gnon lha tsho gos rigs 'dzin srung mar bcas pa rnams spyan drangs/ /gsum pa ni/ ngo bo snang stong kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /zhes sogs kyis/ 'dod yon drug gi lha mo mchod pa'i tsho gos thogs pas nam mkha' bkang ste mchod/ /bzhi pa ni/ zab bral bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgya ldan pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis dbul zhing / rang gi chos skyong nas gzhi bdag gi bar du 'bul lo/ /lnga pa ni/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gaṅgā'i rgyun/ zhes sogs dang / yig brgya brjod de nyes pa rnams bshags/ de'ang tshig zin/ nyi 'od kyis gangs ri bzhu zhing med par byas na ga ṅga sogs chu rgyun la gnod pa ltar/ nyes lhung gi dris dam tshig la nyams chags byung na mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i shegs su 'gyur bas de bshags pa'o/ /drug pa la gdul bya 'gugs pa/ bsgral ba/ stob pa'o/ /dang po ni/ hūṃ/ zhes 'dod (38ba) yon gyi lha mo rang gi thugs skar bsdu/ phye ring tshar gcig gis nga rgyal gsar zhing sprul pa spro/ : dza o gas kyi phyag rgya bzhis dgug bcing bsdam myos dbye gzhug bya/ slar yang gru gsum e yi sogs kyis pho nya mngags shing 'gugs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi dmigs pa dang bcas te/ phye myags sogs brjod cing phur bu btab ste bsgral/ tshe gnas kyi dgongs pa bzhin bya/ slar ral gris gtum cing gong gi sngags rnams brjod do/ /gsum pa ni/ ling ro sman rag gis sbrus pa thod par bsdus la/ sha khrag gi rgya mtshor bsam/ e phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /sogs brjod de/ dgra bo'i sha khrag dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis rol bas dug gsum rtsad nas bcad par bsam mo/ /bdun pa ni/ spyi ltar tshogs dbang bskur ba'i tshig brjod pa'am/ min kyang drang ste/ lha la mchod pa'i bsam pas rol bar bya zhing /lhag ma gsog 'jog med par bzhag go /rjes kyi gnyis pa lhag ma la/ lhag gtor byin gyis brlab pa/ mgron 'gugs pa/ zil gyis mnan pa/ dam tshig bstan pa/ dam bsgrag pa/ kha chu sbran pa/ mchod cing las la gzhol ba'o/ dang po —300

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)ni/ lhag phud kyi gtor ma sman raka dang bcas pa rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ gtor snod nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhal zas hūṃ gis dngos po bsregs/ /āḥyis nam mkha' lta bur te/ /ā+oṃ gyis mos pa ji lta bar/ /sngo yis bdud rtsi nyid du bsgyur/ /gzugs ni bsgral ba'i dngos por gyur/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ sngo zhes brlab bo/ /(39na slogs lhag byin gyis brlab tshul 'di las byang chen mor dngos su mi gsal zhing /las byang 'dir yang dngos su ma bkod la/ 'on kyang rdo rje slob dpon tsam gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas dza las ṭak+ki rā dza spros te/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ṭak+ki rā dza sogs dang /dkyil 'khor phyi rol sogs brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi khyams la dgug go /gsum pa ni/mdzub mo dang gung mo dang mthe bong rnams so sor sbyar/ srin lag dang mthe'u chung 'bar ba ltar byasapa'i khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ā+oṃ shrī mañju kro dha sogs brjod pas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i gzhog pa las 'od zer me'i tsha tsha lta bu 'phros pas ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas pa zil gyis mnan te mdor na yed med bka' nyan par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis ga shibs pa rdo rje rtse gnyis pa ltar byas la/sa ma ya du man+ta/ ka ra na phaṭa/ ces brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ lag g.yas sdigs mdzub bsgreng / be con bzung ba ltar byas la/ a ka ya ma hūṃ/ /zhes brjod pas/ las kyi gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi lag tu be con byin pas rang sems dpang du btsugs shing dam las mi 'da' la/ 'das na mgo 'gas snying 'tshig par bsam mo/ /drug pa ni/ ya rkan la yab lnga/ ma rkan la yum lnga/ sman khar blug pa de yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems 'od zer lnga 'phro ba'i kha phru gtor ma la btab/dpal gtor nas kyang mtheb skyu cha tshang gtor ma'i steng du phab bo/ /bdun pa ni/ dmar chen (39ba)sha khrag bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /sogs dang oṃ e ka ya ma kro dha khā hi ces/sogs kyis/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin/ sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po bstan srung las kyi gshin rje rnams kyis gsol bar bsam mo/ /de'ang sgrub pa zhag sbrel gyi tshe/ lhag ma btson du 'dzin pa'i tshul yang mchis na'ang / dgongs —301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)star gyis gtong ba legs so/ /smras pa/ dpyid kyi ma mas bskyangs pa'i chu 'dzin phreng / /dbyar dus lha lam dbus su rab 'khrigs nas/ /gru char babs pa'i gsher gyi nor 'dzin kun/ /brlan par byed pa dngos po'i rten 'brel yin/ /de bzhin dam ldan rigs 'dzin sngags wong gis/ /gnyis med tsho gos kyi mchod pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /dngos grub nor bu bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /rtsol med lhun gyis grub pa e ma mtshar/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa los don zor las bye brag tu bshad pa la/ /las byang chen mo dang rnam nges gnyis kar/ zor las byed na skabs 'dir bya zhes gzhan du zhal 'phangs pa tsam las dngos su ma gsungs na'ang / las byang 'dir dpyod ldan nyams su blang ba la 'byer bde ba'i phyir bkod pas/'di la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la tshul 'di lag tu blang ba'i gang zag rten gyi khyad par/ gang du bya ba'i gnas kyi khyad par/ sgrol ba'i dus dang tshes kyi khyad par/ lasasbyor bya ba'i yul gyi khyad par/ sbyor ba rdzas dang mchod gtor yo byad kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ gong du rgyas par bshad mod/ 'on kyang rgyud las/ gdengs gsum ldan (34na)par gsal gsum bya/ /zhes dbang thob cing lta ba rtogs pa/ man ngag gi gdengs dang ldan pa zhig dgos par bshad cing /gzhan yang chos gsum zhes bdag don sgril ba/ bag dang ldan pa/ don gnyis 'grub par 'dod pa gsum ste/ de skad du'ang rgyud las/ brda don grol dang smin pa'i lam/ /ta la nag po sbrul 'dzin ltar/ /sbyor ba gang zag bag dang ldan/ /don gnyis 'grub par 'dod pa yis/ /zhes pa ltar yin la khyad par du lha'i nga rgyal brtan cing bsnyen pa thems pa lag len 'phyugs med du khong du chud pa ni med du mi rung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar smos pa ltar drag po'i las sbyor la/ dur khrod dang / brag ri nag pa dang /gdug pa can rgyu ba'i sa gnyan pa'am/ yang na gnas khang nyams dga' ba dag tu bya ste/ rgyud las/ dur khrod gnas sam brag ri'i ngos/ /dben par 'dug la bsam gtan bya/ /zhes dang / yang / dur khrod —302

thil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanal sogs bde gnas su/ /rang sems dben par gnas babs te/ /zhes ga rna/ngas la/ kha thun du/bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi sgrub pa'i gnas dur khrod shin tu gnyan par bya bar bshad nas bod du de lta bu med pas/ slob dpon gong ma rnams kyis dngos grub thob pa'i gnas su bya bar bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ gza' tshes sbyor ba sa bdag gdug pa can sogs shin tu rtsub pa'i nyi ma la byed dgos te/ rgyud las/ tshes dang gza' dang skar ma dang / nag po rmes pa gcig la gtad/ /ces gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud las/ dam chos dge bcu smod pa dang / /dgon pa'i gnas su 'phrag pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' las 'da' ba dang / /mtshams med lnga la spyod pa dang / /bden pa'i bar log lta ba spyod/ /de tshe sngags kyi dmod pa bor/ /zhes gsungs pa (40ba〉ltar/ bsgral bya'i zhing dge ba bcu khyad du gsod cing / mi dge ba bcu dang du len pa/ dben gnas dang chos 'khor gnyan po rnams 'joms shing / mtshams med lnga la spyod pa sogs bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la byang sems can gyi sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pas drag po mngon spyod kyi las brtsam par bya ba yin te/ rgyud las/ bdag don ma yin bstan pa'i don/ /dkon cog bla ma'i don ched du/ /bstan pa'i bar gcod byed pa dag /bsgral na bla med byang chub myur/ /de min na ni mnar med de/ /las kyi ru dra la sogs skye/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'ang / bdag don ma yin zhes pa ni/ tshe 'di kho na bde ba'i thabs tsam dang / rnal 'byor pa chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen du mi 'gro ba'i rkyen chung ngu tsam la mngon spyod kyi las mi bya ba'i don yin la/ spyir rnal 'byor pas rgyud sde sogs gsung rab la thos pa byas pa ni lung gi bstan pa dang / lam zab mo nyams su blangs pa ni rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag mi re la gnod pa byung kyang bstan pa la gnod par 'gro bas rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra rnams bsgral ba'i yul yin no/ /deng sang ni 'di dag gi don ma go bar/ chos byed kyi sgrub pa po blo dkon cog la bstad nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor byed pa la 'phya zhing / dgon grong khang khyim tsam la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i ming du btags nas kha gsang dang tshul 'chos 'thab rtsod g.yo sgyu lhur len pa'i rtog ge pa —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nga rgyal can dang / sgom chen blun po dag cal col gyi gtam ma mang bar bag yod par byos shig /dang po la/ bca' ba zor dang mchod gtor/ zas po 'gugs pa'i dmigs (41na lhan/ spyor ba 'dzom pa drag po'i rdzas so/ /dang po ni/ lcags sdig bzlog gzhung las/ dang po sngags pa bsnyen rdzogs pas/ /zhing chen gdan la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /'bru nag lha grangs tshom bu bkod/ /mchod bshags bskang bzlog bsang gtor ram/ /dmar gyi gtor ma chen po bshams/ /sman phud rak+ta mchod pas bskor/ /zhes pa ltar/ drag po'i gtor zor ri rab gzugs sam zhal phyung ba skabs thob dang sbyar ba la shar du mchod gtor/ lhor bshags pa'i gtor ma/ nub tu bskang gtor/ byang du bzlog pa'i gtor mas bskor ba dang / gas yang gtor zor/ mda' zor/ khrag zor/ kong zor/ me zor/ rdo zor/ yungs zor/ rwa zor rnams so so'i rdzas sngags bzo dbyibs ltar bkod/ sman raka ga chen gyi spos/ gtor chung rnams/ chad mtho'i gtor ma/ gser skyems kyi chas sogs phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams bsham mo/ /de'ang gdong zor byed pa phal cher rgyu mtshan ma go bar spros bcas kho na lhur blangs te/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan sogs lder bzo'i khro bo'i dbu ji lta bar byed pa las gtor ma'i bzo dbyibs ma dod pa'i lag len mang du 'dug kyang / dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes su/ khro bo'i gdong dang gtor ma'i bzo dbyibs gnyis ka mnyams pa mdzad cing / me zor kyang bca' gzhi logs su mi mdzad la/ ma tram gyi steng du 'bru nag gi tshom bu bkod pa'ang skabs dang sbyor ba yin no/ /lugs 'di la ro zor thod zor/ rwa zor zhes bshad/ 'on kyang bod du rwa las zor (41bshong ma gnyis kyi rgyun ma dar ro/ /rwa zor bsgrub tshul gyi man ngag zab mo yi ge logs su gsal ba las shes dgos so/ /lcags sdig lcags 'dra sogs nas zor sna mang po 'di 'dra dngos su ma bshad dam snyam na/ lcags sdig las byang du/ gtor zor dmar po shar ra ra/ khrag zor dmar po 'khyil li li/ /thun zor se phran nyil li li/ /mda' zor skar ltar brengs rtse breng / /thod zor rbab ltar ril li li/ /phur zor sha la thims rtse thim/ /rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad/ /ces bshad cing / phur zor ni sras mchog bskyed pa'i phur pa nya bo la —304

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanabardeg pas zor gyi gtso bo yin la/ de las logs su mi dgos kyang / 'brug pa'i las byang kun bzang mchod sprin pa dag logs su phur zor bskul dang bcas pa byed pa ni man ngag la nang byan ma chud pa'i rtog bzo'i skyon no/ /tshig zin la dngos su ma zin pa'i zor rnams ni/ /'char ka sogs las gshin rnams nas kha 'geng ba phyag len yin zhing / khyad par 'char ka zor gyi rna cha can yin pas so/ /tshe bdag mkhan por rlom pa mang po zhig /man ngag dang bral te rang bzo legatore ma dang / gsar rnying gi man ngag bsres pa'i ngag dug bsdus pa'i gos hrul ltar byas nas/ gdams pa tshad ldan rnams kyang chud za bar byed pa'i lag len gyis rgyal khams gang ba 'di dag dang / sog ma la zan gyi zhal ba byas pa'i rmongs pa mgo bskor gyi gtor ma khong stong can dwags brgyud pa ci rigs kyis byed pa sogs la mig ltos byed pas mtshone te/ rang re'i lugs 'dir shan ye ma shor ba byed dgos pa shes ldan (42na jig snying la chongs shig /gnyis ba ni/ snying gzer las/ dmigs bstad 'bem la bca' ba ni/ /dgra bgegs ling ga 'dri ba yin/ /zhes pas dmigs rten gyi nya bo la'ang zan ling dang shog ling gnyis las/ snga ma ni rgyu bag zan las byas pa'i nya bo skye mched dod pa/ che chung tshad sogs man ngag ltar bya zhing / phyi ma ni/ phyir yang phra zhib kyi mdzad pa mang zhing khyad par lugs 'di la mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos shin tu mang bas zhal gyi bdud rtsi las long zhig /gsum pa ni/ 'brub khung / phur pa/ ral gri /skam gsher gyi thun/ thod ngan/ man ngag ltar byas pa'i zor gzhu/ zor skul/ dug sna/ mtshe yungs/ rtsang / rta tshil/ khrag gi kong bu lo tshad/ spos kyi sdong bu/ sha khrag sna tshogs/ phabs rtsi/ bal tshon sna lnga/ yugs sa'i 'phang gi rtsang / sbang ma/ skyer pa'i rtsang / lha bsgos khrag gi byugs pa/ gu gul/ rabs chad khang pa'i dud pa/ rams kyi phye ma/ dug khrag /gri khrag /ro sol/ sa sna/ mda' khra/ 'phang khra/ sa sbyin po/ rgyu ma/ dbye rdzas/ ma tho/ tsaka li/gdug pa can gyi shing ngam lcags las byas pa'i gtor stegs/ lcags slang / khrag gi gsher ba'i 'bru —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nag /zhwa phod/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs mdor na mthong brgyud kyi phyag bzhes ltar bsham zhing / rdzas dang / yo byad/ ngo bo/ ngos 'dzin lugs sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mtha' yas pa zhal shes ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'di na rnam par rgyal ba lha yi dpung / /yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba dag /nye bar bshams tshe bcud bral sder bcas rnams/ 9 1 ga (42ba)gi lhag ma'ang shor snyam snying ga 'dar/ /rdzas sngags ting 'dzin ldan pa'i drag po'i las/ /'brul med rta ljang dbang po mngon shar tshe/ /log 'dren dgra sde'i srin bu me khyer rnams/ /cig car nyams pas sa 'og song snyam byed/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ zor rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad pa/ mchod gtor sman raka brlab pa/zor bskyed cing gsal gdab pa/ ye shes kyi lha tsho gos spyan 'dren pa/ dmar gtor rak+ta phul te drag tu bskul ba/ lha so sor gtor ma 'bul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba/ bsgral zhing stob pa/ bzlog bsgyur bya ba/ zor lam dbye ba/ zor 'phang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ sum bha sogs kyis rang gi thugs ga'i oṃ las khro bo gnod mdzes spro ba sngar ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ ra gis zhes sogs kyis brlab cing dmigs pa sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa la/ gtor zor gsal 'debs pa/ zor gzhan rnams gsal 'debs pa/ thun zor gsal 'debs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sogs kyis gtor zor snod dang bcas pa stong par sbyangs pa ngang las/ snod dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du bcud kyi gtor ma rnams lha so sor bskyed pa yin no/ /de'ang sngags rnying ma'i phyag len phal cher du khro rol/ 'char ka zil gnon sogs mang por gyer sgom zhes bdag bskyed kyi las byang brjod cing gsal 'debs skabs/ mdun gyi gtor ma'ang lhan cig tu bsgom par mdzad cing / khyad par chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes su'ang de ga gnang bas 'jug pa bde zhing (43na〉spegs la/ 'on kyang lha'i ngo bo la khyad par med na'ang / mdun bskyed kyi lha rten sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur rnams lcags sdig lugs ltar mdzad pas ngag 'don du —306

zil gnon phrin la kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanalcags sdig lugs ltar bsgrigs pa gsal 'debs kyi rkyen du 'gro ba dang / rje kun dga' tshe mchog pas khro chu'i bzlog bsad gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes gtor zor gyi lha tshogs bskyed chog logs su 'dug pa go bde zhing legs par ma rga pas kyang rkyen byas te/ don la khyad par med pas 'di ltar bkod pa yin no/ /de'ang mngon rtogs chen mor/ phyag rgyas grol ba'i don byed du/ /bsam pa chos nyid stong pa las/ /ye shes chen po'i gzhal yas khang / /rin chen lnga las grub pa de/ /zhes pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab gzhal yas khang gi sa bon : sogs gsal bar ma byung na'ang / las byang chen mor/ e lasayaṃ chad rlung gi ba dan rtogs/ /zhes sogs 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gsungs shing / e las rgyu chad dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /zhes pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /bhan+ta skam rlon gyi rtsig pa ni/ las byang du/skam por ris rlon pa rtsig pa brtsigs/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer chen kun tu bdag ces gsal bar yod la/ ka gdung sogs ni las byang dang mngon rtogs gnyis tshig gi spro bsdu ma gtogs sgo mthun pas mngon rtogs chen mo ltar bkod pa yin la/ zhing lngags kyi thog dang rgyu rlon gyi bra ba dra phyed mngon rtogs su mi gsal yang / las byang du/ zhing chen zhing chung thod sbrul zur/ /gnam lcags khro chu chu srin thob/ khyu ma mi snying keng rus can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pho brang gling (43ba)dgu pa/ dbus kyi gling gru gsum mthing nag /de'i nang du gtso bo'i gdan rnams bskyed pa yin zhing /gling dgu yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol tu e'i pho brang mthing nag thod ras bskor ba la zla gam gsum 'byung bas/ las byang du/ e las pho brang gling dgu pa/ /mthing nag zla gam gsum dang ldan/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /gtso bo'i gdan la 'khor lo las byang dang mngon rtogs gnyis ka las byung ngo / /mngon rtogs 'bring por/ klu 'bum gyi gdan de sbrul dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ nag po khra bo 'bum bsnol/ zhes pa dang / gzhan yang / de'i steng du phyogs skyong bcu ste/ de'ang gdan gru bzhin yod pa'i shar du brgya byin dkar po/ lhor gshin rje nag po/ nub tu klu nag po/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po/ byang shar du dbang ldan dud kha/ shar lhor me lha dmar ser/ lho nub tu srin po smug nag zhub byang du rlung lha —307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ljang gu'o/ /zhes so/ /gtso bo phyag g.yon gyi tha ma na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin par las byang du bshad cing / 'phrin las 'bring po dang mngon rtogs chen mor/ phyag g.yon gyi bar ma sdigs mdzub dang zhags par bshad kyang phyag len du snga ma ltar mdzad do/ /las byang du/ yum chen pe ta nag mo ni/ thod sbul rin cen rus pas brgyan/ /ral pa'i zar bu mun ltar gtibs/ /gzig sham dar gyi 'phur lce 'phyang/ /tsit+ta brgyas yab 'khyud stob/ /ces pa ltar las gsal ba mi 'dug la/mngon rtogs su/ de'i pang na yum chen zhes byung ba dang / 'dir g.yon zur nas 'khyud pa'i tshul ltar bkod pa yin cing / sgom don (44na)du gang bde bya'o/ /dbyings yum srid pa'i rgyal mo las byang du gsal bar med kyang / mngon rtogs chen mor gsungs pa ltar bkod pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i lha dang rgyan gyi lha rnams 'dir gling dgu so sor bkod pa yin pas/ de'ang phyogs bzhi'i gling bzhi las/ shar lho nub kyi gling gsum du dregs pa/ sras mchog rus sbal dang / byang gling du sngags srung dang bya khyung 'dam gar mngon rtogs su bshad kyang / las byang du/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin pho mo'i gdan steng du sa bon bh+yo las bskyed pa ni/ sngags srung e ka dzā khyi ni/ zhes pa ltar byang phyogs su bkod pa yin no/ /lasabyang du bya khyung dngos su ma byung yang / mngon rtogs su/ srid pa gsum gyi mkha' la lding ba zil gnon dbu'am byang du bskyed/ /ces khrung bas/ 'dir gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu bskyed pa yin no/ /mtshams kyi gling bzhin rgyan gyi lha rnams 'god pa yin la/ de'ang yab seng ge so gos so so'i dbu la khro bo'i gzugasacan/ yum rnams seng ge sogs so so'i rnam pa can la chibs zhes gsung rgyun du yod cing / mngon rtogs su/ chibs su seng ge g.yu'i ral pa sprug pa la bcibs pa yum yang de 'dra ba la zhes tshig zin la so sor snang yang gong ma gnyis man ngag go /zla gam gsum la sprul pa gsum bskyed pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams mngon rtogs dang las byang gnyis mthun no/ /lcags mkhar bcu gnyis la gshed po bcu gnyis 'god par bshad pa las 'khor lo la phyi nang yod med gsal bar las byang mngon rtogs gnyas kar ma byung yang / zla gam thod ral bskor ba'i (44ba)phyi rol tu lcags mkhar bzhi/ de'i phyi —308

zil gnon phrin la kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)rol tu lcags mkhar brgyad kyi nang ma la ya ma rā dza sogs bzhi dang / phyi ma la'ang mon bdud brgyad 'god pa man ngag dang ras bris khungs btsun las 'byung ngo / /mngon rtogs su/ phyi nang gsang ba'i gshed po bcu gnyis po rnams be con dang lcags kyi 'khor lo 'dzin cing smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa can 'khor lo bcu gnyis la 'god cing / rtsibs mchan bcu gnyis su yum bcu gnyis rnams ma tram ro dbyug dang tsit+ta 'dzin cing / sku smad dug phur gru gsum dmar ba zhes bshad kyang / gshed po bcu gnyis po'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams phyag len ltar las byang chen mo bzhin bkod pa yin no/ /'dir yum rnams kyi phyag mtshan tshig gi spros pa chung ba'i phyi ma bkod kyang / las byang du ya ma rā dza'i yum la khram shing nad kyi rkyal ba bsnams/ /zhes bshad cing / mon pa bzhi la/ yum rnams lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /zhes bshad/ ras bris khungs btsun pa kha cig tu/ myos byed 'bar ba dang ar+ya ma ru'i yum thod pa 'dzin pa'ang yod la/ yang las byang du/ phyi nang gsang ba'i gshed kyi lha/ /yum rnams spu gri mi snying bsnams/ /zhes yum bcu gnyis po thams cad spu gri mi snying 'dzin par bshad pa'ang snang bas mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /gzhal yas khang gi zur bzhi'i zur re rer lcags mkhar gsum gsum rgyab mdun gyi tshul du gnas pa'i bcu gnyis po rnams la 'chi bdag bcu gnyis gsal 'debs shing / de rnams kyi sku mdog las byang dang mngon rtogs gnyis cung zad mi mthun zhing mngon rtogs su smad dug (45na)phur du bshad do/ /'dir sku mdog rnams las byang ltar bkod cing / phyag mtshan mngon rtogs su mi gsal yang / las byang du/ be con 'khor lo phyag na bsnams/ /zla ba bcu gnyis lha ru gsal/ /zhes pas so/ /de'i phyi rol du/ las byang las/ khyams la gshin rje sum cu gnyis/ /zhes pas deng sang phyag len du khyams kyi phyogs re rer lha gnas gru gsum brgyad re bkod pa'i shar du bdud po brgyad/ lhor gshin rje brgyad/ nub tu ma ma brgyad/ byang du gnod sbyin brgyad rnams gsal 'debs pa yin cing / 'di rnams kyang mngon rtogs su smad lcags phur du bshad la/'dir so so'i bzhen pa dang phyag mtshan rnams las byang ltar bkod pa yin no/ /sgo ba bzhi ni/ mngon —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nartogs su/ g.yas kyi phyag na khram shing bsnams/ /g.yon du las kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /zhes pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /las byang du/ phyag na 'khor lo thun khrag bsnams/ /zhes pa'ang yod do/ /yum bzhi ni/rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi phyag len gyi rgyun las byung ba'i tsaka li ras bris rnams su med pas 'dir 'don cha la dngos su ma bkod cing / blo dang ldan pas sgom don la sbyar na/ mdzo rtogs las/dus ba srid pa'i rgyal mo ni/ /sgo yi g.yon logs bzhi na gnas/ /yum chen mkha' 'gro ro langasabazhi/ /phyag g.yas ma tram ro dbyug bsnams/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu g.yon/ /sgo bzhi 'byed cing thun sgong g.yon du 'phen/ /dgra bo gar sgrol rgyun du gsod par byed/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol mu khyud skyong ba'i (45ba)pho gshed sum brgya drug cu dang mo gshed sum brgya drug cu sogs las kyi gshin rje dang sde brgyad dregs pa can dur khrod la 'khod pa sogs mtha' yas par bsam mo/ /de skad du'ang las byang las/ phyi rol gshin rje mu khyud 'dzin/ /za ma'i gshed chen bcu drug ni/ /phyag na 'khor lo thun khrag bsnams/ /chibs su mi yi rta la bcibs/ /phyogs skyong sdo brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /ma yams bstan ma dbang phyug gsal/ /zhes dang / bzlog gzhung du/za ma'i gshed chen bcu drug ni/ /pho gshed sum brgya drug cu dang / /mo gshed sum brgya drug stodang / /gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu ni/ /zhes dang / gshin rje phyogs skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /sa chu me rlung sprin dang dur khrod bdag /mkha' la rgyud dang dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhing skyong ging dang laṅga bstan ma'i tshogs/ /'jig rten kun tu khyab par rgyug byed ma/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ zor gyi rtse mor/ zhes sogs kyis zor gzhan rnams gsal 'debs shing / de'ang spu gri dang chu gri sogs shin tu rno ba'i dpal can thogs pa med pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa zor rnams kyi rtse mor 'tshub pa dang / zor gyi rked par mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa'i zor bdag pho mo ma gshin bdud dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa dregs pa can gyi tshogs mi sdug pa'i gzugs can mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs —310

zil gnon phrin la kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanapa mkha' la glog 'byug pa ltar rgyu bar bsam dgos/ khyad par rdo zor lta bu la/ gnod sbyin gdug pa'i bu mo ri rab sogs mtshone cha thogs pa bskyed dgos pas/ 'char ga'i zor bskul du/ stong gsum gangs ris bskor ba nas/ /gnod na gdug (46na tha'i bu mo rnams/ /sdang ba'i dgra la rdo zor rgyob/ /ces so/ /spyir zor thams cad shin tu che bar gsal 'debs dgos shing / kong zor ni dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab dang mnyam par khro chu'i zor bskyed kyi skabs bshad do/ /zor 'phen pa'i dus/ zor gzhu'i yar mchog la 'brug sgra drag po ldir ri ri sgrog cing / mar mchog nas glog dmar kem kem 'khyug pa/ 'chang bzung nas thog mda' ser ba ltar shar ra ra 'bab par yang gsal 'debs pa yin no/ /gsum pa la/ spyir thun rdzas nus ldan du bya ba'i tshul dang / dmigs bsal kong zor gyi nang du sdugs rgyu'i thun rdzas nus ldan du gsal 'debs tshulu gnyis snang ba g.yin las shes par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa ye shes kyi lha tsho gos spyan 'dren pa ni/ 'gyur med chos sku'i ngang las zhes sogs brjod cing / ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams rnal 'byor pa'i mos pa dang gdung shugs drag pos thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te thogs pa med par mdun bskyed te lha tshogs rnams la thim par bsam zhing / 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje gdug pa can gyi dmag tshogs dang /zor bdag pho mo sogs rang dbang med par skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du spyan drangs par bsam mo/ /lnga pa dmar gtor rak+ta phul zhing drag tu bskul ba ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas la/ /zhes sogs brjod cing / dmar gtor gnyis dang rak+ta ra bcas pa sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po/ ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te phul bas lha tshogs thams cad dgyes shing tshim par mos nas/ gtor mas khar khrag (46ba)gi a lha sbreng zhing / 'gyur khugs kyi dbyangs dang bcas pas dzornga brdung / sha chen gyi gsur btang zhing bzhug pa bya/ dbus kyi gtso bo nas bzung lha grangs tshang bar drag tu bskul lo/ /de skad du'ang ya ma rā dza sku khros pa'i rgyud las/ dzornga brdung zhing gzhin rje 'bod/ /—311—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)tshil chen me dang gsur dud btang / khur ba bus la bshug glu blang / rak+ta dmar gyi a dang / smug chen smug chung snying la 'bod/ khes so/ /gsar ma'i gshin rje bdag rak+tas gzhi dang lam sogs gang bder 'bo zhing / a lha skad chen pos bsgrag pa yod par grags la/ lugs 'di la ni ye med do/ /bskul tshig 'dir cho ga zor yang ba'i dbang du byas te/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i zhes sogs bya zhing / rgyas par spro na dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes ltar mchod bstod gsal ba'i sgron me yongs rdzogs su bya'o/ /drug pa lha so sor gtor ma 'bul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ dmar gyi gtor ma lha grangs dang mnyam pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag nang khrol dbang po sogs su byin gyis brlabs te so sor 'bul zhing / bsdus par byed na/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas la/ zhes sogasakyis mi mthun pa'i rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang / dgra bo rang gshed dbab pa sogs bzlog bsad kyi 'phrin las bcol lo/ /sngar gyi steng du rgyas par byed na lcags sdig bzlog gzhung ltar/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /zhes sogs bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'di ni rig sngags 'chang ba bi shwa rkarma'i ting 'dzin sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/ /gang la thogs med nus ldan lhun gyis rab grub gnam lcags 'bar ba'i (47na ji yi dag las/ tshangs pa'i tshe yang skad cig thal bar byed pa zor gyi thog mda' lha'i mtshon cha/ /rnam par grub pa tsam gyis dgra sde lha min tshogs bcas snying khrag sa la lhung / /zhes so/ /bdun pa bsgral zhing stob pa la/ gser skyemasa'abul ba/ gdul bya 'gugs pa/ skyob pa'i srung ma dang dbye ba/ bsgral las bya ba dngos/ zhal stob bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /zhes sogs kyis phul/ gnyis pa la/'brub khung dang nya bo bskyed pa/ bden stobs brjod de tshe srog 'gugs pa/ bden pa bdar zhing gzu dpang gsol ba/ pho nya brgyad bskul te slar yang bla tsher 'gugs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing nag ces sogs brjod do/ /de'ang ngo bo dug gsum las kyi mthulas grub pa'i btson khang dmar nag kha dog cing / mthil yangs pa/ gting zab pa/ zin nas thar ba med pa'i srid pa las—312

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanakyi gzhal yas khang / srog gcod kyi grong khyer chen po/ nang du bskal pa stong gi mun pa 'khrigs shing /phyi nas bskal pa stong gi me 'bar ba/ rlung nag 'tshub cing shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i nang du bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang / rnal 'byor pa'i sgos dgra gang yin pa de'i rnam par shes pa : dud ka yongs su gyur pa las gsal 'debs shing / byad dbyibs nyam chung zhing skyid pa phra ba/ skra gzings pa/ bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid nyams pa/ ngal zhing dub pa/ kha nas sid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ skyob byed kyi lha srung rnams gshed du gyur pa/ rang bdud rang la langs te rang srog gcod par 'gyur ba mngon (47ba)sum du yod pa lta bur bsam mo/ /dug sdong nag po'i bzlog bsad gnam lcags 'bar ba las/ de'i 'og tu zhing chen gyi sa gzhi brdal ba/ mtshon cha sna tsho gos gzings te bdug pa/ drag po'i tsha tsha chil li li khol ba/ de'i 'og tu rak+ta'i rba rlabs zhakhrug cing zhing chen gyi rba nyil nyil 'phyo ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i rlung dmar nag 'ur ru ru 'bar ba/ de'i 'og gi bskal pa'i rlung spu gri so rgal chil li li zhabrug pa/de'i 'og tu drag po chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dgra bo thams cad gtan nas rlag par byed pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/zhes pa ni sgom don dang ngag 'don gang rigs su bya ba legs shing / 'brub khung dug dang zangs lcagasakhro chu las grub pa dang / bang rim dgu ldan du bshad pa don la khyad par med par sems so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i khro bo dang / thugs ka'i 'od zer rgyas rgyud bskul ba'i las kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs 'jig rten dregs pa can dpag tu med pa stong gsum khyab par spros pas dgra bo'i tshe srog rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa lcags kyus snying ga nas bzung / zhags pas nas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams/ dril bus myos par byas/ las kyi pho nya rnams drag po skad kyi nga ro 'brug sgra ltar ldir zhing / gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu'i shugs kyi bye'u khras ded pa'am/ btson khrid pa bzhin du rang dbang med par bkug ste liṅga la thim pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/na mo ba dang brgyud par bcas pa/ zhes sogs brjod cing / dgug bcing (48na)sdom myos dbye —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nabastim gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum mam bdun/ nyer gcig sogs skabs dang sbyar ro/ kha thun du/ nam phyed dgra bo mi nyal bla nyal gyi dus su srung ma rnams kyis kho'i rnam par shes pa dgug pa ni glang gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng ngam/ rnga mo lta bu'i steng du bskyon la 'ur ru ru bkug nas dngos su sgrub khang du khugs par bsams la kho rang gi liṅga la bstim mo/ /zhes bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ gser skyems byin gyis brlabs te/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs nas bzung /'jig rten dregs pa'i bar rnams la 'bul zhing / dngos grub rtsab rdo rje slob dpon dang / /zhes sogasabarjod do/ /'on kyang ding sang phyag len la gong du gser skyems dang / 'dir bdag nyid sangs rgyas bstan la rab bzhugs shing / /zhes sogs kyis gzu dpang byed pa yin no/ /'dis dpang gzugs dang gser skyems gnyis rka'i go chod kyang / phyag len du so sor mdzad/ dbang po'i sde'i phyag len du'ang / ma nyes dpang du dkon cog bde gshegs bzhugs/ /zhes sogs kyi gzu dpang dang gser skyems logs su mdzad do/ /'on kyang spros te so sor byed na/ gzu dpang nyes byas drag bskul srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba'i tshig don phun sum tsho gos pa snang ba'ang bya'o/ /de ltar dgra bos nyes pa byas pa'i tshogs rnams bsgrags pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad dgra bo gsod pa'i ched du ches cher rngam par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ pho nya gdug pa can rnams spras pas dgra bo'i bla tshe gar brdo zhing / gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par bkug pa'i dmigs pa dang (48ba)bcas pas/ bla 'gugs sprul pa sogs brjod cing / mtshan ma brtan po ma byung gi bar du sngags rnams bzla'o/ /gnyis pa skyob pa'i srung ma dang dbye ba ni/ bdag dang las gshin rnams kyi thugs ka nas khro bo grangs med pa spros pas/ kho'i lha srung bya spu rlung gis gtore ba bzhin bskrad par bsams la nya bo'i mthar gu gul gyi dud pa btang zhing / las kyi gshin rje'i gshed po thams cad dang / /zhes sogasabarjod do/ /—314

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)gsum pa bsgral las bya ba dngos la/ thun brdeg pa dang / phur pa gdab pa/ ral gris ga khu ba pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje'i thog lta bu'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i thun rdzas rno ba'i dbal can btab pas gzi brjid bkrag mdangs dbang po tshe srog thams cad nyams shing bcoms par bsams la mtshe yungs rdo lcags la sogs drag po'i rdzas/ /zhes sogs dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i thun sngags nyin mtshan dang sbyar te brdeg go /gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid zil gnon gsal ba'i zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing /bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas ya ma rā dza las mar me gcig las gnyis chad ltar byung ba'i phur pa ya ma rā dza lta ba man chad zur gsum rno ba'i dpal dang ldan pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab pas/ kho'i tshe srog mar me lta bu nag thum ste bsad cing rnam par shes pa bkrag mdangs yi ge'i rnam par yod pa phur rtse la blangs te thugs ga'i yi ge la bsdu ba sogs tshe lung dang gnas lung gi dgongs pa tshig chod du 'grub pa'i gdams pa rnams bya'o/ /las byang kun bzang mchod sprin pa dag /phur pa dbu gsum phyag drug rdor gshog can smad phur (49na)pa'i dpal ldan du bshad pa ni lugs 'di'i gnad la nges pa ma rnyed pa'i gzhan dag nas kha bskang ba'i 'gal dum gyi phreng ba las rgyu mtshan med cing / thog mar nya bo la phur ba btab nas/ de rjes yungs thun mda' thun sogs thun rdzas rnams brdeg pa ni/phur pa btab ste dgra bo bsgral zin pa la slar thun rdzas brdeb pa rol mtshon cha 'debs pa dang khyad par med cing / yang thun rnams kyi mjug tu phur bu btab ste rnam shes sbar ba sogs 'dug pa/ phur pa snga ma rnam shes rjes 'dzin gyi phur pa zhes rdo rje ga 'ozhe nu las bshad pa ltar yin ma mi son 'ang / lugs 'di la gsal kha mang pas phur pa snga rting gnyis su btab pa tshig tshogs che ba las gzhan pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa ma mthong ngo / /gzhan yang gsar ma'i gshin rje ba dag snum khol mar chang blug pas 'bar ba'i mes liṅga sgrol ba'i lag len sogs ni bgegs bsreg pa la sbyin sreg gi skabs hom sbar ba la brten pa yin 'dra na'ang / dgra bgegs kyi dbye ba ma phyed pa'i bod 'dir ba 'ad gad du —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2na'agyur ba'i lag len mang du dar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ ya ma'i thugs rka'i phyag rdor las byung ba'i ral gri ngo bo phyag rdor du gsal bas liṅga rnams btub cing / sras mchoge thugs nas dregs pa'i bdag po ni/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcasapa brjod/ /bzhi pa stob pa bya ba ni/ stong gsum khengs pa'i skur bzhengs sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing / ling ro sman raka gis sbran cing thod par bsdus pa sha khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs las byed dang bcas (49ba)pas dgyes pa'i rkan sgra dang bcas chem chem gsol bar bsam mo/ /brgyad pa bzlog bsgyur bya ba ni/ gtor ma'i khar dmar sbreng zhing / rab 'jigs gshin rje gshed kyi zhes sogs brjod pa tsam gyis cho go la/ rgyas par spro na sngar gyi steng du/ lcags sdig bzlog gzhung du/ da ni bzlog pa dus la bab/ /da ni bsgyur ba'i dus la bab/ /ces so bzlog gzhung rgyas pa bya'o/ /dgu pa zor lam dbye ba ni/ las byang 'dir yang gtor zor rnams phyir spags te gral du bkod/ rol mo drag tu brdung zhing 'di skad do/ /zhes zor rnams phyir bteg grub nas zor lam dbye ba lta bu zhig byung ba ni/ sgrub pa zhag sbrel du byas pa'i zor 'phen pa'i nyin yang zor lam dbye ba'i tshig brjod pa'i dbang du yin gyi/ zor lam dbye ba dngos gzhi ni/ zor rnams la bskul bskyod sogs ma byas pa'i sngon rol du mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar zar lam dbye dgos so/ /sngags rnying ma'i lugasa'adzin mang po zhig dang / kun bzang mchod sprin pas/ gtor ma spags te sgo dbye byed par bshad pa ni/lha srin la phog thug dang nyes skyon gyi nus pa gang la brten nas byung ma rtogs pa'i skyon no/ /rang lugs kyi zor lam dbye tshul 'di ni lugs 'di la med du mi rung ba'i gdams pa dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes yin no/ /'ga' zhig ni/ yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'gro ba la sgo dbye sogs bya mi dgos zhes rgyu mtshan ma go ba'i gtam bab bcol du smra ba la blun bo dag rjes su 'jug srid de/ dpyod ldan su zhig tho che'i spyod pa la 'jug par ga la byed/ de'i phyir lag len la mtha' rgya chod pa ni gnad dam pa yin no/ /—316

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(khanabacu pa zor 'phang ba la/ gser (50na) skyems 'bul ba/ zor g.yin rnams 'phang ba/ rwa zor dang gtor zor 'phang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bde gshegs zhi khro mthu ldan srung ma'i tsho gos spyi dang / khyad par gshin rje'i dmag tshogs gnam sa g.yo ba tsam dang bcas te/ dgra bo'i mngon spyod kyi las byed par bsam zhing / gza' dang bstun te sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu sngar bzhin gser skyems phul/ bden pa bdar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dug chen shing la lug pa'i zhes sogs zor bskul rnams rim par brjod cing dmigs pa dang bcas pas zor sngags bzla zhing phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su 'phang / zor g.yin rnams kyi sngags rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'char ka nas kha 'geng ba phyag len no/ / gsum pa ni/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol gom pa zhe dgu'i sar bgrod nas bskul dang bcas pas rwa zor dang gtor zor 'phang ba sngar bzhin no/ /de'ang rwa zor la brtag pa bya ste/ rus sbal snying gzer nag po'i rgyud las/ thor kha'i bra yang 'di lta ste/ /ru rtse kha sha phar bltas nas/ /phyir mi ldog dang pho rab gsum/ kha bzang pho mo rab gnyis te/ /rtse bzang mo gnyis phyis pa byed/ /ces bshad cing / de'ang zor gyi brtag tshul gtsug phud nag po'i zhu lan du gsal ba ltar zhib par bya'o/ /de ltar bzlog pa gtso bor byas te zor dkyus ma'i dbang du btang ba yin la/ bsad pa dang zor 'chams sogs spros par byed na zor rnams nya bor brdeg pa sogs go rim lag len ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/ mi mthun nag po bdud kyi ru mtshon rnams/ /cig car bstol ba'i rgyal rnga dbyar dus kyi/ /'brug sgra drag po'i skad ltar bsgrags pa na/ /dkar phyogs lha yi ba dan rnam (50ba)par rkyong / /shugs drag rlung gis bskyod pa'i ser ba dang / /gnam lcags thog gis lo tog brag ri rnams/ /nye bar 'joms na 'di lta'i las sbyor gyis/ /dgra srog lcags las byas kyang ji ltar 'tsho/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ srung 'khor bya ba/ dam sri gnon pa/ chad mtho bsgrag pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub khang gi sgo drung ngam/ gtor zor 'phang ba'i sa yul de ga gang bder me chu'i rgyas 'debs shing / bdag nyid khro rgyal/ zhes sogs dang / srung sngags brjod cing —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dmigs pa dang bcas pas sru lung 'khor bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtor gzhong ri rab tu gsal ba kha sbub pa'i 'og tu dam sri rnams chud par bsams la/ stong gsum 'jig rten yangs pa'i zhes sogasabarjod do/ /gsum pa ni/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa nam mkhar bteg ste/ bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong sngon rol du/ /zhes sogs tshang ma bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag mdun lhan cig tu bya'am/ rdo rje slob dpon tsam gyis byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar zor gyi khog phubs pa'i phyir brjod pa yin gyi/ tshul bzhin lag tu len par 'dod na/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin thams cad la man ngag zab gnad mtha' yas pas/ de dag ma rtogs par nyams su len pa ni rang g.yin phung pa'i rgyu yin pas/ snying nas mos pa'i skal ldan rnams/ gang byung gi bla ma dang su byung gi gdams pas ma tsham par/ chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i zhal gdams khong du chud pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yun du bsten cig /(51na)gong gi sa bcad bzhi pa bstan ma bskyang ba ni/ rin cen sgron mer/ gtor ma rnams phyi rol nam mkha' mthong ba'i gnas su bteg la/ bstan ma mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'dod pa spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ zor gyi skabs chad mtho dang bstan skyong gi gtor ma snod gcig tu mdzad pa dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes yin cing / sngon tshe slob dpon spyan sngar zhes sogasabarjod do/ /lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdub ni/ nang du dkyil 'khor gsal btab la/ khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon sogs kyis mchod/ rin cen sgron mer/ bstod pa dang bshags pa byed par bshad pa'ang spro na bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i lha dang rgyan gyi lha brgyad rnams/ /zhes sogs brjod de/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du cung zhig mnyam par bzhag /de'i ngang las skad cig gis:la gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang bcasapa la lhun grub tu bsams la sku'i sngags bzlas shing lus bsrung ngo / /lnga pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum ces sogs kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rgyal ba'i sar bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bo/ /drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas zhes’ 318

zil gnon phrin las kyi rnam nges rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ nang ma(kha)sogs kyis me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra sgrog /phun sum tsho gos pa'i dga' ston gyi dpal la rol lo/ /las byang rnam par nges gnyis snod ldan dang / /rigs 'dzin bdag gis bka' rgya khrol ma gtogs/ /gzhan la bab col rgyu nor ngo dga'i phyir/ /bstan na ston pa po dang ston yul gnyis/ /gter bsrung mthu chen sdebazhi rā hu las/ /snying khrag 'thung la tshar cho de zla ba chos (51ba 'di/ /gnyer du gtad do nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /ma g.yel srungs shig gu ༅ sam ya/ /de ltar zil gnon phyag rgya'i lam zab mo 'di nyid lhod pa med par nyams su blangs pas/ 'jam dbyangs bla med kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /'dir smras pa/ khungs ldan rgyud gsum rnam dag theg pa mchog /ma nyams phyag rgyar btab pa gsang ba'i gter/ /skal bzang 'dod pa 'jo ba bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa yid bzhin nor/ /tshad ldan drag sngags spyi yi sdom tshig dang / khyad chos rna cha brgyad sogs bsdebs pa'i gnad/ /rno ngar thogs rdugs med pa'i 'khor lo che/ /rigs 'dzin dam pa'i lam srol bla na med/ / 'di 'dra mig dang rna bar ma gyur pa'i/ /tshe bdag ring lugs 'dzin pa'i khur 'chang ba/ /smig rgyu chu ru rlom yang skoms pa'i nad/ /sel ba'i nus pa mi 'byung rang nyid ngal/ /kye ma gsar rnying gdams pa gcig tu bsre/ /gshed skor ma mgon phan tshun dpe ru len/ /gang dran lag tu blangs la snyan brgyud ces/ kha phor byed pa'i gsar rnying sngags 'chang mang / /tsū ta'i yul du rkang gnyis ldan pa'i mi/ /tshad ldan min zhes 'phya ltar rang gzhan gyi/ /gdams pa'i phyogs tsam rna bas ma thos 'gas/ /tshul ldan ba nyen sgrub las sbyor byed la smod/ /kun shes gcig la rdugs pa'i mkhas pa dang / /lha bus byin gyis brlabs pa'i las dbang can/ /mthu nus rigs rus tsam la re ba yi/ /dregs ldan mang yang 'dun pa'i 'gram chu med/ kha bshad kho nas 'tsho ba'i rigs lam pa/ /gti mug zas su za ba'i (52na)sgom chen dang / /ngan sems kho na lhur len rig sngags 'chang / /rgyu mtshan bsnyad pa'i yul min zur du bzhugs/ /de ltar dus 'di'i snang tshul ches ngan yang / /zab mo'i gdams pa 'di la gdengs thob pa/ /kun bzang —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma rje'i/ /bka' drin dran no slar yang thugs rjes skyongs/ /rgyud don man ngag 'grel pa'i don rnams las/ /snying po'i zab don dam pa'i phyag bzhes ltar/ /'phrin las rnam par nges phyir gsal ba 'dis/ /'gro kun theg mchog rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /ces 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi 'phrin las kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i rnam par nges pa rigs 'dzin 'chi med dga' ston bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di'ang / gter ston chen po gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi gdung dri ma med pa las son pa'i rigs 'dzin skyon bstan 'dzin gyis nye bar bskul pa la brten nas/ rtse ston chen pos mdzad pa'i rnam nges la gzhi byas/ rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi gsung rgyun la brten/ rang blos gang spobs kyis brgyan te/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dngos slob dharma pha la nas bzung ste/ ma gshin phur gsum gyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rig sngags long gi brgyud du byung ba zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rjes/ rang lo nyer drug pa dbyu gu zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi khrag 'thung rnam par rol pa'i dus kyi tshes la sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //—320

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khana'ajam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa zhes bya ba bkunas/na mo gu ru : mnyu shā yuḥb ta ye/ phun tshogs chos dbyings nor 'dzin sto bar mi sdug sgeg pa'i nyams kyi chu gter las/ khro chags snying rje'i shugs drag dri bzhen las 'ongs rab brjid nga ro'i rba rlabs zhabrug /mngon spyod ha la'i phrin las na kra'i tsho gos rgyu mchog thun dngos grub yid bzhin nor/ /ma lus stsol pa'i byed po srog dbugs bla tshe'i gshed por rnam rol de la bdud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum yon tan kun/ /gcig bsdus rgyal dbang pad+mā ka ra'i zhabs/ /brgya phrag thabs kyis nges gsang rgyud sde 'di/ /legs par bsgyur mdzad gnubs ban lo tsā ba/ /slar yang zab mo'i gter kha spel ba'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i gar mdzad dum pa zhang khrom dang / /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'khon ston 'gro ba'i mgon/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la snying nas 'dud/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i phul byung bdud tsi las/ /ma nyams rigs 'dzin phyag bzhes zil mngar bcud/ /sngags 'chang 'chi med tshogs kyi dga' ston du/ /'khrul med glegs bu'i ka lā sha 'di 'geng / /de'ang / phyag (2na)rgya chen po thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir la mar med bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gtso bo ni thog mar smin byed kyi sgo dam pa dbang yin la/ smin byed kyi dbang ma thob par gya tshom du gsang sngags kyi lam la thos bsam gyis 'jug pa ni dngos grub mi thob par ma zad/ sdug bsngal mi bzad pa myong dgos pas/des na/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa/ lha dang mkha' 'gro brdas brgyud pa/ rigs 'dzin rigs pas brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa/ las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa sogs brgyud pa zam ma chad —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pas phyag len gyi srol ma nyams shing / byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba'i rdo rje slob dpon/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams la legs par sbyangs pa'i goms pa dang ldan pa/ de kho na nyid kyi don rtogs shing zab mo'i lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa sogs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa zhig la brten dgos te/ ji skad du/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes (2ba〉gnyen gyis/ goms pa sngon sbyangs mang thos chos rnams shes/ /chos nyid mnyam pa'i don rtogs gti mug med/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med gzung ma 'du/ /bla ma'i man ngag thob pa'i gdengs ldan pa/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma dam pa bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa ni mchog yin zhing / de ltar min na'ang bsnyen pa rdzogs shing lha'i gnang ba thob pa ni shin tu gal che ste/ slob dpon bha su dha ra'i dbang gzhung las/ lha yi gnang ba thob pa yis/ /de yis bdag gzhan don rnams 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /slob ma'ang dad pa dang brtson 'grus che zhing / shes rab kyi rtsal kha dang ldan pa/ dam tshig la gnas shing lam 'di la brten nas mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa zhig dgos te/ dad dang brtson 'grus me ltar 'bar ba dang / khres rab che zhing phyogs med slob pa dang / /dad pa che zhing gzungs thob blo brtan pa/ /dam tshig gtsor 'dzin sgom sran che ba dang / /rang rig blo ldan chos nyid don rtogs dang / /go 'phang thob dang man ngag 'dod pa la/ /gsang ba'i don 'jug lung 'dis dbang bskur bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bskur bya'i dbang yang bgrod pa rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug dgos te/ ji skang du dbang po'i sdes/ bde chen ye shes sku dang mchog gi baṃ/ /mtshan ldan gzung ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rab 'byams bgrod pa rnam gsum la brten nas/ /bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba'i las kyi rim par (3na)bstan par bya ba 'di la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba/ gzhung gi las rim rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po la yo byad bsham zhing gtor ma gtang ba/ thig tshon rab tu gnas shing chag chag gdab pa/ dkyil 'khor 'dri zhing rdzas 'god pa slob ma sta gon bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /sa bcad gong ma gsum ni —322—

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanase ston chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang gi cho ga nges pa'i don bde blag tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin 'chugs med du bya dgos la/ de'ang dkyil 'khor 'dri ba 'chugs med kyi phyag len dang ldan pa'i ras bris byin rlabs can yod kyang rung la/ yo byad bsham pa/ bum pa bkod cing bsgrub pa/ sgrub rdzas bkod pa/ mchod rdzas bkod pa sogs sla chos su ma song ba'i nges don bde 'jug nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bya ba ni phyag len yin no/ /bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma rnams phyi rol du khrus byas/ de nas bgegs sbyangs la/ gtor ma changs bu ting lo dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs te/ ā+oṃ sarba bigha na/ na ma smarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe saḥsarba ta/ ud+ma te snya ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ grihā bi lo ta ye swāhā/ zhes tshar re dang / gtor ma re slob ma la phyir bskor te btang / de nas changasabu ting lo dang sbrags pa cha re slob ma la phyir bskor ba dang mnyam du rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/hūṃ/ yang dag lha yi rnal 'byor gzhal yas 'dir/ /'du bar dbang ba'i las ni ma gtogs pa/ /bar chad 'byung po thams cad mi gnas te/ /rang rang gnas su ma thogs myur du dengs/ /phyi ring dang za drag tu brjod cing yungs kar gtor (3ba〉kyi gul gyis bdug /rol mo drag tu bya zhing bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas slob ma rnams phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ de'ang bam chen gsang ba'i dbang gi cho ga las/spro ba bskyed dang gnang ba byin/ /sdom pa 'bogs shing srung skud gdags/ khyor chu blud dang so shing dor/ /ku sha byin dang gzengs bstod de/ /rmi lam brtag dang sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes pa ltar bcu las/ spro ba bskyed pa ni/ gsang sngags spyi rgyud las/ sngags kyi dngos grub 'dod pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pa de las gzhan/ /'jig rten 'di yi bsam pa spang / /slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya/ /bdag don 'di 'bras gnyer mi bya/ /bdag don tshe 'di'i ched byed na/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas gang las byung / /g.yin don rtse gcig tu dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces pa'i don shad/—323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gnyis pa slob mas gsol ba gdab par gnang ba byin pa ni/ mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /gsang 'dzin ci nas bdag 'gyur phyir/ /nges par 'byung gi bar du ni/ /bdag gi bsam pa brtan pos bzung / /nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang / /mi shes ma lus spang ba'i phyir/ /bsam pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du/ /bdag cag rnams la bstan par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla mas gnang ba byin pa ni/ yang dag sangs rgyas lam rig pa/ /nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas/ /(4na)nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa/ /bu 'dir shog cig bde ba'i sa/ /theg chen rim pas 'gro ba dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bzung / /rdzogs pa'i ye shes bde chen gyi/ /dmigs pa med par gnas phyir du/ /stong zhing rang sems rtag par bzung / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dbang rdzogs byin/ /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun/ /'khor rgyud lam gyi sgo bcad nas/ /mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phye ste/ /ma yengs gnas su gtang bar bya/ /zhes brjod/gsum pa sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes su smon/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi sras su mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum dang / gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /bla med gnas su sgrub pa dang / /bde gshegs dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog du sems bskyed do/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/bzhi pa srung skud gdags pa ni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i srung skud kha dog sngon po mdud pa nyer gcig byas pa dpung par bcings te/ bu khyod tshur nyon skal ldan dngos grub bsgrub/ /de la bgegs kyi bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ khro rgyal sngags bzlas mdud pa nyer gcig bya/ /srung skud dpung par gdags pas bgegs srungs shig /ā+oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ (4bzhes brjod cing rdo rje dang dri chus rgyas gdab bo/ /spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la skyi ring gis —324

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(kha)bar chad bsrung ngo / /lnga pa khyor chu blud pa ni/ ā+oṃ — spo ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sarba sho dha na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod de byin la/ hūṃ/ sngags bzlas bdud rtsi'i chu 'di yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs/ /bar chad thams cad dag gyur te/ /zab mo'i snod du rung bar shog /ces brjod do/ /drug pa so shing ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing nyes skyon dang bral ba sor bcu gnyis pa mgo bo rgya mdud kyi dbyibs can rtse mor me tog bcings pa/ /badz+ra dzi lha /bha ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te byin la/ ho/ bla mas bsgo ba ji bzhin so shing dor/ /'jam dpal zhi khro'i sku gsung thugs mchogo gi /ye shes dposagrub dam pa thob bya'i phyir/ /dbus ma chag dga' ldan gnas su lhung bar shog zhes dbus su dor bsaphyogs bzhi dang 'og tu 'phrin las bzhi dang sa 'og rigs 'dzin gyi dngos grub/ steng du mchog thob/bdun pa ku sha ni/ ā+oṃ e ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te byin la/ hūṃ/ bu tshur nyon zab mo bsgrub pa yang / /dngos grub ma 'grub bar du rtags mi 'byung / /'jug pa'i rmis ltas bzang ngan brtag pa'i phyir/ /ku sha'i rtswa mchog khyod kyi sngas su bting / /zhes brjod do/ /brgyad pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /u rdu wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ba/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul mchog 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba sa /sdig pa'i las (ldan)kun byas pa yang / /de kun gyis ni dkyil 'khor ni/ /mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas na/ /grags pa mtha' yasasngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba sa /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags kyang / /'di ni mthong bar shin tu dka'/ /bla med 'di la dga' bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ yang na/ sangs rgyas bstan pa med byung bsam yas la: khyad par 'phags pa'i bstan pa rnam gsum byung : sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa byon:ces sogs brjod de/ mun bskal la bltos te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'byung ba dkon/ bstan pa —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)grangs med byon pa'i nang nas kyang shākya thub pa sogs gsum la gsang sngags kyi bstan pa byon/ g.yin rnams la ma byon pas rdo rje'i theg pa rnyed dka' zhing don che ba sogs kyis gzengs bstod do/ /dgu pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ lha dang bla ma yang la bgyi/ /rmi lam snang ba ci byung yang / /nang par ma gsang smra bar bgyi/ /bzang na shin nyul gsag na/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /bcu pa sbyin sres/ ni/rmi lam ngan pa byung na brtsam par bya'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las kyi rim pa la/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po la/ las byang 'dzab la thug par gzhung bsrang / skabs der baṃ las bum gyi chus bsang zhing sbyangs te/ baṃ gyi tsit+ta gru gsum/ zhes pa nas/ mtshan ma bzang po rnyed kyi bar du bya'o/ /zhes (5ba)pa'i bar nges don bde 'jug las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin rtags dang yun ring thung sogs skabs dang sbyar ro/ /dbang chos 'di'i lugs kyi bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor chig chod du bsgrub pa yin la/ de tsam blos mi lcogs pa 'dzab khang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dbye ba'i gnad shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba dngos gnyis/dang po la slob dpon 'jug pa dang / slob ma 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos 'di'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa nyid kyi nges pa'i don rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yin pas logs su byed mi dgos kyang / blo chung las dang po bas byed par spro na/ maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa nas bzung ste/dbang bzhi mtha' brten dang bcas pa sngags tsam mam/ tshig mdor bsdus pa ting 'dzin gsal bas blangs par 'gal ba med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar slob dpon gyis gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du dmigs la/ hūṃ/ lhun grub rang bzhin gnas pa'i pho brang nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed kyi lha/ /ma lus mnyam pa'i rgyal —326

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanapo dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma mtshan ldan yum gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /brtul zhugs drag po'i stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol/ /bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang dam pa sa /rig pa brtul zhugs stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod de me tog dor bas/ slob ma la ci dgar dbang bskur zhig ces (6na skonang ba thob par bsam mo/ /de nas nges don bde 'jug las/ khrus sogs bya zhing gsol ba gdab/ /rgyun bshags sems bskyed gnas gsum brlab/ /slar yang gsol gdab gnas su drangs/ /dri dang chu blud dam bsgrags shing / /sgrib sbyangs lha dbab me tog dor/ /mig dbye dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar bcu gcig las/ dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ nang du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ho/ bstan pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /dregs pa stobs kyi tshul bstan pa/ /'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas/ /dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po bdag la stsol/ /gsang ba'i sgron me bdag la stsol/ /ye shes rol pa bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/gnyis pa rgyun bshags sems bskyed ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa'i bar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin dang
