/ ā+oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta āḥ gsum/ ku pa ta ya mi zhes brjod/ gsum pa gnas gsum brlab pa ni/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i thig les slob ma'i gnas gsum du reg cing / ā+oṃ āḥlha zhes byin gyis brlab po/ /bzhi pa slar yang nang 'jug gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ (6btang gsang gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags kyi/ /rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso/ /dpa' bos bdag la bka' drin gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ lnga pa gnas su drang ba ni/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun/ /rgyud lnga lam gyi sgo bcad de/ /mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phye nas/ /bla med gnas su drang bar bya'o/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes yol ba'i nang du drangs la sgom don slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i rtsar —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sleb par mos la/ ā+o ba dza sa ku bhan+dha wa ra nas/ mig dar bkab/ a kho wi ra hūṃ/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba byin no/ /drug pa dri ba ni/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam/ /grub mchog brtul zhugs spyod nus sam/ /mngon spyod las rnams byed nus sam/ /zhes dri/ lan du/rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ khyod kyi bka' stsal bdag rjes bsgrub/ /dam tshig sdom pa gang yin dang / /gsang ba'i las kun bsgrub par 'tshal/ /brtul zhugs chen po bla med pa/ /mthar phyin pa ni spyad par 'tshal/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba rnams/ /ji ltar gsungs pa nyan par 'tshal/ /zhes khas blang ngo / /bdun pa chu blud dam bsgrag ni/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag cing / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /rdo rje dam tshig gnyan po ste/ /tshul bzhin bsrungs na dngos grub thob/ /nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro /rdo rje'i chu 'di khyod kyis long / /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro dha i rda hol k+ṣa sa ma (7na〉 i dam na ra skan/ zhes dang / rdo rje'i rigs kyi bu mchog khyod/ /de ring phyin chad nga yi bu/ /nga yis bsgo ba bya ba dang / /dam tshig la yang gnas par bya/ /zhes brjod/brgyad pa sgrib sbyong ni/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo yid kyis shag gis phye bas gzhal yas khang gi nang na phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung / slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas thog med nas bsags pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang bar bsam mo/ /de bzhin du sgo gzhan gsum du yang bya'o/ /dgu pa lha dbab pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas/ /ye shes khro bo'i sprin chen rnams/ /ma lus bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /zhes slob mas lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa rgyan dang ldan par gyur pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer dpag tu —328

/wa4pa brtse bye1zi sde la gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'cha kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanamed pa 'phros/ bla ma'i thugs gar phog /bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i rnam pa yi ge bzhis mtshan pa dang dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang / drag po e'i gzhal yas khang nas/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs thams cad bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya zil gnon gyi rnam par nam (7ba)mkha' la sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin du byin te/ slob ma'i spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te snying ga'i 'jam dbyangs kyi rang bzhin hūṃ la gnyis su med par thim par gyur par bsgoms la/ gu gul gyi dud pa bya/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas byin 'bebs bde chen chos dbyings ma'am/ rgyas par spro na/ bde gshegs rgyal ba ma rdzogs par byas pa'i mjug tu/ sku gsung thugs sngags kyi mthar tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha yaḥ.a be sha ya dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal a be sha ya zhes dang / phye ring brjod cing rol mo drag tu bya'o/ /rdzogs par slob ma rnams lhod glod la sems kyi ngo bo la cher blta/ de dus nyams dang rtogs pa/ sku 'phar g.yo/ gsung sngags/ thugs bde gsal la sogs pa sngar dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'byung ste/ byang gter dbang byang las/ de ltar drag tu brjod pa yis/ /byin rlabs ye shes phebs pa'i rtags/ /'dar dang 'khrab dang gar byed pa/ /smra ba rgod dang 'od gsal nyams/ /mi rtog ye shes thod rgal gyi/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de brtan pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/bcu pa me tog dor ba ni/ dar sna lnga sor lnga pa gtubs te me tog lnga brgyus pa phreng ba snyim par thogs te/ shar sgo nas 'dun pa drag pos/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bzang ngan med kyang sngon gyi rigs kyi 'brel ba gang yod cig dang mjal bar gyur cig snyam pa'i yid kyis/ 'jam dpal dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /'gro la phan phyir 'jam dpal gyis/ /bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas kyang / /sman par dgongs nas bzhes su (8na) gsol/ /myi ka ya ma pra tismo badz+ra sho: zhes skabs 'dir phyag len la dkyil 'khor la mi dor bar slob dpon gyi sku la me tog bltos med du dor/ gang la babs pa'i rigs ngos bzung la bstan/ rtsa sngags dang pra ti gro hā ma hā ba la ho zhes me tog mgo la —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26) bzhag la lha bstim mo/ / skabs der slob dpon gyi sku la me tog phog na rdo rje ba 'ad pa rtsal lam/ zil gnon drag po rtsal dang / g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu phog na so so'i rigs dang sbyar te gsang mtshan btags so/ /bcu gcig pa mig dbye dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ ho rig pa'i stobs ldan sbyor ba'i gnas/ zhabrul pa'i bag chags sprin lta bu/ /ye shes rig pa'i sgron mar gsal/ /mnyam pa'i stobs kyis brtul zhugs long / /mye ka ya ma tsak+ṣu pra be sha phaṭaḥ ces mig dar bsal la dkyil 'khor ston pa ni/ nges don bde 'jug tu/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor legs par bstan nasagazhal yas khang dang lha'i rnam dag bshad nas/ zhes gsungs pa lta ra/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i phyag len du/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dag pa dang bcas te zhib par mdzad snang ba dang / bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal 'byor lhun grub tshul 'di la nan tan du mdzad pa'i phyir zhib par brjod na/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ris bskor ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad dang bcas pa'i dbus su lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / yum gyi mkha' dbyings mtsho ni pa'i gru gsum mthing nag /thugs (8ba)rje'i rol pa mtshon pa'i thod phreng gi rwa bas bskor ba/ bde ba chen po mtshon pa'i zla gam gsum dang 'i bcas pa phyi rol tu ye shes bzhi mtshon pa'i thod mkhar bzhi/ ye shes bcu drug mtshon pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mtshan dang bcas pa/ skye mched bcu gnyis dag pa'i lcags mkhar bcu gnyis/ chad med bzhi mtshon pa'i gru chad bzhi/ 'phrin las bzhi mtshon pa'i khyams bzhi/ ye shes bzhi mtshon pa'i sgo bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad mtshon pa'i rta babs brgyad/ chos brgyad kyi spros pa dang bral ba'i sna tshogs pa'i rgyan can/ rtse mo mtho ba thig le nyag gcig dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su dregs pa can rnams bde ba chen por sbyor zhing thabs shes chags med mtshon pa'i gdan gyi steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rtsa ba'i lha lnga/ skye med kyi ngang du mya ga las 'das pa'i yum rdo rje khros ma/ ye shes kyi rol pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sprul pa gsum/ nyon mongs bzhi dag pa'i gshed bzhi/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i —330

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanamon bdud brgyad/ skye mched bcu gnyis dag pa'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ bdag tu blta ba dag pa'i sgo ba bzhi'o/ /de ltar phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil gor ni de bas mtshon pa yin gyi/ don dam par rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i ngo bor lhun grub tu gnas pa yin te/ de'i don dbang don ngo sprod pa'i skabs su rim par 'byung ba lags so/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / rang byung ye shes (9na)kyi dbang / rjes dam tshig bstan pa'o/ /dang po la maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ khrus kyi bum pas bkru zhing lhar bskyed pa/ lha bum la shis brjod bsgrags te dbang bskur ba/ yon tan rgyas byed ye shes lnga'i dbang / bum pa'i dbang don ngo sprad pa/ mtha' brten gyi dbang ngo / /dang po ni/na mo dbang chen gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la/ /zhes pa'am/ nor 'dzin lhun po ri phran nyi zla mtsho/ /zhes sogs skabs sbyar gyi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ hoḥ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang / /stong gsum g.yul du 'brub pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dbang bskur gsol/ /'jam dpal gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bsnyen sgrub las la sbyar ba dang / /dkyil 'khor las mtha' bstan pa'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur gsol/ /gshed bzhi sbyor ba'i 'khor lo dang / /ban dgra nag po sgrol ba dang / /'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthu rtsal dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag ni dam tshig 'jam dpal te/ /rin chen dngul gyi bum pa na/ /byang chub sems kyi chu yis bltams/ /nyon mongs bag chags byang gyur cig /ā+oṃ swa bhā wa shu che sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3nya/ zhes bkrus te/lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad dag par bsam pa'i ngang las/ slob ma nyid phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo (9ba)rje dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa rgyan dang ldan par gsal btab/gsum pa ni/ dbang stegs pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'am bsams pa'i steng du/ slob ma dkyil —331

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'a'akhor la mngon par phyogs te 'dug pa'i steng du g.yas su gdugs dkar po/ g.yon du ba dan rgyal mtshan/ phyogs kun tu mchod bas bskor zhing / steng gi nam mkha' la dbang lha gzhal yas khang dang bcas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' gang bas dbang bskur bar mos la //bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bkra shis shog /cho sel phyag 'tshal bkra shis shog /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal bkra shis shog /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing me tog gi char yang phab/ rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bo'i steng du bzhag cing glud gtor bya/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhu zhing thim/ byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur/ hūṃ/ mkha' dbyings bum pa chen po na/ /rigs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bzhugs/ /gnyis med ye shes dbang bskur bas/ khams gsum rigs kyi bdag por gyur/ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang / /srid gsum zil gyis mnan pa dang / /dam can las la 'dzud pa yi/ /dbang mchog dam pa bskur dug so le/ /myi ka ya ma ka pak+ṣa a bhi khiñca hūm̐ : hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi snying po dang / phyi ring gi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi 'a ṣañca badzi bha wa hūṃ/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma dag /phung po lnga gnas bsgyur/ ye (10na)shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rgyal ba rigs rnam pa lngas dbu brgyan pa/ de la sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dbang lha rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchode/ bkra shisakyi me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob bu'i mgo thog tu dbu rgyan bzhag ste/ mgo bo'i gnas lngar dbu rgyan rigs kyi lha khrag 'thung khro bo rigs lnga mngon sum du bzhugs par mos la/ ā+oṃ ma hā shā rgya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha 6 ma hā a ta ri sha dz+nyā na badz+ra su bha wa āt+pa ko3rnya tshwa ma hā sa man+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha: zho ma hā pra ta be sha dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ ā+oṃ ma hā hri ta a gu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha: zhes brjod do/ /—332

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanalnga pa ni/ 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad tshe bdag gi don rtags las mi 'da' ba'i brda don ngo sprad pa yin la/ de yang don brda yis ngo sprod pa/ don rtags rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ dbye ba/ ngo bo/ yon tan lnga las/ 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /dang po kun gyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir ngo bo bshad pa ni/ tshe bdag ngo bo zer ba 'dug /ces tshe bdag gi don brtag cing rnam par bshad pa lnga las/ dang po dbye ba ni/ dbye ba dag la rnam pa lnga/ /rang bzhin lhun grub tshe bdag dang / /ye shes lhun grub zil gnon dang / /phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag dang / /thugs las sprul pa'i tshe bdag dang / /rang rgyud las kyi tshe bdag go /zhes gsungs/ ngo bo ni/ (10ba)tshe bdag ngo bo 'di lta ste/ /thams cad chos sku ngo bo gcig /lhun grub ye shes chen po'i sku/ /sna tshogs snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /rol pa gsum gyi ngang du rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /yon tan ni/ yon tan rin po che lta bu/ /kun 'byung 'phel 'grib med par gnas/ /lhun grub tshe bdag dngas ma lnga/ /rgyu rkyen 'phro 'du'i rtsol dang bral/ /phyag rgya chen por lhun gyis grub/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag ni/ /snang srid ye shes rtogs las 'das/ /rtog can 'phrul pa ru bzlog phyir/ /rin chen gzhal yas lhun grub gnas/ /gdug pa sto 'phye phyogs skyong glang / /stobs kyi gdan lnga de bzhin grub/ /rang bzhin gsal ba'i ngang nyid las/ /ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i sku/ /lhun po ri rab ltar brtan brjid/ /srid gsum sbyor ba zil gyis gnon/ /bdud mo mkha' 'bar gsod byad ma/ /myos byed khrag skyug ma mo'i tshogs/ /ma lus zil gyis gnon cing 'joms/ /gsod byed bka' yi byin rlabs gnod/ /bya khyung klu bdud klu srin gnon/ /seng ges rgyal blon stobs can gnon/ /stag gis gcan gzan gdug pa 'joms/ /zhe sdang gdug pa'i sbrul nag gis/ /sngags dang dmod pa'i rigs bzhi'i glu/ /dug rigs lnga dang dbyig sogs bzhi/ /tsha ba'i nad dbal zil gyis gnon/ /srid pa'i khyams khang rus sbal gyis/ /srog dbugs bkrag mdangs tshe srog 'chang / /rang bzhin chos sku skye med las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul lhun grub skus/ /skye ba las kyi 'khrul pa yis/ /skam chags skye med dbyings su sgrol/ /dwangs ma'i (11na)thig le bcud la sdud/ /snang srid skye —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'gro ma lus kyi/ /tshe srog yi ge gnyis bsdus 'chang / /phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag ni/ /gdan la yab yum bya khyung dregs/ /rgyan gyi sngags dang gab pa'i sngags/ /lus bsrung drag po 'joms pas so/ /sprul pa'i tshe bdag nag po ni/ /zil gnon thugs kyi sprul pa ste/ /dbu dgu las dang yon tan stobs/ /gnad dgu mi nad 'joms bdud yin/ /theg pa dgu yi don ldan la/ /'bras bu rigs lnga ye shes bzhi/ /sprul pa sna tshogs bsam dpag dka'/ /las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni/ /'byung ba gdan bzhi rngam 'og na/ /mi dge bcu yi las dbang las/ /yi dwags rgyal po 'chi bdag sku/ sha za gi dang 'khor dngang sa/ /sngags kyis dbang sdud las kun byed/ /ces so/ /las kyi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /las kyi rnam grangs 'di lta ste/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag bcas/ /lhun grub tshe bdag nag po las/ /rtsa ba gnyis dang yan lag bcu/ khyad par brgya dang bcu drug spyod/ /snying po man ngag rtsa ba gnyis/ /yan lag phra mo nyi shu dgu/ /zil gnon phyag rgya chen po'i las/ /sbyor ba'i rnam grangs brgya phrag gcig /drug cu rtsa gcig byed par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /lam kun gcig tu grol ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /gos bu'i gnasatshul 'di lta ste/ /chos nyid rang bzhin mi 'gyur las/ /rang byung ye shes phyag rgyar shar/ /thams cad snang srid ye shes sku/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /snang stong ma (11ba〉smug gas bde chen no/ /zhes so/ /de dag gi don bkrol la bshad do/ /'di dag cho ga zor yang bar byed na tshig mdor bsdus te don go tsam byas pas chog par sems so/ /mdor na snang stong thams cad lha dang ye shes kyi rnam rol du 'char ba las mi 'da' bar bya'o/ /drug pa la/ sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang / gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa sngags kyi dbang / thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang / yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa longs spyod kyi dbang / 'phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa sbyor sgrol gyi dbang ngo / /dang po ni/ slob ma'i lus thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa sku phyag rgya 'di dbang bskur ba yin te/de yang slob ma rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa'am/ lus mchod rten du —334

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanagasal btab nas de la lha dgod pa la/ 'og min gyi dkyil 'khor nas lha tsho gos rnas ma sum du byon nas gnyis med du thim ste sku'i nus pa brjid dang ldan par bsgom zhing / rtsa ba rgyan gyi lha rnams kyi nga rgyal brtan po 'dzin du gzhug /sprul pa gsum nas sgo ma'i bar gyi lha rnams rang rgyud kyi srog gi gnad dang dam tshig gi dbang gis bran g.yog gi tshul du bka' bsgo ba yang yin no/ /de ltar gtso bo nas ral pa spyi bcings kyi bar dbang chog mu tig phreng ba ltar la/ 'chi bdag bstoganyis sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pas zur brgyan te lha grangs tshang ba'i tsaka li bskur tshig rgyab yig ltar sbrags te bskur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnas gsum gyis (12na)bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi 'phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung ste/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i lam brgyud gnas gsum gyi sa bon la bskor bar bsams la/ dpon slob gnyis ka 'phreng ba gcig la 'jus te sku gsung thugs kyi sngags dang phye ring lan gsum slob dpon gyi rjes su slob mas brjod/de bzhin du sngags tshar gsum gyi bzlas lung byin la/ mthar 'phreng ba'i me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/hūṃ/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di dag ni/ /'khor ba'i 'phro 'du gsal bsgoms te/ khyod kyis rtag tu bzlas par gyis/ /gsang ba gzhan du smra mi bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ga'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas thams cad thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dus/ de dag zil gnon gyi phyag rgya drug tu gyur/ drug po'ang bsam gyis mi khyab par slob bu'i snying gar thim par bsams la/ ho/ 'khor ba 'dal byed 'khor lo dang / nyon mongs gcod pa'i ral gri dang / /chos nyid skye med rdo rje yis/ /sku gsum mnyam pa'i dbang thob shog /phye ka ya ma tsakra kha ṅga badz+ra/ badz+ra a bhi 'a ṣañca hoḥ be con dug lnga zil gyis gnon pa dang / /gdug pa ma lus 'joms byed gtun shing dang / /log rtog rkam chags sgrol ba'i sdigs mdzub kyis/ /reg pa stobs kyi sgo gsum thob par shog /mye ka ya ma bhi ta hu ti sab ra a bhi ṇiñca sngo zhes brjod cing phyag mtshan (12bsgoms snying gar gtug —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)cing lag tu byin/bzhi pa la/ gdug pa zil gyis gnon pa dpa' bo'i chas/ /rnal 'byor bar chad zhi ba rdo rje'i tshe/ /dngos grub myur du thob byed dpa' bo'i rdzas/ /dang po ni/ hoḥ blang chen zhing lpags stag sham sprul/ /thod pa snying 'phreng keng rus rgyan/ /me ri dur khrod dbang bskur bas/ /dregs pa'i mthu stobs ldan par shog /phye ka ya ma ho ti ma hā na ga ka pa li tsit+ta dz+wa la : ti a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ/ zhes brjod de/ rgyan rnams lus la 'god pa'i tshul bya/gnyis pa ni/ bkra shis dngos grub ga'u sa /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe bskyil nas/ /rang rtags tshe yi dbang bskur bas/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i dbang thob shog /my-i ka ya ma ā yur dz+nyā na a bhi ṇiñca hoḥzhes brjod de tshe bum mgo la gtug /gsum pa la/ bdud rtsi/ gtor ma/ rak+ta/ baṃ/ dang po ni/ 'chi med rang byung ra sa yan/ /bkra shis mtshan ldan lhag pa'i rdzas/ /'phel 'grib med pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dbang thob shog /mye ka ya ma sarba pa3 55 skṛ ta dz+nyā na a bhi 'i ṣañca hoḥ zhes brjod de/ bdud rtsi myang zhing lag tu gtad/gnyis pa ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /bcud kyi sems can gtor mar gsal/ /'byung ba rnam lnga gtor ma'i rgyu/ /lhun grub kun 'byung gtor ma'i rgyan/ /'dzin chags med pa'i stobs kyis rol/ /myi ka ya ma ba kla dz+nyā na a bhi ṣañca hoḥ zhes brjod de spyi bor gtug cing cung zad rol/gsum pa ni/ rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyar nas/ /pad+ma rak+ta byang chub sems/ /baṃ chen (13na)rme ba don dang sbyar/ /brtul zhugs rol pas dbang bskur bas/ /mi zad rgyan gyi dbang thob shog /phye ka ya ma gu tho rak+ṣa bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣañca sngo zhes brjod de cung zad myang zhing lag tu gtad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ dpa' brtul sngags kyi byin bskyed pa'i/ /baṃ chen ro la mnyam par rol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang thob nas/ /mi zad rgyan gyi dbang thob shog /mye ka ya ma ma hā paṃ sa a ti ba ta sirnyi a bhi khiñca sngo zhes brjod/ baṃ gyi bsam rgyud ni/ baṃ gyi phyi rgyud kyi lha thams cad tsit+ta'i dkyil 'khor la 'dus/ de yang dngas ma lnga'i —336

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(khanathig le la 'dus/ de slob ma'i snying gar lhub kyis thim par bsam mo/ /de yang baṃ de ye shes lnga'i ngo bo byin rlabs dang dngos grub dpag tu med par bsams la dum bur bgos te yul dang dbang po ro gcig pa'i de kho na'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam rol lo/ /de dag gi don yang / ro ni bdag med pa yin la/ baṃ chen gsang ba rab 'byams kyi dbang thob nas chos thams cad bdag med pa'i don khong du chud par 'gyur zhing / baṃ chen po nyid ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dam rdzas kyi mchog tu bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rgyud mtha' dag las bshad cing / las kyi gshin rje ma mo sha za ki dang sha khrag la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis 'du zhing dam tshig dran te rnal 'byor pa'i grogs su 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rtog pa shin tu rags pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i baṃ dang / de'i rme ba'i rdzas la ngan rtog gi 'dzin pa chod de lam du lhongs na g.yin tshogs drug gi dngos po thams cad la gtsang rme med bzhin (13ba)du chos nyid du ro gcig pa'i rtog pa skye sla ba yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ dril bu lag tu gtad la/ hūṃ/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /yang gsang bde chen ting 'dzin ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter yin pas/ /bde chen mchog gi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ āḥlha badz+ra satwa su kha sirnyi pha la ma hā āt+pa ko3hi/ zhes chos thams cad bde stong gi don dran du gzhug /ral gri gtad la/ gshed chen mas stobs yongs rdzogs pa/ /dpag med phrin las mthar phyin cing / /stong khams srid pa'i zil mnan nas/ /snang srid kun sgrol dbang bskur ro/ /myi ka he dun ya ma kro dha sarba da rma mā ra ya a bhi ṣañca hūṃ/ zhes snang srid thams cad snying rjes bsgral lo/ /sbyor sgrol gyi don mthar phyin pa ni stong nyid snying rje'o/ /skabs 'dir chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i phyag len du/ bam chen gsang ba rab 'byams nas kha bskang ste/ khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang / mchod rten gyi dbang /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang las/ dang po ni/ pho rdzas dug gis spos par byed/ /mo rdzas khrag gi myos par byed/ /yungs kar rgyal pos gzer bar byed/ /gshin rje'i mda' yis 'bugs par byed/ /bshan pa'i gri yis srog rtsa gcod/ /drag po sngags kyis pho nya bskul/ /gu gul sbyar bas lha dang phral/ /drag —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)po'i phur pa snying la 'debs/ /thun rdzas rnams kyi dbang bskur bas/ khams gsum dregs pa 'joms pa'i mthu/ khengs pa thams cad bsgral ba'i mthu/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu sgrol ba'i mthu/ /ru dra dam nyams sgrol ba'i mthu/ /gang gis mi thub bzlog (14na)pa'i mthu/ /dam nyams rang gshed 'bebasapa'i mthu/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'dul ba'i mthu/ /skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas/ khams gsum sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog /my-i dun ka yaṃ dgra bgegs sarba mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ a bhi 'i ṣañca hūṃ/zhes brjod de rdzas rnoms lag tu gtad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ pad spungs lag tu gtad la/ chos sku 'gyur med mchod rten 'di/ /longs sku bde chen zil gnon bzhugs/ /sprul sku 'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje'i mkhar du bsrung ba dang / /nam mkha'i mthongs su bshig pa dang / /ri rab rtse la bsad pa dang / /ri thang mtshams su bzlog pa dang / /rgya mtsho'i gting du mnan pa dang / /dregs pa tsit+ta dkrug pa ste/ /las drug 'khor lo bskor ba yi/ /dbang rnams khyod kyis thob par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ṇi ka a bhi ṣañca lhaḥ zhes brjod/gsum pa ni/ tsho gos kyi slob dpon tsho gos kyi bdag /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu che/ /bzung zhig rdo rjes byin brlabs nas/ khyod ni rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /chos kyi dung ni sgra chen ldan/ /chos kyi 5 sgra bo che/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzugs/ khyab bdag chen po rin chen gdugs/ /lha rnams mchod dang sems can gso/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /sems can don rnams khyod kyis gyis/ /zhes brjod (14brko/ /de ltar mtha' brten gyi dbang de rnams bum dbang gi mtha' brten du bskur na'ang mi legs pa med ces nges don bde 'jug tu gsungs la phyag len du yang mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la rig ma mtshan ldan khrus dang rgyan gyis spras pa dbul zhing / yol ba la sogs pas dben par byas —338

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(kha)la yab yum zil gnon yab yum gyi skur rdzogs pa dang / yab kyi spyi bo bde chen gi 'khor lo la ya ma rā dza/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la myos byed 'bar ba/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la ar+ya dmar po/ gsang ba dbang po'i 'khor lo la ral pa tshar dgu ste phung po bzhi dag pa'o/ /mig gi rtsa nang du dung gi mon pa/ rna ba'i rtsa nang du lcags kyi mon pa/ sna'i rtsa nang du bse'i mon pa/ lce'i rtsa nang du gser gyi mon pa/ mig gi rtsa'i phyi ru he le khyab pa/ rna ba'i rtsa'i phyi ru nag po 'dzum med/ sna'i rtsa'i phyi ru so 'dar 'khrigs pa/ lce'i rtsa'i phyi ru ral pa spyi bcings te rnam shes brgyad dag pa'o/ /lte ba pho ba bcu gnyis kyi rtsa nang du 'chi bdag bcu gnyis skye mched bcu gnyis dag pa'o/ /lto ba zlum po'i khrag khyams su sha za ki gang bshan pa'i tsho gos khams dag pa'o/ /lag pa g.yas kyi ngar mthil la dkar po snying 'byin/ g.yon gyi ngar mthil la mgon po nag po/ rkang pa g.yas kyi ngar mthil la yab rje nag po/ rkang pa g.yon gyi ngar mthil la sku mchog dmar po ste log rtog bzhi dag pa'o/ /yum gyi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo la dpal gyi bka' nyan khrag gi dri snom ma/ mgrin pa gshin rje'i btsun mo kha 'bar ma/ (15na sko ba ye shes kyi ma mo dpa' mo btsan/ gsang ba lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma ste 'byung ba bzhi dag pa'i yum mo/ /mig gi rtsa nang du mon mo bla rkun rngam pa'i gdong / rna ba'i rtsa nang du mon mo g.yu'i rol ba can/ sna'i rtsa nang du mon mo tshe phyog khrag gi ral pa can/ /lce'i rtsa nang du mon mo snying la gzer 'debs ma/ mig rtsa phyi ru mi zan snying rkun ma/ rna ba'i rtsa'i phyi ru me tog snying 'byin ma/ sna rtsa phyi ru khrag mig snying la gzer 'debs ma/ lce'i rtsa phyir smyo byed dbugs sdud ma ste yul dus brgyad dag pa'i dpa' mo'o/ /lte ba pho ba bstoganyis su 'chi bdag gi dpa' mo bcu gnyis so/ / lto ba khrag khyamasasu log shes dag pa'i gying mo sha za dpa' mo'i tshogs/ /yan lag bzhi la rtag chad mu bzhi dag pa'i sgo ma'o/ yab yum gyi snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus na dngas ma lnga 'dus kyi thig le la ye shes snying po rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan lha dang bcas pa/ rtsa ba 'a 'dab bzhi la gshed bzhi/ yal ga brgyad du gyes pa la mon bdud brgyad/ de'i phyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis 'obs srung dang bcas pa ste/ de yang rtsa de dag —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)byang chub sems kyi thig les rang bzhin gyis gang ba/ lhar ngo shes par byas pa nyid skyus chog gis cha lugs rdzogs par bsgom dgos pa ni ma go'o/ /'on kyang gong ma'i phyag len 'ba' zhig la byung bas cha lugs gsal bar bsgoms pa la yang skyon med do/ /yum gyi bha ga phrin las bzhi'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i pho brang du yab kyi rdo rje brtsegs pa las rnyed pa'i dga' ba nyams su bstar ba'i ye shes bcu drug tshul rdzogs pa ni zil gnon bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /don gyi de (15bskor yin la/ 'on kyang lha tsho gis rdzogs par bsgom pa'ang mi 'gal lo/ /de ltar phyi kyi lus dkyil 'khor/ nang rtsa dang thig le/ gsang ba bde ba chen po lhan skyes kyi snang ba de yum la dkyil 'khor gsum/ bam gyi phyi lus/ nang tsit+ta ste dkyil 'khor gnyis/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor lnga ni bgrod pa 'di yi dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi yin par shes so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor de rnams rten dang brten par phan tshun 'dres te mtshon bya mtshon byed de phyi dang nang tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dag par byas te lha'i nga rgyal bzung la/ drangs/ brtan/ mchod/ bzlas/ bstod tshogs kyi 'khor lo rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma khrus byas/ rgyan gyis brgyan te gdong g.yogs dang ldan pas/ phyag dang / na mo 'jig rten las gyis 'dus pa'i bar do sto /zhes sam/ yul mkhar longs spyod 'i byams pa mdza' grogs sogs/ /zhes sogs skabs sbyar gyi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ ho/ bstan pa'i sgron ma bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas/ khregs pa'i lha tsho gos dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma mtshan ldan yum gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /brtul zhugs drag po'i sto bos kyis bzhugs su gsol/ /dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i sgron me bdag la gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bam chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la me tog gtor du gzhug /gdong g.yogs bkrol te lha ngo bstan/ sngar bstan pa'i phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor de (16na)bas nang bam chen gyi dkyil 'khor dang / yum gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid khyad par 'phags te/ rgyud las/ bam chen tsit+ta'i pho brang du/ /'jug pa nang gi lha ngo bstan/ /gzung ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /gsang ba phyi yi lha ngo 340

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(kha)bstan/ /tsit+ta gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gsang ba sems kyi lha ngo bstan/ /bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /me tog dor la lha ngo bstan/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol la spro ba bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa'i don no/ /zhes spro ba bskyed/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi yab kyi mkha' hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i ā+oṃ las nor bu'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag /dpa' mo rnams kyi mkha' baṃ las chu skyes dri ma med pa āḥlas ze'u 'bru phaṭa sa bkag /lho me bkra shis mtshan ldan gsang ba'i pho brang du/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyar ba'i/ /byang chub sems nyid mi 'gyur bde ba'i mchog /pho brang lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pa dang / /rme ba lnga dang bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i sems/ /bkra shis mtshan ldan bum par brtul zhugs phyin/ /dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ /dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong zhing / ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ zhes brjod chags pa chen po'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs sgoms par zhugs te thig ler zhu nas rtsa gnas kyi lha rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ rtsa gnas kyi lha thams cad sbyor ba mdzad/ thig le dkar dmar du zhu ba des gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ltar gzhal yas khang yang thig ler zhu ste dbyer med du 'dres (16ba)pa nyi zla kha dog dkar dmar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ don dam bde ba chen po nyid mo thod du bskyil la pho thod du bkab pa baṃ gyi rme ba lnga dang bsres la/ ka ra 'o ma la sogs pas ro mdog bsgyur ba'am/ bskur thabs gang yang rung bas/ sbyor ba dag pas byin brlabs las/ rtsa rgyud bde ba'i thig ler bskyil/ /byang chub sems dang rmeb bsres/ /ba po shis mtshan ldan bum par bskyil/ /brtul zhugs rab 'byams dbang bskur ro/ /phye ka ya ma gu tho bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣañca hoḥ zhes khar byin/ des kyang / a hoḥsu kha zhes myong bas ye shes bdud rtsi shel ltar dngas pa bde ba bskyed pas lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang ste 'khor bar skyed byed kyi sa bon thams cad bcom/ nang gi lha gsal stong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ phyag rgya mo mtshan ldan khrus byas/ rgyam btags pa lha —341—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho rigasung 'bum/ (2namo gsod byed mar bsams pa'i bha ga las bzhi'i dbyibs can gyis gang bar lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom/ slob ma khrus byas gdong g.yogs pas phyag dang / bdag lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i pho brang du/ /zhes sam/ bdag gi rnam shes dbang po tshogs brgyad dang / /zhes sogs skabs sbyar gyi maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bstan pa'i sgron ma bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes bzhi dang / bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang gsang ba mā /rig pa brtul zhugs stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol/ /dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /shes rab rol pa (17na)bdag la gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la me tog gtor/ gdong g.yogs bkrol te lha ngo bstan la spro ba bskyed/ de nas bla mas/ bkra shis mtshan ldan gsang ba'i pho brang du/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyar bas/ /byang chub sems nyid mi 'gyur bde ba'i mchog /pho brang lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pa dang / /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i sku dang ye shes bgrod/ /ces brjod de/ phyag rgya mo slob bu la gtad/ bu mos yab kyi nga rgyal bzung zhing / blangs la lag pa gnyis bcangs/ gsang ba'i gzung ma spro ba bskyed la blangs/ /zhes so/ /de nas/ hoḥ bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang du/ /thabs chen gsang ba'i bde phob la/ /dbu ma'i rtsa rgyud sa bon bsreg /bha ga'i gnas su chos skur bskyil/ /rtsa ba 'od 'phros longs spyod sku/ /mnyam par gnas pa byang chub sku/ /spros bral kun khyab sprul pa'i sku/ /bstan pa thob pa rdo rje'i sku/ /yab yum mnyes pas mnyes par bya'o/ /zhes gdams nas/ de dag gi don nyams su blang ba ni/ mkha' gsang brlab/ yum gyis sa ma ya skye gyi sbyor ba'i brdas bskul/ yab kyis sam ya hos lan gdab/ gnyis gas/ a ti gu h+ya hoḥ zhes 'khril sbyor bya/ dzaḥ& baṃ ho: srubasapa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba bya ste/ gsod byed gzung mas g.yon nas 'byud/ /bha ga gsang ba'i pho brang du/ /rdo rje brtsegs pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /gsang ba lhun grub mkha' la 'jug /ces pa'i don no/ /de ltar yas babs mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rim (17ba)pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes nyams su myong ba la/ hoḥ rig pa'i stobs ldan sbyor ba'i gnas/ /'khrul pa'i bag chags sprin lta bu/ /ye shes rol —342

'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa/ nang ma(kha)pa'i sgron mas bsal/ /mnyam pa'i stobs kyis brtul zhugs longs/ /myi ka ya ma pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi chu hoḥbazhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang la/ bla mas rang byung ye shes pho brang du lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor rtsal rdzogs par gsal btab/ slob bu khrus bya zhing yol bas bcad la/ phyag dang / phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal yongs rdzogs rgyas bsdus gnyis skabs sbyar gyis phul la/ bstan pa'i sgron ma bcom ldan 'das/ /lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /lhun grub rang bzhin gsang ba'i pho brang nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /ma lus mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /rig pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rang rtsal ye shes lnga yis gzhug tu gsol/ /dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /ye shes rol pa bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/rang thong ye shes pho brang du/ /rig rtsal 'od lnga'i lha ngo bstan/ /me long shel dang nyi zer bstan/ /zhes pas/ rang byung gi ye shes rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang / /dpe'i ye shes zhu ba de lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnyis dbyer med nam mkha' ltar brjod pa thams cad dang bral zhing smra bsam gyi yul las 'das pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba nyid kyang ye shes 'od lnga'i ngo bor ma 'gags pa yin no/ /zhes brjod cing / dpe la ngo sprad pa'i phyir me long (18na)g.ya' dngas pa la bris sku'i gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug pa bstan la/ 'di ltar me long nang gi phyag rgya sna tshogs su snang yang snang bzhin du stong zhing ngos bzung med pa snang stong mtha' las 'das pa ltar/ rang byung ye shes snang stong gi mtha' dang bral ba/ de yang rkyen bcos bcos pa lta bu ni ma yin te/ lhun grub tu bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du shel dngas pa nyi zer ram/ mas mo yin na mar me'i 'od dang 'phrad pa'i 'od kha dog lnga la bltar bcug la/ rang byung gi ye shes lhun grub tu bzhugs pa'i rtsal ye shes lngar rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya sna tsho gos su 'char ba yin la/ 'brul pa kun btags la bden 'dzin gyi mtha' btul nas/ blo 'das rdzogs pa chen por bzhugs pas rang byung ye shes rig cing ngo la phrod pa'i dbang —343—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)thob pa yin no/ /zhes dang / hoḥye shes lhun grub 'char sgo yis/ /brtul zhugs rig pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /'khor ba rnam dag chos skur gsal/ /rang byung ye shes dbang thob shog /phye ka ya ma dz+nyā na pañca a bhi ṇiñca hoḥ 'bras bu rang byung ye shes lnga rdzogs pa'i phyag rgyar lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /rjes dam tshig bstan pa la/ man ngag snod min la mi spel zhing / slob dpon gyi bka' las mi 'gal bar gdams pa/ mna' chu blud pa/ dam tshig bsrung thabs bstan pa/ 'khor gyi srung ma la dam bsgrags pa'o/ /'di dag bla ma'i phyag len du nges don bde 'jug las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin phri bsnan mi mdzad pas der blta bar bya'o/ /spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ tsho gis kyi cho ga (18ba spra bskang / gter srung mchod/ tshogs lhag btang / bstan ma skyong / dkyil 'khor mchod bstod byas la gshegs te dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing thig rjes mi mngon pa bya/ lha bskyed/ lus bsrung / go bsgo/ rdul mtshon rnams chu bo chen por dor ro/ /slob dpon la yon phul/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod par bya'o/ /smras pa/ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yi/ /gsung mchog nges gsang rgyud sde'i gangs ri las/ /gshed skor gaṅgā'i chu rgyun spel byed pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bka' drin bla na med/ /gang de las rgyud gsang chen chu gter che'i/ /yang snying zla gsang sdig rgyud bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /pad 'byung lha yi 'khrul 'khor byed po las/ /gnubs ban gtsug na zla ba'i mgrin par mdzes de lta'i bdud rtsir spyod pa'i skal bzang dpal/ /sngags 'chang dbang po gter ston dum pa rgya/ /brgyud par bcas 'gas dbang dang rim gnyis lam/ /'khrul med nyams bstar bde chen sar rol kyang / /dgas rgyud phag mo'i byin rlabs tsam nyid kyis/ /zab mo'i snod du rung smra'i rgya mtsho'i rlangs/ /thub bstan mkha' dbyings ngos la rtag 'khrigs pas/ /gsar rnying lugs bzang nyi zla'ang sgrib snyam byed/khyad par snyigs ma lnga bsdo'i mtshan mo'i dus/ /rang bzo'i bsre bslad log chos skad sgrog cing / /rigasa'adzin cher rlom mtshan rgyu'i gnyis skyes 'ga'/ /tshad ldan sngags 'chang khyung chen gral du bsnyeg /kye —344

zil gnon drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba/ nang ma(kha)ma de lta'i ngang tshul ma bzod par//rigs 'dzin se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis//pad+ma'i gzhung la 'khrul med phyag bzhes kyis//legs brgyan 19na sngon med dbang gi cho ga mdzad//rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bshes gnyen rnam rol gyis//mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mdzad rigs 'dzin rje'i//gsung rgyun rkang drug snying gi pad mtsho'i dbus//'bral med bskyangs las dbang chog dbyangs nyid bsgrags//de lta'i zla gzhon las kyang ches dkar ba'i//rnam mang dge tsho gos gtsang ma'i chu rgyun gyis//ma dag dri ma'i tsho gos kun rab bkrus nas//'gro rnams zab mo'i snod du rung bar shog/ces 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang gi cho ga sngags 'chang kun+da'i 'dod 'jo zla shel gsar pa'i thigs pa zhes pa 'di yang /phan bde legs bshad gling gi slob dpon pa chos rje ngag dbang blo bzang dang /'brom gyi btsun pa chos rje bsod nams grags pa gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/dbang chog nges don bde 'jug la gzhi byas bla ma'i phyag len sa rgyas brgyan te/sngags rnying ma'i ma gshin phur gsum gyi lha'i gnang ba thob pa'i sngags 'chang rim par byon pa'i gdung las son pa/zil gnon drag rtsal du 'bod pas smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //sarba maṅga lo////zil gnon drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba bzhugs/gang zhig zla bral nus mthu'i me dpung gis//dgra bgegs nag phyogs sder bcas bud shing rnams//thal bar bsreg mdzad tshe bdag nag po dang //dbyer med rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs snyo nas//mnan sreg 'phang zhes rigs sngags 'chang kun la//rlung ltar grags kyang ming tsam gyur tshul 'di//mthong ba sbyin sreg mchod pas gshin rje'i gshed//mnyes byed dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba 'dri//de'ang man ngag rtsab las//de nas bsreg pa me yi las//gdug rtsub drag po'i sbyor ba brtsam//gdug pa'i nad rnams zhi ba dang //dgra bgegaXbasgral zhing las 'di bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams kyis mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor mtha' yas pa las/ bsreg pa me'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba las kyi mjug sdud dang / gdug pa can thug phrad du 'dul ba dang / zhing bcu'i dgra dang bar chad kyi bgegs bsgral zhing 'og gdon gdug pa can gyi gnod pa/ nad pa/ sri'u sogasal gnod byed dang / spyo 'bog rnams 'bul ba'i phyir nyams su blang bar bya dgos la/ de'ang gnas dur khrod dam/ sgrub khang (2na)rnying pa gnyan zhing dben pa'i sar/ sgrub pa po bsnyen pa rdzogs shing lta ba'i gdangs dang ldan pas lag tu blang bar bya ste/ man ngag rtsa ba las/ gnyan zhing dben pa'i gnas nyid du/ /bsnyen rdzogs gdengs dang ldan pa yis/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sbyin sreg gi las rim la gsum/sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang phyag bdar byas la/ sa gzhi ngos mnyam zhing 'jam par sa tshoni gyis rus sbal ser po rdo rje'i rgya gram gru gsum zla gam can dpe chung ltar bris pa'i steng du sa sna gsum dang / 'khar gong srin can rnams la maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su thab khung gru gsum pa chag gang ba bang rim sum ldan/ rtsang dang thod pa me ris brgyan pa/ nang du 'og 'degs rlung gi 'khor lo/ sreg 'khor mu khyud drug pa/ sbrul dang me ri can/ sbyor ba'i 'khor lo rnams brtsegs/ thab khung steng du drag po'i shing la hom thab gru gsum mtho gang ba brtsigs/ gcod pa nam mkha'i 'bor lo dang drag po'i 'khor lo gnyis mkha' la brgyang ngo / /phyi'i mchod pa lnga/ sman rag (2ba)gtor gsum/ mar nag /nya bo/ sbyin sreg spyi gzhung gi sreg rdzas rnams dang / lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i drag po'i rdzas/ gnad kyi rdzas/ tsha ba'i rdzas/ gsod pa'i rdzas/ myos byed kyi rdzas rnams thod pa'am lcags sogs kyi snod du bsham mo/ /gnyis pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang ye shes kyi me lha mchod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/'phrin las kyi gzhud bsrangs/ /'dzab dang tshogs mchod 'bul/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon phod nag gyon/ rag sha'i 'phreng ba se ral du byas/ /zhwa nag gam thod nag bcings/ kha lhor bsgyur/ rkang pa dor stabs su 'dug pa la/ rdo rje dril bu lag tu bzung nas/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang —346

zil gnon drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba/ nang ma(khananyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ /ma hā rak+ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ zhes pa'i bar dang / a ka pha la/ zhes pa nas/ shasta'i bar brjod pa'o/ /sreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ a khru tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi/ shin dang khrag las byung ba'i sreg byed kyi/drag po'i rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs med pa/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rang bzhin gyur/ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ shri yaṃ swāhā/ rmadzi swāhā/ cha ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ de nas me sbar ba ni/ngag tu rtsa sngags lan gsum brjod/ me byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ dme yugs bshan pa nag po'i khyim nang nas/ /blangs me yam shing nag po la sbar bas/ /drag po'i sreg rdzas 'bar bar mnga' gsol lo/ /'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'khyil (3na〉ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ asne/ a bya ka bya dzaḥdagra bo che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing rlung g.yab dang bcas pas phyogs bzhi nas me sbar ro/ /de nas thab bskyed pa ni/ swā bha was stong par sbyangs/ thab khung mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /mdun du drag po'i thab khung gru gsum pa/ /dpangs rgyar khru gang kha khyer sum brtsegs can/ /thabs kyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ /nyi ma'i gdan steng raṃ las me lha ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas gnyis rdo rje bgrang 'phreng g.yon pa na/ /dbyug pa :rje 'dzin cing me dpung brgyan/ /ra skyes kham pa 'ja' tshon glog gis 'khril/ /zhing gi ya 'gal snga ru sprul nag dang / khra bos gong rmed byas la rab bcibs pa'i/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las/ /'od zer sa pas shar lho mtshams nas ni/ /skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no/ /badz+ra sa ma ya dza dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs shing bzhugs/ /dga' dang gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /asne dhe pa ṛ ṣi sa mo ya dzaraḥ sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ na mo sirnyi hūṃ/ gdan 'bul ba ni/ ( sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/ /dkon cog gsum po mnyes byed dang / /sa las skyes 'di 'dab ma'i snying / /bdag (3bsko bgegs—347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta na dz+wa la ye/ phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ mchod yon me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri chab sman rag bdud rtsi zhal zas rnams/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te yid 'ong ba/ /drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /sngags la a lha nas shabha'i bar sbyor ro/ /gtor ma ni/ hūṃ/ ting 'dzin dbang gyur zhal zas bdud rtsi lnga/ /drang srong chen pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar la 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /o.asne/ : wa ṛ tshe ma bya ka bya/ : wa ṛ tshe ma hā ba skra ta pā dza 'a hi/ skyer tsher 'bul ba ni/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mar dang dri chu bdud rtsi byugs pa yis/ /dug shing tsher ma drag las bsgrub phyir 'bul/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa sngags la ka la srig mā ra ya phaṭa sbyar ro/ /mar khu ni/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dri med rtsi bcud dang ldan rnam par dag /byang chub sems kyi ngo bo mar 'dul gyi/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa sngags la ka la srig sha mā ra ya phaṭa sbyar ro/ /sman raka ni/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang / /thugs rje chags pa'i dmar chen rak+ta 'bul/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa sngags la ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rak+ta pā dza khā hi sngo bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bde chen dbyings la ster (4na)byed ro ldan pa/ /skye med byang chub sems rtogs bdud rtsi 'bul/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa sngags la bo dhi tsit+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ sman sna/ rin po che/ 'bru sna 'bul ba ni/ drang srong me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sman sna rin cen lnga dang 'byu sna lnga/ /snying po lnga dang chos mchogo lnga rnams 'bul/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /rtsa sngags la bha ra a khra ta mā ra ya kha raṃ khā hi/ hi ra sa rat+na bhu ta hūṃ/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa/ /'phrin las kun gyi dbang po mdzod/ /lha 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags kyi mjug tu a la la ho a ti pu hoḥ pra lha sto hoḥ—348

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)la bar du gcod pa thams cad:: (5na bangs dar/ ā+oṃ ar+sha sirnya ye swāhā/55 nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa'i ca nas/ ā+oṃ mahā be bhā ya swāhā/—ca myur ba'i shugs la 'byung ba'i bar du gcod pa'i:tsha sran ma/ ā+oṃ ma hā ba lwa ya swāhā/caḥ stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gro /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swāhā/:: nad med pa la bar du gcod pa'i ཿ bu ram la/ ā+oṃ sto bha le ye swāhā/jo cha log par 'dren pa'i:ཿ gos zung / ā+oṃ badz+ra wa sta ye swāhā/ྈ za gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa'i:: drag po'i rdzas/ gnad rdzas/ tsha rdzas/ gsod rdzas/ myos rdzas rnams so so'i ril bu byas pa 'bul zhing / ā+oṃ byu ye swāhā/ khyad par snga dgra lag la bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa da dgra gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs nga po thams cad rmā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa me lha'i sngags dang 'brel ba brgya'am nyer gcig gang rung gis 'bul/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyag bzhi po/ /'khas bzhi las kun 'grub byed pa'i/ /las kun mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ /gnyis pa la/ rtsa ba'i lha dang rgyan lha mchod pa/ 'khor rnams mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyan drangs pa'i me lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/ asna ye/ dza ya dza ya/ gha dza gha dza/ sa bha bha mu/ ye shes me lha dam tshig pa nyid las/ /phyir gshegs shar lho mtshams su rab bzhugs nas/ /zhal tshur gzigasate dkyil 'khor lha tsho gos rnams/ /mchod pa'i dpang (5ba)bo lta bur bzhugs par gyur/ /dam tshig me lha'i thugs gar ga 6 lta pa yas khang / /bkod legs rin cen las grub sgo bzhi pa/ /zhes pa nas/ phyag rgya gar mchod kyi bar dkyus bzhin btang / de rjes liṅga bcu bzhi bsgral zhing stob pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya zhing / 'on kyang stob pa'i sngags mjug tu/ e myags ya rngubs mugs shag ka dun/ che ge mo'i srog la hur thums dzaḥ dza la raṃ shag rbad/ dz+wa la raṃ/ sa nā ga du ru raṃ/ sa nā ga u na na/ gzir phyung /srog la du raṃ/ tsit+ta breng shag du reḥ e raṃ sa nā ga snying gzer du reḥ i nan 'drid phyung : sa nā gwa tsit+ta ṭaṃ ril rbadaḥ dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭaḥ ces sbyar ro/ /gdon bgegs dmigs bsal klu lta bu la —350

zil gnon drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba/ nang ma(khana'adi bzhin dang / gnod byed sdo brgyad gzhan la'ang mtshon zhing / bgegs spyir btang la/ e myags — gnod byed sogs la raṃ dza la raṃ 'a hi/ dgra spyir bsreg pa la/ phye myags ca dgra bo'i srog la khā raṃ dz+wa la raṃ khā hi/ thun mong la/ phye myags cha dgra bgegs gnod byed kyi srog la khā raṃ dz+wa la raṃ khā hi/ zhesaskabs dang sbyor ro/ /dmigs bsal yod na/ gye/ zil gnon rtsa ba rgyan gyi lha rnams kyis/ rnal 'byor dpon slob ltos bcas sbyin pa'i bdag /'khor dang bcas pa sdang zhing gdug pa dang / /drag shul sems 'chang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub pa'i/ /byad ma dgra bo che ge 'di zhes pa'i/ gzo khrag 'thung srog chod dbugs long la/ /lo zla zhag dang za mar ma lus par/ /da lta nyid du bzhes pa'i 'phrin (6na)las mdzod/ /rtsa sngags gsang sngags dang bcas pa'i gsham du thal mo brdeb/ de yang bgegs dmigs kyis gsal ba la liṅga bar snang la brgyang ste snum khol mar/ chang la rdzas bsregs pa rwa co'i sdugs snod dang bcas te hom 'bar ba'i bskul tshig kyang 'di nyid kyis byed cing / byad ma dgra bo zhes pa bgegs gang yin pa la 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /de nas sreg rdzas 'bul zhing gnyer gtad bya ba ni/ phye/ chos dbyings drag pos yi pho brang nas/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon gsod byed rgyal/ /sras mchog dregs pa rus pa'i ga ru ḍa/ khyung stag seng sprul sprul pa 'khor bcas la/ /chos nyid gdal ba chen po'i hom khung du/ /rig pa byang chub sems kyi me sbar nas/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg 'bul/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /byad phur gtad khram zor rlung nye 'byed dang / /'goms chog bskrad 'khor rig sngags gnod pa dang / /chags che nyam nga mi mthun phyogs rnams kun/ /thams cad bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de nas dgang blug thog la/ rtsa ba rgyan lha'i ljags ni rdo rje yi/ /zhes sogs sngar ltar brjod/ phye ka he dun sogs rtsa sngags bdun nam nyer gcig gis mar khu phul te me gso ba dang / sreg rdzas yaṃ shing nas gos zung gi bar rtsa sngags kyi gsham la sbyar te 'dod gsol dang bcas brgya'am nyer gcig sogs long skabs dang bstun nas sngar ltar 'bul/ de nas tshe bdag nag po rtsa ba rgyan gyi lha/ /'khor dang —35/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bcas la (6ba)drag rdzas gnad kyi rdzas/ /tshe rdzas gsod dang myos byed rdzas bsregs pas/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag gyur cig /phye myags mthug tu drag sngags skabs sbyar gyis 'bul/phye ka he dun ca — ma hā pañca a skṛ ta 'a raṃ 'a hi/ zhes nang mchod kyang dbul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ yo byad rnams sngar ltar bshams la/ mye/ sprul pa rnam gsum gshed bzhi mon pa bzhi/ /bdud bzhi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis bar khyams lha/ /sgo ba bzhi dang 'obs srung bcu drug sogs/ /pho nya bye ba sa yar bcas pa la/ /chos nyid gdal ba sogs sngar ltar brjod/ gtor ma lha grangs dang mnyam pa log 'dren dgra bo bsgral ba'i sha khrag las/ zhes sogs dang skye ring gi mthar gtor sngags dang bcas pas phul/ liṅga lha grangs dang mnyam pa gong bzhin bsgral te phul/ de nasadagang blugs thogs la/ phyi nang 'khor rnams ljags ni rdo rje yi/ /zhes sogs brjod/ phye ring la asne sbyar ba'i mar khu dang / yam shing nas gos zung gi bar sngar bzhin phul/ phye mnan bshig bsad pa'i las kyi mtha' sdud pa'i/ /'chi bdag srog bdag tshe bdag mgo dgu pa/ /gshed bzhi mon bdud 'chi bdag sgo srung sogs/ /'khor dang bcas la drag rdzas gnad kyi rdzas/ /zhes sogs dang / nang mchod sngar ltar 'bul/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dar bla ma'i sku tshe brtan/ /'gro rnams bde zhing bdag cag 'khor bcas kun/ /(7na)bsam don 'grub cing mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi/ /dgra bgegs byad ma rbod 'dre rbod gtong sogs/ /thal bar rlog la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gnyis pa mjug gi cho ga la/ gtang rag mchod bstod bya zhing / gshegs su gsol ba/mthar las mjug mnan pa bya ba'o/ /dang po la 'jig rten las 'das pa la bya ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i me lha la bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ /zhes sogs dang /a ka pha la a dhu su/ zhes pa nas/ sha lta'i bar dang / sman rag gtor gsum gyi sngags rnams 'bul/ /rab 'byams dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ yi dam lha mchog zil —352

zil gnon drag po'i sbyin sreg gi las byang dus kyi me lce'i phreng ba/ nang ma(khanaganon 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las gzhung bzhin bgyis pa las/ /bdag cag ma rig log rtog dbang song bas/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa brjod de nyes byas bshags/ /gshegs gso me smon lam rnams las byang gi dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpang por bzhugs pa'i ye shes me lha ni/ /slar yang dam tshig pa la thim par gyur/ /drang srong me lha'i ljags ni rdo rje yi/ /zhes sogs nas gos zung dang / drag rdzas 'bul ba'i bar sngar bzhin dang / nang mchod kyang 'bul/ me lha'i gtor ma bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ ting 'dzin dbang gyur zhal zas bdud rtsi lnga/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal (7ba)'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar brjod/ 'phrin las gsol ba ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa rnam dag phul ba yis/ /sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i tshogs gyur cig /drag rdzas lha yi rdzas su rtogs par mdzod/ /ces brjod/ de nas/ mchod yon me tog spos dang mar me dang / /zhes pa nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs dang / asne badz+ra mu/ me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ /ces brjod de gshegs gsol bya/'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas bla ma yi dam lha/ /zhes sogs kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor ro/ /gnyis pa las mjug mnan pa bya ba ni/ thal ba la nya bo bya zhing / ming byang sogs man ngag ltar/ gcod pa ni nam mkha'i 'khor lo dang bcas te phag thod du 'jug pa sogs lag len ltar byas la skam gsher gang yang rung bar skabs dang sbyar te mnan cing bro yis gzir ba sogs gzhung ltar bya'o/ /thab khung bsdu zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ yang na 'khor lo gcig la sbyin sreg bdun/ /bram ze dz+nyā na kirtis mdzad/ /'khor lo re la sbyin sreg gsum/ /'di ni 'jam dpal rdzus —353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2na(8na〉skyes gzhung / /yang na 'khor lo gcig la yang / /tshes nas zhag bdun sbyin sreg bya/ /bcu gnyis sred med bu yang 'joms/ /de ni rgyal po kun skyong man ngag yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /smras pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i las mtha' bsreg pa'i gzhud / /pad lugs gzhir bzhag gnubs kyi man ngag gis/ /legs par brgyan te dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ /gzur gnas sngags 'chang rnams kyi don du bkod/ /de lta'i rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mar gyur 'gro 'di'i duḥkha'i nags klung rnams/ /ye shes mchog gi me lces rab bsregs nas/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i lam der bgrod par shog /ces 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams sbyin sreg gi mchod pasamanyes par byed pa'i las byang dus kyi me lce'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang don gnyer can du mas nye bar bskul zhing phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi lag len du khyer bde ba'i phyir du zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rjes dbyu gu zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dam can mngon par 'du ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// // sarba maṅga lo//'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can bzhugs/na mo mañju sto ṣa sa man+ta bha drwa ya/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'jam mgon kun tu bzang / /bshes gnyen gar gyis rnam rol rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i pad mtshor rtag bzhugs shig /ngo bo ka dag lha lam lus phra'i gdong / /rang bzhin lhun grub 'ja' tshon mig dkyus ring / /thugs rjes sprul pa'i mdzes sdug lang tsho yis/ /kun bzang bde chen la sbyor 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gang de'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i yang snying bcud/ /bstod pa glur —354

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)blangs le'u'i smin grol lam/ /gangs can bod 'dir spel mdzad pad+ma 'byung / /dus gsum kun mkhyen sangs rgyas gnyis par nges/ /bkra shis dpal gyi phug nas zab gter sgo/ /'byed phyir mtshan ldan gsang yum she sa sgron/ /bsams bzhin sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /gsar ban phyogs med snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /zab gter chos 'di'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa'i/ khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis stobs kyi rgyal/ /'phrul med brgyud pa'i bka' babs rig sngags 'chang / /mu tig 'phreng ltar byon rnams phyag gi yul/ /'jam dpal rdzogs chen 'phrin (2na sgos dbang chog gi /snang stong 'od kyi 'ja' tshon 'khyil ba'i lus/ /dug lnga'i tsho gos las grol ba'i ye shes kyi/ /rgya can drug skyes gyer sgom glu 'di sgrogs/ /'jam dpal rdzogs chen las byang sngon 'gro dang / /dngos gzhi rjes rim gsum gyi dang po la/ /skyabs sems gsol 'debs rgyud bklag tshogs zhing dang / /tshad med dngos grub bgegs skrod sgo dbye ba/ /brda phyag dam tshig byin 'bebs rig rtsal mchod/ /mchod gtor bshams pa bco lnga sngon 'gro'i khrigs/ /dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ hūṃ/ rang byung rig pa ye shes chos kyi sku/ /gsal dngas longs sku chags bral dam pa'i chos/ /sna tshogs rang grol sprul sku dge 'dun la/ /rang shar rang grol don dam skyabs su mchi/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ rig pa rang sar gsal ba'i 'od po che/ /rang shar kun khyab bde chen brtse ba'i sems/ /ma bcos lhun grub gnyug ma don gyi lha/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa'am yang na chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i phyag bzhes mtshan brjod kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs ba'i na byas kyang skyabs sems lhan cig tu 'jug (2ba tha bde ba 'di ltar/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /ye shes lha dang dam tshig lha la skyabs su mchi/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang drin can pha mas gtso byas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa nyid la der shes kyi/ /byang chub mchog tu rgya chen sems ni bskyed par bya/ /—355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gsum pa 'jam dpal brgyud 'debs ni/ chos sku 'dus pa kun tu bzang po dang / /longs sku 'dus pa 'jam dpal rigs lnga dang / /sprul sku 'dus pa shākya thub pa sogs/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro o rgyan mkha' 'gro sogs/ /ma lus mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī sidha dang / /rang byung chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs/ /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ khri srong lde btsan 'jam mgon sprul pa'i sku/ zha sa sgron gcig mtshan ldan gsang ba'i yum/ /gter ston chen po gsar ban phyogs med sogs/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lung zin gsar ban nyi ma'i snying po dang / /sngags 'chang dbang dar 'gar ston rin chen 'bum/ /ri ba sangs rgyas byams pa dpal la sogs/ /brgyud 'dzin bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ban bla ma rba ston dpal ba dang / /rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can/ /rdo rje mgon po ngag dbang grags pa sogs/ /(3na〉bga' babs bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang thugs sras nam mkha'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan blo gros dran mchog chos kyi rje/ /yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung dbang po'i sde/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung gsob ngag gi dbang / /klong chen rab 'byams gsum pa sha gzug pa/ /zab don gter mdzod dme gsang sngags rje/ /mkhas grub bla ma rnams la ba 'debs/ /gzhubs chen yang srid 'phrin las lhun grub zhabs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /'jam mgon dgyes pa'i za hor ba 'ad pa rtsal/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug g.yu phra'i gnas/ /bdud rtsi'i tshul du rgyas btab gsang ba'i gter/ /rdo rje brag skyes skyin mthing shwa ṇa ma/ /gnas chos srung mar bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal rigs lnga zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rmad byung rdzas kyi rten 'brel la brten nas/ /rig rtsal dbang bzhi ye shes thob pa dang / /ngo 'phrod —356

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanadon gyi snying po rtogs par shog /bde gshegs kun 'dus rang byung ye shes sku/ /gsal stong dbyer med bskyed pa'i rim pa yis/ /tha mal lus kyi snang chen yongs grol nas/ /gzhi lus 'od phung chen por mngon 'gyur shog /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bcud phyung glu blangs rgyud/ /brjod tshul bzhi dang yang snying snying po'i don/ /skye med a yi rang sgra yongs bsgrags nas/ /mthar thug gos bu sku bzhi thob par shog /rdo rje thugs kyi bzlas pas lam sbyangs nas/ /rtsa la ngo sprad rlung la bde ba sbyar/ /thig le chos kyi sku ru la zla ba'i/ /zag med (3ba)dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtogs par shog /mtha' gnyis las grol rang rig chen po'i don/ /sgom med sgom sogs dbang po'i rim pa yis/ khreg chod thod rgal ye shes zang thal sogs/ /tshul bzhin lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon dus rgyal ba'i smon lam rnam dag mthus/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rdul snyed rab 'byams kyi/ /'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /bzhi pa rgyud bklag pa ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā wa shu d+dha sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3gi/ phyi nang snod bdud stong pa nyid gyur de yi ngang / /oṃ wā gī shwa ri thu zhes brjod pa'i mthus/ /gnyis su med dang gnyis med la gnas skad cig gis/ /dri med pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog btso ma'i mdog /phyag g.yas ral gyi ut+pa la gnas po ti g.yon/ /rin chen rgyan rdzogs sku smad dar gyi 'khor gsum khebs/ /thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer 'phro 'du'i sbyor ba yis /'phags pa mchod dang sems can kun gyi don byed gyur/ /bdag gi mdun du rtsa ba sra brtan dpag bsam shing / /yal ga lo ma me tog gos bu phun tshogs pa/ /gter chen bum pas kun nas yongasagazungs mchod pa'i sprin/ /de yi dkyil stod ston pa bcom ldan shākya thub/ /g.yas g.yon byang sems 'jam pa'i dpal dang spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyab tu nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas kyi tshogs/ /gusapas lus btud mthu ldan phyag na rdo rje mdun/ /steng phyogs shing gi rtse mor de bzhin gshegs mang po/ /gzhan yang yal ga la ni lha yi bu bu mo/ /mang pos bskor zhing me rta go la sogs mchod pa 'bul/ /gtso —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nabos (4na)rgyud gsung ji ltar ston pas sgra chen sgrog /dga' mgu'i tshul gyis 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang 'dud/ /steng 'og rkan gnyis rnga bo che las rgyud tshig rnams/ /lce yi dbyu gus bskul zhing chos sgras yongs gang gyur/ /gzhen nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba po/ /zhes sogs dang / rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī/ zhes sogs mtshan brjod rgyas bsdus gang rung song rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pas gnas ri bo bya rkang gi gnas su 'jam dpal gyi chos 'di bka' stsal bas/ sku las 'od zer bye ba 'bum phrag mang po bkye/ /'od zer re re'i rtse la pad+ma re/ pad+ma re la sprul pa'i sku re byon nas phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams kyi sems can thams cad grol bar mdzad pa de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams 'dir bdag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ 'jam dpal gyi chos 'di bshad pas/ phyogs bcu dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad/ skye med ye shes kyi sku thob par gyur cig /'dzin med rang snang du grol bar gyur cig /gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am/ /zhes sogs blo ka ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ /lnga pa tsho gos gsog pa ni/ snang sems gnyis su med pa la/ /sgyu ma lta bur spyan 'dren gshegs/ /'pho dang 'gyur ba med mod kyang / /lhun grub ngo shes tshul gyis bzhugs/ /yul dang shes pa gnyis med kyang / rtog 'dzin dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /longs spyod rol pa mi dmigs kyang / /nam mkha'i mdzod ltar mchod pa 'bul/ /gshis la sdig sgrib med mod kyang / /slo bur dri ma bshags par bgyi/ /rang rig dus gsum 'gyur med kyang / /rang rtsal snang la rjes yi rang / /rtag tu (4ba)nges pa ltar bzhugs kyang / /rig rtsal chos 'khor skor du gsol/ /ji ltar snang yang chos kyi sku/ /skye 'chi med par gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa yi/ /don dam 'gyur med klong du bsngo/ /rnam shes 'khor ba gdod med kyang / /ye shes rtag rgyun smin byas shog /drug pa tshad med ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ skal ldan snying gi thig le las/ /'od zer dkar pos stong gsum khyab/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pa la/ /'od kyis thams cad smin byas pas/ /snang la rang —358—

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanabazhin med pa yi/ /byams chen me long ye shes su/ /ye nas yin pa'i don la blta/ /'od zer ser pos kun tu khyab/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can la/ khyab pa'i snying rje mnyam nyid gsal/ /dmar 'jam 'od kyis khyab cing brdal/ /kun khyab bde ba chen po yi/ /dga' ba kun rtog ye shes gsal/ /ljang gsal 'od kyis khyab byas pas/ /chos sku ye shes chags sdang bral/ /btang snyoms bya grub ye shes bsgom/ /bdun pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ /spros bral don gsal bde chen chos kyi sku/ /kun khyab 'od gsal rang byung rig pa'i lha/ /dran rtogs bla ma pad+ma bde chen rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& hrīḥ.a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ/brgyad pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūṃ/ lhun gyis grub pa'i rig pa la/ /lha dang 'dre bgegs ming tsam med/ /kun tu gsal ba'i ye shes kyi/ /'od kyi ma rig mun pa bcom/ /bka' ni kun bzang don gyi bka'/ /log rtog 'khrul ba phyir dengs shig /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rang gter las/ hūṃ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /rdo rje ral gyis ma lus gcod/ /bgegs (ldan)zhes bya ba'i ming yang med/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ring thung gnyis brjod/ /cho me kun ka nas yang dag pa'i/ /brjod du med pa'i srung 'khor la/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi ming yang med/ /gsal stong 'dzin med dbyings su rgya/ /hūṃ/ 'khor ba ming tsam med pas na/ /mya ngan 'das pas kun tu khyab/ /ye shes kun khyab zhing khams su/ /'khrul rtog bag chags bsrung mtshams bcad/ /badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ/dgu pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ /hūṃ/ kun snang ye shes zhing khams la/ /zhakhrul rtog sgo bcad kun tu bral/ /rang shar rang ngo shes pa yi/ /klong yangs zhing khams sgo phye'o/ /: pra be sha ya phaṭa/ bcu pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ zang thal kun bzang ye shes che/ /thig le kun khyab kun tu snang / /rtag chad bral ba'i don gyi mchog /rang ngo shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu hoḥ pra titsā hoḥ a la la ho/ /bcu gcig pa dam bca' ni/ hūṃ/ 'char dang nub pa med pa la/ /spang blang byas pas gol sar lhung / /re dogs bral ba'i byang chub sems/ /srog gi thig le bzung bar bgyi'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ/ bcu gnyis pa —359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūṃ/ gdod nas lhun grub sku gsung thugs/ /byin rlabs ye shes rmad po che/ /spro bsdu med pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /lham me lhan zher byin chen phob/ /sa ma yas ska bhi sha ya a a a bcu gsum pa rig rtsal gyi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ snang du rung ba'i chos rnams kun/ /yon tan longs spyod rol par shar/ /spro bsdu bral ba'i ye shes che/ /chos nyid mngon sum mchod par bgyi/ /sarba pā dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥlha swāhā/bcu bzhi pa mchod gtor brlab pa ni/ hūṃ/ gdod nas (5ba)dag cing dri ma med/ /sbyang dang spel du med mod kyang / /rang ngo shes pa'i yid ches kyis/ /mngon sum thig ler rang byin brlab/ /ā+oṃ pa nyu nga lin+ta rak+ta ga ṇa tsakra bo dhi tsit+ta sarba pā dza āḥ&/ bco lnga pa klong bshags ni/ hūṃ/ glo bur shar ba rig pa'i rtsal/ /thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi ngang / /skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /rtag chad mthar 'dzin mthol zhing bshags/ /yig brgya'i mjug tu/ na raka /bre ta ka/ tirla ka /ne be sha /de wa a li bi shu khye dka ka shudhe shudhe bi shud+dhi swāhā/gnyis pa dngos gzhin lha dbang gong drang bzhugs/ /phyag gar glu gro phyi nang dug lnga gsum/ /sman gtor rak+ta gsang nan sbyor sgrol bstod/ /bshags 'dzab rdzogs rim dngos gzhi nyer gnyis khrigs/ /dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ /rang sems ka nas dag pa'i mkha' dbyings las/ /lhun grub 'od lnga'i rang gdangs 'gag med du/ /chu las chu lhar rdol ba lta bu'i tshul/ /'ja' tshon 'od lngar shar ba'i gur khyim nang / /dbus su seng khri pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /bdag nyid rnam snang mthing kha zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis 'khor lo 'dzin cing yum la 'khril/ /rin chen brog zhu snyan mgul mdzes byed rgyan/ /phyag zhabs gdu bu 'og pag legs par sbud/ /lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs sham thabs klubs/'ja' lus dngas gsal mtshan dpe'i sku ru shar/ /thugs skar rat+na rgyas pa'i lte ba la/ /thabs shes nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du/ /ye shes sems dpa' 'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /yid 'ong lta na sdug pa zhi zhing 'dzum/ /mthon mthing dbu —360

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)skra ral pa'i zur phud can/ /rtsa (6na〉ba'i phyag gnyis cho me 'khor phyag rgyar bcas/ /ut+pa la yi yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i/ /'dab ma g.yas g.yon snyan gyi thad ka na/ /rgyas pas shes rab ral gri glegs bam bteg /lhag ma'i phyag gis thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /zung du 'jug pa mtshon phyir mda' gzhu 'geng / /longs sku'i cha byad rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /shar gyi 'dab mar glang chen gyis bteg khrir/ /pad zla'i gnad la rdo rje sems pa dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /yum dang mnyam sbyor longs sku'i cha byad can/ /lho yi 'dab mar rta mchog gis bteg khrir/ /pad zla'i gdan la rin chen 'byung ldan seng / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen 'dzin pa yis/ /yum dang mnyam sbyor longs sku'i cha byad can/ /nub kyi 'dab mar rma byas bteg pa'i khrir/ /pad zla'i gdan la 'od dpag med pa dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma 'dzin pa yis/ /yum dang mnyam sbyor longs sku'i cha byad can/ /byang gi 'dab mar mkha' lding gis bteg khrir/ /pad zla'i gdan la don yod grub pa ljang / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgya gram 'dzin pa yis/ /yum dang mnyam sbyor longs sku'i cha byad can/ /lnga ga'ang g.yon pa rang rtags yu ba yi/ /dril bu 'dzin cing spyan ma ma ma ki /rin chen sgrol ma gos dkar dam tshig sgrol/ /mgul nas 'khyud cing rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /yum rnams phyag mtshan cha lugs gtso dang mtshungs/ /mnyen lhag rked phra nu ma mngon par rgyas/ /'khas gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung yab la 'khril/ /bde stong zung 'jug dag pa'i lha skur shar/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ni/ hūṃ/ ye shes lnga ldan rang rig sku gsung thugs/ /snang srid dbang sgyur 'khor ba rnam par dag /(6ba)bzang ngan rtog pa'i dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rang byung ye shes rang dbang thob par shog /ā+oṃ hūṃ swā 'a hā/ a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ/ gsum pa go cha gdab pa ni/ hūṃ/ nga ni ye nas rdo rje 'chang / /sku gsung thugs dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sgra 'od zer gyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /byin rlabs go cha chen po gso/ /ā+oṃ āḥ& badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hrīḥbazhi pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūṃ/ kun bzang kun tu khyab pa'i lha/ /kun mkhyen kun rig —361—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nakun tu bzang / /kun gsal 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i gtso/ /rang rtsal rdzogs phyir spyan 'dren bshegs/ /badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ mngon sum 'pho 'gyur 'du 'bral med/ /nyams snang gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ /rig pa rang gsal dngas ma lnga/ /chos nyid zad mthar bzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ /drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ/ rang dang gnyis med ye shes la/ /'du dang 'bral ba ye nas med/ /rang rig thig le chen po dang / /tsit+ta 'od kyi gzhal yas su/ /rang zhal mjal la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /a ti pu hoḥ pra tismo hoḥ na mo pu ru sha /a la la hoḥ bdun pa phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ hūṃ/ kun khyab nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /thig le stong sgron yangs pa la/ /rig pa stong sgron lu gu rgyud/ /sku dang thig le ༅ de par 'bul/ /mahā mu dra pā dza rnya brgyad pa glu bro ni/ hūṃ/ sems can kun gyi snying laganas/ /dga' bzhi ye shes bzhi dang ldan/ /chos dbyings nā da gshom med sgra/ /'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ma hā dz+nyā na te na hūṃ te na te te hūṃ/dgu pa phyi mchod ni/ rang gter las/ hūṃ/ byang chub yan lag me tog spos/ /sku gsum mkha' 'gro rigs 'dzin rnams(7nasgo 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /〈sna kli/ ā+oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā+o pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du sha lta'i bar sbyar te dbul/ hūṃ/ snying nang sgron ma 'od du 'khyil/ /rang byung 'od kyis phyi nang khyab/ /mkha' gsal rdo rje 'od phung can/ /snang bzhi rgyas pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ pa na sgru/ pe nu su ra to/ ti pu ba ra mu/ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sam ya ho/ ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra ra ga puspro pu/ dhū pe sgru/ ā lo ke ā/ ༷ gan/ ni li bye ni/ shasta a/ bcu pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ khri rtsa khams rlud gi dngas ma rgyas pa las/ /ye shes chen po mchog gi thig ler gsal/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'od phung 'khyil/ /kun tu bzang po rol pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /rū pa shasta rte ra sa spar+sha sarba pā dza hoḥbacu gcig pa dug lnga rnam dag gi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ gti mug 'od dkar nga rgyal ser po'i 'od/ /—362

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)'dod chags dmar po phrag dog ljang gur gsal/ /mthing gsal dngas ma chos dbyings ye shes dang / /dug lnga rang grol thig le mchod pa 'bul/ /ha la pañca phu dza hoḥ bcu gnyis pa dug gsum rnam dag gi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ snang ba 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sku/ /sgrar grag sngags kyi nga ro can/ /thugs srog gzer gyi 'phro 'du gsal/ /dug gsum dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /ma hā paṃ sa rak+ta ke: te pā dza hoḥ bcu gsum pa bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ hūṃ/ rang byung thig le dug lnga 'joms/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /snang srid 'od lngar lhun gyis grub/ /rgyud lnga dngas ma lnga ru grol/ /ā+oṃ āḥ/ sarba ma hā pañca a khra ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ kun gzhi thig le chen po la/ /spang (7ba)blang rtog pa kun tu bral/ /thun mong mchog gi 'od gsal ba/ /lnga ldan bde ba chen por mchod/ /sarba ma hā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ bla ma brgyud mchod bya ba spro na brgyud 'debs kha bsgyur nas dbul/ hūṃ/ stong 'byams ma yin dngos grub che/ /snang 'byams ma yin mtha' brgyad bral/ /gnyis med zung 'jug rang rig mchog /bde chen bde ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya lha kyi t+ta sarba sirnyi hrīḥbacu bzhi pa gtar ma'i mar pa ni/ hūṃ/ snang ba stong pa'i snod nang du/ /rig pa 'od lnga'i gtor ma bshams/ /snang srid yongs rdzogs 'od lnga'i rdzas/ /rang shar rang grol mchod pa 'bul/ /ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi/ bco lnga pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'bral med thig le 'od po che/ /spyod lam kun tu spang du med/ /rang shar rang ngo shes pa yi/ /chags pa chen po'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ bcu drug pa gsang nan gyi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ mngon sum ye shes mthong ba la/ /yid ches gdengs rnyed ngo sprod kyi/ /dus gsum dus med mnyam sbyor ba/ /gsang ba nan tan mchod pa 'bul/ /sarba pañca a : ta dza ga da khā hi/bcu bdun pa sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ slo bur bral ba'i 'od gsal ba/ /rig stong 'od lnga kun tu snang / /nyin dang mtshan du mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ dzaḥ& baṃ ho/pad+ma yo gi ni sam ya pra be sha ya phaṭa/ /bco brgyad pa sgrol ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ 'khrul snang shes—363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa tha mal pa/ /ji ltar snang ba dngos po'i sprin/ /dngos med thig le dngas ma'i mtshon/ /kun khyab kun bsgral mchod pa 'bul/ /ma tho ru dra pra bhañja tsakra mā ra ya phaṭa/bcu dgu pa bstod pa ni/ ā+oṃ āḥlha/ chos kyi (8na༄byings kyi zhing khams na/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la/ /rtsa gcig dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /pra dz+nya dz+nyā na mu rta ye/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ du:byu da swāhā/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /bā gī shwa ra swāhā/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhed la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa swāhā/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /glo dz+nyā na kā ya swāhā/ /thub pa chen po thub chen ldan/ /bcom ldan shāka thub sku la bod/ /sangs rgyas phrin las byed pa'i mgon/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /bla ma rigs 'dzin rnams la 'bul/ /nyi shu pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ /sdug bsngal kun dang gdod nas bral/ /ma rig log tog sdug bsngal ba/ /rnam snang chos bdun 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /dug lnga glo bur rang sar bshags/ /yig brgya brjod/ nyer gcig pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ hūṃ/ rigs lnga so so'i (8ba)thugs kyi srog yig mthar/ /bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun ngor med bzhin du/ /snang ba'i nyams chags sdig sgrib mun pa kun/ /rang rig dag pa'i klong du rab sangs nas/ /lus ni snang stong 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i sku/ /ngag gi grag stong gsang ba sngags kyi sgra/ /yid ni bde stong chos—364

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)sku'i ngo bo bsam/ /sngags 'thung ni/ a ā/ i yī/ u ā/ e i/ o au/ e aḥ snyi to: di dz+nyā na byu ra lha brjo/ bud+dhā nā na/ tru ṅgā warti nā na/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ta/ duḥkha ts+tsha da/ pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na mārta ye dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ sngags ring ni/ oṃ sarba dharmā/ bhā ba su bhā wa bi shu zhi badz+ra a ā e aḥpra kṛ te pa ri shurnyaḥ sa spru 3 ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya mnyu shrī pa ri shu khye tā mu pā dā ye ti/e āḥsarba ta thā ga taX da ya ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ hrīḥ bha ga wā na dz+nyā na ci/ bā gī shwa ra ma hā bā tsā/ sarba 3 ga ga nā a ma la/ su pa ri shu zla dharma rte tu dz+nyā na gar+bha a/ yang na ā+oṃ wā gī shwa ri rlu/ ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā/yang na ā+oṃ be+e ro tsa na swāhā/ hūṃ badz+ra a khyo sa swāhā swā rat+na sam+bha swāhā/ e pad+ma dha ra swāhā/ hā a mo gha sirnyi swāhā/ zhes bzla/nyer gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ bsam brjod bral ba'i sems nyid ka dag de/ /ma 'gags wal ler gsal ba sangs rgyas dngos/ /de la rgyun du gnas na tha snyad kyi/ /sgom dang sgrub pa bya rgyu med par rdzogs/ /ci phyir rang rig chos skur dag pa la/ /skye shi med pas las dang rnam smin med/ /de med bskyed dang rdzogs pa'ang ci yang med/ /zhabrul dang grol pa'i ming yang de la med/ /med pa'i don la mnyam pa'i rgyal por bzhag /dngas pa'i thun gcig bsgoms na 'khor ba 'jig /(9na ji de bar gshegs pa kun gyi byang chub sems/ /yang dag snying po 'od kyi phung po can/ /yin ni gcig yin khyab ni kun tu khyab/ /gnas ni rtag tu snying gi dbus na'o/ /gsal stong phyogs bcu dus gsum kun tu gsal/ /de nyid rang 'od yin phyir ngo shes na/ /sku dang ye shes rgyal ba'i zhing du grol/ /ma dag lasakyi snang ba'i skyon dang bral/ /rang 'od ma shes lus dang bag chags kyi/ /snang ba'i go phyi zhabrul pa rgya bskyed nas/ /rang gnas ye shes rang dang mjal mi 'gyur/ /de phyir lus ni drang srong tsog pu dang / /rlung ni ngal ba mig ni zim bur lta/ /mngon sum ye shes mthong bas grol bar gyur/ /da nas blang dor med 'i pa la 'dug stangs kyis/ /dngas ma'i rlung bcings thad ga'i mig gis blta/ /chos nyid mngon sum ye shes mthong ba ni/ /slo bur dri bral rang rig sangs rgyas dngos/ /mig ni dkyil 'khor g.yas—365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)g.yon mdzod spur gtun/ /nyams snang gong 'phel tha mal rnam rtog 'gags/ /'od gsal don gyi ye shes de nyid dang / /rgyun du bstun pas bskyed rdzogs lhun gyis grub/ /srid pa tha mar gyur pa nyid yin no/ /de nas seng ge rab tu 'gying ba yi/ /'dug stangs steng 'og 'jam dpal ye shes rlung / kha sbyar mig ni mdzod spu'i steng thad blta/ /ma bskyed rdzogs pa sku gsum ye shes lnga/ /thig le thig phran za 'og gur khyim dang / /re lde mig mangs dar tshags rtsibs shar dang / /snang ba rnam dag ye shes snang ba 'phel/ /tha mal ming zad ye shes rgyun chad med/ /'di nyid shes na skye ba med par 'gyur/ /de nas snying po'i don bcu'i gnad kyi don/ /sbas pa'i ti ga skal ldan snying gi nor/ /'bras (9ba)bu kun gyi yang bcud dngas ma yin/ /de yi dgongs pa yang dag bstan pa ni/ /lus gnad gcun pas reg pa yul dang mjal/ /ngag gnad gcun pas brjod med gnas lugs rtogs/ /yid gnad gcun pas 'gyu ba rang sar zad/ /gang mthong lta ba ngan bsam chos skur grol/ /zhes nyams su blang ngo / /gsum pa mjug la srung tsho gos brlab 'dren mchod/ /bshags stab zhu ba zhu lan lhag ma dang / /chad mtho bstan skyong rta bro rtag chad bsal/ /bsngo
