smon shis brjod bcu bdun mjug gi khrigs/ /dang po srung ma mchod pa la/ ā+oṃ āḥ&/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro lasakyi ḍā gi dang / /de bzhin mkha' 'gro phyon ḍā gi rnams/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /bka' srung dang ni gter srung tshogs/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /zhing skyong dang ni dur khrod gnas/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi tshogs/ /skyon gli pa gi mkha' 'gro ma/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis stod/ /rnal 'byor sku tshe khyed kyis srings/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /yul 'khor bsrung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /dbang ldan dang ni me lha dang / /srin po dang ni rlung lha dang / /tshangs pa dang ni sa bdag dang / /phyogs skyong bcu rnams gtor ma long / /sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srung / /dkon —366

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrig snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanamachog dbu 'phang khyed kyis stod/ /rnal 'byor sku tshe khyed kyis srings/ /bdag gi bsam pa 'grub par mdzod/ /ces rang gzhung las byung ba (10na)dang gter srung sgos kyi mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ rlung sems dbang sgyur pad+ma rgyal po yis/ /stag tshang bkra shis dpal gyi phug pa mā /zab mo'i gter 'di gsang ba'i rgyas btab tshe/ /srung mar bka' bsgos rdo rje brag skyes dang / /skyin mthing shwa ṇa mu kha rnam pa bzhi/ /mdor na chos 'di skyong ba'i drag shul can/ /rang byung rang shar rig pa'i rtsal tsam du/ /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed ji bzhin gnas 'dir gshegs/ /phyi nang nyer spyod sman rag gtor ma dang / /'dod yon longs spyod mchod yul mchod pa'i rdzas/ /mchod mkhan mtha' dag chu las chu sbur bzhin/ /sems kyi dbyings 'bul dbyings su dgyes par thim/ /ā+oṃ sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra arnya bra tismo swāhā nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ /ā+oṃ sarba pañca a khra ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ kha hi/ mahā ba li sna kha raṃ kha hi/ hūṃ/ rmi lam yul gyi bde sdug ji bzhin du/ /gnod byed sgrol zhing mthun pa'i las kun sgrub/ /zab gter chos bka' spel la phrag ma dog /rang rig mngon sum mthong ba'i grogs mdzod cig /gnyis pa tshogs brlab pa ni/ hūṃ/ ka dag rig pa kun tu bzang / /lhun grub bde chen 'od lnga yis/ /rtog 'dzin tshogs kyi yo byad rnams/ /ye shes 'od lngar byin gyis brlab/ /〈utsuṣ+ṭha kro dha be ta li sarba dra bye si shwa dha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā/ gsum pa spyan 'dren ni/ ye shes lnga dag sku lnga'i klong / /kun 'dus kun tu khyab pa'i lha/ /rig pa mngon sum thig le'i sku/ /snang srid 'od lnga'i tshogs la gshegs/ /bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ ā+oṃ mchod cing brjod pa drang srong che/ /sku gsum mkha' 'gro rigs 'dzin rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mchod pa chen (10ba)po 'dod chags che/ /'dod chags mchod pa bla na med/ /snang ba mtha' yas sku la 'bul/ /bzhes shig me ni gos dkar mo/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /zhe sdang mchod pa bla na med/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la 'bul/ /bzhes shig pa ni sangs rgyas spyan/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug mchod pa bla na med/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku la 'bul/ /bzhes shig nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma/ /mchod pa chen po —367—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)khro ba che/ /nga rgyal mchod pa bla na med/ /rin chen 'byung ldan sku la 'bul/ /bzhes shig chu ni mā ma ki /mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /phrag dog mchod pa bla na med/ /don yod grub pa'i sku la 'bul/ /bzhesashig rlung ni dam tshig sgrol/ khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /mkha' 'gro gter bdag rnams la 'bul/ /lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūṃ/ bzang ngan med pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bzang ngan gnyis su bzung ba'i blo/ /slo bur rtog pa'i sgrib pa rnams/ /blo 'das tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags/ /badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ yig brgya brjod/ drug pa stob pa ni/ hūṃ/ blo 'das chos skur dag pa la/ /blo 'das rtogs pa'i gdengs ma rnyed/ /glo bur rtogs pa lhan cig skyes/ /blo 'das thig le'i mtshon chas bsgral/ /mā ra ya rbad/ hūṃ/ bdag tu 'dzin pa rang gi sems/ /'khrul rtog las kyi tshogs brgyad 'khrul/ /skye med rtogs pa'i mtshon gyis gtubs/ /stob po kun bzang zhal du stob/ /skye 'gag med pa'i klong du stob/ /dngos po stong nyid klong du stob/ /snang ba ye shes klong du stob/ /gsal ba chos nyid klong du stob/ /glo bur rig pa'i klong du stob/ /ma ha mo sa rak+ta skru : (11na)ti ga ṇa tsakra kha kha khā hi khā hi/bdun pa zhu ba ni/ kye/ kun bzang dbyer med bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /snang stong dbyer med tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di/ /bde stong dbyer med rtogs pa'i tshogs kyis 'bul/ /rig stong dbyer med ngang du bzhes su gsol/ /kye/ snang srid dag pa 'od lnga'i lha tshogs dgongs/ /ye nas mnyam nyid tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di/ /rtog pa'i blo la dag snang tshul gyis 'bul/ /'khrul med dag pa'i ngang du bzhes su gsol/ /kye/ rdo rje mched lcam rig rtsal dgongs su gsol/ /dga' mgu rnam dag tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di/ /so sor ma mchis g.yar dam tshul gyis 'bul/ /'khon 'dzin med pa'i ngang du ba ches su gsol/ /brgyad pa zhu lan ni/ e ma ho/ sku gsum zhing khams mthong bas dang re spro/ /chos nyid blo 'das rtogs pas blo re bde/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan ngo mtshar che/ /blang dor mi 'tshal yi rang dga' —368

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)bar rol/ /a la la ho/ /dgu la lhag ma btang ba ni/ phe phe peṃ/ e a ra li hri hri dzaḥ// thig le mi 'gyur dpal gyi lhag sdud ni/ /'od gsal dbyings la g.yo ba med mod kyang / /skye ba'i cho 'phrul gar bsgyur rtsal snang ba/ /chu tshod so gnyis mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /rlung khams shugs 'gro 'byung lnga char ltar 'bar/ /rtsa khams nyer gcig dbang phyug mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dur khrod sgo bzhi ma mo glog ltar 'byug /skye mched bco brgyad gi kai thog ltar 'phro/ /dus tshod 'bar ma me 'od lta bur 'bar/ /yum brgyad spor ma dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis dbyu gu pho nyar 'phro/ /pho nya drug cu laṅga 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /tsho gos brgyad (11bskrag rtsal sdebargyad sdodang dpung / /dus dang sred pa ma bdun nam gru'i tshogs/ /nam zla dus bzhi sring mo 'jo sgeg can/ /kun kyang ma nges dpal gyi bka' stod tshogs/ /slong yangs 'khyil ba 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /kun bzang thugs mchog gcig tu khyab pa'i sku/ /rang rang rig rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas khang mchog gi thig le'i pho brang na/ /gos bzang 'ja' 'od ma 'dres kun tu gsal/ /rkyen bzang zer lnga thugs rje slog tu 'byug /skyogs bzang stong nyid chos sku'i bde bas gang / /zas bzang ye shes lnga dang sku lngar bcas/ /skyes bzang dam pa rlung lnga'i dngas ma rol/ /rnam dag 'od kyi thig le zas su za/ /las su glo bur rtog tshogs dag par byed/ /dbyings rig gnyis med gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /mi g.yo chos sku sku gsung thugs thob pa'i/ /rang bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ma hā pañca ba lin+ta rak+ta ga ṇa tsakra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ma sha hūṃ a mu kai tsam phreng yak+ṣa u rtsit+ta ba li t+na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bcu pa chad mtho ni/ hūṃ/ dus gsum mi g.yo bskal pa thog ma la/ /srid gsum ming med chos sku'i zhing khams su/ /thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba dang / /gsal dang 'gag med lhag mthong ye shes kyis/ /skye med mtha' bral dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /'gags med rang rtsal gzugs sku'i 'khor 'dus shing / /gnas med zung 'jug rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ /dmigs med mtha' bral rtogs par ma chad dam/ /'gro dang 'ong ba blta bar ma chad dam/ /gdod nas dag pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ye —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sangs rgyas pa'i sal ma thob par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ lhun grub dri bral bskal pa bar ma la/ /kun gzhi (12na)gsang ba dag pa'i gnas ma chagatu/ /rang byung rgyal po shes rig 'od lnga dang / /chos can kun ldan 'od zer snang ngo yis/ /ye sangs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /yang sangs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus shing / /sku dang ye shes rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ /snying nang thig le bstan par ma chad dam/ /dkar 'jam lam 'gags bsal bar ma chad dam/ /chos nyid mngon sum gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /snang bzhi tshad du 'byol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ ma 'dres yongs rdzogs bskal pa'i tha ma la/ /'og min lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /nges pa lnga ldan drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /rtog tshogs rang grol 'jam dpal rigs lnga yis/ /sku dang ye shes dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /phung khamasaskye mched rang rtsal 'khor 'dus shing / /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ /spyod yul yongs su dag par ma chad dam/ /tha mal dgra 'dzin 'dul bar ma chad dam/ /dbyings rig rang gsal gtor ma 'di long la/ /rgyud gsum chos 'khor skor ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /kun tu gzigs dang mngon dga' la sogs su/ /rigs bzhi'i sangs rgyasasras yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /rang rang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i gang zag 'khor 'dus shing / /sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ khyu 'bras chos 'khor skor bar ma chad dam/ /cho 'phrul rtsal chen spro bar ma chad dam/ /ye shes dag snang gtor ma 'di long la/ /kun tu 'od kyi sa la 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ de 'og bar gyi bskal ba bar ma la/ /(12brko ga' ldan brtsegs dang rdo rje gdan rnams su/ /bdegs ston pa dam pa bcu gnyis dang / /rang gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus nas/ /sna tsho gis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /skal ldan las can gang zag 'khor 'dus shing / /smon lam dag pa'i rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ /rgyu 'bras chos 'khor bskor bar ma chad dam/ /'gro rnams smin grol 'god par ma chad dam/ /skyon bral dam chos gtor ma 'di long la/ /rang rang khas blangs dam bcas 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ de 'og —370

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanabaskal pa dus kyi tha ma la/ /phyon bsam yas 'dzam gling gnas rnams su/ /rigs 'dzin dpa' bo pad+ma thod phreng dang / /rgya bod rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /theg dgu yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /skal ldan las can 'khor gyi tshogs 'dus shing / /rgyu 'bras blang dor rang rang gzugs bstan nas/ /dal 'byor don yod byed par ma chad dam/ /rgyu 'bras blang dor 'byed par ma chad dam/ /dbang dang dam tshig gtor ma 'di long la/ /bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i dam bcas 'phrin las mdzod/ /sa ma ya a dan na ra skan/ /bcu gcig pa bstan skyong ni/ /ma ma e a ra li hri hri dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ/ pha ni gnam gyi rdzi gan la/ /ma ni nag mo bzhin mi sdug /bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi/ /ye shes bzhi las sprul pa mo/ /mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes ma/ /gzugs can la sogs ma rig pa/ /'du byed ming gzugs dag pa mo/ /'di yang ye shes chen mo'i rtsal/ /mchod sbyin 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ pha ni gnam gyi glog chen la/ /ma ni dmar mo gnod sbyin che/ /bu mo gnod sbyin chen mo bzhi/ /dga' ba bzhi (13na)pas sprul pa mo/ khā da lug pa khyi phag gdong / /skye mched drug dang reg pa dang / /tshor ba sred pa dag pa mo/ /'di yang ye shes chen mo'i rtsal/ /mchod sbyin 'di bzhes wen las mdzod/ /hūṃ/ pha ni gnam gyi skya 'od la/ /ma ni dkar mo bzhin bzang ma/ /bu mo sman btsun chen mo bzhi/ /tshad med bzhi las sprul pa mo/ /gshin rje brtan ma pho nya mo/ /mche ba ma dang 'joms pa mo/ /len dang sred pa rga shi dag /mchod sbyin 'di bzhes 'phrin las mdzod/ /ma ma/ kha kha/ la la/ le le/ ta ta/ te te sring 'gro ma sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ sarba pā dza khā hi/ bcu gnyis pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūṃ/ glu drug blangs pas don drug 'grub/ /bde gshegs yongasardzogs drug rdzogs shing / pha rol phyin drug gla drug thob/ /brtul zhugs drug gi yon tan rgyas/ /oṃ gti mug sha chen 'dus pa la/ /me long ye shes dkar gsal bro/ /oṃ gyi glur blangs brdung byas pas/ /sprul sku'i brtul zhugs sku rba cus/ /ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ/ e 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil ba la/ /sor rtog ye shes dmar gsal bro/ /e snya1ra blangs brdung byas pas/ /longs sku'i brtul zhugs gsung —371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nadu rgyas/ /e ku e e e/ hūṃ/ zhe sdang rus pa'i ri rgyal rtser/ /cho ge dbyings ye shes mthing gsal bro/ /hūṃ gi glur blangs brdung byas pas/ /chos sku'i brtul zhugs thugs su rgyas/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ swā nga rgyal nang khrol brdal ba la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ser gsal bro/ /swā yi glur blangs brdung byas pas/ /nyid sku'i brtul zhugs yon tan rgyas/ /swā swā swā swā swā/ hā phrag dog rtsa khams (13ba)gzigs pa la/ /bya grub ye shes ljang gsal bro/ /hā yi gyur blangs brdung byas pas/ /mngon byang brtul zhugs 'phrin las grub/ /hā hā hā hā hā/ ā+oṃ āḥ& swāhā/bcu gsum pa rtag mtha' bsal ba ni/ srog yig 'od gsal thig le yungs 'bru tsam/ dmar gsal thig pa 'od lngas bskor ba la/ /rtag chad mnyam gzhag de nyid rtag chad bral/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa'i ye shes sems/ /rtags ni stong gsal nam mkhar 'char ba'i don/ /yang dang yang du dngas ma'i rgyun dang bstun/ /sgom du med cing bskyed du ci yang med/ /ma yengs nyi ma phyed tsam gang gi lta/ /de nyid don gyi sangs rgyas rang shar yin/ /bcu bzhi pa chad mtha' bsal ba ni/ /hūṃ/ de nyid mthong ba med cing mi dmigs pas/ /phyogs min sems kyi dri ma kun bral nas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od du gsal ba'o/ /de nyid gang zag las dang byed dbang gis/ /dmigs dang dmigs bya med cing rtogs par dka'/ /rang byung don gyi sangs rgyas skur ldang ba'o/ /bco lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ e ma ho/ /ye shes rol pa chos sku'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'gag med rtsal gdengs dge bcu'i cho 'phrul las/ /kun nas ma 'dres thugs rje chen po yi/ /yongs la dbang bskur lhun grub sa ru bsngo/ /rgyu 'bras thams cad thig le gcig gi ngang / /'khrul dag grol ba slo bur dri ma'i cha/ /rang sar sad pa'i dge rtsa gang yin pa/ /'gyur med chen po thig le slong du bsngo/ /'khor dang 'das pa'i chos rnams sems kyi rtsal/ /sems nyid rang bzhin dag pa nam mkha' ltar/ /bcings dang grol med bri dang gang med pa'i/ /ka dag 'byams klas gdal khyab klong du bsngo/ /gdod nas sangs 372

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma6)rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ /bskyar mi dgos te (14na)rang ngo shes/ /'brel tshad byang chub don ldan pa'i/ /mthong bas sangs rgyas thob par shog /bcu drug pa smon lam ni/ /rdzogs chen lam bzang 'di bsgom rnal 'byor rnams/ /rang rig gdod nas dag pa'i kun tu bzang / /mdzo sum rang ngo 'phrod nas snang tsam 'gro/ /stong ོ chos sku'i dbyingasasu 'khrid par shog /bstobadun pa shis brjod ni/ e ma ho/ kun bzang bde chen 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /thig le zang thal lugu rgyud/ /dbyings rigazung 'jug thod phreng rtsal/ /yang sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i zhing khams su/ /lnga phung zad pa'i 'od po che/ /chos dang ye shes ming 'dogs bral/ /kun tu bzang po'i bkra shis shog /rten 'brel chos kun ma 'gags pa/ /byas dang byed pa chos sku'i rtsal/ /'khor ba ming du zlad pa yi/ /rtog pa gdengs thob bkra shis shog /la la rdzogs chen yo ga 'og ma gnyis dang 'dra ba'i las byang rgyas pa mi dgos gsung na'ang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams kyi mkha' 'gro yang tig tu rigs lnga'i las byang gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo cha lag tshang zhing rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i klong gsal snying tig tu'ang las byang gi rim pa rgyas tsam snang la rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod pa yi/ /rnal 'byor thabs ldan rnams kyis ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa rmang nas brtsig /ces 'byung bas tshe dpag med ye shes 'od mchog gi tshig rnams a ti dang mthun pa 'jug bas de nas blangs te tshang bar bkod pa la wal tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa'i rnying rgan rnams kyis 'bri gung pa'i rmog chad mi mdzad pa zhu/ /dbang gi rim pa la stegs kyi khar rdul tshon nam ras(14ba)bris kyi dbus su thig le sngon po'i mthar dkar ser dmar ljang gis bskor la/ shar gyi thig le dkar po/ de bzhin du lho ser/nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ bzhi ga'i mthar rang mdog ma yin pa'i kha dog bzhis bskor ba'i thig le lnga sgrom gyi mthar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i thig le lnga sbrags kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ma zhi'i khar phud phye gtsang ma la cho se sman sogs dam rdzas/ sman spos btab pa chang gis sbrus pa'i dpal gtor —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zur bzhi logs brgyad rang byung gi yi ge a lngas mtshan pa/ dmar rtsi dang zhi ba'i rgyan spros gang rgyasamathar pad+mas bskor ba/ 'grub na rigs lnga'i tsakli btsugs pa/ shar du bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan gzungs rdor mgul chings dang bcas pa gnyis/ de bzhin du lho nub byang rnams la yang re re bkod/lhor dbu rgyan dang dbyangs can/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ mtshams gang ba der man shel dang gtor mar 'dzugs rgyu med na rigs lnga'i tsakli sku mdog phyag mtshan la ma bltos pa gang rnyed/ mthar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa/ sman raka /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung gi mchod pa/ bgegasagator/ tshogs 'khor/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog /las bum/ gzhan yang rol mo/maṇ+ḍal sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mngon par 'du bgyis/ las byang gzhung bsrangs te bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub pa'am yang na me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa gang rung la brten nas lha bskyed/ de dang dus mtshudas su gtor ma'i yi ge 'bru lnga dkyil 'khor dbus kyi rigs lnga dang ngo bo dbyer med du bsgoms pa'i steng du rigs 'dzin brgyud pa/ mtha' skor du (15na/brag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba gsal btab/ bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du las byang ltar lha tshogs rnams bskyed/ de rjes spyan 'dren nas bzung tshogs tha ma'i bar dkyus bzhin byed/ 'di'i gter srung du dngos bstan e ka dzā tī mi 'dug rung dpal sngags kyi bdag mo 'di rdzogs pa chen po thams cad kyi srung ma yin pas gtor ma bsngos pa 'tshub chung las bum du rdo rje sems dpa' dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed bstim mchod bstod bzlas pa spyi ltar bya/ slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung / nang du 'ongs te dbang yon du skyes pas mda' gzhu/ bud med kyis me long / thun mong du dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ lan tsha sogs ci 'byor ba'i dngos po dbul/ phyag byas te gral la 'khod pa la bgegs bskrad/ mar gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rang rig gdod ma'i sangs rgyas dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de ma thob pa'i gnas skabs su'ang 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa —374

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanamatha' dag nye bar zhi zhing tshe dang dpal 'byor nyams rtogs la sogs pa gong 'phel du bya ba'i phyir/mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo nos nas don tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i kun tu spyod pa dang lan bsags 'tshal/ khyed rang rnams rnyed dka'i lus rten khyad par can thob/ /mjal bar dka' ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi skal ba dang ldan/ bstan pa'i snying po nges don zab mo ston pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rjes su bzung ba'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor don yod par byed dgos pas de la yang smin grol gyi thabs la 'bad par bya ba las/ 'dir smin byed zab mo'i dbang bskur bar byed (15ba)pa la thog mar yid ches kyi nges pa bskyed pa/ chos dang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par sngon du bklag lung gi tshul gyas grub pa de yin la/ 'on kyang de lta bu'i bka' brgyud 'di dag rgyal ba rnams dgongs pas brgyud de rigs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs drug gi nges par ldan pa des skal ldan gyi gdul byar gyur pa sgeg pa rdo rje'i zhabs dang / shrī sidha rnam pa gnyis la bshad sgrub kyi bka' srol 'byed pa'i tshul du gtad pa las phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug shrī sidha sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ma hā paṇ+ḍita bhi mā la mi tra/ lo tsā ba chen po be+e ro tsa na dang rnam pa gsum mchog gi gdul byar gzigs te gnang / bhi ma las snying po'i bcud du dril ba de nyid kyi sprul pa ldan ma lhun gyi rgyal mtshan dang / be+e ros sgrub pa gtso bor brtan pa bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i rgyal sras rdo rje gling pa ste/ lo paṇa gnyis kyi bzhed pa zab gter las byung ba'i lugs kyang yod la/ mchog tu gyur pa slob dpon rin po ches bod yul du chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang mtshan ldan gyi yum jo mo she sa sgron gcig ma rnam pa gnyis gdul bya'i yul du gzigs nas 'jam dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid la bshad thabs gsum du mdzad de yang bka'i 'grel pa la brten nas rgya che ba spyi ti ltar bshad/ rgyud la brten nas don 'grel/ ngo sprod la brten nas gsang 'grel mdzad/ de dag kyang gang zag dbang po'i rim pa gsum gyi bkri tshul du snying por bsdus te gnang bas/ btsad pos spa gro cal gyi brag phug nyi ris su zla ba gcig gi thugs dam gyis—375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rgyud grol/ jo mos stag tshang dpal phug tu lo bdun ye shes kyi sku la thig le sbyangs nas 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes nas lho nub o rgyan gyi (16na〉yul pad+ma 'od kyi bo brang du gu ru'i drung du phebs/gdams pa'i bla dpe rnams ma 'ongs pa'i don du rgyud yang snying ngo sprod btags grol sogs 'kho'i gshin rje gshed dmar po'i thugs ka dang / yongs su tshang ba dpal phug rdo ba g.yu phra can gnyis su slob dpon chen pos gter du gtams pa rim bzhin mnga' bdag gi skye ba bco lnga pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs dang / mtshan ldan she sa'i rnam sprul sar ban ston pa phyogs med gnyis kyis gter mdzod zhal phye ba lasaphyi ma'o/ /spros pa la dga' bas skabs 'dir dbang gi ngo bo nges pa'i mtshon dpe/ bskur ba'i shes byed/ma thob pa'i skyon dang thob pa'i phan yon/ gang gis skur byed slob dpon dang / nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid gang du bskur ba dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs dgos ched bskur tshul cho ga'i rim pa rnams sngags gsar rnying gi rjes 'jug lugs srol bye brag so so thams cad kyi khungs bsdebs tshul dang tshul ma yin pa rnam par dbye/ kun kyang rang rang gi brgyud pa'i phyag len nges thub lung dang rigs pa'i zin so rgyab skyor nas yid ches nges pa rnyed par byas la de dag kyang mthar thug gi skyel po yang gsang rdo rje snying po brgyud pa drug ldan las ji ltar 'byung ba'i phyag len la g.yin gyis cha ma bslad pa zhig yid brtan du rig par bya dgos la/ 'khor skabs su 'bab par nang don snying por dril te spros pa'i rgya bskums grub thob ku su lu pa'i 'chad thabs la gzhi blangs te/ smin dbang sngon du 'gro dgos par 'di nyid las/ smin pa dbang bzhi thob nas grol lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis las zhes dang / yang bslab pa'i mtha' bcu las kyang rim pa dbang gi bgrod pas rgyal bu rgyal sa zin pa ltar (16ba/bslab ces pa dang / dgos ched kyang / bar gcod sel cing slob ma smin pa'i phyir mchod pa dang dbang rim dgu ru bshad ces pa dang / yang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis slob ma smin par bya ba'i phyir rgyud la brten nas 'asdug sgo mdzad ces dang / rgyud las kyang ye shes dbang bskur cod pan zhes gsungs la slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid tshul bzhin tshang ba dka' bar snang yang dbang khrid lung gsum gyi rgyun ma nyams—376

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanapa tsam la gdengs su byas/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni zhu 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang ldan phyin rtsa ba der 'dus par gda'/ dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa yang spros med 'jug pa bde ba tshom bu la brten pa 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa sogs 'khrul med nus ldan du grub pa lags pas bskur tshul cho ga'i rim pa yang sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las thog mar khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rdo rje slob dpon dang 'jam dpal rigs lnga zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa'i drung du 'jug sgo zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te spyi dang khyad par rten 'brel zab mo'i rten dang bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu zhes brjod nas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /las byang las byung ba'i ā+oṃ āḥ// chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams na zhes sogs bdud nyi shu'i rjes zlos byas te bstod pa bya zhing / chos sku 'dus pa kun tu bzang po dang zhes sogs brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bya/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/e ma ho/ rdo rje slob dpon yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad dang / /'phags pa 'jam dpal rigs lnga dang / /mkha' 'gro sde lnga rigs 'dzin rnams/ /bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sems can kun gyi don phyir du/ /(17na)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ /de phyir rdo rje slob dpon la/ shes rab ral gri yon du 'bul/ /snang srid gsal ba'i me long dang / /'bru dang dkar gsum mngar gsum dang / /lan tsha chu yi snying po yon du 'bul/ /thabs shes mda' gzhu yon du 'bul/ /lus ngag yid gsum yon du 'bul/ /bdag la rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol/ /āḥ rigs lnga ye shes lnga ldan gyi/ /ngo sprod gsang ba bstan du gsol/ /zhes ni gsum bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams khyed bdag gi rjes su 'jug pas na/ gting skyes kyi dad pa kha la ma gros yod dam/ myur mgyogs brtson 'grus rtab rtob mi ldang ba yod dam/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thub bam/ bya ba ci byed sems can don du nus slo/ de ltar nus na dbang bskur/ ngo sprod gsang ba bstan par bya/ /mos gus yid ches dad pa dang / /bcas pas nyams su longs par gyis/ /zhes brjod/ las byang —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bzhin skyabs sems bya/ slab ma skad cig gis seng shes bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tsho gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can du 'i bzhugs pa gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ las byang ltar byin 'bebs/de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir rdo rjes rgyas gdab/ dbus kyi bum pa dang slob ma rnam snang du wal gyis gsal/ /rnam rgyal bum pa bteg la/ hūṃ/ ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas (17bskyon du thogs/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyode 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku yi dbang / /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /'dzab kyi sngags ring thung gnyis brjod pa'i mjug tu burnya ka lwa sha a bhi ṇiñca ā+oṃ zhes spyi bor 'jog cing bum chu blud/brgyud 'debs kyi chos sku 'dus pa kun tu bzang po dang zhes pa nas bzung 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i za hor bzhad pa rtsal gyi bar dkyus bzhin la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis rlabasapa mdzad nas kyang / /skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di yis/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob par shog /ces brjod/ bum pa dang dbu rgyan thogs la/ hūṃ/ ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rgyas pa'i dbang / /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /sngags ring thung gnyis kyi mjug tu rat+na ka lā sha a bhi ṇiñca swā zhes bum pa dang cod pan rna ltag g.yas su bzhag /bum chu gtor/ glud gang rung bya zhing brgyud 'debs gong bzhin bldab/ bum pa dang rdo rje thogs la/ nyu/ ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs/ /gsum sel mtha' yasagrol gsum thob/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bshad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /—378

'jam dpal rdzogs pa r+ṣa po'i wen las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(kha)sangs rgyas 18na ) gsung nyid khyod la 'dud//sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud//snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi dbang //rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro//sngags ring thung gnyis kyi mthug tu pad+ma ka lā sha a bhi ṇiñca e zhes ltag par bzhag/rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad cing bum chu gtor zhing brgyud 'debs gong bzhin bldab/bum pa dang dril bu thogs la/hūṃ/ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs//gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob//sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud//sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud//thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud//ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud//don yod grub pa 'phrin las dbang //rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro//sngags ring thung gnyis kyi mjug tu ga me ka lwa sha a bhi ṇiñca hā zhes rna ltag g.yon du 'jog cing lag pa g.yon par dril bu gtad de cung zad dgrol/bum chu gtor te brgyud 'debs gong bzhin bldab/bum pa dang rdor dril thogs la/hūṃ/ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs//gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob//sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud//sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud//sangs rgyas dgyes la phyag 'tshal 'dud//sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud//rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi dbang //rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro//sngagasaring thung gnyis kyi mjug tu badz+ra ka lwa sha a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ zhes dpral bar gtugs te rdor dril lhan cig tu bzung dril bu dkrol nas sna tshogs rang grol/gang shar rang grol/du ma rang grol sogs ming btags shing bum chu gtor ro//'di ni chos rgyal dbang po'i sdes 'chad thabs lag len dran pa'i gsal 'debs su zhi ba rigs lnga bsgril nas bskur ba zhes pa'i dbang 18ba tha skur de yin no//'jug sgo dngos las byung ba'i gtor dbang la/ ā+oṃ āḥ// ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs//gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob//ngo mtshar med byung dpal gyi gtor ma 'di//rgyu ni dog ma shing la zhakhrungs pa'i 'bru//dag cing dri med 'bags btsog la sogs pa//gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba brjid ༷'i dpal//zur bzhi logs brgyad dpung pa bzhi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nadang ldan/ /rtsa ba brtan pa rtse mo gnam du mtho/ /bde gshegs rtsa ba'i lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rten/ /sprul pa bye ba dpag med tshim bya'i phyir/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes pas mtha' nas bskor/ /mtheb skyu sbrel ma'i tshogs kyi dpung bskyed nas/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas du mas brgyan/ /rin chen gtor gzhong yangs pa chos kyi dbyings/ /gtor ma 'dod yon rnam lnga ye shes lnga/ /'jam dpal sku mchog bde chen 'du 'bral med/ /rnam dag bdud rtsis 'phags pa mchod pa'i rdzas/ /gnyis med dbyings su dam tshig gnyen po bsre/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du ba dang / /'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dren pa dang / /sprul pa dpag med las la 'gyed pa dang / /dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob nas/ /gtor ma 'dod yon rnam pa lnga yi dbang / /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /'dzab kyi sngags ring thung gnyis brjod/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi bum dbang dus kyi ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can nas rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro zhes pa'i bar dang chos sku 'dus pa kun tu bzang po dang nas rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob par shog burnya ba li sna a bhi ṇiñca ā+oṃ zhes gtor ma spyi bor gtug /gtso bo rnam snang yab yum gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu zhing rigs 'dzin dang rigs gzhan rnams/ khrag (19na)'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad las kyang rang 'dra dpag med 'phros te zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur te thim pas bde chen 'khor lo dang ro rkyang dbu gsum shar bar mos/ de nas gtor ma'i bskur tshig rnams bshad ma thag pa ji lta ba la ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can gyi kha bsgyur 'od dpag med kyi rdo rje'i dbang gi dus bzhin bya/ pad+ma ba li t+na a bhi ṣañca e zhes mgrin par gtug /nub kyi 'od dpag med yab yum gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu zhing nas longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dang ro rkyang sogs gong dang 'dra/ de bzhin du so so'i kha bsgyur dang bcas badz+ra ba lin+ta a bhi ṇiñca hūṃ gis gtor ma snying ga dang rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu zhing nas chos kyi 'khor lo dang ro rkyang sogs 'dra/rat+na ba lin+ta a bhi khiñca swā sa lte ba dang rin 'byung yab yum gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu zhing nas sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang ro rkyang sogs 'dra/ dmi ba lin+ta a bhi ṇiñca has gsang gnas dang don grub yab yum gyi —380

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanalha tshogs 'od du zhu zhing nas/ bde skyong 'khor lo dang ro rkyang sogs 'dra/ rigs 'dzin brgyud pa rnams dang khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyang thim pas/ lha thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du song bas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang slob ma'i lus ngag yid bya ba dang bcas pa ngo bo dbyer med gcig tu gyur par bsam/ 'chad thabs su zhi khro spyi dbang dang rigs bye brag tu phye ba don grub kyi bar bskur gsung ba'i don no/ /ngo sprod gnad du bsnun na mig dar bkab/ snying po a dang rigs lnga'i sku nyi ma'i zer la bstan/ mig dar g.yogs tshe bsal te/ shel mig la bkab nasabaltar bcug la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo 'di ltar du rang laganas te/ sngar ma mthong bsal na/da mthong ba 'di ga bde bar gshegs (19ba)pa rigs lnga yin no/ /byas la tshig gis ngo sprad pa ni/a me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ /'od zer dkar po snying laganas/ /snying la ye shes ngo sprad pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal dang mnyam/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang thob shog /gong gi sngags ring thung gnyis brjod/ /a mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni/ /'od zer ser po snying la gnas/ /snying la ye shes ngo sprad pas/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhal dang mnyam/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang thob shog /sngags:: a so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /'od zer dmar po snying la gnas/ /snying la ye shes ngo sprad pas/ /snang ba mtha' yas zhal dang mnyam/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas khrung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang thob shog /sngagasaḥ ga a bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /—381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'od zer ljang gu snying la gnas/ /snying la ye shes ngo sprad pas/ /don yod grub pa'i zhal dang mnyam/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang thob shog /sngags jo a (20na)chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni/ /'od zer mthing ga snying la gnas/ /snying la ye shes ngo sprad pas/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'kho dang mnyam/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang thob shog /sngagasaḥ: a thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ /'od zer 'ja' tshon snying la gnas/ /snying la ye shes ngo sprad pas/ /'jam dpal gzhen nu'i zhal dang mnyam/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa yin/ khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /rang byung rang ngo shes pa'i dbang thob shog /sngags gnyis brjod/ bstim dus nam yang mi lā la bar bsgom/ blo la the tshom mi za bar 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /zhes dbang bskur ro/ /rang ngo sprad do/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas la/ bya rgod phung po'i ri ni sprul sku bzhugs pa'i gnas yin te/ ri'i snying po rin po che cung zhi las grub pa'o/ /pad+ma spungs pa'i ri ni mkha' 'gro ma'i ri yin te/ ri'i snying po rin po che mtshal las grub pa'o/ zhal ri spungs pa'i ri ni byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs pa'i ri yin te/ ri'i snying po rin po che man shel 'ba' zhig las grub pa'o/ /ri de rnams kyang / sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i byin rlabs las grub pa yin te/ rin chen cung zhi ni sku'i byin rlabs kyi thigs pa'o/ /rin po che mtshal ni gsung gi byin rlabs kyi thigs pa'o/ /rin po che shel ni thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi thigs pa'o/ /byang (20ba〉dub sems dpa'i gnas de ni/—382

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanabyang chub sems dpa' rang las ga' na gyis mthong bar mi nus te/ snang ba thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa la/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od du yod de/ sku'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par snang ngo / /nam mkha' la longs spyod cing longs spyod pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' la rab tu gnas so/ /phyi nas bltas na nang na yod par gsal lo/ /nang nas bltas na phyi na yod par gsal lo/ shar nasabaltas na nub na yod par gsal lo/ sdus ba nas bltas na shar na yod par gsal lo/ /de bzhin lho dang / byang dang / steng dang / 'og dang / mtshams bzhi yang de bzhin du snang ste/ 'od sna tsho gos par snang ba de yang / 'ja' tshon gyi rang bzhin te/ 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba dang / 'ja' tshon gyi 'od zer dang / khang pa dang / khri dang / gdan dang / sku dang / rgyab yol dang / rgyan dang / gdugs dang / bla bre dang /'khor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa yang 'ja' tshon du snang ste/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rgyun dang / rtsi shing nags tshal dang / sman dang / spos dang / me tog dang / skye 'gro'i sems can sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyang yod de/ de dag kyang kha dog sna tshogs pa la/ skye shi'i dngos po dang / rdos bcas kyi snang ba med pa kho na'o/ /de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs/ rin po che man shel gyi snang ba'o/ zhal ri sbungs pa zhes bya ba de dang / shel lung yangs pa zhes bya ba de ni/ 'di na yod do bya ba'i dpyad bya sus kyang mi shes te/ la la na re rgya gar shar phyogs na yod zer/ la la na re nub phyogs na yod zer/ sus kyang gtan la phebs pa med/ de dag ni 'od zer 'phros pa las/ rgyal khams kun na yang cung zhi dang / mtshal dang (21na〉nal dngas yod pa/ co le yod pas/ de dag gi yon tan longs na/ phan yon shin tu che'o/ khyad par du shel rigs bzhi yod pa las/ rdo shel/ me shel/ chu shel/man shel lo/ /rdo shel la bzo sna mang po btub bo/ /me shel la me 'thon/ chu shel gyis me thub/ rin po che man shel gyis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku dang zhing khams kyi ngo 'phrod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dang mi nyam pas/ dar zab kyis gril rin po che'i snod du bcug la/ phyag dang mchod pa'i gnasasu khur na byin rlabs che'o/ /gdams ngag med pa rnams kyis ngo yang mi shes la/ shes kyang phan par —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zag tshad dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis bcang bar mi nus te/ rang gi rang bsregs par 'ong ngo / /gtsang ma'i bram ze ngas ni shel ri spungs pa'i shel khang yangs pa sa 'jam dpal sku'i zhal mthong ba yin te/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis/ shes rab kyi sgo phye nas ye shes kyi snang ba bstan pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal mthong bas/ snang ba de la 'gyur ba med de/ ye shes kyi snang ba lam me yod de/ ye shes khyad par che ba yin no gsungs nas/ de'i rjes su bram ze'i khye lus sprul pa'i khyes 'od 'bar ba la/ rin po che man shel zur bzhi logs brgyad sgo bcu drug yod pa/ chu zheng gab pa gcig bstan nas/ rigs kyi bu/ man shel 'od lnga 'bar ba ltar/ /rang byung rig pa cho the/kyi sku/ /'di 'dra ci 'drar rtogs par gyis/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ldan/ /sku gsum 'bral med dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ āḥ&/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ rin po che spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba thams cad 'jam dpal gyi zhing khams su mthong (21ba thas/ khye'u'i mtshan yang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen du 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng shes/ btags so/ /bram ze khye'u la zhus lan dri ma med pa gsungs pas/ dus de gar dpal rdo rje sems dpas/ rin po che man shel gyi dbang dang ngo sprod gnang nas/yig tsho gos lag mthil gang la chos thams cad kyi don thugs su chud do/ /de ltar 'jam dpal gyi smin byed gtor ma la brten nas dbang bzhi rig rtsal ngo sprod kyis brgyan pa brgyud pa'i srol ltar lhag chad nor 'brul med par yongs su rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/de ltar maṇ+ḍal gyis mtshon pa'i rang gi lus longs spyod la sogs pa cha shas cha shas kyis spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te dus kun du/ /lus dang longs spyod dngas kun gyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed mchod pas/ /brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par mdzod/ /ces so/ /des rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzad pa zhu/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pas gnas ri bo bya rkang zhes sogs dang chos shes bkra shis bkra shis 'byung / /sangs rgyas bkra shis gang lags pa/ /deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs sna/ga /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /chos kyi bkra shis gang lags —384

'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can/ nang ma(khanapa/ /deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs 3|ga /grags pa'i bkra shis snyan grags dge /dge 'dun bkra shis gang lags pa/ /deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs shog /sku'i bkra shis chos sku thob par gyur cig /gsung gi bkra shis dbyangs dang ldan pa 'gyur cig /thugs kyi bkra shis rnam rtog med par gyur cig /yon tan bkra shis dgos 'dod 'byung bar gyur cig /'phrin las bkra shis 'gro don nus par (22na)gyur cig /ces brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i bcud kyi snying po las/ bstod pa glur blangs le'u'i ro bda'i zas/ /dngar por 'thul ba 'jam dpal rdzogs pa che/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum rang ngo sprod pa'i chos/ /chos 'di zab mo'i gter du rgyas btab gnas/ /stag tshang phug tu mkha' 'gro she sgron gyis/ /lo bdun nyams bzhes 'ja' lus 'pho chen sku/ /brnyes te pad+ma 'od du thogs med byon/ /zab gter sgo 'byed gsar ban phyogs med nas/ kho bo'i bla ma zur chen bar byon rnams/ /theg pa'i rtse mo khrag chod thod rgal la/ /brten nas kun bzang chos sku'i zhing du gshegs/ /de phyir lam 'di'i sngon 'gro 'phrin las dang / /smin byed khrigs rim gab dkrugs 'thor ba rnams/ /dam pa'i bzhed pa ji bzhin 'khrugs bsdebs su/ /mthong chog snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can spel/ /mkhas grub nyin byed nub ri'i 'phag gzhol bas/ /dbang gi phyag bzhes 'dab stong kha zum zhing / /mi shes mun khrod zog rdzun 'byung po'i bya/ /skad gsang sgrog mthong kho bos 'bad de bkod/ /deng nas rgyal bstan ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /zab chos gdams pa 'di go'i 'chad nyan rgyun/ /chad med sgos kyi gter srung tshogs rnams dang / /khyad par sngags srung rag gdong ma des mdzod/ /ston zla ltar dkar legs byas 'od snang gis/ /med cing 'gro ngor snang ba'i sgrib pa'i mun/ /bsal nas rang rig 'jam dpal kun tu 'od/ /snang ba dam par rtag tu 'chel gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i 'phrin las dang smin byed kyi chog sgrigs zung du 'brel ba mthong chog snang stong 'od lnga'i rgya can 'di ni byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po'i sprul pa'i (22ba)thog drangs gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin du ma dang khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i rigs kyi dpon rin po che/ rnam par rgyal ba'i —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2'phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams la chos 'di bka' rdzogs lung rdzogs su phul ba'i tshe sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las/ be+e ro'i yang srid gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa/ bkra bzang rigs 'dzin chen po thugs mchog 'od 'bar gsum gyis 'iXgrags sdebs shig gyis zhes gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i zlos gar rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag zur chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin la brten nas rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po la cung zad nyams su myong ba'i za hor gyi sngags ban gang shar rang grol gyis gter byon rdo rje'i gsung rang sor bzhag chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs rnams bsnan/ kha 'geng dgos pa paṇa chen rin po che mched kyi gter gsar tshe dpag med ye shes 'od mchog nas blangs te bag yod ces pa chu glang nag pa zla ba'i dkar cha'i bzang po gnyis pa la rang byung 'phags pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba dza ( // //'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon sum ston pa'i lag bcangs bzhugs so/ /chos kun sgrib bral gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/nges pa don gyi 'jam mgon bla ma mchog /chos dbyings rang grol snying dbus pad mtshor bzhugs/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang gi sems nyid 'di/ /'jam dpal rdo rje mngon sum ngo sprad nas/ /tshe 'dir byang chub bsgrub pa gsang ba'i lam/ /gnubs chen 'byung ba'i lugs srol 'di rmad byung / /bskal brgyar bsgrub bya'i grags chen sangs rgyas de/ /rang ngo 'phrod nas phung po 'od sku sa /grol tshe gzhan nas 'tshol 'dod dka' spyad can/ /blo chung byis pa chu zla'i gzugs kyis bslu/ /gnas skabs las —386

'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngan gsum ston pa'i lag bcangs/ nang ma(khanabazhi bsgrub par sngon 'gro'i chos/ /mthar thug byang chub 'tshol la dngos gzhi'i lam/ /rigs 'dzin rim par byon pa'i zhal gyi drod/ /ma nyams byin rlabs rlangs pa ci yang 'thul/ /lcags sdig chos sde'i lha lam yangs pa'i ngos/ /stod dril nyi ma shar ba'i 'od stong gis/ /sgrib gnyis smag rum sangs dang lhan cig par/ /dngos grub snang ba'i (2na)dga' ston 'dir spyod cig /de la 'dir 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon dang zung du 'brel bar 'jam dpal zhi ba'i sgrub skor la/ gtso bor bya sla zhing 'khyer bde ba gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i skor lcags 'dra'i chos tshan 'jam dpal zhi ba'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dang gter kha mi gcig pa sprul pa'i gter ston gsar ban phyogs med kyis stag tshang bkra shis dpal phug nas gdan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal rdzogs chen gyi skor sogs las ji ltar rigs pa drag sgrub mang po'i sngon du 'gro dgos pa/ ji skad du/ zhi bar bsnyen cing drag por sgrub/ /ces rgyud kyi dgongs don dang mtshungs par yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i las sbyor rtsa bsnyen gyi gong gnon zla gsang zhi bsnyen gyi sngon 'gror 'jam dpal zhi ba ye shes sems dpa'i bsnyen pa bya dgos pa yang bzlog gi chos skor du sa bcad tsam las med cing / de la brten nas gong ma rnams kyis yang bzlog dang 'brel mtshungs pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub skor ji ltar rigs pa thugs nyams su bstar ba las yig char 'khod pa ma byung la/(2ba)phyis su rje 'bri gung pa chen po dbur smyon chos kyi grags pas yig cha zhig mdzad pa dngos gzhi shin tu legs na'ang phyis 'gyur gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba zhig 'dug pa de nyid mi rung ba ma yin mod/'on kyang gter byon rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul pa med pa nyams su blang bya yod bzhin du de kho na ltar byed par rigs shing / de'ang gong du smos pa gsum gyi nang nas mngon rtogs sogs lcags sdig gi zhi ba'i sgrub pa dang yang bzlog gi thugs ga'i 'jam dpal 'brel mtshungs pas de'i dgongs don ltar nyams su blang ba la/ sngon 'gro ni/ de nyid las/ byang chub dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /sa bzang srog chags med pa la/ /yang na rin cen shing la ni/ /maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhir bzheng : 'od lnga kha dog —387—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)legs par bri/ /dkyil du a lnga 'od kyi gzugs/ /sku lnga rigs lnga'i ngo bo la ba'i steng du dar sna lnga yi gur: mchod lnga gtor ma legs par bshams: rol mo sna tshogs yid 'ong bshams: phyi nang gtor mas mchod byas la: zhes pa ltar gnas khang phyag dar bya/ srog chags med cing bkra shis pa'i sa la stegs bu'am yang na cog tse lta bu'i steng du rin po che dang shing sogs las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi khod snyoms par 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor dbus su 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i sa bon rang mdog dang mthun pa mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar 'bri dar tshon sna lnga'i gur phub/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo/ gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab can sman rag tshogs gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams (3na)mngon par 'du byas/ de'ang rdzogs chen dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas na gdon bgegs rang snang rig pa'i cho 'phrul las logs su med pas ka dag gi dbyings su gnod bya gnod byed dang bral na'ang sgyu ma'i srin po ltar kun rdzob dang bstun te rang nyid zil gnon gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal la gnas pas gzhi bgegs la bka' bsgo ba nas srung 'khor gyi bar las byang rdo rje'i thog mda' bzhin bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon cog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o: dkon cog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags dge ba kun la rjes su smon: sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung : byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed:dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs kyi sras su mdzad du gsol lan gsum/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: bla med gnas su sgrub pa dang : bde gshegs dngos grub thob bya'i phyir:byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: zhes lan gsum brjod: sngon 'gror zhi ba 'jam dbyangs bsgom zhing mtshan brjod bklag pa ni/ chos kun stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang : zhes pa nas: 'dzin med rang sar grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig gi bar las byang chen mo bzhin bya/ tre rat+na maṇ+ḍal/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal sogs kyis tshogs zhing dkyus ltar dang / hūṃ/ ngo bo chos sku spros bral mkha' dbyings nas/ /rang (3ba)bzhin —388—

'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon gsum ston pa'i lag bcangs/ nang ma(khanalongs sku 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i tshogs/ /thugs rje sna tshogs sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las byin chen phob/ /ā+oṃ mañju shrī sa ma ya a be sha ya a as byin dbab/ rten gtor dor ba'i sman rag gtor gsum dang mchod pa byin rlabs las byang ltar bya/ dngos gzhi ni gter gzhung las/ de rdzogs bsam gtan ting 'dzin ni: rang nyid 'jam dpal ser por bskyed ces sogasakyi dgongs don cung zad kha bkang ba ni/ hūṃ/ chos rnams thams cad ka nas dag pa'i gshis/ /ma skyes 'gag med gang du mi gnas pa/ /rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /lhun grub 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings/ /sra mkhregs srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs pa'i nang / /chu las nya 'phar bzhin du pad+ma dang / /nyi ma'i gdan steng rang nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /sku mdog ser po gur gum mdangs dang ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa shes rab kyi/ /ral gri 'phyar chi kha g.yon pa ut+pa la'i/ /yu ba nas 'dzin dgung thad 'dab steng du/ /bstod pa glur blangs le'u'i glegs bam bsnams/ /rin cen dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang / /phyag zhabs gdu bu do shal se mo do/ /chos nyid 'khor lo dbu yi gtsug na mdzes/ /srab 'jam dar gyi stod g.yogs lhab lhub dang / pañca li ga'i sham thabs rnam par klubs/ /zhi zhing 'dzum ldan bcu drug lang tsho can/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung gis/ /ye shes 'od lnga 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /(4na)thugs kar thabs shes zung 'jug nyin mtshan gyis/ /mdangs mtshon zla nyi kha sbyor ga'u'i nang / /'ja' 'od klong du a yig mthing dkar ser/ /dmar ljang tha mar snying po'i sngags kyis bskor/ /zhes bdag bskyed kyi ting 'dzin sngon du btang ste mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ chos sku stong pa'i rang mdangs ma 'gags pa'i/ /ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' ris rnam bkra ba/ /thig le rnam lnga'i tshom bu'i gur khang nang / /gdod nas rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhir 'jam dpal rigs lnga ni/ /nyon mongs lnga dag ye shesarnam lnga'i mdangs/ /ma 'dres mthing dkar ser dmar ljang gu'i mdog /zhi zhing 'dzum ldan bcu drug na tshod can/ /ral pa'i zur phud lnga ldan rin cen rgyan/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' mdzes par —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gsol/ /phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri'i 'chang bzung ni/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin cen pad+ma dang / /rgya gram rang rtags las grub yu ba 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thugs gar 0 la rtsa ba nas/ /bzung ba'i 'dab steng mtshan brjod glegs bam bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs/ /thugs gar zla nyi kha sbyar ga'u'i nang / /'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i gur dbus rang rang gi /mdog ldan a yig tha mar yi ge drug /sum cu rtsa drug sngags kyis yongs su bskor/ /bdag mdun lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum du/ /ā+oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ yig mthing ga yis/ /mtshan pa las 'phros ye shes lha tshogs rnams/ /dbyings (4ba)rig dag pa'i klong nas sa mā dzaḥ/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin spros bral chos nyid pho brang nas: rang byung ye shes zhi ba'i cha lugs can: gser mdog gzi mdangs 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros:phyag gnyis shes rab ral gri po ti can: bden pa dbyer med 'ja' tshon klong na bzhugs ma rig rtog pa'i mun pa sel ba'i phyir rang byung ye shes spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: e gye hi bha ga wā na mnyu shrī n+ya pa ta ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha ho:sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya stoḥ dza hūṃ baṃ ho zhes spyan drangs shing bstim/hūṃ/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa yi: 'khor 'das dbyer med bde ba chen po'i ngang: ma rtogs blo yi chen pa sgrol ba'i phyir: rang byung ye shes 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs: rma mañja shrī dz+nyā na sarba dharma dh+wa tu ma hā su kha hūṃ a āḥs bzhugs su gsol/ hūṃ/ mi gnas ma bcos dag pa chos sku las:rang snang ye shes dpal gyi skur gsal nas: gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'byung gnas te: 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pu hoḥpra ti dza ho: zhes phyag bya/ hūṃ/ mkha' dbyings klong yangs kun tu bzang po'i ngang : rang 'od rang snang kun bzang rol pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ma lus pa: gnyis med rang snang ngang la thim par 'bul ma mañja shrī sa pa ri wā ra a lha pra titsā swāhā nas shasta pra titsā swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i bcud: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i (5na)rdzus: rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba:dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma yi dam rnams la 'bul: sarba pañca a skṛ ta ji hi: bla ma brgyud —390

'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon gsum ston pa'i lag bcangs/ nang ma(khanamachod ni: nyams len dkyus ma la las byang chen mo ltar dang / yang bzlog gi sngon 'gror sger du byed na/ de ga'i rgyun mchod len/ dug lnga rang grol ye shes lnga yi bdag bcom ldan 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rje cher dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rma mañju shrī sarba pañca a mri ta khā hiḥ zhes sman mchod 'bul/ oṃ a+yauPROBPROB/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku gsung thugs 'chang ba: mi phyed rdo rje sku gsung thugs dang ldan/ /deng bdag 'jam dpal sku gsung thugs 'dzin pa/ /'jam dpal sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ mnyu shrī kwa ya sirnyi ā+oṃ wā ka sirnyi ā ༷tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ gis dngos grub blangs/ hūṃ/ rang bzhin spros bral chos nyid dag pa la/ /'gro mgon rang byung 'jam dpal ye shes sems: rang rgyud bcings pa'i bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i chos:bdag med rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor ba'i phyir: rang snang zhen bral 'dod yon lha mos mchod: bdud rtsi sman raka dam rdzas gtor ma rnams rigs lnga dbyer med klong du 'bul lags na gnyis su med pa'i don gyis bzhes nas kyang : mtshan ma'i rnam rtog bag chags zhi bar mdzod: o mañju shrī ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā sti ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ ji gyi mahā ba lidha kha (5ba)re khā hi: zhes pas nang gi mchod pa 'bul/ hūṃ/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog: mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud: yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud: stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud:sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud: sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud: sangs rgyas rol pa phyag 'tshal 'dud/ sangs rgyas 'grum pa khyod la 'dud: sangs rgyas ba 'ad pa phyag 'tshal 'dud/ sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud: sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud med pa las byung khyod la 'dud sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud: ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud: sangs rgyas rolaston khyod la 'dud thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud: ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud: ces pas bstod/ hoḥ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas nas rang byung ye shes chen po'i sku: mtshan —391—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2naldan zhi ba'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rigs lnga mkhyen par mdzod cig dgongs su gsol lo/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i mchod pa/ ye shes kyi rol pa 'dod pa'i yon tan dang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du byin gyis brlabs te 'bul na thugs rje chen pos bzhes shing longs spyad du gsol/ chos thams cad rang byung ye shes yin pa la yin par ma shes pas dngos po la mngon par chen pa ste/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig la nyams chags dang 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa mthol zhing bshags: rang byung ye shes don mchog dang thun mong gis bsdus pa: dus dang las la rag ma lus par da lta nyid du stsal (6na)du gsol: 'du ba'i nad dang bar gcod kyi gdon zhi ba dang tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas pa dang sems kyi chos nyid la rang dbang bsgyur te rtog pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dbyings su gzhom du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab cing nongs pa bshags/ de nas bskyed rim la gsal snang thon pa bsgom/ gter gzhung las/ bzlas brjod bral ba snying po'i don bsam gtan dran rig nges don bzung : zhes lhun grub 'od lnga bskyed rim gyi gsal snang mtha' dag ka dag gi dbyings su rgyas btab ste de'i gnas lugs kyi don la ci gnas su bzhag /gter gzhung las/ de la gnas pa 'gyu ba gnas: zhes rtog pa 'phro ba na 'dzab bzla ba ni/ bdag mdun bskyed rim sngags 'khor rab gsal ba'i/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer 'ja' lta bu/ /'phros pas mdun bskyed thugs bskul 'od zer 'phros/ /sangs rgyas byang sems skyabs gsum ma lus dang / khyad par 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la/ /mchod pa phul bas mnyes shing de rnams kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu sku gsung thugs yon dang / /'phrin las byin rlabs ma lus rab bsdus shing / khyad par rigs lnga so so'i kha dog dang / /mtshungs pa'i a yig char babs bdag mdun la/ /thim zhing mdun bskyed rigs lnga'i tshogs las kyang / /byin rlabs ye shes rang 'od 'ja' tshon dang / /yig 'bru'i rnam pa skye ba med pa'i sgra/ /brjod bral brjod pa'i ngang nas bdag nyid dang / /dbyer med 'ja' ris 'od lnga'i (6bgong bur gyur/ /slar 'phros snod bcud kun tshang snod gzhal yas/ /bcud kun lhar gyur gsang sngags 'brug —3(32

'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon gsum ston pa'i lag bcangs/ nang ma(khanaltar sgrog /'khor 'das rnams kyi phun tshogs yon tan kyang / khab len rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul bzhin/ /ma lus bdag la 'dus te ro gcig gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra mnyu shrī a: zho wā gi shwa ri rlu: dharma dh+wa tu sa dz+nyā na gar+bha a hrī: a i e o e a: ra li la li ye hūṃ/ yang bzlog gi gong bsnyen min pa'i 'di ga la chig dril yin na yi ge drug pa 'di stong phrag drug bzlas pas/ gter gzhud las/ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra: 'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba: sngags 'di stong phrag drug gis ni mtshan ma'i bag chags sgrib pa dag: 'od lnga kha dog 'ja' 'od 'byung : zhes pa'i don yin zhing / zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi sngon 'gro gtso bor byed na yi ge drug pa'i 'dzab 'di thog mthar cung zad re bzla zhing / gtso bo wā gi shwa ri la chig dril du byas pa'i 'bum phrag drug gis 'grub par zla gsang rtsa rgyud las/ ye shes sems dpa' bsgoms byas nas: lha gi shwa ri drug 'bum bzlas: zhes pa ltar ro/ /g.yin yang gter gzhung las/ btags grol dngos grub blang bar bya: tshe yi bdag por 'dod pas na: zhes ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi chos lnga'i nang tshan btags grol gyi man ngag dang tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gyur ba'i nyams len kyang zhal las shes shing / yang de nyid las/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba ni: sogs kyi dgongs don rdzogs rim gyi gnad gsang zab mo dang / yang de nyid (7na7sa/ zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod rnams: zhes dang / chos nyid 'chi kha'i 'pho ba ni: sogs kyi gnas skabs las kyi kha bsgyur dang sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i myur lam zab mo rnams kyang pad gnubs gdams pa'i man ngag la 'dris par byas te nyams su blang ngo / /mjug chog ni/ ā+oṃ āḥ& gyis tshogs byin gyis brlabs/ 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ mnyu shrī ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hiḥ zhes pas 'bul/ bdag sogs dug lnga'i dbang gyur te/ /ye shes dag pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dngos por bzung ba'i nyes pa kun/ /'jam dpal lha tshogs rnams la bshags/ /yig brgya brjod de bshags/ lhag ma dkyus bzhin gtong / /bcom —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ldan 'jam dpal rigs lnga 'khor bcas la/ khyad par mchod pa pañca a gra ta/ /zhes sogs kyis gtang rag /gzhen nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po sogs kyis bstod/ yi dam 'jam dpal rigs lnga 'khor bcas la/ /bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las gzhung bzhin zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ snod bcud srung 'khor la thim de mdun bskyed/ /de yang bdag thim stod smad nas zhu ste/ /rim gyis sa bon la thim je phra'i mthar/ /gnas lugs spros bral ngang las lha skur ldang / /zhes nyer bsdu bya/ 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i (7bsgom 'byor zab mo la/ /brten nas yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra/ /nyams su blangs pasatshe 'dir 'ja' lus sku/ /mngon gyur 'jam dpal kun bzang thob par shog /ces smon lam gdab/'jam dpal rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam yas pa /'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la rab zhugs nas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /sogs shis pa brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bde stong rigs lngar shar ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /brten nas tshe 'dir 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /nyams su len pa'i blo ldan skal bzang dpyid/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi bcud phyung pa/ /bstod pa glur blangs yang snying skye med don/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhal lung gnubs ban gyi/ /dka' spyad rgya bal nas bsgyur chos sde yi/ /'di don nyams su bstar la nyer mkho ba'i/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum lag bcangs 'phrin las 'dis/ /'gro rnams rang snang dag pa'i 'og min du/ /'jam dpal longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang rgya shog /ces yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i las sbyor rtsa ba'i gong bsnyen zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi sngon 'gro 'jam dpal zhi ba'i 'phrin las sangs rgyas mngon sum ston pa'i lag bcangs 'di'ang lam 'di nyams su len pa rnams la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas chos kyi cha lag tu bsgrig 'dun yod pa ltar nye char sngags rams pa nor bu chos 'phel dang sngags ban blo gros rgyal ba gnyis yang (8na)bzlog gi gzhi bsnyen byed par dus kyis gtugs pas mtshams sbyar te gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde'i nang tshan stod dril nyi ma shar ba las byang chub bsgrub pa'i chos sde'i dgongs don gtso bor bzung —394

yang bzlog me'i spu gro'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+eḍū rla'i do shal/ nang ma(khana'adon cha'i kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa nas kha bkang ba'i skabs thob kyi tshig phrad phran bu bsgyur cing med mi rung 'ga' zhig gsar du bsgrigs te za hor gyi rigs las sngags 'chang ba 'ad pa rtsal gyis pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so// // sarba maṅga lo//yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+e ḍūrla'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo mnyu shrī shi wa kro bhā ya/ chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal ches dul yang / /rab gdangs srin po'i zhal can dus kyi dgra/ /byang chub bar du bdag snying ze'u 'bru sa /spyon la phyag rgya ma lus zil gnon kye/ khyod nyid bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i gnad gsang kun/ /gangs khrod sngags 'chang phal gyis ma gzigs pa'i/ /gnam lcags me 'bar zhal lung yid bzhin nor/ /chos grags de da dpon lasa'ongs kho bos rnyed/ /'jam dpal zhi khro'i lam bzang la brten nas/ /'di phyi'i gtan mdun snying nas bsgrub 'dod la/ /gcig tu gces pa'i bsnyen yig be+eḍūrla'i/ /do shal yi ge'i srad bur brgyus 'di long / /de la 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i man ngag thams cad kyi nying khur gyur pa drag sngags bdag po gnubs kyi khyad chos sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyi zab gter yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i srung bzlog bsad mnan sogs nyams su blang ba'i sngon du bsnyen pa gnad du thengs pa 'gro dgos shing de'ang dbang chog nges don bde 'jug gi steng nas bgrod pa rnam pa gsum la brten pa'i dbang bzhi dang lung man ngag thob pa'i (2na〉sngags pas tshe bdag lcags 'dra dang lcags sdig gang rung gi las byang la brten nas sku gsung thugs sngags dang / gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i drag sngags ā+oṃ ring gi bsnyen pa thengs na las sbyor la 'jug tu rung na'ang ma thengs pa'am phun sum tshogs —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa'i yan lag tu 'di'i sgos kyi bsnyen pa byed par 'dod pas dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon dang / rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang rgyas bsdus gnyis/ chos skor gdams pa rnams thob pa'i sgrub pa pos sngon 'gro 'jam dpal zhi bar bsnyen pa/ dngos gzhi zla gsang gzhi bsnyen bya ba/ mjug las sbyor rtsa bsnyen byed pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gsung sgrog /la chab gtor/ bskang bshags sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog rgyas par spro na kho bos brtsams pa'i sangs rgyas mngon sum ston pa'i lag bcangs bzhin byed/ 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na gnas dben par 'jam dpal zhi khro'i rten bkram pa'i mdun du cog tse'am stegs bu lta bu dris byugs pa'i steng du 'jam dpal zhi ba'i mchod gtor zlum po pad 'dab can dmar po/ sman rag /phyi mchod rnams(2bskyongs tshar du bsham/las byang rdo rje'i thog mda' bzhin du/ phyogs skyong gzhi bgegs la gtor ma btang zhing rgyal chen gyi mtho g.yin nas bkang ste 'dzugs/ stan bde ba la 'khod de skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ tshogs zhing rnams bya/ su bhā was sbyangs/ 'khor 'das chos kun stong pa nyid kyi ngang / /baṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng / /thu yig dmar ser yongs gyur bdag nyid ni/ /'jam dpal dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ /g.yas pas shes rab ral gri dpung thad 'dzin/ sa rmis la yu ba g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ /thugs mar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan thad du/ /rgyas pa'i steng na sher phyin glegs bam mtshan/ /zur phud lnga ldan dar dang rin cen brgyan/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung can/ /'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i dkyil bzhugs gnas gsum du/ /oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ yig mthing kha yis/ /mtshan pa las 'phros ye shes lha tshogs rnams/ /dbyings rig dag pa'i klong nas sa mu dzaḥ dzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyis su med par gyur/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu hoḥ pra tismo hoḥ chu gnyis me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas dang / /rol mo sman gtor rak+ta sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ shrī mañju sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shasta pra titsā swāhā/ sngags bsham du ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā bha kla ta kha raṃ ji hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ ji hi/ gzhen nu cha lugs 'chang ba po/ /zhes —396

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+eḍū rla'i do shal/ nang ma(kha)sogs kyis bstod/ /thun (3na)'go rnams su phreng ba byin gyis brlabs/ /thugs dar nyi steng my-i la sngags phreng gis/ /bskor las 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don byas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /tshur 'dus bdag la byin gyis brlab par gyur/ /che skos bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dmigasapa dang bcas/ ā+oṃ wā gī shwa ri rlu zhes pa 'bum tsho drug thun du bcad de bsnyen/ thun mthar mchod bstod bya/ thun mjug rnams dang bza' btung bshang gci rnams kyi mjug tu ā+oṃ gyis mgo drangs ā di kā di'i mtha' 'grub par gyur cig grub bo zhes dang gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya/ rten 'brel snying po/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha rnams gsum re brjod pa 'og ma kun la 'gre/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba spyi ltar byed cing 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rgyas bsdus gang rung 'don par dam bca' ba phyag len du snang ba bzhin bya zhing zhi drag sbrel nas mi byed na gtang rag bzod gsol nyer bsdu shis brjod kyang byed/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub pa chen po 'chi bdag bdud sgrub dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/zla ba tha chung bzhi'i mar ngo'i 'grub pa'i nyi ma'am yang na gza' tshes dang bstun te yar ngo la'ang rung bas dkyus gcig tu mi phyed pa'i dbang du btang dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas shis na'ang sbrel mar gtong ba'i dbang du byas te gong gi zhi bcas rnams bsdus pa'i shul du sman rag mchod gtor rtags mthong na 'bul ba'i rtags gtor/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ bgegs gtor/ tshogs chas/ baṃ bskang /chos skyong / gter srung gi (3bskoto me ma sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams bsham/ 'jam dpal zhi ba dang sbrel mar byed pa'i dbang gis phyogs skyong gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma dang rgyal mtho logs su mi dgos/ las byang rdo rje'i thog mtha' dkyus bzhin la/ /tshugs par nus min mthu rtsal ldan par gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar song nas zla gsang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu gsum pa dang / dregs pa tshar gcod kyi skabs brgyad par gsungs pa bzhin/ mgo bo rma bya bzhin du dgug /ru raka yi phreng ba bgrang / /mgon po nyid la gus byas te/ /zhes pa ltar bya/ dmigs pa ni/ phyi rol snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang / /nang bcud 'gro ba gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha/ /rang gi snying gar mchong skrug gur khang dbus/ /—397—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2napad zla nyi steng rang rig ye shes sems/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal mtshon gang tsam gyi tshad/ /sku mdog dmar ser zhal bstig phyag gnyis kyi/ /g.yas pas shes rab ral gri zhes pa nas/ /thebs gnyib/mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung can/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin len/ /thugs kar nyi steng rdor sngon rtse lnga'i lter/ /zla nyi'i steng na mthing nag hūṃ mthar sngags/ /bskor zhing 'khor bzhi'i thugs kur rdor zla nyi/ /hūṃ yig bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /sngags 'phreng las chad gnyis pa ljags steng brgyud/ /phyi rol 'dom gang tsam du sngags 'bru 'od/ /grangs med lnga skur gyur pa'i zhal nas kyang / /sngags sgrog 'od zer sne la lha mo'i tshogs/ /'phros te bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs kun mchod/ /sku gsung thugs byin bsdus (4na)nas bdag la thim/ /zhes pa dmigs pa dang bcas/ ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya māt+na ka hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa 'bum phrag drug gi bar du bsnyen no/ /de yang gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi yi ge 'khor lo rdzogs chen gi le'u las/ gong gi sngags mthar/ khro rgyal rngam pa'i rgyal po nyid/ /bdag dang dbyer med rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs gsungs la/ a kro 'bru bcu bdun pa dang nyi ma bzhi pa'i rtsa ba yi ge bcu bdun pa gsum po gang rung gdam ngar gsungs shing a kro bcu bdun pa 'jam dpal khro bo rin po che gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u sogs rgyud du ma nas bshad cing nyin bzhi'i rtsa ba gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi srog la drangs pa'i le'u nas bstan pas/ don la khyad par med na'ang yi ge bcu gcig pa nyid la gtso bor mdzad pa shas che'o/ /de ltar thun bzhi so so'i mthar gtor ma gsos la sman raka bran nas gtor bsngo byas pa'i mthar mchod cing thabs mchog bde chen nas bstod/spyir sngags stong phrag re song ba'i mtshams mchod bstod byed par bshad cing phyag len mang por snang brgyud dang mthun zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin mod 'dir thun mtshams tshor mchod bstod mdzad pas go chod pas thun mtshams bzhi por nges par dgos pa 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u las/ sngags kyi phreng ba stong rdzogs dang / /stong tshogs mchod dang bstod pa bya/ /drag tu gshin rje dgug pa ni/ khur bas bus la gshin mi bzlog /tshil chen mar me —398—

yang bzlog me'i skru gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+eḍū rla'i do shal/ nang ma(kha)rgyun mi (4ba)bcad/ /rdza rnga brdung zhing dbyug pas bgo /rmugs chen rmugs chung snying la bdo/ /dpa' bo grub rtags byung ba dang / /dngos grub dam shing blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshil chen gyi mar me sha chen dang gu gul bsres pa'i bdug pa dang / rdza rnga'i rol mo sogs bya ba gnad che'o/ /mtshams tshugs pa'i nub mo tsho gis kyang rgyas par dbul/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi yi ge 'khor lo rdzogs chen gyi le'u las/ sgo lnga rang so yul med bzhag /be shing 'khar ba thogasanas/ /bying nas rmugs par gyur pa na/ /'jam dbyangs khro bo'i 'dzab kyis bskul/ /g.yel zhing rgod par gyur pa na/ /mtshan ma lha yi sku la brtag /ces sogs gsungs pa'i 'di'i sgrub pa ma grol bar bying na 'dzab dbyangs bya zhing dal gyis bcag /rgod na bris sku sogs la blta zhing bying rgod sogs skyon gang yang med par dus kun tu bsgrims nas bzla bar bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ stegs bu'i khar thig tshon byin gyis brlabs te dur khrod kyi sa tshon gyis dkyil 'khor gru gsum mthing nag zla gam gsum dmar/ mu khyud mdzes tshon/ rtsibs bzhi ser/ thod rwa dkar/ de'i phyir sgo rdzogs bris kyang 'gal ba med na'ang 'jug pa bde bar byed na thod rwa'i phyi rol du rdor rwa me ri bris/ de'i steng du tshe bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i tsaka li 'dzugs pa'am/ 'jam dpal zhi khro'i rigs kyi sa 'bur byin can rnyed na rung zhing legs/ phyi nang mchod pa rnams bsham/ rang rang mdun bskyed kyi (na ji kyil 'khor dbyer med gcig pa'i tshul du las gzhud rdo rje'i thog mda' bsrangs la gong bzhin dmigs pa dang bcas te a kro 'bru bcu gcig pa 'bum phrag gsum du bsnyen no/ /gsum pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen thems kyang / /gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa las/ yab yum sngags kyi grangs thems kyang / /lha yi mtshan ma ma mthong na/ /sngags kyi dam tshig nyams srid pas/ /lhu rdum gsil la brgya gshags bya/ /de tshe mtshan rtags ma rnga zhe du ster/ / des kyang rtags rnams ma byung na/ /gsang sngags sil bur lto nas bzlog /ru sag ru nyal ru nyal dang / /ru bzlog drag pos gnad la dbab/ /gzhug la dam tshig bdar la bzhag /lha nyid gnad la dbab pa ste/ /—399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)kun gyis bya ba ma yin te/ /las rnams lkugs na bya ba yin/ /mi 'gro 'gro bar bya ba yin/ /mi 'grub 'grub par bya ba mā /dam tshig bdag pos rab tu gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ bshags pa dang sngags sdebs bya dgos kyang / bris sku 'dzum pa sogs dngos nyams rmi lam du rtags bzang po mthong na/tsan dan dmar po'i byang bu gnyis la rab 'bring tha gsum gyi rdzas gang rung gi gcig la sku dang /cig shos la gzugs bris pa'i khong pa dang rgyab tu yi ge 'god lugs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar la so so'i rdzas 'byug cing sra rtsis mnan pa kha sbyar ba dar tshon gyis dam du bcings nas rlan mi 'chor ba bya/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'bor steng du ma zhi'i khar mo thod mtshan ldan gyi nang du ba dmar (5ba)ser gyi 'o ma dang chang la man ngag las byung ba'i rdzas rnams btab pa hub gang tsam dang lhan cig par byang bu zhal phyogs ma log par gzhug /de steng pho thod mtshan ldan gyis bkab pa dar tshon sna lngas gril/ pho mo'i thod pa so sor ma rnyed na pho thod gnyis sbyar/ gzungs thag dmar po btags/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dngos grub kyi rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan chang gis bkang ba dang tshogs chas bza' bca' btung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa ci 'dzom/ tshe gal thun gsum/ gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang yo byad sna tshogs dang mchod gtor thams cad sngar bas bzang ba bshams/ 'phros te bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs kun mchod yan gong ltar la/ byin rlabs ma lus dngos grub rdzas la thim/ /zhes tshig dmigs cung zad bsgyur la gzungs thag nas bzung ste yig 'bru bcu gcig pa gnyid sogs spangs te shin tu brtson pas 'bum phrag gcig thengs ma thag sngags mthar dngos grub bsdu ba'i sham bu btags pa khri phrag gcig /dam bsre dngos grub blang ba'i sngags bsdebs stong tsam bzlas la/ nam gung yol tsam la tshogs rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas lha la 'bul ba'i bar byas te rang nyid tshogs la longs ma spyad pa'i snga rol tu nam tho rangs la bab pa'i tshe/ hoḥnam mkha'i khams mnyam zil gnon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sku yi dngos grub nam mkha'i dkyil yangs bzhin/ /gsung gi dngos grub 'gag med brjod dang bral/ /thugs kyi dngos grub mi rtog pa nyam pa'i ngang / /yon tan dngos grub —40/lha

yang bzlog me'i sbu gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+eḍū rla'i do shal/ nang ma(khanayid bzhin rin cen gter/ /'phrin las dngos (6na〉spyab rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnas skabs nad gdon bar gcod la sogs pa/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang / /mnga' thang snyan grags dgos dgu rgyas pa dang / /mos bzhis khams gsum srid gsum lha mi'i nor/ /yid la gang 'dod dbang du 'du ba dang / /bstan dang bla mar do bsdo bdag la 'tshe/ /dgra bgegs gang byung drag pos bsgral ba sogs/ /rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mthar thug bdag don phun tshogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ye shes sems pa'i go 'phang myur thob cing / /gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /gang la gang 'dul gzugs skus chos bstan nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la rab 'god pa'i/ /don gnyis phun tshogs dngos grub deng stsol cig /hūṃ/ yi dam rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid rigs 'dzin sgrub pa pos/ /'dzab bsnyen grangs su thems zin gyi/ /bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob zin gyi/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskangs zin gyi/ /sgrub pa'i zhag grangs thems zin gyi/ /rdo rje srin po nam langs nye/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ /dam can thugs dam bdag bskul gyi/ /sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang / /dam bcas ma bsnyel deng dgongs la/ /dngos grub dam pa da lta stsol/ /(6ba tshe zhes lan gsum dang / lha yi lha mchog ma dang bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i 'dod gsol yang lan gsum byas rjes dkyil 'khor dbus nas thod pa tshur blangs nas dbral bar gtugs te/ dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon las byung ba ltar/ hūṃ/dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /sku yi dbang mchog mi gshegs rdo rje yis/ /rdos bcas lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā ya sirnyi oṃ/ mgrin par gtad la/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /gsung gi dbang mchog mi gshegs rdo rje yis/ /'chal pa —401—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka wā ka sirnyi āḥ snying gar gtad la/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /thugs kyi dbang mchog mi gshegs rdo rje yis/ /'khrul pa sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka tsit+ta sirnyi hūṃ/gnas gsum du gtad la/ hūṃ/ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /rnam gsum dbang mchog mi gshegs rdo rje yis/ /dug gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/sne /sarba sirnyi pha la: zhes dbang blang / de nas thod pa zhal phye ste bla ma dngos su bzhugs na dang mi bzhugs na'ang bla ma yi dam la sman mchod gzhung bzhin byas nas rang nyid kyis longs spyad/ dngos grub kyi rdzas gzhan rnams la yang rol/ tshe sgrub kyi kha sgyur byed par 'dod na zhal las shes/ lhag ma/ chad mtho/ bstan skyong btang / gtang rag gi mchod pa dang yig brgya brgya'am nyer gcig gis lhag chad bkang rjes/ ye shes pa (7na)byang bu la bstim pa sogs man ngag ltar bya/nam ma langs gong du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bsdu'o/ /bzhi pa 'chi bdag bdud sgrub ni/ nam langs su nye ba na bca' gzhi bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar byas la/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ ya nag por bsgyur te 'od zer 'phro 'du sogs zhal shes bzhin byas nas 'bru bcu gcig pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa'i thun mtshams su las gshin lha bcu bdun ma dang / dregs pa'i sde dpon gyi gsol mchod byed/ de yang zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi skabs brgyad pa las/ bye ba chig 'bum thon pa dang / /me tog la sogs mchod pa bya/ /phyi nang gi ni mchod pas mchod/ /bstod pa la sogs ci rigs bya/ /zhes pa ltar bsnyen sgrub bzhi po bsgril bas gsang sngags bye ba gcig dang chig 'bum 'byung ba grangs kyi bsnyen pa/ dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig rtags kyi bsnyen pa/ de nyid las/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas rtags rnams 'byung / /'jam dpal sku ni zhal 'dzum mam/ /rtags ni bzang po byung ba dang / /dngos grub la sogs blang ba dang / /de nas drag po'i las sbyor 'jug /ces gsungs so/ /de'ang dang po bsnyen pa ni lha bsnyen pa'i rtsa ba ste 'phrin las 'khor lo bskor ba la —402

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+eḍū rla'i do shal/ nang ma(khanadabang / mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed/ /gnyis pa nye ba'i bsnyen pas lha dam la 'du nyid dmod mo nye bar bsnyen pa yin/ 'phrin las thun gyi las la dbang / thun mong gi dngos grub gtso bor thob/ gsum pa sgrub pa chen pos ni lha gnad la dbab cing dam la gdags pa dang phyis mi 'gyur bar tshe gcig la bsnyen pa (7ba/rdzogs/ sgrub pa gong ma gnyis kyi dngos grub blang ba'ang yin/ las rab 'byams 'grub bo/ /bzhi pa 'chi bdag bdud sgrub kyis ni mthar byed dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa las la 'dzud cing drag po'i 'phrin las gtso bor 'grub pa min no/ /de rnams kyang gzhi'i chos nyid dri bcas lam gyi chos nyid rang gsal btab pa'i 'bras bu chos dbyings dri bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mchog grub ni chos nyid do/ /sgrub pa bzhi po thengs nas tshogs 'khor bskang bshags/ gtang rag gi mchod pa rnams rgyas par bya'o/ /gsum pa mjug las sbyor rtsa bsnyen ni/ 'jam dpal snyan brgyud yang tig gsang ba'i man ngag las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje bsgrub 'dod pas/ /dur khrod bas mtha' 'jigs rung gshin rje'i gnas/ /dam nag rtsi shing rtsub cing brag ri mtho/ /'brub khung gru gsum mdun du yod pa'i sar/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rten rdzas bye brag bsham/ sha chen zla zhing thod chen ra sgo yang rung / phreng ba bzung /zhes gnam sa gru gsum sogs drag po'i gnas su bshad pa thog ma nas yod na dang / de min mtshamasasnga phyi bar chod na gnas de 'dra zhig 'tshol ba'i dbang du mdzad na'ang / da lta dkyus gcig tu byed par de bzhin ma grub kyang btang sgoms su bzhag /rten dang mchod rdzas sogs sngon nas yod bzhin pa mu 'thud pas gsar sgyur ma dgos/ pu ri dkar po thog ma nas bshams kyang 'gal ba med mod spyod yul dog na skabs 'dir bsham/ res gza' mig dmar dang dbo lta bu 'dzom pa'i stobs
