ldan sbyor ba mchog (8na)tu shes shing dus kyang dkar phyogs dang 'grig na dang / ma 'grig na nag phyogs la'ang rung / gnas khang gi btub na 'dir ma zad gong nas kha lhor bltas pa shis/ dom gyi pags dmar 'dang bar bshad pa sa gdan lta bu'i tshul gyi de steng gdan dngos gzhi 'ding / smin mtshams dang lus —403—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nakyi sul rnams su thal chen mkhur tshos dang dpral bar khrag chen/ lkog ma dang brang la zhag chen mi rus kyi rgyan dang mi lpags sam ro chas kyis bgo ba sogs dur khrod kyi chas rgyan ci 'dzom thog ma'i thun mgo tsam la gang 'grub dang de nas mos pa bya zhing seng ngam be shing gi 'khar ba dang ral pa'i cod pan sogs dam tshig gi yo byad rnams 'du byas nas/ las byang rdo rje thog mda'i gzhung bsrangs pa'i/ /gzung 'dzin rnam dag mtshan ma'i yul las 'das/ /zhes gdengs gsum gsal gdab pa yan dkyus ltar byas nas/ ā+oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gtso bo'i 'dzab bye ba gcig dang chig 'bum mam 'bum phrag brgyad gang rung / /ā+oṃ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sarba tsit+ta gzir thums shig nan/ trig nan rbad ya/ bzlog ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yum sras 'chi bdag /srog bdag dang bcas pa'i sngags yin pas so sor chig 'bum re bzla dgos par phyi ma sbas lha gnyis kyi sngags bsdoms pas ldab 'phar bzla dgos shing bsnyen pa thun bzhir bcad de bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral bar bzla/ thun bzhin gtor ma sha zan sman rag gis gsos nas dgug gzhug lan (8bsko sum dang drag gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs gtso 'khor lnga'i sngags kyis dbul/ thabs mchogo bde chen mas bstod/ lha yi lha mchog ma/ /bskal pa dpag med ma/ mkhyen brtse nus mnga' ma/ nam mkha' med pa sogs kyi smon lam 'dod gsol bya/ bzlas pa thams cad skyon dang bral ba dgos pa'ang 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub pa rtsa ba'i le'u las/ myur ba ma yin bul ba min/ /de bzhin yi ge 'dres pa min/ zhan tu gsal zhing dag par smra/ /zhes dang / gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i las thams cad grub par byed pa'i 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni/ /de lta'i tshul du bzlas pa bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /ces thun mtshams su byed dgos shing gong ma rnams la'ang shes so/ /bsnyen pa thengs nas tshogs 'khor brgya'am nyer gcig /gter srung mchod pa bzabs rgyas/ bam bskang / gtang rag mchod gtor kha gsos bsngos la chos sku zhi ba mas thog steng du 'bul/ bzod gsol/ nyer bsdu/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/—404

yang bzlog me'i skru gri'i las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bsnyen yig be+eḍū rla'i do shal/ nang ma(kha)shis brjod rnams las byang bzhin bya zhing / nang mtshams grol nas har 'don mi byed pa mtshams spyo dang 'dra/ dgu gsum la tsho gos dang mchod gtor dbul ba rgyan bsnyen nar mar byed pa gal che'o/ /da yang bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i rtags rags pa tsam ni nang rtags su/ sku gsung thugs gang la rtag par sems lhang nge 'dug pa dang lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang snang ba gang yang mthong ba (9na)dang lus yod du mi tshor zhing dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar lhan ne 'dug pa dang dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang rtog med gyi bde ba rang la 'char ba ste bsnyen pa rdzogs shing sems las su rung ba rtags dang po'o/ /phyi rtags su sku gzugs 'gul ba'am ba 'ad pa'am steng nas lung ston pa'i sgra thos pa'am lho phyogs nas sgo bye ba snyam byed pa'am mdun gyi nam mkhar 'od kyi lha'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba'am 'od dang sgra dang dri zhim po dang gtor ma dang sman rag khol ba dang mchod rdzas dang sgrub rdzas la me 'bar ba dang skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshod sprul te gtam zer ba rnams ni mngon rtags so/ /nyams kyi rtags ni nyams mi dga' na bdud kyi bar chad yin pas nyams brtag go /rmi ltas su/ nyi ma mang po nam mkha' la shar ba dang nam mkha' 'od kyis khengs pa dang zla ba thang la lhung ba dang rdo rje'i slob dpon dang rtag tu 'phrad cing 'grogs pa dang dbang bskur ba dang mchod rten la 'dzegs pa dang ri la 'dzegs pa dang rnga brdung ba dang a tsar mang po gtam zer ba dang / mon pa nag po 'khol ba dang bsdo'i tshul du byung ba dang sngags pa dang mi nag gcer bu dar thogs pa dang bud med nag mo phyag byed pa dang / ma dang sring mo dang mdza' mos 'tsho ba sbyor ba dang brag la mi lhung ba dang chu la mi bying ba dang nam mkha' la 'phur ba rnams rmi'o/ /rtags 'di rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa byung na rab/phyed tsam rdzogs pa byung na 'bring / 'ga' zhig byung na tha ma yin no/ /bsnyen pa thengs dus rtags rab 'bring tha ma gang rdzogs kyang dngos grub blangs te las kyi sbyor ba byas na gang byas kyang (9ba tshe srub par 'gyur te the tshom med do/ /rtags kyi yi ge zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /zhes pa rnams ni gshin rje kha thun gyi ṭīk+ka phan byed snying gi nyi ma dang rtags yig sogs las byung ba'o/ /de yang gong gi bsnyen pa'i —405

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nadus thams cad du gshin rje nag po'i sngags rgyud nag po'i bsnyen pa'i le'u las/ mi smra glal sbrid gnyid rmugs dang / /sgra chen sgra chung spangs pa dang / /drag thal ring thung rdzogs pa dang / /yid la shub bur bzlas pa'i thabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bza' btung dang bshang gci 'dor ba dang gnyid dang /klal ba/ sprid pa/ snabs/ lud pa/ 'og rlung shor ba rnams kyi skabs bzlas pa'i sngags de dag bzlas pa'i grangs su mi bgrang / gzhan yang phreng skor 'khor nas mdo 'dzin rtsar ma sleb pa'i bar rnams su mi dang gtam shor na sngar bcad zin nas phreng rdog bzhi/ slo lu na lnga/ glal na gsum/ sbrid pa la bcu/ mchil snabs lud pa sogs 'dor na gcig /'og rlung la bdun/ gnyid la lo lnga rnams grangs su mi brtsi bar slar ldog la bgrang / bza' btung byed bzhin pa dang bshang gci 'dor bzhin par sngags bzla ba gtan nas spong / bza' btung byas pa/ gnyid dang glal sgrid byung ba/ /bshang gci dang mchil snabs dor ba/ 'og lung shor ba rnams kyi rjes su chab ma blangs par sngags la mi 'jug /glo lu ba nas gnyid kyi bar drug po la 'phreng rdog grangs nges can slar ldog pa ni zhi bsnyen dang zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen 'chi bdag bdud sgrub las sbyor rtsa bsnyen rnams kyi skabs(10na)yin la/ gzhi bsnyen gyi sgrub pa chen po'i skabs ni glal dang sbrid pa dang gnyid dang rkang lag brkyang bskum rnams ye ma shor ba dang 'og rlung mchil snabs lud pa slo lu ba rnams byung na gong ltar phreng rdog grangs bcad slar ldog par bya ba 'dir ma zad sngags rnying ma'i bsnyen sgrub thams cad la dgos mi dgos dpyad do/ /mjug tu mchod rten dkar nag la brten pa'i las sbyor ram gtor ma la brten pa'i srung bzlog bya zhing kha skong gi sbyin sreg kho bos brtsams pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gaṅgā'i chu rgyun nas lha sngags 'byin 'jug byas pas 'grub bo/ /zla gsang rgyud sde 'o ma'i rgya mtsho cher/ /brgyud pa'i gsung sgros ri bo bsgril ba las/ /bsnyen yig sa srungs rin cen rgyan spras nas/ /dngos grub thang la lhod po'i 'gros kyis rgyu/ /lha sras mjing yon yang srid 'bri gung pa'i/ /zhal gdams phab rtsis sbran pa'i legs bshad chang / /btungs pas ci —406

yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thogs mda' lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ nang ma(kha)dgar myos pa'i bsnyen yig gi /snyan po'i rgyang glu spobs mtho'i mgrin nas blangs/ /de phyir chos 'di mos ldan du ma'i rnar/ /ches mngar ro brgya bda' ba'i bcud 'khyil mthus/ /skye bar 'jam dpal rdo rjes rjes bzung ste/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po me'i spu gri'i srung bzlog bsad mnan nyams su blang ba la med du mi rung ba'i gzhi bsnyen dang rtsa bsnyen gyi yi ge be ḍūrla'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni kyi gnubs sngagasa'achang zil gnon rdo rjes bskul bas rkyen byas lam 'dir mos pa'i snod ldan mang por phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas(10ba)blangs te bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag 'di dag dpal 'bri gung pa dbur smyon chen po'i zhal las dngos su thos shing sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub la yang bskyar du dpyad pa za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal rgyas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa snod min la 'chal bar mi ston pa'i bka' rgya yod pas gter srung rnams kyis thub par srungs shig/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya// // sarba maṅga lo//yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'i lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan dus dgra'i ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin/ /drin can bla ma spyi gtsug pad mtsho sa /brten nasayang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i/ /las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'i lhan thabs 'bri/ /'jam dpal dmar nag 'khor sa tseg phyag gnyis pa/ /dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser 'bar/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs mi bzad khro zhing tha yis/ /phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'phen/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rgyun rnams rdzogs/ /'khas gnyis brkyang bskum pad zla'i gdan la bzhengs/ /zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad gyur/ waṃ/ mdun du sku yi —407—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sprul pa 'chi bdag nag /gshin rje bdud po bye ba dbu khri ni/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsal ri rab/ /'phyar zhing dgra sta g.yon gdengs sku sked la/ /lcags kyi zhun khrab zhing chen ska rags tshul/ /stag sham zhing chung chos gos thod skam lngas/ /dbur brgyan gdug pa'i sbrul gyis yan lag dkris/ /zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad cing chu glang chibs/ /sku sprul bye ba sa ya'i 'khor gyisabaskor/ /rgyab tu gsung gi sprul pa srog gi bdag /nag po sgrol ring chen po rme ru rtse/ /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /gdug pa sbrul gyi ral pa spyi bor bcings/ /thod pas rnar brgyan g.yas pa be con 'phyar/ /g.yon pa zhags 'dzin rus sbal nag po yi/ /g.yang gzhi gsol zhing zhabasaganyis dor stabs su/ /bgrad nas(2na7sa kyi rlung dmar rta la chibs/ /gsung sbrul bye ba sa ya'i 'khor dang bcas/ /gnyis ga'i thugs kar dmar nag ya yi mthar/ /sarba tsit+ta gzir thum lhag nan trig nan bod ya bzlog ya/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor bar gyur/ waṃ/ sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po gshegs su gsol/ /gsung sprul srog bdag nag po gshegs su gsol/ /'khor gyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /waṃ/ 'chi bdag nag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srog bdag nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'khor gyi gshin rje'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /waṃ/mdun na sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po ni/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa ri rab g.yon pa dgra sta rnams/ /gnam lcags zhun khrab zhing lpags stag sham gsol/ /thod skam dbu rgyan zhing chung chos gos can/ /sbrul gyis brgyan cing chu glang sngon po bcibs/ /sku sprul 'chi bdag thugs dam dus la babs/ /'chi bdag bye ba sa ya dgra la bh+yoḥ ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma lha bsrung rang gshed rang la phog /rgyab na gsung sprul srog bdag nag po ni/ /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /thod pa'i rna cha sbrul nag ral pa bcings/ /g.yas pa be con g.yon pa zhags pa bsnams/ /sku la rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi gsol/ /'khas gnyis (2ba)dor stabs las kyi rlung dmar bcings/ /gsung sprul srog bdag thugs dam dus la babs/ /srog —408

yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thogs mda' lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ nang ma(kha)bdag bye ba sa ya dgra la bh+yoḥ ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byad ma lha bsrung rang gshed rang la phob/ ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor/ /bsrung zhing skyobs pa'i 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / /nad gdon bar gcod zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /tshe dpal 'byor ba rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /mon bzhis khams gsum dbang sdud las mdzod cig /gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /'chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /rmi ltas mtshan ngan bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zhag skeg za skeg bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad ma lha bsrung rang gshed rang la phob/dmigs pa'i dgra bo gzugs ling ming bcas 'di'i/ /bla khug dbugs phyogs mgo 'khor khrag tu skyugs/ /rgyal zhing lus sems phrol la srog rtsa chod/ /tshe yi 'du byed bkum la myur du gsod/ sha khrag gzugs phung 'byung ba zhal du thog /bsad rtags srog rnying dmar po khyer la shog /byad ma lha bsrung rang gshed rang la phob/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bo lha bsrung dang bcas pa'i/ /lusang ga yid gsum ldang du med par gnon/ /bla dang rnam shes nus mthu rnam par chings/ /tshe srog lus dbang rlung rta nyams par gyis/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor phun tshogs thal bar rlog /rtag tu thar pa med pa'i gnas su chug /byad ma lha bsrung rang gshed rang la phob/ /thun phur las kyi gshin rje dmar nag mdog /zhal waṇi ga phyag gnyis g.yas pa be con ni/ /bsdigs pa'i rnam pas 'phyar zhing dgra bgegasakyi/ /don snying g.yon pas 'drad tshul sdigs mdzub kyis/ /thun thag nas 'dzin stag lpags sham thabs can/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhugs par gyur/ /mdun du las gshin nag po zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis g.yas pa gser gyi ral gri yi/ /rtsibs stong 'khor lo klad la rab bskor bas/ /dgra bgegs byad ma lha bsrung dum bur gtubs/ /(3na gi yon pa gser 'khor rtsibs stong phub lta bur/ 'dzin pas bdag sogs bsrung bya ma lus skyob/ /spyi bor lam las bu ri nag cing 'tsher/ /bang rim dgu pa ri rab spongs tshadi tsam/ /mgo mjug ldog pa gcig gis mnan pa'i steng / /lha bsrungs409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nagur khung pu ri dang bcas brjid/ /lcags 'khor rtsibs bzhi rno ngar ldan pa yis/ khog pa rgyangs pas g.yo zhing 'gul mi nus/ /rang gi mdun du khro bo rab 'jigs pa/ /sku dang yan lag rags shing phyag gnyi khe/kyis/ /spu gri lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i thugs ka nas/ khro bo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /thogs pa dpag med spros pas byad ma rnams/ /bkug nas rang gshed rang la dbab par gyur/ /thun gtor ni/ hūṃ/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /tshe bdag nag po yum chen sras mchog dang / /'chi bdag srog bdag las gshin 'khor tsho gos rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang / /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bden pa dang / phyag rgya zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i lha tshogasarnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang / rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' bden pa dang / chos nyid ngo bo ka nas dag kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob skyabs yul dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ gdug pa dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ lo rgyal po'i skeg sri/ zla ba blon po'i skeg sri/ zhag dmag mi'i sgeg sri/ dus tshod mtshon cha'i sgeg sri/ za lam du dug g.yo ba/lus la mtshon kha gtod pa/ g.yul 'khrug /'thab rtsod/ kha smras/ dmod mo/ chags che ba/ nyam nga ba/rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan ma ngan pa/ ltas(3ba)ngan pa dus min 'chi ba/ nad dang rims dang sdebargyad 'byung po'i gnod pa sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya bzlog bzlog /byad bzlog gtso bor byed tshe dmigs bsal yod na khyad par che ge mo dang / med na ban bon sngags pas btags pa'i rbad 'dre rbod gtong / phar phyin bka' mthu'i mdo sgrub/ byad kha phur kha/ mnan gtad/ mdos zor/ hom 410

yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thogs mda' lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ nang ma(khanadang par bu/ rlung gi zhabrul 'khor sogs rigs sngags kyi stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dang ngan sngags kyi dpal dang / kho'i chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad kho rang gi steng du zlog cig /rang srog rang gis cho de cig /rang sha rang gis zo zhig /rang khrag rang gis thungs shig /rang nus rang la smin cig /rang mtshon rang la rgyab shig /rang gshed rang la phob la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du rlog cig /mā ra ya bzlog bzlog bh+yo bh+yo/ phyag g.yon dang po'i lcags kyus byad ma yi/ /snying ga'i rjer nas bzung ste gzugs la stim/ /g.yas pa'i 'khor los gtubs te sha khrag gtor/ /skyabs bral nyam thag dgra der kho rang gi /lha bsrung rnams kyang log lta cher skyes nas/ gshed gyur mtshon cha'i char 'beb srog rtsa gcod/ khog par lcags 'khor rtsibs bzhi rno ngar rtses/ /srog rtsa khrag rtsa rbad rbad gcod/ sha khrag rus rnams gtubs te dmar thor btang / /lha tshogs sprul pa gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams//bsad sngags drag po 'brug ltar sgrog byed cing / sha za khrag 'thung rus mur las byed gyur/ /pu ri nag po ri rab gling bzhi yis/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas mnan cing lce thog tu/ /gser rdor rgya gram yan lag bzhi yi tshig /rdo rjes gzer zhing snying khar rtsibs bzhi pa'i/ /'khor lo rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan te/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'khyog 'gul med par gyur/ /oṃ a ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa sod/ gye ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa sod/ gh+ri ma du ru tsakra sa sod/ sarba tsit+ta gzir thum lhag nan trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya sod ya/ dgra bo byad ma lha bsrung dang bcas pa'i sha la rgyug /snying la mā ra ya (4na)rgyug song /dbugs la rgyug /srog la mā ra ya rgyug sod/ khrag la rgyug /rtsa la mā ra ya rgyug sod hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo byad ma lha bsrung dang bcas pa mā ra ya sod ya/ rtsi mā ra ya rbad ya/ ā+oṃ ra tri srog la mā ra ya rbad ya/ klu bdud nag po dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ swe e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa nan/ da phya ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa nan/ gh+ri ma du ru tsakra sa nan/ sarba tsit+ta gzer thum bhi ga nan trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya nan ya/dgra bo'i sha la rgyug /snying la mā ra ya rgyug nan/ dbug la rgyug /srog la mā ra ya rgyug nan/ khrag la rgyug /rtsa la mā ra ya rgyug nan hūṃ phaṭa/ byad ma lha bsrung dang bcas pa'i kā ya wā ka tsi/sto bha ya nan/—411—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rtsi sha ku pu rtsi sha ku mu kha so pa ti yaṃ ru ti yaṃ sen ya sen/ man yaṃ snying tshal bar rbad bam ril rbad/ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma khyod kyi bla rten tshe rten srog rten ci yod pa thams cad 'dir khug myur du shog cig /oṃ a kro te ka ya mun ta ka ka la rū pa dgra bo rje e ku sha dzaḥdzaḥya ma rā tsa klu ling sang sang ku ta hūṃ phaṭa/ bla 'gugs kyi mon pa bzhi'i bskul ni/ e/ chos dbyings drag po'i zhing khams na/ /phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas rnams/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bla kun jag pa las la khye/ /dza:shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa/ dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo /dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs/ /phyag dgu 'khas dgu tsit+ta dgu/ /'khas dgus stong gsum bla la rgyug /spyan dgus dgra bo lta zhing 'dzin/ /snying dgus dgra bo zhe la gnon/ /phyag dgus khong nas tsit+ta 'byin/ /zhal dgus kha mngar med par gsol/ /ljags dgus nyams pa'i khrag la 'thung / /gang la bya ba khyod kyibs shes/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di'i/ /bla dang rnam shes khug la shog /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /tsan ru tra mo man+ta dzaḥrbad bh+yo drag po che ge mo rje e ku sha dzaḥdzaḥdza: lho yi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa/ lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo /dbu (4ba ji gusaḥ phyag dgus zhabs dgus spyan ཿ snying la phyagaḥ zhal ljags ca gang laḥ yid laḥ bla dang ca dmaraḥbacolaḥ ya ma mo n+ta dzaḥ nub kyi phyogs bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo /dbu phyag zhabs: spyanaḥ snying cha phyag zhalaḥ ljags gang laḥ yid laḥ bla dang tsha dmaraḥ bcolaḥ rak+ṣa man+taḥ dzaḥ byang gi gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo/ཿ — ཿ — zaḥ pa:ཿ ཿཿcha — — yak+ṣa mo n+ta — sdebargyad byung tshul ltar bskul ba ni/e/ nga ni phyag rgya zil gnon gshin rje gshed/ /zhi dang khro bo thams cad nga yi sku/ dregs pa thamasacad rang byung rang shar rdzogs/ /las kun sgrub phyir rang rtsal so sor snang / /spyi bo'i rtsa nas ya shar gshin rje byung / /lte ba'i rtsa nas ma shar ma mo byung / snying ga'i rtsa nas na shar klu rgyal byung / /mgrin pa'i rtsa nas ra shar rgyal po byung / shangs kyi khungs nas shar gza' rgod byung / /snyan gyi khungs nas k+ṣa gar gnod sbyin byung / /spyan mig gnyis nas tsa shar btsan rgod byung / /phyag zhabs mthil nas—412

yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thogs mda' lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ nang ma(kha)du shar dmu rgyal mdud/ /snang srid pho mo klu gsum gyis bsdus pa'i/ /dregs pa 'khor g.yog dmag dpung bcas pa rnams/ /bskul lo bod do yid la brnags pa'i dgra/ /rings par bla tshe khug la srog rtsa chod/ /bsad rtags srog snying dmar po khyer la shog tar khrag rus zod me zhabrug dal yam dang //thog ser than ltas ngan pas dgra yul khongs/ /myur du rtags phyung thal ba'i rdul du rlog /oṃ ya māt+na ka e dzaḥdzaḥhring hring ya man ra shak+ṣa tsa du dzaḥdzaḥhrang hring rbad bh+yo mā ra ya bsod dgra po'i sha khrag rus pa nang khrol phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa kha raṃ ji hi/ so bsdebs nas gsungs pa'i bdud bzhi slong ba'i dregs pa'i bskul/ hūṃ/ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku mdog sngon nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs/ /sa yi rang bzhin spyi gtsug rtsa la 'jig /dam nyams sgral phyir tshangs pa'i gtsug thag chodaḥ dngas ma bsdus la klad khrag zho ltar phyosaḥ 'dod chags khrag mtsho dmar po'i nang gshed naḥ(ldan༄ga mdog dmar po bse yi ral pa can chu yi rang bzhin sdig pa bgrad pa'i tshulaḥ dam nyams bsgral phyir mgrin pa'i rtsa chod la dngas ma bsdus la khrag ltar skyug tu chug nga rgyal kem rus 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku mdog dud kha rngam pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /'jigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rtsa mdud 'joms dam nyams bsgral phyir lte ba'i rtsa chod la dngas ma bsdus la lus sems bral bar gyis gti mug dug mtsho 'khol ma'i nang gshed na: srog bdag nag po ma rung ral pa can mche ba gtsigs shing dug gsum khong du 'jams: skye 'gro srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog sdud rlung gi rang bzhin dkar nag mtshams na gnas: dam nyams bsgral phyir srog gi rtsa chod la:dngas ma bsdus la tshe yi 'du byed bskums g.yin yang 'chi bdag 'khor na gnas pa yi: las kyi gnod sbyin ma mo nag mo bdun : lcags kyu 'bar bas dgra snying khyer la shog mon pa gsod byed me dang 'khor lo bsnams: gnam lcags mda' dang gdugs pa'i khram bam thogs: khyi mo dmar mo don snying bla cho: bya nag bdun ni khong nas tsit+ta 'byin dug sprul bdun ni khong nas dug mda' brdegs rus sbal mdun ni dgra bo'i tshe srog sdud: sdig pa bdun ni dgra po'i srog dbugs len: dus la bab —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)po dam rdzas 'di long la: dam nyams ru tra 'di la rang gshed phob: rang gi lag pa gnyis nyi zlar gyur pa'i/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga oṃ hūṃ /hrīḥ.āḥ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga hūṃ lī / sī lha las rigs lnga yab yum tu gyur pa'i sbyor mtshams nas sras mchog zil gnon gī lwa ya rdo rje'i gzhog pa can/ dbu gsum phyag drug gis mtha' ma gnyis phyag mtshan dang bcas pas phur bu thugs kar bsgril ba/ 'chang bzung rdo rje'i lte bar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal yab yum/ yar mar gyi ra lnga la zhi khro rigs lnga yab yum/ rgya mdud gong mar yi dam/ 'og mar bka' bsrung bzhugs pa/ sku smad phur bu me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba'i dbal la dregs pa'i dmag tshogs/(5ba)rtse mor mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub pa/ bsgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar zhing phyar ba tsam gyis khams gsum dngang pa/ brdabs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs brlag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī lā ya kā ya wa ka tsit+ta a bhi ṇiñca oṃ āḥ&/ phur bu la 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin brlabs bsdus te thim pas khams gsum dus gcig tu sgrol ba'i dbang dang ldan par bsam/ na maḥs māt+na burnya nai ka ya wa ka tsit+ta ya mān+ta ka badz+raki li gī lwa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: gshin rje rol ba'i dur khrod wo po na shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa: gshin rje yongs rdzogs drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod ma ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li ki lwa ya la bsad sngags sbyar te gdab/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /snying rje chen pos rab bsgral te/ /thugs rje thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ rnam shesargyal ba'i sras su spar/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī lwa a rje yaṃ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/ bo dhi tsit+ta rtsir 6ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa bzhin bya/ hūṃ/ drag po sgrol mdzad phur bu yis/ /lus kyi 'khrul pa rtsad gcod phyir/ /lte ba'i dkyil du gī lwa ya/ /gzugs su mig gi dri rtsa sna yiḥ sgra rtsa rna ba'i: ro ru: lte yi 'khor bar gsang ba'i reg byaraḥ yan lag bzhi la : sa ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya la bsad sngags btags te gdab/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya phrag gsum/ hūṃ brgya phrag /oṃ āX3/brgya phrag bzlas nas gso ba gsum gyi dmigs pa byed/ phur pa rnams man ngag ltar gdab/ dreg —414

yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thogs mda' lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod chas/ nang ma(kha)bskul thun bskul/ zor bskul dang bcas te thun dang gtor zor brdeg /hūṃ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /thogs med drag po'i mtshon cha yis/ /dgra bgegs log rtog dug lnga'i tshogs/ /'khor ba'i skye rgyun rtsad nas chod/ /bsad sngags dang bcas te (6na〉tshon mas bsgral/ hūṃ/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas pas/ /nyams pa'i tshe srog lusang ga yid/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlag par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra kro ta a ko ṭa ya kha the kha the mchu chings mchu chings/ zhes brdungs pa'i mthar btab pa sogs dkyus bzhin no/ /rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag /phyag g.yas dang po 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i/ /be con bsnun pas sa gzhi shag gi khas/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po sngo mer mthong / /dza: lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa yi 'og /sgo med gshin rje'i grong khyer lcags khang nang / /las gshin 'chi bdag bye ba dgu ring ni/ khro gtums mdog nag khrag gdangs mche gtsigs pa/ /lag gnyis mnan gtad len pa'i phyag rgya byas/ /mi lpags rlon pa'i gos gyon ma ho zhe ne/ /'chi bdag gshin rje bye ba g.ya dang / /sa bdag klu gnyan sdebargyad dregs pa'i 'khor/ /grangs med kyis bskor deng 'dir skad cig la/ /ya ma rā dza sam ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes dar nag gis g.yab/ rkang gling lan gsum 'bud/ bshug glu lan gsum kyur/ /dzornga drag tu brdung / gsur chen gyi dud pa dang bcas te 'bod/ /dmar chen khrag gi a lha skyems su 'bul/ /bzhes shig rol cig 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs/ /ya ma rā dzā ma hā rak+ta a: khā raṃ 'a hi zhes khrag chang 'byer/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /bzhes shig rol cig: ya ma rā dza ma hā ba ling ta khā hi/ zhes gtor ma 'bul/ de nas bskul 'gugs dbye mthar/ hūṃ/ lho phyogs dpag tshad brgyad khri mar 'das na/ /thod pa lcags kyi mun khang grong khyer cher/ /gshin rje yongs kyi ded dpon 'chi bdag nag /gson po skos 'debs gshin po rnams kyi rje/ /dge sdig chos bzhin spyod (6ba)pa'i rdzu lngal can/ /bka' gnyan sdo brgyad dregasapa'i dmag tshogs la/ /gzugs byang ming rus btab pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /gnyer du gtad do gshin rje'i lag tu gtad/ /gshin rje'i lag tu chud pas 'chor mi srid/ /415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gtad do 'chi bdag nag po'i lto bar gtad/ /zas su gtad kyi slar yang ma skyug sdoms/ /gtad do lha srin sde brgyad lag tu gtad/ /sngo dmar byad du bcug pas 'tshor mi srid/ /gshin rje klu gnyan sde brgyad dmag tshogs kyis/ /bskal pa ma stongs bar du ma btang zhig /zhes brjod cing skyur/ hoḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po khyod kyi lto ba na/ srid pa gsum yod de khyod kyis mi 'grub pa'i las gang yang med pas snga dgra lag la brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra khyi ltar zug pa/ sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba/ lus la na tsha gtong ba/ srog la bar gcod gtong ba/ zas nor la god kha gtong ba/ za lam du dug g.yo ba/ 'gro lam du rtsangs 'dzugs pa/ grosang na dmag bgoms byed pa/mthu byed dmod pa gtong ba sogs bsam ga sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs spyi dang khyad par gzugs byang ming rus btab pa'i dgra bgegs 'di rnams kyis tshe srog bsod nams/ kha rje dbang thang / mthu stobs nus pa/ lusang ga yid gsum/ thams cad bskal pa ma stong gi bar du nam yang thar ba med par gnon cig sha chen don snying zas su zo zhig /dmar chen khrag rgyun skom du 'thung zhig /pags rlon dmar bsus gos su gyon cig /nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ mi tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin gyi skye 'chi la khungs ma 'tshol bar da lta nyid du gsod cing gnon pa'i mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /hūṃ/ 'byung ba gdan bzhi'i rngam 'og na las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni: ya mtshan che la med du byung : mun nag thibs pa'i (7na khog na bzhugs: g.yas pa'i phyag na ri rab bsnams g.yon pa'i phyag na rgya mtsho bsnams: zha khas kyi rlung gi 'khor lo gnon dam nyams dgra bo las ༅ 'di mnan pa las kyi dus la bab: sgo med lcags mkhar nang du chug gshin rje rnams kyi zas su byin 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chug: ri bo chen po'i rmang du gnon nam yang ldang bar ma byed cig che ge mo mā ra ya stam bha ya nan/zhes brjod/ khong chud gshin rje sdebargyad kun dga' zhing zhes sogs gi dang dmar chung gi chog bsgrigasachos rgyal ma ma ga'i mtshan can gyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin dang ཿ 'byung ba lnga'i sngags lag len dang 416

yang bzlog las byang rdo rje'i thogs mda' lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs/ nang ma(khanabastun pa'i mthar na mo sangs rgyas sogs dang bcas te thal rdeb lan bdun gyi rjes su lag tshags dam par byas nas/ las bzhi'i bro brdung / de ltar yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i ngag 'don lhan thabs 'di ni lag len dmar khrid du bstar nas khong du chud par byed pa las gzhan du ma dang dkyus gcig tu 'dri ba dang gsal byed kyi mchan bu 'debs pa sogs byas pa byung na 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje bhe wa sa twas snying khrag hub kyis bzhes la tshar gcod cig /de ltar rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i zhal gyi drod/ /ma nyams lag len gnad kyi zur rgyan 'di/ /bkod pas bdud sde'i ru mtshon par bsnyal te/ dkar po chos kyi ba dan bsgreng bar shog /ces yang bzlog me'i sbu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda' la nye bar mkho ba'i gzu dpang dregs pa'i bskul sogasang ga 'don bklags chog ma zur bkol dang zab gnad sha kha la rag las pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs tshang bar bkod pa'i lhan thabs rig 'dzin zhal gyi drod rlangs 'di ni gter gzhung yig rnying sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung rnams phal cher rang sor bzhag tshigs lhug phal cher (6ba thigs bcad du bsdebs shing khyer bde ba'i ched du 'ga' zhig la phri bsnon cung zad bgyis te za hor gyi rigs las sngags pa nag bo zil gnon drag rtsal gyis shing sbrul hor zla bdun pa'i dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshes la sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /bskud pa ser po la badz+ra ri ri bam ri phud dmar po la kha la rag sha rbad sngon po la da rnyi rbad su rbad dkar po la lo shi kha du 'byung ba rig na nam nag po la zla shi pra sha srod hūṃ/ sa ser bo la/ badz+ra ra ri baṃ phaṭa/ dmar po la ma hā sa ri nā gā hūṃ sngon po la sad ri sad shig sad hūṃ/ dkar po la lo shi kha rag sha rbad hūṃ/ nag po la du na pa ri thib nad 'byung ba hūṃ/ rdo la nā ga ma ra ya sod chu la byi ra sa lhag mug thum ril rbad dza/—417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nayang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda' bzhugs/rgyal kun yab tu 'jam dpal rdo rje zhi zhing dul ba'i gar mdzad kyang / /dus kyi dgra bor ches cher rab khros srid gsum za ba tshe bdag nag /khrag 'thung tshogs kyi dbang phyug gang dang gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i gzugs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma gtsug na rab mdzes byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyongs/ /rgya bal mkhas shing grub brnyes thugs kyi bcud/ /gnubs chen gdams pa'i nying khu zab mo'i gnad/ /zhang khrom gter byon rang la shed 'bebs pa'i las/ /sngags yong yongs kyi lag char 'os pa'i mtshon/ /de phyir rang srung go gyon sbyor stobs bzlog /lha srung bdud dbab dmag dpon g.yul du gsod/ /btson nang dong rul ga kho ba'i las kun gyi/ /thun mongs gyer sgom rdo rje'i thog 'di'o/ /de'ang slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dges 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i rgyud las lag len man ngag tu bsdebs pa dpal o rgyan chen po dang bal po ba su dha ra'i thugs kyi brnag pa/ drag sngags kyi bdag po gnubs kyi khyad chos/ sprul sku rgya zhang khrom gyi zab gter yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i srung bzlog bsad (2na7nan gyi rim pa nyams su blang ba la/ spyir 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'bor du dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang / khyad par snyan brgyud rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang zab mo sgrub skor gyi lung man ngag phyag bzhes rnams legs par nos nas gong bsnyen zhal shes ltar tshad du 'byol ba'i rig sngags long bas bca' gzhi'i rim pa rnams gsung rgyun dang phyag bzhes bzhin du bstar nas 'phrin kyilas gzhung gyer ba la/ brgyud 'debs ni/ rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag gshin rje'i gshed/ /rdo rje rnon po dga' rab rdo rje'i zhabs/ /'jam dpal bshes gar+sā shan+ti gar+bha dang / /ye shes snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /nam mkha'i snying po rgya gar khrag 'thung nag /gtsug lag dpal dge rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /ba su dha ra gnubs chen sangs rgyas zhabs/ /yon tan rgya 4/8

yang bzlog me'i skru gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)mtsho rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rdo ston lcags dpe ba/ /me ston dran chung dran ston mtha' bral rje/ /dkon cog rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mthar phyin lha sgom rnams la gsol ba (2ba 'debs/ /gangs pa shāka 'bum gra phyi g.yung ston pa/ /rgyal ba rdo rje rig 'dzin dar ma 'bum/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ston pa sangs rgyas mgon/ /bla chen khams ston rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' nas brgyud dang slar yang gter ston rgya/ /lha rje gnubs chung mtshur ston sku zhang dpal/ /tshul khrims rin cen byang mgon nam mkha'i mtshan/ /tshul khrims rgya mtsho rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' gter zung 'jug rgya ston nam mkha' dpal/ /gnam lcags me 'bar chos rgyal phun tshogs rje/ /gtsun yag sprul sku bkra shis phun tshogs zhabs/ /drag po'i mtshan can rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha sras dbur smyon bsod rin 'phrin las mtshan/ /kun mkhyen nyang ston slar yang rgyal sras rje/ /byang bdag yab sras grang so gter ston mched/ /mthu chen bstan rgyam rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khon ston khyab bdag dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs/ /slar yang snang gsal rig 'dzin bkra shis mtshan/ /du ma rang grol ngag dbang ye shes grub/ /gzhon nu don grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs kun bdag po chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /slar yang dkon cog lhun grub gter bdag gling / /gshed skor bka' gter gdams pa'i 'dod 'jo mkhan/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang gis rang rgyud smin/ /rnon po nang gcod byin chen sgo gsum brlabs/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i gnad kyi dmar 'khrid la/ /'khrul med sgro 'dogs chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo bo blo 'das ka dag rig ba'i gdangs/ /(3na)rang bzhin lhun grub byang chen srung 'khor rten/ /brten pa zhi khro'i lha tshogs shar ba yi/ /thugs rjes btsan po'i mkhar du 'jug par shog /mi dang mi min bsam sbyor ngan pa'i stobs/ /rig sngags 'khrul 'khor bskor bas rnam par 'jig /skyogs gnyis nang phrad sgrogs rdo lam bcag ste/ /srung ma bdud 'bab bzlog pa'i las tsob shog /phyag cha rang la bskor ba rbod gtong gi /dmag dpon g.yul du bsad pa dpa' 419—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nabo'i las/ /byang ma'i stobs gzhom ngan sngags kha bcings nas/ /btson khang nang du dong rul gnon par shog /de ltar log 'dren gnyis 'dzin zhakhrul pa'i ngor/ shar bar nges nas nye ne mongs dug gsum dgra/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen lam gyis tshar bcad de/ /tshe 'dir 'jam mgon kun bzang 'bras smin shog /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi tshogs zhing rnams las byang chen mo ltar dang / gtor ma btang zhing mtshams bcad pa ni/ rang skad cig gi phyag rgya chen po zil gnon sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis bshams/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer los pas phyogs skyong sdo brgyad gzhi bdag zhing skyong gdon bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥs bkug /gtor ma sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis brlabs/ phyogs skyong sde brgyad rnams dang khyad par yul phyogs sa phyogs 'di kun na gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag zhing skyong gtsang phud la dga' ba rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag cag rnams 'jam (3ba)dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'phrin las zab mo nyams su len pa la bar gcod mi 'byung ba'i dge ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo/nag phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba lan chags dang gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs nam mkha' la 'phyo ba/bar snang la rgyug pa/ sa gzhi la 'grim pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa/ stob grib la gab pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub pa chen po mthong thos mi bzod pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la byams pa'i sems kyis so so rang gnas dang rten la dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo sprin rab mas kyis ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas phye mar brlag par 'gyur/ hūṃ/ bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas sogs dang / sgrub sngags dang sum bha brjod de khro bo dang mtshon cha dang me rab tu 'bar ba'i gur khang du gyur gyi bar dkyus bzhin bya/ byin 'bebs ni/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gcig pu 'di sbyar te 'og nas 'byung ba'i bskul gyi nang gi 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas bzung bdag nyid las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod kyi bar brjod/ rten gtor bor ba'i sman raka gtor gsum dang phyi mchod las byang ltar brlab/ dngos —420

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)gzhi'i thog mar sems bskyed gsal 'debs ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang / /bdag dang bsrung bya'i bar chad zhi ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs khros pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /tshe bdag nag po'i srung 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ ā+oṃ su bhā (4na7 shurnya sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3hi/ chos kun ka nas dag pa'i spros bral dang / /dharma rdzo tu ā: kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /ma rtogs 'gro la kun khyab snying rje'i gdangs/ /bo dhi tsit+ta hūṃ/ rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni/ 'gag med rang rtsal rig pa hūṃ mthing nag /de las 'od los rtse mor raṃ yaṃ kho/ /rim byung dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus/ /hūṃ las e ye raṃ baṃ lo yig lnga/ /rim chad nam mkha' mthing nag gru gsum steng / /rlung ljang rdo rje'i rgya gram lte ba la/ /me dpung dmar po zur gsum 'bar zhing 'phro/ /chu dkyil dkar po dbyibs zlum rba rlabs 'khrug /gser gyi sa chen gru bzhi brdal ba'i steng / /rgyu chad mchod rten dkar po 'od lnga pa/ /thabs shes dbyer med dbyangs gsal rgyu las grub/ /ngo bo rdo rje'i pha lam rnam pa ni/ /byang chen mchod rten gdan khri bang rim gsum/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi steng bum pa bre/ /chos 'khor gdugs tog nyi zla nor bur bcas/ /phyogs bcur 'od 'phro stong gsum khengs par gyur/ /bum pa'i nang du rgyu las hūṃ chad pas/ /gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram ra dbrag tu/ /rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro zhing chil chil khol/ /lte ba ga'u kha sbyor dbyibs can nang / pad zla nyi steng shel gyi rdo rje dkar/ /'od zer kun 'phro'i lte bar hūṃ de las/ /'od 'phros sne la ya ma ti ra baṃ/ /yongs gyur gshin rje pho mo'i gdan gyi steng / /ma he glang rgod zung gnyis kyis bteg pa'i/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rgyu'i yi ge /hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga ldan babs/ /(4bti las 'od los tshun 'dus zhu ba las/ /gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu hūṃ mthing gis/ /mtshan pa las 'phros 'phags pa'i tsho gos rnams mchod/ /sems can don byas tshur sa yongs gyur las/ /ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed mthing nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad/ /'kha g.yas dkar lab 'ad cing g.yon dmar gshe /dbus ma mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal re rer/ /dmar la rab zlum spyan gsum —42/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()g.yo zhing 'byug/sprul nag gdug pa snyan gong g.yas g.yon brgyan/ khro gnyer smin ma'i mtshams bsdus shangs gnyer ba//ljags 'dril mche ba bzhi gtsigs zhal gdangs nas//a ra li sgrog smin ma dmar ser 'byug/kham ser dbu skra gyen brdzes phyag g.yas kyi//dang pos sno ngar rtsibs brgyad 'bor lo bskor//bar pa ral gri rdo rje rtse dgu mtha'//phyag g.yon dang pos lcags kyu gas shing bar//'og ma sdigs mdzub rtse la me dpung 'phro//zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhengs//khrag 'thung rigs lnga nang bzhugs thod skam lngas//dbu brgyan ra ri nyer gcig mgul par 'phyang /khrag 'dzag thod sa lnga bcu'i se ral kha//glang byu ko rlon stod g.yogs zhing pags kyis//rnyed bcingasastag sham smad dkris sprul rigs lnga'i//dkar khras dbu skra bcings shing ser khra yis//phyag gdub dmar khras ska rags zhabs gdub ljang //nag khras se ral kha byas smin mtshams dang //sku ldan tha nywa sul thal chen tshom bus byugs//mkhur tshos dpral ba rak+ta'i thig les brgyan//zhag gi sor risalkog ma brang la bshal/ /ba spu'i bu gar khyung nag me gshog dang / /rdo rje rtse lngas gtam las me stag 'phro//sku las sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med 'gyed//las kyi gshin rje bsam mi khyab kyis bskor//lus las 'bar ba'i ye shes me dpung gis//rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro ba'i klong na bzhugs//spyi bor ye shes khyung nag khro bo'i zhal//rdo rje'i mchu ldan nyi zla'i spyan gsum zlum//gnam lcags rwa dbrag nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras/kham nag dbu skra gyen 'khyil lcags sder gyis//dkar nag sprul bzung mjug ma zhabasa' kyas mnan//mgo bo zhal gsol spu phran mtshon char gtams//bskal pa'i me 'bar spu gri'i sgro gshog tshogs//brdabs pas sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus 'dul//gtso bo'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng //'jam dpal gser mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi//g.yas pas shes rab ral gri dpung thad 'dzin/khri t+pal yu ba g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis//thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan thad du//rgyas pa'i steng na sher phyin glegs bam mas/khur yi lnga ldan dar dang si wo bas//rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs zhi 'dzum zhal//nang du gziXnas srung ba'i las mdzad gyur//lte bar bad zla

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma6)nyi steng rin po che//sna tshogs las grub mar rten 'od lnga 'phro//bum nang pad zla'i gdan gnas mthing nag hūṃ//5ba khongs gyur gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i ra//yar lngar rigs lnga yab dang mar lngar yum//sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rdzogs zhal nang gzigs//lte bar ā di kā di las grub pa'i//dkar dmar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyar nang //bye yig khog par mthing nag mdog ldan hūṃ//'od 'bar bsrung bya dang bcas de yi mthar//e /ya ma du ru tsa po dang //dkar dmar dbyangs gsal thabs shes tshul gyis bskor//rang gi thugs las dmar nag 'od 'phros rtser//smug nag mdog ldan bh+yo yig g.yon du chad//'phro 'du yongs gyur ma mo khrag mig ma//smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs//gcer bu rgyan med phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar//g.yon pa thod pa khrag gang thugs gar bsnams//gzig sham dkris shing zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad//ma mo bye ba sa ya'i 'khor tshogs bcas//rang lus las sa me dpung rab 'bar dbus//bzhugs pa'i thugs gar smug nag bh+yo yi mthar phya ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa bskor//slar yang thugs las dmar nag 'od los rtser//ya yig khrag mdog g.yas su chad pa las/chom srus mag ya ma rā tsa dmar nag mdangs//zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yasapa bshan gri 'phyar//phyag g.yon don snying dmar po tsa re 'brad/khrag 'dzag mi lpags g.yang gzhi sku la gsol//zhabs gnyis sar brdabs stag lpags sham thabs dkris//dregs pa lha srin sdebargyad 'khor tshogs bcas//sku las 'bar ba'i ye shes me dpung klong //bzhugs pa'i thugs dar 6nadamar nag ya yi mthar//gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra sa bskor//(e)slar yang yab yum thugs ga'i hūṃ bh+yo las//'phros pa'i khro bo khro mo g.yas g.yon du//zhal nang gzigs te srung ba'i las mdzad gyur//byang chen mchod rten phyi rol yig las//gser gyi ga'u kha sbyor gur khang can//de yi phyi rim rigs lnga'i rang bgur//hūṃ sna ra ṇa phaṭa/khro bo sngon po rang mdog rdo rje thogs//rdo rje sngon pos bar ma sgos medags te//bser bu'i rlung tsam nam yang thar med gur//ā+oṃ snya ra ṇa phaṭa/khro bo dkar po rang mdog 'khor lo thogs//'khor lo dkar posaX mtshams med gtams te//bser bu'i rlung tsam

bu'i rlung tsam nam yang thar med gur//hrī:spra ra ṇa phaṭa/khro bo dmar po rang mdog pad+ma thogs/ /pad+ma dmar pos bar mtshams med gtos te/ /bser bu'i rlung tsam nam yang thar med gur//āḥsla ra ṇa tshogs/kham nag rlung g.yab 6bsgo tshon cha thogs pas gtams//raṃ lpa ra ṇa phaṭa/raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal/dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba'i gur nang du/khro bo dmar nag me dpung 'bar bas gtams//baṃ tik+ta maṇ+ḍa la//chu bo rba klong 'khyil ba'i gur nang du/khro bo dkar po chu zhags thogs pas gtams//lo tik+ṣa ṇa maṇ+ḍal/gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gur nang du/khro bo ser po ri rab thogs pas gtams//e maṇ+ḍal/nam mkha' lcags kyi gur nang khro bo nag/mtshon cha sna tsho gos char ltar 'bab pas gtams//kun kyang sra mkhregs ra dbar khro chung mtshon//thogs dang nam mkha'i rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs//spu gri reg gcod rlung dang ye shes me//chu gri sna tsho gis mar cha'i 'khor lo yis//'tshub mar gtams las drag po'i 'od los pas//dgra bgegs thams cad rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bkrad//ma song ba rnams thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag/de yi phyi rol rang sngags dbyangs gsal 'phreng / /thabs shes tshul du 'khrigs las dgra bgegs kun/ /gsod ces stong nyid rang sgra cher sgrog pa//nam yang gzhom zhig med pa'i gur 'od kyi sna dag klong //rang ba gnas nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed//yab yum sras 'khor srung ༷'i /ra khang 7na〉los//skad cig nyid la badz+ra sa

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)mā dza:wen las kyi g.yi la don bdun yod pa'i dang po spyan 'dren pa ni/hūṃ/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis wom dpal yab yum 'khor cas spyan 'dren no//'og ṣ+ka chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas//gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas//'phags pa'i rgyal po khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed//bdag dang mtha' yas sems༅don slad du//sa rjes dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//yum mchog ma mo khrag mig gshegs su gsol//sras mchog ya ma ra dza gshegs su gsol/((ed/ā+oṃ mnyu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā tsa ma mo e ka tsa ti sam ya dzaḥganyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/hūṃ/gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su//gshin rje ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i steng /khro rgyal gzhin rje yab yum 'khor dang bcas: brkyang bskum 'gying bag rngam brjid tshul gyis bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/hūṃ/ dgra bgegs ma lus thal bar rlag byed pa:khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo ma mo khrag mig ma la phyag sprul la:dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i 7bamar tsho gos 'bul me rtag bdug spos mar me dri ra zas sil snyan ma rdzo pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/tshwa mañju shrī ya lha /ya ma rwa tsa ma mo e /tsa ti sa pa ri wā ra a lha/pā hūm̐/pu spyi sgru baṃ/ā lo rka/gan+ta/ni li bye/sha rdi āḥ&/sman mchod ni/gdod nas rnam dag rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman//ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i dam tshig rdzas/khyud drug kun sgrol dug lnga rab sel ba//bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā gyi zhesasman spyir phul nas bye brag tu/ 'phags pa 'jam dang dngos grub stsol//oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/dbur spyon chos grags bso de nams rin cen dpal/ /'phrin las rnam rgyal nyang ston rigs kun bdag /slar yang rigs 'dzin bkra shis rgya mtsho la//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/du ma rang grol ngag dbang ye shes grub//chos dbyingasarang grol slar yang dkon cog mtshan//gter bdag gling sogs bka' gter bla ma la//sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol//oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a ni/bla med mchog gi mchod pa sbyar ba 'di//ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro//'dod pa'i yon tan lnga sa rab brgyan pa//gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//ā+oṃ mnyu shrī sogasakyi mthar ma hā ba liṅka khā hi/rak+ta ni/gdug can dgra bgegs khrag gi dngas ma'i mtshor//mkha' dbyings pad+ma rak+ta'i 'bab ldan kun//gcig bsdus mtshams sprin la 'gran dbu phreng can/rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//ā+oṃ mnyu shrī sogs kyi mthar ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/sbyor sgrol ni/mas ldan gzung mdang sbyar brgya drug cha//yongaX2 6 tsho bzhi'i bde wo rab rgyas shing //dam

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)sa tshe pas dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i//spyor sgrol mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//oṃ mnyu shrī sogs kyi mthar ma hā mo sa khā hi/ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ma hā bha su ta khā hi/ma hā go ro tsa na 'a hi/ma hā ke ni ri ti khā hi//bo dhi tsit+ta ma tre ru dra pra be sha ya phaṭa/lnga pa bstod pa ni/e/chos sku skye ba med pa las spros bral bde chen dag pa'i sku: rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa'i gsung :ma bsgribs don dam rdzogs pa'i thugs 'gran zla kun bral yon tan ldan 'gro kun don mdzad 'phrin las sogs sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi sems can don mdzad gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras 'khor bcas la bstod:drug pa bshags pa ni/bdag gis tshe rabs thog med tshun chad nas:da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyad ngag gis tshig kyal smra ba mang du brjod yid kyis blo nor log par sems la sogs 'dod 'phro gti mug dbang gis las spyad kun bkram pa'i lha tsho gos rnams la bzod par gsol ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang :de yi 'khor du gtogasapa'i dregs pa rnams mi g.yel skyon mthong tsam nas brlag par mdzad nor zhabrul chags nyams mchis na bzod par gsol bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol:'di phyi'i rkyen dang sgrib par mi 'gyur gsol:dbyangs gsal dang 9na〉/zhen rje'i gshed kyi yig brgya brjod/sdebargyad bran du rab 'khol snying rje ches gdug pa can rnams dus gcig brlab nus shing //gzhan gyi byad stims rig sngags sbyor ngan gyis//tshugs par nus min mthu rtsal ldan par gyur//dag pa dran zhing nga rgyal brtan pa ni/hūṃ/nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed//snang srid 'khor 'das nga las byung //sangs rgyas sems can nga laganas//sku gsum nga yi rang bzhin yin//lha srin sdebargyad nga las byung //gshin ni skye ba med pa ste//rje ni 'gag pa med pa'i don//gshed ces bya ba mtha' gnyis bral//de phyir gshin rje tshe bdag yin//mtshan tsam thos yon bsam mi khyab//bsgrubs na lang tsho nga dang mnyam//bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni//gtso 'khor/༷sa kya thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las//los pa'i 'od

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zer kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /las byed pho nya sprul pa yang sprul dang / /sum sbrul khro bo khro mo dpag med tshogs/ /spros pas rang gzhan bsrung bya thams cad kyi/ /tshe dang srog gi ngo bo rtsi'i rnam par/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyis brkus phyogs nas/ /mtho ba nam mkha' dma' ba dmyal ba'i sa/ /nyi zla'i them bar sprin gyi sgo bar khrod/ /ri rab lcog par 'dzam gling yul gru sogs/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla gar khyer zhing / /sbas dang bskungs nas yod pa ma lus pa/ /sprul pa'i pho nya khro bo khro mo'i tshogs/ /ye shes spyan (9bskon rnams kyis nyer gzigs nas/ /gnod byed thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag /tshe srog yi ge'i gzugs can de phyogs nas/ /hūṃ gi rnam par rang gzhan bsrung bya yi/ /thugs kar bstim pas srog 'thud tshe nyams spel/ /slar yang thugs ga'i 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /bla ma yi dam bde gshegs zhi khro'i lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshogs/ /pho rgyud mo rgyud chos skyong byin rlabs mthu/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyi srog gi snying / /lha mi'i tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang dang / /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnam lnga'i bcud/ /thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas ni/ /bdag gzhan bsrung ba kun dang dbyer med par/ /thim pas bkrag mdangs mthu stobs ldan par gyur/ /ā+oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa srungs phya ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa srungs: /gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra sa srungs sarba tsit+ta gzir thum bhi ga nan trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya saṃ gh+ri wa ri rtsi sa hūṃ dza: bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'phreng rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i/ /phyi rim 'od zer g.yas su yongs bskor zhing / /lha rnams zhal nas srung ba'i sngags kyi sgra/ /dir dir rab sgrog gur khang tsho gos las kyang / /'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba lta bu'i sgras/ /srid pa gsum khyab bdag gzhan bsrung bya la/ /'tshe ba'i rig sngags byad stems rbod gtong dang / /lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa las bskyabs gyur/ khams gsum ma (10na/cis gzhal yas chen por blta/ /gzugs snang ma lusakhro rgyal chen por rdzogs/ /grag stong sgra rnams bzlas brjod sngags su rdzogs/ /srid gsum ma lus chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan/ /dug gsum rnam dag sku gsung thugs su rdzogs/ /rang byung dug lnga ye shes428

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma6)chen po lnga/ /'khor 'das dbyer med khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed/ /gzung 'dzin rnam dag mtshan ma'i yul las 'das/ /zhes gdengs gsum gsal btab pa las mi g.yel bas gong gi bsnyen pa thun drug tu bcad nas nyams su len tshul man ngag ltar byas te rtags ma byung gi bar du 'bad cing / mjug sdud kyi rim pa rnams zhakhrul pa med par bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /bzlog pa ni/ rtsa phyag mthil gnyisazla nyi thabs shes tshul/ /lha tshogs zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i sngags/ /sgrog cing gur khang las kyang 'brug stong ltar/ /ldir bas rbod gtong lha srin gnod pa bzlog /sngags 'phreng las 'phros 'od zer gyis bskor ba'i/ /'phro 'dus byad ma'i steng du babs par gyur/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi sa thugs ka' sa bon dang / /ba spu'i bu ga nas thon las byed kyi/ khro bo khro mo mardzo cha sna tshogs pa/ /thogs te skar ltar 'brug cing glog lta bur/ /'khyug pa rnams kyis byad ma rbod gtong mkhan/ /lha dang srung mar bcas kun phur bzlog cing / /mes bsregs rlung gis rab gtor chu yis bshal/ /sa sa mnan thal ba bun bun bzhin du btang / /lhag ma lus (10ba)pa'i stobs can tshur byung rnams/ /mtshon mas gtubs pas nye bar ma nus nas/ /byad ma mkhan po'i steng du rbad 'dre'i tshogs/ /babs pas rang gshed rang la rnam par dbab/ /oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa bzlog: rgya ka ya ma du ru tsakra sa bzlog gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra sa bzlog sarba tsit+ta gzir thum lhag nan trig nan bod ya bzlog ya: dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa sha la rgyug snying la mā ra ya rgyug: dbugs la rgyug srog la mā ra ya rgyug khrag la rgyug rtsal mā ra ya rgyug: ྅ phaṭa dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bzlog ya: zhes 'bad de bzla/g.yas g.yon phyag mthil zla nyi'i dkyil 'khor bar/ /dgra bgegs gnod byed lha dang srung ma rnams/ /brdabs te bcar bas sha khrag rus pa rnams: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs kyis hab zos gyur/ /zhes gsal btab pas bden stobs lan gsum brjod pa dang bstun nas thal mo brdab/ thun gtor sbran dgug bya/ gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin raṃ las mes bsregs/ ya las rlung gis gtor/ kho las chus bkrus/ oṃ āḥlha gis rnam pa dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur —429

cig yid la rang byung thugs kyi byin phob cig yon tan 'gran med zil gnon byin phob cig: phrin las 'gro 'dul rnam bzhi'i byin phob cig dbang chen dbang bskur zil gnon bcom ldan 'das byin chen byin phob zil gnon bcom ldan 'das mas chen mthu stsol zil gnon bcom ldan 'das dngos grub mchog stsol zil gnon bcom ldan 'das bdag nyid lasakyi 'bras bu mas par mdzod bdag gis rtse gcig gus pas khyod bsgrubs na khyod kyi thugs rjesabadag la byin gyis rlomes dusang na snyigs ma'i dus su bdag skyes pas bdag gis bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la: lam la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs dang : bdud dang lha 'dre ngan sems can rnamasakyi bdag gi tshe srog lam la bar gcod rnams dpal chen zil gnon 'khor dang bcas pa yis:rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang : thugs rje gtum rngam shugs kyis bsgral nas ni gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i zhal du btab: gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan pa'i mgul du bsgril: rnam dag skye med thugs kyi dkyil du bstim sgrub mchog bdag gi bsam don byang chub lam bar chad med par dus 'dir (13na〉spyab par mdzod: bskul thung ni/ hūṃ/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: gshin rje ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : yab gcig lha yi rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed sbyor ba'i yum mchog ma mo khrag mig ma sgrol ba'i yum mchog e ka dza ti ma thugs kyi sprul pa sgrol ging rme ru rtse dus gsum gshin rje bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu: ging bdud ma mo mkha' 'gro gyad gnon lha 'jam dpal sku yi rigs brgyud thugs dam can mi mngon dbyings nas sku bzhengs bdag byin rlobs thugs dam rgyud bskul thugs rjes dgra bgegs sgrol zhes bstod bskul gsum ga sham bu dang bcas pas phul te/ zor bskul ni/ lcags sam ban+ta'i snod nang du 'bru sna lnga la ngar phye byas drag po'i bsgos bu zur gsum bzhengs mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan myos byed dug dang khrag gis byugs: rtsa bar 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil ngos la zhe sdang me chen 'bar 'og tu gti mug —432

wa wa/bgob byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)mun pa 'khrigs rtse mor mar cha 'i bu yug las:ned par gshin rje'i dmag dpung bsdus:gshin rje rol pa'i gtore zor 'di 'phangs pa bzhin rje nyid kyis phangs brdeg pa dam nyams dgra la brdegaḥdagra khams thal ba'i rdul du rlog rbad thum ril yis ka ya ma du ru tsakra sogs la bzlog bsad mnan pas sham bu sbyar ba'i mthar ril shag srog 13ba tsher :༷ga myags kā pa ye zhes 'phang :zhes nyamasasu blangs nas rtags mthong gi bya ba'i rim pa'i mthar/dgongs 'dus rta nag gi pad+ma dbang zhes pa 'don ༷ ni/ lha yi lha mchog 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dus rnams rtag tu khro rgyal khyed bsgrubs r+sāsrog gi phyir yang yi dam mi spong na:ye shes thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol:khro rgyal 'khor bcas khyed kyi gzi brjid kyis bar gcod dgra bgegs tshogos rnams bas la nas kyang :byams pa'i zhal bzang mngon sum ston pa dang :sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir stsal du gsol:yang 'bri gung gnam lcags me 'bar gyis mdzad pa'i/bskal pa dpa gtu med pa'i sngon rol nas:lha mchog khyod dang smon lam lhan cig btab:da lta zhal mthong yi dam lhar gsol na:snying po byang chub mchog la mi gnas tshe tshe rabs 'khor ba gar skye gar gnas kyang :rjes su bzung zhig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed: dngos grub stsol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed bar gcod sol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed:dgra bgegs sgrol cig bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed:sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol gzhan yang kho bos zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tu brtsams pa 'don pa bsgyur ba 'di ltar/mkhyen brtse nus mnga' 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi//bstan pa rgyas dang de 'dzin tshogs rnams kyi//sku tshe phrin las skye rgu'i bde skyid la//bar du gcod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/khyad par 4narigs 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob dang //yon mar 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa'i//sngon las phral rkyen las byung dgra bgegs gdon//nad rims dbul 'phongs 'thab rtsod bzlog tu gsol//phyi nang drang srong dmod pa mthu byad dang //byur dang skal ga mi shis mi dus na 'chi/ /keg sri langs sogs chags che nyam nga ba'i//'gal rkyen bar /cod thams cad bzlog tu gsol//phrin las lhag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nachad dam rdzas ma tshang nyams/ /bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing dus kyi mchod pa chag /ting 'dzin mi gsal gsang sngags sgra nyams sogs/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor dbang phyug phun sum tshogs/ /lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan sogs/ /'khor 'das dngos grub kun dang khyad par du/ /'jam mgon kun bzang tshe 'dir mngon gyur mdzod/ /ces 'dod gsol smon lam bya/ /dbyangs gsal yig brgya bzla zhing ngag 'grol/ tshogs mchod baṃ bskang dkyus ltar bya/de rjes thog nas zor lam dbye/ gtor ma kha phyir bsgyur te gso dgug sbran brlab bya zhing thun gtor ltar bsngo/ bstod ring gis bskul nas phyir spags/ bzlog gzhung ni/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha sogs gtso bo'i las bcol gzhung bzhin gyi rjes su/ de yi 'khor du yum chen khrag mig ma/ /ya ma rā dza 'chi bdag srog gi bdag /las gshin ral pa tshar dgur bcas pa la/ /dgra (14ba tha gegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du stob/ /byad dang rbad gtong ma lus bzlog tu gsol/ /gshin rje phyogs skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /zhes sogs dang / da ni bzlog pa'i dus la bab nas ma hā de wa mu stegs gdon bden pa'i sto bos kyis bzlog tu gsol:gyi bar dkyus ltar la/ yum chen za byed pe ta li zhes pa khrag mig ma dang / gyad gnon sprul pa'i lha brgyad ces pa sras mchog sprul pa rnam gnyis zhes par bsgyur/ rabs bgrang ba ni/ bh+yo/ sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung ཿ bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub la lha sbyin bdud kyi bar gcod byung : bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje yis:dmar chen khrag gi zor brgyab pas lha sbyin ngan pa khrag tu bskyugs bdud kyi dmag dpung brgyal zhing bog bar du bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la mu stegs ngan pa'i chad pa byung : gnubs ban sangs rgyas shes kyis dmar chen khrag gi zor brgyab pas mu stegs ga pa rtsad nas bcad: tha mar bzlog pa gang nas byung : bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la dgra bgegs byad dang rbod gtong byung : rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag nyid kyis phyag rgya zil gnon ting 'dzin dang : srung bzlog bsad mnan sbyor ba yis dgra bo'i rbod gtong rang gshed 'bebs 434

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun gcod cing : ltas ngan dmigs kyis bsal (15na skos bzlog: ྅ bh+yo:'ja' 'khyil lha yi ltas ga yin sogs gzhung ltar gyer/ gshegs skyems su gtor ma gong ltar 'bul/ 'phen sar drag bskul zor bskul dang bcas te gsung rgyun man ngag ltar 'phang / me dgra chus bsad/ bro/ skor ba/ la gu sogs phyag len bzhin bya: mdor chad mtho bya zhing bstan ma skyong / nang du log ste tshe 'gugs/ gtang rag gis mchod/ gshin rje'i gshed gyi yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / bzod gsol ni/ yi dam lha mchog zil gnon 'bor bcas kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub 'phrin las gzhung bzhin bgyis pa la/ /bdag cag ma rig log rtog dbang song nas/ /'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /nyer bsdu ni/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros srung 'khor rnams/ /mtha' nas rim bsdus lha tshogs rnams la thim/ /'khor rnams gtso bo de yang bsrung byar bstim/ /bsrung bya hūṃ la thim zhing de thig le/ /de yang rang gi ming yig dang por thim/ /'ja' ltar yal te snanas dag pa'i ngang / /stong pa'i rang mdangs 'gag med gshin rje'i gshed/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnam par gsal bar gyur/ /srung sngags brjod/ smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar rgya bal paṇa grub zhal gyi lung / /bod yul drag sngags bdag po gnubs kyi lugs/ /rong pa rgya yi zab gter me'i spu gri/ /bdud sde'i snying ga 'bigs pa rdo rje'i thog /tshul (15ba)'di ming tsam 'dzin pa'i rig sngags 'chang / /bod yul kha ba'i ljongs su ches mang yang / khyud ldan zhal gyi drod rlangs ma nyams pa/ /thob pa'i skal bzang nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ /'on te lha gcig sras po mu tig btsan/ /sgyu 'phrul rol gar gnam lcags me 'bar gyi/ /lugs srol 'khrul med 'dzin pa'i yongs 'dzin rnams/ /bsnyen pas chos tshulu 'di la nges pa rnyed/ /gter gzhung yig rnying phal cher rang sor bzhag /tshig lhug legs bcad 'phri bsnan brjod pa bde/ /gab dkrugs 'thor bsdebs nyams len gsal 'dril bas/ /lam 'dir mos ldan rnams kyi snying nor yin/ /phyis 'gyur phyag bzhi mgon dang drug cu par/ /bka' brgyad rdzas tshig bca' gzhi'i bsre bslad can/ /chos lugs mu to'i phye la snyan 435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)brgyud ces/ /thabs kyis ga' na blo 'drid pa'i do zla min/ /tshul 'di 'khrul med nges par nyams blangs na/ /mi bsrun bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal zhing khams su/ /mngon sum 'dren pa'i nyams myong gdengs tshad bdog /dge des phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas ma rig zhabrul pa'i rgya dral nas/ /'gro kun rang sems don gyi gshin rje'i gshed/ khrag 'thung gdod ma'i mgon po mngon 'gyur shog /ces yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda' 'di ni sngon nas bsgrigs pa'i 'phrin las de shin tu nyung ba la dga' ba'i dbang du byas pas brjod don mi gsal (16na)zhing ma tshang bas lag len du 'debs nga/ga 'a ba nas rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams len du gal po cher mthong bas ring nas bsgrig pa'i 'dun pa yod kyang rnam g.yeng gi 'khol bor lus te re zhig 'gyangs pa/ nye char spang ston sngags 'chang blo bzang ngag dbang sogs don gnyer can 'gas bskul bas mtshams sbyar te zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol sogs dam pa du ma'i drung du gshed skor 'di nyid kyi dbang lung man ngag rnams 'bad pas nos shing shin tu zab cing sbas pa'i snyan brgyud kyi phyag len dmar 'khrid rnams lha sras rnam sprul dbur smyon chos kyi grags pa'i drung du zhun thar bcad pa la brten nas gdengs tshad rnyed pa za hor gyi rigs las sngags pa nag po zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis shing sbrul gro bzhin zla ba'i thabs kyi cha'i dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs so/ /sarba maṅga lo//yang bzlog bzhugs so/tre rat+na maṇ+ḍa la/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra la/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas chos sku spros bral mkha' dbyings las longs sprul gyi 'jam dpal zhi khro rigs —436

yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i las byang rdo rje'i thog mda'/ nang ma(kha)lnga sprul 'khor bye ba sa ya las byed pho nya las gshin sde brgyad dang bcas pa glog ltar myur pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis thogs pa med par mdun gyi nam mkhar ā+oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/a ti pu hoḥpra titsā ho / mkha' dbyings kun tu bzang po'i ngang //rang snang kun bzang rol pa'i sprin//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs//gnyis med ngang nas rgya cher 'bul//'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor bcas la//drod rlangs ma yal dbang po la/sha chen bsregs dud sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /rkang tshil zhun chen sgron me gsal/khrag zhag mkhris pa sgrol chil 'khrug/phyi nang sha tshil rus pa'i gshos//dung chen rnga dang rkang gling 'bud//bdud rtsi sman dang dmar chen khrag/dam rdzas gtor ma spyan gzigs 'bul//gzugasacan dgra bo bcoms pa dang //gzugs med bgegs dpung bcil ba dang //ci bsam lhun 'i rgyas grub pa yi//sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang / /slad nas las 'chol don ched du//'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor bcas la//'bul lo dgyes par bzhes nas kyang /khyu sbyor sbyin bdag sgo gsum la//sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob//sdebazhi'i sgo brgya phyogs 1ba spun tu//'byed pa'i med byung dngos grub stsol//bar gcod dgra bgegs mi mthun phyogs//srung bzlog mnan pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//sngon las 'phral rkyen nad mug sogs/ /rab gzhil rnam bzhi'i las kun sgrubs/ /ā+oṃ mnyu shri ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra a:/pā thu/puṅge dhū pe/ā lo ke/ga rnye/ni wi du/sha sdi pra titsā su tā/ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khya hi/ma hā ba li ta kha raṃ 'a hi/mahā me sa kha raṃ khā hi/ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ma hā tsit+ta kha raṃ khā hi/mahā bha su ta kha raṃ khā hi/ma hā go ro tsa na kha raṃ ji hi/ma hā lka ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi/phye/chosasku skye ba med pa las//spros bral bde chen dag pa'i sku//rang bzhin gnyis med dag pa'i gsung //ma bsgribs don dam rdzogs pa'i thugs//'gran zla kun bral yon tan ldan//'gro kun don mdzad 'phrin las sogs//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyis//sems can don mdzad gshin rje gshed//yab yum sras rabacas la bstod/khres pa'ang me stag gro zhun zla ba'i bzang po gsum pa nas nyin lnga gtang rag btang skabs log tri yang bzlog tu tshig zur /sgyur mi bde zer ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes bkod//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po bzhugs so/ /khyod mtshan thos pa'i mod la mi srun snying / khog car 'gas na gar dgu'i nyams 'gyur tsam/ /bstan pas nag phyogs drung 'byin tshe bdag dngos/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs bad la btud nas/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas la zhe sdang bas/ /rab khros gnam sa ltar bgrad zhal nang du/ /dgra bgegs 'debs byed ye shes rang 'bar ba/ /dus kyi byin za'i phung po'i rjes bsnyeg tshe/ /gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i yid khong chud pa'i bzhin/ /thur phab mya ngan khang bur brgyal byed na/ /rbod gtong dmod pa'i sbyor ngan phye ma leb/ /ming gi lhag mar 'gyur bas bag yod byos/ /yang bzlog nag po me'i sbu gri'i las kyi mtha' sdudag du ga pa me'i sbyor ba la brten nas/ bzlog bsad kyi sgrub mjug 'khor lo dang liṅga bsregs te bsad pa'i las mthar thug pa sgrub pa dang gzhan yang dgra bgegs slo bur du sgrol ba/ gdug pa can thug phrad du gsod pa/ 'og gdon gyi 'tshe ba/ nad pa dang gre'u la gnod pa'i gdon/ rgyal 'gong gi spyo 'bog sogs (2na)mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa bzlog bsad btsan thabs su bsgrub pa'i rim pa rnams las sgrub mjug min pa'i glo bur du bya ba yin na lo zla zhag dus tshone rtsub cing gza' skar sbyor byed ngan pa sogs dang bstun te dur khrod dam lha 'dre drag po gnas pa lta bu'i sa ma dul bar byed na gnubs ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dbang mchog las byung ba'i sa chog dang / gnas khang rnying pa lta bur ma byas kyang mi 'gal la/ 'on kyang dbang chog nges don bde 'jug las gsungs pa'i sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gzhan yang bsangs dang gser skyems sogs kyis sde brgyad cha snyoms las sbyor gyi sgrub mjug dang 'brel na bshad ma thag pa rnams btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ de'ang slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dges mdzad pa'i gnubs lugs kyi sbyin —438

yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po/ nang ma(kha)sreg gter gzhung las/ thog mar lho phyogs kha bltas pa'i sa gzhi nag dang sa rtsub sar drag po'i thab khung brtsig par bya sa gsum mkhar gong chu gsum la maṇ+ḍal khru gang dpangs su brtsig cesasogs yang ba (2bskor mkhar gong srin can dang sbyar ba'i sa gsum chu gsum gyis sbrus pa'i stegs bu rtse cho/ lhor bstan pa'i dbus su/ ma tre mgo byang du bstan pa'i sto bar thab man ngag ltar bris pa'i steng du/ drag po'i hom shing dug khrag gis sbags pa zur gsum rgyar sor nyi shu dpangs su sor gcig gis dman pa brtsigs/ dbus su me tshad dang ting lo sogs phyag len ltar bca'/ me lces mi slebs pa'i sar gcod pa nam mkha'i 'khor lo dgram/ gangs ri dang sa bon bris pa'i me yol bca'/ me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas ni gong du bshad pa'i shing gi rgyu la yam shing sbom phra mthe'u chung tsam srid du sor bcu pa drag po'i rtsang gi dbyibs can mi'i rgyu ma'am rgyus pas dkris shing zhun chen dang dug khrag gis sbags pa/ chil zhun gsum dang bsres pa'i mar nag /drag po'i rdzas/ gnad kyi rdzas/ nad bskyed pa'i rdzas/dug gsum las sbyor gyi rdzas/ rbod gtong bzlog cing tsha ba bskyed pa'i rdzas/ myos byed kyi rdzas/ gsod byed kyi rdzas rnams thod ngan gyi snod du gtams te ro ras sam 'phung re gang rung gi steng du ma zhakhrugs par me ltar 'bul rgyu nyung zad cig dang bcas pa'i tshar gnyis g.yas su dgod/ g.yon ngos su chu gnyisasngon 'gro'i phyi'i nyer spyod/ khyad par dug chang gnyis dang sbyar ba'i khrag gi a/ dang zhabs bsil/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sha chen dang gu gul sbyar ba'i spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen chang dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling sogs rol mo/ /dmar (3na)gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa rnams 'das ma 'das gnyis so sor bshams/ mdun gyi g.yon ngos su sman raka /dgang blugasakha sbyar/ las bum/ thod rnga/ rdor dril/ 'byu nag gi me tog /ro ras sam mi lpags kyi rlung g.yab/ro skra brgyad/ 'phung re'am zhing lpags kyi gos zung / drag po'i so rtsi dang / g.yas ngos su rtsa ba li rdzasa'akhor lo liṅga 'phung res kha bkang ste bsham mo/ /de nas sgrub pa po gos nag gam mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon/ thod nag bcings/ gdong la me long btags/ ra ka'i phreng ba se ral khar byas/ thal chen 439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma gsung ma/ la —gyi tshom bu/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi sor ris rnams kyis sbags/ ngag bcad/ nyid lhags sam bsgrub bya'i gzugs kyi snying gar g.yon brkyang gis 'khod/ sngon du las byang gyer ma zin na 'phrin las kyis gzhung bsrangs te tshogs las yan bya/ glo bur gyi las yin na liṅga rnams la gser skyems nas bzung gtso du brdung ba'i bar gyis gdab las rgyas par byed/ rdor dril bcangs te de nyid dang rnga byin rlabs bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi snyelas byang lhan thabs ltar dang / da gang blugs brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi tshul du bkug ste gzar bu gnyis la thim/ de zhu ba las hūṃ las blugs gzar rdo rje dang a las dgang gzar dril bu'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag nag po rdo rje zhags (3ba)pa bsnams pa dang gsod byed ma sngo nag tsit+ta bhan dmar 'dzin pa snyom par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'od du zhu nas blugs gzar dang dgang gzar gyi rnam par bsam/ las bum ni rtse ston chen posamadzad pa'i dbang chog nges don bde 'jug tu rgyas bsdus gnyis 'byung ba las skabs 'dir bsang chu'i dod tsam la bsdus pa'i lugs ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i dang las las byung ba'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su a dkar po shel dkar ltar 'tsher ba de las 'od zer 'phros 'og min nas bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rab 'byams rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus te bum chu la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi sems can rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la ā+oṃ āḥ/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla/ mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas brlab pa ni/ bsang chu g.yon skor gyis gtor zhing / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shesakyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rtsi dang tri las dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag phung khams skye mched las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang 440

yang bzlog nag po me'i sbu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po/ nang ma(kha)rang gi drag po'i las rab 'byams ma lus pa sgrub par nus pa ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a lha āḥ(4na stu nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchode rdzas dang / ā+oṃ ya māt+na ka dgra bgegs: tri mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ lan gsum gyis sreg rdzas rnams brlab/me sgrub pa ni/ las sngags brjod cing gzhung nas bshad pa'i me las sbar ba'i spor lde ras dmar sogs man ngag bzhin bsgrubs pa thal sbyar gyi bar du bzung nas g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ de dang mtshungs par a kro 'bru bcu gcig pa bzla zhing ting lo sbar ba dang bcas/ hūṃ/ dme khu gas bshan pa nag po'i khyim nang nas bslangs me yam shing nag po la sbar bas: drag po'i sreg rdzas 'bar bar mnga' gsol lo 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du 'khyil ba'i las mdzod cig zho asni ha bya ka bya dza: dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa dz+wa la re zhes brjod cing rtsa skam cung zad bcug /bshad ma thag pa'i sngags dang bcas blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso zhing / e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad ces rlung g.yab kyis cung zad g.yab/ sngar bzhin thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma dgra bgegs kyi gdan la hūṃ mthing nag las rdo rje nag po rwa rnam par gdengs pa lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ drag po'i thab khung gru gsum pa kha dog nag pa bang rim gsum dang ldan pa kha khyer gdengs shing mchu 'phyang ba zab cing rgya che ba drag po chos kyi dbyings gshin rje'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du raṃ las dug gi me dpung 'bar zhing 'byug pa 'ur 'ur chom chom tshig tshig phaṭa phaṭa khug khug sod sod rgyob (4ba)rgyob sgra 'brug stong ltar ldir ba'i dbus su ra skyes kham pa 'ja' 'od lnga dang glog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ mi'i ya mgal gyi snga ru dang ma mgal gyi phyi sasbrul nag khra bo'i gong rmed byas pa/ sga la zhing pags g.yogs pa'i steng du hūṃ raṃ las skyes pa'i me lha sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyis dbyu gu dang gus bsnams pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags shing mi sdug pa khro 'khrugs rngam pas khams gsum za bar nus pa mche ba gtsigs shing ljags dril ba/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing khro gnyer —441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6) bsdus pa dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan cing me'i thod bcings pa/zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ bra mo ha pra mo ha/ zhes brjod pas phyogs bzhir pra mo ha bzhi sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/g.yas gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang mi'i mgal ba/g.yon gnyis me dar dang dril bu 'dzin pa gcer bu 'greng ste gnas pa/gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sku las 'od zer nag po dpag med 'phro ba/de thams cad kyi dpral bar ā+oṃ/mgrin par skuḥthugs kar hūṃ/bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi me mtshams nas6lha drang srong gi tsho gis kyis bskor ba rmi bedz+ra sa mādza:rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang dbyugu rtsegasum gyi phyag rgyas g.yab cing /hūṃ/dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis:tshur gshegs me lha drang srong ldan7chog:bstan pa srung mdzad gzi brjid can rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du:'dir gshegs drag po'i phrin las mdzod:e khyo hi bha ga wā na dzaḥsnyi baṃ sngo ca asna ye dz+nyā na sam ye ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri shu dza sngosam ya stoḥzhes pas spyan drangs te/hūṃ/gzi brjid chen po me yi lha 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub cing :thugs rjes drag po'i las mdzad pa 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol:chu 0 ye sam ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan rgyas bzhugs su gsol //me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog:zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tsho gos pa:'phrin las kun gyi dbang po mdzad ting 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo:chu asna ye a la la sngo a ti pu lho pra ti dza sngo zhes phyag bya/hūṃ/me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog:ra skyes bcibs nas glog las mgyogs sreg rdzas kun gyi phyag 'tshang mdzad:tshim byed khyod la mchod pa ni mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos:mar me dri chab zhal zas dang :rkang gling rol mor bcas pa 'bul zhes nas drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod zho badz+ra kro ta asna ye ji pā dza snronas sha lta gu dza hūṃ gi bar gyis chu gnyis nyer spyod tsol/hūṃ/kho 'dzin dbang sgyur zhal zas bdud rtsi lnga:drang srong wo pos sngon chad ma bstar ba'i dag cing gtsang mar sbyar ba 'bul lags kyi thugs rje chen pos dgongs 5bte bzhes su gsol:ma badz+ra krota asna ye pā dza ༷ / sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi:ma ha ba liṅka khā hi:ma

yang bzlog nag po me'i sbu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po/ nang ma(khanahā rak+ta khā his nang mchod 'bul // gzi byin chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub cing :thugs rjes drag pos las mdzad pa longs spyod tsho gis kyi mchod pa 'bul ca badz+ra kro ta asna ye ga ṇa tsakra byu dza khā sti zhes tshogos nas kyang 'bul // me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: mnyam pa'i ngang la kun snang yang : chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa'i: ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pasabastod/ ro sgra brgyad po bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rtsi dang tri las byung ba'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sgra ma nyams pa drag po'i las rab stims sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ hūṃ ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra satwa a zhes ro skra rnams g.yon skor du snga ma'i rtses phyi ma'i rtsa ba non pa dgram/byon zan 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i zhal gru gsum du gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje nag po rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can 'bar zhing glog ltar 'byug pa la raṃ yig dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa dang / dgang blugs kyi rtse la hūṃ yig nag po re res mtshan par mos nas/ ā+oṃ asna ye swāhā/ brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyisadagang gzar bkang ste pus mo'i khong las lag pa gnyis mi 'da' bas khro bo'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar nas g.yon du bskor zhing ā+oṃ asna ye di bya di bya bi shudhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye/ bdag cag dpon (6na)slob yon mchod rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar gcod khyad par dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong che ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/na mo rig pa'i rgyal po drang srong me lha chen po khyod kyis las thams cad byed pas sreg rdzas lha'i zhal du 'bul ba dang me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlab pa dang bdag gi 'phrin las sgrub par mdzad dug sol/ bdag cag gi sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad dug sol/zhes brjod de yam shing zung du sbyar ba ni/ ā+oṃ asna ye pra ti ha ra dz+wa la ye/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod la gnod par byed pa nas bzung mā ra ya rbad ces pa'i bar gyi mang nyung skabs dang sbyar ba 'bul/ 'bru mar ni/ ā+oṃ asna ye bdag cag dpon slob sogs spel tshig gong dang 'dra ba la dgang blugs kyis dbul/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyag bzhi pa:—443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nazhabs bzhi las kun grub par byed: ra skyes kham pa chibs su bcabs: ra la 'ja' dang glog gis brgyan: zhing gi ya mgal snga ru dang : sprul nag 'khyil pas gong rmed byas me lce dgu phreng sku la brgyan:bram ze'i bu mo lnga brgya yang : khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog yin no: kha 'bar ma yis me bus pa'i asni rā dza 'khor bcas la: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa dang : 'tshe med bdud rtsi dpal bshos dang : spos chen dud pa la sogs pa sreg rdzas mchode pa 'di (6bsko.u la gyi: zhe sdang khros pa'i sbyor ba choms lus srog dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye rtsa rgyus khrag gi bla mtsho skoms: gdug rtsub me lha'i zhal du stob: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ 'a ṣi PROB badz+ra kro ta asna ye che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces pas rtsa ba'i rdzas/ drag rdzas/ gnad rdzas/ nad bskyed pa'i rdzas/ dug gsum las sbyor gyi rdzas tsha ba bskyed pa'i rdzas myos rdzas: gsod rdzas te brgyad po yang grangs su bcad de 'bul/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog ra skyes bcibs nas glog pas mgyogs zhes sogs kyis mchode bstod gong ltar bya me lha 'khor yos khye rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor la: nyer 'tshe bar gcod mi mthun phyogs gtong ba'i ban bon skye bo sogs/ /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba yi/ /drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ asna ye dz+wa la dz+wa la/gha tsha gha tsha/ la bha bha muḥ ye shes me lha dam tshig pa nyid las phyir gshegs shar lho'i mtshams su rab bzhugs nas/ /zhal tshur gzigs te dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ mnyes byed mchod pa'i dpang po mdzad par gyur/ /zhes me lha ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ skye/dam tshig me lha'i thugs kar chos kyi dbyings drag po'i zhing khams mtha' dang (7na8bus med pa/ /rab tu yangs shing gting zab rgya che'i nang : rang gi thugs las hūṃ chad 'od du 'bar/ /hūṃ las e yaṃ raṃ baṃ le yig lnga nas/ nam yang gzhom zhig med pa'i gur du gyur gyi bar dkyus ltar gtso 'khor kun kyang sku mdog
