rtsa ba'i zhal/ mig sman mdog can shin tu khro zhing rngam/ stang zil ltar gnag 'tsher ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ /drag po'i las kun mdzad pa'i rnam par gyur/ /de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs thams cad 444

yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po/ nang ma(kha)kyi/ /zhes pa nas/ tshugs par nus min mthu rtsal ldan par gyur gyi bar las byang gi dkyus bzhin las rang nyid 'jam dpal zhes pa skad cig 'jam dpal dang / rang gi thugs las zhes pa gtso bo'i thugs las zhes par bsgyur zhing / 'jam dpal zhi drag gi mngon rtogs 'byin 'jug bzlog pa'i skabs ltar byas nas/ lte bar pad zla nyi steng rin po che nas/ dkar dmar dbyangs gsal thabs shes tshul gyis bskor zhes pa'i bar dor/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum pad zla'i gdan la bzhengs zhes pa'i mjug tu thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje nag po'i rwa/ lnga gdengs lte bar mthing nag hūṃ mtshan gyur/ /zhes 'dogs/ sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i mjug tu/ gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol ba'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas la/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul /'bar ba gshin rje'i zhal du kha raṃ ji hi: mañja shrī sogs kyi mthar ga ṇa tsakra (7ba)byu tsa khā his tshogasanas 'bul/ byon zan ni/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal gru gsum zhes pa nas hūm̐ yig nag po re res mtshan par mos pa'i bar dang phyag rgya sogs sngar bzhin gyis/ hūṃ/ chos nyid gdal ba chen po'i hom khung du/ rig pa byang chub sems kyi me sbar te/ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i bag chags bsreg pa dang / 'jam dpal lha tshogs thugs dam bkang ba'i phyir/ /dug gsum sha khrag rdzas chen 'di 'bul gyi/ /mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /las sbyor rtsa ba'i bsnyen sngags tshar bdun brjod rjes blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar 'geng ba sogs dang ā+oṃ asna ye de bya nas ma ra ya rbad kyi bar me lha'i skabs bzhin bya/ nyes byas drag bskul gyi mjug tu/ hūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: gdug pa 'dul mdzad gshin rje'i gshed: srog bdag tshe bdag nag po ni: sku dpangs che la dregs shing rngam nag po dug chen 'khyil ba 'dra: sku ni nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam:gsung ni nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog: thugs ni stong khams khyab par blta zhal ni hom khung gdangs pa 'dra ljags ni hom gzar brkyang ba 'dra: mche ba rtsang phur gtams pa 'dra: khyod ni srog dbugs bdag po ste: gti mug 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: rab khros zhal gsum da dgongs shig sdang —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dgra gnod bgegs kha raṃ khā gi 'dod chags 'bar ba'i slong dkyil nas yum chen khrag mig zhal gdongs shig:(ni〉nga dgra gnod bgegs kha raṃ 'a snyi nga rgyal 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas ya ma rā dza zhal gdongs shig sdang dgra gnod bgegs kha raṃ khā hi: zhe sdang 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas bye ba dgu khri zhal gdongs shig sdang dgra gnod bgegs kha raṃ khā hi phrag dog 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas klu bdud nag po zhal gdongs shig: sdang dgra gnod bgegs kha raṃ khā sti bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas: las gshin sde brgyad zhas gdongs shig sdang dgra gnod bgegs kha raṃ khā hi phye/chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po 'khor dang bcas gdug rtsub dmar nag 'khyil ba'i hom khung 'dir: gshegs shing bzhugs la drag po'i mchod rdzas bzhes:yam shing zhun chen mar nag 'di bsregs pas sdang dgra gnod bgegs ma lus thal bar rlog ling ga ming dus bla srog bcas bsregs pas yid la brnag pa'i dgra gdon rtsad nas chod: drag po'i rdzas rgod ril bu 'di bsregs pas gnod byed byad ma'i mthu stobs drung nas phyung / /gnad la 'bebs pa'i drag rdzas 'di bsregs pas/ /dgra gdon byad me'i tshogs kun gnad la phab/ /'du ba zhabrug byed rdzas rgod 'di bsregs pas/ /dal yams nad kyis dgra bo kha phung thong / /gdug pa gsum gyi rdzas sbyor 'di bsregs pas/ /dgra bgegs rbod gtong ma lus nyams su chug /dreg sngags dmag bzlog rdzas rgod 'di bsregs pas/ /mthu byad rbod gtong rang gshed rang la phob/ /dbye dkrug tsha rdzas 'bar ba 'dri bsregs pas/ /dgra bo lha dang phrol la lus sems bsregs/ /rmugs shing myos byed rdzas sbyor (sa 'di bsregs pas/ /byad ma lhar bcas brgyal 'bog myos su chug /gsod byed rno ngar rdzas sbyor 'di bsregs pas/ /byad ma dgra bgegs ma lus myur du gsod/ /gdug pa me yi las sbyor mchod pa 'dis/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag gyur cig ces brjod de/ thog mar gtso bo la 'bul ba ni/ phye/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dam pa nas bzung / byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob: kyi bar bstod ring ltar dang / ā+oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ phaṭa pra ti ha ta dz+wa la ye/ che ge —446

yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po/ nang ma(khanadu raṃ sha / u nan gzir phyung srog la du raṃ tsit+ta breng shag thun rbad e raṃ dgra'am bgegs a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa kyis yam shing zung du sbyar ba rab brgya/ 'bring drug cu rtsa bzhi tha ma'ang nyer gcig 'bul/sngags dngos gzhi gong ltar la pra ti ha ta dz+wa la'i tshab tu asna ye sbyar bas til mar zhun chen grangs sngar bzhin dgang blugs kyis 'bul/ sgrub 'jug gi 'khor ling ngam liṅga gtubs pa nas gang dgos rnams lha sngags kyi rjes su e la tsakra e rā ga badz+ra ming trig nan srog la hur ṭaṃ dzaḥ ming srog mā ra ya dgra'am bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes sngags bzlas bstun te grangs bcad nas 'bul/ de rjes drag rdzas nas bzung gsod rdzas kyi bar lha sngags la che ge mo du raṃ sha hūṃ nas mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar sbyar bas rim bzhin 'bul/ bh+yo/ khro rgyal chen po'i g.yon gyi phyogs nas ni: zhes sogs dang / he ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ phaṭa la sngags sbyor lugs yab ltar byas rjes rdzas sna dgu po gong ltar 'bul/ hūṃ/ g.yas na sras mchog ya ma rā tsa ni: zhes sogs (9na skong / gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ phaṭa sogs kyis rdzas dgu sngar bzhin 'bul/ mdun na sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po ni: sogs dang /sarba tsit+ta gzir / lhag nan trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya hūṃ phaṭa sogs kyis gong bzhin dang / rgyab na gsung sprul srog bdag nag po ni: zhes sogs dang sngags bshad ma thag pa ltar gyis 'bul zhing bzhi ga la gtso bo las rdzas nyung tsam byed/ las gshin bye ba dgu khri 'khor bcas la/ /drag po'i sreg rdzas 'bar ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob rtswa dmi ya ma kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa sogs gong bzhin 'bul/ bsdus par 'dod na 'khor rnams kyi bstod bskul dkyus gcig tu byas rjes/ he /ya mdu ru tsakra /gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra /sarba tsit+ta gzir thum lhag nan trig nan rbad ya bzlog ya hūṃ phaṭa kyi mthar sngags sbyor lugs sogs gzhung ltar bya/ rgyas bsdus gang gi mthar yang na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa sogs kyis thal mos lan bdun rdeb/ hūṃ/ gzhan yang khro rgyal chen po khyed rnams la: zhes sogs bstod ring mjug gi 'phrin las rdzogs par 'chol/ byon zan gyi skabs ji lta bas gshegs skyems 'bul/ hūṃ/ 'phags 447—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pa'i rgyal po khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed ces sogs kyis phyi mchod/ bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la/ khyad par mchod pa pañca a khra ta/ /mahā ba ling rak+ta ra bcas pa 'bul/ /bzhes (9ba)nas bla med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ mañju shrī sogs kyi mthar ma hā pañca dang ma hā rak+ta sbyar bas sman raka dang gtor ma drag po'i gtor ma ltar brlabs/ hūṃ/ bla med mchog gi mchod par sbyar ba 'di/ sogs kyi mjug tu thun gtor bzhin 'bul/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ta'i la ye swāhās so rtsi dang / zhing chen pags pa la sogs pa/ /lus la bde ba'i reg bya can/ /gos zung gshin rje'i gshed po yi/ /lha tsho gis 'khor bcas sku la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra wasta ye swāhās gos zung 'bul/ /gye/ chos sku skye ba med pa las: zhes sogs kyis bstod/ tshe bdag yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa la bsad pa'i sham bu btags pa bya/ /lha yi lha mchog ma/ bskal pa dpag med ma/ mkhyen brtse nus mnga' ma sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad bkang / yi dam lha mchoge zil gnon 'khor bcas sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ā+oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs dang badz+ra mu:sa ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dbang por bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi/ /me lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ slar yang dam tshig sems dpa' dang / /dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu gyur/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: ra skyes bcibs nas glog pas mgyogs: nas ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ces pa'i bar gyis(10nasgo cho de bstod bya/yam shing nas bzung gsod rdzas kyi bar sngar bzhin dang gshegs skyems dgang blugs bdun gsum byon zan bzhin phul rjes/ /badz+ra ta mu las so rtsi dang wa stas gos zung 'bul/ gtor ma dag po'i gtor ma ltar brlab/ ā+oṃ asna ye sa pa re wā ra ma hā ba lidha pā dza khā hi lan gsum gyas 'bul/ hūṃ/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong 'khor bcas rnams/ /ba ling sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes par bsad pa'i sham bu btags pa'i 'dod gsol bya/ ā+oṃ asna ye — pra titsā nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ yig brgya —448

yang bzlog nag po me'i sbu gri'i drag po'i sbyin sreg du kyi byin za'i phung po/ nang ma(kha)dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyisasgrub kyis gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur spyon zhig /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /ā+oṃ asna ye ya hi gas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ sgrub pa po rnams lag g.yas steng du byas/ srin lag sbrel nas gral gru gsum gyi tshul du/ hūṃ/ 'byung ba'i gdan gzhi rngam 'og nas zhes pa nas nam yang dang bar ma byed cig gi bar dang / bdag cag dpon slob mched dang lcam dral la sdang dgra gnod bgegs thams cad mā ra ya sto bha ya nan/ zhes bro brdung zhing ga pa brjod/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ myur du me gzhi la dgos pa yod na dug khrag gi chus brlan/ /glo bur gyi las dang sgrub mjug gi mtha' sdud kyi mnan pa bya tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sogs phyag len zhal (10ba)rgyun las shes par bya zhing / sgrub mjug gi tshe rdzas gzhan drug po ma 'byor na sngon ma gsum gyis gab tsam yin la/ glo bur ba'i las la rdzas tshang ma nges par 'dzom dgos shing / dam sri sogasagadon chen ma rungs pa kho na la gtso bor dmigs pa'i skabs me hom rang 'bar gyi las ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyud dang rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /bod yul bka' gter gdams pa'i man ngag bcud/ /rigs 'dzin rim byon phyag len zhal shes la/ /brten nas lag len zhakhrugs bsdebs gsal bar bkod/ /'di ko tshul 'dir snying nas mos pa'i blos/ /thos bsam sgom par byed pa'i dpyod ldan la/ /nyer mkho'i ched dang pad gnubs bstan pa yi/ /btsas su spel la chos srung phrang ma dog /'on te chos dang de ston rgyud pa gsang / /rang 'dod dam med 'dod can la bstan na/ /gnyis ka gter srung mas chen sdebazhi pos/ /srog rtsa dmar po drongs la snying khrag 'thungs/ /gtan mdun dam chos sgrub pa dkar po'i mkhar/ /srung byed nag po mthu yi lcags ri'i mthar/ /rab 'bar sreg sbyor rgod ma kha yi me'i/ /tsha reg yid srubs tshogos kyis bzod nus min/ /dge des nyon mongs dug lnga'i bud shing kun/ /ye shes zhugs kyis lhag ma med bsregs pas/ zhes sgrib bag chags smag rum mthar 449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)byas te/ /'jam mgon rigs lnga'i 'od snang 'bar gyur cig /ces yang bzlog nag po me'i spu gri la nye bar mkho ba'i drag po'i sbyin sreg dus kyi byin za'i phung po 'di ni/ slob dpon chen po gtsug lag dpal dges mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg la gzhi byas/ tshe (11na thad ga dgongs rgyud/ drag sngags mtsho ni cha nag po'i rgyud/ srog dmar len spu gri sogs rgyud mang po'i dgongs pa dang / dpa la skyon chen pos mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg pad lugs su grags pa/ gzhan yang slob dpon chen po pa d+me'i man ngag rtsa ba'ang lcags 'dra'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg sogs gter byon dang / se ston chen po'i phyag len gyi sbyin sreg gi shoms/ rje 'bri gung dbur smyon gyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg zla gsang 'dus pa' tan+t+ra sogs rgyud mang po'i dgongs don gyis brgyan pa'i rgyas bsdus sogs khungs ldan gyi yig cha rnams la zhib mor dpyad de theg mchog nges gsang snying po'i 'dus grwa rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams len du 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi snang ba thob pa'i sngags 'chang rim par byon pa'i gdung las son pa za hor yi ban+de zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis shing sbrul hor zla bdun pa'i dmar cha khrag 'thung rnam par rol ba'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ / maṅga lo//rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ka zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma shrī tri ku la sa mā dzā ya/ srid pa'i rtse nas mnar med bar khyab mig sman lhun po srin po'i gzugs/ /srid gsum grong khyer sto bar rab 'chang skye dgu'i bla srog gshed gyur kyang / /srid 'khyams 'gro la gcig tu rjes brtse bgrang yas rnam 'dren yongs kyi yab/ /srid zhi'i pha mthar nam yang lhung min 'jam dpal kun tu bzang po rgyal/ khro med dam nyams dgra la lhag par khro/ /sdang med —450

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta zha nang ma(khanabadud sde'i tshogs la gcig tu sdang / /brtse med 'chi bdag gshin rje 'gro la brtse/ /'jigs med dpa' bo khro chu dug sdong 'jigs/ /gang gi gdams pa rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /bod yul mthu stobs zla bral gnubs chen lugs/ /drag sngags rtsibs stong rtse mor log 'dren tshogs/ /mi rtag lam 'god grags pa phyogs bcur snyan/ /'on te ming tsam brjod las tshul bzhin du/ /legs mkhyen gnam lcags me 'bar yab sras dang / /brgyud par bcas las sngags rloms phal cher gyis/ /ma rtogs gsang ba'i mdzod kyi sgo lcags dam/ /bsams kyin bdag 'dra'i blo dman gdul bya la/ /gnyags (2na)ban rnam sprul chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /'khor lo'i ri mo gtsug tor rtser ba kra ba/ /sangs rgyas thob kyang rgyan du 'dzin par spro/ /bla chen ming dang rigs rus skye ba yis/ khri mthor khengs pa'i sto ba ma sbos par/ kho pos dam pa bsten cing mkhas du mar/ /bgros pas mun par rdzasa'atshol re ba skyungs/ /de phyir yi dam chos skyong dbyer med pa/ /rigs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed/ /bsnyen thabs chu klung dngas byed ke ta ka /dpyod ldan snyim par 'bul gyis dang bas long / /de'ang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya grangs med pa'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por dam pa'i chos kyi phung po mtha' yas par stsal pa thams cad kyang nyan rang byang sems/kṛ yog sdogasum/ yo ga gsum ste theg pa rim pa dgur 'dus la/ de'i nang nas sgrub sdebargyad la sogs pa'i skor rnams bskyed pa ma hā yo gar gtogs shing de la yang sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las ma mo rbod gtong 'jig rten mchod bstod drag sngags rnams las sku 'jam dpal gshin rje la (2bsko bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs phyag rgya zil gnon/ rdo rje'i rigs 'joms byed nag po/ rin po che'i rigs kha thun nag po/ pad+ma'i rigs 'jigs byed ru mtshon dmar po/ las kyi rigs gshor bsad nyi ma khros pa'i skor sogs rnam grangs ches mang ba las 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi las kyi gshin rje khro chu dug sdong nag po 'di ni 'gran gyi zla med pas byad ma mkhan po'i rbod gtong rang gshed du —451—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'bebs shing rgyal ba zhi khro nas grong rgyu'i 'gong po yan gyi gnyen po/ skye 'gro rnams la chu srin kha gdangasapa lta bu/ yi dam chos srung gzhan gyis lta bar mi bzod pa'i mu stegs rdzas mthu nag pos gnod mi nusapar ma zad 'di la grogs su 'gyur/ byad ma pha rol po nus pa che zhing srung zlog ji ltar mang bzhin du lhag par phar la bzlog bsad myur/ lan cig bsgrubs na slar bskyar mi dgos/ bsnyen pa kha gso gtor bskul 'thu ba brdabs pa tsam gyis dgra bo skad cig la 'chi ba'i ral gri byung rgyag /rlung sgrub bam rdzu 'phrul gyi bsgrub po yin pas spu gri ka ma la ltar rno zhing rlung bzhin 'khrug pa la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i skor 'di ni sman sdong chen mo'i rgyud las/ rgya gar gyi grong khyer mu stegs kyi ba ra dh+wa dza bya ba dar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ni dar yod pa mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phung byed nag po dang / mu stegs skra'i la ba can dang / mu stegs me'i slag pa can dang / mu stegs kyi sde rigs thams cad 'dus nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa thams cad ni bshig /glegs bam thams cad me la bsregs/ chos kyi sgra yang (3na〉sku grag par byas so/ /de'i dus su sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'di 'dra yong ba yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dgongs te thugs mug skyes te 'jam dpal thugs khros pa las las kyi gshin rje ya ma rā dza zhes pa'i skur sprul nas dbu gsum phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra sta/ g.yon gsum glo snying bsnam ba'i pa/ sku smad lcag bshakyi phur pa zur gsum pa dpal dang ldan pa/ sku la ye shes kyi me 'bar ba 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu bstan pas mu stegs thams cad brgyal zhing shi/ mu stegs kyi yig cha thams cad mer bsregs/ mu stegs kyi bstan pa ni gcig kyang med par byas so/ /zhes pa ltar lha mchog 'di nyid shes bya bcu'i sgo nas shes dgos pa 'byung khungs ni/ gshin rje zla gsang nag po'i rgyud las byung zhing mu stegs pa rnams 'dul ba'i thabs gtso bor bstan pas mu stegs zla gsang nag por grags/ rigs ni sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga las sku'i rigs/ mtshan ni rgyud las/ nang ltar rta mgrin 'jam dbyangs phyag rdor gsum yin/ phyi mu stegs la rno ba mthu de ltar che/ gsang ba ltar chos sku longs sku gsum yin —452

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug stong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)pas rtags mtshan che ba de ltar lags/phyi ltar na 'chi bdag/tshe bdag/srog bdag gsum yin/rdzu 'phrul drag rtsal che ba de ltar lags/ zhes pa ltar rigs gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gshin rje khro chu dug sdong nag po/mu stegs srog gi spu gri/byad ma 'bum gyi srog gcod/las kyi mtha' sdud spyi gshed nag po zhes sogs rnam 3ba ) grangs mtha' yas/'khor ni gshed chen sdo drug por ma zad ye shes kyi srung ma dang 'jig rten dregs pa'i tsho gis rnams kyis bka' nyan/gsung bstod/'phrin las sgrub par byed pa 'di'i sngon gyi dam tshig dang las kyi che ba las ni sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i spyan sngar srog snying phul nas dam bcas pa'i mthus phyi nang ban bon gyi byad ma mkhan po gang dang 'gras kyang log rdugs 'byams gsum med par skad cig la brlag pa'i las 'grub/sprul pa ni dus drug dam rdzas tshogs shing rbad bskul gnad kyi sprul pa lha srin sde brgyad dam las mi 'da' bar gang bcol byed pa/sprul pa'i rgyu mtshan yang ji slad du/spyi bo'i rtsa nas ya shar gshin rje byung //lte ba'i rtsa nas ma shar ma mo byung //snying ga'i rtsa nas na shar klu rgyal byung //mgrin pa'i rtsa nas ra shar rgyal po byung /shangs kyi khung nas shag ra gza' rgod byung //snyan gyi khung nas k+ṣa shar gnod sbyin byung //spyan mig gnyis nas tsa shar btsan rgod byung //phyag zhabs mthil nas du shar dmu rgyal bdud//ces tshe bdag gi lasasbyor skabs rgyud khungs dang tshol ba don gyi 'dir yang thob/mdzad pa po ni siṅga la'i paṇ+ḍita 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/skyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa/slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po rnams kyis zla gsang gi rgyud rnams bshad thabs kyi sgo nas bal yul gyi 'bangs 'bum sder dbang ba'i yam bu'i rgyal rigs gu ru nor bu 'dzin par gnang /gzhung las/mu stegs ston pa 'di nyid kyi//las sbyor gshin rje'i ga sngags 'di//gshin rje nag po'i rgyud las btus//lcags kyi 4na lngar bur bcu gnas ni//bal yul bum thang gter du sbas//phyi rabs dus kyi tha ma la//las can zhig dang 'phrad par shog/las can zhig gis thon nas kyang //gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar shog/ces pa ltar/slob dpon bal po'i rgyal pos gshin rje zla gsang lo po'i rgyud las bkol te lcags kyi par bur bcug rgya

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rim pa gsum gyis btab nas gzhung yig rnams bal yul bum thang ke rur gter du sbas/slob dpon 'dis mu stegs pa rnams btul bas mu stegs slob dpon du'ang grags/ chos skor rnams gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin bo cher tshig brgyud kyi tshul du gsungs pas ji skad du/spu ga sangs rgyas ye shes kyis//rgya gar gtsug lag dpal dge la//bal yul yam bu'i dgon du zhus//zhes ba la po'i rgyal por ma zad gtsug lag dpal dger yang gsan/bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyi//gshin rje nag po'i zhal gdams sbyar//gtsug lag dpal dge'i bkar nyan pas//su la'ang mi spel gter du sba//zhes pa ltar shog dril la zhal gdams phal cher bse sgrom sprug por bcug nas mon bum thang dang 'thor bu byang spra dun rtser yang gter du sbas/dgos byed ni spyir bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog pa dang /bye brag sngags ban la stobs ldan gyi 'tshe bas khas nyen pa/lhag par ban bon mu stegs byad ma mkhan po mthu chen rnams 'dul ba'i phyir mdzad/gter ston ni gnubs chen gyi skye ba sprul sku rgya zhang khrom rdo rje 'od 'bar gyis gter kha gsum po tshang bar gdan drangs pas/bdag 'dra sangs rgyas ye shes kyis//rgya gar shar nub chu 4ba ) bzhin myul//tha mar bod yul dbus su slebs//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung don du//srog ser gtad gsum la sogs pa'i//ngan sngags yig sna dpag med zhus//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag/khyad par snying thig skor mdzod nas/khro chu khol ma'i 'gom chog 'di//bal yul bum thang ke rur sbas//dum pa rgya yis gter nas bton/kha ba rgyug pa'i 'phro la 'gyel//gdams pa 'di 'dra a tsa ma//zhes pas shes nus shing gdams pa'i che ba 'don pa'i ched du bal po nas la stod kyi bar gtor ma dang bskul tsam gyis ban bon lnga bcu tsam zhag bdun nas 'chi rtags thon par bsgral bas drag sngags kyi snyan pas khyab/brgyud pa ni gter ston rgya zhang khrom la gnubs ston dar dbang gis 'bri sum sto sogasum gzhal ba'i rta 'brug gshog/gser srang gang /sbyang thul rnams phul nas zhus/dgra bo zhag bdun nas 'chi rtags thon/de la bha ya shāka rdor gyisagaser srang gang dang nor bu g.yu wor bya ba phulaXzhus/pho mo sum stozlo go go nas 'chi rtags thon/

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)de la sras a grags kyis 'bul zhabs bteg nas zhus pas mthu nus kyi grags pa thob/ gzhan yang rje btsun don yod rdo rjes gsan pa sogs nas nye bar brgyud/ bar skabs su dar rgyas che ba tsam byung na'ang rim gyis cho me rgyun nyag phrar song bas lho na stag dang byang na 'brong gi dpe bzhin khro chu dug sdong zer ba'i gshed skor zhig yod par snang zhes gleng ba tsam las rtogs pa ni dgun chu ltar gyur skabs gung rad pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang rgya ston nam mkha'i mtshan can sogs yongs 'dzin 'ga' zhig la rje zur pa gnam (5na tshe:gas me 'bar gyis gsan/ de la snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho yab sras rnams kyis gsan pa las rim par brgyud de zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol dang dpal 'gri gung pa dbur spyon chos kyi grags pas gsan pa'i rgyun ma chad pa yod cing mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rjes kyang tshe bdag yang bzlog dang khro chu'i skor rje 'bri gung par gsan/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis 'jam dpal dug sdong gi skor snang gsal ba rigs 'dzin kun dga' che chog lags na par grags kyang brgyud pa de dag las 'ongs pa'i rgyun ni nam mkha'i dbyings su dengs so/ /de yang chos skor 'di'i yig sna phra zhib gab dkrugs 'thor ba'i tshul du bzhugs pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsung rgyun phyag bzhes dmar khrid du sdeb lugs mdzub btsugs su ngo ma 'phrod na yungs gar spang la gtor ba'am byis pa 'ja' tshon blta ba ltar lag tu mi khel bas spyi sgos su 'tshe ba'i dgra bo gdug can la mkhas pa gtsang nag par khyis rmug par brtsams pa na/ dgag bya byung na dgos pa yod/ khyi la chos kyi bkra shis shog /ces gsungs nas po ti brgyab pa ltar dug sdong gi glegs bam dpangs mtho bar bzhugs pa bsnun na dgra gcig gi thod pa gtib thub pa tsam ni yod shas che/ de las gzhan du glegs bam sngas su rgyag gam gsar ma ba'i chos skyong rnams kyi be'u bum dang lhan du rdul dang mun pa'i mal du gzims pa las 'os ma mchis pas gnubs chen dang sprul sku rgya'i thugs bdud 'di nyid kyi dgos don log 'dren gyi dgra bo tshe srog dang phral te rnam shes chos sku bde ba chen po'i klong du 'dren pa'i las la sbyor ba de'i sngon (5bskos grub ba'i gnad shes dgos/ sgrub pa la'ang lha nye bar bsnyen pa 455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)nyid gal che bas de la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum gyi dang po la nges pa'i don bde bla gtu 'jug pa sogs yig cha khungs btsun gyi steng nas 'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du legs par smin cing /sman sdong nag po'i byin rlabs dug gi srog dbang gi yi ge ltar las gshin 'di nyid kyi sgo nas dbang lung man ngag phyag khrid legs par nod pa'i sngags pas gnas kyi khyad par rgyud sde spyi skad du bsnyen par gnam sa bar gsum la bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs sa dpyad bkra shis pa 'byung po gdug pa can gyi rgyu srang sogs mi dang mi ma yin gyis 'tshe ba nyung ba/sgrub thob gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags pas mtshone dge ba'i mtshan ma dang mngon spyod la gnam sa gru gsum ri brag mtshon cha gzings pa lha 'dre drag po 'du zhing dur khrod dang bas mtha' chu gling lta bu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas bshad la/gter ston rgyal po chosargyal rat+na gling pa'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus su/sde dgon gnas gzhi sbyin sreg byas skul du//ser ba bsgrubs na mi 'grub zhud pas spang //dbang bskur byin rlabs tshe sgrub byas bzhul du//mthu phran bsgrubs na mi 'grub zhud pas spang //mchode rten su tsā gsung rab bklags ma la du//ltas bsgrubs na mi 'grub zhud pas spang //dug sbrul 'gyus srang sa ral shwa 'od rtsar//nor sgrub bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub zhud pas spang //zhes sogs rten 'brel gyi gnad 'gag brtsi lugs sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung lhad med ngo mtshar ba snang mod/'on 6na long rigs gsum 'dus pa'i kyilas gshin rje 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum dkyus gcig tu byed pa'i dbang du byas nas rtsa tshig bzhi bcu rtsa drug gi bshad bgrol rin po che'i gter mdzod las/ dang po sgrub pa'i sa gsum ni/ dur khrod/nags khrod shin tu 'jigs pa'i sa ni dben pa'i gnas so//dur khrod dam zhes pa ni ro bsregs pa'i sa/dme byas pa'i sa/mi grir bsad pa'i sa dang de rnams bsdus pas dur khrod do/ /nags khrod ni/mtshams khang gsal khung med pa yol ba dang mtshams rig legs par bya'o/man tu 'jigs pa ni ri gnyan gsum gyi rtse'am gdong sna'i sa dang /luX ༷nyan gsum 'dus pa'i sa dang /lha khang rnying pa'i

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug stong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)sa dang / mchod rten zhig po'i sa dang / de rnams lha 'dre 'du ba'i sa yin pas 'jigs pa'i sa'o /dben pa ni mtshams dgra med pa mtho ba btsan pa khyi la sogs pa'i gnod 'tshe med pa/ mtshams g.yog go chod pa/ bsil khang 'dzom pa la sogs pa'o/ /zhes byung la/ dus tshod gza' skar yang lugs gzhan ltar shis pa gtso bor mi 'don par sgrub thabs 'grel pa lag len gsal sgron las/sgrub pa'i dus tsho de gza' skar ni/gza' phur bu/skar ma mgo la sogs pa mar gyi ngo/gza' skar 'phrod pa'i dus su/ zhes bshad pa drag po'i sgrub pa la yin nam snyam na/ gzhung 'di gar/ smra bcad byas la gzhung ltar bsnyen pa drag tu thog ltar bzlas so//zhes pas rtogs nus/chos rgyal 'bri gung pa dbur smyon gyis gza' skar 'grub sbyor la'ang gdam ngar gsungs pa 'grub sbyor bdun po zhi drag kun la shis par dgongs/6ba〉sa rab rgya mtsho reg za' skar dus tshes bzang bar bshad pa lugs 'di ga'i bzang ba de g.yin dag gi ngan 'tshub la ngos 'dzin dgos pa phar ri la bltos nas tshur ri dang tshur ri la bltos nas phar rir 'jog pa bzhin yin pas gnas dang yo byad 'du byas shing / dus tshod tshes grangs dang bstun mtshams khang du 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon dang las gshin dug sdong nag po sogs kyi bris 'bur gyi brten rab gnas can bshams/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag bskyed kho nar brten pa dang / bdag mdun zung 'brel gnyis byung ba spros par mi dga' na snga mas 'grub kyang / rje 'bri gung chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i las byang gdug pa kun spros las/gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/bsnyen pa'i dus rang gi mdun du bskyed cing /srung bzlog bsad pa'i to dus gar chen la dmigs pa'o//de yang 'di lta ste/mdun gyi rten nam gtor chen bsangs sbyangs la/hūṃ/chos rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal//zhes pa nas/spyan drangs gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed kyi skabs ji lta ba las/bdag nyid ces pa'i mal du mdun zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas lha tsho gos rnams gsal bar bskyed la/zhes byung bas srung bzlog bsad mnan gyi dus mdun bskyed kyi gtor mar dmigs rten du mdzad la/rje snang gsal ba kun dga' tshe mchog gisaXdzaX pa'i bzlog bsad gnam lcags 'bar ba log

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'dren 'joms pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lor mdun dugator chen gyi lha tsho gos bskyed tshul rgyas par gsungasapa ltar byed na gong du bshad pa btang snyoms su bzhag pas chog cing 'dir ma tho gyi lto bar chos 'byung bsnol ma bris pa zor gdan dang nor (7na thas gtor chen la stegs bu 'brub khung sogs dgos tshul rje 'bri gung pa gsung ba bla ma gnyis ka chos 'di la nang byan chud par 'dug pas rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par las mi 'gal zhing gshin rje sde drug phyag drug tu bshad pa yig chung shog dril nas bstan pas lugs gnyis gang byas kyang mi 'thad pa med dam snyam/ snang gsal phyogs su rang 'dra'i sprul pa zer ba tsam la'ang khungs su mdzad rung mu tig phreng bar rang 'dra'i sprul pa phyag gnyis pa'ang bshad pasamatha' gcig tu mnges pa 'dra/ gdug pa kun sgrol du srung bzlog gsad pa dang ma 'brel ba'i mdun bskyed kyi dmigs rten sgrub gtor la bshad cing / rje snang gsal ba'i las byang du/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni rten rnams bsangs sbyangs byas la zhes pa las gtor ma'i gsal kha med cing las byang gi brjod bya dang mthun pa'i bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa snang ba lugs 'di'i dbang gi cho ga gtor mar brten pa las dkyil 'khor dgos don yang med la phyag len la'ang mi mdzad pas mdun bskyed kyi sgrub gzhi kho na gtso tshe zhing dus gtore sogs rgyun gyi nyams len la tsho gis mchode kyi yul lta bu so gos la dgongs te bzlas pa grub nas slar gsal 'debs skyor mdzad mod/ bdag mdun bsnyen sgrub zung 'brel gyi skabs thog ma nyid nas gsal 'debs dgos pas stegs kyi khar mdun dkyil bkram pa'i steng mthing lcags sam bhan+ta'i zhing du sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ mi rta bya g.yag ra stag gzig sogs nag po'i rigs kyi sha khrag /btsan dug thang phrom sogs dug sna/ 'bru sna rnyed tshad rnams bsres pa chang dang sems can gyi gso ne khrag gis sprus pa'i gtore ma (7bcu gtu zan grugasum logs mdun la bstan pa'i steng du zur gsum phur bu'i dbal lta bu zur mdun la bstan pa las cung zad chung ba yum/ de las chud ba'i sde drug lta bdun gyis bskor ba rnams kyi dkyil nag mtha' dmar bar me ri phyag mtshan sa bon sogs dkar dmar gyi rgyan sprod legs pa'i mthar mtheb skus bskor bar rtsang dmar 458

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta spu nang ma(kha)nyer gcig srin 'gros su btsugs par sha khrag gis brgyan pa/de'ang srung bzlog bsad pa'i gtor ma'i nang bzhugs kyi 'khor lo lcags sbubs su bcug pa dang steng nas gdugs ltar 'bugs pa'i tshe bdag lto 'khor sogs mi dgos kyang srog 'khor gal che ba snang gsal ba'i dpe ris kyi mu khyud cig la thun sngags 'dug pa man ngag yig chung du mi gsal yang /rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i phyag rgyun gyi dbe'u ris su mi snang zhing /de'i lto bar rdo rje dang de'i phyi rol tu rigs gsum mgon po'i sngags bshad pa yig chung du ma byung yang bsrung dmigs dang 'brel chags shing rje zur pa'i phyag dpe khungs thub kyi rgyun yin 'dra ba dag gam snyam gang ltar srog 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lte ba lugs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar byas pa tshon sna lnga'i srad bus bcings/ gri lcags kyi rten phur/ tsher nag gi phur pa dar sna lngas brgyan cing dar dmar gyis gril ba de dang lhan cig par rtse mo rdo rje phyed pa la rtsa ba phur zhabs can rnams gtore gdugs kyi 'og tu mi ma rga par mda' la 'dogs/dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyisabris pa'am ras bris la lha mtshan tsam las sku med pa dang /de yang ma 'byor bar gtor ma 'ba' zhig la brten na gtso 'khor brgyad po'i tsakli 'dzugs/de'i mdun ngos su gtor gdugs srog 'khor phur pa rtsang sogs spang zhing tshad 8na7nga snga ma las chung ba'i 'dzin gtor dang de las cung dma' ba'i gta' gtor bshams/'dzin gtor zhes pa gsar ma'i shan shor snyam pa'i log rtog 'byung srid kyang /kha byang gsal ba'i sgron mer/rten bzheng ba dang /srog 'bor bca' ba dang /gri phur gyi rten bca' ba dang /gtar chen dang /rgyun gyi 'dzin gtor bcas pa'o//zhes bshad/logs shig tu lcags sam bhan+ta'i nang du spyi gshed kyi gtore ma sha khrag rtsang gis brgyan pa/mdun gyi g.yas su pañca.a mṛ tas spagasapa'i chang zhim po'i sman mchod/ g.yon du mi'am dud 'gro'i gson khrag la dug sna dang khrag chen bsresapa'i rak+ta/lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+ta'i snod so sor khrag chen gyi yon chab/dbang po'i me tog sha chen gyi bdug spos/tshil wo gyi mar me/mkhris pa'i dri chab/tsit+ta'i zhal zas rnams sgor mchod dam thad ma rdzogang rung du bsgrig /sgrub ba pho stan ༷༷ rdor dril thod rnga lor nas gu gul sogs nye bar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mkho ba'i rdzas yo thams cad bsnyen sgrub spyi gzhung ltar 'du bya/ 'di nyid sgrub pa'i sgab 'dre gza' dang rgyal po yin pa gnon thabs kyi man ngag bshad kyang lta sgom gyi drod tshang med na dregs pa can 'di rigs thul dka' bas phyag len la tsher mi mdzad/ mdun dkyil gyi mtha' skor du sdebargyad rnams kyang 'god cing tshogs gtor dbul nas srung ma'i tshul gyis ltas ngan g.yang du blang ba yin gsung / las rab rgya mtshor/ spyir bstan dgra /khyad par du yang bsnyen sgrub la bar chad byed pa rnams kyi ྅ pa bzlog bsad kyi sngags kyis bskor ba gzhug /ces pa ltar lag len bzhin bris nas bsgrubs shing mnan na (8ba)dgra bgegs kyi bar chad spyir zhi ba'i zhan sgab 'dre'i gnod pa la'ang shugs kyis phan par sems mod ding sang phyag len du mdzad pa nyung bsam byas kyang 'gal ba med/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ mtshamasakyi sngon du cha gsum dang gser skyems btang ste sde brgyad cha mnyam/ dkar dmar gyi gtor ma bsngo ba 'di ga'i las byang tshor byung ba ltar bgegs bskrod dang srung 'khor bya/ de'ang gnubs chen gyis mdzad pa'i las byang bdud dpung gtor byed du bdag bskyed 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po dang mdun bskyed khro chu las kyi gshin rje'i tshul du sgrub par gsungs pas zil gnon gyi las byang rgyas pa'am yang bzlog yab yum gyi mngon rtogs tsam la brten kyang legs pa'i cha yin mod phyis su 'jug pa bde ba'i ched yi dam chos skyong dbyer med du bzhed pas rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog gis mdzad pa'i las byang gzhung bsrang / rgyud las/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum yin te phyi ltar 'chi bdag srog bdag tshe bdag gsum du 'dus pas khro chu dug sdong gi sgrub pa dang gcig /nang ltar 'jam dbyangs rta mgrin phyag rdor gsum du 'dus pas rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub pa dang gnyis/ gsang ba sku gsum 'dus pa gzhi lam 'bras gsum sgrub pa dang gsum/ zhes bshad pa'i don bzhin cho me rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal/ /zhes pa gzhi chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ka dag gi ngang nas/ snying rje'i rtsal du/ zhes pas lam gong gi gdangs 'gag pa med pa longs sku kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin lhun grub 'od lnga'i rang bzhin nyi ma'i snying po lta bu/ rang byung khro tsho gis gsal/ zhes pas 'bras bu nyi ma 460

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ge ta spu nang ma(khanalas 'od zer shar ba (9na skor sprul sku rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin khro bo'i tshogs kyi rten brten pa rnams 'char byed kyi rgyu yi ge e las rim gyis 'phros pas/ e las rab 'jigs nam mkha' mtha' dbus med/ /ces sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bdag mdun gnyis ka'i gzhi rten gcig tu byas te/ rgyud las stong pa'i ngang las 'jig rten khams/ /gshin rje dmyal ba'i yul du bsam/ /'og ni spu gri'i sa gzhi la/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyi ru mtshon cha 'tshol ba'i gzhal yas khang / /zhes sogs blo ka lngas srung 'khor dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rten brten pa bsgom tshul rnams bsnyen pa'i dus dmigs pa gtod pa'i zab khyad kyis me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar las byang gi tshig gcig pus bdag bskyed bsgom pa dang mnyam du mdun bskyed kyang gsal 'debs shing gsang sngags spyi'i srung 'khor dang mi 'dra bar cung zad 'khrug cing rtogs dka' ba gur khang shog dril/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog gi gsung rgyun dang zhal bkod kyi mdun dkyil rigs 'dzin ku mā ra'i rnam sprul zur sngags 'chang gzhen nu don grub kyi phyag bris ma khungs btsun dang dam pa'i zhal lung ltar go bde bar bshad na/ kha byang las/ ting nge 'dzin gyi srung ba la dgu /phyi gur khang brgyad kyi srung ba dang zhes sogs kyi gur khang brgyad ni/ shog dril las/lcags bsregs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dmar har re 'dug pa zhig tu bsam/ de'i phyi rol tu mtshon cha sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / de'i rgyab tu thod pa'i gzhal yas khang dbyibasasgo nga lta bu/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang de'i 'od zer dang / gzhal yas khang gi lha 'jam (9ba'i pa la gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i snying gar phog /rnam shes mar me lta bur gsal ba de 'od zer phog pa tsam gyis kho'i lha srung 'khor bcas 'khor sa ma rnyed nas bros te srung mas mgon byed rgyu la rang gi srung ma kho'i srung ma'i mas du gnas pas kho'i gshed byed par bsgoms/ de'i phyi rol tu dug sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dbyibs khu1 bzhi pa kha dog na bun lta bu smug nag 'thibs shing g.yas dang g.yon du 'khor ba dug gi 'od zer 'phros pas byad ma lha srung gnod byed thams cad kyis mthong ba tsam gyis brgyal nus pa 461—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)zhig tu bsgoms/ de'i phyi rol du rlung sbu gri ngar ma so 'thab kyi gur khang dbyibs gru gsum pa kha dog ljang nag g.yas g.yon du 'khor bas byad ma lha dang bcas pa'i gnod byed thams cad bskal pa'i me la bya sgro phog pa lta bur bsam/ de'i phyi rol du khro chu'i gzhal yas khang sra la mkhregs pa bskal pa'i rlung yang mi thar bar bsam/ de'i phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me ri me dpung 'bar bas gnod byed gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bsam ste gur khang brgyad kyi bsrung ba zhes pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin brtsis na dang po me/ gnyis pa khro chu/ gsum pa rlung gi spu gri/ bzhi pa dug sna tshogs/ lnga pa dur khrod/ drug pa thod pa/bdun pa mtshon cha sna tshogs/ brgyad pa lcags sregs kyi khang pa'i gur te brgyad po bsdo mes pa gzugasakyi shog dril yin la/ de dag gi zhib cha'i rgyas bshad/ srung ba'i shog dril gsum pa las/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba lcags sregs las grub pa'i ga 'kha yas khang dmar har re ba 'dug pa la bskal pa'i me'i tsha tsha dmar (10na)phrom phrom 'phro bar bsam/ de'i phyi rol tu mtshon cha sna tsho gos las grub pa'i gur khang / rdo rje/ ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mdung rtse gsum pa/ dgra sta/ zhags pa/ 'khor lo/ gri gug /mda' la sogs pa mtshon cha rtse phyir bstan pa'i gur/ rdo rje sngon po/ nor bu ser po/ pad+ma dmar bo/ sna tsho gos rdo rje/ gri gug /rgya gram gyi gur khang bsgom mo/ /de'i phyi rim thod pa'i gur khang dbyibs sgo nga lta bu sra la mkhregs pa'i gur khang / de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i gzhal yas khang /zhing chen dang / zhing chung gi dral ma 'phyo ba/ me sa'i g.yang gzhi/ ro bam pa myag ma rul bro ba gzar ba ro zhe sdang gi mes 'tshig pa/ gcan gzan gyi za 'phro yod pa/ keng rus khral khrol yod pa/ dur bya sna tsho gos klad la lding ba/ gcan gzan sna tsho gosang ra ba rgyug mchonges byed pa/ rlangs pa sngo dmar thu lu lu byed pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba zhig bsgom/ shin tu ya nga ba skyi g.ya' ba zhig bsgom/ de'i phyi rol tu dug sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhaX yas khang dbyibs gru bzhir 'dug pa/ kha dog na bun smug nag 'thibasapa/ dug gi 'od zer sngo dmar gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi khyab par los pas byad ma lha srung gnod byed dang bcas pa rnams brgyal nus par bsam/ de'i phyi rim rlung gi spu gri so 'thab pa ngar ma'i gur khang 462

rigs gsum bos pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)dbyibs gru gsum du 'dug pa kha dog ljang nag g.yas dang g.yon du 'khor bas byad ma gnod byed thams cad gri'i bar du gtub pa'am bskal pa'i me la bya sgro bsregs pa ltar bsam/ de'i phyi rol tu khro chu'i gzhal yas khang sra la mkhregs pa cis kyang mi shigs pa'i sda/ra khang /(10ba〉de'i rgyab tu bka' lha ma srin sdebargyad mtshon cha sna tsho gis 'dzin pa'i gur khang / de'i rgyab tu me chu rlabs kyi rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i gur khang / de'i rgyab rlung nag 'tshub ma'i gur khang sbu gri ltar du zhakhrugs pa/ de'i rgya btu lha dmag nyi khri tshig stong gi gur khang / bskal pa'i me chen po ni kun tu sgong ril tshur 'bar ba/ gzugs med nam mkha'i rang sgra'i byad ma la sogs pa gnod byed rnams gsod cig /rgyob cig /rdungs shig /med pas gyis shig /rdul du lhogs shig /ces pa'i sgras 'jig rten gsum khyab par bsam mo/ /gur khang re re la 'thug rngams dpag tshad re yod par bsam/ kun kyang sra ba brtan pa gzhan gyi skyon gyis 'jig mi nus par bsam mo/ /zhes byung ba gong gi gur rim brgyad por lhan thabs su sbyor ba gnad che zhing khro chu'i gur khang dkyil 'khor gzhan ltar khro bo bcur ngos mi 'dzin par khro chu khol ma'i gur yin pasam 'brul ba dgos/ khro bo dkar nag ni/ de nyid las/ de rnams kyi nang du khro bo nag po phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pas zhal phyir 'gyu nas bzlog pa'i sngags dang bzlog pa'i las phun sum tshogs pas dmigs bya rnams phyir bzlog cing res 'ga' phyi rol gyi me la'ang bsreg go /de'i nang du khro bo dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis tshe bum/ bar pa gnyis kyis tsakra /tha ma gnyisakyis thod pa bsnams shing zhal nang du gzigs nas srung ba'i sngags dbyangs gsal dang bcas brjod cing srung ba'i las phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa'i gur khang du bsams te khro bo dkar nag gi srung ba zhes pa dang dus mtshudas las byang du'ang mi gsal mod/ ces byung ba yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i (11na)gur rim bcu gsum gyi bar mtshams tshor khro bos gtam pa dang dgongs pa gcig pas gur rim brgyad po'i bar thams cad khro bo dkar nag gi srung bzlog mdzad par bsams pa mig gi shog dril/gur khang gzhal yas chen po'i nang nyid du zhes sogs blo ka gnyis kyis gzhal yas khang dang gdan 463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bskyed lha bsgom pa ni bdag nyid skad cig rdzus skyes rdo rje'i sku/ /zhes pa nas 'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar ni/ shog dril las/ gur khang gi nang du e mthing bsnol ba'i dbus su gzhung ltar lha bsgom pa ni/ zhes pa srung ba me'i shog dril te khyad par gyi dmigs pa/ srung bzlog bsad gsum gyi zhal gdams las/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor mchod rten gsum la rig gsum gyi mgon po bskyed nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang yi dam zhi khro'i lha tsho gos kyi 'od zer snying po bas bsdus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur bar bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas mu stegs la sogs pa'i khro bo dbang chen ma hā de wa la sogs mu stegs kyi lha thams cad kyi bcud dang 'od zer nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas sku la thim par bsams nas phyi nang ban bon thams cad kyi yi dam gyi lha tshogs thams cad gcig tu bsdus pas dug sdong gi skur gyur par bsams pa ni/ zhes byung gzab gnad do/ /de'ang kha gnon dgos pa khro chung tsho gis 'phros dgra bgegs rdul du rlog zhes yab bskyed zin pa'i 'og tu/ gsang yum gsang ba dun ting nag mo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i cha byad can/ /mche ba bzhi gtsigs spyan gsum sdang (11ba〉peg bgrad/ /ral pa kham nag srid pa'i rtse mor bsnyeg /phyag g.yas dang po ral gris dgra srog gcod/ /'og ma lcags kyusadagra bgegs bla srog 'gugs/ /g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag yab la stob/ /'og ma lcags sgrog gnod byed bla sems 'ching / /zhabs gnyas yab kyi lte bar 'khril sbyor tshul/ /rang 'od las byung sbas pa'i tshul du gsal/ /zhes pa 'jug cing gdug pa kun sgrol du gnyis med sprul pa zhal gcig phyag gnyisapa sde drug gi gras dang / de'i phyi rol tu las kyi bshan pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa mdzad cing / snang gsal ba'i las byang na g.yon du gnyis med sprul pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa mdzad pa las logs su las kyi bshan pa med pa rgyas bsdus las ngo bo gcig pas 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te snang gsal ba gzhin bzhag la 'di skor dang spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod sogs la yum dang las kyi bshan pa la jug pa gdug pa kun sgrol nas blangs na legs par mngon zhing mi len na gnyis med dug gsum 464

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)khros par spyi gshed kyi gtor ma bsngos pas 'grub bo/ /spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar bdag mdun la lhan cig tu bya/ bsnyen pa la/ 'jam dpal:la gnon gyi bsnyen pa thebs na des khyab cing rje dbur spyon lag ris mthong tsam la tshe bdag gi las byang gyer dgos par gsungs kyang bdag mdun gnyis ka las gshin la byas phyin tshe bdag gi las byang rgyun gyi thugs dam la yod na ma gtogs par bkab mi dgos pa zur kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed pa gong bsnyen ma song na dbu steng gi rigs gsum mgon por dmigs nas so so'i bzlas pa brgya rtsa re byed pa gnad dam pa (12na than/ snying gar rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba ru zhes sogs rkang pa dang po gsum gyi don/ shog dril las/ rang gi tsit+ta du las byas pa zur gsum rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa sra zhing mkhregs pa/ de'i rgyab tu rdo rje lte ba gcig pa steng 'og phyogasamatshams thams cad du rtse mo 'bur thabs su yod pa/ nang 'jam pa mar dkar gyi zhal ba byas pa lta bu'i nang du sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis zhal nang du gyur nas srung ba'i las byed par bsam/ zhes pa 'od dkar rdo rje'i srung ba chu bo'i shog dril/ nang du tsit+ta zur gsum dug rlangs 'phyo/ /zhes sogs rkang pa drug gi don shog dril las/ dug gi tsit+ta'i mdun zur mar 'jam dpal/ g.yas su rta mgrin g.yon du phyag rdor rnams rang rang gi rang rtags kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te sngags dang srung ba'i las mdzad pa/zhes pa rigs gsum mgon po'i srung ba 'byung ba'i shog dril/ de nang gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa/zhes sogs tshig rkang bzhi'i don/ shog dril las/ tsit+ta'i nang du lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gyen du bsgreng ba lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du ngo bo ye shes rnam pa lnga las grub pa'i rnam pa 'od lnga'i gur khang / de'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor/ de la ye dharmā dang / ā+oṃ āḥ/ gi thag pas bsdams pa'i 'od kyi gur khang bsam ste/ zhes pa rdo rje 'od lnga'i srung ba dus kyi shog dril te/ sman sdong gnad kyi shog dril mu tig phreng ba las/ de'i lte ba yangs pa'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sra zhing mkhregs pa srubs med pa/ zla dkyil la g.yas skor du ā di/ nyi dkyil la g.yon skor du kā di/ de'i rgyab tu ye dharmā rgya gram du 'khril ba/ zhes bshad/ dbus su rgyal ba'i (12ba)thugs srog hūṃ mthing nag /ces sogs tshig rkang 465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nadrug gi don/ shog dril las/ srung ba drug po'i dbus su dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag /de nas 'jam dpal gyi thugs kyi ngo bo ya dmar nag /bsrung bya thams cad kyi ngo bo ni dmar po 'od dang bcas pa/ de gsum gyi mthar srung sngags kyis bskor bar bsam zhing / dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems dam can srung ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gyur tshad bsrung bya la bskyed bstim bya ba ni gnad dam pa'o/ /zhes pa'i dmigs rim 'di la ya ni hūṃ gsum gyi srung ba ri bo'i shog dril te/ srung ba'i man ngag lde mig las rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge ni dkar po ming yig dang bcas pa bsgom/ bsrung bya rnams g.yas su pho rigs g.yon du mo rigs/ mdun phyogs su gces pa/rgyab phyogs su 'khor g.yog /yul zhing bang khang bsgom/ de rgyab tu bsnyen sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom/ de'i rgyab tu 'od rdo rje'i ra bas bskor bar bhe/ rdo rje'i dra mig thams cad sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis g.yas rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsam/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis srung ba'i rgyas btab pas cis kyang mi shigs pa chos kyi sku ru lha/ yang thugs kyi sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la brgyud/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas ba spu'i khro bo rnams la brgyud/ de rnamasalas 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor gyi khro bo rnams la brgyud/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum srid gsum thams cad rang dang 'dra (13na)bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khengs/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgya mtsho'i gling bar/ ri rab kyi lcog bar/ nyi zla'i theb bar/ sprin gyi go bar/sa rdo ri brag /rtsi shing nags tshal/ lha 'dre'i gtad mnan gar sbas sbyang ba/ khro bo rnams kyi thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs bsrung bya'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo de yi ge hūṃ du byas te tshur 'dus/ rdo rje ya dris mtshan pa la bstim/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan par lha/ yang 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros pas srid pa gsum gyi bkrag mdangs/ 'byung ba lnga'i bcud/ nyi zla'i 'od/ mi'i tshe/ zas kyi bcud/ rin po che'i rigs/ me tog gi bcud/ rtsi rta ge gi bcud/ sa rdo ri brag gi bcud thams cad tshur 'od zer spro/66

rigs gsum 'dug pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(khanadamar po'i rnam par bsdus nas ya dris mtshan pa la bstim pas sngar bas kyang 'od zer gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ yang 'od zer sngar ltar 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ tshur 'dus spyi bor rigs gsum mgon po la thim pas de rnams kyi thugs rje nus mthu thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du tshur rang gi spyi gtsug tu mar thim pas rdo rje ya dris mtshan pa la bstim/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ cis kyang mi shigs pa chos kyi skur bsam/ zhes pas 'phro 'du rnams kyis bsnyen yig gzhan dag nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen pa bdag byin rlabs sogs ming 'dogs sna tsho gos pa'i gnad thams cad tshang zhing / hūṃ gi klad kor dbus su bla ma dang / zhes sogs rkang pa lnga'i don shog dril las/ mi phyed pa'i thugs kyi mi bskyod pa'i dbus su bla ma (13ba)dang bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med tha dad med pa tshe bum can du bskyed nas man ngag ltar spro bsdu la tshe'i phur pa gdab par bya'o/ /zhes pa nā dar tshe phur gdab pa'i bsrung ba gdengs can gyi shog dril/ skad cig rang nyid rdzus skyes khro bo'i sku/ /zhes sogs blo ka drug gi don/shog dril las/ rang nyid skad cig gi rdzus skyes su lhag pa'i lha khrag dang chu ser gyi brlan med pa/ lo du ma lon pa'i rus pa btsa' can 'dra ba/ ngo bo ye shes lha'i rang bzhin/ kha dog rnam pa lnga las grub pa'i keng rus kyi khro bo bde ba chen po'i nyams dang ldan pa zhal phyag sogs bskyed la/ yi ge gsum gyi bskyed bstim sogs byas nas slar yang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dam pa chos skyong srung ma thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thugs rje nus mthu srog gi yi ge dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du bsdus nas sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pas de dag thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing / slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can thams cad la phog sdig sgrib thams cad 'i sbyangs nas lha go 'phang la bkod/ de dag gi mthu stobs rgyal yon tan nus mthu srog gi snying po'i yi ge dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du bsdus nas sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)thim pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nag bun bun sregs nas gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dregs pa can thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bkrag mdangs gzi (14na)brjid mthu stobs thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal brten por byas la spro bsdu de nyid kyi ngang las sgyu ma lta bur don shes par byas la bzlas pa bya/ zhes pa dregs pa dbang du bsdus nas bsrung ba bu ga'i shog dril te/ gzhan yang tshe bdud kyi u pa de sha las/ sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang / khyad par du tshe thung ba'i las sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad nag nyil li li song nas tshe bdud la thim pas nag gzir gyis song / tshe bdud pho mo'i bkrag mdangs dang rang gi tshe dpal phyogs pa rnams dang bcas pa bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bkrag mdangs thams cad rab tu rgyas nas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par gyur te skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku thob par bsam/ zhes pa'i don dran par bya ba sogs ting nge 'dzin de lta bu mdun bskyed la'ang gsal ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du'i ngang nas bzlas pa bya/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs srog las 'od 'phros nas mdun bskyed kyi thugs gar rang rang gi sa bon gnas pa la phog ste thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul bas 'phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par bsams shing gtso bor lha/ga dril bdun pa dang dgu pa'i dmigs par nan tan du byas nas bdag dang bsrung byar bcas pa sba gzung byed pa shin tu zab pa yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i pu ti dkar por sba ba lta bu la 'dir mdun bskyed lhar gsal ba dang / yang bzlog la mtshan ma rdzas kyi pu ri'i khyad par yod kyang sngags rlom phal cher la 'di zhes gtad so med cing mkhas pa'i rgyud 'dzin la la mchod rten la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrub gzhin nor ba dang /de las (14ba)rnam dbye che ba 'ga' yang ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod rten zhal sprod sogs chos kyi grags pa'i gsung rgyun ma zin pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas du ma mthong ngo / /thun mthar gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pas byin brlabs brtan par byas/ tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum/ mdangs bskang / tshogs —468

rigs gsum 'dug pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug stong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)lhag /thun gtor mtshams kyi thog mtha'i tshogs 'khor dang 'brel bar lha tshogs yongs rdzogs bskul nyid bsrung ba'i sham bu'i 'dod gsol dang bcas khang thog tu 'bul/ gtor mnan gyi dmigs pa las gshin ya ma rā dzar sbyar ba snang gsal ba'i gzhung gi dgongs don ltar mnga' gsol gtor mar sha zan sman raka gis gsos la bsngo/ phyi nang gis mchode cing bstod pa bsdus pa zhig bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing smon lam dang shis pa brjod/ mdun bskyed mi bsdu zhing / bdag bskyed ka dag 'od gsal gyi ngang nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ na mgung / tho rengs/ snga thun/ nyin gung gi thun rnams la bzlas pa'i thun mthar mchod gtor 'bul ba man chad las tsho gos dang mnga' gsol sogs dor zhing /nam gung / tho rengs/ nyin gung / dgongs mo/ srod lnga'i thun la bdag mdun ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal 'debs/ nang par lag ris mthong tsam nas las byang rgyas par gyer te snga thun dang sbrel/ nyin gung gi thun mjug yab yum gyi sngags sbrel nas sum brgya tsam bzla ba khyad par/ dgongs thun la tsho gos mchode/bskang ba/ mnga' gsol/ srod la tshogs dang mnga' gsol spangs pa'i thun gtor ya ma rā dza man chad kyis bskul nas gtore mnan bya ba'i so so'i dmigs bsal gyi 'byin 'jug shes dgos/ bsnyen tshad sa ya (15na〉lngar gsungs pa rnying lugs la bye ba sngon du gtong srol ltar na zhag gcig la yig drug khri tsho gsum 'gro bar/ lo rkyang dgu bshol gyi zla ba gsum zhag gsum nyi ma'i gsum cha rnams la dung phyur 'gro ba sngags 'di dang ma ṇi phyed dang drug skor brtsis na zla bgol dang bcas pa'i lo nyer bzhi zla ba bdun nyi ma'i gsum cha gnyis dgos pa sgrub pa por ma zad lha yang sku thang chad dogs 'dug cing spyi dang mthun pa'i sa ya la lo gnyis zla ba lnga zhag bcu dgu nyi ma'i drug cha gcig dgos shing / 'bru 'bum la lo gcig zla ba bdun zhag gcig nyi ma'i drug cha bzhi rnams byung / gser chos nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'bru 'bum lo gsum tsam dgos pa shas che ba legs sbyar gyi sngags ring cha sogs la zhib mor byas pa snang ba snga 'gyur la 'gro lding dang sha za sogs skad rigs sna tshogs pas myur ba yong rigs yin nam snyam de tsam ma lcogs na 'bum phrag bcu la las rung dang grangs dang dus las rtags gtso che bas/—469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nargyud las/ mkhar brtsig pa dang go khrab gyon pa dang mtshon thogs pa dang g.yul dmag 'gyed pa dang rdo rje'i rdzong brtsig pa dang 'thab pa las rgyal ba dang brag bshig pa dang shing bcad pa dang khams gsum kun las rgyal ba rmi/ de ltar byung na 'grub pa'i rtags zhes dang / sku yi rtags su 'di ltar lags/ /mtsho yi kha la bsdad pa dang / /gangs dkar rtse la 'dzeg pa dang / /gos dkar rgyan dang me rtag mthu/ /de ltar byung na sku yi rtags/ /gsung gi rtags su 'di ltar lags/ /lus la me 'bar mtshon cha thogs/ /rol mo'i bye brag dkrol ba dang / /lo legs ma rten bskor ba sogs/ /de ltar byung (15bsko gsung gi rtags/ /thugs kyi rtags su 'di ltar lags/ /bdud rtsi 'thung dang chos shes dang / /nyi zla 'char ba thugs kyi rtags/ /zhes dang / rgyas par bya lam nas byung ba ltar ro/ /bsnyen pa thengs nas ting nge 'dzin gong ltar la srung sngags sham bu 'dogs lugs rje rat+na'i mtshan can gyi sngags 'grig dang gsung rgyun ltar srung sngags zhag bdun tsam ji ltar 'os pa'i thun thams cad kyi mthar thun gtor la dgug bran brlabs pa'i srung ba'i thun phul sham bu dang bcas srod thun ma gtogos pa'i lnga por mdun bskyed la 'bul zhing / srod thun la dgra phyogs su 'phen/ 'phang phyin las gshin ya ma rā dze'i dmigs pa rje dbur smyon gyi bzhed pa ltar 'dir sbyor ba 'thad par sems shing / lugs gnyis ka'i khungs ni gdamasapa gnad kyi shog dril las/ gru gsum rdo rje gdan la thug pa'i 'og rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du las kyi gshin rje ya ma rā tsa khros pa'i mgo bo gsum ni g.yas seng ge'i mgo /g.yon phag mgo nag po dbusazhal chu srin gyi gdong la/ ya thod gnam la ma mgal sa/ mche ba spu gri ltar rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa zhig 'og tu kha gdangs nas yod par bsam zhes bshad do/ /bzlog pa ni/ bzlog pa'i shog dril zla ba'i don ni/ gshin rje rta mgrin bya khyung rnam gsum la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yi dam zhi khros bskor/ /zhesarkang pa gnyis 'asdug dgos par ma zad drag po'i las la bsngags pa rgyud las/ phyi sgrub lha gsum 'di ltar lags/ /'jam dpal thugs sprul 'chi bdag lags/ /mu stegs bstan pa bshig don du/ /'chi bdag gtad khram dkor la dbang / /mu stegs bstan pa bshig don du/ /rta mgrin thugs sprul —470

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)tshe bdag lags/ /tshe bdag rlung gi las la dbang / khu stegs bstan pa shig don du/ /phyag rdor (16na)sprul pa srog bdag lags/ 91ga bdag las sbyor mnan sreg skor la dbang / /lha gsum 'dus pa khro chu dug sdong yin/ /drag po'i las rnams kun la dbang / /zhes bshad/ sgo bsrung bsgyur ba bzlog pa'i shog dril zung gi don ni/ gshin rje dmar nag ral gri zhags pa 'dzin/ /zhes brje zhing bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong kyang khro bor bsgyur ba man ngag go /rang nyid gshin rje khro chur gsal ba yi/ /spyi bor gshin rje 'char ga nag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchod rten bsnams pa yis/ /steng phyogs lha yi gdug pa bzlog par byed/ /mgrin par gshin rje 'joms byed 'bar ba nag /g.yas pa mchod rten g.yon pa dgra sta bsnams/ /bar snang gnyan gyi gdug pa bzlog par byed/ /snying gar gshin rje tshe bdag nag po ni/ /zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngams/ /g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje dang / /g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtun shing sdigs mdzub brdeg /'og phyogs klu yi gdug pa bzlog par byed/ /gsang bar gshin rje kha thun nag po ni/ /phyag gnyis lcags par bsnams nas dgra sha za/ /sdebargyad dregs pa'i gdug pa bzlog par byed/ /dpung g.yas gshin rje khrag mtsho khol ma ni/ /phyag gnyis nyi zla cha lang ltar brdeb pas/ /byad ma'i sha khrag nyal nyal rab ster zhing / dgra gdon pho rgyud tsho gos rnams bzlog par byed/ /dpung g.yon gshin rje ral pa tshar dgu ni/ /mdog nag phyag laXs khyag shing g.yon nad rkyal/ /thogs nas byad ma lhar ya cas khram la 'debs/ /dgra bgegs mo rgyud tsho gis rnams bzlog par byed/ /(16badzeng gi ba spu'i gseb nas khro chung tshogs/ /mtshon thogs grangs med skar ltar 'phros pa yis/ /byad ma ltar bcas bzlog cing gsod par byed/ /gshin rje sde drug dug gsum khros pa dang / /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor tshogs bcas rnams kyang / /zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad cing / /ba spu'i gseb nas mtshon cha sna tsho gos pa/ /'phros pas dgra gdon drozlog cing gsod par byed/ /gur khang phyi rol gnam lcags las grub pa'i/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcu/ /g.yas su 'khor bas byad ma lha srung bcas/ /bla srog 471—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gcod cing sha khrag 'thor bar byed/ /rtsibs la ma reg tsam du khro chen bcu/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nam mkha'i mdog /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa thob bsnams/ /lho ru shes sa mthar byed dung gi mdog /g.yas pa thod dbyug g.yon pa sdigs mdzub gzir/ zhub tu pad+ma mthar byed byu ru'i mdog /g.yas pa pad+ma g.yon pa bsdigs mdzub gzir/ /byang du bgegs tshogs mthar byed mu men mdog /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa sdigs mdzub gzir/ shar lhor 'dod rgyal sngo nag g.yas lcags kyu/ /lto nub dbyug pa sngon po g.yas dbyug to/ /nub byang stobs chen mthing nag g.yas rdo rje/ /byang shar mi g.yo bam shing g.yas ral gri/ /steng du hūṃ mdzad sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ /'og tu gnod mdzes mthing nag g.yas gtun shing / /g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub dgra gdon bgegs tshogs gzir/ /kun kyang stag sham dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad cing / /byad ma lhar bcas bod gtong byol zor sogs/ /gzhan gyi sbyor ngan bgegs dang gnod byed tshogs/ /phar la bzlog cing me lcer sbrang ma ltar/ /thal bar brlag cing phyi yi (17na)rgya mtsho che'i/ /pha mthar bskrad cing bsad bcad gtubs gtor nas/ /ming yang med par skad cig brlag par gyur/ /bdag dang lha rnams sku las rang 'dra ba'i/ khro tshogasagrangasamed nad mtshon thogs spros pas/ /byad ma lhar bcas phar bzlog bsad cing bsgral/ /'byung bzhis tshar bcad lhag rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bskrad cing mtshams bcad tshur mi bzlog par gyur/ /zhes sa mā dhi dang bcas sngags 'grig bzhin bzlog sngags zhag bdun sogs ci rigs bzla/ ja sogs kyi dus thal rdeb dang dmod pa bya zhing thun gtor gtong lugs dngos gzhi srung ba dang 'dra ba la mdun bskyed la bsngos rjes bzlog pa'i sham bu can gyis bskul nas dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo / /de ltar lus dkyil la lha rnams bkod pa'i dgos pa ni lha de rnams kyi byang du bdag nyid btab pa sogs yod na lha de rnams btson du bzung ba'i dgos pa yod cing lha de rnams byad ma kho rang gi rang gshed du 'bebs pa yin no/ /lus dkyil 'god pa dang khro bo bcu bskyed pa 'di bzlog pa'i dus ma gtogos gzhan nam du yang mi dgos so/ /de ltar bzlog pa'i dmigs pa sngags dang bcas 472

rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ga nang ma(kha)pa 'di ni khro bachu bzlog pa ri rab khong myul gyi don yin pa rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i man ngag go /ting nge 'dzin gyi srung bzlog 'di tsam bsnyen pa'i mjug dang sbrel na legs shing mtha' gcig tu byed dgos pa'i nges pa med/ spyir 'di nyid la mchod rten dkar nag /thod pa zhal dbye/ bsad khang gcig ma dang bco lnga ma sogs gang 'tsham la brtan pa'i srung bzlog bsad mnan sreg zor gyis mtshon/ tsit+ta rlung 'khor/ 'gom chog /dgra sri mnan pa/ (17bskong ba dgu 'gyur/ du ba rlung zhen sogs las phran mang du yod pa gnubs chen brgyud pa'i zab chos la nang byan chud pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba zhig gi drung du sa ser rdo sngon lcags gos kyi yon dang bcas 'bad pas 'tshol bar rigs so/ /gsum pa mjug ni/ dngos grub len par gsal kha ma byung kyang snga 'gyur gyi phyogs su dar rgyas che zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi 'bras bu dngos grub blang ba yin pas/ tshe zan / tshe ril/ tshe chang / zla khrom/ zla rgyas/ thun/ si thog /spang na skyes sogs bza' bca' sna tshogs bsham/ gter kha gzhan nas byung ba'i dngos grub kyi sngags dmigs bskul ba sogs sbyar/ sgrub gtor las sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs len zhing dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams la rol/ gta' gtor bsnyen pa'i stod smad bar gsum gang 'os su rtags bzang ba byung na dus der gtor yang slar de tshab dgos pa 'di dus dbul/ tshogs bskang ba/mnga' gsol/ gtang rag mchod pa/ nongs pa bzod gsol/ rten rnams la brtan bzhugs dang rten med rnams gshegs/ smon lam/ bkra shis bya/ sgrub gtor gyi 'khor lo dang phur pa rnams rang gi lus la 'chang / mdun dkyil bsdus kyang sgrub gtor shas pa rnam pa gsum gyi tshul du bzhugs su gsol/ 'dzin gtor lo rer brje zhing rgyun gyi gtor bsngos dang dgu gsum la dus gtor ram tha ma'ang nyer dgu la bzang ba dang phral du lha'i bskyed rim dang bsnyen pa ma chag pa bya ba sogs lha sgrub gzhan ltar byed cing / lha dang bla mar som nyi spangs pa'i yid ches pa'i mos gus dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams pa dus dang yun du bgyid pa dang bsnyen sgrub lag len phra zhib rnams(18na)gzhan las 'byung ba ltar la khyad chos yugs sa mar mi spyod/ mtshams khang du bud med dang khyi'i rigs —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mi gtong bas mtshon spang blang mtha' dag zhib mor dpyod pa gces so//phyinang ba na bon rbod gto me mkhan po'i brag/'jam dpal khros pa dus dgra'i gnam lcags thog/khro chu khol ma'i zegs ma phyogs brgya mā/'thor tshe yid srubs mya ngan khang bur brgyal//rgya bal paṇa grub zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud//gnubs chen thugs kyi sgrom bur nyer gab gter/ /zhad khrom phyag rgyas bkrol ba thub pa'i bstan//ring gnas nag po mthu yi lcags ri btsan//thor tshugs dmar po'i rtsa chings gos dkar klubs//lcags phur dar nag klung bskyod rked par ldan//thun dong ra ka'i phreng 'dzin sngags 'chang gis/ /sngon dus gangs can dpal mo'i sto ba khengs/ /so zur gnubs lugs smin grol man ngag dang /khyud bshad bstan dang rang rtags cha byad kun//nyi ga'one 'char ga'i mkha' la rgyu skar bzhin//btsal yang rnyed dka'i dus 'dir skal ga byas//bye brag phyogs 'dir dkar ba'i blo gros zlas//zab don ut+pal 'dzu pa pa sngon mang yang //deng sang phal cher rmongs chen mun pa yis//lan brgyar byugs pa'i tshul la bzhin ras smad//gnubs bstan dgun gyi chu phran ltar gyur tshe//lha sras rnam sprul rje btsun rat+na'i zhabs//srol 'byed du ma rang grol la sogs pas//pad+ma'i skud phrar rdo rje'i srog thungs byin/khyad par bka' gter ring lugs gaṅgā'i rgyun//snga 'gyur rgya mtshor chad med 'bab pa'i drin//nor 'dzin gser gyis bkang yang 'jal dka'i yul//zur chen 'jam dbyangs18babla ma khyod min su//zhwa ser bstan pa'i sa srungs glang po'i steng //bgrang yas shes byar lta ba'i mig stong nga //bcu phrag rig gnas sbyong la rab brel bar//mthumakhan rgan po'i g.yar khral ci phyir babs//'on te so dkar tsam nas tshe bdag sogs//gshin rje'i rgyud lung man ngag mang thos pas//skra dkar lang tsho yol yang rnam dag tshil//phreng bar spel la blo gros mi dog yangs//grags 'dod bzhin rasalas byang chus bkrus kyang /zhus ldan mdzes chos sgrub pa'i lus phra'i tshogs//snyan brgyud mu tig sbrel legs 'khor lo 'dis//gzhan yid 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu byed dang snyam//'chi bdag gshin rje'i rnam par nyer bstan pa//nges pa'i don du 6 4 daXl kun tu bzang //bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rnal

'jam dpal me'i sbu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khana'abyor la goms pas//mkha' mnyam skye dgu ma lus grol bar shog/ces rigs gsum 'dus pa 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge rin chen ke ta ka 'di ni snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar drin can bla ma khyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi drung du dbang lung phyag bzhes dmar khrid dang lung rgyun thor bu lus pa rnamasasngags 'chang dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rgyun las mkhas grub khra tshang pa chen por thos shing /rat+na gnyisapa mtshungs med chos kyi grags pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gsung rgyun rnams ban grong sngags long mchog grub rgyal por phyag khrid zhun thar bcad pas gshin rje mkhan po'i gral du sdod pa la ma nongs pa'i za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal 19na ) gyis me sbrul hor zla brgyad pa'i khrag 'thung rnam par rol ba'i tshes la rgyal khab dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis shing /dus dbang gis gal chung chos la byed par ma zad gshed skor 'di nyid dkon zhing gdams pa rnams kha 'thor ba'i nyag phra bar snang bas zhal shes yig chung gis legasapar brgyan nas gsal bar bkod pa brgyud pa'i khungs la mi sem zhing /rang gi gegs sel tsam du rma khar phan na khyi tshil du byed pa sogs snod min la gsang zhing sba ba'i bkar rgya yod pas 'chol par spyod na 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rjes tshang chod cig gu tho sa mā yā//sarba maṅga lo////'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong nag po'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs so/rigs gsum kun 'dus dug sdong gzhin rje gshed//bcom ldan thub chen shākya seng ge'i zhabs//dge slong 'char ka nyan thos sde yi gtso//gsol ༷ 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//zla gsang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()mnga' bdag 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs//dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung //sdobargyad bran 'khol khrag 'thung nag po la//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//gshin rje gshed dngos slob dpon nor bu 'dzin//drag sngags kun gyi bka' babs gnubs ban zhabs//zab gter bstan pa rgyas mdzad rgya zhang khrom//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//thugs kyi sras mchoge don yod rdo rje dpal//rig sngags grub pa rol pa'i rdo rje dang //gsang sngagasa'achang ba ga me sirnyi la//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//slob dpon ོ po dka' bzhi'i mtshan ldan dang / grub pa mchog brnyes nyi ma bcu drug pa/ /zab don bka' bab kun dga' rgyal mtshan la//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//sbas pa'i rnal 'byor byang chub dpal mo dang / /mtshungs med tshul khrims rgya mtsho gung rad pa/ /chos rgyal 'bri gung gnam 2nalcags me 'bar la//gsol ba 'debs sgo drag po'i dngos grub stsol//ras chung rnam sprul bkra shisargya mtsho'i zhabs//rigs 'dzin chen po kun dga' tshe mchog dang //rje btsun ngag dbang ye shes grub pa la//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//zhad khrom dngos slob gnubs chen dar ma dbang //sngags 'chang gha ba shākya rdo rje'i zhabs//mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal ldan a grags la//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ grub pa mthar phyin slob dpon a waṃ mtshan/ /brtul zhugs grub pa a khyo badz+ra dang / /bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /rigs gsum lha yis rjes gzung brag la ba/ /rab 'byams 'phrin las kun 'grub yo rdor dang //bdud dpung mthar byed rgya ston nam mkha' la//gsol ba 'debasaso drag po'i dngos grub stsol//brgyud pa kun 'dus zur chen thams cad mkhyen//gdams pa'i kha 'geng phur pa bkra shis dang / /rig sngags 'chang ba pad+ma dbang rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol//'gran zla gnyis pa dbur smyon chos kyi grags//mkhyen brtse nus ldan dkon mchog lhun grub dpal//gas kun bdag po blo 4 7 / la//gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang mkhyedastsol/ /mdor na srog dbang klag lung man ngag (2ba)sogs/ /phra zhib dmar 'khrid ston pa'i yongs 'dzin tshogs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /rigs gsum kun 'dus 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /khro chu dug sdong srog dbang byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag rgyud smin nas lam 'di'i mchog kun gyi/ /las rnams thogs pa med par lhun grub shog /srung ba'i gur khang bcu gsum rdo rje'i mkhar/ /yid srubs dpung gis 'jig par mi nusapas/ /bdag sogs dmigs bya mtha' dag gzhom zhig dang / /bral ba'i 'chi med rigs 'dzin 'grub par shog /mu stegs ban bon mthu byad sgrogs kyi 'phrul/ /phyir bzlog rdo yis bar snang la bcag nas/ /rbod gtong mkhan por rbad 'dre rig sngags kyi/ /rno dbal rang gshed thog tu 'bebasapar shog /bsam sbyor ga pas rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi/ /zhabrul 'khor byed pos mtshon pa'i dgra bgegs kun/ /g.yul ngor gsod pa 'chi bdag gshin rje yi/ /mngon spyod las sbyor myur du 'grub par shog /phas rgol tshe srog nus stobs chu srin gyi/ /mgrin pa btson dong nang rul mnan pa'i las/ /ri bo rlung gis mi bskul bskal pa'i bar/ /nam yang ldang bar mi nus las 'grub shog /bsgral bya sgrol byed mtha' dag sems nyid kyi/ /rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i seng ges glang po'i srog /phral ba ji bzhin /dag chos sku'i klong / /dbyer med 'tshengs gsum don dang ldan par shog /phyi rol dgra bgegs bcom pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /nang du dug gsum srog rtsa nyer 'phral te/ /rang rig 'jam dpal kun tu bzang po'i zhal/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i (3na)dga' ston myong bar shog /brtson sa las 'phro zhan pasatshe 'di la/ /mgrol 'chi ba 'od gsal shar ba na/ /skyabs mgon gcig chog gshin rje gshed po yis/ /kun gzigs dag pa'i zhing der 'khrid par shog /'khrid byed lha dang bgrod bya'i gnas rnams kun/ /med bzhin chu nang zla gzugs ltar shar ba/ /gnas lugs ngo 'phrod 'jam dpal rang sems las/ /gzhan min thag chod gdengs tshad rnyed par shog /deng nas chos nyid zad pa'i pha mtha' mā /'khyol min de srid lhag pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /rjes bzung bar chad mi mthun kun zhi zhing / /'khor 'das legs —477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()tsho gos don rnams lhun grub shog/khyad par drag sngags bdag po gnubs chen gyi//bka' gter gshin rje'i smin grol rgyud bshad lung //sgrub 'phrin phyag bzhes mtha' dag thub bstan gyi//btsas su mi nub dar zhing rgyas par shog/ces 'jam dpal gshin rje khro chu dug sdong nag po'i brgyud 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi cho ge grwa ba rnams kyis bskul zhing /so'i sngagasa'achang gnas byung pa gnam lcags zil gnon dpa' bos bskul ba ltar zur wo rdo rje 'chang gi bka' drin la brten nas chos tshul 'di la blo gros kyi snang ba cud zad dkar ba za hor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog go/gshin rje khro chu dug sdong gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor spu gri 'bar ba bzhugs/bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med cing / /rigs gsum kun 'dus khro chu dug sdong nag /rnal 'byor rgyun 'khyer nyams su blang bde ba//gnubs chen brgyud pa'i bzhed pa ma nor 'dri//de'ang yi dam 'di ṣ+ka kyi sku'i mdun du sman rag mar gtor ci 'byor pa bsham/stan bde bar kha lhor bltasate/dus 'di nas bzung byang tso snying pho bar//bla ma lha dang das ma rdzo gi wo gsum//gshin rje gshed po'i lha tsho gos 'khor bcas la//lusang ga yid gsum gus pas skyabs su 'chi//snang gragasachos rnams rang bzhin med pa la/ /de ltar ma rtogs sems can snying re rje/ /de phyir bdag ni gshin rje'i gshed gyur nas//de dag sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya//zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/mye yu/khro rgyal wo po'i sprul pa'i tsho gis rnams ni/khro mar 'khor lo rdo rje phur bu dang //tho ba ral gri dgra sta me yi tshogs//phyogs mtshams steng 'og bar med kun tu gtams//ā+oṃ shrī ya ma kro ta tsakra badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya sgru pa sha dz+ra la raṃ rak+ṣa / ༷ṭa/ces srung 'khor bsgom/ 2na ) zho badz+ra ji

gshin rje khro chu dug sdong gi nga gyi rnal 'byor sbu gri 'bar ba/ nang ma(khana.āḥ/ nas sha lta'i bar dang /ā+oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi hūṃ hrī sto/ā+oṃ bha lin+ta hūṃ lha'i/ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa lamaṇ+ḍal/ hrī sto/zhes mchod pa rnams brlab/hūṃ/chos rnams spros bral snying rje'i rang rtsal las//rang byung khro tshogs mtha' med nam mkha'i dbyings//tsha grang rab 'khrug mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub//de nang lcags sregs ma cha chol pa'i khang //phyi rol thod zlum dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor//ha la'i gur khang rlung gi spu gri 'khor//de phyir khro bcu'i gur khang bskal me 'bar//dkar nag khro bos bsrung dang bzlog las mdzad//gzhal yas khang nang gshin rje'i grong khyer che//mthing nag gru gsum bsnol dbus mtsho ni cha'i tshogs//dug phur khru steng pad+ma zla nyi dang //ma he gshin rje sdebargyad bdud kyi rigs//phyi nang yi dam chos skyong dgra bgegs steng / /bdag nyid rdzus skyes las gshin dmar nag 'tsher/ /nag dmar ljang zhal gdangs shing rkan sgra rdeb//ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan bgrad sma ra dang //smin ma dbu skra 2bskom ra ser rab 'bar ba//dbu steng dug lcags khro chu'i mchod rten nang //dusagasum sangs rgyas kun 'dus rigs gsum mgon//phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra sta g.yon tsit+ta//spu gri ral gri'i gshog gdengs dug sbrul dang //dur khrod mas brgyan srid rtse mnar med bar/khyab sku'i lte bar gsal byed nyi zla 'char//rang 'dra'i sprul pa ba spu'i gseb nas 'phro//sto bar srid pa'i grong bcas khram la 'dabs//sku rked chu srin zhal nas phur pa'i dbal//sprul chun 'phyang rtse nyams pa'i snying la gzir//sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las gnyis med kyi//sprul pa sde drug phyi 'khor gshin rje'i tshogs//skar mda' 'khrug pa lta bus phyogs bcur skor/ /zhes dam tshig pa gsal gdab/khye yu/phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na//nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na//las kyi gshin rje'i zhing khams su//tsha grang 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor nas//spyi gshed dug sdong mthu bo che//sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du//drag po'i pho brang dam pa 'dir//spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol//ya ma rā tsa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ sngos ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/a ti pu stonas ye shes pa spyan drang zhing stan la bzhugs par phyag bya/du tri ya ma rā tsa sa pa ri wā 4/ /lha nas shag pra titsā swāhā/gong gi sngags mthar/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nam hā pañca a mṛ ta pā tsa ji hi/ ma hā rak+ta pā tsa khā hi/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ sngags mthar i rda pa lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ dgra bgegs byad ma'i don snying wa la i rda ba lin+ta kha kha 'a hi khā hi/ srog rtsa snying rtsa khrag rtsa la i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ (3na〉skye mched gzugs phung la i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ byad ma dgra bgegs mi nor 'khor dang bcas la i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dgra bgegs skye ba bdun brgyud la i rda ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes phyi nang gi mchod pa dbul/ myi yā/ngo bo dusagasum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal/ /rnam pa las kyi gshin rje mthu bo che/ /rigs gsum drag por khros pa'i rngam zhal can/ khro chu dug sdong 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /ces pa'am bstod pa rgyas pa skabs sbyar bya/ /snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar sangs rgyas stong / /tsit+ta zur gsum rigs gsum khro tshul can/ /de nang lcags rdor lte bar 'od lnga'i klong / /nyi zla'i ga'u sngags phreng srad bus bsdams/ /hūṃ ya ṇi mthar srung sngags kyis bskor bar/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod 'jam dpal lha tshogs dgyes/ /bsgrub bya'i sgrib dag ye shes gsum la thim/ /klad kor nang du bla ma tshe dpag med/ /thugs ga'i 'od kyis bkug pa'i bdud rtsi rgyun/ /tshe srog gsum la thim pas 'chi med gyur/ /rang nyid skad cig 'od lnga las grub pa'i/ /rkeng rus bde ba'i nyams ldan lha yi sku'i/ /ā+oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ mthing yi ges mtshan/ /'od 'phros ye shes dpag med spyan drangs bstim/ /'od kyi bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur dngas ma drangs/ /'chi med bcud kyis yongs khyab khro bo yi/ /bdud rtsi nang 'khyil srid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs/ /bde stong ro myangs tshe dang dpal lor rgyas/ /bsrung bya'i tshe srog nad gdon sdig sgrib kun/ /tshe bdud bsnol mar bstim la phur rtses gzir/ /slar yang yig gsum 'phro 'dus gdul bya rnams/ /sgrib sbyangs lhar bsgyur 'khor 'das yon tan tshogs/ /bsdus nas(3ba〉bdag dang bsrung byar thim pa yis/ 'jigs med sra mkhregasardo rje'i lus su gyur/ /zhes dmigs pa'i brjed byang tsam du spro na rje btsun kun dga' che mchog gi las byang las byung ba ltar ngag tu brjod nas/ du tri ya mā rā dza/ ya ma raka/ kro ta pa tsa la te/ kā la rū pa/ a kro rā dza/ ya ma rā dza/ sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags ci nus su bzla/ srung ba sogs byar 'dod na —480

gshin rje khro chu dug stong gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor spu gri 'bar ba/ nang ma(khanagazhan du shes par bya/ las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gi bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor 'phrin las dang / /lam 'di brtsams pa'i dge ba'i nus mthu yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dar bstan 'dzin sku tshe ring / /dkon mchog dbu mtho bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs/ /rnal 'byor tshe ring yon bdag bar chad zhi/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor bsam don phun tsho gos shing / /bdag gzhan thams cad rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog /ces smon lam gdab/ mtha' nas rim bzhin srung 'khor rten gzhal yas/ /de nyid brten pa phyi 'khor nas bzung ste/ /rim par bsdus nas gtso dang dbyer med gyur/ /gtso bo stod smad nas bsdus thugs ka yi/ /sa bon la thim rim bzhin 'ja' ltar yal/ /slar yang chu las rlabs bzhin lha skur gyur/ /zhes rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal/ ā+oṃ/ byang chub sems mchogo shes rab ting 'dzin gyis/ /nyon mongs bdag 'dzin rnam rtog kun bcoms nas/ /ya mān+ta ga'i don la rab bsgomasapa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces sogs shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ /e ma dpal ldan dus(4na ne gra'i rgyud kyi don/ /rgya bal paṇa grub ba ched srol gangs can 'dir/ /gnubs chen zhad khrom thugs kyi nying khu'i thigs/ /bka' babs gnam lcags me 'bar 'bri gung pa/ /de tshul snang gsal rigs 'dzin rim brgyud pa/ kho bo'i 'dren pa rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /chos dbyings rang sar grol ba'i zhal lung bcud/ /snying dbus za ma tog tu rnam par 'khyil/ /de phyir rnal 'byor rgyun du 'byer bde ba/ /ban bon mu stegs snying la gzer ba'i mtshan/ /gnam lcags spu gri 'bar ba 'di bkod pas/ /dga' rab dbang phyug sde las legs rgyal shog /ces rigs gsum 'i 'dus pa bdag nyid las gshin rje khro chu dug sdong gi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor spu gri 'bar ba 'di ni sngags ban ngag dbang rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar bsnyen sgrub gal che ba'i skabs rigasa'adzin chen po kun dga' che mchog gis mdzad pa'i las byang gtso bor nyams su len dgos pas brjed tho snying po lta bu phan tso 'dres nas brjod mi bde ba spangs te za hor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig sngags 'chang ba 'jam grags pa'o/ /sarba maṅga le// //—481
