rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dum pa rgya'i gter ga'i gi dang dmar chung gi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'phrul/ /sna tshogs longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zlos gar can/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dpal ldan dus kyi dgrar/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /gang gis rjes bzung 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung / /mngon spyod rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gnubs ban rjer/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /drag sngags zab gter sgo 'byed dum pa rgya/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug lcags brtun nag po dang / /gnubs ston rigs 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /drag sngags grub pa gnubs ban bya bral ba/ /tshul 'dir mkhas grub rdo rje rgyal ba dang / /rigs pa 'dzin pa dharma ke tu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /gshin rje gshed dngos chos kyi blo gros dang / /gsang wo chos kyi bdag po kong wo pa/ /mnga' bdag skye sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /snga 'gyur gsal byed legs ldan rdo rje'i zhabs/ khri srong rnam 'phrul chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /rigs 'dzin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por/ /gsol ba 'debs so drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /mthu chen bstan pa bsrung ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'khon ston chos kyi rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med drin can bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debasaso drag po'i dngos grub stsol/ /'ja' r+sā lta bur snang stong lha yi sku/ /rgyu rkyen dang bral skad cig dran rdzogs su/ /mngon par gsal ba'i g.yo med ting 'dzin gyi/ /tha mal snang zhing zhen pa bzlog par shog /'jigs rung las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /gnag pa'i dgra bgegs bla tshe rnam shes kun/ /lcags sregs (1ba tshe spyab khung nang gi dmigs rten la/ /bkug nas thal bar brlag pa'i nus ldan shog ga khrag rus phung dam can tshogs rol zhing / /tshe yi lhag mas rang gi ā yu spel/ /rnam shes dpal —482

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed lde mig nang mkhyenachen yab yum sbyor mtshams su//'phen pa'i mag spyod 'phrin ltas 'grub par shog/rdzas sngags ting 'dzin phyi rol dgra sde 'joms//gsal stong rig pas 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog/lhun grub lam gyis rang sems kun tu bzang //mngon du 'gyur ba'i dga' ston rgyas par shog/ces dum pa rgya'i gter da'i gi gang dmar chung gi brgyud 'debs 'di'ang gter ston gu gru yang dbang gi dbon brgyud/khams pa sngags long don grub ba po shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho ming gzhan zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis sbyar////sarba maṅga lo////gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed lde mig bzhugs theg/dus kyi dgra bor 'jam dpal srin po'i gzugs//'khor 'das zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag nag/dbyer med rdo rje lang dngos yongs 'dzin rnams//'dir spyon byang tso bar du byin gyas snos//rgya bal paṇa grub dam pa'i zhal gyi bcud//gnubs chen brgyud pa'i man ngag gnam lcags thogs/shing rta'i srol 'byed chos rgyal 'bri gung pa'i//bzhed gzhung bdud rtsi kho bo'i snying dbus 'byil//de phyir dmar khrid song ba'i snod ldan la//me dang spra ba 'phrad ltar dran gsos shing //dpe mthong tsam gyis mi rtogs lag len sgo//'byed pa'i gsal byed lde mig 'di ltar ro//dkyil tshe bdag gi dbang rgyas pa/'khor mchod yang zlog sger dbang /rten gtor rnon po nang gcod/ma la brten pa'i/ /smin byed legs nos tshe bdag bsnyen chen tshu rings/wo ma da4tham kro/nam//yang na sgos chos zhi drag yang zlog rtsa bsnyen/gong bsnyen thengs//man yod shing lan 'a dmar sgo/ngag khong chud dam spyi dang bye brag/ldan rnal 'byor pas//dang po rdo rje'i go gyon bsrung ba la//las gzhung skyabs sems kyi rjes su cha gsum ga kho bar gad pa las byang rdo rje thog mdar dkar gtor dmar gtor gtong tshul yod pas thus shing rdo ༷ sbyar ba'i 'dzab la thug pa/bskang waṃ khung phyogs su bskang ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)kyus ma zhig las mi mdzad kyang baṃ bskang gter byon 'di yid/gtor waṃ gung phyogs su ma grags kyang mthu 'a sdebazhi 'di ga kho ma 'dril med/tsho gos mtha'i tshe bdag nas blangs pa'i/(2na thar byas rjes/ /gsang sngags 'bru drug zhi sngags/dang ni bcu gcig a kro/pa/ /rtsa bsnyen stong phrag bsrung mtha' bsgyur shes dgos shing bzlog pa la dmar lang byed na bsrung sngags kyi sgo twa bzlog sngags bslabs4bi/ba brgya tsam bzla/ /sman mchod phul nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya//nang par gzhung gyer bsrung ba'i dmigs skor 'jug/rtsibs 'khor bzhi pa'i ma bu'i rtags gnyis sprod//gdengs gsum ngang nas ma yengs gsang sngags bzla//thun mtshams gtor yong kyu dmar rgyan sogs mar gtor ma la stod smad kyi dbye ba mi mdzad pa rje dbur spyon gyi gsung dngos las thos pas yig char dbye ba dgos par shad kyang gong ma nyid ba 'a nam snya/wo sha zan sman raka dang //thun gtor rak+ta sbran zhing bden kha stongs nas/tshig brjod//dgug gzhug mtshar snyag/sman ling ga la bdud rtsi dang mar me'i 'od phyog na dme ru 'gro ba man ngag gser phreng las bshad pas spang bya'i ched du 'phung re'i gur 'bugs des yang mi thar/raka sbran te drag kha skongasanas/gtor rlab//bsngo zhing 'bul tshig bu yig gi chos sku zhi ༅ yang na kha bskongs nas/sham bu bu yig nas/can gyi mthar//gtor wo la stobs slar yang sman rag spron//gsar du gcig bsham sbran nas 'dod yon brlab//ma hā ba ling gong bzhin gso zhing sbran//tshogs waṃ khung phyogs su mi mdzad kyang sgrub pa'i skabs mdzad pa ga4 sngags snyo ma spyi lugs yin/kyi mchod pas cho ga'i chad lhag lhag ma bzhi du bang /2ba〉skor//zhag grangasam thengasang ga zla gsang nas smras na rnal wor rang don da/ de yi phyir na lag 3 bya/ zhes gsung so/ /bcad dam pa gnad//grogs yod sngags sgra ma chad rab kyi rang ma sgrung las na sngags rgyun byed thebs med/rab//spyi dang bye brag sgrub pa' bsrung ga kho phyi ma sogs nas shad pa'i/sdom 'bad/ /lag len ma nor gdungs shugs yid ches gces//dug drug sgo ge stag wo khag dngas pa sngos/nyams blangs rtags mthong rtag gtor de//thun bskul wo sham bu ༅ gyi thog tu tsol snyo gsar pa snyi nyams/gtor bzhin bsngo gtor chen bsos te 'bul//dbyangs 'da'i gong du ma yig gi 'dod gsol 'a lam byed/gsal yig brgya bzlas nas hen rdzo kyang brjod/ngag 'grol ba//lcags ris bskor ba'i baX/ mkhar bsrung ba yin//gnyis par rig sngags

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed lde mig nang ma(khana'akhrul 'khor bzlog rkyang la//stan gos khyad chos bsgyur zhing sna zhur gsang ba'i rdzas sbyar nas/'then//las byang gzhung bsrangs 'dzab gong dri ldan rtsags snod du/sha/lag len bzhin ltar khyur mid byed pa'i dus//gnad gsang zab mo'i dmigs pa zhal las bri//las gshin bsrung ba'i dus kyi dmigs rim bya//thun gtor las kyi gshin rje'i sku ru sngags bzla ring /bsam//ma yig bzlog pa'i dmigs pa le tshan rnams//dkyus ltar brjod las rtags kyi 'jug pa ma rten dang lcags kyu/dor//ting 'dzin gsal bas bzlog pa'i sngags rgyun bca'//thal brdab dmigs pa bden sto bos kyus bzhin du//bya bar ma zad za 'thung sngon byed mtshungs//thun gtor smad tshol ring /cha dgra bgegs gsal ba la//dgug gzhug lan gsum tsam gyis khyad par las//gtor chen thun gtor bsrung ba lta bur 'bul//yig char rgyun 'khyer bzhin du bskul thung tsam bshad kyang bstod ma yig nas/ ring drag ma yig nas/ bskul ma yig nas/bskul ldan ) thung mthar//bzlog bu yig nas/sham btags 'bul zor bskul bu yig nas/khrom lcags sdigs nas/bzlog sogs//bzlog sngags zab sbyar dgra'o thebs phyogs dmigs pa dang bar/'phen//gtor gsar pa lhar bskyed gtor r+sā gso//bzlog pa'i bsrung sdoms bya zhing rtags mthong nas//rtag gtor 'bul zhing gtor chen gsos la bsngo/ /'dod gsol bsrung mtshungs thal brdab ngag 'grol dkyus//gser skye mas gtore zor 'phangs thoganas/pas sgo dbye zhing //gtor chen sha zan rak+ta sbran pa la//dgug gzhug gsum mthar sman dang rak+ta spron//bsngos drag ga 'a ltar/rjes bskul thung sham bu btags nas 'bul//yig brgya bzod gsol 'dod don smon yan skar dbarda na rdzo/lam gdab//gshegs ye shes pa/pas dam li pa slar yang gtor chen man ngag ltar//ltar bskyed dmigs pa'i gnad gsal zhal phyir bsgyur/gzan khrag sbran dpal 'bar spar ba btsugs//dgug gzhug gsum mthar sman raka sbran pa la//byin rlabs dmag lho'i tshul 'bul bstod ring bskul//phyir spags bzlog gzhung gyer nas tshogos lhag dang / /chad mtho btang shog ling med pas4kho sgra i gos/zhing gso sbran dgug rlabs kyis//gshegs skyems tshul 'bul phyi rol gser /mas bskul//bzlog sngags bcas 'phen dmigs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonapa zhal las dras/ /me chu'i rgyas 'debs chos 'byung rim gsum/rtsi steng du/ /me dgra chus bsad bro brdung zil gnon la byang nas/bstan ma skyong //rtsi mtho gshin rjer bskyed la ban bon gyi//dgug bskor dmod nang pa sangs rgyas pas bdag la byas pa'i rbod gtong thams cad zhig par bsam/phyi pa mu stegs pa dang bon gyis bdag labyas pho rbod ga sto thams go zhig par sa a/pa la klungs dgus bcad bye 'a la dgu bya par gom pa dgu sto/bsam//3bskong du log te tshe 'gugs gtang rag gtong //bzod gsol bsdug shegs brtan bzhugs bsngo smon bya//mi dang mi min sbyor stobs bzlog pa'i mardzo//gsum pa rang gshed bzlog pa drag po la//'phrin las nas bzung bstan skyong bar bya ba//thun mong ltar la gnas gsum byin rlabs 'god//bu yig mthing mdog pa skag bsad pa skyer shun mnan pa yin pas rtag de rnams tshang na gsum ga dang gnyis dang gcig byung na gang yin de shes dgos pas 'dir gsum ga bod/phur pa'i rtags can blangs pas 'grub/ /'khor ling gcer zhing gtor gso dregs mchod sdod pon sum tso gsol kha dang dregs pa'i bskul snying gzer nas len/bskul//gser zil gnon las byang na len/skyems mkhyen dgongs la shin 'phrin las nas len/'brub khung las shin lon la nas len/ling ka bskyed/ /dmod las shin phren las na len/pa gshin rje'i gzu kha skongs nas/spang byed gshed kha skongs nas/bskor/nyes byas rje ra sna5mdzad yo phag wo 4tho rgyas la/drag bskul bla 'gugs mon bu miganas/pa'i bskul//sde bu yig nas/brgyad byung tshul dus dang khoskongs nas/sprul pa 'gyed//bla 'gugs sngagasazil gnan las byang dang bu yig/dang dbye bskul sngags rdzas dus//so sdebs bu yig nas/dregs ka bskul zla gsang kha sgo sgo nas/thun bskul bcas//dgug thun brab cing bden pa'i tshig kha skong pos/kyang brjod//bcas lor lo rnams lteng na rags du khrugacing tso thag mo yan pa gal che/zin thun dngos spyod la mthun mong mtshungs//gser skyems 'brub ling bskyed dgug kha skangs nas/tshe srog yid//bla brtag mthong bar gsung sngagams la na na 〉 bya/'gugs sngags bzla lha dang rnam par spro gnyis la rten dkar por mi reg/dbye//thun gtor las kyi gshin rjer skad cig bsam//'dzab gong sha dang dri ma sngar bzhin mid//mchod rten 'khor lo'i rtags can bu nas len/ /ma yig baX dmigs tshig rkang drug song mtshams/ /bu yig

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed lde mig nang ma6)lcags kyu'i (4na lhags blangs de yi rjes/ /bzlog dmigs lhag ma thal brdab bden brjod zlog sngagasabazlas pho sa 'don khar a la phu 'debs shing sgrubs/ par/ /gtor chen gso zhing thun gtor gsal cha sha khrag ru mos/sman raka sbran/ /dgug 'dren nyer gsum i gtor ma dang lhag ma rnams 'khor ling la dmigs/ lnga tshun bya gtor brlab bsngo/ /bstod ring drag skul nyes byas drag bskul dang / /las gshin mon pa sdebargyad bskul rnamasathun drug gal lcog na rab ma lcogs na re gnyis lam ho pa nges par dgos/ bskul ba'i rjes/ /bla 'gugs lha dbye zor bskul btang nas man ngag las byung ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas khrom zlog sogs zer sngags pa'i rigs dang sngags sdeb sbyor/ 'phen/ /thun gtor bsham bskyed gtor chen sngar ltar gso/ /thun la ma nges bla phur snying phur dang / srog phur sngags bcas man ngag dus dang pha rol po skyas yo'i ngan dbye shā ma na spu khan sgo bya/ bstun/ /srod kyi thun la dgug thun nges par brdeg /yid ches bla rtags 'ga' mthong drag thun lugs r+sāg la bzlog pa'i ring thun mi brdeg pa bshad pa yod na'ang rgyag pa legs zhes dbur spyon dkon mchog phun tshogs gsung zhing rang gzhan gyi bla rtags ma nor ba'i gnad shes dgos/ rgyag /de ltar dus drug nyams blangs bzlog pa dang / khrugs de nas bar la lam gas3 rang gi bla 'gum pa wo bod/ rtags phal cher rdzogs nas rtags gtor ni/ /'bul nasang ga 'grol bar sogs dkyus dang 'dra/ /sngags bon nang 'phrad pha rol sgrogs kyi rdo/ /lam bcag lha bsrung bdud dbab man ngag go /bzhi pa phyag cha rang skor bsad las ni/ /'khor ling gcer zhing gser skyems dgug thun bar/ /gong mtshungs gtor ma'i zor tsob khung du/ brdeg phur blang phur sogs/gsum bsgril/ lag gdab rje slar yang snying srog gi phur pa brdeg par bshad/ slar yang bcas bya gser skyems nas(4ba〉zung ste/ sha dmar dri bcas mid pa'i bar rnams 'dra/ /bu yig lcags kyu'i rtags can 'dir blangs rjes/ /rgya rtags6skos dmigs bu yig ltar gsal gdab/ /bsad sngags gsung sgra mi chag thun du bzung / /thal mo brdab nas zor bskul bar rnams kun/ /bzlog pa drag po ltar la thun gtor de/ /gsod pa'i dmigs pas 'brub khung nang du dri ma song dogs pa'i wo ṣ+ka snang yang bsnyen pa go du 'thengs na skyon med gsung zhing dmig pa'i zab gnad zhal las dri/ brdeg /so rdebs bdud bzhi slong ba'i dmigs pa zab rmo sbyor shes dgos/487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonathun bskul gnyis mthar bsad sngags dang / ban dgrar dmigs lugs 'di ga'i/bsal spyir btang thun lcags sdig lcags 'dra dang rdo rje gtsug lag sogs nas len/sngags rigs/'ur rdo rje gtsug lag tu rno tshad dril ba la zer/ba blangs nas bsod dmigs zab gnad bcas//thun grub phral gyi lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur bus thun phung bkag /rdeg bden brdar dmod mo thal brdab bdun/ /bden brjod gtor chen thun ag sto thib khung du 'phen pa'i dbang ga sman phud mi sbran/gtor bsham gso mtshungs//phur gsum las dang bla srog 'dzom pa'i phur gsum rdeg pa zlog pa'i skabs dang 'dra ṣ+ka /a dang ga kho zor yang bla srog wom dus byed pa gnad/dus//thun zor brdeg cing thun drug nyams tsherd las zad gos kyi zab gnad kyang shes na sbyor/bstar bas//bsad pa'i rtags mthong ṣ+ka las thal na sngags pa grir lo/rtag gtor 'bul ba nas//ngag 'grol bar 'dra 'khor lor ling ka gcer//gtor ོ kha gso a gtor brdeg pa'i bar//gong bzhin byas rjes mnan gto masasu bu rin khor stog pas 2ga/bcug/bzlog bsad 'khor ling byang chub lam kha stong po bstan dang //phur bla thog 'dzom pa'i dus dpal nubacu rdeg pa yin/btab gud rgyas pa kha skong dag bsdu pa bu yig nas/bkol ling ror sman raka bcas/ /cung zad gtor mar 'bul zhing phal ldan thing rnams/ kho bos brtsams pa'i drag po'i sbyin bsreg gi/lag len ji bzhin me yi las sbyor bya//thal ba 'phyar dgos 'phyar gtad mnan zor byed//bzlog bzlog kyang sreg pas mtha' bsdub bsad kyang sreg pas mtha' bsdub gnyis ka gcig tu bsgril ba sa tshogazha rgyas bsdus yod pa sngos zhal las sgo /rkyang bsad kyang sgril ba zhal las shes//mngon spyod rbod gtonge yas kyi dpung bshams nas//dmag dpon g.yul du gsod pa'i gdams pa yin//lnga pa byad ma'i stobs gzho me mnan pa ni//las gzhung nas bzung sha dmar mid par mtshungs//bu yig ser rtagasasgos kyi dmigs pa len//mnan sngags rgyun a ga' bzlog pa'i skabs zutshe grams su 'go pyod mags ga/yos a rdeg bar rnams 'dra//rtags mthong rtag gtor ba nasang ga 'grol bar//ji bzhi 'khor ling gcer te gser skyems nas//phur gdab bar rnams khyad par med pa la//mi 'dra'i phur rtse rdeg tso las la sne ling mo brtol/lag len cung zad mthong ba// |zhin//mnan chas bca' bzhi'i lag len yi ge

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed lde mig nang ma(khanadang / /zhal shes phyag len dmar 'khrid bzhin du bya/ /gtor ma'i skor rnams sngon bshad kho bzlog rkyang gi skabs ltar/ na la/ /bzlog gzhung khyer rjes dan ling rkyang thog mnas 'du byas pa/ 'og ling ka rnams/ /hom la bsregs te bzhes sgra drag tu byed/ /mnan pa dngos rnams bu yig rgyas par lha 3 rje dbur ston gyis mdzad pa na len snyogato kyi khyabasgyur dang dmigs po dgolas 'dri/ nang du gsal/ /tshe 'gugs ma na kyang dkyus kyis rtogs par rtag mo byung bar tso gtor gyi sa mi dzo cing rtags mthong gong rag sgrib sbyong sa tsā rnams man ngag bsto byed/nus/ /btson pa dong rul gtong ba mnan pa'i las/ zla gsang yang bcud rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /ljongs 'dir gnubs chen brgyud (5ba)pa'i phyag mtshan thog /gza' gdong drag sngags gshin rje me'i spu gri/ 'bri khung rat+na'i thugs kyi rnog po'i chos kho bo sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro bsad pas/ /mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon mang dang 'jal/ /ngal dub khyad du bsad de gnad 'gag kun/ /ma 'dres h+phu da pa'i blo gros mig dkyus ring / /de phyir gtad kyi zhib cha der ma zad nying bzlog gi lag len zab mo'ang logs su gab /ma rtogs pa/ /bsrung bzlog bsad mnan bsdus don lag len gyi/ /srad bur brgyus pa'i rin chen 'phreng ba 'di/ /rnying rgan phal gyi mgul du ga la bzhes/ /gdong phyed tshad mnyam kha dang mgon kun bsags/ /rnying dpe gsar mar bkab pa'i gshin rje mkhan/ /chos skyong gnyan pa'i grags pa lhur len rnams/ /be'u bum rdul dang mun pa'i mal du gzims/ /de phyir yi ge tsam gyi bklag lung dang / kha bshad nam mkha'i mdzub ris ma yin par/ /dgra mgo sngags nag rnams kyi nyer thob pa'i/ /gtam thos lag rjes rim par bzhag la gzigs/ /rdzogs chen la rten 'chi med 'pho ba che/ /sgrub pa dkar po chos kyi bde skyid grong / /bsrung byed nag po mthu yi lcags ri 'di/ /ches cher snyigs ma'i dus 'dir lhag par mkho/ /skye bar sdang dag nyon mongs dug gsum srog /theg mchog smin grol mtshon gyi nyer bcad nas/ /'og min zhing gi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal/ /lnga ldan 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /ces gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi lag len sgo 'byed kyi lde mig 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams 'a du byed 'dun yod pa'i steng nye char mchod dpon 489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ngag dbang shes rab kyis mtshams sbyar ba la brten nas za hor gyi sngags nag zil gnon drag rtsal gyis chu glang hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu (6na)bzhi la pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags btsun 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dam med snod min lag tu shor na ston yul dang ston mkhan gnyis ka chos skyong stag zhen nag po dang gter bsrungs mthu chen sde bzhis tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig gu gye sam ya/ /gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang ma yig dang bu yig tu mi gsal ba'i kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro bzhugs so/na mo bha wa shi rlu rmu drwa bhi bhū wā ya/ dgra bgegs bdud sdo kun gyi ru mtshon rtse/ /cig car sa la stol ba'i mod nyid la/ /dkar phyogs ba dan tshangs pa'i yul sa cher/ /bsgreng mdzad phyag rgya zil gnon lag da nas/ /gza' gdong dmar nag gshin rje me'i spu gri'i/ /lag len med du mi drang kha skong rnams/ /'bad tshol 'jigs pa spang phyir dkyus waṇi gtu/ /don gnyer blogs la dga' ston ched du 'dri/ /bden tshig brjod pa gsar 'gyur gshin rje'i rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ nam mkha' med par gyur na yang / /sngags kyi dngos grub med mi srid/ /lha dang drang srong gis bshad pa'i/ /rig sngags bslu ba mi srid na/ /'dod chags bral pas bshad pa yi/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba bslu ba ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod pa gdams pa la sem nyi med pa'i nges shes bskyed pa gnad che'o/ /drag po'i gtor ma byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags rgya rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa ni/ gtor mar rak+ta bran la dgug gzhug gsum sogs byas rjes slar sman raka dran nas/ lag pa'i sor mo bsnol —490

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bsnyed dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma(khanal mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ba'i ngos la mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ oṃ badz+ra bhañja ba chu ta bi shwa tsakra (2na)ra/ rdo rje'i gtor snod ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdzub mo mche ba 'dra bar byas la/ oṃ ma hā smi ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ gti mug sha'i gtor ma ri bo tsam du gyur/ rdor thal bskyod pa rak+ta sbreng ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ 'dod chags khrag gi gtor ma rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ lag pa po'i phreng ba ltar byas la/ oṃ ma hā ke nirti dzo la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ zhe snang rus pa'i gtor ma gram bu ltar khrol bar gyur rdor thal snying gar gtugs rjes mgo thod kyi rgya lus la lan gsum bskor la de'i rjes su mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe bong gnyis te bzhi po rtse sprad sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol te bsgrengasal/ oṃ ka pā lab su ta ra li kro kro dhe wa bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūṃ ba lin+ta maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ngo bo rang bzhin rnam par dag cing med du byung ba la rnam pa sha khrag rus pa'i rang bzhin srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i dgyes skong dam par gyur/ oṃ āḥ& gsum dang / e a ra li hri lha dza ༷dzaḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs rjes lha gang yin gyi sngags mthar dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum la khā hi sogs kyis phul rjes drag po mngon spyod kyi 'dod gsol 'phrin bcol skabs (2ba)su gang bab bya ba gnad che bar go /rgyas par spro na las byang la yang gtor ma byin rlabs 'di nyid blangasan legs/ bsrung ba'i thun gtor 'bul tshag chos sku zhi ba ma'am/ yang na/ e thabs mchogo bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /rab 'jigs khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon sku/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gar/ /dpal gyi chas brgyan mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'phen/ khros pa'i bzhin can me dpung 'bar ba'i klong / /ma he chu glang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /gshin rje dregs byed pho mo'i gdan la 'gying / shes rab mkha' dbyings stong pa'i dbyings rum las/gnyis med sbyor yum ma mo khrag mig ma/ /dmar nag gcer bu brkyang bskum khro mo'i tshul/ /lcags kyus 'gugs shing don snying khrag la rol/ /bde stong gnyis med rol pa'i mkha' klong las/ /thugs rje'i dbyings sprul ya ma rā tsa ni/ khrag rul mdog mtshudas bshan gris dgra bgegs sgrol/ khros pa'i 491—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 9)zhabs brdabs dgra snying dmar la rol//yab yum sras bcas sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs la//'du 'bral med pa'i don gyis phyag 'tshal ṣ+ka //rang rtsal ye shes mchogo gi ma rdzo pa 'bul//thugs kyi dam skongasamachog sa dngos grub stsol/ /'khor ba'i mun rum gnas pa bdag 'dra yis/ /'phags pa'i thugs rje'i cha yi zer mthong nas/ /gus pas bstod 'dis byang chub mchog thob ste/ /rang don mthar phyin gzhan don lhun grub shog zhes pa spro lung du sbas pa zhig bgyis dus 'jam dpal tshe bdag zhal gzigasanas bstod pa'o//lcags khang dang liṅga bskyed mchog tshar nas dgug gzhug byas la/gzu dpang ni/dkon mchog gsum po rin ) gzu dang dpang //yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang //chos skyong srung ma gzu dang dpang //gshin rje'i lha tsho gos gzu dang dpang //ma dang mkha' 'gro gzu dang dbang //dam can rgya mtsho gzu dang dpang //dam nyams sdig can las ༅ 'di//dkon mchog gsum la skyabs ma 'tshol//dkon mkho gsum gyis khyod mi skyob//sku gdung bcom wo dgon sde bshig/ser gas yongs la gnod pa bskyal//das mchoge rten rdzas khyone kyis bshig/das mchog gsum dang da phye la//rang dbang med par khug la shog/dam nyams sdig can las ༅ 'di//chos skyong rnams la skyabs ma la'i//cho so skyong rnams kyis khyod mi skyob//chos skyong srung ma'i rten rdzas phag/chos skyong khyod la mthu med zer//chos skyong rnams dang da phye las//rang dbang med par khug la shog/dam yis sdig can las ga 'di//dgra lha gnyan la skyabs ma 'tshol//dgra lha gnyan gyis khyod mi skyob//dgra lha'i rten rdzas khyod kyis shig/go mtshon sna dgu khyod kyis phral//dgra lha g.yi dang da phye las//rang dbang med par khug la shog/dam nyams sdig can lasang na 'di//yul lhag nyan la skyabs ma 'tshol/yul lha gnyan gyis khyod mi skyob//lha ri gnyan la me chen bkye//lha rten thams cad khyod kyis bshig/lha gnyan rnams kyi thugs kyang dkrugs/ /de bas yul lha gnyan dang da phye las/ rang dbang med par khug la shog/dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di//zhang lha gnyan 〈skyabs ma 'tshol//zhang lhag nyan gyis khyone mi skyob//zhang lha gnyan la brnyas su btsu/༷//zhad lha gnyan la ma brtsis pas//de bas zhang

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma(khanalha gnyan dang da phye las/ /rang dbang med par (3ba/bug la shog /dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di/ /ma lha gnyan la skyabs ma 'tshol/ /ma lha gnyan gyis khyod mi skyob/ /ma lha'i rten rdzas khyod kyisabashig /de bas ma lha gnyan dang da phye las/ rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di/ /le dgu lha la skyabs ma 'tshol/ le dgu lha yis khyod mi skyobs/ /bris pa tshar rtsa lha yon bsdos/ /de bas le dgu lha dang da phye las/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di/ /thab lha gnyan la skyabs ma 'tshol/ /thab lha gnyan gyis khyod mi skyob/ /snyed bu sga med rta ltar 'dzegs/ /bya'u 'jug med rta ltar rgyugs/ /thab gzhed sna tshogs khyod kyis byas/ /de bas thab lha gnyan dang da phye las/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di/ /steng gi lha la skyabs ma 'tshol/ /steng gi lha yis khyod mi skyob/ /lha srin rnams kyi thugs kyang dkrugs/ /lha khams rnams la bden pa bdar/ /de bas steng gi lha dang da phye las/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can lasang na 'di/ /'og gi klu la skyabs ma 'tshol/ /'og gi klu yis khyod mi skyob/ /klu shing sna tshogs khyod kyis bcad/ /klu mtsho dkrugs shing klu rten bshig /de bas 'og gi klu dang da phye las/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can lasang na 'di/ /bar gyi gnyan la skyabs ma 'tshol/ /bar gyi gnyan gyis khyod mi skyob/ /shing gnyan gcad cing sa gnyan brkos/ /rdo gnyan chu gnyan thams cad dkrugs/ /de bas bar gyi gnyan dang da phye las/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can lasangan 'di/ /mtho nam mkha'i dbyings su ma los shig /nam mkha' nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /chos dbyings sgrol ma nga yin pas/ /skya (4na khri lta bu'i pho nya phye/ /phug ron lta bu'i dgra bo 'di/ /nam mkha'i mthongs nas khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can lasang na 'di/ /rlung gi khams sums shig /rlung yang nga yi rang ba na yin/ /dam tshig sgrol ma nga yin pas/ /bya khra lta bu'i pho nya phye/ khye'u lta bu'i dgra bo 'di/ /rlung gi khams nas khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can lasang na 'di/ /sa yi khams su ma yos shig /sa yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma —493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nga yin pas/ /spyang thong lta bu'i pho nya phye/ /lug thong lta bu'i dgra bo 'di/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can las ga 'di/ khu yi khams su ma 'bros shig khu yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /ma ma gi yang nga yin pas/ /nya dol lta bu'i pho nya phye/ /nya mo lta bu'i dgra bo 'di/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di/ /me yi khams su ma 'bros shig /me yang nga yi rang bzhin yin/ /gos dkar mo yang nga yin pas/ /rlung dmar lta bu'i pho nya phye/ /phye leb lta bu'i dgra bo 'di/ /rang dbang med par khug la shog /gzhog pa can gyis mtha' nas chum/ /lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung / /zhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings/ /lcags sgrog can gyi yan lag sdoms/ khril bu can gyis myos su chug /tho ba can gyis rdul du rlog /la yogs gshed kyis ded la shog /brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /byad ma rang gshed du skor ba ni/ oṃ e ka ya ma dgra snying la bh+yo bzlog /dgra sod rbad/ he ka ya ma snying la bh+yo bzlog /dgra sod rbad/ lham ya ma dgra snying la bh+yo bzlog (4ba)dgra sod rbod/ /ya ma sarba du stan e tri dza ya bh+yo: sarba ru tra'i tsit+ta gzer thums/ a mu ka trig nan/ rbod gtong rbad nan/ dgra sog la myags rbad sod yu/ dgra snying la phyung ya/ ṇi mā ra ya/ rtsi hur thums rbad kho a mu ga'i snying srog dmar po hur thums/ mā ra ya dza rbad/ ban+de sha sha rbad/ nā lo ka sha sha rbad/ ban dhe brag tshal rbad/ snying sto chod/ cad nas cho de/ dam nyams brnye phye ma phur ya/ zhes pa 'byin 'jug ltar bzla/ dgra bo'i srung bzlog byed pa'i lha srung rnams/ /'byub khung bcug la thun gyi brab/ /srung byed dregs pa gshed la dbab/ /sngags bzlas rdzu 'phrul dgug cing bstim/kho yi dregs pa'i stobs nus bshig /lha dang srung ma bdud du dbab/ /gtor mar dmar sbreng zhing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ yab gcig 'jam dpal sprul pa ni/ gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i sku/ /sku mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /sku ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /zhabs ni dmyal ba'i gdan bzhi gnon/ /zhal ni khrag gi rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /zas su gshin rje'i sha la za/ /skom du gshin rje'i khrag la 'thung / /zhi khro 'bar ba'i tsho gos chen nas/ /las khro mo mkha' 'gror bcas/ /gnod sbyin srin po yan chod du/ /—494

gshan rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma(kha)ma lus bsgral zhing zhal du gsol/khro bo nyid kyi sha la za/khro bo nyid kyis khrag la 'thung //dgra bo'i mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha//srung bzlog byed pa'i lha 'dre rnams//zhal du stob bo khā raṃ khā hi/mgur du gril lo a ra li//dbyings su bsgral lo sa mā ya//bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i//srung bzlog byed pa'i lha srung gi/mthu dang nus pa thams cad bshig/sku dang gzi brjid thams cad choms//stobs dang rdzu phrul brlag par gyis//rang gshed phob cig dregs pa'i tshogs//bka' yi chad pa 'di la chod//ces brjod cing rtags ldan〉ti mnyams dang bstun//'khu ldog spong ba gcun gzir bran du bkol ba rnams zhal las 'dri//dus dang sprul pa bgyed pa ni//dgra bo'i bla dwags brgyad po la pho nya brgyad kyi bla 'gugs pa btang ba ni:lag tu yungs thun dang phur pa thogs la bdag yi dam gyi ting 'dzin gsal bto la 'di skad do//hūṃ bh+yoḥd ni bsgral ba'i thugs dam dus la bab:da lta nam gyi srod la bab dus 'dar: chom rkun las la 'gyed pa'i dus yin pas: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'khyams pa'i dus:dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog/bh+yoḥd lta nam kyi gung la bab dusa'adir//sems med 'byung ba chu yang gnyid log gi:dgra bo las ngan sdig can gnyid log gi:bla tshe lkoms po da lta khrid la shog bh+yoḥd lta nam gyi tho rengs bab dus 'dir:dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo zhing 'phro ba'i dus dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo ba'i dus las ga bla 'khyams myur du khrid la shog:bh+yo:da lta nam langs nyi ma shar 'dus 'dar:mi phyugs thams cad las la gram pa'i dus:dgra bo'i bla tshe sgo ru thon pa'i dus:bla lkoms las ga myur du khrid la shog:bh+yo:da lta nyi ma gung la bab dus 'dir:dgra kun rnam shes bying zhing myos pa'i dus:dgra bo'i bla tshe 'thom zhing 'khyams pa'i dus: bla 'khyamasalas ga myur du khrid la shog bh+yoḥd lta nyi nub grib so phog pa'i dus snying mi dga' zhing shes pa 'phyo ba'i dus:dgra bo'i bla tshe rnam shes 'phyo ba'i dus:bla 'khyams las ga myur du khrid la shog bh+yoḥbla 'khyams las ngan 'phyo ba'i dus drug la:bla gshed pho nya khyed rnams myur du rgyug:mgon med bye'u phrug skya khras zin pa ltar:rang 5bskobang med ༷/ myur du khrid la shog:dgra bo'i bla 'khyams ru

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bsgrub na pho nya gnod sbyin srin por sku sprul la rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams sha bar brdzub na pho nya gser gyi stag mor sku sprul la: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog dgra bo'i bla 'khyams dgo bar brdzu ba na: pho nya lcags dom nag mor sku sprul la: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog dgra bo'i bla 'khyams lug ru brdzub na pho nya lcags kyi spyang mor sku sprul la rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i bla 'khyams ra ru brdzub na/ /pho nya byu ru'i khyi mor sku sprul la rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog dgra bo'i bla 'khyams bya ru brdzu ba na: pho nya bya rgyal khyung du sku sprul la: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog dgra bo'i bla lkoms gla bar brdzub na pho nya gser gyi 'phar bar sku sprul la: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog dgra bo'i bla 'khyams bong bur brdzu ba na: pho nya zangs kyi dred mor sku sprul : rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog bh+yo: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla dwags brgyad po la pho nya brgyad kyi gnyen por sku sprul laḥ 'brub khung 'khor ba'i btson dong 'di nang du dam nyams ling ga'i rten la bla srog khug bla srog gsum la drag po'i phur bus thob: khur mtshon dpal gyis lus sems phye mar mthong :dgra bo'i bla srog steng du mā ra ya: srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyi chod la shog bla stims las ngan steng du mā ra ya: ra dang lug dang bong bu rnam pa gsum bla dwags yin pas myur du khyer la shog so dang sen mo pags pa rnam pa gsum phyi rtags yin gyi da lta khyer la shog rna ba lce dang mig (6na ting gsum po ni: dbang po yin pas myur du khyer la shog slo ba snying dang mchin pa gsum po ni: don snying yin gyi myur du khyer la shog gnye ma rgyu ma mkhal ma gsum po ni nang khrol yin gyi myur du khyer la shog sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i 'phrin las da lta grub par mdzod sgrub thabs sngags bsham 'di yis 'gugs che ge mo a ka ra sha ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥsrog 'gugs pa'o/ /ā yu lan a ka ra sha ya: tshe 'gugs pa'o/ tri yaṃ ni a ka ra sha ya hūṃ dzaḥdza'ad 'gugs pa'o/ /rū pa skan+ta a ka ra sha ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥgazugs 'gugs pa'o/ /sgrub thabs sngags la 'di nyid gdags/ /che ge mo : ba ka pa 496

gzhin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma6)ye e dza la dza la/ ra tsa phye ra tsa phye a shag shag /ya ma phye ya ma phye ya/ spu ta spu ta phus phus/ lang lang /seng seng / phus phus/ che ge mo yul lha dang phye/ dgra lha dang phye/ srog lha dang phye/ pho lha dang phye/ mo lha dang phye/ zhes dmod pas so/ /lha lnga so so dang dbye ba'i sngags rdzas byed par spro na gzhan du shes/ zla gsang 'dus pa'i tan+t+ra'i le'u bcu drug pa thun gyi skabs su rang nyid gshin rje gsal bsgoms te/ thun sngags ring mo spyir bzlas la tha ma sham bu so sor btags/ thun rnams so sor lhar bsams te/ zor thogs 'jig rten khams bkang nas/ /gzas pa'i gzugs la bsnun par bsam/ /lha yi skul tshig 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ bskal pa 'das pa'i sngon rol na/ /thugs dam zhal bzhes las kyi lha/ /ya mān+ta ga'i thugs sprul pa/ /las kyi 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas/ /thun zor pho nyar bdag bskul gyi/ /dam nyams dgra la thun 'bebs las/ /stong gsum thun gyi pho nyas khong / thun rdzas so so'i (6ba)pho nya rnams/ sku yi pho nyas gzugs phung bshig /gsung gi pho nyasang ga dbang sdoms/ /thugs kyi pho nyas rnam shes phrol/ /zhe ka hi dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ spre ram/ he raṃ/ dzo la raṃ/ ha mā rak+ta dgra bo che ge mo'i srog la raṃ raṃ/ gzhan yang lcags sdig lcags 'dra dang / drag sngags rdo rje gtsug lag gi thun sngagasarnams len/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes byang chub kyi lam la 'god pa bu yig de ha cang bsdus skyon snang bas rgyas pa ni/ hūṃ nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi rje/ /dam nyams dgra bo las ga 'di/ /bsad par bya ba kho nar 'os/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams khyod/ /da lta bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ khyod nyid byang chub sems su bsgoms/ zhed bsgral ba'i las ga khyod/ /lus sems bem rig bral ba'i dus/ /yi dam rnams kyi sku ru bsgoms/ khrag 'thung rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /sngags 'chang bdag gi ting 'dzin gyis/ khro rgyal rnams kyi brtul zhugs dang / /srung ma rnams kyi dam tshig gis/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas bsgral ba'i phyir/ /dang po ras chen dmar po la/ /dug dang khrag gis ming byang bris/ /skye mched dbang po tshang bar bkod/ /ming ru bla dwags tshang bar bris/ /de nas gru gsum nang du bcug /tshon skud sna lngas byad chibs byas/ khyi phag spyang gsum thod par bcug /drag po'i rtsings kyis tha ma bskor/ /—497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)phung shul re bas gur khang phub//de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis//skyabs byed lha la bden pa bdar//snang srid lha 'dre thams cad la//gtor ma sbyin nas gzu dpang bcol/khyod skyob byed lha dang bral ba'i phyir//pho rog 'ug pa'i dang rus byabs//mi gtsang ba yi dud pas gdugs//de nas sngags 'chang rgyal ba yis//he ru ka yi skur bsgoms te//pho lha'i tshogs7na sgoms las la 'gyed//sprul pa'i tshogs rnams skar ltar 'khrug/lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung //zhags pa can gyis ske nas chings//lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag bsdams//dril bu can gyis myos su bcug/'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus//las kyi rlung pos rgyab nas ded//'chi bdag las kyi pho nya des//'chor med bzung thag nag pos bzung //de nas las kyi rnam shes des//mtshan byang gzugs la phab tsa na//chu la chu zhag ji bzhin du//rang dbang med par gzugs la bstim//pho rog 'ug pa pho nyar bkye/kha sbyor dbye ba rnam gsum byas//nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du/khrag po'i sa gyi char pa phab//mtshon cha ngar mas yan lag bcad//rtsangs dang phur pas snying nas btab//mtshon cha lnga yi khong nas gzer//hūṃ/nga ni sngags 'chang rgyal po yis/khrag 'thung lha tshogs skur bsgoms nas//drag po'i las la 'jug pa'i phyir//gos nag zhwa gyon phur pa sgril/kha nas drag sngags tsā ga ltar bsgrags//lus las khro chung dpag med spros//mtshon cha'i char pa thog ltar phab//steng na gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor//'og tu mtshon cha'i so rnams gzengs//bar snang me yi phreng ba zhabrug/rtse mor mtshon cha'i ba yug tshub//'og tu gti mug mun pa 'khrigs//log la gshin rje'i dmag kyang bsdus//spyo byed ༄dug dang khrag gis byugs//lto len tsho gos rnams ro khur cig sha zla'i tsho gis rnams tshim sgra byed/khrag 'thung tsho gos rnams hur sgra byed//rus mur tsho gos rnams so sgra byed/khyod lus sems rten dang bral tsan//sngar byas las la 'gyod 7ba pa skyes//dmyal ba'i btson dong chen po sa/las kyi gshin rjes khrid tsa na//dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs rje bsgoms//he ru ka yi byin rlabs dang //sngags 'chang bdag gi dam tshig gis/khyod la snying rje dpag med skyeX/93khyod las ga dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams//

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma(kha)las ngan gyi rnam shes yar la 'phos/ /ngas dang po khyod kyi liṅga ming rus bris/ khyod ni nag po'i phyogasasu sdod pa'i dus/ /dug gsum chu la mi sbyang rgyu/ /phud la mi za mgo tsho za/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi 'dzin rgyu/ /rnam shes 'khor bar 'khyams la khad/ khyod dang po las ngan dbang gis skyes/ /bar du mi dge bcu la spyad/ /tha mar las rnams sna tshogs byas/ /mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang byas/ khyod bsad par bya ba ma yin te/ /las ngan 'khor ba'i sems can khyod/ /ras chen ngos la bris tsa na / sangs rgyas zhing du sleb par bsgoms/ /lha khung nang du bcug tsa na/ /gzhal yas khang du phyin par soms thod pa'i nang du brdzangs tsa na/ /bde chen gnas su phyin par soms/ /mi gtsang dud pas bdug tsa na/ /dri zhims sang da yin par sems/ /skyob byed lta dang phul tsa na/ /lasang na grogs dang bral bar soms/ /pho nya'i tshogs kyis bkug tsa na/ /ngan song gnas nas drangs par soms/ /las kyi mun pa bsus tsa na/bar do'i mun pa sangs par bsgoms/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas drud tsa na/ /byang chub grogs kyis khrid par sems/ rnam shes rlung la bskyon tsan/ /theg chen rta la zhom par soms/ /zhing chen gdan la gting tsa na/ /'og min gnas su phyin par soms/ /bdag gi phur bu gtab tsa na/ /zhe sdang rnam smin byang bar soms/ /yungs kar thun gyis drangs tsa na/ /me tog (8na)char pa bab par soms/ /tshon skud sna lngas bcings tsa na/ /lus la 'ja' tshon 'khyil bar soms/ /thun sna du sna brabs tsa na/ /gti mug mun pa sangs par soms/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs tsa na/ /nga rgyal ri bo bcom par soms/ /dug thun khrag thun brabs tsa na/ /'dod chags me chen zhi bar soms/ /rnon po'i mtshon gyis gtubs tsa na/ /phrag dog rlung 'tshub zhi bar sems/ /gtore zor brang la rgyab tsa na/ /zhe sdang rtsad nas bcad par soms/ shes pa rten dang phral tsa na/ /lus ni sa rdo yin par soms/ /rnam shes dbyings su spar tsa na/ /mkha' spyod gnas su phyin par soms/ /pho nya las mkhan thams cad kyis/ /sha rus dum bur gtubs tsa na/ /tsho gos 'khor rgya wo thengs par soms/ /thod ga nang du oṃ tsa na/ /skyed mos tshal du slebs par sems/ /'khor ba'i las 'di chags pa'i rgyu/ /chags pa ma skye las ngan khyod/ /bcom ldan dpal chen thugs rje —499

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi snying rje yis/ /'khor ba'i gnas nas drang ba'i phyir/ /bslu med byang chub gnas su spar/ khyod kyi0kyi khugs phung po yis/ /sku li lha tsho gos mchode par byas/ /rnam par snang mdzad zhing khams su/ /chos dbyings ye shes thob par bya/ khyod kyi tshor ba'i phung po des/ /yon tan lha tsho gos mchode par byas/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhing khams su/ /mnyam nyid ye shes thob par bya/ khyod kyi 'du shes phung po des/ /gsung gi lha tshogs mchod par bya/ /snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams su/ /sor rtog ye shes thob par bya/ khyod kyi 'du byed phung po des/ /'phrin las sna tshogs mchod par byas/ /(4skon yod grub pa'i zhing khams su/ /bya grub ye shes thob par bya/ khyod kyi rnam shes phung po des/ /thugs kyi lha tshogs mchod par byas/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhing khams ga /me long ye shes thob par bya/ khyod kyi sha khrag rus pa dang / /srog dang dbugs kyi longs spyod la/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro longs spyod pas/ /yum lnga'i dbyings su dbyer med 'gyur/ khyod kyis rnam par shes pa de/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhing khams su/ /bde gshegs rje yi rigs su skye/ /de bas nyone mongs lasang na khyod/ /bla ma yi dam smod cing bsad pa na/ /bsad pas sdig par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gsod pas lhung ba chen por 'gyur/ khyod kyi lus sems bral ba 'di/ /byang chub lam la 'god pa'i phyir/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs/ /phaṭa byas pas yi dam gyi thugs kur 'phangs/ kho'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rang nyid la bstim mo/ /yang phaṭa byas pas rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su yar rgyang ste 'phang ngo / /man ngag bla ma'i zhal las shes/ /phur gdab gud du bkol ba ni/ mthar bsgral las bya ba ni/ srog phur min pa'i gdab phur khro zhal yod pa zhig lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du gzung la/ rang gi lag g.yas nyi ma dang g.yon zla ba g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga cha/ tre 1āḥlas rigs lnga/ /g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga rmā lī rlu / lha las yum lngar gsal ba yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems las sprul pa'i rdo rje phur bu hūṃ nag po las sras mchog ya mān+ta ka badz+ra ki la ya nag po rdo rje'i gshog pa can zhal gsum nag dkar dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtun shing sdigs mdzub kyi tha ma gnyis rdo rje phur bu —500

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma6)thugs kar sgril ba/ dur (9nasgo rgyad kyi mas brgyad kyis brgyan pa sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur bu mgar gyi sol mal nas gton pa lta bu me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba sprul gyi chun po 'chang ba de dag gi sked pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yab yum/ yar gyi rwa lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum/ mar gyi rwa lnga la khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum/ rgya mdud gong ma la yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ rgya mdud 'og ma la bka' bsrung dam can rgya mtsho/ dpal la gshin rje sde brgyad dres/sa pa'i dmag tshogs/ rtse mo zur gsum nas mtsho ni cha sna tsho gos pa'i char 'bab pa/ sgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar zhing / phyar ba tsam gyis khams gsum dngangs par byed pa/ btab pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs brlag par nus pa zhig tu gyur par bsam/ ā+oṃ yā man+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī la ya ka ya waka tsit+ta a bhi 〉 oṃ āḥ/ phur bu las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs bsdus phur bu la thim pas sku 'gyings pa dang / gsung bsgrags pa dang thugs g.yos pa tsam gyis khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur par bsam/phur bu dril zhing / hūṃ/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin can/ /rigs lnga yab lnga'i ngo bor gsal/ /g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin can/ /rigs lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyar ba las/ /mthing nag hūṃ las sprul pa'i sras/ /ya mān+ta ka gī la ya/ /sku stod khro rgyal chen po la/ /sku smad gnam lcags phur bu'i tshul/ /(9ba)dus gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku/ khams gsum sgrol mdzad gī la ya/ dgra bgegs dug lnga dug gsum dang / /las dang nyon mongs tshar bcad nas/ /rgyal ba'i sras su rab sgrol ba'i/ /rdo rje phur bur mnga' gsol lo/ /na maḥs man+ta burnya rna ka ya waka tsit+ta ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod slar yang phur bu bsgril zhing / hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ /shin tu mi zad rab 'jigs skur ston pa/ /gshin rje yongs rdzogs drag po'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /cha ya mān+ta ka badz+ra kyi li gī la ya badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti dgra bgegs ma ra ya phaṭa/ ces dang po bla gnas par —50/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gdab/ de rjes snying ga'i rtsi la gdab cing gnas spar ba ni/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams/ /ma rtogs 'brul pa snying re rje/ /snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /thugs rjes thabs shes sbyor ba yis/ /phung po bsgral nas zhal du btab/ /rnam shes rgyal ba'i sras su sbar/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī la ya a ni yaṃ ྅ ra ṇa phaṭa/ bo dhi tsit+ta ni /ha ra ṇa hūṃ zhes phur bu snying gar btab pas yid kyi rten rlung gi dngas ma sngo skya byi'u'i mgo tsam gyi dbus su srog gi rten khrag gi dngas ma thig le dmar po sran ma tsam gyi dbus su srog gi ngo bo rje rang rang gi mdog can gyi lte bar kho la sngar bla mas dbang bskur dus ye shes sems dpa' bstim pa de nyid dam tshig bsrungs na ye shes sems dpa' yin la dam las nyams na las kyi gshin rje'i gshed po yin pas mthe shes sems dpa' de (10na 〉 :gas kyi sdig pa mgo dgu par gyur te snying rtsa brgyad nas za zhing khrag 'thung / phur bu'i rtse mo nas 'od 'phros pas rlung gis dwangs ma sngo skya de gtor/ khrag gi dwangs ma thab kyi skams/de ma thag kho'i 'byung ba'i khams sa chu la thim chu me la me rlung la rlung rnam shes kyi ngo bo snro la thim ma thag rla de nyid phur bu'i rtse mor lub kyi bsdus pa phur bu'i khong bsreng nas brgyud rdo rje'i lte ba'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yab kyi thugs kur : de nyid āḥdakar po'i rnam par bstim pas chos skur sangs rgyas/ slar 'jam dpal yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i tshe ā:de nyid yab kyi dbu ma'i lam brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yab yum gyi mkha' gsang du babs pas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sras su gyur te lho phyogs rdul bral yang dag brtsegs kyi zhing du longs skur sangs rgyas/ de'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa bkye ste khams gsum pa'i 'gro ba sgrol bas don gnyis grub pa'i sprul skur sangs rgyas par bsam/ yang phur bu kho'i snying gar btab pas kho'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad phur bu'i khong gseng nas brgyud rang gi snying gar thibs bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang stobs dang gzi brjid rgyas par byas/ kho'i snying nang gi ye shes sems dpa' yang phur bu'i khong gseng nas brgyud 'chang bzung gi rdo rje'i lte ba'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la thim par gyur par —502

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma(kha)bsam zhing phur bu gnas rnams su btab cing / hūṃ/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /lho phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /drag po sgrol mdzad phur bu ni/ /sku stod phyag rgya zil gnon la/ /sku smad lcags phur zur gsum (10ba 'bar/ /stobs chen 'dus pa'i mtshon cha yis/ /dgra bgegs 'bor ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /lte ba'i dkyil du gī la ya/ /lus kyi rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /lus kyi 'khrul ba rtsad nas cho de/ /mgrin pa'i dkyil du gī la ya/ /ngag gi rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /ngag gi zhabrul pa rtsad nas chod/ /mig gi dkyil du gī la ya/ /mig gi rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /gzugs su 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod/ /sna yi dkyil du gī la ya/ /sna yi rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /dri ru zhabrul ba rtsad nas cho de/ /rna ba'i dkyil du gī la ya/ /rna ba'i rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /sgra ru zhakhrul pa rtsad nas chod/ /lce yi dkyil du gī la ya/ /lce yi rnam shes rten dang phrol/ ro ru 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod/ /gsang ba'i dkyil du gī la ya/ /kun gzhi rnam shes rten dang phrol/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod/ /yan lag bzhi la gī la ya/ reg bya'i rnam shes rten dang khrol/ /reg bya'i zhabrul ba rtsad nas chod/ /oṃ ya mān+ta kā badz+ra gī li gī la ya/dgra bgegs mā rā ya nā shā ya ri bhā ya mo hā ya bhan rte ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gdab/ kho'i rnam shes tshogos brgyad phur bu la thim/ phur bu 'od du zhu lha rnams la thim/ lha rnams 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la thim 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bdag la thim par gyur par bsam mo/ /de ltar tshe lung khrus lung gi rjes su gso ba gsum las bdag gso ba ni/ ā+oṃ ya māt+na ka hūṃ phaṭa ces brgya phrag dang / hūṃ brgya bzlas pas khams gsum hūṃ gis gang hūṃ de rnams rang la thim pas rang nyid phyag rgya zil gnon sku che zhing yan lag rag pas stong gsum gang ba gcig tu gyur par bsam/ phur bu gso ba ni/ yang ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas phur bu de las phur bu grangs med pa 'phros khams (11na)gsum phur bus gang / dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus phur bu la thim pas phur bu mthu stobs gzi mdangs nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ dgra gso ba ni/ oṃ ya māt+na ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas sngags kyi 'od zer ling ga'i snying gar phog pas tshogs brgyad kyi sgrib pa nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs —503—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nas kho 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gyur ma thag rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyis btegs nas lho phyogs rdul bral gyi zhing du 'jam dpal yab yum gyi sbyor mtshamatha su 'phangs pas rgyal ba'i sras su skyes par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥ& brgya phrag gcig bzlas pas(sku gsum thob par bsam pa'o/ /'di yan smad las gru gu 'thul ba lta bu bsgral 'dren mthar thug pa yin la 'di phyin kho'i rnam smin gyi lus sgyu ma lta bu bag chags dang bcas pa ro tshabs byed pa ltar bsgral nas sha khrag lha rnams la tshogs 'khor dga' ston du 'bul ba yin no/ /bla phur sogs phur pa gsum sngags dang bcas te gdab so sdebasadang zla gsang thun bskul gyi thun brab/ gtor zor dhe ga /gdab phur gyi dpal las mtsho zhe cha rnams spro ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ hūṃ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /nyon mongs bag chags kyis smyogs pa'i/ /dug gsum gyis mnar khyod gzigs nas/ /'jam dpal gshen rje'i gshed po yis/ /snying rjes khyod nyid bsgral ba'i phyir/ dzaḥdzaḥgaza' bzhin spros nas kyang / /bkug cing rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral/ rdo rje phur bu'i rtse mo nas/ /zhe sa rtsad gong rdo rje'i mazhi/ khrag po thog gi char ltar pheb/ //e dzaḥlcags kyu 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/ khug cig badz+ra 'a gu sha dza tshigs pa 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/ /(11bsti'i sa shig badz+ra pa she hūṃ/ /lcags sgrog 'bar ba'i tsho gos spros pas/ /sdo mes shig badz+ra h+pho ṭa baṃ/ /dril bu 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/ /phob cig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ rdo rje 'khor lo'i tshogs spros pas/ /gtubs shig badz+ra tsakra ṇa/ rdo rje ral gri'i tshogs spros pas/ /gzhog cig badz+ra kha zhe ṇa/ /rdo rje rtsedagu'i tsho gos spros pas/ /rdul du ltogs shig badz+re ṇa/ /rdo rje lcags kyu'i tsho gos spros pas/ /myur du khug cig rtsi tri dzaḥrdo rje gas shing tsho gos spros pas/ /rdungs shig badz+ra mu kha la/ /rdo rje sdigs 'thub tsho gos spros pas/ /gzir shig badz+ra tig ni/ /mchil pa 'bar ba'i tsho gos spros pas/ khrongs shig badz+ra.ā na ya/ /thod khrag 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/ /myos par gyis shig brta dar/ /bshan gri 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/ /sgrol zhig badz+ra smin/ /tsit+ta 'bar ba'i tshogs sgros pas/ /nyams par gyis shig bi dra ji/ /ri rab 'bar ba'i tsho gos spros pas/ /rnam par gnon cig kun kus /dgra sta 'bar —304

gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang gi kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro/ nang ma(kha)ba'i tsho gos spros pas/ khos shig badz+ra par+sha pa/ /be cen 'bar ba'i tsho gos spros pas/ /rgyob cig badz+ra tā ḍa ya/ /zhags pa 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/ /dam por sdoms shig bhan dha na/ /gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs rab 'bar ba'i/ /phog par rgyob cig tā ḍa ya/ /gnad du bsnun cig pu tsi ya/ /myur du gsod cig ma ra ya/ sha la zo zhig bhu dza ta/ khras la 'thung zhig bi wa tha/ /rus la mur zhig bhak+ṣa ya/ nang khrol chom zhig bhañja na/ /klad pa stobs shig kha raṃ 'a hi/ /'phrin las bsgrubs shig da rla ho/ zhes brdeg /de nas mi bsad pa'i mtshon chas brdeg cing / hūṃ nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /ye shes rno ba'i mtshon cha ni/ /thogs med drag po las kyi ma'/ /(12na rdo rje'i me chen rab 'bar bas/ /nyen slongs las kyis tha mnan pa'i/ /dgra bgegs log rtog dug lnga'i tshogs/ /'khor ba'i skye brgyud rtsad nas chod/ /ā+oṃ man+t+ra sum bha badz+ra dz+wa la/oṃ sa/ hūṃ : / tre hūṃ/ hri : / āḥrgyu/ tshal pa tshal pa ma ra ya dzaḥdza zhes bzlog bsad kyi 'khor lo dang liṅga rnams dum bur bsgral/ gtad mnan gyi 'khor lo rnams bsgral ba'i tshul tsam ma gtogs dngos su mi bsgral lo/ /de nas zan ling gcig dang bsgral ba'i ling ro rnams gtun khung du bcug la rdo rje'i tho bas brdung zhing / gtun khung yum gyi bha gar thob yab kyi rdo rjes brdungs pas dgra bo'i nyon mongs pa rtsad nas bcad de rgyal ba'i sras su skyes par bsam la/ hūṃ dza mi rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun/ /bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di/ /rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral nas kyang / khro mo 'bar ba'i gas khung du/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas pas/ /lha yang rung stobarlag par byed/ /dgra bgegasarnams la smos ci dgos/ /nyams pa'i tshe srog lus ngag yid/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag par bgyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a ko ṭa ya kha the kha the mchu chings mchu chings/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas la brdung / de nas ling ro cung zad zhig /sman rag dang bcas te gtor mar sbran la zhal stobs kyus bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar mngon spyod kyi las 'di ni gshin rje nag po'i rgyud la/ e ma ho gsang ba'i yang dag gsang / /bsad pa ma yin sdig las grol/ /ji srid bsad kyang ma bsad de/ /sdig pa stong phrag byas pa yis/ /mnar med —505

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)la sogs mi skye ba/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas cha ba'i bdag /bsad pas byang chub thob par byed/ /ces dang / dgra nag gi rgyud las/ 'di ltar gsad pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /sras su de ni skye bar 'gyur/ /las kyi sdig las de (12ba)grol lo/ /zhes ma rga spyod kyi las la brten nas rang g.yin thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa drag sngags bdag po gnubs kyi khyad chos 'di ni snying la bcang bar bya'o/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs ldan rgyal sras de/ /mi bzad ches cher khros pa srin po'i gar/ /gdul dka'i log 'dren gnyen por legs bsgyur na/ /man ngag 'di ko deng dus blang bya'i chos/ /ha cang gab na mi rtogs rang mgo 'khor/ /lhug par bgod na gdams pa 'chol ba'i rgyu/ /mnyam 'jug 'byung ba mi med zab mo'i gnad/ khub 'phangs dkyus bris dam can phrag ma dog /dpe 'di bka' rgyas bkrol ba'i snod ldan las/ /kun la ma spel srung mar gter du gtad/ /rgyud 'dzin sngags 'chang rnams kyis nyams blangs nas/ /thub bstan mi nub btsas su 'gyur bar shog /ces gshin rje gza' gdong dmar nag gi las byang ma yig bu yig tu mi gsal ba'i kha skong bdud dpung snying rtsa 'dar ba'i nga ro 'di ni rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi nyams len du za hor gyi ban+de rdo rje thogs med rtsal gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa'i dge bas nag po'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /gshin rje zhing dang dmar nag gi gtang rag bzhugs so/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas las kyi gshin rje zhing ming dmar nag /'chi bdag nag po chu srin gyi mgo bo can sogs 'khor dang bcas pa thogs pa med par gnas 'dir e gye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ mnan pa'i rna cha gshin rje'i gshed/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog 'phrig /bam chen bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'thul/ /zhun —306

wa 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i brgyud 'debs/ nang ma(khanachen gsal ba'i sgron me sbar/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i dri yi chab/ /sha rus nad khrol zhal zas spungs/ /rkang gling sna tshogs rol mo snyem brol/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a skṛ ta/ /rak+ta'i rba klong zegs ma gzug /bha li tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs sogs/ /log 'dren dgra bo dam nyamasal/ /sngar bcol rtags thon gtang rag dang / /slad mar mi nor tshe srog dbugs/ /bsod nams stobs 'byor dmag dpung kun/ /sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi gting / /lha srin sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyi/ /zas dang skal par gtad byas nas/ /nam yang mi ldang 'phrin las mdzod/ oṃ ya mā ri zhing dang sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shasta'i bar dang / ma hā pañca a skṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ ma hā bha li ta kha raṃ ri hi/ ma hā rma sa kha raṃ ra hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā bha su ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ mahā go ro tsa na kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā ke ni ri ti kha raṃ 'a hi/ hūṃ/ dgra bgegs bskal ba'i bar du yang / / (1ba〉zhan pa'i lasamadzad gzhin rje'i bshed/ /dmar nag ging gang las byed la/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'ang spyi bla mi 'gyur brtan pa phyogs gtogs nang 'khrugs kyis bcoms pa dang slad mar yang gtang rag sogs la mkho ba'i ched du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// // sarba maṅga le//'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/'gro ba'i nyi ma thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /mngon par sgo phye sis rol pa'i rgyan/ /pad+ma ge sar rtse las rang byung sku/ /dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas mahā tsho sa /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i mgon por nges/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med gshin rje'i gshed/ /ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms byed pa'i/ /raka kā la nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen ye shes bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ /pa ra mi ta mtshan ldan shes rab tshul/ /mtsho gling gnas nas spyan drangs rgyal sras kyi/ /gnyis —507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)med yum gyur 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /rigs 'dzin rig pa'i brda brgyud gsang ba'i gnyen/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med be+e ta li/ /ban dgra glang snying mu stegs pham mdzad pa'i/ /mthing 'bar rgyal mo nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /smon lam dbang bskur mngon mtho mdzad 'phrin las/ /rgyal btab ma nyams chos bdag mkha' 'gros gtad/ /'om bu tshal gyi brag dmar gter sgo phye/ /gru gu yang dbang zhes grags sprul pa'i sku/ /bkur 'os dam pa nyid dang bla ma mchog /dbyer med ngo mtshar man ngag zab mo yis/ /(2na'ang rgyud nus stobs bdag por byin brlabs pa/ /chos dang gang zag bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims rnam dag rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /bal po zhes skyabs rin chen rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /ston chung grags dbang bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims phung po phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gdams pa'i dbang phyug bdun ldan rdo rje'i mtshan/ /rin cen seng ge bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs kyi nges bzung mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /rin cen bzang po brag gsum nags phug pa/ /tre bo chos bzang bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rong po'i char gzungs seng ge rdo rje dang / /pha jo'i tshul bzung 'jigs byed nag po dang / /'jam dpal rgya mtsho bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum lagasol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /rin cen mdzod ltar dbang phyug gdams pas gtams/ /mdo sde rgya mtsho bla ma mchoge nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum lagasol ba 'debs/ /gang la bskyab phyir pad+ma dbang phyug ces/ /ba po shis man ngag (2ba)dbang grags gdams pas phyug /dpal ldan bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /dbyer med dam pa gsum lagaso le ba 'debs/ /rigs 'dzin mchog sprul ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /yol mo sprul sku stobs ldan shugs 'chang rtsal/ /bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /dbyer med dam pa gsum lagasol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang zung 'jug dbyer med dkyil 'khor du/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dam tshig rdzas/ /bka' gtad 'phrul gyi brda sprod thabs nyid la/ /brten nas smin cing —508

'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i brgyud 'debs/ nang ma(kha)grol bar byin gyis rlobs//brnag pa'i mthar thug 'phrul 'khor nyi zla'i bcas//gang la thogs med gnam lcags 'bar ba'i dbal//rten 'byung nus ldan bsgrub la rab brtson pa//lha mchog 'joms byed nyi zla 'grub par shog/snyigs dus log spyod skye bo sngags bzlog mkhan//las byed gshin rje gshed dang gzhan mi thub//sgom bzlas dmod tshig thabs rdzas sbyor byed sogs//'joms par byed 'dis gsang sngags bstan bsrung shog/mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal dam pa'i chos//mtsho skyes sprul sku'i bstan pa sems kho na//rim brgyud phas rgol stobs 'joms byed po 'di//phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/hūṃ bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas:sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i gzhal yas su:dgra bgegs gnod byed bsnol ba'i khri steng na bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /mche ba rab gtsigs spyan gsum khro gnyer bgrad:dbu skra dmar ser me ltar gyen du 'bar:sku smad phur bus 3na skos sa pa'i snying la gzir:phyag g.yas ral gris dgra srog rtsad nas gcad:phyag g.yon lcags kyus dgra bo'i snying nas bzung :zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum drag po'i tshul du 'gying :sku la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba yis:gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad gshob tu gtong :'phrin las thogs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod:྅ mtshon cha sna tshogs gur khang na dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i khri steng du mu stegs dbang phyug chen po ni:sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa:mche ba rab gtsigs drag po'i rkan sgra rdeb dbu skra mtshon cha gyen du 'bar:phyag gnyis ri rab mchod rten bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum drag po'i tshul du bzhugs: sku la dug gi me 'bar dgra bo gzhob tu thob bdud 'dul khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod:ces 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad la nyer mkho'i brgyud 'debs dang bcas pa ༷di'ang za hor gyi bzhes sbyar//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad sgom lung bya tshul mthong bas don ldan bzhugs/ /phyi nang so so'i snying po gnam lcags thog /'o mo bu tshal gyi brag la rgyas btab gter/ /pad+ma'i thugs kyi nying khu 'byin mdzad pa/ /gter ston gru gu yang waṃ khyod gcig bsngags/ /rnying rlom nus mthu med pa'i sgrib shing du/ /chos gos zlum por gyon nas gzhan 'drid dang / /ral khur kha spu gos dkar tsam nyid la/ /mtshar 'dzin phal gyis ma thos zab gsang chos/ /ra gan gser du brdzu ba'i g.yo sgyu mkhan/ /ma yin gter ston 'khrul med dbang po'i sde'i/ /phyag len ji bzhin mthong chog nag 'gros su/ /bkod 'dis shes ldan tshogs rnams dga' bas long / /de yang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ban sngags dang 'gras pa'i gshed mar mu steg ba'i dbang phyug ma hā de wa zla ba nag po'i skru gri ka mā la dang phyi rol pa'i gnyen por dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje ra ka'i skur bstan pa thabs shes gnyis su med pa la brten nas gzugs med kyi bgegs byur sri rbad 'dre gnod byed dgra bo rbod gtong mkhan por bcas pa rnams bsad mnan dkrugs bshig 'gom chog sogs mngon spyod kyi las zab pa'i mthar thug pa mu stegs spu gri'i rgyud gsum (2na)nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal o rgyan chen pos bsdus te jo mo mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal la gdams te 'om bu tshal gyi brag dmar la gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa sprul pa'i gter ston gru gu yang waṃ gis spyan drangs pa'i gdams pa zab mo nyams su blang ba la/ 'di nyid kyi bka' gtad ma thob par gya tshom du bstar na dbang phyug chen po sogs 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi srung mas rang nyid kyi srog zan lta bur mthong nas srog la hab zas byed pa'i nyes dmigs shin tu che bas thog ma'i sngon 'gror bka' gtad nod pa gal po cher dgongs nas gter gzhung du rtsa tho tsam dang de'i gsal byed chos rgyal khri —5/0

'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bga' gtad sgom lu nga bya tshul mthong bas don ldan/ nang ma(kha)srong lde'u btsan gyi yon tan gyi rnam 'phrul mi nyag byang pa sngags 'chang dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal drag po stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' bo'i sdes mdzad pa'i sgom lung 'bogs pa'i cho ga tsha grang nyi zla'i gdung sel dang nyi zla'i gdams gtad snyan brgyud phyag len gsal bar byed pa'i lde mig /brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i bsnyel tho'i reg zig sogs bstan pa'i btsas su mdzad pa la dgos don ma tshang ba'i legs bshad (2ba)gsar pa'i bris rtsom byed rgyu ci la mchis kyang ha cang chig 'doms ches pas go dka' zhing sogs khongs rnams gter gzhung dang ljags sgrigs so so nas len pa bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rdo rje slob dpon du rlom pa rnams mgo rmongs pas bul pa'i dka' tshegs kyis ngal bar mi 'gyur ba'i ched du bklags chog chu 'bab kyi tshul du bkod pa la/ sngon 'gro gter ma/ byang bu/ phur gdan/ dpon slob gnyis kyi zhal phyogs/ chas dang phyag rten sogs sngon 'gro'i phyag bzhes rnams gsal byed lde mig dang mthong brgyud ltar zhakhrul med sla chos su ma song bar grabs bshams bkod mdzes su mngon par 'du bgyis/ slob dpon rang rig don gyi pad+ma thod 'phrong rtsal rang las gzhan du ma yin par gdengs rnyed kyi nga rgyal brtan po la rnam pa der gsal gyi bskyed rim spangs pa'i sgo nas bgegs gtor btang zhing phyir bskrad de srung 'khor bsgom/ sngon 'gro spyi bye brag gi chos dang 'di nyid mu stegs rgyud gsum nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bsdus te ma 'ongs bstan pa'i btsas su mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal la gnang nas brag dmar 'om bu la gter du sbas pa ma yig sa bcad drug tu bsdoms pa/ bu yig gsal byed gser gyi phreng ba rnams kyi gdams pa zab pa'i che ba/ gru gu yang waṃ gis spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa zam ma chad par byon pa'i lo rgyus bshad pa la spro ba bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dpon slob thams cad mgrin gcig tu brgyud rim gyi gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'gro ba'i nyi ma thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /mngon par sgo phye sis rol pa'i rgyan/ /pad+ma ge sar rtse las (3na)rang byung sku/ /dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas mahā ghu sa /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud thog ma'i mgon por nges/ /bla ma —511

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mchog dang dbyer med gshin rje'i gshed/ /ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms byed pa'i/ /raka ka la nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen ye shes bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ /pa ra mi ta mtshan ldan shes rab tshul/ /mtsho gling gnas nas spyan drangs rgyal sras kyi/ /gnyis med yum gyur 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /rigs 'dzin rig pa'i brda brgyud gsang ba'i gnyen/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med be+e ta li/ /ban dgra glang snying mu stegs pham mdzad pa'i/ /mthing 'bar rgyal mo nyid la gsol ba 'debs/ /smon lam dbang bskur mngon mtho mdzad 'phrin las/ /rgyas btab ma nyams chos bdag mkha' 'gros gtad/ /'om bu tshal gyi brag dmar gter sgo phye/ khru gu yang waṃ zhes grags sprul pa'i sku/ /bkur 'os dam pa nyid dang bla ma mchog /dbyer med ngo mtshar man ngag zab mo yis/ /rang rgyud nus stobs bdag por byin brlabs pa/ /chos dang gang zag bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims rnam dag rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /bal po zhes skyabs rin chen rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /ston chung grags dbang bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims phung po phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gdams pa'i dbang phyug bdun ldan rdo rje'i mtshan/ /rin chen seng ge bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs kyi nges bzung mi bskyod rdo rje dang / /rin chen bzang po brag gsum nags phug pa/ /tre (3ba)bo chos bzang bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rong po'i char zhakhrungs seng ge rdo rje dang / /pha jo'i tshul bzung 'jigs byed nag po dang / /'jam dpal rgya mtsho bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /rin chen mdzod ltar dbang phyug gdams pas gtams/ /mdo sde rgya mtsho bla ma mchog nyid dang / /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang la bskyab phyir pad+ma dbang phyug ces/ /bkra shis man ngag dbang grags gdams pas phyug /dpal ldan bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs 'dzin mchog sprul ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ /yol ma sprul sku stobs ldan shugs —512

'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad sgom lung bya tshul mthong bas don ldan/ nang ma(khan 'chang rtsal/ /bka' drin mnyam med chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /dbyer med dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi nang zung 'jug dbyer med dkyil 'khor du/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dam tshig rdzas/ /bka' gtad 'phrul gyi brda sprod thabs nyid la/ /brten nas smin cing grol bar byin gyi rlobs/ /brnag pa'i mthar thug 'khrul 'khor nyi zla'i bcas/ /gang la thogs med gnam lcags 'bar ba'i dpal/ /rten 'byung nus ldan bsgrub la rab brtson pa/ /lha mchog 'joms byed nyi zla 'grub par shog /snyigs dus log spyod skye bo sngags bzlog mkhan/ /las byed gshin rje gshed dang gzhan mi thub/ /sgom bzlas dmod tshig thabs rdzas sbyar byed sogs/ /'joms par byed 'dis gsang sngags bstan bsrung shog /mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal dam pa'i chos/ /mtsho skyes sprul sku'i bstan pa sems pa na/ /rim brgyud phas rgol (4na〉stobs 'joms byed po 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces gdangs dang bcas te tshar gcig gis thun mong gi 'jug pa song nas/skyabs yul 'gro ba po 'gro tshul phan yon rnams brda sprad de/ gu ru pad+ma ye shes 'tsho rgyal yum/ /sprul sku gter ston gru gu yang waṃ sogs/ /bka' babs rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma la/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla phyi nang gshed/ /dmar nag raka spu gri gang 'dul skur/ /ston mdzad lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /gnyis 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa'i bstan dgra bcom/ /nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir/ /nyi zla nag po'i dmod pa bsgrub par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed/ khyed rang dang 'o skol gyi g.yas phyogs su bzhugs pa'i dmar gyi gtor ma phyi rol pa'i cig shos su bshams pa 'di nyid sngags phur dang gsum ga 'jam dpal gshin rjer bskyed dgos pa lags pas 'di bzhin du sgoms mdzod ces brda sbyar nas/ gzhi don ma rtogs snang srid 'bor 'das kyi/ /chos kun stong zhing bdag 'dzin bral ba'i ngang / /skye med dbyings las rig gdangs 'gags med rtsal/ /bdag dang mdun bskyed gtor —513—

wa wa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ (6)ma las phur gsum//stong gsum stong gi mi mjed 'jig rten khams/sha khrag dug mtsho rba klong 'byug pa'i dkyil/ /rab 'jigs mtshon cha sna tshogs 'khrigs 4ba ) pa'i gur/ /ye shes me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /phyi rol gnam lcags thog gi bu yug 'chub/ /'og phyogs lcags kyi khang pa gru gsum pa/ /gshin rje'i grong khyer srid pa'i btson khang nang / /gnod byed dmigs yul sdang bar byed pa'i dgra//mthu byad byad ma rbod ga sto ban dang bon//gdon bgegs za 'dre pho mo 'phung byed sri//pha rol rbad 'dre phyir 'phreng sgab 'dre sogs//bsnyel zhing bsnol ba'i khrir brtsegs gdan steng du//bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /dgra dpung 'joms byed raka gnag pa'i las//mthar byed sku mdog dmar po khro bo'i zhal//ngo bo gcig las 'gyur med thabs shes rab//zung du 'brel ba'i sdigs mdzub phyag gnyis pa//mche ba bzhi dkar rab 'jigs spyan gsum ldog/smin phrag khro gnyer bzhin bsdus rngams shing bgrad//dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser mdog/me ltar g.yo zhing ral pa gyen du 'bar//sku smad gsang ba'i gnas nas gnam lcags kyi/ /zur gsum dpal ldan phur pas dgra dang bgegs/ /gnod byed nyams pa'i snying la rtag tu gzir//phyag g.yas ral gris dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir//nam mkhar 'phyar bas srog rtsa rtsad nas gcod//phyag g.yon lcags kyus dgra bo'i don snying la//btab nas 'chor ba med par bzung zhing 'gugs//zhabs gnyisagayas brkyang mthil la gnam lcags dang / /g.yon bskum zangs kyi sog le rno ngar can/ /de gnyis bar du dmigs bya'i mgo lus sogs//pags rus sha khrag dum bur dmar ldan(kha li//gtub cing drag po'i stang stabs tshul du 'gying / /'jigs pa'i sku la bskal ba'i me chen po/ /ji ltar ba spu re la 'bar ba yis//gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs la sogs//thams cad gzhob tu bsreg cing thal bar gtong //'phrin las thogs med khro rgyal skur gyur to//zhes gsal btab/mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba thon slob ma'i zhal du zhugs par brda sprad//sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed//hūṃ bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i kleX dkyil nas sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i gzhal

'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gto sgom lung bya tshul mthong bas don ldan/ nang ma(khanayas su: dgra bgegs gnod byed bsnol ba'i khri steng na: bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal bzhan rje'i gshed sku mngog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mche ba rab gtsigs spyan gsum khro gnyer bgrad dbu skra dmar ser me ltar gyen du 'bar: sku smad phur bus nyams pa'i snying la gzer: phyag g.yas ral gris dgra srog rtsad nas gcod phyag g.yon lcags kyus dgra bo'i snying nas bzung : zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum drag po'i tshul du 'gying : sku la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba yis: gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad gzhob tu gtang : 'phrin las thogs med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod ces slob ma lhar gyur pa la che brjod 'phrin bcol mnga' gsol gyi tshul du dbyangs gyer nas bya/ g.yon du bkod pa'i gtor ma nang pa'i cig shos su bshams pa 'di nyid sngags phur dang gsum ga dbang (5ba)phyug chen por bskyed dgos tshul brda sprad de/ mu stegs rtsal chen dbang phyug chen po ni/ /zla ba nag po'i spu gri ka mā la/ /sku mdog sngo nag khro gzugs zhal gcig pa/ /mche ba rab gtsigs spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad/ /drag po'i ljags 'dril dgra la rkan sgra rdeb/ /dbu skra mtshon cha ltar gzings gyen du 'bar/ /g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis zangs lcags las grub pa'i/ /ri rab mchod rten bang rim dgu pa re/ /bzlog mdzad phyag rgyar bcas pa'i steng du bsnams/ /dam nyams lusang ga yid gsum mnan pa'i ri/ /brgyab pas dgra bo'i bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod/ /gcer bu liṅga dmar po gyen du bsgrengs/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum stang stabs gyis/ /drag po'i gdan la gnon mdzad tshul du bzhugs/ /sku la dug gi nus ldan me 'bar bas/ /dgra bo myos shing gzhob tu bsreg par mdzad/ /bdud dpung 'bul mdzad khro bo'i skur gyur to/ /zhes lhar gsal btab/ dmigs pa dang bcas sngags lan gsum gyi bzlas lung phog /hūṃ/ mtshon cha sna tshogs gur khang na dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i khri steng du mu stegs dbang phyug chen po ni: sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mche ba rab gtsigs drag po'i rkan sgra rdeb dbu skra mtshon cha gyen du 'bar: phyag gnyis ri rab mchod rten bsnams: dam nyams —515

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dgra bo'i bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum drag po'i tshul du bzhugs: sku la dug gi me 'bar dgra bo gzhob tu thong : bdud 'dul khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgra bo'i sha khrag gtor (6na)ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ces lhar gsal ba la bstod/ dpon slob gnyis kyi bar thod pa dang sngags byang phur pa slob mar gdong bstan te mdun du bsham/ liṅga dang sha btsos pa la dmigs te/ bdag dang mdun bskyed sgrub gtor las phur gsum/ /phyi nang gang sgrub skabs kyi skur gsal ba'i/ /mthu stobs nus rtsal 'od zer sprul pa'i tshogs/ /dngos 'dra lta bu'i bka' 'khor 'jig rten las/ /'das dang ma 'das dpag med kyis bskor ba/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs dmigs bya yi/ /snying la lcags kyus btab nas 'og gi ni/ /liṅkar rnam shes dgug bstim las mdzod cig /na mo gu ru pad+ma ye shes 'tsho rgyal yum/ /sprul sku gter ston gru gu yang waṃ sogs/ /mthar thug dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /byin rlabs rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bden pa dang / /dgra dpung 'joms byed rak+ta gang 'dul skur/ /mu stegs zla ba nag po'i spu gri ste/ /rgyas pa phyi nang gshed mdzad nyi zla nag /yi dam lha tsho gos rnams kyi bden pa dang /dus gsum gnad 'bebs dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bcas/ /bha li las phur mnan gcod tsakra sogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan byas pas/ /rten 'brel nus par ldan pa'i bden pa dang / /chos dbyings rnam dag bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bstan pa yongs la gnod pa'i spyi yi dgra/ /sngags 'chang sku la bsdo ba sgos kyi dgra/ /zhing bcu tshang ba bla ma'i sku dgra sogs/ /bsgral bya'i rnam shes tshe srog 'dir khug cig /bod khams 'phung bar byed pa mtha' dmag (6ba)dpung / /chos 'khor dben gnas 'joms byed bdud kyi sde/ /gsang sngags bka' gter bstan la gnod sems can/ /dus bzang chos bcu 'dzin pa'i dge rgyun gcod/ /de 'dra'i bsgral zhing gang 'dug 'dir khug cig /pad+ma 'byung gnas rigs 'dzin gdung gsob mkhan/ /'dir dus dpon slob thar lam bsgrub pa la/ /gnod byed bsam pa ngan zhing sbyor ba rtsub/ /sdang byed dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bsgral bar —5/6

'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad sgom lung bya tshul mthong bas don ldan/ nang ma(kha)'os pa ci 'dug 'dir khug cig /ces 'jam dpal 'byoms byed kyi sgo nas dgra bo 'gugs shing slar yang dgra dpung 'joms byed raka nag po'i skur zhes pa'i tshab la dgra dpung 'joms byed ma hā de wa'i sku zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba'i gdab las tshar gcig gzhung bsrangs te liṅga dang sha ma bcos pa la dgug gzhug bya/ bla 'gugs kyi sngags lan gsum dang de la bsad pa'i 'byung gsham sgril ba tshar gsum bzla ba dang lhan cig par sngags phur bsgril zhing dang po'i skabs bcos pa dang gnyis par ma btsos pa rnams dgra bo'i ngo bor bsams la rtsabs pa'i tshul gyis de rnams bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung po zhig tu dmigs/ dgra bgegs sha rus dum bur gtubs pa'i gdan/ /lhar gsal rno ngar stobs shugs rtsal ldan gyi/ /zhabs su yi dwags sde dpon las byed dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub nyid kyang mnan par gyur/ /ces brjod nas gsal btab ste/ slob ma dang byang bu'i mdun ngos kyi yig 'bru rnams 'jam dpal gshin rje 'joms byed du gsal ba 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor mos te/ dpon slob gnyis gas smra ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par nyin sngags (7na)brgya rtsa bzlas nas/ sngags 'phreng rnams dbu nas rim gyis gu rus srin lag bdud rtsir bcas pas bkrus pa'i khu ba chang phud hub gang blud sha btsos pa bstan dgra bsgral ba'i don snying du dmigs nas sngags 'dren zhing byin/ yang slob ma dang rgyab sngags dbang phyug zla ba nag por gsal btab ste mtshan sngags brgya rtsa dang bcas gong ltar bkrus la ster/ sha ma btsos pa sbyin/ smod mo ni/ lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan/ zhag dang za ma la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan/ srog lus dbang thang la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan/ kha rje dang rlung rta la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan/ za mal du dug g.yos pa thams cad mā ra ya nan/ 'gro lam du rtsang 'dzugs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan/gsod gshom 'phrog gshom brku gshom byed pa thams cad mā ra ya nan/ byad kha phur kha mo ngan ltasangan tsher rtsub thams cad mā ra ya nan/ byur mi kha snying stong ngan pa thams cad mā ra ya nan/ dgra gshom dmag gzhom bsam ngan mdun ma ngan pa thams cad mā ra ya nan/ zhes rjes zlos lan gsum byas te —511—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)thal mo lan gsum brdab/ zor gtad la/ hūṃ/ nga ni 'phen byed ye shes lha/ /nyi ma zla ba nag por zor /gnod byed phyi nang gnyen po sa /mda' ltar bkang zhing thog ltar 'bebs/ /'jig rten las grub dbang phyug che/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor dang bcas/ /dmigs yul byad ma'i steng du rgyug /byad kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong bzlog /gnod byed dgra bo'i steng du rgyug /bsam sbyor ngan bzlog dmag dpung choms/ /lo zla zhag dus za ma'i sgeg /sri dang ltas ngan mtshan rtsub bzlog /ces zor sngags bzla zhing dmigs bya yod na gang yin dang / /(7bsgod na thebs dang bstun te 'phen du 'jug /slob ma 'jam dpal du gsal btab pa'i spyi bor gtor ma 'jam dpal gshin rjer bskyed pa'i steng gi char rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams mtho brtsegs su bzhugs par mos nas rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod de dam bsgrags shing bka' bsgos/ mthar ye shes pa bzhu blugs su thim par bsams la zan kham gyi dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol/ bskal me mas sngar ltar bstod nas che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed/ de bzhin du dbang phyug la yang bdud 'dul ba'i bstod pa dang bcas te bya/ bkra shis ni/ khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng 'tsho rgyal yum/ /gru gu yang waṃ drag sngags gter gyi bdag /gdams pa'i bka' babs rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /dngos grub char ltar 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog /phyi rol mu stegs ga sngags mtshone cha'i dbal/ /'jomasamadzad 'jam dpal gshin rje raka dang / /nang pa'i dmod byad gnyen po dbang phyug che/ /thabs shes gnyis med 'phrin las bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin zab gter bsrung zhing skyong / /rigasa'adzin mngag gzhug log 'dren dgra bgegs gshed/ /gtum drag rtsal ldan dam can srung ma yis /drag sbyor mngon spyod 'grub pa'i ba po shis shog /gzhan yang shis brjod dang smon lam rgya cher bya'o/ /de yang bka' gtad kyi skabs 'dir khyad par gyi chos su rdo rje slob dpon ngo bo gu ru pad+ma yin pa la ltar snang cha lugs da lta'i tha mal pa'i gzugs su bhe pa de ga las g.yin pa'i lha so so'i rnam par dpon slob gnyis gas mi bsam pa la dgos pa zhig yod pa zhal las shes shing gnad zab/ sngon du (8na)dngos grub rdzas su byin pa'i gtor ma sogs dam rdzas slob ma rang gis rol pa las g.yin la —518
