'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad sgom lung bya tshul mthong bas don ldan/ nang ma(khanami ster ba 'di'i khyad par gyi dam tshig yin no/ /e ma rgyud gsum don bsdus snying po'i bcud/ /phyon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhal gyi lung / /yang waṃ sprul skur bka' babs zab mo'i gter/ /phyi nang sngags mkhan 'joms pa'i tho ba yin/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i dkar po'i mkhar nang du/ /dam pa chos kyi dga' ston la spyod par/ /dgra bgegs dpung gis brdzi bar nus min pa'i/ /nag po mthu yi lcags ri 'di na btsan/ /log 'dren gzugs can gzugs med spyi gtsug tu/ /'khrul 'khor nyi zla nag po'i gnam lcags lce/ /babs tshe bdud dpung pham pa'i cho nga'i sgra/ /sgrogs bzhin bros pa'i mod la brgyal zhig rengs/ /srid sde dmag gshom dug mtshon sbyar ba la/ /ra ba'i phyi 'gyur 'dren rloms rnam par thar/ /ma yin mtshams khang nang nas srad gsum las/ /rgyal ba'i mdun ma sngags rgan rnams kyis 'grub/ /de phyir bsnyen sgrub las sbyar sngon 'gro'i sgo/ /bka' gtad mthong bas don ldan bkod pa'i dges/ /'byul pa'i dgra srog bcad nas rang gi sems/ /kun bzang 'jam dpal go 'phang mngon 'gyur shog /ces 'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad sgom lung bya tshul bklags chog nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bkod pa mthong ba'i don ldan 'di ni byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po'i sprul pa'i sku rin po cher chos 'di 'bul ba'i sta gon gyi che 'jug bde'i bsam pas mtshams sbyar rang dang skal mnyam gyi las dang po ba mang por phan 'dod kyi bsam pas(8ba)kun nas blangs te za hor gyi sngags spyon zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dkar cha rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor thog sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dgra bgegs g.yul las rgal ba'i rnga sgo srid gsum kun tu khyab par gyur cig/ // sarba maṅga lo// //—519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)las kyi gshin rje'i 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra bzhugs/na maḥkarma ya mā ya/ skye dgu yongs kyi bla tshe dang / /srog dbugs kun la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /las gshin bhe wa satwa zhes/ /'chi bdag nag po'i 'phrin las 'dri/ /de'ang zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i mchod rten bcas chog yod na des khyab la gzhan du na 'chi bdag zhal dbye'i las kyi dkyil 'khor sa stegs 'brub khung sogs kha thun gyi gzhung man ngag bzhin du byas pa'i nang du thod pa 'khor lo sogs phyag len ltar mngon par 'du byas/ de'i mdun du bsnyen sgrub/ bsad pa/ 'phrin las dkyus su 'chol ba/ gtang rag sogs skabs thob dbye ba phyed par byas pa'i rdzas spyir btang dmigs bsal gang babs bsres pa'i 'bru nag gi phye la gtor ma zur gsum pa 'khor gshed bzhi khram bdag bcu gnyis dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bcu drug mtheb skyu rab brgya 'bring lnga bcu tha ma'ang nyer gcig gis bskor ba sha khrag gi rgyan dang mar rgyan gyis spras pa/ sman mchod/ rak+ta/ khrag gi a/ dbang po lnga dngos sam rgyu de dag nas bsres pa'i bzo ma dang dud 'gro'i snying sol pa/ sha chen/ gu gul gyi (2na)dud pa/ ro ras kyi sdong bu la tshil chen gyi mar me/ khrag dang mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus bsres pa'i zhal zas gru gsum/ shog ling zan ling skabs sbyar/ gser skyems kyi dza rag dang phud phor/ khrag mchod kyi bzed zhal/ mi rkang gi gling bu/ thod pa'i rnga chung / g.yab dar/ byi la'i gcin/ smug chen smug chung / rol mo go mtshon spyan gzigs rnams bsham/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ā+oṃ / bhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/dgra bgegs gdug pa can mtha' dag bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag gi yon chab/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ tsit+ta'i zhal zas/ rkang chen gyi gling bu la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/—520

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(khanar ya dza ni/ bhe wa sa twa dza ma ri hūṃ/ sarba 'bu ba ta ya ba ti/ a lha āḥ&/ de bzhin du/ pā bye/ phre dhū pe/ (2ba)ā lo ke/ gharnye/ ni wi bye/ sha lta āḥshā/ bdud rtsis bsangs sbyangs / stong pa'i ngang las/rlung mi thod pa'i snyed po gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin/ kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho chen por gyuraḥ.ā+oṃ sarba pañca a skṛ ta la kha raṃ ji hi hūṃ hrī lta/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ rlung me thod pa'i skyed po gsum la gnas pa'i a las bhardzi'i snod lcang lor bcas pa gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du : dang tri las dgra bgeb/sa byad ma gzugs phung sha khrag gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ā+oṃ ma hā bha smra ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/rak+ta bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ srid gsum dgra bgegs gdug pa can ma lus bsgral ba las byung ba'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po lku phreng rba rlabs 'phyo zhing /yongs su gang ba las kyi gshin rje'i lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hrī4/ zhes gsum gyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /bsad las gtso bor byed na gtor ma'i dus zur khyad dgos pa yang bzlog gi thun gtor dang 'dra'o/ /de nas las khung dang rten bskyed pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las lcags khang sgo med zur gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyi lcags mkhar thod pa'i rwa ba/ nang lcags mkhar mun pa nag po'i gling / phrag dog gi rlung gis zhe sdang gi me sbar (3na tsā kho / 'dod chags kyi khrag dug khol ba'i rlangs pas gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa/ de'i nang du lcags mkhar gcig /de'i phyir lcags mkhar brgyad/ de'i phyir lcags mkhar bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi rol mun pa'i gling / de'i phyir lcags mkhar bcu drug yod pa 'jigs shing rngam pa'i kha bad lcang lor bcas pa ban+ta rlon pa rnyid pa skam po rnams brtsegs mar bskor ba'i steng du mi lpags kyi rgyal mtshan dang 'phan gdugs bsgreng ba/ sgal tshigs dang rkang lag gi rus pa' bya 'dabs/ dug sprul dang rgyu ma'i lda ldi/ slo snying mchin pa mkhal mcher mig sna rna ba lce sogs lung ba'i dra ba phyed pas spras pa/ steng du —521—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2name dmar nag tu 'khyil ba dang 'og rlung gi 'khor lo gnyis 'khrug cing 'tshub pa/ khrag gi chu bo 'bab cing mtshor 'khyil ba/ nang lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'du gnas/ srid gsum lto bar 'chang ba'i zhing khams/ shi gson gnyis kyis mtshams kyi zam kha/ gson po skos la 'debs par byed pa'i sa/ gshin po dbang med 'khyam zhing rgyu ba'i yul/ skye 'gro khram la 'debs pa'i sa gzhi/ ma rungs log 'dren 'jug pa'i btson khang / dam nyams dgra bgegs gsod pa'i bshas ra/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i pho brang 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ dbus kyi lcags mkhar du dgra bo gan rkyal kha sbub tu brdzis pa'i ma he nag po kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa rno ngar dang ldan pa'i rwa gdengs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i steng du ya nag po las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros log (3ba)'dren thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje bha wa sa twa sku mdog rdo sol ltar gnag pa srin po'i zhal can/ rab tu khros pa'i gnyer ma smin mtshams su bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ gnam sa lta bu'i zhal gdangs pa las kha rlangs dug gi me lcer 'bar ba/ tshems dang mche ba gangs ri lta bu'i bar nas ljags glog ltar 'byug pa/ zhal gyi gra nas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra rnams me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas be con 'phyar zhing / g.yon gnam lcags las grub pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor ba/ gsus pa che zhing lto ba 'phyang ba/ zhabs gnyis ma he la thon nas stong gsum myul ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / rgyu ma dang / dug sprul gyis spras pa/ khrag gi thig les brgyan pa/ bh+yo las yum gtum mo dug hrul ma nag mo khro zhing gtum pa g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag bzung nas dgra la nad yams gtong ba las kyi rlung dmar la zhen pa/ yab yum de gnyis kyi sto bar srid pa'i grong khyer lcags mkhar brgya drug gi nang du ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya dza ni rnams yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i las gshin yab yum 'khor du gshed bzhi khram thogasabacu gnyis sogs lha srin sde brgyad bu yug ltar 'tshub pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las byed pa'i —511

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(khanabadag nyid can du gyur/ 'chi bdag yab (4na tshe rtsam gyi 'khor du lcags mkhar brgyad kyi nang na yi ge bzhi las las kyi gshed bzhi grub pa ni/ shar du gshin rje ya ma rā dza smug nag /lhor bdud po myos byed 'bar ba ser nag /nub tu srin po ār+ya ma ru dmar nag /byang du gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag bzhi ga'ang g.yas rim bzhin rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i be con dang / g.yon mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa mtshams bzhin gshed mo bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol lcags mkhar bcu gnyis kyi nang du yi ge bcu gnyis las las kyi khram bdag bcu gnyis grub pa ni/ shar nas brtsams te g.yas skor du gshin rje nag 'joms mthing nag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/gshin rje phywa sangs dkar po g.yas tshe bum dang g.yon rdo rje gzhol dbyug 'dzin pa/ gshin rje kong tse brag 'joms dkar po g.yas brag nag dang g.yon 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gshin rje a ba glang mgo dud kha g.yas lcags kyu g.yon rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ gshin rje ya wa ti sngo nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ gshin rje mig dmar dmar nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhing dbyug 'dzin pa/ gshin rje rmig pa dud kha g.yas thod 'phreng dang g.yon lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ gshin rje tel pa sngo nag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon bhan dmar 'dzin pa/ gshin rje lha mchog dud kha smug nag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin pa/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po dmar ser g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum dang g.yon bdud kyi khram shing 'dzin pa/ gshin (4ba)rje dmar po dmar nag g.yas rtsis kyi byang dmar dang g.yon gtun shing 'dzin pa/ gshin rje thod dbyug mthing nag g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon bdud kyi sho rdel 'dzin pa rang rang gi chung ma dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang de dag gi phyi rol tu las sna tsho gis so sor sgrub pa'i sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshul du las kyi mi brgyad/ mthar byed kyi pho nya brgyad/ gshed po bdun/ sras mchog bcu bdun/ ging chen bco brgyad/ gces bdud bcu gcig /bshan pa bzhi/mon pa bzhi/ pho gshed sum brgya drug cu/ mo gshed sum brgya drug cu/ gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu/mdangs len gyi ma mo stong dang rtsa gnyis/ phyi rol gyi lcags mkhar bcu drug la las byed chen po bcu —523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)drug sogs mdor na snang srid lha zin dregs pa'i dmag tshogs/ sha za ba/ khrag 'thung ba/ blta ba/rgod pa/ khro ba/ brda dang gar byed pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phen pa/ gsod gsod/ rgyob rgyob/ hūṃ hūṃ/phaṭa phaṭa/ rkang rkang / rke rke/ ta hu ta hūṃ sogs 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrog pas sa dang bar snang ma lus pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ spyan gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ hūṃ ya mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra dharmaḥ tsak+ṣu pra be sha na/zhes spyan dbye/ sdang mig tu dgra la gzigs pas 'jigs par 'gyur/ ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka /de ba sho da tre pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pas zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'gril bas/ ha ha zhes dgra bo skrag par byed par gyur/ ā+oṃ a mān+ta ka /badz+ra hri/ zhes brjod pas/ thugs shin tu khros shing rngam pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzes (5na)pa/ smin mtshams 'od zer dmar nag mgar gyi tsha tsha bzhin du 'phro bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra gu/ hwa lam/ zhes brjod pas/ mche ba gtsigs nas dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod par gyur/ lag pa g.yas be con dang / g.yon lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te/ be con brgyab bas sa gzhi gas nas sgo bye rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pa las kyi gshin rje'i snying ga'i ya la phog pas/rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng rgya mtsho chen po'i 'og gshin rje bhe wa sa twa 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa la thim par bsams nas/ 'bod pa'i brdas lan gsum du 'bod/ bshug glu lan gsum du skyur/ mi rkang gi gling bu lan gsum 'bud/ thal mo lan gsum brdab/ thod chen gyi rnga dang rdza rnga brdung / dar nag gi g.ya' mo phyogs bzhi nas lan gsum du g.yab/ sha chen dang tshil chen gyi gsur dud gtong zhing 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ 'di nas byang phyogs ri rab r+ṣa po'i rmang / /dpag tshad brgyad khri thur du zug pa na/ /lcags kyi khang pa sgo med na/ /yid kyis brgyu ba'i sgo can na/ /phyogs phyogs mi ros gtams pa'i gnas mchog na/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje chen po dang / bdud kyi rgyal mo dug hrul gos gyon ma/ /las kyi gshed po khram bdag yab yum rnams/ /srid gsum lto na 'phyo zhing 'gal byed zhags pas 'dren/ /be con 'khor lo bskor zhing dam nyams rtsad nas gcod/ /bstan pa gnyan bsrung las rdzu snyul can/ /tha tshig gnyan pos thugs dam rgyud (5ba〉bskul gyis/ /—514

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(kha)dam tshig rjes su dran zhing dmar chen dam la gshegs/ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya dza ni/ bhe wa sa twa/ dza ma ri hūṃ/ a ra li ho/ dzaḥ& baṃ ho: sa ma ya sto/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/grub pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje srin mo'i tshogs/ /ming dang srog tu brjod pas grub pa'i tshogs/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig dam tshig rjes dran zhing / /grub pa'i las rnams sngon tshe khas blangs te/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir dam tshig brtan par bzhugs/ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya dza/ sam ya/ma na ma ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sam ya lhan/ zil gyis gnon pa ni/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ ā+oṃ shrī mañju kro ta dz+nyā na sarba du gi rte ya phaṭa/ dbang du bsdub ni/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan te/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten 'chi bdag gshin rje mthu chen rnams/ /'jigs rung las kyi rdzu 'phrul stobs can las/ /ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyi byin stobs kyis/ /'jig rten gdug pa 'dus pa'i ye shes dang / /srid pa'i snying thag 'dren pa'i ting 'dzin nga la yod/ /nga ni bgegs chen 'dul ba yi/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul bdag sbyong bas/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ngas 'dul lo/ /ā+oṃ hrī:rdzi wi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ma hā baṃ ka /rdza bi ta an+ta ka ra/ sarba du sha sto pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig bstan pa ni/ rdo rje rtse gnyis pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ hūṃ/sngon tshe dpal chen gshin rje gshed/ khro mchog 'bar ba'i sku mnga' des/ /'chi bdag gshin rje gzir nas ni/ /dregs pa spangs nas srog (6ba)snying phul/ /pho brang 'khor du dam tshig byin/ /sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor ba'o/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag 'dir/ /rtag tu dam tshig tshul bzhin gyis/ /bhe ba satwa sam ye sam ya thā/ dam bsgrag pa ni/ be con gyi phyag rgya bstan te/ 'chi bdag nag po'i 'khor bcas rnams/ /rang sems dpang du rab btsugs la/ /dam tshig dag la gnas par gyis/ /'gal na mgo bo tshal par 'gas/ /ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje'i mna' chu sbyin pa ni/ dam chu gter ba'i stang ga dang bcas te/ 'di ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /spyan sngar khas blangs rdo rje'i chu/ /ma nyams dngos grub thob byed cing / /'gal na mgo 'gas dmyal bar lhung / /ya ma rā dza i rda ho: bak+ṣa sa ma ya i dan na ra skan/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya ston pa'am rdo —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)rje dngos gang rung dang bcas te/ ho/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje bha wa sa twa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ slob dpon gtsug lag dpal dge /bal po bha su dha ra/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnubs ye shes rgya mtsho/ gnubs pad+ma dbang rgyal/ gnubs bla chen 'jam dpal/ gnabs rgya gar rdo rje la sogs pa'i bka' ma'i brgyud pa dang / gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ bral te sam bho ṭa/ gangs (6ba)ban bkra shis dar/ /gangs pa ri dkar ba/ mthu chen gangs pa shāka 'bum/ gra phyi g.yung ston rdo rje dpal la sogs pa bka' gter zung du 'jug pa'i rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs spyi dang / khyad par mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje dang / mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar bcas pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam tshig dran par mdzod la/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis bcol ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod cig /ya ma rā dza badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ khrag gi mchod yon ni/ hūṃ/ sgrub pa'i 'che bdag gshin rje'i tshogs/ /'phung byed sha khrag zhal gsol te/ /dmar chen khrag la sa ma ya/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di la rol/ /ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya dza ni/ bhe wa sa twa dza ma ri hūṃ/ sarba 'bu pa ta ya pa ti ma hā rak+ta pra tī ts+tsha ho.a lha pra twe tsā kha raṃ ji hi/ zhes bzed zhal du khrag chang sbreng ngo / /nyer spyod lnga rol mo 'bul ba ni/ las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas la/ /dbang po'i me tog rnam par bkra sha chen dud pa sprin bzhin gtibs/ /tshil chen mar me nya ltar gsal/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab rba klong 'byug sha rus zhal zas ri ltar spungs/ /thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'bul/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gong gi sngags (7na)mjug tu a lha nas/ shasta'i bar brjod/ sman mchod ni/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'di/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'phrin las sgrub par —519 —

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(khanamadzod/ /gong gi sngags mjug tu ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ rak+ta ni/ mi dang srog chags sna tshogs pa/ /bsad khrag rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /gong gi sngags mjug tu ma hā rak+ta a mṛ ta kha raṃ 'a hi/ gtor ma ni/ phyags chen sha dang khrag dang rkang / /lha ba rus pa bdud rtsir sbyar/ /dbang po tshim byed 'dod yon lnga/ /'dod yon bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin gyis/ grub pa'i gshin rje'i tshogs rnams rol/ /ha ha hi hi kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bha kla mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /gong gi sngags mas ga tu ma hā bha sla ta kha raṃ khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun dang / ma hā rma sa nas/ ke : ti'i bar brjod/ nas nag gi me tog 'thor zhing / ho/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs rnams la/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang / /da bcol 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rten du mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di 'bul gyis bzhes la rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod cig /ces brjod/ bstod pa ni/hūṃ/ mun pa'i mdog can srin po'i gzugs/ /ma he zhen nas stong gsum myul/ /sna tshogs (7bsgo tshone chas dgra srog gcod/ /'chi bdag nag po khyod la bstod/ /sbyor yum gtum mo ro gos ma/ /las kyi gshed bzhi gshed mo dang / khram bdag bcu gnyis chung mar bcas/ /'khor gyi bka' nyan rnams la bstod/ /sprul pa yang sprul la sogs pa/ /rab 'jigs gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dang / /snang srid lha srin sdo brgyad kyi/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do/ /'dzab bzla ba ni/ rang zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ /gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs gar nyi gdan la ya nag po sogs rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba la phog pas brgyud bskul te drag po'i las thogs med du bsgrub par bsams la/ las gshin gyi snying po/ ā+oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa dang / gtso 'khor bsgril sngags ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā dza sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ rā ya tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ci mang du bzla/ gdab las bya zhing bsgral mchod 'bul ba la bskul ba ni/ rak+ta sgreng bshug sgra sogs spyan 'dren dus kyi skabs su gang byed rnams blangs la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ/ ya man+ta ga'i zhabs 'og nas/ /—527

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)skye 'gro'i srog la mnga' mdzad pa/ /'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /phyogs phyogs mtshams kyang pha gi na/ /nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na/ /ri rab chen po'i rmang 'og na/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum na/ /gshin yul nag po'i rmang dag na/ /thod pa lcags kyi mun khang na/ /sgo med lcags (8na)mkhar bcu bdun yod/ /grong khyer de yi nang shed na/ /rus pa'i gdang bu khrol lo lo/ sha yi lhu dum nyil li li/ /rak+ta'i rba klong khyil li li/ /zhing chen gsar rnying rtsig par brtsigs/ /sa gzhi ke rus khrag thigs can/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis ma khyab pa'i/ /mun nag 'jigs pa'i smag rum na/ zhan tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ /de na las kyi gshin rje bzhugs/ /yi dwags 'bum gyi ded dpon po/ /'chi bdag chos kyi rgyal po ni/ /gson gshin gnyis kyi zam kha ba/ /gson po skos la 'debs par byed/ l+le ba rnams kyi gshed du che/ /dge ba can gyi stangs kyang 'dzin/ /sdig pa can la chad pa mkhan/ /legs nyes gnyis kyi stangs gcod pa/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nag po ste/ /bzhin mi sdug la khro gnyer can/ /gsus po che la lto 'chang po/ khrag zhag mang po'i thig le can/ khyu ma sbrul gyis sku lus brgyan/ /phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams/ /snying rje med par gsod la dga'/ /spyan gdangs zhal bsgrad mche ba gtsigs/ /lce brkyangs mchu ni khrag gis bkus/ kha rlangs dug gi me lce 'bar/ /so rno lag pa dmar ba ste/ /las su skye 'gro'i srog rtsa gcod/ /zas su skye 'gro'i sha la za/ /sgom du skye 'gro'i khrag la 'thung / /sku ni ha cang mi bskyod de/ /'jam dpal ting 'dzin g.yos pa'i tshe/ /brnag pa'i dgra la khyur mid byed/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nag po la/ /'khor du yi dwags 'bum gyis bskor/ khar (8ba)phyogs ya ma rā tsa dang / /lho phyogs myos byed 'bar ba dang / /nub phyogs ār+ya ma ru dang / /byang phyogs ral pa tshar dgu bzhis/ /rgyal po'i tshul du sa yang 'dzin/ /blon po'i tshul du zhal lce gcod/ /dmag dpon tshul du khrims las mdzad/ /mngon shes dus 'dir bdag la dgongs/ /bdag kyang rigs 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /'jam dpal gzhen nu'i rigs 'dzin te/ /ya mān+ta ga'i thugs kyi sras/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub pa dang / /dge ba'i chos la bar gcod pa'i/ /sdig can 'di dag —515

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(kha)bsgral ba'i phyir/ khyod kyi thugs dam bdag bskul na/ /don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don/ /las ni sangasargyas kun gyi las/ /bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor bcas la/ /'phrin las drag po'i gnyer gtad kyis/ /lhas byin zhes bya'i sdig can 'di/ spyir yang dkon mchog gsum la sdang / /dmigs kyi rnal 'byor bdag la sdang / /'di dag myur du bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gshin rje 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhesal/ /bka' las 'das pa'i sdig can 'di/ /mgo bo skor cig bra ma ya/ /lus po shi sprugs ga mur tsa ya/ /snying khrag skyug tu chug cig rak+ta tsa ra ya/ /gsod par gyis shig mā ra ya/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /bh+yo/ dbus kyi thod mkhar chen po nas/ /bdud po bye ba gung ring yab yum shelas la chas/ /shar (9na)phyogs lcags mkhar sgo med nas/ /ya ma rā tsa yab yum las la chos/ /lho phyogs lcags mkhar sgo med nas/ /myos byed 'bar ba yab yum las la chos/ /nub phyogs lcags mkhar sgo med nas/ /ār+ya ma ru yab yum las la chos/ /byang phyogs lcags mkhar sgo med nas/ /ral pa tshar dgu yab yum las la chos/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og gi /lcags mkhar nag po sgo med nas/ /phyogs skyong bcu po las la chos/ /ri rab lhun po'i zom rtse nas/ /gri thogs ging chen bco brgyad las la chos/ /bka' nyan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khram thogs bdud po bcu gsum las la chos/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sgo ma bse mo bzhi po las la chos/ khrag mtsho zhag mtsho 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /srid pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro las la chos/ /dam nyams dgra bo rtsad nas chod/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /yā/ 'di nas byang phyogs ri rab chen po'i rmang / /dpag tshad brgyad khri mar 'das na/ /rgya mtsho rlung gi bar dag na/ /thod pa lcags kyi mun khang na/ /gshin rje kun gyi ded dpon che/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje'o/ /'chi bdag kun gyi bdud chen po/ /klu rnams kun gyi srin po ste/ /gson gshin gnyis kyi zam kha ba/ /gson po skos la 'debs par byed/ l+le ba rnams kyi gshin bu rje/ /gshin rje nag po dgra yi gshed/ /bdud po mi zan skye 'gro'i —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nabadud/ /bye ba dgu ring sus mi bzlog /me lce glog gi 'phreng ba can/ /thod pa sbrul gyis rgyan du byas/ /ma he nag po (9ba〉zhe nas ni/ /lag na dbyug pa zhags pa thogs/ /las kyi rlung dmar 'ded cing rgyu/ /zhal nas thog dang ser ba 'bebs/ /zas su skye 'gro'i srog dbugs za/ /las su dam nyams srog dbugs len/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /gshin rje'i zhags pas khrid la shog /khram la thob la lhung la rgyus/ /be con rgyob la 'khor lo skor/ khyod kyis zas skal 'di yin gyis/ sha rus khrag la longs spyod kyis/ /sngon chad ji bzhin dam bcas bzhin/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho srung bar gyis/ /de yi thugs dam rgyud bskul ma/ /srin mo dug hrul gos rgya zhe ma/ /bdud mo nag mo skye 'gro'i gshed/ /srid gsum sto na gnas pa mo/ /sna tsho gis nad kyi bdag mo ste/ /skye 'gro kun gyi srog 'phrog ma/ sha khrag srog dbugs bdag mo ste/ /las kyi rlung dmar zhon nas ni/ /lag na thod khrag 'thor byed cing / /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad gtong ma/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da gshegs la/ /yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /bdud mo nag mo'i lag tu gtad/ /gtad do ma btang sho ra re/ /yā/ phyogs bzhi grub pa'i lcags mkhar nas/ /dgra bo'i gshed po sgrol ging chen po bzhi/ /ya ma ra tsa myos byed 'bar ba dang / /ār+ya ma ru ral pa tshar dgu bzhi/ /las kyi yum chen bzhi dang bcas pa rnams/ /dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang / /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /mgo 'khor yid 'khrug khrag tu skyug pa dang / /rnam shes(10na gi zir la myur du bsgral bar mdzod/ /yā/ grub pa'i thod pa lcags kyi mun khang nas/ /las kyi 'chi bdag khram bdag bcu gnyis kyang / /las kyi srid ma chung mar bcas pa rnams/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren 'phrin las mdzod/ /dam tshig rdzas kyi mchod pa bzhes nas kyang / /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo dam nyams 'di/ /gzer nad cha ba'i nad dang khrag skyug dang / /cho 'phrul 'bum nad mkhris pa gsha' ya dang / mdze nad glo gzir skya rbab brgyal nad dang / /skrangs 'bur rims nad gzhogs skams nad rnams kyis/ /myur du gzir la tshe yi 'du byed bkum/ khram thogs bdud dang rtsis byed ging du bcas/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje pho mo rnams/ /bcom ldan gshin rje —53(kyi

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(kha)gshed po'i zhabs drung du/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin mna' bor ba/ /dam las ma 'da' 'phrin las mdzod/ /'khor gyi lha tshogs so sor bskul bar 'dod na bskul 'bum las shes par bya'o/ /gser skyems 'bul/ mkhyen dgongs dmod bcol ni/ hoḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma/ dben gnas gnyen po'i srung ma/ pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma/ bsten bsten sgrub sgrub pa'i srung ma'i tsho gis spyi dang / khyad par 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs la gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig /ho kyilas gshin rje bhe wa satwa yab yum 'khor las kyi gshed bzhi/ khram bdag bcu (10ba)gnyis/ las kyi mi brgyad/ mthar byed brgyad/ /gshed po bdun/ sras mchog bcu bdun/ ging chen bco brgyad/ bdud po bcu gcig rnams yab yum dang bcas pa sogs mdor na pho gshed sum brgya drug cu/ mo gshed sum brgya drug cu/ phyi'i lha ma srin sdebargyad/ nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ gsang ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ sbas pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/bstan pa bsrung ba'i lha ma srin sdebargyad/ drag sngags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ /btags chags kyi lha ma srin sdebargyad/ las byed myur mgyogs kyi lha ma srin sdebargyad/ bye brag de ring gi tshes grangs dus tshod la rgyu ba'i rā hu la/ rnal 'byor ma/ gshin rje dus mtshan/ zin 'phung / hal khyi/ pi ling sogs sa bdag drag rtsal can/ mi mngon bar snang dbyings su rgyu ba'i mig nag hrig ge ba/ lce dmar yug ge ba thams cad thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes kyi sgo nas gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig /khyed rnams bosapa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yabs pa'i chen spyan ma rtul/ /bsten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / /bsgrubs pa'i tshe na gong ma g.yel/ /bkur ba'i tshe na phrag ma dog /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung / /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid shig par byed pa spyi'i dgra /sgos su rigs 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag la bsdo ba'i dgra bgegs dmigs su bsal ba gzugs byang bu la bris shing ming yi ger btab pa rnams dang /dmigs su ma bsal ba snga dgra (11na〉pag la dar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra dngos su 'phyar ba/ rgyab nas khra ltar 'jab pa/ lkog nas 'bu ltar g.yeng ba/ gdong nas khyi ltar zug pa/—531—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2namadun nas log par lta ba/ g.yas nas bsam pa ngan pa/ g.yon nas sbyor ba rtsub pa/ mgo nas ri ltar mtho gnon byed pa/ 'og nas rlung ltar bskyod pa/ bar nas chu ltar khrug pa/ za lam du dug g.yo ba/'gro lam du rtsang 'dzugs pa/ stobs 'byor dang mnga' ris 'phrog pa/ 'thab cing rtsod par 'dod pa/'grug cing 'dzing bar 'dod pa/ 'gras shing khon par 'dod pa/ lus la na tsha gtong ba/ sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba/ srog la bar chad gtong ba/ bsam pa mi 'grub rnga/ra byed pa/ mdor na gzugs can snang bar byed pa'i dgra /gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs 'di rnams kyis/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa byas so/ /dkon mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten bshig go /bla ma'i sku la bsdos so/ /dge 'dun gyi sde bcoms so/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi bde skyid la 'tshe'o/ /rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la bsnyad btsugs so/ /srung ma khyed rnams la zhe 'gras so/ /lha srin sdebargyad rnams kyi za sgo bkag go /lha chos kyi dam tshig las nyams so/ /mi chos kyi mna' tho zas so/ /blo gtad pa'i snying brkus so/ /gros dris pa'i mtshang brus so/ /phan gtags pa la dgrar bltas so/ /bzang lan ngan (11ba)gyis 'jal lo/ /rig sngags 'chang ba bdag gis/ dang por khas ma nyes so/ /bar du lag gis ma nyes so/ /tha mar spyod pas ma nyes so/ /ngas nya ltar bros kyang / khos sram ltar ded do/ /ngas byi'u ltar bros kyang khos khra ltar ded do/ /ngas sha ba ltar bros kyang / khos khyi ltar ded do/ /ngas gangs ltar dkar kyang / khos rdza ltar gnags so/ /ngas mkha' ltar yangs kyang / khos sprin ltar gtibs so/ /mi nga la lha med zer ro/ /lha khyod la mthu med zer ro/ /mdor na bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo bza' tshang pha bu dang bcas pa 'di rnams da lta nyid du dmigs rten gzugs kyi liṅga 'di nyid la bkugs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /'brub khung bskyed chog nas bzung dgug gzhug gi bar dkyus bzhin byas rjes/ dam nyams dgra bo bza' tshang pha bu mi nor phyugs gsum/ mnga' 'bangs srid sdodang bcas pa rnams kyi gzugs phung bla tshe srog dbugs rnams/ las gshin rje sdebargyad kyi tshogs la dug gsum sha khrag mngon spyod drag po'i gsang mchod 'bul zhing zas skal du gtad pa yin —531

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(kha)pas dgra bo 'di rnams/ pho lha dang phye zhig /pho 'dre dang sprod cig /mo lha dang phye zhig /mo 'dre dang sprod cig /zhang lha dang phye zhig /'ad 'dre dang sprod cig /yul lha dang phye zhig /yul 'dre dang sprod cig /dgra lha dang phye zhig /dgra 'dre dang sprod cig /las kyi rlung dmar gyis rgyab nas ded cig /'jigs pa'i mun nag gis (12na7dun nas bsus shig /dpal gyi chad pas chod cig /dam tshig gi dmod pas sdigs shig /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod cig /sa'i brten phur drung nas phyung zhig /bla me stag yar pa bzhin du thong zhig /srog mar me rlung gis bsad pa bzhin du ca dbugs pags pa med pa'i sbud ma chu'i rlung bzhin thong zhig /gzugs bye ma'i changs bu zhig pa bzhin za ngag pi wang gi rgyud thag chad pa bzhin : sems dha dhu ra'i khu ba btungs pas myos pa bzhin ཿ yan lag shing skam gyi 'gal ba rengs pa bzhin tsha dbang po lnga chu la snag tsha blug pas mogs pa bzhin du thong zhig /steng gi mi rabs shing sdong rtsa ba bton pa bzhin du thong zhig /pha mtshan pho rgyud kyi rigs rnams shing tā la'i mgo bo bcad pa bzhin du thong zhig /ma mtshan zhag rgyud kyi rigs rnams rgyus pa thab la btab pa bzhin du thong zhig /mna' ma dang tsha rigs lhug phran zor bas brngas pa bzhin du thong zhig /bu dang bu mo sgo nga brag la brdabs pa bzhin du thong zhig /bu sring dang dmag pa me la chu blug pa bzhin du thong zhig /bar gyi g.yog rabs ser bas lo tog bcoms pa bzhin du thong zhig /'og gi rta nor phyugs rabs rtsa phung la me brgyab pa bzhin du thong zhig /yul dang mkhar gzhis pha bong la thig brgyab pa bzhin du thong zhig /bsod nams dang longs spyod me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin du thong zhig /zas skal dang dbang thang dgun gyi chu phran bskam pa bzhin du thong zhig /kha rje dang rlung rta 'dab chags gshog pa chag pa bzhin du thong zhig /stobs (12ba)dang nus pa gzi brjid khang rul rdib pa bzhin du thong zhig /mthun rkyen legs tshogs nam langs kyi skar ma bzhin du thong zhig /mi 'dod pa'i nyes tshogs nyi rgyas kyi grib so bzhin du thong zhig /nad gdon dang chags che kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du thong zhig /stod kyi tsha ba'i nad rigs nags me rlung gis sbar ba bzhin du thong zhig /smad kyi grang ba'i nad rigs shwa 'od dang —533

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nachu rgod brdol bab na du thong zhig /rlung mkhris bad kun ldan 'dus kyi nang rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs zhabrugasapa bzhin du thong zhig /'go ba'i rims nad dbyar gyi char sprin 'thibs pa bzhin du thong zhig /phan byed kyi sman rnams gnod byed kyi dug zos pa bzhin du thong zhig /gri mdung mtshon khar sbrang bu me la lcibs pa bzhin du thong zhig /khang pa ro yis 'gengs pa gshin rje'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /rimasand khrag tu 'dzag pa ma mo'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /pha tshan gri khar 'chi ba bdud kyi lcog brdungs thong zhig /kha mig ltag par skyel ba gza'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /dug gzer spos gyir 'chi ba btsan gyi lcog brdungs thong zhig /spyo bog rang snang zhabrul pa rgyal po'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /grong khyer khang pa stib pa 'gong po'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /mdze nad phol mig yong ba klu'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /dmu chu rde nad yong ba sa bdag gi lcog brdungs thong zhig /gag lhog skrangs 'bur yong ba gnyan gyi lcog brdungs thong zhig /gzhang 'brum 'on long yod pa dgra lha'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /cir snang 'dre ru mthong ba mon pa'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /dpon g.yog bza' tshang dkrug pa rlung lha'i lcog brdungs thong zhig /thog dang ser ba 'bab pa sdebargyad kyi lcog brdungs thong zhig /mon pa sgo 'bur ba/ a tsa ra brang brdung ba/ dam sri 'o dod 'bod pa 'gong po spun dgu'i ltas ༅ thong zhig /spyang gis sbud pa (13na 'bud pa/ spre'u sa rang 'thag bskor ba/ wa mos mi lab shes pa klu dang srin mo'i ltas ngan thong zhig /rta bong glu skad len pa/ khyim bya sgro gshog rtse zhing mi skad 'don pa/ legs ldan nag po'i ltasang na thong zhig /rang 'thag bshug pa brdeb pa/ skyed pos gleng mo lab pa/ khang pa 'od kyis 'geng ba dpe dkar spun dgu'i ltas ga thong zhig /wa la spre'u zhen pa/ khyim phugs 'ug pas 'geng ba nag po khrosapa'i ltas ༅ thong zhig /rang gshed rang la phob cig /rang mtshon rang la rgyob cig /rang srog rang gis chod cig /rang sha rang gis zo zhig /rang khrag rang gis 'thung zhig /rang nus rang la smin cig /mdor na nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ 'jig rten phyi ma la dus ma 'debs/ rang bzhin gyi skye 'chi la khung ma 'byin/ las kyi dbang btsan zhes bsnyad ma 'dogs/ lo dang zla ba zhag dang za ma ma —634

las kyi gshin rje 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra la/ nang ma(kha)'gyangs par mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phye/ gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs/ glog dmar tsam gyi ljags khyong la/ dgra bgegs 'di rnams kyi sha zo khrag 'thung /dbugs long rus cho mes/ lings thob/ las kyi bla dang tshe srog sbar gyis thob la/ ming tsam brda tsam tha snyad tsam du'ang sgra mi grag par rjes med thal ba rlung la skur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /de nas nyes byas drag bskul nasang zung thun brdeg pa dang phur 'debs gnyis kar dngos gzhi dkyus ltar la/ phye myags sogs gsham du/ ya ma rā dza (13ba 'dogs dgos ral gris sgrol ba ni/ e mā: lho phyogs rab 'jigs gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zil gnon lha tsho gos las kyi gshin rjer bcas/ /dam nyams dgra bo sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /dgra bo las ga spyi dgra ru dra dang / /bstan dang chos byed sems can rnal 'byor la/ /rtsan gdang thog 'bebs byed pa dgra bo'i snying / /gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gnam lcags rgya gram 'bar pas dum bur gtubs/ /rus sbal nag pos srog chod snying khrag 'jongs/ /spyi dgra dang ni slob ma dam nyams rnams/ /gnam lcags sdig pas srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /dam tshig gcig kyang mched la 'khu ba rnams/ /brtse yi sbal pa nag pos sha khrag zo/ /gnod byed nang 'gras sngags pa nag po de/ /sbal pa dmar pos srog snying bskor la gsod/ /bstan dgra mu stegs bon po nag po rnams/ /dug gi phag rgod nag pos bsgral bar gyis/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba dang / /spyi sgos dgra bgegs dmigs bya thams cad kun/ /gshed chen sdebazhisasrog 'khor rnam bzhi chod/ /sod byed mon pas gnam lcags thog mda' rgyob/ /bdud po bshan pasasnying phyungs khrag nad phob/ /'chi bdag bcu gnyis dgra bo khram la thog /bdun brgya nyi shus dal yams sna tshogs phob/ /dregs pa sde bzhis rang dbang med par khug /ru dra sde bzhis dgra la khrag zor rgyob/sprul pa'i khyi mos dgra lnga'i gla phyir rgyug /gnam lcags bya yis dgra wa'i tsit+ta phyungs/ /dug sbrul(14na)nag pos snying la dug mda' rgyob/ /gnam lcags sdig pas srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /gdug pa'i rul sbal nag pos bla tshe zo/ /mtshon cha 'bar bas lus srog dum bur gtubs/ /dam nyams dgra bo rang —535

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)gshed rang la phob/ kha kha/ khā hi/ dgra bo mā ra ya/ gshin rje'i lha tshogs rab tu dgyes par mdzod/ /rnam par shes pa chos kyi dbyings su spor/ /dgra bgegs ru dra'i ming yang med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /phye myags sogs kyi mjug tu ya ma rā dza btags te sngags gzhung bzhin bsgral/ stob pa'i tshigs bcad kyi mjug tu/ e ka he dun gyi mthar/ ya ma me da k+ṣe rā tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya dza ni bhe wa sa twa dza ma ri hūṃ sarba 'bu pa ta ya pa ti ma hā me sa nas/ keng : ti'i bar sogs dkyus ltar byas nas/ bsgral mchod bum nang gi lha tshogs dang / las gshin thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bshags pa ni/ gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa brjod/ hūṃ/ bdag sogs ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang dang / /ma dag mi gtsang rdzas kyis 'bags/ /'phrin las nor 'khrul thams cad bshags/ /bzod par mdzod la las rnams kun/ /thogs med grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /bzhugs gsol ni/ nas nag gi me tog 'thor zhing / las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /'chi bdag rang gzugs dngos grub pa'i/ /drag po'i rten mchog 'di (14ba)nyid la/rtag tu bzhugs la las mdzod cig /su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ shis brjod ni/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /pad gnubs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /dngos grub ma lus thogs pa med stsol ba'i/ /yi dam tshe bdag nag po'i bkra shis shog /mthu stobs nus pas dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /las kyi gshin rje'i lha tshogs bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma yi/ /bde legs phun sum tsho gos pa'i bkra shis shog /'chi bdag zhal dbye'i drung du las kyi gshin rje bhe wa sa twa la mchod gtor las bcol gyi 'phrin las sngon chad thor bu'i tshul du bzhugs pa las khrigs su bsgrigs pa zhig mi 'jug pas/ mchod rten bcas chog sogs bzhugs pa'i sgrub khang du gal po cher mthong nas/ las kyi gshin rje'i 'phrin las 'chi bdag dgyes pa'i rkan sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/'jam dpal tshe bdag gi rna cha brgyad kyi nang tshan kha thun thod pa'i rna cha las ji ltar byung ba'i khrugs bsdebs kyi dpang por/ bod 'dir dang por mkhas pa gnubs dang dum pa rgya'i sras slob brgyud pa'i —536

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ma(khanasngags 'chang rim byon/ bar du mkhas pa mthu chen gangs pa shāka 'bum dang / gra phyi g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba'i phyag len la gzhi byas/ tha mar mkhas pa/ se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po'i gdams pa chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa mi nyag byang pa gter ston dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras kyi man ngag gi bang mdzod 'dzin pa rtsa ba'i bla ma zur chen pad+ma dbang gi zhal gyi (15na)bdud rtsi las legs par thos pa'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan/ mchod gtor byin rlabs dang nya bo sgrol ba'i bskul ring snang gsal ba rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog gis mdzad pa'i gshin rje khro chu dug sdong las blangs mngone rtogs/ dam sgrags/ mna' chu/ dam bzhag /nyer spyod/ sman raka /'phrin bcol/ bstod pa/ 'dzab dmigs/ bshags pa/ bzhugs gsol/ shis brjod rnams gsar du bsgrigs/ mkhyen dgongs dmod bcol lhug pa yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i lugs kyi mkhyen dgongs srog gi sbu gri dang gnubs ro zan nag po'i 'phrin yig las btus shing rang blos kyang cung zad bkang /gzhan ma'i tshigs bcad mtha' dag kha thun gyi yig rnying sor bzhag ste za hor gyi rigs las sngags pa nag po/ zil gnon drag po rtsal gyis gser 'phyang gi lo tor gyi zla ba bcu pa'i nyer dgu sngags pa zor bzlog sogs drag po'i las kyi dus dge bar dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal lo/ khu bha ma stu sa spru dza ga two/ /gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru yā mān+ta kā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung / /'jig rten mig gceg rnam snang lo tsā ba/ /drin can bla ma chos rgyal gter bdag gling / /byang chub bar du bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs/ /bod 'bangs dga' spror byed pa gnas kyi mchog /oṃ ḍi yā na'i gling mtshungs shel brag —537

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)nas/ /spyan drangs gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi/ /'phrin las mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs mo drod 'bar//bcos med rdo rje'i tshig rnams sor bzhag la//ma chad kha skong khrigs su nyer bsdebs pa'i//bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga//yid srubs bcom pa dpa' bo'i rtags su rdungs//de la 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi 'phrin las cung zad kha bkang ste bkod pa la/'jam dpal khros pa khro bo'i rgyal:gshin rje gshed la phyag btsal nas:de nyid sgrub pa'i las gzhung bstan:dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis:yid dang mthun pa'i gnas rnams su:ma rdal mda' gang gru bzhi pa:dri bzang 2na ) rak+ta'i chag chag gdab:ma rdal chos 'byung 'khor lo dang :mu khyud sgo sogs tshad ldan bri:de dbus malji khri'u'i khar mtshan ldan thod pa bdud rtsis bkang :ā dar+sha yi kha bkab steng : rin chen bum pa bcud ldan dang : dmigs rten 'jam dpal sku yang btsugs sman raka dam rdzas gtor ma dang :phyi nang tshogs mchod tshang bar bshams:de nas bde ba'i gdan la 'dug:sngon 'gro/dngos gzhi/rjes dang gsum/sngon 'gro la dang po/rgyun 'debs ni/gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rang rig kun tu bzang //mas dpe'i zlos gar bsgyur ba rdo rje lang //gsang chen bka' sdus lag na rdo rje la//gsol ba 'debs so dgra bgegs 'joms par shog/lam 'di'i bka' babs 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs//gshin rje'i rnal 'byor gtsug lag dpal dge dang / khrag 'thung nag po mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /gsol ba 'debs so dgra bgegs 'joms par shog shan+ti ga lha drag sngags gter gyi bdag/pad+ma thod phreng dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang /ye 2ba/zhes 'tsho rgyal gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /gsol ba 'debs sodagra bgegs 'joms par shog/be+e ro tsa na don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta//zab gsang bstan pa rgyas mdzad gter bdag gling //bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la//gsol ba 'debs so dgra bgegs 'joms par shog/rdo rje slob dpon mchog gis nyer bzung nas//dkyil 'khor wo por dbang gis legs smin cing //'jam dpal zhi khro'i snang stong lha yi sku//phra rags bskyed rim nya/sa su longs par shog/lha sngags ye shes zung du

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ma(kha)'jug pa yi/ /bsnyen sgrub sgrub pa chen po mthar phyin te/ /srung bzlog bsad pa mnan sreg 'phang ba sogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams ba par shog /mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje dang / /de 'dul gnyen por bcas kun rang rig rtsal/ /don gyi 'jam dpal rang ngo nyer 'phrod pa'i/ /rdzogs chen lam gyis tshe 'dir grol gyur cig /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar bslu med skyabs gnas thams cad la: sgo gsum dang bas skyabs su mchi: gsum pa sems bskyed ni/ rang rig rang ngo ma shes pa'i ma rig 'byul pa'i sems can kun bde chen sal 'grod bya'i phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: bzhi pa yan lag bcu pa ni/ tre rat+na maṇ+ḍa la/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi spyi bor rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ bde gshegs sras bcas(3na thad ga la dgongs su gsol/ /sgo gsum dang bas rab tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /zag med kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchode/ mi dge'i lam zhugs sdig sgrib nongs pa bshags/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rang / /bla med chos 'khor bskor zhing bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag g.yin dge tshogs byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /'khor ba yongs dag chos dbyings thob par shog /cesapa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bcus/ /tshogs bsag tshogs zhing rang la bstim zhes pa'i don no/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs rnams la/ /lan chags bsngo zhing 'di ltar bsgo/ /zhes pa'i don ltar/ lnga pa lan chags bgegs gtor ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dpal gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad pa dur khrod kyi chas dang gar dgu'i nyams can ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ hūṃ/ sa phyogs 'dir gnas bgegasadang 'byung po'i tshogs 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di long la: phan bde'i bsam pas rang rang gnas su song : gal te mi 'gro bsam sbyor ngan pa yis mi mthun bar gcod 'bras bu 'byin gyur —539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)na: bdag nyid 'jam dpal khros pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ khyod rnams brlag cing bsreg par gdon mi za: de bas bka' las ma 'da' phyir dengs shig nai ma hā krodha sarba bhu ta ya byu ྅ bzhi'i sngags brjod rol mo sgrog: drug pa mtshams cad srung 'khor ni: lha/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed:thugs srog hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las:(3ba)phyogs mtshams 'khor lo rtsibs bcu 'bar rtsibs steng dpal chen khro bo bcu: bsrung bzlog 'phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir:rno dbal mtshon cha lnga yi gur bsra brtan mi shigs ra bas bskor: sprul pa'i khro tsho gos glog ltar 'byug: ye shes me lte kun tu 'bar bgegs dang 'byung po rdul du rlog nai ma hā kro dha rak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ hūṃ phaṭa: bdun pa bshags pa ni/ tre rat+na maṇ+ḍal/paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza: ྅/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa khyab pa'i sku/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /dregs pa 'joms byed thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ khro gtum thugs rje can la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /ro langs rgyal mo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/dbyings ldan chags med yum la bzod par gsol/ /rang rig ye shes klong du ma gyur cing / /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ma phyin pas/ /'khor gyi gshin rje pho mo'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ /bstan srung so so'i sku la bzod par gsol/ /don dam ngang la dge sdig gnyis med kyang / /de ltar ma rtogs gzung 'dzin dbang gis na/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /gnong 'gyod mos pa'i sems kyas mthal lo bshags/ /thog med nas bsags rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams chags nyes lhung ma lus rnams/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun la bzod par gsol/ /'joms byed thugs dam bzhin du spyad par bgyi/ yig brgya brjod/ brgyad pa/ byin 'bebs ni/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid che/ /drag po las kyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /chos dbyings drag (4na)po e yi gzhal yas nas/ /dregs pa 'joms byed yab yum sprul pa gsum/ /spyi mgrin snying lter gnas pa'i —540

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ma(khanagashed po bzhi/ /rgod stag gang spyang gdong can sgo ba bzhi/ drag po'i las mdzad pho nya dam can tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis byin phob cig /bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar ba la/ /re zhig dpung gnyen gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la brtser dgongs las/ /byin tshan myur du dbab pa'i dus la bab/ /'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /sngags tshig shugs pa brda yis spyan 'dren na/ /mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ sgrub rjes dam pa 'di la mthu stsol cig /drag po'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /bdag cag re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /dgu pa phyi nang gi mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ phud snod la thim pas snod kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/ ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gnas pa'i steng du hūṃ dkar po de'i 'od zer gyis phyi 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi bkug /bdud rtsi la thim pas dngos 'dzin sbyangs nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa lta bur gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥlha ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥb/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis rak+ta'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs/ bhan+ta ka pā la rje/ snod nga yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud (4ba)pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la ra dmar po/ de las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'brug cing 'phyo ba'i steng du yi ge ra dmar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ de las 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus rak+ta'i ngo bo bdud rtsi'i ro mchog brgyad dang ldan pa zegs ma la 'dod yon gyi lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phro bar gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥlha ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ/bdag gi thugs ga nas raṃ yaṃ kho gis gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs te snod a las bhan+ta'i nang du bcud ā+oṃ āḥ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon drug gi lha mor gyur/ ā+oṃ bha kla ta te dzo bha lo ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye swāhā/ de yang gsum pa mchod pa'i yo byad rnams/ sngags rgyas nam mkha' gang bar spel zhes pa'i don gong 'og mtha' dag la sbyar nas/ hūṃ/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang —54/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar bsam: o badz+ra puṅge hūṃ pe ā lo ge: gharnyeḥ ni we skye: shasta rū pa: sha lta/ me/ ra sa spar+sha: dharma dha lco ga na pañca rak+ta: ba kla ta ma hā pā dza āḥlha hri la sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim mo: swā mā yu:dngos gzhi'i dang po bskyed rim ni: // chos kun gdod nas spros bral kyang : 'gag med rang mdangs snying rjer shar de las rang rig yi ge :: ྅ las rim brtsegs 'byung lnga'i steng : dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas khang : mtshan nyid kun tshang lte ba sa dregs pa chu glang pad nyi'i steng : rang rig hūṃ las gshin rje'i gshed: mthing nag dug chen ha la'i mdog: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa:g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing (ldan tshe skal: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dmar 'khrug:'khor lo ral gri gri gug g.yas: thod khrag be con sdigs mdzub g.yon: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: gnyis med yum mchog pe ta nag gri thod 'dzin zhing yab dang 'khril: spyi bor sprul pa'i bya khyung mthing : sbu gri sgro gnag klu gdon 'dul: bdag gi sku yi cha kun nas: sprul pa'i khro tshogs grangs med 'gyed ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: zla gam gsum la ro yi steng : tshe bdag nag po gri zhags 'dzin: srog bdag dmar po be con gri 'chi bdag dud kha khram snying 'dzin: kun kyang dur khrod chas can no: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: shar du ya ma ra tsa mthing : g.yas g.yon ral gri thod khrag 'dzin: lho ru myos byed 'bar ba ser: g.yas pa be con g.yon 'khor lo: nub tu ar+ya ma ru dmar rtse gsum g.yas la mi snying g.yon: byang du ral pa tshar dgu ljang : thod dbyug 'khor lo g.yas dang g.yon:kun kyang rang rang yum dang 'khril: dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brgyan: sgo bzhir bya rgod stag dang ga: spyang gdong rnam bzhi lcags kyu dang : zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi bsrung : g.yin yang 'jigs byed gshin rje'i 'khor: sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bcas: grangs med sprin gtibs ltar gsal ba'i gtso 'khor kun gyi gnas gsum du: 'bru gsum 'od zer 'bar ba las: 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' tshogs: rang bzhin gnas nas sa mā dza: gnyis pa spyan —542

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ma(khana'adren ni: sna tshogs (5ba)rol mo'i sgrar bcas te: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis spyan 'dren pa: ྅/ 'og min lhun rje gas chos dbyings pho brang nas sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam dpal dbyangs: bde chen zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : log 'dren gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: mi bzad drag por khros pa khro bo'i rgyal bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dad pa dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na thugs rje che ldan gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gcig las du ma'i tshul du rang shar ba'i gnyis med yum mchog za byed pe ta dang : sku gsung thugs sprul gshed chen rnam bzhi sogs: 'jigs byed gshin rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis brtser dgongs la: nad gdon bar chad bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: tshe dang bsod nams spel phyir gshegs su gsol: khams gsum dbang du sdud phyir gshegs su gsol: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: zho mañja shrī ya man+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dza:gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: ྅/ dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir: dregs pa chu glang ma he'i steng : khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: 'khor bcas dgyes par bzhugs su gsol:dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan bzhi pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni: rang rig gdod nas 'jam dpal lhar: dmigs byas dbang bskur dang bral kyang : log rtog snying rje bsgral ba'i phyir khro rgyal nus mthus rang dbang bskur: chu hūṃ swā āḥlha sa bhi ṇiñca mi: dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag (6na)pos brgyan lnga pa gus pas phyag 'tshal ba: thal sbyar dang ba'i sems kyis ni: ྅/ lha yi lha mchog bcom ldan 'das: gshin rje gshed po khro bo'i rgyal gtso 'khor sprul par bcas rnams la: rab gus dungs pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pā ho: pra ti tsa ho: drug pa mchod pa'i las rim ni kli/ dngos bshams yid las rnam sprul ba'i me tog gdug spos mar me dri zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga:kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bur dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul tsha badz+ra phre dhū pe ā lo ke: nga ni we skye shasta rū pa shastaḥ ༷ ra sa:—543

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)spar+sha: gu dza ho: ྅/ gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi dbang po lnga dang tshil chen gsur: zhun chen mar me 'khrigs pa'i dri sha rus zhal zas thod rnga sogs dur khrod nang gi mchod pa 'di 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: ma hā ma sa rak+ta ke ni ri ti ba su ta ma hā pañja pā dzaḥho ྅/ snang stong thabs shes sbyor ba las: bde chen byang chub sems kyi chu smra med bde ba'i gsang mchod 'di:'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: sto dhi tsit+ta ga na gu ya pā dzaḥho 'chi med bdud rtsi a skṛ ta rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i khyad par med byung bdud rtsi 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ ji sti chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje 'chang : gsang ba'i bdag po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /gtsug lag dpal dge khrag 'thung nag po la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañca a mṛ ta la (6ba)kha raṃ khā hi/ shan+ti gar+bha rigs 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /jo mo 'tsho rgyal gan jag thang ta dang / /gter bdag gling pa rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ dregs pa 'joms byed yum chen pe ta li/ /gshed chen bzhi dang sgo bsrung gshin rje'i tshogs/ /las kyi gshin rje gter srung rdor legs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañca a skṛ ta la kha raṃ ji hi/ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje sogs brjod/ lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+ta'i nang : dmar chen rak+ta rgya mtshor bskyil: nyon mongs 'khor ba 'joms pa'i phyir: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: ྅/ stong gsum zhing gi gtor gzhong du: bcud kyi 'gro drug gtor mar sbyar: mdzes pa'i dkar dmar rgyan gyis brgyan: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul ma hā ba sla ta kha raṃ ji hi: āḥgadod nas rang rig lha ru dag: mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul kun: mi dmigs spros bral phyag rgya che: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul ma hā mu tra dharma khyu tu pu dza sto bdun pa bstod pa bya ba ni: ྅/ gdod nas spros bral mi dmigs chos kyi sku: rang mdangs 'gag med sna tshogs longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje rab khros khro rgyal sprul pa'i sku: gang 'dul der ston dpal la phyag 'tshal —544

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ma(khanabastod mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa las: bdud 'dul khro rgyal mchog gi skur bstan nas:thugs rje'i gzi ldan gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul: bcom ldan gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod:gtum chen rab 'bar nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi dkar mthing dmar ba'i dbu gsum rngams ba 'ad khro:phyag drug gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin: zhabs bzhi'i gar gyis bdud tshogs phye mar 'thag:dpal dang dur khrod drag po'i chas kyis brgyan:(7na)gar gyi nyams dgu mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs:rab brjid gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye med dbyings las 'gag med ltar snang ba:dbyings dang ye shes rig rtsal las shar ba'i: gnyis med sbyor sgrol yum dang mkha' lding khyung : sku gsum thugs sprul tshe 'chi srog bdag gsum/ /'jigs byed gshin rje chen po rnam bzhi sogs: 'khor bcas dam tshig can gyi lhag pa'i lha: gdul bya'i bsam pa yongs su skong ba'i mdzod: rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i pho nya ba dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i srog gi gshed: 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: brgyad pa bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa ni: dang po rlung las bslab bya ste:rngubs pa ā+oṃ la gnas pa ā: 'byin pa hūṃ la sbyar te bzla bdag gi thugs gar 'khor lo'i dbus:'jam dpal dmar ser pod ral 'dzin: rin chen rgyan mdzes thugs ga'i dbus: nyi steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa: lte bar hūṃ mthing mtshan pa'i mthar: sngags 'phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od 'phros 'phags mchod mthu dbang bsdus: sems can sgrib sbyangs dgra bgegs bsgral: snod bcud yon tan dngas ma kun: 'od zer rnam par bdag la bstim/ ā+oṃ mañju shrī ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa: 'di ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ste:'bum tsho gcig tu bzla bar bya: rlu hri ṣi ṭi bi ṭi tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: 'di ni nye bar bsnyen pa ste: sum 'bum ngag tu bzla bar bya: e a kro te ka ya man+ta ka kā la rū pa sri nyi a pa ye ma ma kro ti shwa ri sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa tshwa ya ma ra tsa sa to me ya ya me do ru ṇa yod ya ya da yo ni ra (7ba〉snye ya yak+ṣi ya tsha ni ra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa: 'di ni sgrub pa'i rtsa sngags te: bdun 'bum nyi khri rtags dang sbyar las sbyor sngags kyi sham bu ni: rig pa'i mda' dang bstun te sbyar: mthun mthar 'dzab bskul dngos grub blang : zhes pa'i —545

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dgu pa 'dzab bskul ni: e dregs pa 'joms byed chos kyi dbyings kyi gsung zhes sogs/ 'dzab bstod zor gyi 'phrin las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda' nas len/ brgya pa dngos grub blang ba ni/hūṃ/ dgongs shig bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lha bdag cag rdo rje mched lcam gyi bskyed rim gsal zhing bsnyen sgrub thems: 'phrin las sbyor ba mtha' ru phyin: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ka ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hūṃ/ sgrub pa dngos gzhi'i las rim mo: sa ma ya: dngos grub len pa rgyas par spro na e bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku zhes sogs zor gyi 'phrin las nas len/ las gshin dang gter bsrung mchod pa ni/ dngos gzhi dang mjug gang du byas kyang khyad med pa skabs 'dir bkod pa la/ gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo: las byed bka' srung gshin rje nyid sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bstan: rang nyid gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i mdun du pad nyi dang dgra bgegs ma he ser nag gi steng du: ya smug nag las las kyi gshin rje gshed po sku mdog smug nag khro bo'i chas can rngams shing 'jigs pa: phyag g.yas thod dbyug dang : g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa 'khor gshin rje bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba de'i gnas gsum du ā+oṃ āḥ& dang : bdag bskyed kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ (8na7sa 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas nas 'khor bcas spyan drangs: :/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi: 'jigs su rung ba mun pa'i klong : dregs pa kun gyi bshan khang nas: las byed gshin rje 'khor dang bcas: bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na dgra geb gas 'dul phyir gnas 'dir spyon: e ya ma ra dza sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ sngo sam ya rak+ṣa ti la snro zhes spyan drangs te dam la bzhag: ྅/ las mdzad gshin rje 'khor bcas la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi: dmar chen khrag dang dbang po lnga: tshil chen gsur dud zhun chen me:mkhris chen bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma sogs: 'dod yon longs spyod bsam mi khyab: bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na: bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: ma hā pā dza bha lo ta ji hi: rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros pas: las gshin gyi thugs gar 'khor —546

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ra (kha)thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar rngo la rtswa ya ma ra dza sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces bzlas pa bya: // khrag 'thung spa/den rje gshed po yi: bka' nyan 'jigs byed ma rung pa khams gsum skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag:rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu dang ldan bstan pa bsrung mdzad dam tshig can: nyams pa sgrol ba'i gshed po che/dge sdig shan 'byed dpang po mdzad: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i pho nya ba: las mdzad nag po khyod la bstod:khyod kyi nus pa klog ltar 'byug: shugs nam mkha'i thog las che: drag rtsal ri rab klad la bskor:rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ci yang bsgyur: sha khrag (8ba)gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab sdang ba'i dgra bo sod la shog: bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog: legs pa'i bya ba shol la shog: nyes pa'i bya ba bskul la shog: gnam gyi la ju thag chod la shog: sa yi rten phur phyungs la shog /gdug pa'i dpung tsho gos 'joms par mdzod ces bstod cing bskul lo: sam ya: rgya rgya rgya: lasakyi gshin rje gshed po'i 'phrin las kyi cho ga rdzogs so: 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i lcags rir re/ga pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal gyis yar klungs shel phug gi byang 'dabs rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i brag gi ngos nas spyan drangs/ /gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo: zab mo'i gter 'di btan byas nas: 'chad spel nyams len byed pa'i tshe: gter bdag mchod pa ma bzung na: rnal 'byor srog la hur thums khrung :de phyir 'di la brtson par bya: gtor ma sha khrag phud kyis bran: 'bru gsum sngags kyis bdud rtsir spel: ྅/ slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi bka' nyan zab mo gter gyi bdag: dgra lha'i rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can dam can skyes bu thig le rtsal bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: bstan pa bsrung phyir gnas 'dir spyon: tri badz+ra sa du sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥlha baṃ ho: ྅/ stong gsum nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i:phyi nang gsang dang de kho na: sman raka bha skru gtor ma sogs: mkho dgu'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab:dam can 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dgyes par rol la 'phrin las mdzod: ma hā pañca bha dzi ta ji hi: ྅/ skye med dbyings las bstan bsrung phyir: snying rjes bzhengs pa'i dam tshig can: dmar (9na)skrug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dar dmar ber gsol khro chas can: phyag g.yas rdo rjes dgra dpung —547

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyon3joms:g.yon pa dam nyams tsit+ta bsnams:chibs su stobs ldan seng ge chibs:mched 'khor sum brgya drug cus bskor:bstan pa'i bka' srung mthu stobs can:'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod:dam rdzas mchode pa 'di bzhes la:dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa srungs:gdug pa'i dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol:bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya:kha tham pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal rgyas yar klungs shel phug gi byang 'dabs rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i brag gi ngos nas spyan drangs pa'o//mjug gi cho ga la/kha skongs tshogos kyi longs spyod ni:bza' dang btung ba'i longs spyod rnams:tshang zhing legs bshams byin rlabs ni:྅/bdag nyid 'jam dpal thugs ka nas:re yaṃ kho 'phros tshogs rdzas kyi:dngos 'dzin nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus:slar yang snying po 'bru gsum 'phros gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs:tshogs rdzas 'dod yon bdud rtsir byas tshwa āḥ& ho:zhes brlabs tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa:྅/chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang mchog drag po e yi gzhal yas nas:bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed:sras yum sprul 'khor bcas pa rnams:ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren nas:dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol:badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ& baṃ ho cha gsum bcad de phud du 'bul bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs:ma tshang 9ba ) med pa'i 'dod yon rdzas/kha dog dri ro bcud ldan pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di:'jam dpal gshin rje'i tsho gos la 'bul:bzhes nas kun tu dgyes par mdzod:i kro dha ra dza ya man+ta ka ga na tsakra hūṃ dzaḥji sti bar pas bkang zhing bshags pa bya/hūṃ/'dod yon tsho gos kyi longs spyod dang :srid zhi'i mar rdzas sna tsho gis kyis:khro rgyal 'khor yosathugs dam bkang :stongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:bdag cag mi dge 'khrul pa'i blos bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams pa yis:khyod kyi thugs dang ci 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags so tshangs par gsol:tha ma bsgral zhang btab pa bya:྅/gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes la slo bur bdag lta'i zhing bcu dgra:ye shes rno dbal mtshon cha yis:skye med chos sku'i klong du bsgral:: ti sha hūṃ mā ra ya rbad:hūṃ/ dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khraX rus: srid gsum zhing kun gang ba'i longs spyod

gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ nang ma(khana'adi sku gsum rol pa khrag 'thung zhal du stob khams gsum yongs sgrol dngos grub stsal du gsol:me sa rak+ta ke ni ri ti pā dza ho: de nas 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor rnams: gtsang dme'i rtog pa tshar bcad nas: rim gnyis ldan pas longs spyod rol: lhag bsdus phud bshal kha chus nan: 'dod yon bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs rtswa āḥ& ha ho hri kli/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: bka' nyan lhag mar dbang ba'i 'khor: mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging laṅka: 'bar ma ma sring sha za dang : lha srin sdebargyad dregs par bcas: kun kyang mi mthun gdug pa can: sha la dga' zhing khrag (10na〉la mos: stong gsum bskor zhing dur khrod myul: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mdzad: dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed ma byed 'dir spyon 'dod yon lhag gtor bzhes: dgra bgegs zhing bcu cham la phob: bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod: o.u tsin+t+ra ba li ta kha raṃ khā 〉 de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: ྅/ chosakyi dbyings nas drag po'i skur: gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i lha: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mi mngon dbyings nas thugs dam bskul/ gnyis med yum dang sprul pa gsum: gshed chen bzhi dang phyogs skyob bcu: 'jam dpal bka' nyan sprul 'khor bcas: thugs dam bskul lo 'phrin las mdzod: de nas chad mtho bsgrags pa ni: ྅/ sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga sa rjes 'jug rnal 'byor skyong ba dang : bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas 'dir spyon dam rdzas gtor ma long : khas blangs ma g.yel 'phrin las mdzod: chad mtho rgyas pa zor gyi 'phrin las nas len: de nas bstan ma skyong ba ni: lha/ bod yul skyong bar mdzad pa mo bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: 'dir spyon gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhes sngon tshe pad+ma thod 'phreng gi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ltar: gangs can ljongs 'dir dus 'khrug dang : mi mthun nad mug kun zhi nas: rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa dang : theg mchog bstan pa rgyas par mdzod pañca nga lin+ta 'a snyi gtor gzheng mnan zhing rta bro brdung : / stong gsum 'jig (10ba)rten gzhal yas khang : kun kyang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: thabs mchog rkang g.yas bro —549

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)brdungs pas: pho sri thams cad g.yas su mnan: shes rab g.yon gyi bro brdungs pas mo sri thams cad g.yon du mnan: ga lhas su med par bro brdungs pas: chung sri dam sri dbyings su mnan: drag po'i gar gyi bro brdungs pas: dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du lhogs: 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bro brdungs pas: las bzhi myur du 'grub bar shog: sarba sha hūṃ a mu /mā ra ya rbad nan shan+ti: ga bā shrīḥ mā ra ya rbad: ྅/ rang rig ye nas 'jam mgon ltar: gshegs bya gshegs byed dngos pos stong / /'on kyang snang tshul ye shes pa: skye med klong du badz+ra mu: ye shes gshegs shing dam tshig bsdu shis pa brjod cing smon lam gdab/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sa ma ya zhes pa'i shis brjod ni/ /rang bzhin chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /gzhugs sku'i rnam rol dpag yas kyi/ /rlabs chen 'phrin las skyong mdzad pa'i/ /brgyud gsum bla ma'i bkra shis shog /ma 'gags rang gsal 'od lnga'i klong / /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rnam par mdzes/ /mchog mthun dngos grub stsol ba'i lha/ /yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i gnas yul 'a sprul pa' zhing / /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rol gar mkhan/ /mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bkra shis bde legs stsal du gsol/ /bsngo smon ni/ dbyer med gcig 'dus rdo rje'i mched lcam gyis/ /rmad byung dmigs byas dmigs med dge ba'i mthus/khams gsum sems can bde zhing skyid pa (11na)dang / /zag bcas yul snang rdo rje'i skur byang nas/ /'pho med chos kyi dbyings mchog thob par shog /'jam dpal sgrub pa'i las kyi gzhung : 'di ni 'jig rten gsum du dkon: de phyir gsang ba'i rgya yis thob: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i mgon du spos: bka' 'di mthu ldan gsum gyis srungs: sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya: 'di kho na'o: pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal gyis yar klungs shel phug gi byang 'dabs rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i brag gi ngos nas spyan drangs pa'o/ /de ltar 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i dgra /mi bsrun dregs pa 'joms byed rdo rje'i thog /phyon bla ma'i thugs kyi nying khu'i bcud/ /lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i zhal gyi lung / /bod 'bangs nyes kun las skyob sra pa'i go /phan bde'i 'dod pa 'jo ba dpag bsam shing / /rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa'i brnog po'i chos/ /yid srubs las rgyal —550

sbyin sreg gi sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig la/ nang ma(khanatshangs pa'i rnga chen yin/ /de ko blo gsal mang por phan 'dod kyi/ /rab dkar dang bas bskrun pa'i dge ba'i 'bras/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'jam dpal rdo rje yis/ /bshes mdzad lus can rnams kyi mgon gyur cig /ces chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gter gsar 'jam dpal gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed 'di lung bstan dus babs bzhin rang gzhan gyi bde skyid spel ba'i slad du rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi chog grar btsugs skabs las byang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba tshangs pa'i rnga chen 'di ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas gter gzhung dngos rnams chad lhag med pa rang sor bzhag /cung zad snon dgos pa rigs 'dzin thugs thig dang 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang nas 'brel mtshungs kha bkang mtshams sbyor phran bu rang blos bsnan te rigs 'dzin (11ba)pad+ma yab yum gyis rdo rje thogs med rtsal du ming btags shing chos bdag tu rlom pa za hor gyi brnyes chu glang nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid do// // sarba maṅga lo/ /sbyin sreg gi sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig bzhugs/rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa rnams/ /gcig bsdus dngos brgyud bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rin chen bang mdzod kyi/ /sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig 'di na'o/ /zhi ba'i skabs/ sa gter/ mu tig /dngul rnams gos dkar po dri ma med pas gril/ skud pa dkar pos bcings/ yun ring por 'jog na mi rul ba'i phyir ga'u sogs kyi nang du gzhug /sa 'khor gyi lte bar —551—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)pad 'dab bri ba'i mu khyud kyi sar rtse sor gnyis tsam mam/ gang 'tsham zhes rig pas gzhal nas bskor/pad+ma'i nang du nyi gdan dmar ser/ tshon gzhan rnams mdzes tshon/ rdo rje thams cad dkar po/ thab kyi rgyu/ ba lang rtogatsang ma za ba'i lci ba la tsan dan dkar po bsres pa'i sa dkar gyis mdog dkar por bsgyur/ phyi mchod lnga la me tog dkar po dngos sam bcos ma tsan dan dkar po/ /a ka sa si ha na ka /ga bur rnams sbyar ba'i spos/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ chu gtsang la tsan dan dkar po btab pa'i dri chab/'o ma dang zho/ mar khu rnams kyis khu ba byas pa la sbrang / bu ram/ phye (2na)btab pa'i zhal zas/'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma/ so rtsi/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma rnams kyang rgyu de ga'o/ /chu bzhi/ chu gtsang la 'o ma dang tsan dan dkar po btab cing / khyad par mchod yon la me tog dkar po'i phye ma 'debs/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i mar gsar pa bzhu ba'i khu ba dang / yam shing yang kha dog dkar por byed/ 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi bsres pa'i khu ba la du bo'i phye ma btab pa'i rdzas kyis sreg rdzas thams cad la sbags/ rdzas khyad par ba zho 'o ma/ mar khu gsum gyis khu ba byas/ gzhan rnams zhib par btags te g.yos pa'i ril bu ji ltar 'tsham pa dril/ gos zungs kha dog dkar po/ mchod yon gyi snod nya phyis sam dung chos/ gzhan chu gsum dang mchod rdzas rnams bsham pa'i snod dngul dang / shel/ dung sogs dkar po'i snod ci 'byor/ slob dpon dang thabs bar du pha gu mtho dma' 'tsham par brtsigs pa'i mdun ngos su gangs ri'i dbyibs dang waṃ yig bri/ slob dpon gyi g.yas ngos su sreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i go rim bzhin bsgrigs pa'i nang du 'das gtor/ nang mchod/ nyer spyod lnga dang bcas pa (2ba)bsham/ de'i nang du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ nyer spyod rnams kyang bsgrigs pa'i mthar yul lha gzhi bdag gi gtor ma/ chu bzhi ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun ma gtogs/ phyogs gzhan gsum gang nasabasham kyang 'dra/ rlung g.yab sngon po rlung gi dbyibs dang sa bon bris pa/ ku sha slob dpon gyi kha gang du bstan pa la shar du sa byas pa' rtse mo nub dang rtsa ba shar/ de bzhin du rtse mo lho/ shar/ byang rnams su yong ba byas pa'i g.yas su bskor bas snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma'i rtsa ba gnon no/ /ku sha rtse rnams —552

sbyin sreg gi sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig la/ nang ma(kha)phyogs gcig tu bsdus shing rtsa ba cung zad khram par byas pa'i rtse nub tu bstan nas g.yog go /sreg rdzas gang du 'bul ba ni/ mar khu dang 'bru sogs zhal/ yam shing 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/ ku sha gdan/zhal bsil phyag /dri thugs ka /me tog dbu/ zhabs bsil zhabs/ gos zungs na bza' rin po che'i rgyan/ mar me dang mchod yon mdun du 'bul/ sreg rdzas grangs mang nyung gi khyad par gtso bo la nyer gcig phul na/ 'khor dang me lha la bdun 'bul pa lta bu rig pas mtshon/ rgyas pa'i skabs/ sbru byed kyi rdzas gcig ghi lha dang ga bur/ stegs bu'i sa ser po/ gter gser dang spos shel/ sgril chas dang /skud pa'ang ser po/ sa 'khor gyi lte bar pad 'dab 'dri ba'i rtse sor gnyis po dgos shing / mu khyud zlum po thams cad gru bzhir gtong / rdo rje dang rin po che rnams ser por bsgyur thabs kyi rgyu 'om bu lta bu la gur kum/ ghi lha/ ga bur gsum dang sbyar ba'i sa ser po byugs/ me rtag ser po tsam ma gtogs mchod pa rnams zhi ba dang 'dra/ chu bzhi la til/ gro/ 'bras/(3na)gur kum/ ghi nya rnams kyi phye ma 'debs/ snod gser sogs ser por bya/ spru byed kyi rdzas gsum gyis sreg rdzas sogs spags te so sor bsgyur/ dbang la spru byed kyi rdzas tsha ba gsum dang tsan dan dmar po/ /stegs bu'i sa dmar gter mtshal zangs/ byu sa k+ṣi lha/ sa thig gi zlum po rnams zla gam du btang ba'i bcad kha rang dang sgal 'bur phyir ston/ mchod pa la me tog dmar po/ gu gul/ rgya tshos/ tsan dan dmar po'i spos/ til mar gyi mar me/ tsan dan dmar po/ ghi lha/ gur kum btab pa'i dri chab/ zhal zas dang gtor ma gong dang 'dra/ gos zungs dmar po/ chu bzhi la/ ghi lha/ gur kum/ tsan dan dmar po/ me tog dmar po/'bras yos 'debs/ tsan dan dmar po/ rgya skyegs/ tsha ba gsum gyis sreg rdzas rnams spags te dmar por bsgyur/ snod rnams zangs sogs dmar por bya'o/ /drag po la/ stegs bu'i rdzas/ dur khrod dang / lam bzhi mdo dang / shing gcig dang / chu 'gram dang / mtshan ma gcig pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgo drung gi sa rnams/ 'byug byed kyi rdzas dug khrag /ro sol/ bong bu dang / rnga mo'i sbangs/ sa'abor gyi logs thig tshun bzo dbyibs zhi ba dang 'dra/ rdo rje rnams sngon po/ dbus kyi rdo rje la gyes pa/—353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)de'i phyi rol hom khung kha khyer thod ra me ri can/ tsher ma can nam ro bsregs pa'i mgal rdum gyi shing la brtsigs pa'i thab (3ba/bung la dug khrag /skye tshe/ tsha ba gsum dang / ro sol snag tsha sogs kyis nag por byugs/ mi'i tshil dang til mar bsres pa'i mar nag /khrag dang chang bsres pa'i bsang gtor/khrag gi zhal bsil/ khrag chang la 'bras yos dang me rtag sngon po btab pa'i mchod yon/ chang gi zhabs bsil/ khrag gi a lha/ dbang po'i me tog dang dug gi me tog /gu gul/ sha chen/ tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ mi dang ma he g.yag sogs kyi rkang bzhu ba'i mar me/ gdan bcu drug la sogs pa'i sha khrag dang nang khrol brtsigs pa'i zhal zas/ gos zungs nag po khrag gis spags pa/ rdzas khyad par ba lan tshwa dang / nim pa'i lo ma/ khyim bya'i tshil dang tsher ma/ gzhan gzhung du gsal ba rnams/ khrag chang gi khu ba dang / gzhan rnams phye mar btab pa'i ril bu bya/ 'bru nag dar btags la sha khrag bsres pa'i gtso bo dang las gshin gyi gtor ma dang so rtsi/ snod thod pa/ rdza/ gyo dum/ lcags sogs gang 'byor/liṅka'i rgyu 'bru nag sna tshogs kyi phye/ dug sna/ tsha ba gsum/ skye tshe/ bong bu'i spangs/ tsher ma/ mi rus/dgra bo'i zag pa rnams dgos/ gdan rab g.yang gzhi/ tha ma'ang dud 'gro'i ko ba rlon pa/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma dkar po rin po che'i snod du bsham/ mchod rdzas rnams 'jam po gsum las go ldog ste g.yon ngos su bsgrig /gser skyems/ phur pa/ sgrol gri /phyag mtshan skam rlon gyi thun rnams g.yas ngos su bsham/ ku sha 'gram pa ni/ (4na)rang gang du blta ba lhor byas pa'i rtse mo lho/ shar/byang / nub/ las bzhi ga'i stegs bu ni dbyibs gru bzhi kho na yin/ me ro sod par shar na/ so so'i rdzas khyad par bas sbags pa'i 'jam po gsum la chu dang / drag po la khrag chang gis bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos so// // sarba maṅga lo// //—554

rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dngos grub nyin mor byed pa zhes bya ba/ nang ma(khanargyas pa'i sbyin sreg dngos grub nyin mor byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mchog thun dngos grub nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rnam par rgyas byed bla ma gshin rje gshed/ /zhabs pad yan lag mchog gis btud byas nas/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg lag len 'di na 'dri/ /tsan dan dkar po ga bur dngos gzhi zhi ba dang 'dra spul/ sbru byed kyi rdzas khyad par bgur kum sogs dang / chus/ /sbrus pa'i sa dkar ser/sa stegs nang gter gter yang de ga'i lugs kyi man ngag bzhin bya'o/ /gzhug /thab khung gru bzhi rgyar byang ngos su brtsigs/ dpangs re'i byed/ khru do/ /sa 'khor sor mo klu thig sogs sngar dang 'dra bal dbyabs kyi sgo nas khyad par dbye/yi grangs/ /lan gnyis rig byed grangs gcig gi /lte ba mu ran kha logs thig mdzes pa'i man ngag go /khyer 'grub/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab de steng nyi dkyil/ brgyad pa/ /lta bar rin chen mdog dbyibs ma na ngag dang bas/rdo rjes mtshan/ kha khyar rin chen 'phreng bas bskor/ /yam srid du khru gang / sbom phra mthe bong gi 3/ bzo dbyibasagru bzhi/ kha dog ser por byed pa man nga gsho mang sreg rdzas mchod rdzas sogs/ /kun kyang ma tshang med par gser sogs kyi snod du/ bsham/ /'god tshul rdzas chen bcu gnyis kyi steng du/ 'bras chen/ zho/ mngar gsum/ sbrang rtsi/ til nag /pad+ma ge sar dang / nā ga ge sar rdzas khyad par ba/ chu bzhi la thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas bzhi man bag ltar 'debs shing / snod gos zungs ser po sogs mchod pa'i rdzas dang mdog dbyibs zhi ba dang mi 'dra ba rnams man ngag ltar bya'o/ /zhi ba ji bzhin no/ /(2na)rdo rje ni thabs dang / zhes ser mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum zhes bsgyur/ pa nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab ser po gru bzhi pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / kha khyer la rin po che gyen du bsgreng bas bskor ba/grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rin po ches mtshan pa'i lte bar/ rdo rje gyen du bsgreng bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ zhes raṃ dkar po ser por bsgyur/ rgyan dang na bza' ser po ra ser po/rdo rje'i rnam pa ༅ ser po zhes par 'don pa bsgyur dgos so/ /pa nas/ me lha bcu gnyis kyi nang nas dbang chen ser po ser mthing dkar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /zhes pa nas/ dgang blugs kyi kha la ya yig —555
