rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ me lha'i sngags la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal 'byor gzi brjid dang / sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dang / khyad par sku gsung thugs kyi rten 2ba 'di dag gi rnam par dkar pa'i mdzad pa 'phrin las/mchod pa'i sgrin tsho gos thams cad pusti dgang snugs bon na mas kha/ku ru oṃ/oṃ bo dhi brik+ta ya gzhan zha ba'i skabs dang 'dra ba la/spel tshig sngon du byung ma thag pa deg ma gtags ma bsgyur ba legs zhes bdag ga bla ma gsungs/āḥ//zhes pa nas/zhal bsil dang bsang gtor yan phul/las sngags kyis bsangs/me lha'i thugs sgar/zhes pa nas/ces pa'i sku mdog ser po'i gzi 'od ces pa dang /'od zer ser po'i gas zhes dang /rdo rje'i rnam pa ༅ ser po zhes pa dang /lha snye'i mthug tu bdag cag dpon slob nas snyo ku ru lta gyi bar sbyor bdang /khreg rdzas rnams tsol pho spel tshig kyang /gtso lha sgo mas dgal de ga smi sbyor mu bya'o//bar snga ma ltar bya'o//lha rnams kyi thugs ka las spros pa'i sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' sku mdog ser po bum pa ser po bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros te/bsgrub bya seng ge'i khri dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ser por gnas pa la dbang bskur bas/tshe dpal stobs wor/lung rtogs kyi yon to rnams rgyas shing /rin chen sna bdun rgyal srid sna bdun sogs/rin po che'i char babs pas phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar bar gyur/oṃ āḥphyi 'dod gsol gyi rdzo rkang gsum pa la tshe dang bar nams snya grags mnga' thang sogs zhes par 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /sogs man chad zhi ba bzhin la/mi 'dra ba'i khyad par shes dgos so//rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dngos grub i mor byed pa zhes bya ba 'di'ang kho bos bgyis pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang sgo bstun nas 'khyer bde ba'i ched du ngaX dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/sarba maṅga lo////

nga bang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ nang ma(kha)dbang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum ga/gas pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs/smin legs lang tsho rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar ltar/ khams gsum kun yid 'i 'gugs pa lcags kyu che/ /gshin rje gshed kyi dbang gi sbyin sreg gi /lag len 'khrul med 'khyer bde 'dri bar bya/ /stegs dbang gi khyad chos kyi rdzas kyis sbrus pa dang / gter gzhug par bya zhing / sa 'khor gyi sor tshad kyang rgyas pa ltar byas pa'i dbus su pad nyi la rdo rje dang / mu khyud rdor phreng / kha khyer la lcags kyu gyen zhwang ngo / /logs thig ni zhi bab smo no/ /bu dmar por zla gam gzugs/ /thab thad drangs pa yin/ khung rgya dpangs rgyas pa bzhin/ /rdzas rnams spyi dang bye brag gi /ma 'dres rdzas chen ban go nyis las mar khu kha dog gis dbye/ yam shing sgong dang mdzo mo shing sogs tshad rgyas pa dang 'dra rgal/ dbyibasazla gam dmar po'o/ /rdzas khyad par ba/shin tu skyur ba'i 'bru dmar po dang / gos dang me tog dmar po/ /bud med kyi me tog dang pad+ma rak+tas sbags la/ tsan dan dmar po/ /gur gum ghi hang rnams so/ /mchod pa lnga'i rdzas dang chu bzhi'i rdzas kyang dmigs bsal zhal las shes dgo shing / phyogs kyi khyad par nub dang / sbar byed kyi me smad tshong ma'i me dgos so/ /dbye ba ji bzhin zangasasam dmar tsho snod du/ dgod/ rdo rje ni thabs dang / zhes pa dmar mthing dkar ba'i zhes par bsgyur/ nas/ ye shes kyi thab dmar po zla (2na skom gyi dbyibs can/ mu ran la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang / kha khyer la lcags kyu gyen du bsgreng bas bskor ba/ grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje gyen du bsgreng bar raṃ dmar po dang / rgyan dang na bza' dmar po/ ra dmar po/ rdo rje'i rnam pa can dmar po zhes par 'don pa bsgyur/ gyur pa'i dbus su/ zhes pa nas/ me lha bcu gnyis kyi nang nas dmar chen dmar po dmar mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /zhes pa nas/ 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ me lha'i sngags la/ khams gsum gyi rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor/ mnga' thang longs spyod tshe dang bsod nams/ mthu stobs nus pa/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub thams cad wa she dgang blugs bdun nam gsum 'bul/ ku ru lho oṃ bo dhi bṛ khri ya āḥ&/ zhes pa dbang la yam shing dang mar khu/ de'i rjes su rdzas khyad par ba rnams —557—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ma gtogs/ rdzas chen gzhan rnams mi 'bul ba phyag len bde zhing khungs dag pa yin pas til nas gro'i bar rnams dor bar bya zhing rang sngags la bshad ma thag pa'i spel tshig nyid kyis 'bul lo/ /nas/ yis bsil dang bsang gtor yan phul/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ me lha'i thugs skar/ zhes pa nas/ (2ba/zhes pa'i bar sku mdog dang 'od zer dang rnam pa can gsum la dmar po sbyor zhing gyi ṣi'i mjug tu khams gsum nas wa shaṃ ku ru ho'i bar sbyor ba dang gtso 'khor gyi sreg rdzas spel tshig kyang de ga'o/ /snga ma ltar bya'o/ /rang dang mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ khro bo dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bsgrub bya rang dbang med par bkug nas rang gi rkang 'og tu bsgyel/ 'gugs byed kyi lha rnams thugs kur bstim/ de las 'od dmar po 'bar ba zhal las byung ba/ bsgrub bya'i khar zhugs/ lus yi ge dmar pos gang bas chags pas myos/ ming gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba/ thugs ka nas byung ba'i sngags dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ slar yang 'od zer gyis bsdus te rang gi thugs kar thim/ me tog dmar po dang 'od zer dmar pos gang ste dbang gi las thams cad phun sum tsho gos par gyur/ ma༅ཿhrī 'gos ma na chad zhi ba bzhin la/ til sogs 'jog pa dang / spel 'dod gsol gyi rkang pa gsum pa la/ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i sbyor go sgo gos zhes bsgyur ro/ /tshig gi dbye ba sngar bzhin shes dgos so/ /dbang gi sbyin sreg khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes pa 'di'ang /kho bos bgyis pa'i zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang sgo bstun nas 'byer bde ba'i ched du ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar/ sarba maṅga le// //drag po'i sbyin sreg bskal pa'i me dpung bzhugs/gtum chen 'bar ba gshin rje gshed kyi zhal/ /gnam sa gdangs pa'i dus mtha'i me dpung nang / /dgra bgegs bla tshe srog gsum sha khrag rus/ /'debs byed drag po'i sbyin sreg 'chad byed kyi/ /rtog ge tha snyad mkhan po'i blos byas dang / /lung med dbang chos 'chad pa'i slob dpon dang / /rtogs —558

drag po'i sbyin sreg bskal pa'i me dpung / nang ma(kha)ldan gzhan mgo bskor ba'i zog po yis/ /gnyis phung mang po'i gral ring ma 'grims par/ kho bos yongs 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /gsang chen theg pa'i chos la cung zad sbyangs/ khyad par mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor kun/ /tshig tsam ma yin nyams myong ldan phyir bri/ /gza' skar sa bdag gdug pa sogs/ /drag po'i che'i/la steg bang grog mkhar sogs sna dang mi rus kyi phyi sogs rdzas 'tshogs pa/ bu ni/ lta spya bzhi nag drag rdzas kyis byugs pa/ po lho phyogs brtseg /steng du tsher ma can gyi shing / /gru gsum brtsegs pa'i thab logs rer sor nyi shu/ dpangs su de'i phyed/ khung bca'/ /sa 'khor lte ba pad+ma dang / /rdo rje kha gyes mu khyud dang / kha khyer rtse lnga rtse dgus spras/ /de mthar hom khung kha khyer ldan/ /(2na)tsher can yam shing rtse mo rno/ /mar nag chu bzhi nyer spyod bsham/ /yam shing sgo so pa zur gsum nag po/ rtse mor mis khyi'i rgyu ma ca zad dkrisapa/ mar na gal tsha ba gsum sogs rdzas sna mang du tsos pa/ khrag chang gi sgrubazhi/ khrag gi a/so gos mchod po lnga dang / dmar gtor/rdzas khyad par ba/ rus pa/ dug sna/ sha tshil/ nang khrol/ tsha ba gsum/ yungs kar/ khrag /rnga mo dang bong bu'i spangs/ dha du ra/ skam gsher gyi sa phur sogs phyag len ltar dgos shing / snod thod pa dang gsogs kyi dum bur bsham/ phyogs lho dang bshan pa'i me dgosaso/ khred gsum zil gnon chas su gzhug /thun mong min pa'i bsreg pa'i rdzas/ /man ngag zab mo zhal las dgra bgegs kyi liṅga med du mi rung ba ni/ rdzas sna tsho gis las byas pa'i zan ling gi khog par 'khor lo dang ling rkyang sogs shin tu zab pa'i man ngag snying gi khrag lta bu/ rje btsun ra chen dang / chos kyi rgyal po bcung kha pa yang sras las/ snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag zab mos dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas zhal las dris shig /deng sang de 'dra'i rnam dbye rna ba'i khung bu tsam du yang ma son par/ zan la mi'i bzo dbyibs dod pa tsam la li thor ming 'dogs pa dang / zan gru gsum du brdzis pa tsam gyis mthu yod par re ba'i grong pa'i skye bo dang / bud med kyi smod mo'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa/ khyi rgan rnams la kha zas kyi dga' ston sgrub par byed pa dag mang ngo / khrus/ /(2ba)rdo rje ni thabs dang / zhes pa mthing dkar dmar ba zhes bsgyur/ nas/ ye shes kyi thab nag po gru gsum pa mu ran la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'phreng ba dang / kha khyer la rdo rje rtse dgu pa gyen du bsgreng bas bskor ba/ grwa bzhin zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rdo rje gyen du bsgreng bar gyur ba'i dbus su/ zhes pa raṃ nag po las sri gug sngon po'i rtse mor raṃ gyis mtshan pa zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /—559

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)nas/ me lha bcu gnyis kyi nang nas khro bo dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi dngos grub rgya mtshor me lha'i mdzo rtogs 'jam po gsum dang kha dog tsam ma gtogos mtshungs pa 'am/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gzhan byed pa 'dam ngar snang ba las 'di ni man ngag bsto no/ /pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrog pa/thod sprul la sogs pa khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang ral gri /'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mdung 'dzin pa/ sbom zhing thung la khro zhing gtum pa/ ba spu la glog gi 'phreng ba grangs med pa 'khyug pa/ ma he nag po'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gzhug mar gnas pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ dgang blugs kyi kha la ya yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ me lha'i sngags la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i snga dgra lag la dar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor phun tshogs bla srog tshe gsum dang bcas pa mā ra ya hūṃ dgang blugs bdun nam gsum 'bul/ phaṭa/(3na)rma bo dhi brik+ta ya āḥ// zhes pa nas/ yam rang sngags la bshad ma thag pa'i spel tshig sbyor ba ma gtogs sngags dang spel tshig sna tshogs mi byed cing rdzas khyad par ba rnams kyang lag len 'jug pa bde spu ma na ngag ltar bya'o/ zheng mar khu rdzas khyad par pa rnams 'bul/ de nas gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal bskyed cing / 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje bskul ba ni/ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyi bka'/ /zhes sogs rdzogs par btang / gser skyems phul/ nya bo la dgug gzhug bya/snying po dang las gshin gyi sngags mjug tu/ sarba sha / ā ga r+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ ྅/ snying rje'i dbang gis cher khros pa/ /'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /drag cing gtum pa khro po'i rgyal/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sku/ /sra mkhregs brtan pa rdo rje'i lus/ /bzod par dka' ba ma he'i gzugs/ /'jigs rung gshin rje'i snying 'dar ba/ /ro langs chen po brgyad dang bcas/ khro bo'i dbang phyug yongs dang bcas/ /srid gsum 'byung po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /las kyi gshin rje'i pho nyar bcas/ /srid gsum snying rjes bsgral ba'i phyir/ /zhe sdang chen po sku bzhengs shig /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra 'di/ /—560

drag po'i sbyin sreg bskal pa'i me dpung / nang ma(kha)theg pa chen po'i sgos dgra 'di/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan dgra 'di/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgra 'di/ /rgyal sras yongs la bsngo ba 'di/ /sems can mang po phung ba 'di/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin dkrugs pa 'di/ /sdang zhing gdug pa'i sdig can 'di/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga rnams dang /khams gsum sgo gsum phung po khams/ /skye mched (3ba〉las dbang yul dang bcas/ /phyogs bcu gzhan du gnas kyang rung / /rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros pas/ khug cig badz+ra e ku sha /rdo rje zhags pa'i tshogs spros nas/ /drongs shig badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog tshogs spros pas/ /sdoms shig badz+ra spro ṭa baṃ/ /rdo rje dril bu'i tshogs spros pas/ /phob cig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥlha/ rab 'bar drag po'i klong dkyil nas/ khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed che/ /'khor dang pho nya bran g.yog bcas/ /sdig can sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /dmyal ba chen po'i gting 'gro ba/ /snying rjes bsgral ba'i zhing gyur 'di/ /ngar bzang rdo rje'i gri gug gis/ khos shig badz+ra gto ri/ /ring 'gro lcags kyi 'phang mdung gis/ phug cig bin+ta bā le na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun shing gis/ /rdungs shig badz+ra mu pa la/ /rno dbal rdo rje'i chu gri yis/ /gtubs shig badz+ra a yu dha/ /rtse gcig 'bar ba'i rdo rje yis/ /rgyob cig badz+ra ka na ya/ khugs chen rdo rje dgra sta yis/ /chod cig badz+ra pa shu ṇa/ /rno ngar rdo rde mdung ring gis/ /thob cig badz+ra gun de na/ /tsha bsreg rdo rje'i me mda' yis/ /zangs mar phug cig wa ṇi na/ khugs drag mtshon cha'i 'khor lo yis/ /tshal par thong zhig tsakre ṇa/ /sna tshogs thun gyi char pa yis/ /dum bur chod cig mā ra ya/ khugs drag rdo rje phur bu yis/ /snying la snun cig gī lwa ya/ /rno ngar ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /gshogs shig badz+ra kha ḍa ge ṇa/ /'bar ba'i me yis bsregs nas kyang / /thal ba'i rdul du brlag par mdzod/ /ces phyag mtshan rnams kyis lag len ltar nyi bzhi'i sngags la spel tshig sbyar te bzla/ bsgral/ /sreg rdzas g.yin (4na〉nims ltar sngags spel tshig dang bcas te 'bul/ zhal bsil dang bsang gtor phul/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ me lha'i thugs gar/ zhes pa nas/ tshogs sku mdog dang / 'od zer dang /rnam pa can gsum la nag po sbyor/'phro bar gyur/ lho sgo'i thad du pad+ma dang nyi ma zhes sogs las gshin mngon rtogs spyan 'dren dkyus —561—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)ltar btang / sngar bzhin chu bzhi dang / zhes pa nas/ snga ma ltar bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhrīḥsogs man chad zhi ba bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i gyi rdzi'i mjug tu/ bdag cag dpon slob nas/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar sbyor bdang /sreg rdzas kyi spel tshig kyang gtso 'khor rnams la de ga yin la/ kā la rū pa btags te las gshin la yang 'bul lo/ khyad 'dod gsol ni 'jam dbyangs gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs kyis/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /par shes dgos so/ /mthar mnan pa bya ba ni phyag len ltar ro/ /drag po'i sbyin sreg bskal pa'i me dpung zhes pa 'di'ang / kho bos bgyis pa'i zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sreg dang sgo bstun te/ 'byer bde ba'i phyir du ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ro/ /sarba maṅga le// //'jam dpal gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi drag po zor gyi 'phrin las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda' bzhugs so/ /na mo da rba bi dwa ra ṇa kṛ mañja shrī ya mā ra ye/ zhi khro kun 'dus dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /pad+mas rjes bzung drag sngags bka' babs can/ /be+e ro'i rnam 'phrul sprul sku gter bdag gling / /drin can bla ma gtsug gi rgyan du mdzes/ /gang gi zab gter mkha' 'gro'i zhal drod rlangs/ /ma nyams dngar por 'thul ba gshed skor gzhung / /dregs pa 'joms byed las mtha' drag po'i zor/ /rno ngar rdo rje'i tsha tsha phyogs bcur 'phro/ /de phyir gab bsal 'byugs bsdebs 'thor ba bsdus/ /ma chad kha bkang gtor bzlog 'phrin las kyi/ /gyer sgom gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda' yis/ /yid srubasasde bcas mgo bo cig car 'gem/ /glo snying chems chems za zhing rgyu ma yi/ /ga sha ring por 'phyang ba'i gshin rje'i tshogs/ khros pa'i gad brgyangs drag po thos pa'i mod/ /dgra srog dum bur 'chad pa dngosapo'i gshis/ /'on te dam ldan sgrub por mchog mthun gyi/ /dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba yongs 'du'i —562

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)ljon/ /'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i grib bsil du/ /bde bar ngal sos kwa ye skal bzang tshogs/ /(2na ti yang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor la bka' gter mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lo chen be+e ro tsa na la gnang ba'i gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi chos sde yar klungs shel phug gi byang 'dabs rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i brag ngos nas gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pas gdan drangs pa'i chos skor gyi nang tshan drag po zor gyi 'phrin las nyams su blang ba la/ gnam sa chos 'byung gi dbyibs can dang dur khrod sogs drag po'i gnas sam/ yang na yid dang mthun pa'i sgrub khang du phyag bdar dang skyang nul legs par byas te sa rgyan gnam rgyan go mtshon spyan gzigs kyi rim pa bkod pas mdzes pa bstar zhing / sgrub pa la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa bsag /zhi khro spyi bye brag dang khyad par sgos kyi bla ma yi dam srung ma'i rten dang mchod gtor bsham/ 'phung sa gsum las grub pa'i stegs bu la dug khrag gis chag chag gdab/ ma tre gyi lto bar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag zla gam sum ldan/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ rdor rwa me ri dang bcas par lha bcu gnyis kyi mtshan (2bsgo'am tshon spungs dgod/ de'i steng du ma'am khri'u'i khar lcags sam bhan+ta'i snod dug rigs khrag sna 'bru sna lnga'i phyi sogs rdzas rnams tshang ba'i 'bru nag dar btags sbrus pa'i drag po'i gtor ma zur gsum rno dbal can logs rgyab tu bstan pa dmar sing nge ba me ri sogs drag rgyan rngam brjid dang ldan pa/ mthar nang du 'khor bcu gcig /de'i phyi rol tu khro bcu'i gtor ma/ khrag kong mtshe yungs/ rtsang rgyu ma'i lda ldis brgyan pa/ lha rten tsaka li bkod pa/ gtor gdugs kyi nang du srung 'khor/ gtor ma'i smad char bzlog 'khor/ dmigs kyis bsal ba la liṅga bsad 'khor gyis gtums pa bzlog 'khor 'og tu 'jug /rdar rwa'i nang gi mdun thad du mnyi'i khar las gshin gyi gtor ma thog gzugs 'khor so bzhi'am bsdu na gtso 'khor lnga pa skyu gu nyer dgu khrag kong mtshe yungs rtsang dmar gyis brgyan pa tsaka li gtor gdug btsugs/ gter gzhung dngos bstan du kong zor dang mda' zor gnyis la zor rnams tshang ba 'dra zhig 'dug na'ang /—563—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2naji skad du/ thun dang zor gyi yo byad kun: man ngag gnad kyis tshogs par bshams: zhes 'byung bas/mdos zor gyi rna cha 'joms byed la 'a ka nag po nas kha bkang ste/ dang zor/ rdo zor/ mda' zor/khrag zor rnams gzhung nas bshad pa'i bca' gzhi rdzas sogs tshang ma bkod/ yungs zor logs su byas kyang 'gal ba med cing gong gi rdzas khrod du yod pas bzhag kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur/ mthar mdun nas brtsams te zhi ba dang drag po'i nyer spyod/ sman raka /las gshin gter srung gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma/ tshogs/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi bkang (3na tha'i gtor ma rgyan spros can/ be ro/ rta nag /g.yag nag /glang nag /lug nag /ra rog /bya nag rnams rang rang gi sha khrag bsres pa'i bzo dbyibs dod pa gzhan yang srog chags gang 'byor gyi sha khrag slo snying mkhas mchin rgyu zhag tshil bu/ sman sna/rin po che/ bza' bca' spyan gzigs mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs kyis bskor ba gser skyems gdab las kyi chas rnams mngon par 'du bgyis/ bdag mdun gnyis ka lhan cig tu las byang bdud las rnam rgyal gyi gzhung bsrangs/ bstod pa yan song ba dang zur gtor la dmigs te las gshin gyi 'phrin las bzlas pa ma gtogs bstod pa'i bar bya/ bdag mdun gyi ting nge 'dzin 'phro 'du dang bcas bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams bzla zhing khyad par thun yod na thor thun la bsnyen sgrub/ snga thun la srung 'khor/dgongs thun la bzlog pa/ srod thun la bsad pa rnams kyi sngags dmigs man ngag ltar bya/ 'dzab bstod 'bul ba ni/ phye dregs pa 'joms byed chos kyi dbyings kyi gsung / /thugs dam gsung gi ye shes rol pa las/ /thabs dang shes rab yig 'bru dpag med mkhar/ /'khor lo bskor zhing yig 'bru'i rang sgra las/ /grag stong dbyer med rgyal ba'i gsung mchog ste/ /'od zer 'phro 'du nyi zla'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /phar 'phros 'phags mchod sems can sgrib pa sbyangs/ /dam can rgyud bskul lha srin gnad la 'bebs/ /dgra dang bgegs la phog pas rdul du brlag /slar 'dus rnal 'byor bdag gis dngos grub thob/ /bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa 'joms byed kyi/ /gsum gyi bzlas pas gsung gi rgyud (3ba tha skul zhing / /sku yi cha lugs 'jigs par ston mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs —564

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)'joms byed gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las byang gi gzhung bzhin dngos grub blang / /rgyas par spro na/phye bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan dregs pa 'joms byed 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis rtsegacig gdung ba yis/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ /bsnyen cing bsgrubs nas las kyi 'phro 'thud de/ /skad cig tsam yang mi brjed khyed bsgrubs na/ /dus 'di nyid la bdag gi bsam bsgrub phyir/ khyad par gyur pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /bzlas bsnyen sngags kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul bas/ /thugs dam dbang gis myur bar bzhes nas kyang / /dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'bras bu gang lags pa/ /dus 'di nyid du bdag la gsol ba ni/ khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gnon pa/ /theg dgu bgrod cing sa rnams non gyur nas/ /mthar thug 'bras bu sku lnga'i bdag nyid mchog /bcom ldan 'joms byed go 'phang myur thob stsol/ /de ma thob kyi gnas skabs rnams su yang / /tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /che btsan dregs pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba dang / /sgrub po dmigs byar bcas pa'i bsrung skyob dang / /dgra bgegs 'joms shing rbod zor bzlog pa dang / /zor rnams rang 'gags mnan pa rang rul dang / /lha rnams rang gshed mi g.yo mi 'gul zhing / /phyi nang bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /drag sngags phyi la tshugs shing rno ba dang / /bsrung bskrad bcom gzir dbab bcad la sogs kyi/ /stobs chen thams cad zil gyis(4na skonon pa dang / /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang / zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub ma lus te/ /bcom ldan dregs pa 'joms byed 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /rgyud la da lta nyid du thob par stsol/ /tshogs bar pa yan song nas bskul ba ni/ gye rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings drag po'i zhing : skye med dbyings nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa: khrag 'thung khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: mngon spyod 'phrin las mdzad phyir thugs dam bskul: khyod thugs chos dbyings zhi las ma g.yos kyang : snyigs ma lnga bdo'i las ngan 'gro ba rnams zhi bas mi thul 'dul phyir thugs rje ches: mi bzad rab 'jigs drag po'i —565

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)skur bzhengs la: byang chub bsgrub la 'tshe ba'i gdon tshogs dang : zhing bcu tshang ba bstan pa spyi yi dgra: khyad par bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo'i tshogs: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las mi g.yel bar ming tsam med par rdul du brlag pa yi: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pas bskul bsgrubs tshe/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mi mdzad na: zhal bzhes thugs dam nyams par mi 'gyur ram: de bas khrag 'thung 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs: mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod rgyas par spro na/ e chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang gi /drag pos yi gzhal yas nas/ /sde brgyad chu glang ma he'i steng / khro bo'i rgyal po 'joms byed ni/ /sku mdog dug (4ba)chen 'khyil ba 'dra/ /sku che gtum la brngams shing 'bar/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /g.yas dkar lha brgyad zas su za/ /g.yon dmar klu 'bum gnyan khri gsol/ /dbus kyi mthing nag brngam pa yis/ /sku dgrar 'os pa'i dam nyams dang / /sa bdag sde brgyad lha srin gyi/ /dbang po lnga dang tsit+ta gsol/ /g.yas kyi dang po 'khor lo yis/ /dgra bgegs mgo lus tshal par gzhog /bar pa gnam lcags ral gri yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /tha ma gnam lcags gri gug gis/ /dgra bo'i khog pa gshags nas 'byed/ /g.yon gyi dang po dung khrag nang / /rak+ta dmar gyis bkang nas gsol/ /bar pa rdo rje be con gyis/ /dgra bgegs zhe sdang mgo la bsnun/ /tha ma sdigs mdzub me 'bar bas/ /dgra bgegs lus ngag gzir cing bsreg /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad dang / khyung gshog la sogs dpal chen gyi/ /rgyan dang chas kyis rnam par brjid/ /mche ba dgu khri rtsang phur gtams/ /spyan nas 'jigs pa'i me 'bar zhing / shangs nas rlud nag 'tshub ma ldang / /dbu skra sma ra ba spu las/ /gdug rtsub sma ra me chen 'bar/ /sku dgrar 'os pa'i dam nyams dang / /gdug pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag bsreg /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags —566

'jam dpal me'i sbu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med (ldan skong du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /skye/ sbyor ba'i yum gcig pe ta li/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ /gdug pa'i ral pa mun ltar gtibs/ /dur khrod rus pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dung khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud/ /sgrol yum ral gcig mthu mo che/ /nad mtshon char pa dgra la 'bebs/ /drag tu bskul zhing rbad tsa na/ /ma tshogs 'bum yang gzir zhing bskul/ /ma mo ki rkang dgra la 'bebs/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phye/ spyi gtsug gdug pa 'dul byed pa/ /bya khyung rgyal po sku mdog mthing / /spu gri'i sgro shog mtshon cha yis/ /gdug can ma lus gshog cing gtub/ /spyan mig nyi ma'i gzi mdangs kyis/ /bag chags rgya mtsho gting nas skems/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mchu dbal gyis/ /gdug pa'i klu rgyal spyi nas 'dren/ /zhal gdangs klu gnyan khong du gsol/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ ji hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing —567

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyu/ zla gam dmar po gsum gyi steng / /baṃ chen ro yi gdan steng du/ /tshe bdag nag po gtum zhing brngam/ /g.yas pa spu gris dgra srog gcod/ /(5ba tshe g.yon pa zhags pas sdam zhing 'ching / /dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brgyan/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba slong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdas/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ ji hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phye/ srog bdag dmar po khrag rul mdog /g.yas pa be con mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa ral gris dgra bgegs gshub/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ba chin mi sdug /dur khrod chas kyis rnam par spras/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ ji hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phye/'chi bdag dud kha srin bo'i gdong / /g.yas pa dgra bo khram la 'debs/ /g.yon pa don snying phyung nas za/ /mche gtsigs ljags 'dril rkan sgra gtog /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar —568

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mye/ shar rtsibs ya ma ra tsa mthing / /g.yas pa ral gri thod khrag g.yon/ /srin po'i gzugs can gtum zhing brngam/ /dur khrod chas kyi rnam par brjid/ /yum dang gnyis su med par 'khril/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phye/lho rtsibs myos byed 'bar ba ser/ /g.yas pa be con 'khor lo g.yon/ khro gtum mi bzad srin po'i gzugs/ /sku la dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs/ /gsang ba'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shesang bkra ga mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ 'a hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mye/ nub rtsibs a rla ma ru dmar/ /rtse gsum g.yas la mi snying g.yon/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs mi sdug gzugs/ /dur khrod rdzas kyis sku la spras/ /gtum chen yum mchog sku la 'khrud/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor cib choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong —569

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mye/byang rtsibs ral pa tshar dgu ljang / /thod dbyug g.yas la 'khor lo g.yon/ /gtum drag 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dur (6nasgo god rgyan dang gos kyis brjid/ /yum mchog khro mo sku la 'khrud/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phye/ sgo bzhir bya rgod stag chan dang / /gang ka spyang gdong brngam shing brjid/ /lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril bu 'dzin/ bzhi ga'ang dur khrod chas dang ldan/ /'gugs 'ching sdom myos las rnams mdzad/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ ji hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mye/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng na/ /bdud 'dul chen po khro bo bcu/ /g.yas g.yon lcags kyu tho ba bsnams/ /dur khrod cha'/kyis sku la spras/ /srung bzlog 'phrin —570

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)las ma lus mdzad/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phye/ drag po'i gzhal yas bar khyams na/ /gshin rje'i dmag tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul dang / /pho nya glog 'khyug skar ltar 'brug /gsod gcod drag po'i las la brngam/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyu/ rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /'chi bdag smug nag khro zhing brngam/ /thod dbyug dung khrag phyag na bsnams/ /mi srun gtum mo dug hrul ma/ /gshed bzhi mon bzhi bdud po bzhi/ khram bdag bcu gnyis sgo ba bzhi/ /bdun brgya nyi shu yang 'khor bcas/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /las kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes/ /dmigs pa gang yin myur du sgrol/ /zhe sdang dregs pa'i sbyor ba choms/ /srog lus dbang po'i dngas snyigs phye/ /rtsa rgyus khrag dang rba klong skoms/ /lus srog dbang po'i rten las phrol/ /'byung ba rnam shes bkrag mdangs sdus/ /bla mtsho bkrag mdangs bag chags skoms/ /lcags mkhar sgo med nang du chug /'byung ba'i gdan bzhi rngams kyis gnon/ /gdug rtsub me yi zhal du stob/ /sdang ba'i —371—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ /thal ba bzhin du rab tu rlog /bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /skye/ dus dgra'i dbang po gshin rje'i gshed/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nya dang / khyad par skye 'gro thams cad kyi/ /bla tshe srog la dbang bsgyur ba/ /ral pa tshar dgu gtum drag can/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon kun gyi gtso/ /pho (6ba tha rgyad mo brgyad gshin rje sogs/ /lha srin sde brgyad yongs kyi rje/ /'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshig sems can 'tshe/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad/ /bla ma'i sku dgra chos 'khor 'jig /khyad par rigs 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /dgon gnas yon bdag bcas pa la/ /snga dgra lag dar phyi dgra sems/ /da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba yi/ /sdang bar byed pa'i gzugs can dang / /tshe srog bsam sbyor 'dod pa'i don/ /chos srid legs tshogs bsgrub pa la/ /bar du gcod pa'i gzugs med bgegs/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar 'dug kyang / /pho nya dus me'i tsha tsha ni/ /slog stong ltar 'byug skad cig la/ /spros te lcags kyus snying nas bzung / /zhags pas ske dang mgo lus chings/ /yan lag lcagasakyi sgrog tu chug /dril bu'i sgra yis rnam shes smyos/ /lha dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdzas/ /bsod namasaza thang mnga' thang sogs/ /skyob byed kun dang rnam par phrol/ /'dre gdon gshed ma'i lag tu phrod/ /las kyi rlung dmar la bskyon nas/ /skad cig thangs cig yud tsam la/ /gnam lcags 'brub khung nang 'dir chug /rnam shes lus kyi rten dang phrol/ /srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod/ sha rus nang khrol tshogs rnams zo/ /snying khrag dron mo hub kyis 'thung / /pags pa dmar bshus gos su gyon/ /mu stegs drang srong bram ze dang / /ban bon sngags pa'i mthu byad tshogs/ /drag sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha dang / /rbad 'dre rbod gtong ma lus pa/ /thams cad rang gshed rang la phob/ /mdor na dgra bo mi nor bran/ /(7na) pha tshan srid sde yul mkhar rnams/ /ming tsam brda' tsam ma lus par/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par mdzod/ /ces bskul/ bsgral las bsdus pa las byang gi tsho gos tha mas go chod kyang 'dir rgyas pa'i dbang du btang ste 'brub khung ling ga phur thun sgrol gri sogs yo byad rnams rdo rje —572

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)slob dpon gyi mdun du gsar/ sngags pa bdud chas su zhugs/ thog mar gser skyems ni/ hūṃ/ rigasa'adzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang / /bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs/ khyad par 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed/ /las gshin 'chi bdag bhe ba sa twa sogs/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras/ /bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang / /sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhis gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lhas/ /gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed/ /gzu dbang gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor kun bdag mchog gsum bla ma dang : yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /'khor bcas bdag la dgongs shing gsan du gsol/ /snang srid gdod nas chos skur ro gcig la: ma rtogs sgrib bsal 'gro kun bsgral sems kyang : dam nyams dgra bos byed du ma ster ro: rtsa brgyud bla mas gzu dang dpang mdzod cig smin grol lam zhugs bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don tshul bzhin nyams (7ba)blangs dngos grub blang sems kyang : dam nyams dgra bos byed du ma ster ro yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston spel sems kyang : dam nyams dgra bos byed du ma ster ro: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpang mdzod cig tshe 'di blos btang dben pa'i gnas rnams su: bde chen byang chub bsgrub par sems na yang :dam nyams dgra bos byed du ma ster ro: dam can chos skyong gzu dang dpang mdzod cig ma nyes ma len ye shes lha yi tshogs: sdig can las ngan bstan pa'i spyi dgra 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan bshig dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad: bla ma'i thugs dkrugs dge 'dun sde la smod: khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: ri ltar brjid cing rtsang ltar 'dzugs pa dang : mdun nas dgug dang rgyab 'ded zur nas gsod: lus kyis brdung brdeg dkor rdzas rku zhing 'phrog: ngag gis ya gas —573—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)g.yin gyi nus mthu bskul: yid kyis bsam ngan dug ltar g.yo byed pa'i: snga dgra lag brdar phyi dgra yid sems dang : da dgra sdo ba'i dgra bgegs gar gnas kyang : gshin rje gshed po'i bka' nyan 'khor tshogs kyis: skad cig 'dir khug mngon spyod las mdzod cig: mkhyen dgongs dmod bcol ni/ ho bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs spyi dang khyad par 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs rnams gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig: bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba spyi'i dgra/ rnal 'byor par sgos su sdo ba'i snga dgra ngan pa lag la bkal ba/ phyi (8na'i gra bsam ngan rlung ltar 'grob pa/ da dgra drag po dngos su 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra dang gzugs med gdon bgegs kyi tshogs 'di rnams kyis/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig go /dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad do/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku dgra byas so/ /rab byung ngur smrig 'dzin pa dang sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sde bcom mo/ /sems can rnams kyi bde skyid phyogs so/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i za lam bkag go /yang sgos rigs 'dzin bdag dang srung ma khyed rnams la do bsdos so/ /sgrub pa po sdodang bcas pa rnams kyi 'di phyi'i bde ba bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs gzugs byang bur bris shing ming yi ger btab pa 'di rnams dmigs rten gyi nya bo 'di nyid la da lta nyid du 'gugs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /'brub khung bskyed chog gter gzhung gi gdab las ltar byas kyang rung mod rgyas par spro na bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas e mthing nag gcig chad mdun du sa yongs su gyur pa las/ dug dang zangs lcags khro chu las grub pa'i khang sgrom me 'bar ba/gru gsum pa bang rim dgu dang ldan pa/ kha khyer yangs shing gting zab pa/ de'i nang du 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ zhe sdang gi me rlung 'tshub pa/ gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ mtshon cha'i drag char 'bab pa/ nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ dug gi rlangs pa sngo dmar du 'phyo ba/ khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/ gshin rje'i skyes bu dpag tu med pa rgyug pa/ than dang ltas ngan gyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs —574—

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khan(8ba) kyis gang ba/ g.yin yang sprul pa'i pho nya 'jigs su rung ba rnams ni/ seng ge ltar brngam pa/stag ltar mchong ba/ 'brong ltar 'gying ba/ khra ltar 'dzul ba/ sprul ltar 'khrug pa/ 'dre srin ltar ngur ba/ 'gong po ltar spyo ba/ srin bya ltar rgod pa/ wa mo ltar brgyal ba/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyug pa/ sod sod dang rgyob rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pas gang ba/ de'i nang du bskal pa stong gi mun pa 'khrigs pa/ phyi nas bskal pa stong gi me 'bar zhing rlung nag 'tshub pa/ gshin rje'i zhing khams/bshan pa'i pho brang / srog gcod kyi grong khyer/ srid pa las kyi gzhal yas khang chen po/ dgra bo phyin ma thag lha dang 'bral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ las ngan thams cad rnam par smin pa'i btson khang drag po de'i dbus su/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra/ dkon mchog gi spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ rnal 'byor gyi sgos dgra/ dmigs pa'i dgra bo gang gi rnam par shes pa rje tri dud kha yongs su gyur pa las dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs de dag /nyam chung ba/ sgyid pa phra ba/ skra gzings ba/ mdog nag cing bam pa/ mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can/ bu ga dgu nas khrag dang rnag 'dzag pa/ kha nas sid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ bsrung zhing skyob pa'i lha dang 'bral zhing gshed du 'bebs pa/ gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/de'i 'og tu zhing chen gyi sa gzhi brdal ba/ mtshon cha sna tshogs gzings te 'dug pa/ drag po'i tsha tsha chil li li khol ba/ de'i 'og tu rak+ta'i rba rlabs 'brug cing zhing chen gyi rba nyil nyil 'phyo ba/ de'i 'og tu (9na)bskal pa'i rlung dmar nag 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ de'i 'og tu bskal pa'i rlung spu gri so rgal chil li li 'byug pa/ de'i 'og tu drag po chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dgra bo thams cad gtan nas brlag par byed pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ na mo rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa/ chos kyi bka' bden pa/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa/chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang khyad par bcom —575

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2naldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dregs pa 'joms byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje 'chi bdag ral pa tshar dgu lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyi bden pa dang bden pa'i nus mthu la brten nas/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag dpon slob sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang bar byed pa sgos kyi dgra bo gnod byed bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad da lta nyid du dmigs rten 'di nyid la khug cig /lan gsum mam bdun sogs kyi mthar sgrub sngags kyi sham bur che ge rtsi dza/ tri baṃ ril dza/ a gar+sha ya dza/gar+sha ni dza/ a be sha yā dza zhes bstim/ dgra bo mi nor srid sdodang bcas pa 'di rnams kyi sha khrag bla tshe srog dbugs rnams 'chi bdag gshin rje nag pos gtso byas sngags bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs kyi zas skal du gtad pa yin pas/ dgra bo 'di rnams 'go ba'i lha (9ba〉lnga dang phrol zhig /gnod pa'i 'dre lnga dang sprod cig /gnam gyi 'ju thag steng nas chod cig /sa yi rten phur 'og nas phyungs shig /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khyer zhig /srog rtsa dmar po dum bur gtubs shig /gsal gsal yid kyi snang ba sgribs shig /brjod pa gtam gyi smra ba lkugs shig /rgyu ba dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong chod cig: rnam shes rten gyi gzugs dang phrol zhig /pha tshan mi rabs rtsa ba phyungs shig /shad tshan nye rigs pha mtha' btul zhig /mnga' 'bangs 'khor g.yog srid sde gtor zhig /dbang thang bsod nams zad du chug cig /dpal 'byor longs spyod yal du chug cig /mkhar dar grong khyer stongs su chug cig /zhing la lo med tha bar thong zhig /tsha grang nad kyis mnar du chug cig /sde brgyad za kha zug tu chug cig /bsten pa'i lha srung bdud du phob cig /byad ma rbod gtong rang gshed phob cig /mdor na dgra bgegs 'di rnams lo zla zhag dus las ma 'gyangs par dam can srung ma khyed rnams kyis rkan sgra drag pa dang bcas te da lta nyid du rab dkar tshems kyis chems chems bzhes la thal ba'i rdul du rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /hūṃ/ khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: las byed bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab: sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs —576

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)'gugs pa'i dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: bla srog rnam par shes pa kun: ma shar ma gtang khug la shog /btab pa'i dus las ma 'da' bar: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra dang bgegs: thams cad ma lus myur du khug: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas drongs: zhags pa (10na7na gyis yan lag chings: lcags sgrog can gyis dbang po sdoms: dril bu can gyis myos su chug las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul: 'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas sus:skad cig de ni yud tsam la: rang dbang med par khrid la shog: a mu ka sarba rtsi tri badz+ra e gu sha dzaḥdzaḥ/pho nya bskul zhing bla 'gugs pa ni/ hūṃ bh+yo/ da ni bsgral ba'i thugs dam dus la babs: do nub nam gyi srod dang gung la babs/ /da lta nam gyi gung la bab dus 'dir: sems med 'byung ba chu yang gnyid log gi /dgra bo lasang na sdig can gnyid log pa'i/ /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nam gyi srod la bab dus 'dir/ /chom rkun las la 'gyed pa'i dus yin pas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'khyam pa'i dus: bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nam gyi tho rangs babs dus 'dir/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo zhing 'phro ba'i dus/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo ba'i dus/ /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nam langs nyi ma shar dus 'dir/ /mi phyugs thams cad las la gram pa'i dus/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe sgo ru 'thon pa'i dus/ /bla 'khyam las༅ myur du khrid la shog /sbyo/ da lta nyi ma'i gung la bab dus 'dir/ /dgra kun rnam shes bying zhing myos pa'i dus/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe 'thom zhing 'khyam pa'i dus/ /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/ da lta nyi nub grib so phog dus 'dir/ /snying mi dga' nyid shes pa 'phyo ba'i dus/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe rnam shes 'phyo ba'i dus/ /bla tshe 'khyam po da lta khrid la shog /bh+yo/bla 'khyam las ༅ 'phyo ba'i dus drug la: bla gshed pho nya khyed rnams myur du rgyug /mgon med byi'u phrug rgya khras zin pa ltar/ /rang (10ba) dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo bla 'khyam mi ru rja ba na/ /pho nya gnod sbyin srin por sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam sha bar rdzu ba na/ /pho nya gser gyi stag mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la —577

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam dgo bar rdob na/ /pho nya lcags dom nag por sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam lug tu sgrub na/ /pho nya lcags kyi spyang mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam ra ru rdzub na/ /pho nya byu ru'i khyi mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam bya ru rdzub na/ /pho nya bya rgyal khyung du sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam gla bar rdzu ba na/ /pho nya gser gyi 'phar bar sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /dgra bo'i bla 'khyam bong bur sgrub na/ /pho nya zangs kyi dred mor sku sprul la/ /rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog /bh+yo/ dam nyams dgra bo'i bla rtags brgyad po la/ /pho nya brgyad kyis gnyen por sku sprul la/ /'brub khung 'khor ba'i btson khang 'di'i nang du/ /dam nyams ling ga'i rten la bla srog khug /bla srog gsum la drag po'i phur pas thob/ /phur mtshon dpal gyis lus sems phye la sgrol/ /dgra bo'i bla srog steng du mā ra ya/ /srog rtsa dmar po rbad kyis chod la shog /bla 'khyam las ngan steng du mā ra ya/ /ra dang lug dang bong bu rnam pa gsum/ /bla rtags yin pas myur du khyer la shog /so dang sen mo pags pa rnam pa gsum/ /phyi rtags yin pas myur du khyer la shog /sna dang lce dang mig dang gsum po ni/ /dbang po yin pas myur du khyer la shog /pho ba snying dang mchin pa (11na)gsum po ni/ /don snying yin pas myur du khyer la shog /gnye ma rgyu ma mkhal ma gsum po ni/ /nang khrol yin pas myur du khyer la shog sha khrag brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod/ /sgrub sngags jug tu dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim/ sha ma ru ti thul thul/ myogs phyogs/yed yed/ sha ma ru ti khug ling / phyog ling / sha ling / thum tsa mun tri bh+yo dza/ lha dang dbye ba ni/ hūṃ/dbye byed las kyi pho nya'i tshogs las ngan sdig can dgra bo 'di: bsrung zhing skyob par byed pa yi: ye shes 'jig rten lha yi tshogs: phyol zhig phye zhig rnam par phye dgra lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phrol: srog lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrol/ /yul lha phrag pa g.yon nas phrol/ /zhad lha lte ba'i khung nas phrol/ /ma —578—

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol/ /rigs 'dzin srung ma rgyab nas phrol/ /mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud dang sprod: ma ma shig raka mā ra ya phye phye: rje tri de wa sarba u tsa ta ya phaṭa: thun rdzas sna tshogs kyis brab pa ni/ hūṃ/ khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: pho nyar mngags pa thun gyi bdag: dgra bgegs sgrol phyir las la yu: sna tshogs drag po rdzas kyi thun: glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'bebs:dgra bgegs lus sems 'bem la yuḥ sgrub sngags sham bur e ya ma rā dza dgra bo byad ma sha ::srog rtsi tri hur ṭaṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad sod: kho shag ro myags mug ti rbad: dgra bo che ge mo'i srog rtsa mā ra ya chod: / ril rbud: e myags thun bh+yo: mā ra ya rbad dza: nyes (11ba)pa bsgrag cing phur gdab ni/hūṃ/ dug lnga'i dbang gyur las ngan khyod: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba ste: snying rjes khros nas bsgral bar bya: byang chub mchog tu sems skyed cig: rang gi lag gnyis nyi zla sa gyur pa'i g.yas kyi sor mo lnga: tshe hūṃ tre hrīḥ.āḥdang ni/ hūṃ lī phe zhwa hūṃ lnga g.yon/ /rigs lnga yab yum sbyor mtshams nas/ /sras mchog gshin rje gī lā ya/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor ba9|ga can/ /phyag gnyis phur pa thugs sgar bsgril/ /'chang zung rdo rje'i lte ba la/ /'jam dpal yab yum ye shes sems/ /yar dang mar gyi ra lnga la/ /zhi khro rigs lnga yab dang yum/ /rgya mdud gong mar yi dam lha/ /'og mar dam can bka' skyong tshogs/ /sku smad phur bu'i dpal gseng la/ /me yi tsha tsha sde brgyad dmag /rtse mor mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub/ /bsgril bas srid pa gsum 'dar zhing / /phyar ba tsam gyis khams gsum dngangs/ /btab pas dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /ā+oṃ ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya kā ya lha ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣañca ā+oṃ āḥlha/phur pa las 'phros 'od zer gyis/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs rnams/ /tshur 'dus khams gsum dus gcig tu/ /sgrol bar nus pa'i dbang thob gyur/ /na maḥs man+ta bu d+dha nai kā ya lha ka tsitā ya mān+ta ka badz+ra gī li gī lu ya hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ/ khro rgyal khrag 'thung chen po yi: sras mchog badz+ra ki 'u ya:bsgril bas lha yang skrag byed na: btab pas dgra bgegs smos ci dgos: zhing bcu tshang ba'i log 'dren tshogs: sgrol cig ye shes klong du sgrol: e myags rngubs mugs shag la dun sgrub (12na)—579

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)sngags mjug tu badz+ra gī li gī lwa ya hūṃ phaṭa la gong gi bsad sngags btags te tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa ltar snying gar btab nas bsgral/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams: ma rtogs 'khrul pa snying re rje: snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: thugs rje'i thabs kyi sbyor ba yis: phung po bsgral ba'i zhing du byas: rnam shes yum gyi mkha' la sba: ye shes dpa' bor byin brlabs te: rig pa chos kyi dbyings su 'phangs: khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed: ces brjod/ slar yang 'khor bar mi zlog pa'i phyir gnas bcur brdeg pa ni/ hūṃ/ drag po sgrol mdzad phur bu yis/ /lus kyi 'khrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /lte ba'i dkyil du gī lwa ya/ /gzugs su 'khrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /mig gi dkyil du gī lā ya/ /dri ru 'khrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /sna yi dkyil du gī lā ya/ /sgra ru 'khrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /rna ba'i dkyil du gī lwa ya/ /ro ru zhakhrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /lce yi dkyil du ki lwa ya/ /'khor bar 'khrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil du gī lwa ya/ /reg byar 'khrul ba rtsad gcod phyir/ /yan lag bzhi la gī lwa ya/ /gong gi sngags dang bcas gdang / de nas ral gyis dum bur gcod cing / /hūṃ/ snying rjes khros pa'i khro rgyal gyi: ye shes rno dbal mtshon cha yis: dgra bgegs bag chags 'khrul sems bsgral: rnam shes skye med dbyings su thim: e myags rngubs mugs sha la dun: a mu ka sha snre trig nan rbad nan tsit+ta thums ril rbad: che ge mo'i srog rje hur thums jaḥ 6 shag ro myags mug ti rbad: mā ra ya rbad: ces bsgral/ tho ba hom gzar thogs la/ hūṃ/rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun:(12ba)bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung duḥ rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas pas: lha yang rung ste brlag byed na: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos tshwa pad+ma a ko ṭa ya kha the kha the: stob pa ni/ hūṃ/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku ni ri rab lta bur bzhengs: gnam sa lta bu'i zhal gdongs shig: gangs ri gtams 'dra'i mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i ljags skyongs la: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dug gsum sku gsum klong du 'bul: bzhes shig rol zhig kha raṃ ji hi:—58(/—

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)ā+oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ma hā mo sa rak+ta ke ni ti tsit+ta bha su ta kha kha ji hi ji hi: ling ro'i phud nas gtor mar stob/ gter srung gi gsol kha bya/ bskang rdzas rgyas pa'am mdor bsdu na tshogs tsam la dmigs nas bskang ba ni/ mar me sbar/ gsur chen gyi dud pa btang / rol mo sna tshogs 'brol zhing / hūṃ/ gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig 'dus ma byas/ /rtogs na kun bzang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /ma rtogs bla tshe'i gshed po 'chi bdag nag /nyon mongs dug gsum rang gdangs 'gag med du/ 1 /shar ba'i rgyud gsum sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /dar nag g.yab cing tshil chen dud pa 'thul/ khrag chang sgom sbreng rkang gling thod rnga sgrog /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bod byed na/ 2 /dur khrod rus pa'i gzhal yas gnas mchog 'dir/ /dbyar gyi glog dmar bzhin du 'byug cing spyon/ /dgun gyi bu yug bzhin du 'tshub cing spyon/ /thogs (13na) med 'dir spyon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ 3 /rang rang dbang po sna lnga tshim byed pa/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /rab phye dngos bshams yid kyis sprul byed na/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam gnyan po bskang / 4 /sman chab dri ngad 'thul ba'i mchod yon dang / /rnyog med bsil ba'i klung chen zhabs bsil sbreng / /pad dkar ku mud me tog sna tshogs 'phreng / /dri zhim sdong po bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'khrigs/ 5 /nyi zla nor bur rtsi 'bru'i snang gsal sbar/ /ga bur gur kum bsres pa'i byug pa'i rdzas/ /brgya phrag ro bda' lha dang mi yi zas/ /snyan cing brjid pa'i rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog 6 /bsad khrag drod rlangs ma nyams a: dang / mig lte rna ba sna snying me tog bshams/ /baṃ ro sbam por bsregs pa'i dud pa 'thul/ /tshil chen ro skra la sbar mar me gsal/ 7 /mkhris zhag ngad pa ldang ba byug pa'i dri/ /nang khrol sha rus bskos bu 'phreng bar bsgrigs/ /mi thod gsang ba'i rnge'u chung rkang gling sgra/ /gzugs mdzes lha mo gar bsgyur pi waṃ brdung / 8 /bcud ldan dung chos bza' bcas gang ba'i snod/ /lta mi'i gos bzang 'jam pa'i reg bya rngom/ /mi sdug srin po drag shul gar stabs bsgyur/ /bla tshe bzhugs pa'i 'o dod phyogs bcur 'bod/ 9 /lcang lo'i bhan+ta sa khrag zhag dri ldan 'phyar/ /glo snying sha —581—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)khrag gtams pa'i yol go bteg /dmar bshus pags pa rgyu ma'i thag par bkal/ /skam rlon thod pa brgyus pa'i rgyan drug bres/ 10 /glang stag sna tshogs pags par khrag rgyun 'dzag /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ (13na) ta/ /pad rā ka dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrug /dam rdzas gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la snyeg 11 /stong phrag sha sna'i lhu dum brtsigs shing nyil/ /slo snying mkhal mchin mcher pa phyur bur spungs/ /klad pa zhag tshil rkang mar 'dam rdzab g.yo/ 12 /sna tshogs rus pa'i gram krod sa gzhi g.yogs/ /rgyu ma'i srad bur brgyus pa'i nang khrol dang / /rkang lag spel mar byas pa'i lda ldi g.yo/ /zhing gi rgyal mtshan mi mgo'i tog gis mdzes/ 13 /ro skra'i rnga yab rus pa'i yu ba can/ /zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'ja' ltar bkra/ /dza gad gser skyems chang phud chal chil g.yo/ /rta mchog rgyan gyis spras pa mkha' la 'phyo/ 14 /'brong g.yag lcags rwa rnon pos dgra snying 'bigs/ /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin ba mo 'dod pa 'jo/ /'jam pa'i spu ldan lug nag rog po'i rwa/ /pho rog khra sogs gnam la 'phur dgu lding / 15 /stag gzigs khyi dang ce spyang seng ge sogs/ /sa la 'dzul dgu'i srog chags pha mtha' yas/ tan rkyang la sogs ri dwags 'phyo dgu rgyu/ khrab rmog zhol btags lcags bzhibs rang bsrung go 16 /mda' mdung gri sogs pha rol 'joms pa'i mtshon/ /bla bre 'phan gdugs lda ldi bgrang yas bstar/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rnam pa bdun/ /nya ba'i rin chen bdun dang glu gar ma/ 17 /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /ma rmos lo tog gsal byed nyi zla zung / /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa'i/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum dang /18 /mi sogs mtho ris gnas kyi 'byor ba yis/ /rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /regs 'dzin brda yi brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /(14na)gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ 19 /smon lam dbang bskur brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /bka' babs lung bstan brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /las 'phro gter gyi brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /shog ser tshig gi brgyud pa thugs dam bskangs/ /grangs med rgyal —582

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanab zhi khro thugs dam bskangs/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dregs 'joms thugs dam bskangs/ /sbyor yum ro langs nag mo'i thugs dam bskangs/ 21 /sgrol yum e ka dza zhi'i thugs dam bskangs/ /sprul pa bya khyung rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs sprul tshe bdag nag po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gsung sprul srog bdag dmar po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /sku sprul 'chi bdag dud kha'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gshin rje ya mā rā tsa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /srin po myos byed 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskangs/ /klu bdud a rla ma ru'i thugs dam bskangs/ 24 /gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu'i thugs dam bskangs/ /sgo bsrung chen po bzhi yi thugs dam bskangs/ /'jigs byed khro bo bcu yi thugs dam bskangs/ khyams kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskangs/ /'chi bdag bhe wa satwa'i thugasadam bskangs/ /gtum mo dug hrul nag mo'i thugs dam bskangs/ /gshed po sgrol ging rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs/ /bla 'gugs mon pa bzhi yi thugs dam bskangs/ 26 /bshan pa bdud po sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs/ /las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis thugs dam bskangs/—/phyogs kyi sgo skyong rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs/ /srog gcod ru dra sdebazhi'i thugs dam bskangs/ 27 /dregs pa lha srin sdebargyad thugs dam bskangs/ /rtsa gsum dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ khyed kyi thugs dam bdag gis skongs lags kyi/ /bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad khyed kyis zlog 28 /yar gnas pha mes bzhin du ngas mchod na/ /bu sdug tsha bo bzhin du khyod kyis skyongs/ /mkha' 'gro spun grogs bzhin du ngas bsten na/ /gdungs pa'i gnyen bzhin phan pa khyod kyis sgrubs/ 29 /dam can mnga' 'bangs bzhin du ngas bskyangs na/ /snying nye bran ltar las rnams khyod kyis sgrubs/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskangs pa'i (14bsko yas/ /mchod pa'i yul rnams dgyes pa rab bskyed de/30 /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chags sos gyur zhing / /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang / /byang chub bsgrub pa'i gdong grogs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /tshogs la rol/ ling ro lhag ma rnams sman raka dang bcas 'bul zhing 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ mye/—583—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)chos dbyibs drag po e yi gzhal yas na/ /dregs pa glang rgod pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /'joms byed bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /sku mdog mthing nag mun pa'i mdog 'dra zhing / /zhal gsum gdangs pas srid gsum zas su za/ /mche ba gtsigs pas skye shi rtsad nas gcod/ /zhal nas khrag 'bab stong gsum nad kyis 'geng / shangs nas rlung byung ri rab chen po gtor/ /spyan ni nyi zla rigs drug 'dam rdzab skem/ /snyan gyi 'brug sgras bdud khams klad pa 'gem/ /ral pa khams nag srid pa'i rtse mor 'khyil/ /dur khrod dpal gyi chas rnams sku la rdzogs/ /g.yas gsum 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar dgra bo gtub/ rno ngar ral gris mgo lus tshal par gshog /gri gug brdeg pas khog pa dmar por bral/ /g.yon gsum thod par khrag rgyun bcus nas gsol/ /be con dgra bgegs tshogos kyi mgo la bsnun/ /sdigs mdzub rtse las me 'bar srid gsum bsreg /bzlog pa'i las mdzad khro chung sprul pa 'gyed/ /ngan sngags bsreg byed ba spu me dpung 'phro/ /las rnams bsgrub phyir ma gshin 'khor gyis bskor/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag (15na) po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kya/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /bh+yo/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog pe ta li/ /sku mdog mthing nag gtum drag khro mo'i gzugs/ /g.yas pa gri gug dgra bo'i mgo lus gshog /g.yon pa thod khrag gtso bo'i zhal du stob/ /sgrol ba'i yum mchog e ka dza ṭi ma/ /mtshon cha dal yams sna tshogs dgra la gtong / /drag po'i las rnams bsgrub pa'i bshan pa mo/ /ma mo 'bum sde pho nya las la 'gyed/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /skye/ spyi bo'i gtsug na bya khyung ka ru —584

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanaḍa/ /sku mdog mthing nag spu gri'i sgro gshog can/ /rwa dang mchu ster gnam lcags las grub rno/ /gdug pa klu gnyan sa bdag zhal du gsol/ /rin chen rgyan dang sprul gyis sku la spras/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ thugs kyi sprul pa tshe bdag nag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri zhags pa 'dzin/ /dur khrod chas ldan khro gtum mi bzad 'jigs/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag dmar po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis be con ral gri bsnams/ kha gdangs mche gtsigs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ sku yi sprul pa 'chi bdag dud kha'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis khram shing mi snying 'dzin/ /srog la (15ba)brngams shing dur khrod chas rnams tshogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ ya ma rā tsa mthing nag mun pa'i mdog /g.yas g.yon phyag na ral gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /dur khrod chas brjid —585

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2nagasang ba'i yum dang sbyor/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha kha rlung bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ myos byed 'bar ba ser nag mi sdug gzugs/ /g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis be con 'khor lo bsnams/ /yum chen skur 'khril dur khrod chas gos gsol/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ a rla ma ru dmar nag khro zhing gtum/phyag gnyis rtse gsum mi snying dron mo thogs/ /dur khrod chas spras sku la yum gyis sgyul/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag mig rtsa dmar/ /phyag gnyis thod dbyug lcags kyi 'khor lo thogs/ /dur khrod chas kyis nyer brjid yum dang 'khril/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ sgo bsrung rgod stag rkang ka spyang gdong bzhi/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin/ /'gugs 'ching sdom myos las rnams thogs med mdzad/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su —586

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanagasol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/steng phyogs khro bo'i rgyal po hūṃ ka ra/ /g.yas pa lcags kyus dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren/ /g.yon pa tho bas lus sems rdul du rlog /khro gtum 'bar zhing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ steng phyogs tshangs pa'i gdon tsho gos bzlog par mdzod/ shar phyogs khro bo rnam par rgyal ba mthing / /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /skye/ shar phyogs brgya byin gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /shar lho khro bo dbyug pa sngon po nag /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ shar lho me lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i gshed po mun pa'i mdog /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /lho phyogs 'chi bdag gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /lho nub khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo —587

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)mthing / /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ lho nub srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /nub phyogs khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog nag /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kya/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ nub phyogs klu dbang (16na) gdon tsho gos bzlog par mdzod/ zhub byang khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub sngo/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ /nub byang rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /byang phyogs khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba mthing / /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /byang shar khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal nag /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ byang —588

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanashar 'gyung po'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /'og phyogs khro bo'i rgyal po stobs chen mthing / /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di ba che kha la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /phye/ 'og phyogs sa bdag gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor bar 'khyams gshin rje dmag gi tshogs/ sha za khrag 'thung srog gcod lam la dga'/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /drag po zor gyi dpung la gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /chags che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zor kha rlung kha bsgyur ba'i las mdzod cig /mye/ byang phyogs dpag tshad brgyad khri mar 'das na/ /thod pa lcags kyi mun khang nag po'i dbus/ /las kyi gshin rje ral pa tshar dgu ni/ /sbug nag zhal gcig phyag kyang gnyis pa ste/ /g.yas pa thod dbyug g.yon pa dud khrag 'dzin/ /dam nyams dgra bo khrams la 'debs par byed/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di ba che khi yul/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ khram la thob la 'khor lo bskor la sgrol/ /lo dang zla bar bzhag pa'i skabs med pas/ /zhag dang za mar ma bzhag myur du sgrol/ /phye/ de yi thugs dam rgyud bskul chen mo ni/ /gtum mo dug hrul gos gyon skye 'gro'i gshed/ /srid gsum ltor gnas las kyi rlung dmar zhen/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ 'dus pa'i nad thod gshin rje'i lag tu thod/ /mye/ phyogs bzhi grub pa thod pa'i lcags mkhar nas/ /dgra bo'i gshed ma sgrol ba'i ging chen bzhi/ /ya ma rā dza myos byed 'bar ba dang / /a rla ma ru ral pa tshar dgu (16ba)bzhi/ /gdug pa'i sku mdog smug ser dmar ljang nag /dbyug pa brdeg cing bdud zhags nag po 'phen/ /las kyi yum chen bzhi dang bcas pa rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di —589—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (16)bzhes la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /mgo bskor yid dkrugs khrag tu skyug pa dang / /rnam shes gzir la myur du sgrol bar mdzod/ /phye/ gshin rje'i bka' bsgrub dgra gshed mon pa bzhi/ /dung gi mon pa lcags kyi mon pa dang / /bse yi mon pa gser gyi mon pa bzhi/ /seng ge stag dred khyung gi mgo bo dgu/ /g.yas rnams be con g.yon rnams dgra snying 'dzin/ /mon mo bzhi ni lcags kyu thegs pa bsnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bceXs la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /nyes byed dgra bo gzugs phung rnam shes phrol/ /pha tshan yul 'khor mi nor sdodapung choms/ /rang dbang med par skad cig brlag par gyis/ /mye/ gshin rje'i bshan pa bdud po sde bzhi ni/ /zhe sdang me 'bar 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khyil/ /nga rgyal ri nyil gti mug dug mtsho'i klong / /sngo nag khrag rus dud kha kham pa'i mdog /'byung bzhi'i rang bzhin rtsa bzhi 'jib cing gcod/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /rtsa bzhi chod la 'byung bzhi'i dngas ma sdus/ /klad khrag dkrugs la khong khrag skyug tu chug /lus sems phrol la tshe yi 'du byed stungs/ /mye/ grub pa'i thod pa lcags kyi mun khang nas/ /las kyi 'chi bdag khram bdag bcu gnyis kyang / /las kyi sring mo chung mar bcas pa rnams/ /mun pa'i klong nas 'dir byon 'phrin las mdzod/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di/ /gzer nad tsha ba'i nad dang khrag skyug dang / /(17na) cho 'phrul 'brum nag mkhris pa sha ya dang / /mdze nad lhog gzer skya rbab bal nad dang / /skrangs 'bur rimasand ga'o gos skams nad rnams kyis/ /myur du gzir la tshe yi 'du byed bkums/ /phye/ dpal chen gshin rje'i sgo ba chen po bzhi/ shar lho nub byang bsrung ba'i pho nya'i tshogs/ /dkar po snying 'byin mgon po nag po dang / /bdud po yab rje gnod sbyin bshan pa ste/ /phyag na 'khor lo thun khrag ber khrab gsol/ /yum mchog mkha' 'gro ro langs mched bzhir bcas/ /ma tre ro dbyug lcags kyu dril bu bsnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /sgo ba rnam bzhis dgra bo'i dus mtha' stungs/ /sgo —590

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma6)ma bzhi yis dgra bo kha 'phung thong / /phye/ srog gcod ru dra sde bzhi dregs pa'i tshogs/ /pho gshed mo gshed bdun brgya nyi shu dang / /yang 'khor gshin rje dgu 'bum dgu khri rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la/ /bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po'i zhabs drung du/ /sngon gyi dam bcas tshul bzhin mna' bor ba/ /dam las ma 'da' bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dmar sbreng zhing bzlog bsgyur ni/ phye/ chos dbyings drag pos yi zhing khams su: rdo rje ra gur ye shes me dpung dbus dregs pa sde brgyad chu glang ma he'i steng : dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku mdog mthing nag dug chen ha la'i mdog: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad:rno dbal mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams: dpa' brjid dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis klubs: sku ni mi bzad gar gyi (17ba〉nyams dgur ldan: gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ltar brngam sgra: thugs ni chos dbyings spros bral snying rje'i ngang : yon tan mchog mthun dngos grub ster ba'i mdzod: 'phrin las dgra bgegs byad ma sgrol ba'i gshed: bde gshegs khro rgyal kun gyi rje bo che: rab 'jigs gshin rje mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor khyod kyis mi bzlog mi bsgyur gang yang med: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi mi mthun 'gal rkyen gnod pa'i phyogs rnams kun: da nub bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: stong nyid shes rab ma mo kun gyi gtso: gnyis med sbyor yum pe ta nag mo dang : sgrol ba'i yum mchog e ka dza ṭi mas: mi mthun bdud kyi bar gcod dgra la bzlog: sku gsung thugs sprul dug gsum sgrol ba'i gshed: rdo rje gsum grub sku gsum ngo bo rdzogs tshe srog 'chi bdag chen po rnam gsum gyis: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs thamasacad bzlog tu gsol: ya ma ra tsa myos byed 'bar ba dang / /a rla ma ru ral pa tshar dgu ste: 'jigs byed gshed chen rnam bzhi yum dang bcas: rig sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha bzlog tu gsol: 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal dpal chen khro rgyal chen po rnam pa bcu: rang rang bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: phyogs bcu'i byad dang thod gtang bzlog tu gsol: sa bdag gdon —591—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'joms mkha' lding khyung chen dang : phyogs skyong sgo bsrung bka' nyan las byed bcas: gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: bstan dgra gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang : (18na)mi mthun 'brul 'khor thams cad bzlog tu gsol zor gyi rabs dang bcas bzlog pa ni/ bh+yo/ sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung / /bcom ldan rgyal ba shākya thub la/ /lhas byin bdud kyi bar chad byung / /bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje yis/ /dmar chen khrag gi zor brgyab pas/ /lhas byin ngan pa khrag tu skyugs/ /bdud kyi dmag dpung brgyal zhing bog /bar du bzlog pa gang nas byung / /rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /mu stegs snyen pa'i chad pa byung / pa gor be+e ro tsa na yis/ /dmar chen khrag gi zor brgyab pas/ /mu stegs ngan pa rtsad nas bcad/ /tha mar bzlog na 'dir ltar bzlog /mye/ drag po e yi gzhal yas na/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i gdan stengs su/ /bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /sku mdog mthing nag stong gsum gang / /ral pa kham nag srid rtser khyab/ /steng phyogs lha rnams ma lus bzlog /thod skam rin chen lnga yas brgyan/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i dmag dpung bzlog /spyan dgu dmar zlum bgrad pa yis/ /gza' dang rgyu skar dmag dpung bzlog /ag tshoms sma ra me 'bar bas/ /las kya gshin rje'i dmag dpung bzlog /mche ba bcu gnyas zla tshes gtams/ /las kyi bshan pa'i dmag dpung bzlog /dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa yis/ /pho rgyud dmag dpung thams cad bzlog /zhal nas khrag zhag rgya mtshor 'bab/ /mo rgyud dmag dpung thams cad bzlog /g.yas kyi mtshon cha 'bar ba yis/ /bdud dang srin po'i dmag dpung bzlog /g.yon gyi phyag mtshan bsnams pa yis/ /(18ba)drag po btsan gyi gnod pa bzlog /rdo rje 'bar ba'i khyung gshog gis/ /dregs byed pho mo'i gnod pa bzlog /dbu gtsug khyung chen 'bar ba yis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan gnod pa bzlog /ba spu rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'gyed/ /byad kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong bzlog /gshin rje'i tshogs kyis bskor ba yis/ /lha srin sde brgyad gnod pa bzlog /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa'i/ /lha srin 'khrug pa'i gdug rtsub rnams/ /'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /dga' bo 'jog po la sogs —592

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(khanapa'i/ /klu srin 'khrug pa'i gdug rtsub rnams/ /gzi brdzid stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /gang ba bzang po la sogs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin 'khrug pa'i gdub rtsub rnams/ /'jigs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /za byed rngam pa la sogs pa/ /srin po 'khrug pa'i gdug rtsub rnams/ /rngam pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ kha 'bar rgyal mo la sogs pa/ /yi dwags zhabrug pa'i gdug rtsub rnams/ /bzhad pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /phag gdong 'jigs pa sha za'i gdon/ /gtum pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /bi na ya ka bgegs kyi gdon/ /'gying ba'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/khyab 'jug byi nu gza' yi gdon/ /dregs pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ khram thogs gri thogasaging gi gdon/ /sprul pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ kha bzhin mgyogs pa btsan gyi
