gdon/ khros pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /tel pa phya sang gshin rje'i gdon/ /sprul pa'i stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /ral gcig nag mo ma mo'i gdon/ /gsung gi stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /rol pa skya bdun dmu yi gdon/ /mgo brnyan stobs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /ma hā de wa mu stegs gdon/ /bden pa'i stobs (19na)kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /bh+yo/ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: gnod cing bar du gcod pa yi ltas ga brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog ye 'phrog sum brgya drug cu bzlog slo bur bdun brgya nyi shu bzlog bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad bzlog sgeg chen sum brgya drug stobazlog: lha chen drag po'i gdug rtsub bzlog: lha ma yin gyi rgyu stabs bzlog mgon po'i par bu bskor ba bzlog gshin rje'i 'brul 'khor bcas pa bzlog drang srong bram ze'i dmod pa bzlog gza' yi gi rkang 'phen pa bzlog btsan nad gzer kha gtong ba bzlog sa bdag klu yi mdze nad bzlog brje'i 'bum bskor byed pa bzlog sngags pa'i sngags thor 'phen pa bzlog bon gyi btso dmar 'phen pa bzlog mu stegasang na sngags byed pa bzlog byad phur rbod gtong byung ba bzlog mnan gtad bsreg 'bangasabyas pa bzlog snga zhags mda' ltar 'phen pa bzlog phyi zhags dru ltar 'thul ba bzlog yas kyi —593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bdud du g.yos pa bzlog /kyims sri ru langs pa bzlog /pha tshan nang gi rgya 'dre bzlog /ma tshan ngan pa'i dug 'dre bzlog /mo btab mo ru ngan pa bzlog /rtsis byas rde'u ngan pa bzlog /khyim gang mi yi nad 'dre bzlog /sgo gang nor gyi god 'dre bzlog /ban bon sngags pa'i zor kha bzlog /mgon pos sbyin sreg byed pa bzlog /ma mos thun zor 'phen pa bzlog /yungs kar khro bo'i rbab zor bzlog /ban+de yongs kyi sngags byad bzlog /dbang phyug chen po'i par bu bzlog /klu bdud nag po'i (19ba) gtad khram bzlog /bon po yongs kyi lha byad bzlog /bal po'i ngan sngags sbyor ba bzlog /rgya gar chos kyi mthu byed bzlog /mar pas phra min gtong ba bzlog /sum pas glang dmar rmo ba bzlog /mi lhag 'bo le thams cad bzlog /bod kyis rbod gtong byed pa bzlog /bram ze'i sngags rgod dmod pa bzlog /dri zas smyos shing 'thibs pa bzlog /rgyal pos spyo 'bog gtonge ba bzlog khrin pos shod khagatonge ba bzlog /bdud sa khram yi tab pa bzlog /btsan gyis zhags la 'phen pa bzlog /gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debasapa bzlog /'byung pos nyams len byed pa bzlog /mtshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa bzlog /the'u rang sri la rku ba bzlog /glo bur ye 'byog thams cad bzlog /'byung pos god 'dre byed pa bzlog /se rags sris la rku ba bzlog /dar tshan nang gi stong 'dre bzlog /bdud btsan yongs kyi gnod 'dre bzlog /ma mo rnams kyi rims nad bzlog /nad dang mtshon gyi dru bu bzlog /rims nad gag lhog gzer gsum bzlog /mi nad sna dgu thams cad bzlog /rgan sri dar sri thams cad bzlog /byis pa'i chung sri thams cad bzlog /bdud kyi cho tog phrul gang ba bzlog /gshin gyi dur sri langs pa bzlog /rus la tshig ngan gtong ba bzlog /snag la mtshan ngan 'dogs pa bzlog /rta nad nor nad thams cad bzlog /lo dgra btsa' dang sad ser bzlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog /ltas ngan nyi khri tshig stong bzlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog /phyi yi ltasang na phyi ru bzlog /bar gyi ltasang na dbyings su bzlog /byad ma lha srung bcas pa bzlog /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun bzlog bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas bzlog sgyur ro 'jam dpal mthu yis bsgyur zor ro dgra dang bgegs la zor bcom —594

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)(20na skon gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs: dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la byad dang rbod gtong bsgyur ba dang : bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod: zho ya mān+ta ka rtsi tri dgra bgegs a mu kai mā ra ya rbad bzlog trig nan/ gzer nan/ rbud thums bzlog: phyogs rngubs mā ra ya dur na bzlog:gnod byed rū pa tsit+ta ha na da ha pa tsa tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: mā ra ya rbad bzlog mdos la ma 'then la sgo dbye ba ni/ hūṃ/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la rigs 'dzin bdag gi bka' la nye sgo: dmar chen drag po'i gtor zor 'di lha srin tsho gos la 'phen snyam ste: dkar po'i phyogs la mi 'phen no: khyed rnams rang rang gnas la gshegs: ྅/ rnal 'byor zor 'phen gang du 'phen sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su 'phen:phyogs der gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: sku gzur dbu smod zhabs bsdus la do nub zor gyi zor lam phye: 'khor bcas drag po'i dmag sna drongs sdang dgra gnod bgegs phyogs su khyer: ྅/ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: khrag 'thung kun gyi rgyal po yin bka' 'khor las byed stong gsum gang : thams cad drag po'i las la phyos: sgrol byed drag po zor gyi rdzas sdang dgra gnod bgegasaphyogs su 'phen gtor zor thog ltar shar ra ra: khrag thor mtsho ltar khyil li li: mda' zor 'byug ltar thigs se zhug: rdo zor rbab ltar nyil li li: thun zor ser ltar shar ra ra (20ba) dug zor mun ltar thibs se thib: drag po sna tsho gos zor gyi rdzas: sdang ba dgra yi snying la yu: bdun brgyud chod cig mā ra ya gnod pa bgegs kyi snying la yuḥ med par cho mes shig mā ra ya: yul mkhar khyim la gtor zor yuḥ rdul du rlog cig mā ra ya: bdag 'dzin bdud la gtor zor yuḥ gnyis med sgrol cig mā ra ya: dmag lho'i tshul du thog mar tshogs lhag btang / de nas chad mtho ni/ /hūṃ/ sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings gnas mchog tu/ /bcom ldan 'jam dpal kun tu bzang po yis/ /sgra tshig bya rtsol bral ba'i rgyud gsungs tshe/ /rang las mi yin rig pa'i rang gdangs 'khor/ /mkha' la 'ja' ltar shar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rang byung rang shar rtogs grol dus gcig tu/ /blang du med pa'i dam tshig ma —595

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)bcas 4 / /snang rig don gtor len par ma chad dam/ khas blangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di long la/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de 'og bskal pa bar ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo sa /sku yi rigs 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis/ /'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs nas/ /zla gsang rgyud don man ngag la bsdebs tshe/ /gshin rje drug khrisasrog snying rab phul nas/ /bka' yi gtor len rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong / /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par ma chad dam/ khas blangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di long la/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de 'og dur khrod sgrub pa'i gnas chen tshor/ /gtsug lag dpal dge dha na da la dang / thung gar+bha bha su dha ra sogs/ /drag sngags bka' babs rigs 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i dngos grub grub pa'i tshe/ /las kyi gshin rje'i srog snying rab phul nas/ /bka' yi gtor len rnal 'byor bu bzhin stong / /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par ma chad dam/ khasablangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di long la/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de 'og bskal pa tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /'phrin las (21na〉sgrub gnas yar klungs shel brag tu/ /pad+ma thod phreng jo mo mkhar wo bza'/ /sgra sgyur chen po be+e ro tsa na yis/ /dregs pa 'joms byed dkyil 'khor zhal phye dus/ /ma gshin dregs pa'i srog snying rab phul nas/ /bka' yi gtor len rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong / /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par ma chad dam/ khas blangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di long la/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de 'og rtsub 'gyur lnga brgya'i bskal pa la/ /rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang du/ /'khor 'das dbang sgyur pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /slob ma'i dngas ma 'gro 'dul gling pa yis/ /'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /ral pa tshar dgus srog snying rab phun nas/ /bka' yi gtor len rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong / /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par ma chad dam/ khas blangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di long la/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /da lta sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams pa/ /smin —596

'jam dpal me'i skru gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)grol man ngag chad med brgyud 'dzin pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin sngags yong bdag gis gshin rje'i gshed/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs nas 'phrin las bcol ba'i tshe/ /las gshin gtsor gyur sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis/ /bka' yigatore len rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong / /'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par ma chad dam/khas blangs ji bzhin gtor ma 'di long la/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas phyi rol du gser skyems btang zor 'phen pa ni/ rtsang dmar mtshe yungs thun rdzas me/ /sna tshogs rdzas kyis bar btags pa'i/ /drag po'i kong bu zur gsum can/ /dug dang mtshon char byin brlabs pa/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs steng du bh+yo/ /srog rtsa chod las rdul du rlog /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /sgrub sngags mjug tu e ya ma ra tsa sha / rū pa trig nan srog rtsi tri hur thums dza: mā ra ya rbad bh+yo: phung shul dur khrod la sogs pa'i 'jigs su rung ba'i rdo nag po/ /drag po rdzas kyisang ra btags pa/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs steng du bh+yo/ /srog rtsa chod las rdul du rlog /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /(21ba)dug chen tsher ma'i shing dag la/ /ltas ga 'byung po'i sgro yis brgyan/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mde'u btsugs/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs steng du bh+yo/ khrog rtsa cho de las rdul du rlog /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ khru gsum sa yi kong bu'i nang / /dmar nag khrag gi mtsho bskyil bar/ /ha la nag po'i ngar btags pa/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs steng du bh+yo/ /srog rtsa chod las rdul du rlog /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i snod nang du/ /'bru nag dar btags dpal gtor la/ /drag po'i rdzas kyisanyer brgyan pa/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs steng du bh+yo/ khrog rtsa cho de las rdul du rlog /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces dmigs pa dang bcas dgra bgegs bar chod thams cad rdul du brlag par bsam zhing bsrung ba ni/ hūṃ/ dang po thig le nyag gcig rgya/ /gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya/ /gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya/ /—597

yo dbang lnga pa ngag dbang sbo bzang rgya mtsho gsung tshom/ (6)lnga pa rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rgya/ /drug pa thub pa drug gi rgya/ /bdun pa sangs rgyas rabs bdun rgya/ /brgyad pa sems dpa' brgyad kyi rgya//dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya//bcu pa khro bo bcu yi rgya//bcu gcig skyon pad+ma'i rgya//bcu gnyis rnal sor bdag gi rgya//bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgya//bcu bzhi phan chad mya ༅ 'das//myag 'das pa'i pha rol na//snang srid 'khor 'das dgrar langs kyang //dgra zhes bya ba'i ming yang med//bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med//mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub//bsrung sngags bzla zhing me chus rgyas 'debs/gtor gzhed gi bshal chus bstan ma bskyang wo sgo drung du bro brdung //nang du slebs nas tshe 'gugs//gto rag ni/:phyi nang wo spyod sman rag gtor gsum sogs//kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs//gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor 22na tha cas la//'bul gyis bzhes la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol//gshin rje'i gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa brjod de/nongs pa bzod par gsol/rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya kho med na gshegasagasol dang dkyil 'khor nyer sdu byed/smon lam ni/dge ba 'di yis bdud bzhi'i dpung bcom ste//kun bzang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sa brnyes nas//rang don mthar phyin mkha' mnyam sems can rnams//phan dang bde ba'i dpal la spyod par shog mas pa brjod pa na/sku yi rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //'jam dpal zhi khro yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//ma dang mkha' 'gro las gshin srung ma yi//bkra shis phyogs dus kun tu khyab par shog/gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs bya'o//zla gsang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud phyung ba//sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyon zhal gyi lung //drag sngags bka' babs be+e ro tsa na yi//zab chos dregs pa 'joms byed gshin rje'i skor/zhal brag ri bor rgyas btab gsang ba'i gter//'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pas spyan drangs pa/khog ser dri ngad ldang ba'i tsan+dan ljon//dgra bgegs tsha gdung gzhil ba'i cho ga mkhan//gang gi 'phrin las bzhi dang khyad par du//drag sbyor mngon spyod nang tshan zor gyi las//gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog gi mda' chen pos//dgra bgegs sdo brgyad mgo bo cig car 'gems/3/'di ko rtsod bral sprul pa'i gter ston gyis//bklags cho go 98

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)tshul du sgrigs zhes skabs dbye ltar/ /lung zin chos kyi bdag por nyer rlom pa'i/ /za hor sngags spyon (22ba〉ba 'ad pa rtsal gyis bkod/ 4 /bsod nams btsug na zla ba'i mig gi mes/ /dgra bgegs dga' rab dbang phyug lus bsregs nas/ /thub bstan sum rtsen lha rnams rgyal ba'i rnga/ /brdungs pa 'a sgra yis 'jig rten kun khyab shog 5 /ces rnam snang lo tswa'i yang srid gter chen chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pas yar klungs shel ri rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i byang 'dabs kyi brag ngos nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal dregs pa 'joms byed kyi smad las drag po zor gyi skor chog sgrigs bklags chog ma zhig bris zhes rigs 'dzin chen po nyid kyi gsung dang du blangs te smad las gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog mda' 'di ni za hor gyi sngags rgan zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyis gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rnams rang sor bzhag /kha 'geng dgos pa sgrol chen bsam grub rdo rjes mdzad pa'i tshe bdag gi 'phrin las 'bring po/'bri khung lugs kyi yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i lhan thabs rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog gis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong gis da las/ byang gter phur bzlog gi cho ge bsgrigs rnams las blangasashing / gser skyems/ ling ro 'bul ba'i 'phrin bcol/ chad mtho sogs 'ga' zhig rang blos gsar du bskrun te yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo rnam 'dren shākya seng ges gzhan sde tshar bcad pa'i cho 'phrul gyi dus chen dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa la rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // sarba maṅga lo// //—599

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)'chi bdag zhal dbye'i phrin las rgyun 'byer tshig nyung don gsal ba bzhugs so/ /mthu stobs mi bzad 'bar ba'i rdo rje yis/ /bdud dpung phyer 'thag pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /drag sngags bdag po gnubs chen yab sras/ /ba ched gzhung 'chi bdag 'phrin las rgyun 'khyer 'dri/ /rten dang phyi nang dam rdzas nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams 'du bgyis/ mchod rdzas rnams/ byungasabasangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dgra bgegs gdug pa can mtha' dag bsgral ba las byung ba'i khrag gi yon chab/ dbang po'i me rta ge sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ /tsit+ta'i zhal zas/ rkang chen gyi gling bu la sogs mchode pa'i rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā dza sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ra ya tsa ni/ bhe wa satwa dza ma ri hūṃ/ sarba 'bu pa ta ya pa ti/ ar+gha āḥ&/ pus nas shasta'i bar brjod/chang la chos sman btab na ched gnyer brlab mi dgos shing med kyang bdag bskyed kyi dus song bas chad skyon med/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs rlung me thod pa'i snyed bu gsum la gnas(2na lnga'i a lasabhan+ta'i snong lcang lor bcas pa gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du snu dang tri las rnam par dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha khrag la ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam/ ā+oṃ ma hā ba lin+ta hūṃ lha'i lan gsum/ rak+ta bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar srid gsum dgra bgegasagadug pa can ma lus pa bsgral ba las byung ba'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po lha 'phreng rba rlabs lho zhing yongs su gang ba las kyi gshin rje'i lha tsho gos dgyes pa bskyed nus par bsam/ ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ lha'i lan gsum gyis brlab bo/ /las khung dang rten bsangs sbyangs/ stong khri'i ngang las ye las lcags khang sgo med zur gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyi lcags mkhar thod pa'i ra bas bskor —600

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha) ba'i nang mun pa nag po'i gling phrag dog gi rlung gis zhe sdang gi me sbar zhing 'dod chags kyi khrag dug khol ba'i rlangs pas gti mug gi mun pa 'thibs pa'i dbus su lcags mkhar gcig /de'i phyi rol tu rim pa bzhin lcags mkhar brgyad/ bcu gnyis/ mun pa'i gling / lcags mkhar bcu drug (2ba)rnams 'jigs shing rngam pa dur khrod kyi rdzas las grub pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa 'chi bdag gshin rje'i pho brang 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dbus kyi lcags mkhar du dgra bo gan rkyal kha sbub tu brdzis pa'i ma he nag po kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa rno ngar dang ldan pa'i rwa gdengs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i steng ya nag po las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ log 'dren dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'chi bdag gshin rje bhe wa sa twa sku mdog rdo sol ltar gnag pa srin po'i zhal can/ rab tu khros pa'i gnyer ma smin mtshams su bsdus shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs pa/ gnam sa lta bu'i zhal gdangs pa las rlangs pa dug gi me lcer 'bar ba/ tshems dang mche ba gangs ri lta bu'i bar nas ljags glog bzhin 'khyug pa'i gra nas khrag rgyun 'dzag pa dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra rnams me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas be con 'phyar zhing g.yon gnam lcags las grub pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor ba/ gsus khyim che zhing lto ba 'phyang ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa/ rgyu ma dang dug sprul khrag zhag gi thig les brgyan cing zhabs gnyis pa/ ma he lan nas stong gsum myul ba/ bh+yo las gtum mo dug hrul ma nag mo khro zhing rngam pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag bzung nas dgra la nad yams gtong zhing las kyi rlung dmar la zhon pa/ gnyis ka'ang me rlung zhabrug pa'i klong dkyil (3na sko bzhugs pa/ yab yum de gnyis kyi sto bar srid pa'i grong khyer lcags mkhar pas drug phyi nang du ma me da k+ṣe/ rā tsa sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya dza ni rnams dang nang gi dbus su ya yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i las gshin yab yum gyi 'khor du gshed bzhi khram thogs bcu gnyis sogasalha srin sde brgyad bu yug ltar 'tshub pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las byed pa'i bdag nyid can du —601—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (26)bsam/ 'chi bdag yab yum gyi 'khor du lcags mkhar brgyad kyi nang na phyogs kyi yi ge bzhi lasagashed bzhi grub pa ni/ shar du gshin rje ya ma rā dza smug nag /lhor bdud po myos byed 'bar ba ser nag zhub tu srin po ār+ya ma ru dmar nag /byang du gnod sbyin ral pa tshar dgu ljang nag /bzhi ga'ang g.yas rim bzhin rdo rje rin cen pad+ma rgya gram gyis mtshan ba'i be con dang g.yon mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir gshed mo bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu yi ge bcu gnyis las khram bdag bcu gnyis grub pa ni shar nas brtsams te g.yas skor du bdud 'joms/ dmar po/ kong tse brag 'joms/ mig dmar/ mgo dgu/ lha mchog /a ba glang mgo /tel pa/ ya bti/ stag mgo /phya sangs/ chos rgyal rnams rang rang gi chung ma dang bcas pa'i yab rnams g.yas dbyug to dang g.yon zhags pa/ yum rnams g.yas spu gri dang g.yon thod khrag thogs pa/ de dag gi 'khor du gshin rje pho mo bdun brgya nyi shu/ sha za yi dwags 'jig rten dregs pa'i tsho gos 'jigs su rung bas sa gzhi bar snang (3bgi khyon thams cad gang bar bsam/ spyan dbye ni/ ya ma rā dza ni dza: snyi/ ya mān+ta kṛ ta tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa/ snyan dbye ni/ ya man tsakra gra ha pra be sha sha shangs dbye ni/ : yaṃ dra / / zhal dbye ni/ha ha pra be sha khā hi/ drag por 'gyur ba ni/tri po pra be sha badz+ra a du sha lo/ bzhengs bskul ni/ muñja ba sil/ zhes brjod/ lag g.yas be con dang g.yon lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ ā+oṃ na mo brnya ya/dharma sa rnye saḥ ta thā ga ta kro ta bi dza ya a lha li tā pra tsa shi ka pra ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ be con sa gzhir bsnun pas sa gzhi gas nas sgo bye/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros te las kyi gshin rje'i snying ga'i ya la 'phog pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng rgya mtsho chen po'i 'og gshin rje bhe wa sa twa 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis glog 'khyug pa ltar bkug par bsams la/ 'bod pa'i brda lan gsum/ bsdug glu lan gsum/ mi rkang 'bud thengs gsum/ thal mo ro gsum brdab/ dar nag gisaphyogs bzhi nas lan gsum re g.yab cing thod rnga dang rdza rnga brdung zhing sha tshal gyi dud pa btang ste/ hūṃ/'di nas byang phyogs ri rab chen po'i mong / /dpag tshad brgyad rdzi thur du zug pa nas/ /lcags kyi khang pa —602

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma(kha)sgo med na/ /yid kyis rgyu ba'i sgo can na/ /phyogs phyogs mi ros gtams pa'i gnas mchog na/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje chen po dang / /bdud kyi rgyal mo dug hrul gos gyon ma/ /las kyi gshed po khram bdag yab yum rnams/ /srid gsum lto na 'chang zhing 'gal byed zhags pas (4na) 'dren/ /be con 'khor lo bskor zhing dam nyams rtsad nas gcod/ /bstan pa gnyan bsrung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ /tha tshig gnyan po thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi/ /dam tshig rjes su dran zhing dmar chen dam la bh+yo/ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā dzos do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni/ sgye was twa/ dzom ri hūṃ/ a ra li to/ dzaḥ〉 baṃ ho sam ya ri/ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūṃ/ grub pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje sring mo'i tshogs/ /ming dang srog tu brjod pas grub pa'i tshogs/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig dam tshig rjes dran zhing / grub pa'i las rnams sngon tshe khas blangasate/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir dam tshig brtan par bzhugs/ /ya ma chad k+ṣe/ rwadzos do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ra ya tsa ni/ sam ya/ ya na ma ra/ a dhi ti byu sam ya lhan/ zil gyis gnon pa ni/ bya 'i phyag rgya bstan te/ ā+oṃ shrī mañju kro ta sgo sarba du/ bhan+ta ya phaṭa/ dbang du bsdub ni/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ hūṃ/ 'jig rten 'chi bdag gshin rje mthu chen rnams/ /'jigs rung las kyi rdzu 'phrul stobs chen las/ /ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyi byin stobs kyis/ /'jig rten gdug pa 'dul ba'i ye shes dang / /srid pa'i snying khrag 'dren pa'i ting 'dzin nga la yod/ /nga ni bgegs chen 'dul ba yi/ /sangs rgyasargya'aphrul bdag sbyong bas/ /bgegs kyi tsho gos rnamasang la 'dul lo/ /ā+oṃ phyiX li kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa mahā pi ka /dzi bi ta an+ta ka ra/ sarba du sha sto ba ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dam tshig bstan pa ni/ rdo rje rtse gnyis pa'i phyag rgya (4ba tha stan te/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe dpal chen gshin rje'i gshed/ khro mchog 'bar ba'i sku mnga' des/ /'chi bdag gshin rje gzir nag ni/ /dregs pa spongs nas srog snying phul/ /pho brang 'khor du dam tshig byin/ /sku gsung thugs su bdag sbyor ba'o/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag 'dir/ /rtag tu dam tshig tshul bzhin gyis/ /bhe wa satwa/ sam ye sam ya thā/ dam bsgrag ni/ be cen gyi phyag rgya bstan te/ hūṃ/ 'chi bdag nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rang sems dpang du rab btsugs la/ /dam —603

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (6)tshig dag la gnas par gyis//'gal na mgo bo tshal par 'gas//ya ma rā dzā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/rdo rje mna' chu sbyin pa ni/chu ster ba'i stangs/dang bcas te/hūṃ/'di ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed//spyan sngar khas blangs rdo rje'i chu//ma nyams dngos grub 'thob byed cing //'gal na mgo 'gas dmyal bar lhung /ya ma rā dzas rda ho pa k+ṣa sam yas rda na ra skan/rdo rje'am phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag par mos te/hoḥ'achi bdag las kyi gshin rje bhe wa sa twa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs kyi dam tshig dran par gyis la mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod cig/ya ma rā dza badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/khrag gi mchod yon ni/hūṃ/grub pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs//'phung byed sha khragazhal gsol te//dmar chen khrag las ldan ma ya//mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di la rol//ya ma me da k+ṣe/rā dza sa do/ru ṇa yo ni/ra ya tsa ni/kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ma hā rak+ta pra tismo ho.a: pra la kha raṃ khā hi/bzed zhal du sbreng /wo spyod ni/hūṃ/las kyi gshin rje 'khor casal//dbang po'i tshe rta ge rnam par bkra sha chen dud pa sprin bzhin gtings//tshil chen mar tshe nyi ltar gsal//mkhris pa'i dri chab rba klong 'khrug sha rus zhal zas ri ltar spungs//thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'bul//dag bgegs sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ya ma me da k+ṣe/rā dza sa do/ru ṇa yo ni/rā ya tsa ni/kā la3 pa ya ma rā dza pur+sha nas sha lta pra tisnroswāhā/sman ni/hūṃ/rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i//bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni//'chi bdag gshin rje'i tsho gos la 'bul//bzhes nas 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ya ma me da k+ṣe/rā dza sa do/ru ṇa yo ni/ra ya tsa ni/kā la3 pa ya ma rā dza ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/rak+ta ni/hūṃ/mi dang srog chags sna tsho gos pa//bsad khrag rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di//'chi bdag gshin rje'i tsho gos la 'bul//bzhes nas 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod//ya ma me da k+ṣe/rā dza sado/ru ṇa yo ni/ra ya tsa ni/kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ma hā rak+ta a skṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/gtor ma ni/phyugs li sha dang khrag dang rkang //lta ba rus pa bdud rtsi /༷//dbang po si byed 'dod yon lnga//'dod yon

'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i dmod pa zor bskul rdo rje pha lam/ nang ma6)bdud rtsi'i ting 'dzin (5ba)gyis/ /grub pa'i gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ha ha hi hi kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bha li mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā dza sa do/ ru ṇa yo na/ ra ya tsa ni/ kā la ྅ pa ya ma rā dza ma hā bha lin+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā mo sa'i hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā bha su ta khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā skru n-i ti khā hi/ lan gsum brjod/ nas nag 'thor zhing / ho/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs rnams la sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang da 'chol sgrub pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rten du mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di 'bul gyis bzhes la rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis bcol ba'i drag po'i las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/mun pa'i mdog can srin po'i gzugs/ /ma he thon nas stong gsum myul/ /sna tshogs mtsho ni chas dgra srog gcod/ /'chi bdag nag po khyod la bstod/ /sbyor yum gtum mo ro gos ma/ /las kyi gshed bzhi gshed mo dang / khram bdag brgya gnyis chung mar bcas/ /'khor gyi bka' nyan rnams la bstod/ /sprul pa yang sprul la sogs pa/ /rab 'jigs gshin rje'i dmag tsho gis dang / /snang srid lha srin sdebargyad kyi/ /'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do/ /bzlas pa ni las gshin gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la ya yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs gar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ bdag ya mā ri'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa las gshin gyi (6na)thugs ga'i sa bon sngags 'khor dang bcas pa la 'phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas bdag gis gang bsgo ba'i 'phrin las thams cad skad cig la bsgrub cing las gshin gyi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pa 'khor rnams snying kha'i sa bon la 'phog pas rang dbang med par las la bskul te 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsam/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs thams cad du spros pas snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs thams cad las la bskul te 'phrin las thams cad da lta nyid du bsgrub par bsam/ ā+oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ya ma me da k+ṣe/ rā dza sa do/ ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya —605

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (26)me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe ya ts+tsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'bum gsum dang bye ba sogs rtags dang bstun nas bzla/ thun mtshams su bskul dang bsgral mchod gzhung bzhin bya/bshags pa ni/ gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya bzla/ /hūṃ bdag sogs ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /mchod pa yo byad ma tshang dang / /ma dag mi gtsang rdzas kyis sbags/ /'phrin las nor 'khrul thams cad bshags/ /bzod par mdzod la las rnams kun/ /thogs med grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /bzhugs gsol ni/ nas nag gi me tog dang bcas/ hūṃ/ las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /'chi bdag rang gzugs dngos grub pa'i/ /drag po'i rten mchog 'di nyid la/ /rtag tu bzhugs (6ba) la las mdzod cig /ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ bkra shis ni/ hūṃ/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /pad gsabs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /dngos grub ma lus thogs pa med stsol ba'i/ /yi dam tshe bdag nag po'i bkra shis shog /mthu stobs nus pas de gra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /las kyi gshin rje'i lha tshogs bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma yi/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /me tog gis phyogs kun khyab par dgram mo/ /de ltar sems can kun la rang mas su/ /yod pa 'i 'chi bdag zhal dbye sgrub pa'i thabs rim bdun sa 'og gnas nas 'bod pa'i brda/ /'phrin las drag po'i rdza rnga 'di brdungs so/ /zhes pa'ang me 'brug gi lo 'chi bdag zhal dbye sgrub pa'i dus tshig nyung don gsal bar za hor gyi sngags smyon drag po rtsal gyis pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// // sarba maṅga le// //—606
